data.anv: राजन् O king दुरात्मनाम् evil minded, एषाम् these, वधाय: to kill, शीघ्रम् quickly, व्यादिश: order, अल्पतेजसा: being short of life, हता: killed, धरण्याम  on the ground, निपतन्तु: will fall down.
data.md: Do you order us, O king, to destroy these vicious-souled demons. These shall crush them to death, limited as is the tenure of their life.

data.v: तेषां संभाषमाणानामन्योन्यं स विभीषणः । उत्तरं तीरमासाद्य खस्थ एव व्यतिष्ठत ॥
data.es: As they (Vanaras) started conversing, Vibheeshana, having reached the northern shore, stayed in the sky.
data.anv: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, उत्तरम् northern, तीरम् shore, आसाद्य: having reached तेषाम् there, अन्योन्यम् one to the other, सम्भाषमाणानाम् started conversing, खस्थःएव: in the sky, व्यतिष्ठत: stayed.
data.md: They addressing each other in this wise, Vibhīşaņa descended from the sky on the northern shore.

data.v: उवाच च महाप्राज्ञः स्वरेण महता महान् । सुग्रीवं तांश्च संप्रेक्ष्य खस्थ एव विभीषणः ॥
data.es: Great and very wise Vibheeshana, gazing at Sugriva and the Vanaras, addressed them in a loud tone.
data.anv: महाप्राज्ञः very wise, महान् great, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सुग्रीवम् at Sugriva, तांश्च: and those (Vanaras ), सम्प्रेक्ष्य: gazing, सर्वान् all, महता: loud, स्वरेण: tone, उवाच: addressed.
data.md: And beholdings Sugrīva and all others stationed near him, the highly intelligent Vibhīşaņa accosted them, at the highest pitch of his voice, saying.

data.v: रावणो नाम दुर्वृत्तो राक्षसो राक्षसेश्वरः । तस्याहमनुजो भ्राता विभीषण इति श्रुतः ॥
data.es: "I am called Vibheeshana, the younger brother of Ravana, the king of Rakshasas and of evil conduct."
data.anv: रावणोनाम: Ravana by name, दुर्वृत्तः of evil conduct, राक्षसेश्वरः king of Rakshasas, राक्षसः Rakshasa, अहम् I, तस्य: his, अनुजःभ्राता: younger brother, विभीषणइति: as Vibheeshana, श्रुतः called.
data.md: There lives a Raksasa, named Ravana, the lord of demons, and perpetrator of many iniquitous deeds. I am his younger brother known as Vibhişaņa.

data.v: तेन सीता जनस्थानाद्धृता हत्वा जटायुषम् । रुद्ध्वा च विवशा दीना राक्षसीभिः सुरक्षिता ॥
data.es: "Having been carried away from Janasthana by him (Ravana) poor and pitiable Sita is detained and protected by the Rakshasas."
data.anv: तेन: by him, जटायुषम् Jatayu, हत्वा: killing, सीता: Sita, जनस्थानात् from Janasthana, हृता: having been carried away, रुद्दा: detained, विवशा: poor, दीना: pitiable, राक्षसीभिः by Rakshasas, सुरक्षिता: protected.
data.md: By him, slaying the vulture Jatayu, was carried away Sītā from Janasthana. She is imprisoned, brought under his sway, poorly, and being well guarded by the Rakşasees.

data.v: तमहं हेतुभिर्वाक्यैर्विविधैश्च न्यदर्शयम् । साधु निर्यात्यतां सीता रामायेति पुनः पुनः ॥
data.es: "I argued with him again and again in several ways to explain him and admonished him saying 'restore Sita to Rama'."
data.anv: सीता: Sita, साधु: correct, रामाय: to Rama, निर्यात्यताम् इति: to restore, पुनःपुनः again and again, तम् him, अहम् I, हेतुभिः argued also, विविधैः in several ways, वाक्यैः words, न्यदर्शयम् to explain.
data.md: With various well meaning words and reasonings I pointed out to him, the necessity of rendering back Sītā to Rāma.

data.v: स च न प्रतिजग्राह रावणः कालचोदितः । उच्यमानो हितं वाक्यं विपरीत इवौषधम् ॥
data.es: "Impelled by death Ravana would not take good words of advice tendered to him just as one who is impelled by death does not take medicine."
data.anv: सःरावणः that Ravana, कालचोदितः impelled by death, उच्यमानम् advice tendered, हितम् good, वाक्यम् words, विपरीतः contrary to, औषधम् इव: like the medicine, नप्रतिजग्राह: would not take.
data.md: And Ravana, possessed by Death, paid no heed to my well-meaning words, like to one, lying on the brink of death, neglecting the administration of medicine.

data.v: सोऽहं परुषितस्तेन दासवच्चावमानितः । त्यक्त्वा पुत्रांश्च दारांश्च राघवं शरणं गतः ॥
data.es: "Leaving my sons and wife, I have come for protection of Raghava having been put to shame by him (Ravana), spoken to harshly and treated like a slave."
data.anv: तेन: by him, परुषितः spoken to harshly, दासवत् treated like a slave, अवमानितः having been put to shame, सःअहम् that I, पुत्रांश्चदारांश्च: sons and wife, त्वक्त्वा: giving up, राघवम् of Raghava, शरणंगतः came for protection.
data.md: Being reviled by him and treated harshly like a menial, I have come to seek Rāghava's shelter, renouncing my children and wives.

data.v: सर्वलोकशरण्याय राघवाय महात्मने । निवेदयत मां क्षिप्रं विभीषणमुपस्थितम् ॥
data.es: At once you may inform Raghava who is a protector of the whole world that I, Vibheeshana, are waiting here.
data.anv: महात्मने: O great soul, सर्वलोकशरण्याय: one who is a protector of the whole world, राघवाय: Raghava's, विभीषणं: Vibheeshana, माम् I, उपस्थितम् waiting here, क्षिप्रम् at once, निवेदयत: you may inform.

data.v: एतत्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवो लघुविक्रमः । लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतो रामं संरब्धमिदमब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Highly valiant Sugriva having heard all this (from Vibheeshana) eagerly spoke these words to Rama in the presence of Lakshmana.
data.anv: लघुविक्रमः highly valiant, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, एतत् all this, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, लक्ष्मणस्य: Lakshmana's, अग्रतः presence, रामम् Rama's, सम्रब्धतरम् eagerly, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoken.
data.md: Hearing those words the quick-paced Sugrīva, excited with ire, spoke to Rāma, before Laksmana, saying.

data.v: रावणस्यानुजो भ्राता विभीषण इति श्रुतः । चतुर्भिः सह रक्षोभिर्भवन्तं शरणं गतः ॥
data.es: "Ravana's younger brother, known as Vibheeshana, along with four Rakshasas has come to you seeking protection."
data.anv: विभीषणःइति: thus Vibheeshana, श्रुतः heard, रावणस्य: Ravana's, अनुजःभ्रातः younger brother, चतुर्भिः all the four, रक्षोभिःसह: along with Rakshasas, भवन्तम्: to you शरणम् protection, गतः sought.
data.md: Ravana's younger brother, known Vibilisana, uc come here with four Raksasas, to seck your shelter.

data.v: रावणेन प्रणिहितं तमवेहि विभीषणम् । तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये क्षमं क्षमवतां वर ॥
data.es: "O Rama of most forbearing nature Vibheeshana is sent by Ravana. You may consider that he is fit to be arrested, I think."
data.anv: क्षमवताम् one who is forbearing, वर: choicest one, तम् him, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, रावणेन: by Ravana, प्रणितम् sent by, अवेहि: to consider, तस्य: his, निग्रहम् arrest क्षमम् fit, अहम् I, मन्ये: think.
data.md: O you the foremost of forgiving persons, I consider this Vibhīşaņa, who has been despatched by Ravana, worthy of being slain. as

data.v: राक्षसो जिह्मया बुद्ध्या संदिष्टोऽयमुपस्थितः । प्रहर्तुं मायया छन्नो विश्वस्ते त्वयि राघव ॥
data.es: "O Raghava You may know that this Rakshasa is being sent here by deceit ever intending to strike you under the cover of creating confidence."
data.anv: राघव: Raghava, अयम्: this, राक्षसः Rakshasa, जिह्मया: with a crooked, बुदद्या: you may know, संदिष्ट: being send, मायया: by deceit, छन्नः under the cover, विश्वस्ते: creating confidence, त्वयि: to you, प्रहर्तुम् to strike you, इह: here, आगतः came.
data.md: Being impelled by his wicked intention and commissioned by Rävaņa, this Rākşasa has come here and secretly by virtue of his illusive powers he shall slay you, O innocent one, when you shall place confidence in him.

data.v: बध्यतामेष तीव्रेण दण्डेन सचिवैः सह । रावणस्य नृशंसस्य भ्राता ह्येष विभीषणः ॥
data.es: "Let us kill this Vibheeshana by punishment along with his ministers as he is the brother of cruel Ravana (said Sugriva to Rama)."
data.anv: एषः that way, सचिवैः with ministers, तीव्रेण: severe, दण्डेन: by punishment, वध्यताम् will kill, एषःविभीषणः this Vibheeshana, नृशंसस्य: cruel, रावणस्यभ्राताहि: is Ravana's brother.
data.md: Being impelled by his wicked intention and commissioned by Rävaņa, this Rākşasa has come here and secretly by virtue of his illusive powers he shall slay you, O innocent one, when you shall place confidence in him.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा तु तं रामं संरब्धो वाहिनीपतिः । वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यकुशलं ततो मौनमुपागमत् ॥
data.es: The chief of the army (Sugriva) who knew how to speak appropriately having submitted in that manner to Rama who was adept in expression remained silent.
data.anv: वाहिनीपतिः the chief of the army, वाक्यज्ञः one who knows to speak, सम्रब्ध: well, वाक्यकुशलम् one who was adept in expression, तंरामम् him, to Rama, एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा: after having spoken, ततः then, मौनम् silent, उपागमत् remained.
data.md: Having thus accosted Rāma, skilled in the are of speech, that lord of the army, Sugriva, well versed in speech, became silent.

data.v: सुग्रीवस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा रामो महाबलः । समीपस्थानुवाचेदं हनूमत्प्रमुखान्हरीन् ॥
data.es: Rama of great fame having heard the words of Sugriva, addressed the Vanara army including the great Hanuman who stood close by.
data.anv: महायशाः of great fame, रामः Rama, सुग्रीवस्य: Sugriva's, तत् those words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, समीपस्थान् stood close by, हनुमत्प्रमुखान् including the great Hanuman, हरीन् to Vanaras, इदम् thus, उवाच: addressed.
data.md: And hearing the words of Sugrīva, the mighty Rāma spoke to the monkeys, near him, headed by Hanumān, saying.

data.v: यदुक्तं कपिराजेन रावणावरजं प्रति । वाक्यं हेतुमदत्यर्थं भवद्भिरपि तच्छ्रुतम् ॥
data.es: "The highly reasonable words of advice given by the king of Vanaras about Ravana's brother was heard even by you."
data.anv: रावणावरजंप्रति: about Ravana's brother, कपिराजेन: by the king of Vanaras, अत्यर्थम् highly reasonable, हेतुमत् words of reason, यत् those, वाक्यम् words, उक्तम् having spoken, भवद्भिरपि: even by you, श्रुतम् has been heard.
data.md: You have all heard, the words well grounded in reason, the lord of monkeys has said, regarding Rāvana's younger brother.

data.v: सुहृदा ह्यर्थकृच्छेषु युक्तं बुद्धिमता सता । समर्थेनापि संदेष्टुं शाश्वतीं भूतिमिच्छता ॥
data.es: "It is always desirable to seek everlasting advice for one's welfare from capable and wise ones by the near and dear ones. It is proper to seek advice on complex matters by one who is in a difficult situation."
data.anv: शाश्वतीम् everlasting, भूतिम् welfare, इच्छता: desirable, समर्थेन: capable, बुद्धिमता: wise one, सदा: ever, सुहृदाम् to near and dear ones, अर्थकृच्छ्रेषु: in difficult situation on complex matter, निर्देष्टुम्: to express, युक्तम् is proper.
data.md: It behove him, who desires for perpetual wealth, and is intelligent and capable of giving sound counsels, to advise his friends in difficult matters.

data.v: इत्येवं परिपृष्टास्ते स्वं स्वं मतमतन्द्रिताः । सोपचारं तदा राममूचुर्हितचिकीर्षवः ॥
data.es: The Vanaras having heard the words spoken by Rama in that way, tendered beneficial advice and their own opinion respectfully, to be vigilant.
data.anv: तदा: then, इत्येवम् in this manner, परिपृष्टाः having told, ते: you, अतन्द्रिताः vigilant, हितचिकीर्षवः beneficial advice, सोपचारम् respectfully an end, स्वंस्वम् one's own, मतम् opinion, राम् Rama, ऊचुः spoke.
data.md: Being thus addressed by Rāma (to minister to him best counsels) all those monkeys, intent upon encompassing his well-being, gave out their respective opinions.

data.v: अज्ञातं नास्ति ते किंचित्त्रिषु लोकेषु राघव । आत्मानं पूजयन्राम पृच्छस्यस्मान्सुहृत्तया ॥
data.es: "O Raghava there is nothing unknown to you in the three worlds. You are asking our opinion (giving us the honour) out of friendship."
data.anv: राघव: Raghava, त्रिषु: in the three, लोकेषु: worlds, ते: to you, अज्ञातम् that which, किंचित् nothing, नास्ति: is not there, आत्मानम् you yourself, सूचयन् to give our opinion, पृच्छसि: ask, अस्मान: to us, सुह्रत्तया: out of friendship.
data.md: O Rāghava, there is nothing beyond your knowledge in the three worlds. It is only to show your respect towards us; O Răma, that you did accost us in this wise.

data.v: त्वं हि सत्यव्रतः शूरो धार्मिको दृढविक्रमः । परीक्ष्य कारा स्मृतिमान्निसृष्टात्मा सुहृत्सु च ॥
data.es: "You are a truthful follower of vows, a heroic and righteous one. You are firm in your resolve, capable of good judgment, have a good memory of the past traditions and committed in heart to your friends."
data.anv: त्वम् you, सत्यव्रतः one who follows vows truthfully, शूरः heroic, धार्मिकः one who is righteous, दृढविक्रमः firm in resolve, परीक्ष्यकारी: one who is capable of good judgment, स्मृतिमान् one who has good memory of laws of the past, सुहृत्सु: to your friends, निसृष्टात्माच: and committed in heart.
data.md: You are of truthful vows, heroic, pious, of firm prowess, discriminating, recollecting and having implicit confidence in your friends.

data.v: तस्मादेकैकशस्तावद्ब्रुवन्तु सचिवास्तव । हेतुतो मतिसंपन्नाः समर्थाश्च पुनः पुनः ॥
data.es: "On account of that reason, since your ministers are richly endowed with intelligence let them speak out again and again, one after the other in that way."
data.anv: तस्मात् for that reason, मतिसम्पन्नाः richly endowed with intelligence, समर्थाश्च: capable also, पुनःपुनः again and again, तवसचिवाः your ministers, एकैकशः one after another, हेतुतः with reason, ब्रुवन्तु: speak out, तावत् like that.
data.md: Let the intelligent and capable counsellors deliver their reasonable opinions to you.

data.v: इत्युक्ते राघवायाथ मतिमानङ्गदोऽग्रतः । विभीषणपरीक्षार्थमुवाच वचनं हरिः ॥
data.es: Having said so, Angada the intelligent Vanara spoke these words immediately to Rama for judging Vibheeshana.
data.anv: इति: so, उक्ते: having said, अथ: then, हरिः Vanara, मतिमान् intelligent, अङ्गदः Angada, राघवाय: to Rama, अग्रतः immediately, विभीषणपरीक्षार्थम् for the sake of judging Vibheeshana, वचनम् these words, उवाच: spoken.
data.md: They speaking thus to Rāghava, the intelligent monkey Angada, spoke as follows for sounding the intention of Vibhīşaņa.

data.v: शत्रोः सकाशात्संप्राप्तः सर्वथा शङ्क्य एव हि । विश्वासयोग्यः सहसा न कर्तव्यो विभीषणः ॥
data.es: "Since he has come from the enemy's camp suddenly, surely Vibheeshana is to be suspected in every way. He is not worthy to be trusted."
data.anv: शत्रोः enemy, सकाशात् from the camp, सम्प्राप्तः having come, विभीषण: Vibheeshana, सर्वथा: in every way, शङ् क्या: doubtful, एवहि: surely, सहसा: suddenly, विश्वासयोग्यः worthy to be trusted, नकर्तव्यः not to be.
data.md: We should always suspect him since he has come from the side of our enemies, and should not, all on a sudden, place confidence in him.

data.v: छादयित्वात्मभावं हि चरन्ति शठबुद्धयः । प्रहरन्ति च रन्ध्रेषु सोऽनर्थः सुमहान्भवेत् ॥
data.es: "One who has a perfidious mind keeps moving about concealing his intention and will attack at weak points, which will be a great inestimable mistake."
data.anv: शठबुद्धयः one with perfidious mind, आत्मभावम् one's own feeling, छादयित्वा: concealing, चरन्तिहि: keep moving about, रन्ध्रेषु: a weak point, प्रहरन्तिच and attack, सः he, महान् great, अनर्थः inestimable mistake, भवेत् will be.
data.md: The wicked-minded always move about hiding their real self, and bring about peoples' calamity, taking advantage of their weak points. And great is the disaster thereof.

data.v: अर्थानर्थौ विनिश्चित्य व्यवसायं भजेत ह । गुणतः संग्रहं कुर्याद्दोषतस्तु विसर्जयेत् ॥
data.es: Ascertaining advantages and disadvantages one should take the right course of action, by acting if it is virtuous and giving up if it is faulty.
data.anv: अर्थानर्थौ: advantages and disadvantages, विनिश्चित्य: ascertaining, व्यवसायम् course of action, भजेत: follows, गुणतः by virtue, सङ्ग्रहम् take hold of, कुर्यात् act, दोषतस्तु: if faulty, विसर्जयेत् should give up.
data.md: It is always proper to engage in actions, considering what is right and what is wrong. Virtues should always be gathered and vices abondoned.

data.v: यदि दोषो महांस्तस्मिंस्त्यज्यतामविशङ्कितम् । गुणान्वापि बहूञ्ज्ञात्वा संग्रहः क्रियतां नृप ॥
data.es: "If there are great bad qualities (in Vibheeshana) no doubt he has to be rejected. If there are many virtues let us take him knowing them also."
data.anv: नृप: king, तस्मिन् in him, महान् great, दोषःयदि: if one has bad qualities, अविशङ्कितम् no doubt, त्यज्यताम् to be rejected, बहून् many, गुणान् virtues, ज्ञात्वावापि: knowing them also, सङ्ग्रहः let us take, क्रियताम् we will.
data.md: Do you renounce him unhesitatingly, if did you find in him a source of a great calamity and do you embrace him if did you find him crowned with many virtues.

data.v: शरभस्त्वथ निश्चित्य सार्थं वचनमब्रवीत् । क्षिप्रमस्मिन्नरव्याघ्र चारः प्रतिविधीयताम् ॥
data.es: "Sarabha has also decided and spoken these meaningful words of advice." O Tiger among men Let a spy be assigned to cover him at once."
data.anv: नरव्याघ्र: tiger among men, अथ: and now, शरभस्तु: Sarabha too, निश्चित्य: decided, सार्थम् meaningful, वचनम् अब्रवीत् tendered words, अस्मिन् in this, क्षिप्रम् at once, चारः spy, प्रतिविधीयताम् shall be assigned to cover him.
data.md: There upon followed Sarava with words fraught with high import, best of men, do you speedily despatch emissaries to sound Vibhis ana.

data.v: प्रणिधाय हि चारेण यथावत्सूक्ष्मबुद्धिना । परीक्ष्य च ततः कार्यो यथान्यायं परिग्रहः ॥
data.es: "By employing a spy with subtle intellect to examine Vibheeshana, we can act in an appropriate manner to accept him (Vibheeshana)."
data.anv: प्रणिधाय: employing spies, सूक्ष्मबुद्धिना: who has subtle intellect, चारेण: by a spy, यथावत् in the same way, परीक्ष्यच after examining, ततः thereafter, यथान्यायम् in appropriate manner, परिग्रहः accept, कार्यः action.
data.md: If did you, sounding him well through the instrumentality of sharp spies, find him friendly, do you win him over to your side.

data.v: जाम्बवांस्त्वथ संप्रेक्ष्य शास्त्रबुद्ध्या विचक्षणः । वाक्यं विज्ञापयामास गुणवद्दोषवर्जितम् ॥
data.es: Then, enlightened Jambavan who was endowed with sense of discrimination, considering all facts made his submission which was free from flaws.
data.anv: अथ: and then, विचक्षणः one who has sense of discrimination, जाम्बवांस्तु: even Jambavan also, शास्त्रबुध्या: enlightened one, सम्प्रेक्ष्य: considering, गुणवत् full of virtues, दोषवर्जितम् free from flaws, वाक्यम् statement, विज्ञापयामास: made this sub mission.
data.md: There upon the wise Jāmbavān, arriving at conclusions by virtue of his knowledge of Šāstras, began with words, void of defects.

data.v: बद्धवैराच्च पापाच्च राक्षसेन्द्राद्विभीषणः । अदेश काले संप्राप्तः सर्वथा शङ्क्यतामयम् ॥
data.es: "Vibheeshana who has conceived bitter hatred towards the sinful Rakshasa king Ravana came without regard for place and time is always to be viewed with suspicion."
data.anv: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, बद्धवैराच्च: one who has conceived bitter hatred, पापात् sinful one, राक्षसेन्द्रात् towards Rakshasa king, अदेशकाले: without regard for timeand place, सम्प्राप्तः having come, आयम् this, सर्वथा: always, शङ् क्यताम् viewed with suspicion.
data.md: Surely does Vibhīşaņa come from the vicious lord of Räkşasas, dead set against us and has arrived at such a bad piace and in such a bad hour. We should always fear him.

data.v: ततो मैन्दस्तु संप्रेक्ष्य नयापनयकोविदः । वाक्यं वचनसंपन्नो बभाषे हेतुमत्तरम् ॥
data.es: "Mainda, who was prudent in making policy and rich in expression, considering all facts expressed this statement that was fully logical."
data.anv: ततः then, नयापनयकोविदः prudent in making policy, वचनसम्पन्नः rich in expression, मैन्दस्तु: Mainda, सम्प्रेक्ष्य: considering, हेतुमत्तरम् fully logical, वाक्यम् statement बभाषे: expressed.
data.md: There upon followed Mainda, conversant with what is right and wrong, after due deliberation, with words pregnant with words pregnant with reason.

data.v: वचनं नाम तस्यैष रावणस्य विभीषणः । पृच्छ्यतां मधुरेणायं शनैर्नरवरेश्वर ॥
data.es: "O king of mortals This is Ravana's brother called Vibheeshana. Let him be slowly and gently interrogated for long."
data.anv: नरपतीश्वर: O king of the mortals, एषः this is, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, तस्य: his, रावणस्य: Ravana's, वचनं: words नाम: indeed, आयम् for long, मधुरेण: gently, शनैः slowly, पृच्छयताम् be interrogated.
data.md: He is Rāvana's younger brother, by name Vibhīşana. Let the lord of men ask him every thing at first in sweet words.

data.v: भावमस्य तु विज्ञाय ततस्तत्त्वं करिष्यसि । यदि दृष्टो न दुष्टो वा बुद्धिपूर्वं नरर्षभ ॥
data.es: "O Best of kings After truly ascertaining Vibheeshana's intention whether he is wicked or not, you may act wisely (said Mainda)."
data.anv: नरर्षभ: O best of kings, अस्य: his, भावम् intention, तत्त्वतः truly, विज्ञाय: after ascertaining, दुष्टोयदि: if he is wicked, नदुष्टोवा: or not wicked also, बुद्धिपूर्वम् wisely, त्वम् you, करिष्यसि: act accordingly.
data.md: Do you first ascertain, O foremost of men, with what intention he has come evil or good and then settle what course to adopt.

data.v: अथ संस्कारसंपन्नो हनूमान्सचिवोत्तमः । उवाच वचनं श्लक्ष्णमर्थवन्मधुरं लघु ॥
data.es: On the other hand, Hanuman who was endowed with rich culture spoke these soft, sweet, and meaningful words briefly.
data.anv: अथ: on the other hand, संस्कारसम्पन्नः endowed with rich culture, सचिवोत्तमः best of the ministers, हनुमान् Hanuman, श्लक्ष्णम् soft, अर्थवत् full of meaning, मधुरम् sweet, लघु: brief, वचनम् words, उवाच: spoke.
data.md: There upon spoke Hanumān, the foremost of the counsellors and well versed in Šāstras, in accents sweet, glorious and fraught with a high value.

data.v: न भवन्तं मतिश्रेष्ठं समर्थं वदतां वरम् । अतिशाययितुं शक्तो बृहस्पतिरपि ब्रुवन् ॥
data.es: "Even for Brihaspati who is proclaimed to be highly intelligent, it is not possible to surpass you as you are the foremost in capability and eloquence."
data.anv: बृहस्पतिरपि: even Brihaspati, बृवन् proclaim, मतिश्रेष्ठम् highly intelligent, समर्थम् exceptionally capable, वदताम् in eloquence, वरम् foremost, भवन्तम् you, अतिशाययितुम् excellent, नशक्तः not possible.
data.md: Even Brhaspati, (the lord of speech) cannot excel you, capaable,* gifted with the best of intellect and foremost of those skilled in the are of speech, as you are. *Capable to ascertain the truth of all Sastras.

data.v: न वादान्नापि संघर्षान्नाधिक्यान्न च कामतः । वक्ष्यामि वचनं राजन्यथार्थं रामगौरवात् ॥
data.es: "O King Rama I am telling this to you truly not for the sake of argument, not for the sake of creating friction, or with a sense of superiority, or desire but out of respect."
data.anv: राजन् O king, राम: Rama, वादात् for the sake of argument, वचनम् words, न: not, सङ्घर्षादपि: for the sake of creating friction, न: nor, आधिक्यात् with sense of superiority, न: nor, कामतःच: or even desire, न: nor, गौरवात् out of respect, यथार्थम् truth, वक्ष्यामि: telling you.
data.md: And what I know I speak, o king. I do so, in the interest of Rāma's work and not impelled by my skill in the are of speech, by the pride of being a counsellor, by the vanity of being gifted with a high intellect or by the desire of speaking for its own sake.

data.v: अर्थानर्थनिमित्तं हि यदुक्तं सचिवैस्तव । तत्र दोषं प्रपश्यामि क्रिया न ह्युपपद्यते ॥
data.es: "Your counsellors have said that after judging good or bad qualities we should accept or reject Vibheeshana. I see a flaw in that statement as such action would not arise."
data.anv: तव: your, सचिवैः counsellors, अर्थानर्थनिमित्तम् after judging good or bad qualities, यत् by what, उक्तम् has been said, तत्र: there, दोषम् fault, प्रपश्यामि: I see, क्रिया: action, नउपपद्यतेहि: not arise.
data.md: What your counsellors have said for ascertaining the good or evil intention of Vibhīş aņa appear to me as most defective and productive of no consequence whatever. It is impossible to sound him without any command.* *To command to relate for what he has come.

data.v: ऋते नियोगात्सामर्थ्यमवबोद्धुं न शक्यते । सहसा विनियोगो हि दोषवान्प्रतिभाति मे ॥
data.es: "When entrusted with duty one's capability will be known. It is not possible to appoint him for duty inconsiderately without understanding (his capacity) as it will be faulty."
data.anv: नियोगात् ऋते: only when entrusted with duty, सामर्थ्यम् capability, अवबोद्धुम् will be known, नशक्यते: not possible, सहसा: inconsiderately, विनियोगः appointment to a duty, दोषवान् will be faulty, मे: to me, प्रतिभाति: to understand.
data.md: And even to command him now for the same appears to me as improper.

data.v: चारप्रणिहितं युक्तं यदुक्तं सचिवैस्तव । अर्थस्यासंभवात्तत्र कारणं नोपपद्यते ॥
data.es: "Your counsellors (Sarabha) have said that it is proper to know from the spies to ascertain about him. It has no meaning as it is not possible to do so (as he is near you). It does not serve the purpose."
data.anv: तव: your, सचिवैः counsellors, यत् that way, चारप्रणिहितम् ascertain from the spies whether he is good or not, युक्तम् proper, उक्तम् has said, तत्र: then, अर्थस्य: has no meaning, असम्भवात् not possible to do, कारणम् reason, नोपयुज्यते: no purpose will be served by that.
data.md: And as regards the despatch of spies, anent what you have been advised by your ministers, I do not observe any utility.

data.v: अदेश काले संप्राप्त इत्ययं यद्विभीषणः । विवक्षा चात्र मेऽस्तीयं तां निबोध यथा मति ॥
data.es: "This Vibheeshana has come here without regard for place and time. I desire to speak what I feel in this regard."
data.anv: अयंविभीषणः this Vibheeshana, आदेशकाले: without regard for place and time, सम्प्राप्तःइतियत् has come here, तत्र: hence, मे: my, यथामति: according to me, इयंविवक्षा: desire to speak this, अस्ति: will be, ताम् to it, निबोध: be considered.
data.md: And what little I have thought of, I have something to say (regarding Jambaban's proposal) that Vibhīşaņa has arrived at such a bad place and in such an evil hour.

data.v: स एष देशः कालश्च भवतीह यथा तथा । पुरुषात्पुरुषं प्राप्य तथा दोषगुणावपि ॥
data.es: "It seems proper for him (Vibheeshana) to come here, considering place and time and so also considering that you are superior to him (Ravana) even if there are demerits in him and merits in you."
data.anv: एषः this, इह: here, देश: place, कालश्च: and time, तथा: similarly, पुरुषात् you, पुरुषम् superior, प्राप्य: came here, तथा: so also, गुणदोषावपि: even if there are de merits (in him) and merits (in you), यथा: as, तथा: it is, इह: here, भवति: seems to be.

data.v: दौरात्म्यं रावणे दृष्ट्वा विक्रमं च तथा त्वयि । युक्तमागमनं तस्य सदृशं तस्य बुद्धितः ॥
data.es: "He has thought over and seen wickedness in Ravana, likewise valiance in you has made you come here. He seems to be right and suitable."
data.anv: रवणे: in Ravana, दौरात्म्यम् wickedness, तथा: likewise, त्वयि: in you, विक्रमंच: valiance, दृष्टवा: seen, अत्र: here, आगमनम् has come, युक्तंहि: seems right, तस्य: his, बुद्धितः thinking, सदृशम् suitable.
data.md: He has really come to a very good place and in a very good hour. And truly has he performed a becoming and sensille action by coming here after duly ascertaining that Rāvana is a vicious wight and you are a pious person-he is full of vices-you are gifted with many virtues-he is tyrannical and you are powerful.

data.v: अज्ञातरूपैः पुरुषैः स राजन्पृच्छ्यतामिति । यदुक्तमत्र मे प्रेक्षा काचिदस्ति समीक्षिता ॥
data.es: "O king People of unknown identity should enquire about him. (Vibheeshana)" said Mainda. Having reviewed the matter, I have another view. (in the matter)."
data.anv: राजन् O king अज्ञातरूपैः people of unknown identity, पुरुषैः by men, सः he (Mainda), पृच्छ् यताम् said to enquire इति: this, यत् that way, उक्तम् said, अत्र: here, समीक्षिता: having reviewed, मे: to me, काचित् a little, प्रेक्षा: view, अस्ति: be it.
data.md: And what they have said, O king, as regards sounding him through secret spies, appear to me as one requiring great wisdom.

data.v: पृच्छ्यमानो विशङ्केत सहसा बुद्धिमान्वचः । तत्र मित्रं प्रदुष्येत मिथ्यपृष्टं सुखागतम् ॥
data.es: "If enquired suddenly, a wise one will also become suspicious of his words. Even a friend who has come there will seem like a wicked one to him."
data.anv: सहसा: at once, पृच्छयमानः if enquired, बुद्धिमान् wise one, वचः words, विशङ्केत: will become suspicious, तत्र: there, सुखागतम् come with relief, मित्रम् friend, मिथ्यापृष्टम् प्रदुष्येत: will appear as wicked one.
data.md: An intelligent man, when questioned by any suddenly, suspects many things. And if the newcomer be a friend and has come here for his own happiness, how greatly shall his mind be changed by such a course?

data.v: अशक्यः सहसा राजन्भावो वेत्तुं परस्य वै । अन्तः स्वभावैर्गीतैस्तैर्नैपुण्यं पश्यता भृशम् ॥
data.es: "O king It is not possible to know the intention (of an enemy) of others at once without excessive dexterity. It is to be known by his tone of words and description."
data.anv: राजन् O king अन्तस्स्वभावै: his intention, र्गीतै: tone of words स्तै: his, पश्यताम् to find out, भृशम् excessive, नैपुण्यं: dexterity, परस्य: other's, भावः feelings, सहसा: at once, बोद्धुम् to know, अशक्यम् not possible.
data.md: Besides by a sudden questioning it is impossible to ascertain the intention of a foreigner. Do you therefore yourself accost him and determine, by his voice, his secret motive.

data.v: न त्वस्य ब्रुवतो जातु लक्ष्यते दुष्टभावता । प्रसन्नं वदनं चापि तस्मान्मे नास्ति संशयः ॥
data.es: "Even when one is speaking, his malevolence is known. It does not seem so as his countenance is also pleasing. Therefore, I have no doubt (of him)."
data.anv: ब्रुवतः he is speaking, अस्य: his, दुष्टभावता: malevolence, जातु: known, नलक्ष्यते: does not seem, वदनंचापि: even his countenance, प्रसन्नम् pleasing, तस्मात् therefore, मे: to me, संशयः suspicion, नास्ति: is not there.
data.md: I did not however mark anything of his wickedness while he spoke; rather I did observe signs of gladness on his countenance. So I do not suspect him.

data.v: अशङ्कितमतिः स्वस्थो न शठः परिसर्पति । न चास्य दुष्टा वाक्चापि तस्मान्नास्तीह संशयः ॥
data.es: "One who is with deceitful feeling will not come without an expression of suspicion. He has come on his own and even his talk and looks are not suspicious to me."
data.anv: शठः one with deceitful feeling, अशङ्कितमतिः without any expression of suspicion, स्वस्थः on his own, नपरिसर्पति: not going about, अस्य: his, वाक् च: even his talk, दुष्टा: looks, नास्ति: not, तस्मात् therefore, मे: to me, संशयः suspicion, नास्ति: not there.
data.md: The wily can never come fearless and undisturbed. Nor were his words cunning. So I do not suspect him.

data.v: आकारश्छाद्यमानोऽपि न शक्यो विनिगूहितुम् । बलाद्धि विवृणोत्येव भावमन्तर्गतं नृणाम् ॥
data.es: "Even if one intends to hide in his external form, it is not feasible to keep it concealed. The inner feeling of a man gets revealed even if cleverly hidden."
data.anv: आकारः form, छाद्यमानोऽपि: even if one wishes to hide, एवगूहितुम् kept concealed, नशक्यः not feasible, अन्तर्गतम् inner feeling, नृणाम् of a man's, भावम्: feeling, बलात् perforce, निप्पणोत्येव: cleverly also.
data.md: It is not very easy to hide one's real nature. It manifests itself by force.

data.v: देशकालोपपन्नं च कार्यं कार्यविदां वर । सफलं कुरुते क्षिप्रं प्रयोगेणाभिसंहितम् ॥
data.md: So this action of Vibhīşana is not out of place or season. When accomplished it shall redound to his own interest.

data.v: उद्योगं तव संप्रेक्ष्य मिथ्यावृत्तं च रावणम् । वालिनश्च वधं श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवं चाभिषेचितम् ॥
data.md: Considering well your preparations for war and Ravana's vain conduct, hearing of Vah's destruction and Sugrīva's installation on the throne he has, impelled by his good sense, come here, desirous of gaining the kingdom. Taking these into account, it seems prudent to take him to our side.

data.v: राज्यं प्रार्थयमानश्च बुद्धिपूर्वमिहागतः । एतावत्तु पुरस्कृत्य युज्यते त्वस्य संग्रहः ॥
यथाशक्ति मयोक्तं तु राक्षसस्यार्जवं प्रति । त्वं प्रमाणं तु शेषस्य श्रुत्वा बुद्धिमतां वर ॥
data.md: O you the foremost of the intelligent, I have spok thus considering him sincere. It now behove you to perform what you think proper.

data.v: अथ रामः प्रसन्नात्मा श्रुत्वा वायुसुतस्य ह । प्रत्यभाषत दुर्धर्षः श्रुतवानात्मनि स्थितम् ॥
data.es: Having heard Hanuman (son of wind god) formidable Rama was highly pleased at heart and started to tell his opinion.
data.anv: अथ: and then, दुर्धर्षः formidable one, श्रुतवान् one who heard, रामः Rama, वायुसुतस्य: son of wind god's, शृत्वा: having heard, प्रसन्नात्मा: highly pleased at heart, आत्मनि: his own, स्थितम् that which was in his mind, प्रत्यभाषत: started to tell.
data.md: Hearing those words of the Wind-god's son, the irrepressible Rāma, conversant with all the Šāstras, replied, with words expressing his own opinion.

data.v: ममापि तु विवक्षास्ति काचित्प्रति विभीषणम् । श्रुतमिच्छामि तत्सर्वं भवद्भिः श्रेयसि स्थितैः ॥
data.es: "Even I desire to speak a few words about Vibheeshana. I wish you, who are my well wishers and devoted to me, also hear me."
data.anv: विभीषणंप्रति: about Vibheeshana, ममापि: even I, काचित् a few words, विवक्षा: desire to speak, आस्ति: is there, श्रेयसि: well wishers, स्थितैः are devoted, भवद्भिः you also, तत् that, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छामि: I desire.
data.md: I have also thought of some thing regarding Vibhisana. I wish you all, interested in my wellbeing, to hear that.

data.v: मित्रभावेन संप्राप्तं न त्यजेयं कथंचन । दोषो यद्यपि तस्य स्यात्सतामेतदगर्हितम् ॥
data.es: Although he (Vibheeshana) has defects, as he has come here with a friendly feeling, I cannot reject him. Good people are not reprehensible.
data.anv: मित्रभावेन: with friendly feeling, सम्राप्तम् having come here, तस्य: his, दोष: defects, यद्यसि: although, कथञ्चन: however, नत्यजेयम् not reject, एतत् all this, सताम् good people, अगर्हितम् not reprehensible.
data.md: (Vibhīşaņa) has come here as friend so I cannot forsake him by any means. And even if he has come with any evil intent it is not culpable for the pious to afford him shelter.

data.v: रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवः प्लवगेश्वरः । प्रत्यभाषत काकुत्स्थं सौहार्देनाभिचोदितः ॥
data.es: Having heard the inciting words spoken by Rama so lovingly, the king of Vanaras replied.
data.anv: प्लवगेश्वरः king of (leaping) Vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, रामस्य: Rama's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, सौहार्देन: lovingly, प्रचोदितः inciting, काकुत्स्थम् Rama of Kakuthsa race, प्रत्यभाषत: replied.
data.md: Hearing the words of Rāma, Sugriva, the lords of those who go bounding, over-flowing with friendliness, bespake Kākutstha.

data.v: किमत्र चित्रं धर्मज्ञ लोकनाथशिखामणे । यत्त्वमार्यं प्रभाषेथाः सत्त्ववान्सपथे स्थितः ॥
data.es: "What wonderful words have been spoken by you, Rama? You are the knower of righteous duty, protector of the world, a virtuous and upright one."
data.anv: धर्मज्ञ: knower of righteous duty, लोकनाथसुखावहा: protector of the world, सत्त्ववान् virtuous one, सत्पथे: upright, स्थितः who stands, त्वम् by you, आर्यम् noble, प्रभाषेथाः that which was spoken, इतियत् thus which, अत्र: here, चित्रम् wonderful, किम् What.
data.md: What wonder is there that you wouldst speak these auspicious words, O you the foremost of kings, conversant with morality, gifted with prowess and ever treading the pious track as you are.

data.v: मम चाप्यन्तरात्मायं शुद्धिं वेत्ति विभीषणम् । अनुमनाच्च भावाच्च सर्वतः सुपरीक्षितः ॥
data.es: "My inner self is aware that this Vibheeshana is pure. He has been tested in all respects with doubtful feelings."
data.anv: मम: my, अयम् this, अन्तरात्माच: inner self, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana's, शुद्धम् pure, वेत्ति: known, अनुमानात् च: and with doubt, भावात् feeling, सर्वतः in all respects, सुपरीक्षितः been tested.
data.md: Truly does my inner self regard Vibhīşana as devoid of any wicked intention. He has been well sounded by signs and gestures.

data.v: तस्मात्क्षिप्रं सहास्माभिस्तुल्यो भवतु राघव । विभीषणो महाप्राज्ञः सखित्वं चाभ्युपैतु नः ॥
data.es: "Rama therefore, let this highly sagacious Vibheeshana be with you like a friend in equal terms and enjoy."
data.anv: राघव: Rama, तस्मात् therefore, महाप्राज्ञः highly sagacious one, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, क्षिप्रम् at once, अस्माभिस्सह: along with us, तुल्यः equal term, भवतु: be, नः our, सखित्वंच: friendship, अभ्युपैतु: you enjoy.
data.md: And let the greatly wise Vibhīşaņa, O Rāghava, be placed on an equal footing with us and gain our friendship.

data.v: स सुग्रीवस्य तद्वाक्यं रामः श्रुत्वा विमृश्य च । ततः शुभतरं वाक्यमुवाच हरिपुंगवम् ॥
data.es: Then Sugriva, the leader of Vanaras reflecting on what was spoken by Rama said these words favouring Rama.
data.anv: जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, मैथिली Mythili, तस्य her, तत् those, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, ततः that, पवनात्मजम् son of wind god, शुभतरम् auspicious, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke
data.md: There upon hearing his words and considering them well, Sugrīva, the lord of the monkeys, replied in more auspicious* word. *More reasonable word.

data.v: सुदुष्टो वाप्यदुष्टो वा किमेष रजनीचरः । सूक्ष्ममप्यहितं कर्तुं ममाशक्तः कथंचन ॥
data.es: "Whether this night ranger is wicked or not wicked, is he capable of doing even subtlest harm to me?"
data.anv: एषः this, रजनीचरः night ranger, सुदुष्टोवा: wicked or, अदुष्टोवा: or not wicked, मम: to me, कथञ्चन: What to say, सूक्ष्मम् subtlest, अहितमपि: that which is harmful, कर्तुम् to do, आशक्तः capable.
data.md: Wicked or other wise, whatever this nightranger may be, he shall not be able to do me the least mischief.

data.v: पिशाचान्दानवान्यक्षान्पृथिव्यां चैव राक्षसान् । अङ्गुल्यग्रेण तान्हन्यामिच्छन्हरिगणेश्वर ॥
data.es: "O leader of the Vanara troop If I so desire, I can kill with the tip of my big finger the devils, Danavas, Yakshas and the Rakshasas on this earth."
data.anv: हरिगणेश्वर: leader of Vanara troop, इच्छान् if I desire, पृथिव्याम् on this earth, तान् them, पिशाचान् devils, दानवान् Danavas, यक्षान् Yakshas, राक्षसान्चैव: including Rakshasas, अङ्गुल्यग्रेण: with tip of my big finger, हन्याम् can kill.
data.md: Piśācas, Dānavas, Yakşas or all the Rākşasas on earth, I can slay them all, if I like, with the tips of my fingers, O you the lord of monkeys.

data.v: श्रूयते हि कपोतेन शत्रुः शरणमागतः । अर्चितश्च यथान्यायं स्वैश्च मांसैर्निमन्त्रितः ॥
data.es: "You have heard of the (story of a) dove that offered his own flesh to an enemy who came to seek protection according to tradition (of hospitality)."
data.anv: कपोतेन: by a dove, शरणम् to seek refuge, आगतः came, शत्रुः enemy, यथान्यायम् according to practice, आर्चितश्च: offered, स्वैः its own, मांसैः flesh, निमन्त्रितश्च: without any jealousy, श्रूयतेहि: have heard.
data.md: I have heard of a pigeon adoring and entertaining with its own flesh, an enemy who took its shelter.

data.v: स हि तं प्रतिजग्राह भार्या हर्तारमागतम् । कपोतो वानरश्रेष्ठ किं पुनर्मद्विधो जनः ॥
data.es: "O Supreme Vanara When the fowler who had carried away the mate came near the dove it received him and in turn protected him. What more can a man like me do?"
data.anv: वानरश्रेष्ठ: supreme Vanara, सःकपोतः that dove, आगतम् came near, भार्याहर्तारम् carried away its mate, तम् him, प्रतिजग्राहहि: in turn received, मद्विधः like me, जनः a man, किंपुनः What more.
data.md: While a pigeon received so friendly its enemy, the slayer of its mate, how can I then act otherwise, O foremost of the monkeys?

data.v: ऋषेः कण्वस्य पुत्रेण कण्डुना परमर्षिणा । शृणु गाथां पुरा गीतां धर्मिष्ठां सत्यवादिना ॥
data.es: "In the past Kanva's son called Kandu, a sage and a truthful one used to sing verses inculcating righteousness. (I shall recite) You may listen."
data.anv: पुरा: in the past, कण्वस्यऋषेः sage Kanva's, पुत्रेण: by the son, सत्यवादिना: truthful one, परमर्षिणा: great sage, कण्डुना: Kandu by name, धर्मिष्ठा: inculcating righteousness, गाथा: used to sing, गीता: verses, शृणु: you may listen.
data.md: Do you hear, I shall relate, a sacred story, narrated by the great ascetic, the truthful Kandu, son of the ascetic Kanyā.

data.v: बद्धाञ्जलिपुटं दीनं याचन्तं शरणागतम् । न हन्यादानृशंस्यार्थमपि शत्रुं परं पत ॥
data.es: "O scorcher of enemies To one who greets reverentially with folded hands and begs for protection, we should not be cruel, and he is not to be killed."
data.anv: परन्तप scorcher of enemies, बद्धाञ्जलिपुटम् who greets reverentially with folded hands, दीनम् piteous, याचन्तम् begs, शरणागतम् protection, शत्रुम् अपि even the enemy, अनृशंस्यार्थम् not to be cruel नहन्यात् not to be killed.
data.md: o slayer of foes, even a wicked-minded enemy, if he, with folded palms and a poor heart, crave for your shelter, should not be slain.

data.v: आर्तो वा यदि वा दृप्तः परेषां शरणं गतः । अरिः प्राणान्परित्यज्य रक्षितव्यः कृतात्मना ॥
data.es: An enemy who comes for protection against another enemy should be protected, even giving up one's own life whoever he may be, even if he is afflicted or arrogant.
data.anv: कृतात्माना one's own self, परेषाम् an enemy, शरणम् protection, गतः comes, अरिः enemy, आर्तोवा or one who is struck by suffering, यदिवा whoever he be, दृप्तः arrogant, प्राणान् life, परित्यज्य giving up, रक्षितव्यः should be protected.
data.md: If an enemy, proud or terrified, seek shelter in affright, he should be saved by a great man even at the risk of his own life.

data.v: स चेद्भयाद्वा मोहाद्वा कामाद्वापि न रक्षति । स्वया शक्त्या यथातत्त्वं तत्पापं लोकगर्हितम् ॥
data.es: "If one does not protect, or give refuge, according to his capacity out of fear, desire (to gain) or delusion, the sin acquired by him will be censured by the world."
data.anv: सः he, भयाद्वा: from fear, मोहाद्वा: from delusion, कामाद्वापि: even from desire, स्वया: his own, शक्त्वा: capacity, यथासत्त्वम् accordingly, नरक्षतिचेत् if he does not protect, तत् that, लोकगर्हितम् censured by the world, पापम् sin.
data.md: One, who from fear, ignorance or wilfully does not protect him who seek his shelter, perpetrate a mighty iniquity, blamed of all.

data.v: विनष्टः पश्यतस्तस्य रक्षिणः शरणागतः । आदाय सुकृतं तस्य सर्वं गच्छेदरक्षितः ॥
data.es: "One who fails to protect a refugee who seeks protection from him is ruined in the eyes of the refugee and he takes away all the merit."
data.anv: शरणागतः one who seeks protection, अरक्षितः fails to protect, तस्य: his, रक्षिणः refugee, पश्यतः in the eyes of, विनष्टः ruined, तस्य: his, सर्वम् all, सुकृतम् merit, आदाय: takes, गच्छेत् away.
data.md: When a person is slain before him whose shelter he has taken he take away all the virtues of his protector.

data.v: एवं दोषो महानत्र प्रपन्नानामरक्षणे । अस्वर्ग्यं चायशस्यं च बलवीर्यविनाशनम् ॥
data.es: "One who resorts to failure in protecting a refugee, will be doing a great sin that way and will be shut out of heaven, be infamy and his strength and virility will be lost."
data.anv: प्रपन्नानाम् resorts to, अत्रअरक्षणे: that way fails to protect, एवम् in that way, महान् great, दोषः sin, अस्वर्ग्यम् out of heaven, अयशस्यंच: and infamy, बलवीर्यविनाशनम् strength and virility gets lost.
data.md: So great is the sin in not affording shelter to those who seek for it; it stands in the way of going to heaven, brings in calumny and destroys the strength and prowess.

data.v: करिष्यामि यथार्थं तु कण्डोर्वचनमुत्तमम् । धर्मिष्ठं च यशस्यं च स्वर्ग्यं स्यात्तु फलोदये ॥
data.es: "Excellent and meaningful words have been said by sage Kandu (about one who protects a refugee), that is by doing one's righteous duty. He will be not only famous but reach heaven as a result of his action."
data.anv: कण्डोः of Kandu, उत्तमम् excellent, वचनम् words, यथार्थम् meaningful, करिष्यामि: has said, धर्मिष्ठम् one who does his rightful duty, यशस्यम् glorious, स्वर्ग्यम् heaven, फलोदयेस्यात् will receive such result (after death).
data.md: I shall therefore follow the excellent words of Kaņdu-leading to piety, fame and the attainment of the abode of the celestials.

data.v: सकृदेव प्रपन्नाय तवास्मीति च याचते । अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो ददाम्येतद्व्रतं मम ॥
data.es: "I will provide protection from all living beings for the one who seeks protection from me and begs in this way. This is my vow."
data.anv: सकृदेव: for the sake of one, प्रपन्नाय: one who seeks protection, तव: him, अस्मि: me, इति: this way, याचते: begs, सर्वभूतेभ्यः from all living beings, अभयम् security, ददामि: will provide, एतत् thus, मम: my, व्रतम् vow.
data.md: I always declare 'no fear' to all creatures, whenever any, approaching me, says, 'I am thine' and seek my shelter. Even this is my pious observance.

data.v: आनयैनं हरिश्रेष्ठ दत्तमस्याभयं मया । विभीषणो वा सुग्रीव यदि वा रावणः स्वयम् ॥
data.es: "O best of Vanaras Sugriva Either Vibheeshana or any one by himself and even Ravana who is unprotected thus seeks security from me, I will offer protection."
data.anv: हरिश्रेष्ठ: best of Vanaras, सुग्रीव: Sugriva, विभीषणोवा: either Vibheeshana, यदिवा: or any one, स्वयम् by himself, रावणः Ravana, अस्य: his, मया: from me, अभयम् security, दत्तम् will offer, एनम् thus, आनय: one who is unprotected.
data.md: O Sugrīva, O foremost of monkeys, do you soon bring him here, whether he be Rāvaņa or Vibhisana and I shall declare to him 'no fear'.

data.v: ततस्तु सुग्रीववचो निशम्य त;द्धरीश्वरेणाभिहितं नरेश्वरः । विभीषणेनाशु जगाम संगमं; पतत्रिराजेन यथा पुरंदरः ॥
data.es: Perceiving Sugriva's befitting words, king Rama went to meet Vibheeshana like Indra arranged to meet with the king of birds.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टादशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the eighteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: ततः then, नरेश्वरः king, तत् there, सुग्रीववचः Sugriva's words, निशम्य: perceiving, पुरन्दरः: like Indra, पतत्त्रिराजेनयथा like with the king of birds, विभीषणेन: with Vibheeshana, अशु: as said, हरीश्वरेण: by Sugriva, अभिहितम् very fitting, सङ्गमम् meeting, जगाम: went.
data.md: Hearing the words of Sugrīva, the lord of monkeys, the king of men (Rāma) made instantly friends with Vibhīşaņa, like to the conqueror of enemies' cities making friends with the king of birds.

data.v: राघवेणाभये दत्ते संनतो रावणानुजः । खात्पपातावनिं हृष्टो भक्तैरनुचरैः सह ॥
data.md: Rāghava thus declaring to him 'no fear' Ravana's younger brother, the greatly wise Vibhișana, bending low his head, cast his looks on the earth.

data.v: स तु रामस्य धर्मात्मा निपपात विभीषणः । पादयोः शरणान्वेषी चतुर्भिः सह राक्षसैः ॥
अब्रवीच्च तदा रामं वाक्यं तत्र विभीषणः । धर्मयुक्तं च युक्तं च साम्प्रतं संप्रहर्षणम् ॥
data.es: Thereafter Vibheeshana and the four Rakshasas who sought shelter prostrated lying at the feet of Rama expressing their duty, duly and placing confidence in Rama who spoke these words showing extreme joy.
data.anv: अथ: thereafter, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, चतुर्भिः and the four, राक्षसैःसह: along with Rakshasas, पादयोः by foot, शरणान्वेषी: who seeks shelter, निपपात: prostrated falling down, रामंप्रति: in front of Rama, धर्मयुक्तम् duly expressing his duty, युक्तंच: and appropriate, साम्प्रतम् placing confidence in, सम्प्रहर्षणम् showing extreme joy, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीच्च: spoken.
data.md: Descending from the welkin with his devoted attendants the virtuous-souled Vibhisana, delighted, bowed to Rāma. And thereupon touching his feet along with four Rākşasas, Vibhisana addressed Rama, with words, fraught with piety, befitting the occasion and conducing to pleasure.

data.v: अनुजो रावणस्याहं तेन चास्म्यवमानितः । भवन्तं सर्वभूतानां शरण्यं शरणं गतः ॥
data.es: "I am Ravana's younger brother. Having been put to shame I came to seek protection from you who are the protector of all beings " (Vibheeshana said to Rama)."
data.anv: अहम् I am, रावणस्य: Ravana's, अनुजः younger brother, तेन: having been, अवमानितश्च: put to shame, सर्वभूतानाम् all beings, शरण्यम् protector, भवन्तम् you are, शरणागतः came to seek protection.
data.md: I am Rāvana's younger brother and have been greatly insulted by him. I have therefore come to seek your shelter, the refuge of all creatures, abandoning Lanka and renouncing my friends and riches. My kingdom, life and happiness are all at your disposal.

data.v: परित्यक्ता मया लङ्का मित्राणि च धनानि च । भवद्गतं मे राज्यं च जीवितं च सुखानि च ॥
data.es: "Leaving Lanka, my friends and my wealth I came to you. Now my life, kingdom and welfare are at your disposal."
data.anv: मया: my, लङ्का: Lanka, परित्यक्ता: leaving, मित्राणिच: and friends, धनानिच: even wealth, मे: my, राज्यम् kingdom, भवद्गतंहि: at your disposal, जीवितम् life, सुखानिच: for happiness.
data.md: I am Rāvana's younger brother and have been greatly insulted by him. I have therefore come to seek your shelter, the refuge of all creatures, abandoning Lanka and renouncing my friends and riches. My kingdom, life and happiness are all at your disposal.

data.v: राक्षसानां वधे साह्यं लङ्कायाश्च प्रधर्षणे । करिष्यामि यथाप्राणं प्रवेक्ष्यामि च वाहिनीम् ॥
data.es: "I will render assistance with all my strength for storming Lanka, for killing the Rakshasas and for the army to enter."
data.anv: लङ्कायाः Lanka's, प्रधर्षणे: for storming, राक्षसानाम् for Rakshasas, वथे: for killing, साह्यम् help, करिष्यामि: will render, यथाप्राणम् with all my strength, वाहिनीम् army, प्रवेक्ष्यामिच: to enter.
data.md: I shall lend you my might in slaying the Raksasas and devastating the city of Larkā, and shall be in the midst of Rāvana's army.

data.v: इति ब्रुवाणं रामस्तु परिष्वज्य विभीषणम् । अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं प्रीतः समुद्राज्जलमानय ॥
data.es: When Vibheeshana had spoken in that manner, Rama was pleased and embraced him. He called for Lakshmana to get water from the ocean (for consecration).
data.anv: रामस्तु: even Rama also, प्रीत: pleased, इति: thus, ब्रुवाणम् spoken, विभीषणम् by Vibheeshana, परिष्वज्य: embracing, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said, समुद्रात् from the ocean, जलम् water, आनय: get water.
data.md: There upon, embracing Vibhīşaņa, who spoke thus, Rama, delighted, said to Laksmana, Omy brother, do you bring water from the ocean. Sprinkling the greatly wise Vibhișana, I shall make him at once the king of the Rākşasas, o confrere of honour; for I am greatly pleased with him.

data.v: तेन चेमं महाप्राज्ञमभिषिञ्च विभीषणम् । राजानं रक्षसां क्षिप्रं प्रसन्ने मयि मानद ॥
data.es: "I am pleased with this highly intelligent Vibheeshana, a respectable one. I will coronate him at once as king of Rakshasas."
data.anv: मानद: respectable one, मयि: I am, प्रसन्ने: pleased with, महाप्राज्ञम् highly intelligent, इमम् this, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, राजानम् crowned king, क्षीप्रम् at once, तेन: so, अभिषिञ्च: will coronate.
data.md: There upon, embracing Vibhīşaņa, who spoke thus, Rama, delighted, said to Laksmana, Omy brother, do you bring water from the ocean. Sprinkling the greatly wise Vibhișana, I shall make him at once the king of the Rākşasas, o confrere of honour; for I am greatly pleased with him.

data.v: एवमुक्तस्तु सौमित्रिरभ्यषिञ्चद्विभीषणम् । मध्ये वानरमुख्यानां राजानं रामशासनात् ॥
data.es: (Rama) having spoken that way, Saumithri crowned Vibheeshana as crowned king on the command of Rama amid Vanara army chiefs.
data.anv: एवम् in that way, उक्ताः having spoken, सौमित्रि: Saumithri, वानमुख्यानाम् chiefs of army of Vanaras, मध्ये: midst, रामशासनात् by the command of Rama, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, राजानम् as king, अभ्यषिञ्चत् coronated.
data.md: Being thus addressed, Saumitri, at the command of the king, anointed Vibhișana and made him the king of the Räkşasas in the presence of the monkey host.

data.v: तं प्रसादं तु रामस्य दृष्ट्वा सद्यः प्लवंगमाः । प्रचुक्रुशुर्महानादान्साधु साध्विति चाब्रुवन् ॥
data.es: At that instant the Vanaras jumped, moving about exhibiting their joy on witnessing great Rama's grace saying "Good, good."
data.anv: प्लवङ्गमाः the leaping animals (Vanaras), रामस्य: Rama's, तम्: that, सद्यः that, प्रसादम् grace, दृष्टवा: seeing, प्रचुक्रुशुः moving about in joy, महात्मानम् great self, साधुसाधुइति: good, अब्रुवन् च: hailed saying.
data.md: Beholding Rāma's kindness (towards Vibhīş ana), the monkeys eulogized the high-souled one, exclaiming “Excellent! Excellent!”

data.v: अब्रवीच्च हनूमांश्च सुग्रीवश्च विभीषणम् । कथं सागरमक्षोभ्यं तराम वरुणालयम् ॥
data.es: Hanuman and Sugriva enquired of Vibheeshana as to how to cross this ocean that is imperturbable along with the entire lot of energetic Vanara army.
data.anv: हनूमांश्च: Hanuman also, विभीषणम् to Vibheeshana, अब्रवीत् said, सुग्रीवश्च: to Sugriva, सर्वे: entire lot of, महौजसाम् highly energetic, वानराणाम् with Vanaras, सैन्यैः army, परिवृताः surrounded, अक्षोभ्यम् imperturbable, वरुणालयम् abode of Varuna (ocean), सागरम् ocean, कथम् how, तराम: to cross.
data.md: Thereupon, Hanumān and Sugrīva addressed Vibhisana, saying, Do you tell us how we shall cross over the main-the abode of Varuņa, along with the host of the highly powerful monkeys.

data.v: उपायैरभिगच्छामो यथा नदनदीपतिम् । तराम तरसा सर्वे ससैन्या वरुणालयम् ॥
data.es: "What strategy should we adopt to cross this abode of Varuna, the Lord of rivers and streams with the entire army of Vanaras?" (Hanuman and Sugriva asked Vibheeshana).
data.anv: नदनदीपतिम् Lord of rivers and streams, god of water, वरुणालयम् abode of Varuna, ससैन्याः with the army, सर्वे: entire, तरसा: to cross, यथा: this way, तराम: to cross, उपायैः strategy, अभिगच्चाम: shall we approach.
data.md: Do you inform us of the means by which we may cross over, along with our army, the lord of rivers and streams-the abode of Varuna."

data.v: एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मज्ञः प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः । समुद्रं राघवो राजा शरणं गन्तुमर्हति ॥
data.es: (Hanuman) having asked so, righteous Vibheeshana said, "O king Raghava We ought to go and seek refuge from the god of the ocean."
data.anv: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having said, धर्मात्मा: righteous self, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, प्रत्युवाच: replied, राजा: O King, राघवः Raghava, समुद्रम् ocean, शरणम् refuge, गन्तुम् will go, अर्हति: we ought to.
data.md: Being thus addressed, the virtuous-souled Vibhisana replied, "It behovth the king, Rāghava, to seek refuge from the Ocean.

data.v: खानितः सगरेणायमप्रमेयो महोदधिः । कर्तुमर्हति रामस्य ज्ञातेः कार्यं महोदधिः ॥
data.es: "This immeasurable great ocean was excavated by Sagara (A King of the Ikshvaku dynasty). The great ocean needs to do the task of Rama who is of the same race."
data.anv: आप्रमेयः unbounded, अयम: this, महोदधिः great ocean, सगरेण: by Sagara, खनितः excavated, महामतिः king of the great ocean, ज्ञात: race, रामस्य: Rama's, कार्यम् task, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हति: ought to.
data.md: This measureless deep was dug out by (the king) Sagara.* And the great ocean shall surely help Rāma belonging to Sagara's race. *Sagara was a sovereign of Ayodhyā, belonging to the same family with Rāma.

data.v: एवं विभीषणेनोक्ते राक्षसेन विपश्चिता । प्रकृत्या धर्मशीलस्य राघवस्याप्यरोचत ॥
data.es: Vibheeshana having spoken in that manner, Sugriva accompanied by Lakshmana reached near Rama.
data.anv: अथ: and then, विपश्चिता: learned, राक्षसेना: by rakshasa, विभीषणेन: by Vibheeshana, एवम् in that manner, उक्तः having spoken, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, सलक्ष्मणेन: accompanied by Lakshmana, रामः Rama, यत्र: where, आजगाम: reached.

data.v: स लक्ष्मणं महातेजाः सुग्रीवं च हरीश्वरम् । सत्क्रियार्थं क्रियादक्षः स्मितपूर्वमुवाच ह ॥
data.es: To Rama who was by nature righteous the advice (of Vibheeshana) was pleasing. To the brilliant Lakshmana of skilful action, to Sugriva the king of monkeys, Rama said smilingly.
data.anv: प्रकृत्या: by nature, धर्मशीलस्य: one who is of righteous character, अस्यरामस्यापि: to Rama also, रोचित: pleasing, महातेजाः brilliant, सः he, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, क्रियादक्षम् skilful at action, हरीश्वरम् king of Vanaras, सुग्रीवंच: and Sugriva also, सत्क्रियार्थम् about the task to be undertaken, स्मितपूर्वम् smilingly, उवाच: said.
data.md: And those words pleased Răma, pious by nature. And the highly effulgent (hero) requested, smiling, the active Lakşmaņa and the monkey-chief Sugrīva to collect necessaries for his adoration.

data.v: विभीषणस्य मन्त्रोऽयं मम लक्ष्मण रोचते । ब्रूहि त्वं सहसुग्रीवस्तवापि यदि रोचते ॥
सुग्रीवः पण्डितो नित्यं भवान्मन्त्रविचक्षणः । उभाभ्यां संप्रधार्यार्यं रोचते यत्तदुच्यताम् ॥
data.es: "Lakshmana This advice of Vibheeshana is pleasing to me. Sugriva is learned, and you are always capable of good advice. That which appeals to both of you, and which is meaningful may be informed to me."
data.anv: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, विभीषणस्य: Vibheeshana's, आयंमन्त्रः this advice, मम: to me,रोचते: pleasing, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, पण्डितः learned, भवान् me, नित्यम् ever, मन्त्रविशारद: capable of good advice, उभाभ्याम् for both, अर्थम् meaningful, सम्प्रधार्य: tradition, यत् that which, रोचते: appeals, तत् that, उच्यताम् may be told to me.
data.md: O Lakşmaņa, this counsel of Vibhīşaņa appear to me as most sound. Sugrīva is a ways greatly wise, and you are greatly proficient in counsel. Do you, holding a conference, intimate to me what you think becoming."

data.v: एवमुक्तौ तु तौ वीरावुभौ सुग्रीवलक्ष्मणौ । समुदाचार संयुक्तमिदं वचनमूचतुः ॥
data.es: Heroic Rama having said that way to both, Lakshmana and Sugriva replied thus respectfully following tradition (with folded hands).
data.anv: ततः then, एवम् that way, उक्तौ: having been said, वीरौ: heroic, सुग्रीवलक्ष्मणौ: to Sugriva and Lakshmana, उभौ: both, समुदाचारसंयुक्तम् mixed with respectful tradition, इदम् these, वचनम् words, ऊचतुः gave reply.
data.md: Thus addressed, those two heroes-Lakşmaņa and Sugriva, spoke respectfully the following words fraught with propriety.

data.v: किमर्थं नो नरव्याघ्र न रोचिष्यति राघव । विभीषणेन यत्तूक्तमस्मिन्काले सुखावहम् ॥
data.es: "O Raghava, the tiger among kings Why will this good advice given to us at this time by Vibheeshana be not pleasing?" Sugriva and Lakshmana said to Rama."
data.anv: नरव्याघ्र: tiger among kings, राघव: Raghava, अस्मिन् this, काले: time, सुखावहम् good, यत् that which, विभीषणेन: by Vibheeshana, उक्तम् has been spoken, नौ: us, किमर्थम् why will, नरोचिष्यति: it not be pleasing.
data.md: Why shall not the well-meaning words of Vibhīşaņa expressed now, please us O Rāghava, O you best of men?

data.v: अबद्ध्वा सागरे सेतुं घोरेऽस्मिन्वरुणालये । लङ्का नासादितुं शक्या सेन्द्रैरपि सुरासुरैः ॥
data.es: "Without building a bridge on that dreadful ocean, the abode of Varuna, it is not possible for suras or asuras accompanied by Indra also to crush Lanka."
data.anv: घोरे: dreadful, वरुणालये: abode of Varuna, सागरे: on the ocean, सेतुम्: bridge, अबध्वा: without building, लङ्का: Lanka, सेन्द्रैः Indra , सुरासुरैःअपि: even suras and asuras, मर्दितुम्: to crush, नशक्या: not possible
data.md: Without throwing a bridge over the ocean-the dread abode of Varuņa-even the Asuras and celestials with Indra (at their head) are unequal to subduing Laňkā.

data.v: विभीषणस्य शूरस्य यथार्थं क्रियतां वचः । अलं कालात्ययं कृत्वा समुद्रोऽयं नियुज्यताम् ॥
data.es: "Valiant Vibheeshana's words are true. Let us proceed and let us not waste time. Let us request Sagara to help the army to be able to proceed to Lanka ruled by Ravana (Sugriva and Lakshmana said to Rama)."
data.anv: शूरस्य: valiant, विभीषणस्य: Vibheeshana's, वचः words of advice, यथार्थम् are true, क्रियताम् to execute, कालात्ययम् no use was ting time, कृत्वा: to do, अलम् it is enough, रावणपालिताम् ruled by Ravana, पुरीम् city, यथा: like that, सैन्येन: army, गच्छाम: to proceed, सागर: अयं: over th is ocean, नियुज्यताम् let us request.
data.md: Do you act on the genuine counsel of the heroic Vibhisana, and without losing time, do you engage the Ocean for this work, so that we may with our army proceed to the city protected by Ravana.

data.v: एवमुक्तः कुशास्तीर्णे तीरे नदनदीपतेः । संविवेश तदा रामो वेद्यामिव हुताशनः ॥
data.es: Then when they (Sugriva and Lakshmana) said so to Rama, he sat on Kusa grass mat on the shore of the ocean just as fire stayed in the sacrificial altar.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकोनविंशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the nineteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having said, रामः Rama, तदा: then, नदनदीपतेः ocean, कुशास्तीर्णे: on the Kusa grass mat, तीरे: shore, हुताशन: fire God, वेद्यामिव: like in the sacrificial altar, संविवेश: sat.
data.md: Being thus addressed Räma reached the shore of the lord of rivers and streams, covered with Kusa, like to fire getting into the sacrificial dais.

data.v: तस्य रामस्य सुप्तस्य कुशास्तीर्णे महीतले । नियमादप्रमत्तस्य निशास्तिस्रोऽतिचक्रमुः ॥
data.es: As Rama kept himself alert with a vow and lay on the kusa grass m at spread on the ground, three nights rolled fast.
data.anv: नियमात् with vow, अप्रमत्तस्य kept himself alert, तस्य his, रामस्य Rama's, कुशास्तीर्णे on the kusa grass mat, महीतले on the ground, सुप्तस्य lying down, तिस्रः three, निशाः nights, अतिचक्रमुः rolled fast.
data.md: As Rāma slept on the earth on Kuśa spread over, without ever swerving from the rule, three nights passed away.

data.v: न च दर्शयते मन्दस्तदा रामस्य सागरः । प्रयतेनापि रामेण यथार्हमभिपूजितः ॥
data.es: Though Rama remained selfrestrained and respected the ocean well according to propriety, the ocean was dull and did not show its real form.
data.anv: प्रयतेन though selfrestrained, रामेण by Rama, यथार्हम् according to propriety, अभिपूजितः well respected, अपि also, मन्दः dull, सागरः the ocean, रामस्य to Rama, रूपम् real form, नचदर्शयते did not show.

data.v: समुद्रस्य ततः क्रुद्धो रामो रक्तान्तलोचनः । समीपस्थमुवाचेदं लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्ष्मणम् ॥
data.es: Enraged at the ocean, Rama's eyes turned red. He went near Lakshmana who was endowed with auspicious marks and thus addressed.
data.anv: ततः then, समुद्रस्य at the ocean, क्रुद्ध: enraged, रक्तान्तलोचनः eyes turned red, रामः Rama, समीपस्थम् went near, शुभलक्षणम् possessed of auspicious marks, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, इदम् thus, उवाच addressed.
data.md: Thereat Răma grew enraged and had the corners of his eyes crimsoned; and he spank to Laksmana of auspicious marks, saying.

data.v: पश्य तावदनार्यस्य पूज्यमानस्य लक्ष्मण । अवलेपं समुद्रस्य न दर्शयति यत्स्वयम् ॥
प्रशमश्च क्षमा चैव आर्जवं प्रियवादिता । असामर्थ्यं फलन्त्येते निर्गुणेषु सतां गुणाः ॥
data.es: "Why is it that the ocean does not show up to me? Indeed, calmness, forbearance, straightforwardness, politeness of speech are all attributes of virtuous qualities and one without these attributes are considered incapable."
data.anv: यः who is it, स्वयम् by himself, नदर्शयति does not show up, समुद्रस्य ocean's, अवलेपः pride, प्रशमश्चैव calmness also, क्षमाचैव with forbearance, आर्जवम् straight forwardness, प्रियवादिता politeness of speech, एते all these, सताम् virtues, गुणाः qualities, निर्गुणेषु without attributes, असामर्थ्यफलाःहि construed indeed as incapability.
data.md: Behold the hauteur of the Ocean in not presenting himself before Calmness, forbearance, candour, and soft speech-these virtues of the good are by the insolent taken for the effects of incompetency.

data.v: आत्मप्रशंसिनं दुष्टं धृष्टं विपरिधावकम् । सर्वत्रोत्सृष्टदण्डं च लोकः सत्कुरुते नरम् ॥
data.es: "Indeed, the world treats one with respect, who praises himself, as an impudent one, an unchaste one and one who goes about with a rod of punishment (not the one who is virtuous)."
data.anv: लोकः the world, आत्मप्रशंसिनम् praising one's own self, दुष्टम् wicked ones, धृष्टम् impudent, विपरिथावकम् an unchaste one, सर्वत्र all over उत्सृष्टदण्डंचनरम् one who goes about with a rod of punishment, सत्कुरुते treat with respect.
data.md: The person' that is self-laudatory, wicked and badly-bold, publish his own praise and met out chastisement everywhere, is honoured in the world. 1. The word, however, is naram (ac.), man. 2. i.e. indiscriminately.

data.v: न साम्ना शक्यते कीर्तिर्न साम्ना शक्यते यशः । प्राप्तुं लक्ष्मण लोकेऽस्मिञ्जयो वा रणमूधनि ॥
data.es: "O Lakshmana Neither fame nor popularity can win a battle front in this world."
data.anv: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, अस्मिन् in this, लोके world, साम्ना in front, कीर्तिः popularity, प्राप्तुम् is attained, नशक्यते not possible, यशः fame, न not, रणमूर्धनि in battlefront, जयोवा victorious, न not.
data.md: By moderation one cannot attain celebrity, by moderation one cannot attain fame, and, O Lakşmaņa, in this world by moderation one cannot attain victory on the edge of battle.* *Ranamārdhani, 'The perilous edge of battle when it raged.'

data.v: अद्य मद्बाणनिर्भिन्नैर्मकरैर्मकरालयम् । निरुद्धतोयं सौमित्रे प्लवद्भिः पश्य सर्वतः ॥
data.es: "Saumithri Witness the crocodiles shattered by my ruthless arrows jumping and floating in the ocean with water splashed on all sides."
data.anv: सौमित्रे Saumithri, अद्य now, महद्बाणनिर्भग्नैः shattered by my ruthless arrows, प्लवबदिः jumping and floating, मकरैः crocodiles, सर्वतः all over, निरुद्दतोयम् water splashed all sides, मकरालयम् abode of crocodiles, पश्य witness.
data.md: See, O Sumitrā's son, the abode of Makaras, with his waters obstructed all around with Makaras destroyed by my shafts. O Laksmana, see the bodies here of serpents, and the huge on bodies of mighty fishes, and the trunks of elephants, torn by my arrows.

data.v: महाभोगानि मत्स्यानां करिणां च करानिह । भोगांश्च पश्य नागानां मया भिन्नानि लक्ष्मण ॥
data.es: "Lakshmana See here the coils of serpents, huge snakes, fish and large sea elephants cut into pieces by me."
data.anv: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, मया by me, छिन्नानि cut into pieces, भोगिनाम् serpents, नागानां serpents coiled, मत्स्यानाम् fishes, महाभोगानि huge snakes, करिणाम् sea elephants, काराह large, इह now here, पश्य see.

data.v: सशङ्खशुक्तिका जालं समीनमकरं शरैः । अद्य युद्धेन महता समुद्रं परिशोषये ॥
data.es: "I shall make the ocean dry up with its shells and conchs, fishes and crocodiles in this great combat."
data.anv: सशङ्खशुक्तिकाजालम् water with its shells, conchs, तथा so also, समीनमकरम् with fishes and crocodiles, समुद्रम् ocean, अद्य now, महता, great युद्धेन combat, परिशोषये will make it dry.
data.md: To day in terrible battle will I dry up the Ocean with conchs and oysters, and fishes and Makaras.

data.v: क्षमया हि समायुक्तं मामयं मकरालयः । असमर्थं विजानाति धिक्क्षमामीदृशे जने ॥
data.es: "By my being tolerant, this ocean treats me to be incapable. Endowed with such qualities of forbearance, I will show the people (ocean)."
data.anv: क्षमया tolerance, समायुक्तम् remaining, माम् me, आयम् this, मकरालयः abode of fish, असमर्थम् incapable, विजानाति do not know, ईदृशे endowed with such qualities, जने people, क्षमाम् forbearance, धिक् show.

data.v: चापमानय सौमित्रे शरांश्चाशीविषोपमान् । अद्याक्षोभ्यमपि क्रुद्धः क्षोभयिष्यामि सागरम् ॥
वेलासु कृतमर्यादं सहसोर्मिसमाकुलम् । निर्मर्यादं करिष्यामि सायकैर्वरुणालयम् ॥
data.es: "(The ocean) Having made me angry, now I will torment the ocean even though it is imperturbable and has its limits. I will torment the ocean with its thousands of waves and mighty demons by my arrows and make the ocean cross its boundary."
data.anv: क्रुद्ध: made to be angry, अद्य now, अक्षोभ्यमपि even though imperturbable, सागरम् ocean, क्षोभयिष्यामि will torment, वेलासु thousands, कृतमर्यादम् one who has limits, सहस्रोर्मिसमाकुलम् with thousands of waves, वरुणालयम् the ocean, an abode of Lord Varuna, निर्मर्यादम् cross its boundary, सायकैः with arrows, करिष्यामि will make it, महादानवसङ्कुलम् mighty demons, महार्णवम् great ocean, क्षोभयिष्ये will torment.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा धनुष्पाणिः क्रोधविस्फारितेक्षणः । बभूव रामो दुर्धर्षो युगान्ताग्निरिव ज्वलन् ॥
data.es: Having spoken like that, Rama with his flaming red eyes seemed like the flame at the end of the universe and unassailable.
data.anv: एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा having spoken, धनुष्पाणिः bows etc. क्रोधविस्फारितेक्षणः with flaming red eyes, रामः Rama, ज्वलन् burning, युगान्तानगिरिव like the flame at the end of the universe, दुर्धर्षः unassailable, बभूव seemed.
data.md: Having spoken you, Rāma, equipped with his bow, with his eyes dilated in wrath, became exceedingly irrepressible, like to the flaming fire at the final dissolution.

data.v: संपीड्य च धनुर्घोरं कम्पयित्वा शरैर्जगत् । मुमोच विशिखानुग्रान्वज्राणीव शतक्रतुः ॥
data.es: Bending the terrific bow, he released frightful arrows like Indra (who released thunderbolts) who performed a hundred sacrifices.
data.anv: घोरम् terrific, धनुः bow, सम्पीड्यच bending, शरैः arrow, जगत् universe, कम्पयित्वा making to tremble, शतक्रतुः one who has performed a hundred sacrifices, वज्रानिव like Indra, उग्रान् frightful, विशिखान् arrows, मुमोच released.
data.md: And straining his dreadful bow, making the earth shake, tremulously, he let fly fierce shafts like him of an hundred sacrifices hurling his thunder-bolt.

data.v: ते ज्वलन्तो महावेगास्तेजसा सायकोत्तमाः । प्रविशन्ति समुद्रस्य सलिलं त्रस्तपन्नगम् ॥
data.es: Glowing in brilliance like flame, the arrows of the best among the arrows pierced like snakes into the water of the ocean.
data.anv: तेजसा glowing in brilliance, ज्वलन्तः flaming, वेगाः speedily, ते that, सायकोत्तमाः best among the arrows, त्रस्तपन्नगम् like the snakes, समुद्रस्य into the ocean, सलिलम् waters, प्रविशन्ति pierced.
data.md: Thereat, flaming up, those vehement choice shafts surcharged with energy, enter into the waters of the sea, with its serpents afflicted with fear.

data.v: ततो वेगः समुद्रस्य सनक्रमकरो महान् । संबभूव महाघोरः समारुतरवस्तदा ॥
data.es: Then the ocean seemed terrible with the fish and crocodiles rushing out with the speed of water and powerful wind.
data.anv: समुद्रस्य ocean's, समीनमकरः with fishes and crocodiles, तदा similarly, समारुतरवः with wind, महान् powerful, सः that, तोयवेगः rush of water, महाघोरः terrible, बभूव seemed.
data.md: Then great and exceedingly dreadful was the motion of the sea, with fishes and Makaras, and with the roar of the winds (blowing there).

data.v: महोर्मिमालाविततः शङ्खशुक्तिसमाकुलः । सधूमपरिवृत्तोर्मिः सहसाभून्महोदधिः ॥
data.es: With the movement of the sea water filled with the conchs and shells suddenly terrific smoke whirling round and rising played around.
data.anv: सहसा all of a sudden, महोदधिः great ocean, महोर्मिजालचलितः with the movement of the water, शङ्खजालसमावृतः filled with conchs and shells, सधूमः terrific smoke, परिवृत्तोर्मिः whirling round and rising up, आसीत् played around.
data.md: On a sudden the mighty deep was heaving with mighty surges, with conchs scattered about, and a smoke (enveloped) the ocean; and the billows became visible on all sides.

data.v: व्यथिताः पन्नगाश्चासन्दीप्तास्या दीप्तलोचनाः । दानवाश्च महावीर्याः पातालतलवासिनः ॥
data.es: Those snakes with blazing hoods and glowing eyes residing in the underworld and the demons became oppressed.
data.anv: दीप्तास्याः those blazing, दीप्तलोचनाः ones with glowing eyes, पन्नगाः snakes, पाताळतलवासिनः those who reside in underworld, महावीर्याः highly valiant ones, दानवाश्च and the demons, व्यथित्याः oppressed आसन् became.
data.md: The serpents were distressed, with their faces flaming and their eyes aglow; as well as the Dānavas of terrific energy, and the dwellers of the nether spheres.

data.v: ऊर्मयः सिन्धुराजस्य सनक्रमकरास्तदा । विन्ध्यमन्दरसंकाशाः समुत्पेतुः सहस्रशः ॥
data.es: Thousands of waves of the ocean rose like the peaks of Vindhya and Mandara mountains.
data.anv: तथा so also, सिन्दुराजस्य king of rivers, सनक्रमकराः which were like, विन्द्यमन्दरसङ्काशाः Vindhya and Mandara mountain peaks, ऊर्मयः waves, सहस्रशः in thousands, समुत्पेतुः rose up.
data.md: Billows of the sovran Ocean, resembling Vindhya or Mandara, containing crocodiles and Makaras, sprang up by thousands.

data.v: आघूर्णिततरङ्गौघः संभ्रान्तोरगराक्षसः । उद्वर्तित महाग्राहः संवृत्तः सलिलाशयः ॥
data.es: The waves rose up tossing and whirling about. The agitated Nagas and Rakshasas were thrown up by a highly disturbed ocean that produced a great sound.
data.anv: आघूर्णिततरङ्गौघः the waves tossing and whirling about, सम्भ्रान्तोरगराक्षसः the agitated Nagas and Rakshasas, उद्वर्तितमहाग्राहः thrown up highly disturbed, सलिलाशयः from the waters, सघोषः made great sound.
data.md: Varuņa's abode had its surges whirling its serpents and Räkşasas seized with affright, and its ferocious aquatic animals borne all around; and it sent forth sounds.

data.v: ततो मध्यात्समुद्रस्य सागरः स्वयमुत्थितः । उदयन्हि महाशैलान्मेरोरिव दिवाकरः । पन्नगैः सह दीप्तास्यैः समुद्रः प्रत्यदृश्यत ॥
data.es: Then Sagara, the Lord of the ocean himself rising like the Sun over the mighty Meru Mountain rose from the middle of the ocean.
data.anv: ततः then, महामेरोः over the mighty Meru, उदयं rising, दिवाकरःइव like the Sun, सागरः Lord of ocean, समुद्रस्य ocean's, मध्यात् middle, स्वयम् himself, उत्थितः risen.
data.md: Then from forth the mid-sea arose Ocean himself, even as the maker of day rise from the mighty ascending-hill, Meru.

data.v: स्निग्धवैदूर्यसंकाशो जाम्बूनदविभूषितः । रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरः पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः ॥
सागरः समतिक्रम्य पूर्वमामन्त्र्य वीर्यवान् । अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं राघवं शरपाणिनम् ॥
data.md: And approaching the arrow-showering Rāma, and greeting him fair, Ocean spoke to him with joined hands.

data.v: पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च राघवः । स्वभावे सौम्य तिष्ठन्ति शाश्वतं मार्गमाश्रिताः ॥
data.es: "Noble Rama Earth, wind, space, water, and fire, the five elements remain in their path strictly following their nature."
data.anv: सौम्य noble, राघव Rama, पृथिवी earth, वायुः wind, आकाशम् space, आपः water, ज्योतिश्च fire, शाश्वतम् permanent, मार्गम् path, आश्रिताः following, स्वभावे its nature, तिष्ठन्ति remain.
data.md: O Rāghava, earth, air, sky, water and light, these, O mild one, retaining their eternal course, maintain their (respective) nature.

data.v: तत्स्वभावो ममाप्येष यदगाधोऽहमप्लवः । विकारस्तु भवेद्राध एतत्ते प्रवदाम्यहम् ॥
data.es: "I am fathomless and as such not capable of being swum across as it is my nature too. My fording will be a deviation. I proclaim to you (how you can cross)."
data.anv: तत् that, अहम् I, अगाधः fathomless, अप्लवःइतयत् as such not capable of swimming out, एषः so, ममापि mine too, स्वभावः nature, गाधःतु fording, विकारः deviation, भवेत् will be, एतत् as such, ते to you, प्रवदामि I proclaim
data.md: Mine also is that nature whereby I am fathomless and incapable of being crossed. The reverse of this is the having a bottom. And for this reason I speak to you (concerning the means).

data.v: न कामान्न च लोभाद्वा न भयात्पार्थिवात्मज । ग्राहनक्राकुलजलं स्तम्भयेयं कथंचन ॥
data.es: "O Lord of the land Out of desire or covetousness or even out of fear I will not be able to solidify the water infested with poisonous animals."
data.anv: पार्थिवात्मज O Lord of the land, ग्राहनकाकुलजलम् infested by poisonous animals, कामात् out of desire, कथंचन in any case, स्तम्बयेयम् solidify water, लोभाद्वा out of covetousness, भयात् out of fear, न not.
data.md: O king's son, not from desire, covetousness, or fear, or anger, can I anywise deprive my waters abounding in alligators of their (perpetual) motion.

data.v: विधास्ये राम येनापि विषहिष्ये ह्यहं तथा । ग्राहा न प्रहरिष्यन्ति यावत्सेना तरिष्यति ॥
data.es: "O Rama I shall arrange a base in such a mode, by means of which the entire army of Vanaras can cross over the passage and I will also be seizing the poisonous animals and not be aggressive."
data.anv: राम O Rama, अहम् I, येनापि by means of which, तथा so also, विधास्ये in such a mode, हरीणाम् by the Vanaras, तरणे to cross over, स्थलम् base, यत्रा passage, करिष्यामि I will do, तथा and similarly, विषहिष्ये the poisonous creatures, सेना army, यावत् total, तरष्यति crosses over, ग्राहाः seizing, नप्रहरिष्यन्ति will not be of aggressive nature.
data.md: I will tell you how you will pass (over me); or and I will bear it. And no ferocious aquatic animals shall do wrong so long as your forces have not crossed. And, O Rāma, I will make as it were firm land for the crossing over of the monkeys.

data.v: अयं सौम्य नलो नाम तनुजो विश्वकर्मणः । पित्रा दत्तवरः श्रीमान्प्रतिमो विश्वकर्मणः ॥
data.es: "Noble Rama This prosperous one named Nala is the son of Vishwakarma. Since he has obtained boons from his father, he is equal to his father in architecture."
data.anv: सौम्य noble one, श्रीमान् prosperous one, नलोनाम named Nala, अयम् this, विश्वकर्मणः by Vishwakarma's, तनयः son, पित्रा father, दत्तवरः obtained boons, विश्वकर्मणः in architecture, प्रतिमः equal to father.
data.md: O mild one, this one is named Nala, son to Viśvakarmā. He has received a boon from his sire. Visvakarma's son is well pleased with you. Let this monkey, surcharged with exhuberant spirits, build a bridge over me. I will hold that up. This one is as his sire.

data.v: एष सेतुं महोत्साहः करोतु मयि वानरः । तमहं धारयिष्यामि तथा ह्येष यथा पिता ॥
data.es: "This monkey is full of zeal. He will build a bridge over me, and I will bear it. In that way he is like his father."
data.anv: महोत्साहः full of zeal, एषःवानरः this Vanara, मयि over me, सेतुम् bridge, करोतु will built, तम् him, अहम् I, धारयिष्यामि will bear, पिता father, यथा that way, एषः he is, तथा like him.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वोदधिर्नष्टः समुत्थाय नलस्ततः । अब्रवीद्वानरश्रेष्ठो वाक्यं रामं महाबलः ॥
data.es: Having spoken in that way, the Sea God disappeared. Nala, the foremost of vanaras, got up there after and spoke these words to mighty Rama.
data.anv: उदधिः Sea God, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, नष्टः disappeared, तदा thereafter, वानरश्रेष्ठः foremost of Vanaras, नलः Nala, समुत्थाय getting up, महाबलः mighty, रामम् at Rama, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: Having delivered himself thus, Ocean disappeared. Then that foremost of monkeys, Nala, arising, spoke to the mighty Rāma.

data.v: अहं सेतुं करिष्यामि विस्तीर्णे वरुणालये । पितुः सामर्थ्यमास्थाय तत्त्वमाह महोदधिः ॥
data.anv: अहम् I, पितुः father, सामर्थ्यम् skill, आस्थाय adopting, विस्तीर्णे broad, वरुणालये on the abode of Varuna, सेतुम् bridge, करिष्यामि will build महोदधिः ocean god, तत्त्वम् truth, आह has spoken.
data.md: Resorting to my sire's skill, I will build a bridge over the spacious abode of Makaras. The mighty Ocean has spoken justly.

data.v: मम मातुर्वरो दत्तो मन्दरे विश्वकर्मणा । औरसस्तस्य पुत्रोऽहं सदृशो विश्वकर्मणा ॥
data.md: (Formerly) in Mandara, Visvakarma had conferred a boon on my mother: 'O exalted one, your son shall be like me.

data.v: न चाप्यहमनुक्तो वै प्रब्रूयामात्मनो गुणान् । काममद्यैव बध्नन्तु सेतुं वानरपुंगवाः ॥
data.md: I also am capable of constructing a bridge over Varuna's abode. Therefore this very day let the foremost monkeys construct the bridge.

data.v: ततो निसृष्टरामेण सर्वतो हरियूथपाः । अभिपेतुर्महारण्यं हृष्टाः शतसहस्रशः ॥
data.es: Then directed by Rama the Vanara troop leaders in hundreds and thousands sprang up gladly all over the huge forest.
data.anv: ततः then, रामेण by Rama, विसृष्टाः directed, रियूथपाः Vanara troop leaders, हृष्टाः gladly, शतसहस्रशः hundred thousand, महारण्यम् huge forest, सर्वतः all over, अभ्युत्पेतुः sprang up.
data.md: Then directed by Rāma, the principal monkeys with alacrity entered the mighty forest in hundreds and thousands.

data.v: ते नगान्नगसंकाशाः शाखामृगगणर्षभाः । बभञ्जुर्वानरास्तत्र प्रचकर्षुश्च सागरम् ॥
data.es: Mountain like bodied Vanara bulls there upon started collecting roots of trees from the foot of mountain and moved them into the sea.
data.anv: नगसङ्काशाः mountain like, ते those, शाखामृगगणर्षभाः bulls among Vanaras, तत there upon, नगान् from the mountain, पादपान् roots of trees, बभञ्जुः collected, सागरम् into the sea, प्रचकर्षुश्च started moving.
data.md: Themselves resembling mountains, the foremost of the monkeys began to break down trees and draw them towards the Ocean.

data.v: ते सालैश्चाश्वकर्णैश्च धवैर्वंशैश्च वानराः । कुटजैरर्जुनैस्तालैस्तिकलैस्तिमिशैरपि ॥
data.es: The Vanaras brought sala, asvakarna, dhava, bamboo, kutaja arjuna, palmira, tilaka, trisaira, bilva, saptaparni trees karnikara plants with blossoms, mango trees and ashoka trees and dumped into the ocean.
data.anv: वानराः Vanaras, सालैश्च sala trees, अश्वकर्णैश्च as vakarna trees, धवैः dhava trees, वंशैश्च bamboo, कुटजैः kutaja, अर्जुनैः arjuna, तालैः palmira, तिलकैः tilaka, न्तिशैरपि trisaira, बिल्वकैः bilva, सप्तपर्णैश्च and saptaparni, पुष्पितैःकर्णिकारैः karnikara blossoms, चूतैश्च mango, अशोकवृक्षैश्च and ashoka trees, सागरम् into ocean, पर्यपूरयन् brought and dumped.
data.md: The monkeys filled the Ocean with Sālas, and Ašvakarņas, dhavas, bamboo's and kutajas, arjunas, palms, tilakas, tinicas, billakas, saptaparnas, and blossoming karnikāras, mangoes, and asoka trees.

data.v: बिल्वकैः सप्तपर्णैश्च कर्णिकारैश्च पुष्पितैः । चूतैश्चाशोकवृक्षैश्च सागरं समपूरयन् ॥
data.es: The Vanaras brought sala, asvakarna, dhava, bamboo, kutaja arjuna, palmira, tilaka, trisaira, bilva, saptaparni trees karnikara plants with blossoms, mango trees and ashoka trees and dumped into the ocean.
