data.anv: घण्टानाम् of bells, निर्घोषम् ringing, शृणु listen, रथानाम् of chariots, निःस्वनम् rattling, शृणु listen, ह्रेषमाणानाम् neighing, हयानाम् of horses, तूर्यध्वनिंयथा like the flourish of the trumpets, शृणु listen, एषः in that manner, उद्यतायुधहस्तानाम् uplifted weapons, राक्षसेन्द्रानुयायिनाम् following the lead off the king, रक्षसाम् of Rakshasas, तुमुलः tumultuous, रोमहर्षणः horripilation, सम्भ्रमः happy.

data.v: श्रीस्त्वां भजति शोकघ्नी रक्षसां भयमागतम् । रामात्कमलपत्राक्षि दैत्यानामिव वासवात् ॥
data.es: "Your fire of anger will be gone. Your husband, the lotuspetal eyed Rama whose prowess is inconceivable like that of Indra who vanquished Daityas will come and kill Ravana and win you back."
data.anv: शोकघ्नी fire of anger, श्रीः victory, त्वाम् you, भजति will get you, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, भयम् fear, आगतम् will come, अदैत्यानाम् Daityas, वासवःइव like the Lord of Devatas who vanquished Daityas, कमलपत्राक्षः lotus petaleyed, भर्ता husband, जितक्रोधः who has conquered anger, अच्नित्यपराक्रमः whose process is inconceivable, रामः Rama, तंरावणम् that Ravana, समरे in war, हत्वा killing, त्वा you, अधिगमिष्यति will win you back.

data.v: अवजित्य जितक्रोधस्तमचिन्त्यपराक्रमः । रावणं समरे हत्वा भर्ता त्वाधिगमिष्यति ॥
data.es: "Your fire of anger will be gone. Your husband, the lotuspetal eyed Rama whose prowess is inconceivable like that of Indra who vanquished Daityas will come and kill Ravana and win you back."
data.anv: शोकघ्नी fire of anger, श्रीः victory, त्वाम् you, भजति will get you, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, भयम् fear, आगतम् will come, अदैत्यानाम् Daityas, वासवःइव like the Lord of Devatas who vanquished Daityas, कमलपत्राक्षः lotus petaleyed, भर्ता husband, जितक्रोधः who has conquered anger, अच्नित्यपराक्रमः whose process is inconceivable, रामः Rama, तंरावणम् that Ravana, समरे in war, हत्वा killing, त्वा you, अधिगमिष्यति will win you back.
data.md: As Vasava did to the Daityas, the lotus-eyed Rāma, your lord-of controlled anger, and of inconceivable prowess, slaying Rävaņa in battle and thus delivering you, shall approach you.

data.v: विक्रमिष्यति रक्षःसु भर्ता ते सहलक्ष्मणः । यथा शत्रुषु शत्रुघ्नो विष्णुना सह वासवः ॥
data.es: "Your husband accompanied by Lakshmana will exhibit his valour against Rakshasas just as Indra did against enemies accompanied by Vishnu (descended as his younger brother)."
data.anv: सहलक्ष्मणः accompanied by Lakshmana, तेभर्ता your husband, शत्रुघ्नः destroy, विष्णुनासह along with Vishnu, वासवः Indra, शत्रुषु against enemy, यथा just as, रक्षस्सु Rakshasas, विक्रमिष्यति will exhibit his valour.
data.md: And, as Väsava put forth his prowess among his foes, in company with the foe-destroying Visnu, your lord, along with Laksmana, shall display his prowess among the Rākşasa.

data.v: आगतस्य हि रामस्य क्षिप्रमङ्कगतां सतीम् । अहं द्रक्ष्यामि सिद्धार्थां त्वां शत्रौ विनिपातिते ॥
data.es: "When the enemy is killed, and your objective is accomplished, I shall behold you mounted on the lap of Rama."
data.anv: शत्रौ enemy, विनिपातिते after killing, सिद्धार्धाम् having accomplished, त्वाम् you, आगतव्य mounted on, रामस्य Rama's, अङ्कागतांसतीम् on the lap Rama, क्षिप्रम् soon, अहम् I, द्रक्ष्यामि will behold you.
data.md: On the enemy having fallen, I shall behold you, devoted to your lord, with your desire attained, soon lying on the lap of Rama.

data.v: अश्रूण्यानन्दजानि त्वं वर्तयिष्यसि शोभने । समागम्य परिष्वक्ता तस्योरसि महोरसः ॥
data.es: "Virtuous Sita! Hugged by your broad chested Rama, you will shed tears of joy on his bosom."
data.anv: शोभने virtuous woman, समागम्य arrived, परिष्वज्य hugged, महोरसः broadchested, तस्य his, उरसि bosom, आनन्दजानि tears of joy, अश्रूण्याणि tears, वर्तयिष्यसि will shed.
data.md: And, O Janaki, embracing (your lord) you shall shed tears of joy on his mighty breast.

data.v: अचिरान्मोक्ष्यते सीते देवि ते जघनं गताम् । धृतामेतां बहून्मासान्वेणीं रामो महाबलः ॥
data.es: "O Sita! God like lady! Mighty Rama will soon release your single plait hanging up to hind part for many months before."
data.anv: सीते O Sita, देवि God like, महाबलः mighty, रामः Rama, बहून् many, मासान् months, धृताम् , ते your, एताम् , जघनम् your hind part, गताम् before, एकांवेणीम् single plait, अचिरात् very soon, मोक्ष्यते will release.
data.md: O Sitä, soon shall the highly powerful Răma loosen this braid of your reaching to your hips, which you have been wearing for many a month.

data.v: तस्य दृष्ट्वा मुखं देवि पूर्णचन्द्रमिवोदितम् । मोक्ष्यसे शोकजं वारि निर्मोकमिव पन्नगी ॥
data.es: "God like Lady! Beholding the face of Sri Rama whose face is like a just risen full moon, you will cast off tears of sorrow just as a female snake sets its slough free."
data.anv: देवी God like lady, तस्य your, उदितम् countenance, पूर्णचन्द्रम् इव like full moon, मुखम् face, दृष्टवा seen, पन्नगी female snake, निर्मोकमिव like setting free the slough, शोकजम् born of grief, वारि water, मोक्ष्यसे casts off.
data.md: O exalted one, seeing his face like the full moon risen, you shall shed water begot of ruth, even as a she-serpent casts off her slough.

data.v: रावणं समरे हत्वा नचिरादेव मैथिलि । त्वया समग्रं प्रियया सुखार्हो लप्स्यते सुखम् ॥
data.es: "O divine Mythili! Killing Ravana in war before long, your beloved who deserves to be happy will be happy in the company of his beloved."
data.anv: देवी God like lady, मैथिली Mythili, सुखार्हः who deserves to be happy, नचिरात् before long, समरे in war, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा killing, प्रियया beloved, त्वया you, समग्रः companion, सुखम् happiness, लप्स्यते will enjoy.
data.md: O Mithila's daughter, speedily slaying Ravana in battle, that one worthy of happiness shall reap felicity in the company of you, his beloved.

data.v: समागता त्वं रामेण मोदिष्यसि महात्मना । सुवर्षेण समायुक्ता यथा सस्येन मेदिनी ॥
data.es: "Just as the earth becomes green with crops blessed with good monsoon, so also you will become joyful by seeing the great soul Rama's heroism."
data.anv: त्वम् you, सुवर्षेण with good monsoon, समायुक्ता filled with, मेदिनी earth, सस्येनयथा just as the crops, महात्मना great soul, वीर्येण heroism, समागता will become, मोदिष्यति joyful.
data.md: And, loved by the high-souled Rama, you, shall be happy, even as the Earth furnished with crops brought forth by plenteous showers.

data.v: गिरिवरमभितोऽनुवर्तमानो; हय इव मण्डलमाशु यः करोति । तमिह शरणमभ्युपेहि देवि; दिवसकरं प्रभवो ह्ययं प्रजानाम् ॥
data.md: Do you, O exalted one, take refuge with him, who, going round the foremost of mountains, speedily assume a steed-like circular movement; for even the maker of day is the source of people's joy and grief.

data.v: अथ तां जातसंतापां तेन वाक्येन मोहिताम् । सरमा ह्लादयामास पृतिवीं द्यौरिवाम्भसा ॥
data.es: Thus, Sita's agony was put off by Saarana's consoling words and Sita was glad just as the parched earth was delighted with shower of rain.
data.anv: अथ and thus, जातसन्तापाम् put off the agony, तेनवाक्येन by her words, मोदिताम् gladdened, ताम् that, सरमा Saarana, घौरीम् parched, महीम् earth, अम्भसाइव like rainwater, समाह्लादयामास consoled and delighted.
data.md: Burning with grief on account of those words,* Sarama gladdened and cheered her, even as masses of clouds (cheer up) the burning Earth. *i.e.the words of Ravana.

data.v: ततस्तस्या हितं सख्याश्चिकीर्षन्ती सखी वचः । उवाच काले कालज्ञा स्मितपूर्वाभिभाषिणी ॥
data.es: Then Saarana who knew the right time to do so, wishing the welfare of her dear friend Sita and desirous of doing anything for her smiled before she started speaking.
data.anv: ततः then, कालज्ञा who knows the time to do, स्मितपूर्वाभिभाषिणी who smiles before talking, सखी friend, सख्याः beloved, तस्याः her, हितम् welfare, चिकीर्षन्ती desirous of doing anything, काले in time, वचः these words, उवाच spoke.
data.md: Then, desirous of doing her good, (Sita's) friend, conversant with season, and ever precluding her speech with a smile, spoke to her seasonably.

data.v: उत्सहेयमहं गत्वा त्वद्वाक्यमसितेक्षणे । निवेद्य कुशलं रामे प्रतिच्छन्ना निवर्तितुम् ॥
data.es: "Darkeyed Sita! I am eager to go (to Rama's presence) and communicate your welfare and message. I can return back hidden (from Ravana's view)."
data.anv: असितेक्षणे dark eyed lady, अहम् I, प्रतिच्छन्ना hidden, गत्वा going, त्वद्वाक्यम् your message, कुशलम् welfare, रामे to Rama, निवेद्य communicate, निवर्तितुम् return back, उत्सहेयम् eager.
data.md: O you having dark eyes, I can, secretly going to Rama and communicating to him your auspicious words, come back clandestinely.

data.v: न हि मे क्रममाणाया निरालम्बे विहायसि । समर्थो गतिमन्वेतुं पवनो गरुडोऽपि वा ॥
data.es: "While I fly through the sky without any support, either the wind god or even Garuda will not be capable of following my movement."
data.anv: निरालम्बे without any support, विहायसि going through the sky, क्रममाणायाः proceeding, मे me, गतिम् movement, अन्वेतुम् to follow, पवनः wind god, गरुडोऽपिवा or even Garuda, नसमर्थः not capable.
data.md: Nor, when I course the supportless sky, can even the Wind or Garuda follow me.

data.v: एवं ब्रुवाणां तां सीता सरमां पुनरब्रवीत् । मधुरं श्लक्ष्णया वाचा पूर्वशोकाभिपन्नया ॥
data.es: When Saarana was telling Sita in that way, Sita's face which was earlier filled with tears became pleasant and she spoke again.
data.anv: सीता Sita, एवम् in that manner, ब्रुवाणाम् telling, तांसरमाम् that Saarana, पूर्वशोकाभिपन्नया earlier filled with tears, श्लक्क्षणया gentle countenance, वाचा spoke, मधुरम् sweet, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् said.
data.md: As she said this, Sita with her grief a little lightened, said to Sarama in sweet and smooth words.

data.v: समर्था गगनं गन्तुमपि वा त्वं रसातलम् । अवगच्छाम्यकर्तव्यं कर्तव्यं ते मदन्तरे ॥
data.es: "You are capable of flying through the sky or even going to the underworld. For my sake you will do what cannot be done also and that it is your bounden duty, is also known to me."
data.anv: त्वम् you, गगनम् in the sky, अपिच even, रसातलम् underworld, गन्तुम् , समर्था capable, अकर्तव्यम् that which can't be done, मदन्तरे for my sake, ते you, कर्तव्यम् duty, एवगच्छामि also known to me.
data.md: You are capable of even going to the nethermost regions. But do you on my behalf that which is fit to be done by you.

data.v: मत्प्रियं यदि कर्तव्यं यदि बुद्धिः स्थिरा तव । ज्ञातुमिच्छामि तं गत्वा किं करोतीति रावणः ॥
data.es: "In my opinion, your duty for me is to go and find out what Ravana is doing now, if you are firmly resolved."
data.anv: मप्रतियम् in my opinion, कर्तव्यंयदि What you should do, तव your, बुद्धिः understood, स्थिरायदि resolved firmly, रावणः Ravana, किंकरोतीति What is he doing, तम् to him, गत्वा you go, ज्ञातुम् find out, इच्छामि I wish.
data.md: If you intend doing me a good turn, and if your sense be steady, I would know what Ravana is doing after having left this place.

data.v: स हि मायाबलः क्रूरो रावणः शत्रुरावणः । मां मोहयति दुष्टात्मा पीतमात्रेव वारुणी ॥
data.es: "Ravana has the power of conjuring tricks, makes enemies cry. He is cruel, evil minded and deluding me as though he has drunk liquor."
data.anv: मायाबलः power to conjure, शत्रुरावणः who makes enemies cry, क्रूरः cruel, दुष्टात्मा evil minded, सःरावणः that Ravana, पीतमात्रा drunk, वारुणीव liquor, माम् to me, मोहयति deluded.
data.md: That guileful and wicked-minded one, Rāvana, destroyer of enemies, having powers of illusion, overwhelms me even as the Vāruni just drunk.

data.v: तर्जापयति मां नित्यं भर्त्सापयति चासकृत् । राक्षसीभिः सुघोराभिर्या मां रक्षन्ति नित्यशः ॥
data.es: "He, that Ravana makes even the frightful Rakshasa care takers threaten me and reproach me repeatedly every day."
data.anv: याः he, माम् to me, नित्यशः all the time, रक्षन्ति takes care, सुघोराभिः most frightful, राक्षसीभिः even Rakshasa women, माम् to me, असकृत् repeatedly, नित्यम् every day, तर्जापयति threatening, भर्त्सापयति reproaching
data.md: Confining me here for ever and a day, (Rāvana) sets on dreadful Räksnasas to alike threaten and scold me constantly.

data.v: उद्विग्ना शङ्किता चास्मि न च स्वस्थं मनो मम । तद्भयाच्चाहमुद्विग्ना अशोकवनिकां गताः ॥
data.es: "I am perturbed and doubtful (of my life). My mind is not at ease. Even though I am in Ashoka Grove I am disturbed."
data.anv: अहम् I am, उद्विग्ना perturbed, शङ्किताच and doubting, अस्मि, मम to me, मनः mind, सस्वस्थम् not at ease, अहम् I am, अशोकवनिकाम् in the Asoka grove, गता remaining, तद्भयात् fear of him, उद्विग्ना perturbed.
data.md: And I am agitated and alarmed and my mind is (always) uneasy. And I, dwelling in the Asoka wood, is ever agitated.

data.v: यदि नाम कथा तस्य निश्चितं वापि यद्भवेत् । निवेदयेथाः सर्वं तत्परो मे स्यादनुग्रहः ॥
data.es: "Indeed, please tell me certainly in toot, whatever decision that enemy takes and everything. Be kind to me and tell."
data.anv: तस्य his, कथा everything, यदिनाम whatever decision, यत् that, निश्चितंवापि indeed certainly, भवेत् tell me, तत् सर्वम् fully, निवेदयेथाः please tell, तत् that, मे to me, परः enemy, अनुग्रहः kindly, स्यात् being.
data.md: If there is any talk (of delivering me), or keeping me confined, you should communicate to me the decision arrived at.

data.v: सा त्वेवं ब्रुवतीं सीतां सरमा वल्गुभाषिणी । उवाच वचनं तस्याः स्पृशन्ती बाष्पविक्लवम् ॥
data.es: Saarana who speaks sweetly, kept wiping Sita's face covered with tears gently and replied in this manner.
data.anv: वल्गुभाषिणी of gentle expression, सा she, सरमापि Saarana also, एवम् in that manner, ब्रुवतीम् replied, सीताम् to Sita, तस्याः her, बाष्पविक्लबम् covered with tears, वदनम् face, स्पृशन्ती gently wiping, उवाच replied.
data.md: This is the highest favour that I seek (at hands). Thereat, the mild-speeched Saramā, wiping (Sītā's) face washed in tears, spoke to her, as she said this.

data.v: एष ते यद्यभिप्रायस्तस्माद्गच्छामि जानकि । गृह्य शत्रोरभिप्रायमुपावृत्तां च पश्य माम् ॥
data.es: "Janaki! If you think so, I shall go to Ravana secretly and find out his intention and return back."
data.anv: जानकी Janaki, एषः if it is so, ते to you, अभिप्रायःयदि if it is your opinion, तस्मात् to him, गच्छामि shall go, शत्रोः enemy, अभिप्रायम् intention, गृह्य find out secretly, उपावृत्ताम् shall return back.
data.md: If this is your wish, I will go, O Jānaki. O Mithila's daughter, having possessed myself of the intent of the enemy, I shall come back.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा ततो गत्वा समीपं तस्य रक्षसः । शुश्राव कथितं तस्य रावणस्य समन्त्रिणः ॥
data.es: Having said so to Sita, she (Saarana) moved closer (to Ravana) and heard Ravana's conversation with his ministers.
data.anv: एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, ततः she, तस्यरक्षसः her attendant, समीपम् near, गत्वा went, समन्त्रिणः with ministers, तस्य their, रावणस्य Ravana's, कथितम् talk, शुश्राव heard.
data.md: Having said this, (Saramā), repairing to the Raksasa, heard Raksa, heard Ravana's converse with his counsellors.

data.v: सा श्रुत्वा निश्चयं तस्य निश्चयज्ञा दुरात्मनः । पुनरेवागमत्क्षिप्रमशोकवनिकां तदा ॥
data.es: Having heard and known the intention of evilminded Ravana, she (Saarana) quickly reached the beautiful Ashoka grove.
data.anv: निश्चयज्ञा known the intention, सा of him, Ravana, दुरात्मनः evil minded, तस्य his, निश्चयम् decision, श्रुत्वा heard, क्षिप्रम् quickly, पुनरेव once again, शुभाम् beautiful, अशोकवनिकाम् Ashoka grove, आगमत् reached.
data.md: Having heard of the decision of that wickedminded one, she, understanding decisions, swiftly retraced her steps to the fair Asoka forest.

data.v: सा प्रविष्टा पुनस्तत्र ददर्श जनकात्मजाम् । प्रतीक्षमाणां स्वामेव भ्रष्टपद्मामिव श्रियम् ॥
data.es: On entering the Ashoka grove, she saw the daughter of Janaka eagerly waiting for her every moment, looking like Lord Vishnu's wife Lakshmi, who lost her lotus seat.
data.anv: प्रविष्टा having entered, सा she, तत्र then, स्वामेव for her, प्रतीक्षमाणाम् waiting eagerly every moment, भ्रष्टपद्माम् one who lost the lotus seat, श्रियम् इव, जनकात्मजाम् daughter of Janaka, ददर्श saw.
data.md: Then, entering there, she saw Janaka's daughter, expecting (her) like a very Sri,, bereft of her lotus.

data.v: तां तु सीता पुनः प्राप्तां सरमां वल्गुभाषिणीम् । परिष्वज्य च सुस्निग्धं ददौ च स्वयमासनम् ॥
data.es: On seeing the kind Saarana returning, Sita was very glad. She embraced her and offered a seat herself.
data.anv: सीता Sita, पुनः again, प्राप्ताम् returning, वल्गुभाषिणीम् who spoke kindly, सरमाम् Saarana, सुस्निग्धम् very glad, परिष्वज्य embraced, स्वयम् herself, आसनम् seat, ददौ offered.
data.md: And, the fair-spoken Sarama, on getting back (near her), Sītā, embracing her affectionately, herself gave her a seat.

data.v: इहासीना सुखं सर्वमाख्याहि मम तत्त्वतः । क्रूरस्य निश्चयं तस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ॥
data.es: "Seated here happily reveals to me truly that cruel and evil minded Ravana's intention."
data.anv: इह here, सुखम् happily, आसीना seated, क्रूरस्य cruel one, दुरात्मनः evil minded one, तस्यरावणस्य that Ravana's, निश्चयम् intention, सर्वम् in toot, मम to me, तत्त्वतः truly, आख्याहि reveal to me.
data.md: Sitting down here at ease, do you relate to me faithfully all about the determination of the wicked-minded and guileful Ravana.

data.v: एवमुक्ता तु सरमा सीतया वेपमानया । कथितं सर्वमाचष्ट रावणस्य समन्त्रिणः ॥
data.es: To the trembling Sita, Saarana narrated totally all the discussion Ravana had with the ministers.
data.anv: वेपमानया trembling, सीतया to Sita, एवम् like that, उक्ता said, सरमा Saarana, समन्त्रिणः with the ministers, रावणस्य Ravana's, सर्वम् totally, कथितम् all the discussion, आचष्टे narrated.
data.md: Thus accosted by the trembling Sītä, Saramā related everything that had been said by Råvaņa and his counsellors.

data.v: जनन्या राक्षसेन्द्रो वै त्वन्मोक्षार्थं बृहद्वचः । अविद्धेन च वैदेहि मन्त्रिवृद्धेन बोधितः ॥
data.es: "O Vaidehi! Ravana's mother Kaikasi and the aged minister Aviddha advised the Lord of Rakshasas to release you."
data.anv: वैदेहि Vaidehi, त्वन्मोक्षार्थम् to release you, राक्षसेन्द्रः Lord of Rakshasa's, जनन्या mother, मन्त्रिवृद्धेव aged minister, अविद्धेन Aviddha, बृहत् long, वचः words, बोधितः advised.
data.md: O Vaidehi, the Rākşasa lord was advised by his mother and the aged counsellors in pregnant words informed with affection, having your deliverance for their object.

data.v: दीयतामभिसत्कृत्य मनुजेन्द्राय मैथिली । निदर्शनं ते पर्याप्तं जनस्थाने यदद्भुतम् ॥
data.es: "Let Mythili be given back to the ruler of the people (Rama) offering good hospitality. The (killing of fourteen thousand Rakshasas) amazing performance at Janasthana by Rama should serve as sufficient proof to you (of the consequences)."
data.anv: मनुजेन्द्राय ruler of people, अभिसत्कृत्य extending good hospitality, मैधिली Mythili, दीयताम् given back, जनस्थाने at Janasthana, यत् that, अद्भुतम् amazing, ते to you, पर्याप्तम् sufficient, निदर्शनम् proof.
data.md: Do you make over Maithili to the king of men, paying him homage due. You have in Janasthāna profusely witnessed wonderful instances (of his prowess).

data.v: लङ्घनं च समुद्रस्य दर्शनं च हनूमतः । वधं च रक्षसां युद्धे कः कुर्यान्मानुषो भुवि ॥
data.es: "Crossing the ocean, reaching Lanka, seeing Sita and killing Rakshasas in comb at was done by Hanuman. Which man can do this on earth?"
data.anv: हनूमतः Hanuman, समुद्रस्य even ocean, लङ्घनम् Lanka, दर्शनंच and seeing, मानुषः man, कः who, भुवि earth, युद्धे in combat, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वधंच to kill, कुर्यात् done.
data.md: The crossing of the ocean, Hanuman's sight (of Sītā) and the slaughter of the Rākşasa in fight, what person is capable of doing all this in battle?

data.v: एवं स मन्त्रिवृद्धैश्च मात्रा च बहु भाषितः । न त्वामुत्सहते मोक्तुमर्तह्मर्थपरो यथा ॥
data.es: "Even though his mother and aged minister counselled Ravana, he is like a miser holding on treasure not inclined to set you free."
data.anv: मन्त्रिवृद्धैश्च aged minister, मात्राच and mother, एवम् like that, बहु many, बोधितः counselled, सः he, अर्थपरः miser, अर्थमिव holding on treasure like, त्वाम् you, मोक्तुम् set free, नउत्सहते not inclined.
data.md: Thus long exhorted by his counsellors as well as his mother, Rāvaņa does not make up his mind to emancipate you, even as a covetous person is loath to pare with wealth (appropriated).

data.v: नोत्सहत्यमृतो मोक्तुं युद्धे त्वामिति मैथिलि । सामात्यस्य नृशंसस्य निश्चयो ह्येष वर्तते ॥
data.es: "O Mythili! Ravana is not interested in liberating you unless he goes to the other world in combat. (It can't happen when he is alive) This is certain. There is no doubt about this."
data.anv: मैथिली Mythili, युद्धे in combat, अमृतः from the other world, त्वाम् to you, मोक्तुम् to liberate, नोत्सहति not interested, इति this, एषः his option, सामात्स्य with his ministers नृशंसस्य no doubt, निश्चयः certainly, वर्तते not leave.

data.v: तदेषा सुस्थिरा बुद्धिर्मृत्युलोभादुपस्थिता । भयान्न शक्तस्त्वां मोक्तुमनिरस्तस्तु संयुगे । राक्षसानां च सर्वेषामात्मनश्च वधेन हि ॥
data.es: "This thought has come to him only to cause him death. Because of impending death, he is very steady in his mind. This Ravana will not be able to liberate you before his death and of the Rakshasas."
data.anv: तत् to him, मृत्युलोभात् cause death, एषा this, सुस्थिरा very steady, बुद्धिः thought, उपस्थिता impending, तु to you, संयुगे in combat, सर्वेषाम् every one, राक्षसानाम् of the Rakshasas, आत्मनश्च himself also, वधेन by death, अनिरन्तः undetermined, भयात् out of fear, त्वाम् you, मोक्तुम् to liberate, नशक्तः not able.

data.v: निहत्य रावणं संख्ये सर्वथा निशितैः शरैः । प्रतिनेष्यति रामस्त्वामयोध्यामसितेक्षणे ॥
data.es: "Rama will kill Ravana in war with his sharp arrows and take you back to Ayodhya, O darkeyed lady!"
data.anv: असितेक्षणे darkeyed, रामः Rama, सङ् ख्ये war, निशितैः sharp रावणम् Ravana, निहत्य killing, त्वाम् you, सर्वथा, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, प्रतिनेष्यति will take back.
data.md: O dark-eyed lady slaying Rāvaņa in battle with sharp shafts, Rāma shall take the back to Ayodhyā.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शब्दो भेरीशङ्खसमाकुलः । श्रुतो वै सर्वसैन्यानां कम्पयन्धरणीतलम् ॥
data.es: In the meantime (while Saarana was telling Sita) the sounds of drums and conchs combined with the clamour of Vanara troops was heard and it was as though the surface of the earth was shaking.
data.anv: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे in the meantime from inside, वानरसैन्यानाम् Vanara troops, भेरीशङ्खसमाकुलः sounds of drums and conches, धरणीतलम् earth surface, कम्पयन् shaking, शब्दः sound, श्रुतोवै was heard.
data.md: In the meanwhile there was heard a mighty uproar occasioned by the whole host, and drums and conchs, which shook the earth.

data.v: श्रुत्वा तु तं वानरसैन्यशब्दं; लङ्कागता राक्षसराजभृत्याः । नष्टौजसो दैन्यपरीतचेष्टाः; श्रेयो न पश्यन्ति नृपस्य दोषैः ॥
data.es: On hearing the sounds of Vanara troops, the Rakshasas present in Lanka became dull, overcome by depression, thinking that because of Ravana's mistakes they could not see any good prospects for them.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेचतुस्त्रिंशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the thirty fourth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by Valmiki.
data.anv: तम् those, वानरसैन्यशब्दम् sound of Vanara troops, श्रुत्वा on hearing, लङ्कागताः present in Lanka, राक्षसराजभृत्याः by the mistakes of the king of Rakshasas, नष्टौजसः became dull, दैन्यरीतचेष्टाः overcome by depression, नृपस्य Ravana's, दोषात् mistakes, श्रेयः prospect, नपश्यन्ति could not see.
data.md: Hearing that hubbub of the monkey-army, the servants of the Råkşasa monarch, ran who were in Lankā, growing dispirited, and bereft of energy, with weakness overcoming their powers, did not see any good, in consequence of the fault of the ruler.

data.v: तेन शङ्खविमिश्रेण भेरीशब्देन राघवः । उपयतो महाबाहू रामः परपुरंजयः ॥
data.es: The mighty armed Rama, the conqueror of enemy cities, Raghava marched forth with the noise of the blowing of conches and the sounds of drums.
data.anv: महाबाहुः mighty armed, परपुरञ्जयः conqueror of enemy cities, रामः Rama, शङ्खविमित्रेण blowing of conches, राघवः Raghava, भेरीशब्देन by the noise of drums, उपयाति marched forth.
data.md: That captor of hostile capitals, the mightarmed Rāma, was advancing (upon Larikā) with the sounds of drums mixed with the blares of conchs.

data.v: तं निनादं निशम्याथ रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । मुहूर्तं ध्यानमास्थाय सचिवानभ्युदैक्षत ॥
data.es: Ravana, the Lord of Rakshasas, looked at his ministers on hearing the sounds and reflecting for a moment.
data.anv: अथ and then, राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, तम् that, निनादम् sound, निशम्य hearing, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, ध्यानम् reflecting, आस्थाय considering, सचिवान् ministers, अभ्युदैक्षत looked at.
data.md: Hearing this noise, Ravana-lord of Raks asas-reflecting for a while, cast his eyes upon his counsellors.

data.v: अथ तान्सचिवांस्तत्र सर्वानाभाष्य रावणः । सभां संनादयन्सर्वामित्युवाच महाबलः ॥
data.es: Thereafter the mighty Lord of Rakshasas, a cruel one, a scourge of the world addressed the assembly of his ministers and spoke abusing them.
data.anv: अथ and then, महाबलः very strong, जगत्सन्तापनः scourge of the world, क्रूरः cruel, राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, तत्र, सर्वान् to all, सचिवान् companions, आभाष्य addressed, सर्वाम् every one, सभाम् entire assembly, संवादयन् speaking, गर्हयन् abused, इति this, उवाच said.
data.md: Addressing there all those counsellors, that afflictor of the world—the crooked and highly powerful lord of the Rākşasas, Rāvaņa, making his court resound, running down (Rāma's) crossing the main, as well as his vigour, strength and manhood, said to them.

data.v: तरणं सागरस्यापि विक्रमं बलसंचयम् । यदुक्तवन्तो रामस्य भवन्तस्तन्मया श्रुतम् । भवतश्चाप्यहं वेद्मि युद्धे सत्यपराक्रमान् ॥
data.es: "You have told me about the valour of Hanuman the messenger of Rama and his prowess in crossing the ocean which I heard just now."
data.anv: भवन्तः time being, रामस्य Rama's, यत् that Hanuman, अस्यसागरस्य that ocean, तरणम् crossing, विक्रमम् valour, बलसञ्जियम् prowess, उक्तवन्तः have told, तत् all that, मया by me, श्रुतम् heard.
data.md: What you have said touching Rama's (prowess), has been heard by me. And I also know you to be of sterling valour in the field. Yet why, knowing Rāma's prowess, do you silently look at each other?

data.v: ततस्तु सुमहाप्राज्ञो माल्यवान्नाम राक्षसः । रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा मातुः पैतामहोऽब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Then, Malyavan the maternal grandfather of Ravana, a very wise Rakshasa indeed said this on hearing Ravana's statement.
data.anv: ततः then, सुमहाप्राज्ञः very wise, मातुः maternal, माल्यवान् Malyavan नाम by name, राक्षरः Rakshasa, रावणस्य Ravana's, वचः conversation, श्रुत्वा hearing, पैतामहः grandfather, अब्रवीत् said.
data.md: Then the maternal grand sire (of Rāvaņa), possessed of exceeding wisdom, named Malyavān, hearing his words, said.

data.v: विद्यास्वभिविनीतो यो राजा राजन्नयानुगः । स शास्ति चिरमैश्वर्यमरींश्च कुरुते वशे ॥
data.es: "O king! Whoever is well versed in all the fourteen sciences and is a follower of justice, he alone wins over enemies and rules the kingdom for long."
data.anv: राजन् O King, यः whoever, राजा king, विद्यासु all the fourteen sciences, अभिविनीतः path of justice, समामगः, सः he, चिरम् for long, ऐश्वर्यम् sovereignty, शास्ति ruler, अरींश्च enemies, वशे win over, कुरुते enjoys
data.md: The king that is accomplished in the various kinds of learning,* and that follow polity, ever command affluence and bring his enemies under his subjection. *The commentator says there are four and ten kinds of learning; but unfortunately he does not enumerate them.

data.v: संदधानो हि कालेन विगृह्णंश्चारिभिः सह । स्वपक्षवर्धनं कुर्वन्महदैश्वर्यमश्नुते ॥
data.es: "Continuing to act in that way in course of time a king who encounters his enemies and expands his own side, enjoys great sovereignty."
data.anv: कालेन at that time, अरिभिः enemies, सन्दधानः encountering, विगृह्णान् expanding, स्वपक्ष one's own side, वर्थनम् acting, कुर्वन् doing, महत् great, ऐश्वर्यम् sovereignty, अश्नुते enjoys.
data.md: He that seasonably concludes peace and carries on war with his enemies, and who advances his own party, attain great affluence.

data.v: हीयमानेन कर्तव्यो राज्ञा संधिः समेन च । न शत्रुमवमन्येत ज्यायान्कुर्वीत विग्रहम् ॥
data.es: "When a king is losing strength, he should join hand s with the enemy who is equal to him. He should not disrespect the enemy but quit his hostility and join him (if the enemy is more powerful)."
data.anv: हीयमानेन when losing strength, समेवच with equal, राज्ञा with king, सन्धिः join, कर्तव्यः duty, शत्रुम् with enemy, नअवमन्येत not disrespecting, ज्यायान् quitting, विग्रहम् hostility, कुर्वीत do.
data.md: A king should enter into peace, if he be an equal or inferior of his adversary, and engage in war, if be more powerful, but an enemy should never be disergarded.

data.v: तन्मह्यं रोचते संधिः सह रामेण रावण । यदर्थमभियुक्ताः स्म सीता तस्मै प्रदीयताम् ॥
data.es: "O Ravana! Joining with that Rama is agreeable to me. Let that Sita for whose sake you have been attacked be restored to him."
data.anv: रावण Ravana, तत् that, रामेणसह with Rama, सन्धिः join, मह्यम् for us, रोचते agreeable, यदर्थम् for which, अभियुक्ता: favourable, स्मसीता Sita, तस्मै to him, प्रतीयताम् restore to him.
data.md: Therefore, O Rāvana, peace with Rāma is what commends itself to me; and do you render to him that for which you have been invaded (by him), viz., Sītā.

data.v: तस्य देवर्षयः सर्वे गन्धर्वाश्च जयैषिणः । विरोधं मा गमस्तेन संधिस्ते तेन रोचताम् ॥
data.es: All the celestial sages and Gandharvas are wishing him victory. Therefore, do not have enmity. Making an alliance with him is desirable for you.
data.anv: सर्वे all, देवर्षय: celestial sages गन्धर्वाश्च Gandharvas, यस्य their, जयैषिणः wishing victory, तेन therefore, विरोधम् enmity, मागमः do not, ते to you, तेन therefore, सन्धिः alliance, रोचताम् desirable.
data.md: All the Devarsis and Gandharvas wish for (Rāma's) victory. Therefore, do not enter into hostilities with him; but do you bend your mind to the conclusion of peace with him.

data.v: असृजद्भगवान्पक्षौ द्वावेव हि पितामहः । सुराणामसुराणां च धर्माधर्मौ तदाश्रयौ ॥
data.es: "The divine Brahma, the grandfather of the universe created two orders, deities and devils. They took the refuge of virtues and vices respectively."
data.anv: भगवान् God, पितामहः grandfather Brahma, सुराणांच deities and, असुराणांच devils also, द्वौ both, पक्षौएव orders, असृजत् created beings, धर्माधर्मौ virtue and vice, तदाश्रयौ taking refuge.
data.md: That possessor of the six attributes, the Greatfather, has appointed two courses, (respectively) for the Asuras and the celestials, having for their eousness.

data.v: धर्मो हि श्रूयते पक्षः सुराणां च महात्मनाम् । अधर्मो रक्षसं पक्षो ह्यसुराणां च रावण ॥
data.es: "The great souls were towards righteousness and Rakshasas took the side of unrighteousness."
data.anv: राक्षस Rakshasa, धर्मः righteous, महात्मानाम् great souls, असुराणाम् and Rakshasas, पक्षी side, श्रूयते, अधर्मः unrighteous, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, असुराणांच and devils, पक्षःहि being the side.
data.md: Righteousness, we hear, is the course of the high-souled celestials, as, O. Rākşasa, unrighteousness is that of Rākşasa and Asuras.

data.v: धर्मो वै ग्रसतेऽधर्मं ततः कृतमभूद्युगम् । अधर्मो ग्रसते धर्मं ततस्तिष्यः प्रवर्तते ॥
data.es: "When moral merit destroys unrighteousness, it is called Krtayuga. So also, when virtue gets eclipsed by unrighteousness, it is called Kaliyuga."
data.anv: धर्मः moral merit, यदा similarly, अधर्मम् unrighteous, ग्रसते destroyed, कृतंयुगम् Krtam Yuga, अभूत् not exist, अधर्मः unrighteousness, धर्मम् righteousness, ग्रसते eclipses, तदा so also, तिष्यः end, प्रवर्तते commences.
data.md: During the Kţta Yuga, righteousness swallow up sin; and during Tisya,* unrighteousness swallow up virtue. *The Kali Yuga.

data.v: तत्त्वया चरता लोकान्धर्मो विनिहतो महान् । अधर्मः प्रगृहीतश्च तेनास्मद्बलिनः परे ॥
data.es: "While you were ranging in all the worlds, you gave up righteousness and embraced unrighteousness. Therefore, the enemy who is righteous is stronger than you."
data.anv: सत् being good, लोकान् the worlds, चरता ranging, त्वया by you, महान् great, धर्मोऽपि even righteous conduct, विनिहतः giving up, अधर्मः unrighteous, प्रगृहीतश्च embraced by you, तेन therefore, परे enemy, अस्मत् more than you, बलिनः stronger.
data.md: You, ranging the three worlds, worlds, had extinguished pregnant piety, and reaped unrighteousness; and it is for this that your foes have waxed potent. *While ranging the three worlds on a career of conquest, you didst, disturbing sacrifices, etc., wrong righteousness.

data.v: स प्रमादाद्विवृद्धस्तेऽधर्मोऽहिर्ग्रसते हि नः । विवर्धयति पक्षं च सुराणां सुरभावनः ॥
data.es: "You are nourishing unrighteousness mistakenly. Therefore, it is going to swallow us. It has become the cause for the divine celestial side to become powerful."
data.anv: ते you, प्रमदात् mistakenly, वदिवृद्धः nourishing, सः he, अधर्मः unrighteous, वः those, ग्रसतेहि will swallow, सुरभावनः cause of celestials (to become powerful), सुराणाम् for the divine celestials, पक्षम् side, विवर्थयतिच grow in strength also.
data.md: Having grown through through your your neglect, unrighteousness devour us, and that protector of the gods, (righteousness), is strengthening the side of the celestials.

data.v: विषयेषु प्रसक्तेन यत्किंचित्कारिणा त्वया । ऋषीणामग्निकल्पानामुद्वेगो जनितो महान् । तेषां प्रभावो दुर्धर्षः प्रदीप्त इव पावकः ॥
data.es: "Being engaged in matters of sense pleasures you have created great agitation(disturbance) in the minds of the seers (engaged in penance) who resemble gods of burning fire."
data.anv: विषयेषु in matters, प्रसक्तेन excessively engaged in, यत्किञ्चित्कारणा indeed for that reason, त्वया by you, अग्निकल्पनामा burning fire, ऋषीणाम् to the seers, महान् great, उद्वेगः agitation, जनितः created.
data.md: You, addicted to carnal pleasures and acting in defiance of duty, had aroused the high wrath of the saints resembling fire.

data.v: तपसा भावितात्मानो धर्मस्यानुग्रहे रताः । मुख्यैर्यज्ञैर्यजन्त्येते नित्यं तैस्तैर्द्विजातयः ॥
जुह्वत्यग्नींश्च विधिवद्वेदांश्चोच्चैरधीयते । अभिभूय च रक्षांसि ब्रह्मघोषानुदैरयन् । दिशो विप्रद्रुताः सर्वे स्तनयित्नुरिवोष्णगे ॥
data.md: The twice-born ones engage in contemplation with intent minds, offer oblations into the fire according to the ordinance, and loudly recite the Vedas. They overpower the Rākşasa, uttering the Vedas; and thereat they fly in all directions like clouds scattered in summer.

data.v: ऋषीणामग्निकल्पानामग्निहोत्रसमुत्थितः । आदत्ते रक्षसां तेजो धूमो व्याप्य दिशो दश ॥
data.es: "By the spread of smoke in different directions from the sacrificial fires from the oblations offered by the seers the brilliance of the Rakshasas is taken away."
data.anv: अग्निकल्पानाम् poured into fire, ऋषीणाम् by the seers, अग्निहोत्रासमुत्थितः into the sacrificial fires, धूमः smoke, दश all ten, दिशः directions, व्याप्य spread, रक्षसाम् of the Rakshasas, तेजः brilliance, आदत्ते take away.
data.md: The smoke that arise from the Agnihotra sacrifices of saints resembling fire, enveloping the energy of the Räkşasas, spreads over the ten cardinal quarters.

data.v: तेषु तेषु च देशेषु पुण्येषु च दृढव्रतैः । चर्यमाणं तपस्तीव्रं संतापयति राक्षसान् ॥
data.es: "The intense austerities performed by the sages in different regions determined firmly are tormenting the Rakshasas."
data.anv: पुण्येष्वेव at holy places दृढव्रतैः determined firmly, तेषुतेषु those, देशेषु regions चर्यमाणम् performing, तीव्रम् intense, तपः austerities, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, सन्तापयति tormenting.

data.v: उत्पातान्विविधान्दृष्ट्वा घोरान्बहुविधांस्तथा । विनाशमनुपश्यामि सर्वेषां रक्षसामहम् ॥
data.es: "Beholding different dreadful ones rising up in various directions, I foresee destruction of all Rakshasas."
data.anv: विविधान् different, उत्पातान् rising up, तथा like that, बहुविधान् in various ways, घोरान् dreadful, दृष्टवा seeing, अहम् I, सर्वेषाम् all, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, विनाशम् destruction, अनुपश्यामि foresee.
data.md: Witnessing various and many dire portents, I perceive the destruction of all the Rākşasas.

data.v: खराभिस्तनिता घोरा मेघाः प्रतिभयंकरः । शोणितेनाभिवर्षन्ति लङ्कामुष्णेन सर्वतः ॥
data.es: "Formidable clouds are emitting hot and most frightening thunder drenched by rain of blood all over Lanka."
data.anv: खराभिस्न्तिताः emitting hot thunder, घोराः formidable, प्रतिभयङ्कराः very frightening, मेघाः clouds, लङ्काम् Lanka, सर्वतः all over, उष्णेन by the heat, शोणितेन by blood, अभिवर्षन्ति raining.
data.md: Dreadful and terrific clouds, uttering harsh sounds, are showering blood all around Lankā.

data.v: रुदतां वाहनानां च प्रपतन्त्यस्रबिन्दवः । ध्वजा ध्वस्ता विवर्णाश्च न प्रभान्ति यथापुरम् ॥
data.es: "With tear drops falling from the eyes of weeping horses and elephants (carrying army) they are discoloured by dust and are not shining like before."
data.anv: रुदताम् weeping, वाहनानाम् carrying, अस्रबिन्दवः tear drops, प्रपतन्ति falling, ध्वजाध्वस्ताः horses and elephants, विवर्णाः discoloured by dust, यधापुरम् as before, नप्रभान्ति not shining.
data.md: And (live) vehicles are dropping profuse tears. And all sides, covered with dust, do not appear bright as formerly.

data.v: व्याला गोमायवो गृध्रा वाशन्ति च सुभैरवम् । प्रविश्य लङ्कामनिशं समवायांश्च कुर्वते ॥
data.es: "Wicked jackals and vultures are entering deep into Lanka and gathering. They are crying most frightfully."
data.anv: व्यालाः wicked, गोमायवः jackals, सुभैरवम् most frightful, वाश्यन्ति vultures, लङ्काम् into Lanka, प्रविश्य entering, मनिशम् deep, समवायन् gather, कुर्वते crying.
data.md: And beasts of prey, jackals and vultures, are emitting frightful cries, and, entering into the garden of Lankā, form themselves into bands.

data.v: कालिकाः पाण्डुरैर्दन्तैः प्रहसन्त्यग्रतः स्थिताः । स्त्रियः स्वप्नेषु मुष्णन्त्यो गृहाणि प्रतिभाष्य च ॥
data.es: "Women of dark colour like coal with yellow teeth are speaking unpleasant things standing before us in dreams laughing heartily."
data.anv: काळिकाः coal black, स्त्रियः women, स्वप्नेषु in dreams, प्रतिभाष्य speaking, गृहाणि omen, मुष्ण्नत्यः plundering, अग्रतः before, स्थिताः standing, पाण्डुरैः yellow, दन्स्सैः teeth, प्रहसन्ति laughing heartily.
data.md: In dreams mighty dark-hued women in front of dwellings, seizing at (the furniture) thereof, and speaking inauspiciously, laugh displaying their sable teeth.

data.v: गृहाणां बलिकर्माणि श्वानः पर्युपभुञ्जते । खरा गोषु प्रजायन्ते मूषिका नकुलैः सह ॥
data.es: "In the houses, food offerings made for gods are eaten by dogs, donkeys are procreating cows and rats of mongoose."
data.anv: गृहाणाम् in the homes, बलिकर्माणि offerings of food made for gods, श्वानः dogs, पर्युभुञ्जते are coming to eat, गोषु cows, खराः donkeys, प्रजायन्ते procreating, नकुलैहिः mongoose, मूषकाः rats सह also.
data.md: In houses dogs are feasting on the articles of worship. And cows bring forth asses, and mungooses, mice.

data.v: मार्जारा द्वीपिभिः सार्धं सूकराः शुनकैः सह । किंनरा राक्षसैश्चापि समेयुर्मानुषैः सह ॥
data.es: "Cats are having the company of (mating) Leopards, pigs are mating with dogs, Kinneras with Rakshasas as well as human beings also."
data.anv: मार्जराः cats, द्वीपिभिः leopards सार्थम् having company, सूकराः pigs, शुनकैःसह dogs also, किन्नराः Kinnera, राक्षसैश्चापि Rakshasas as well, मानुषैःसह including human beings, समेयुः mating.
data.md: And cats are pairing with leopards, and swine with dogs, and Kinnaras with Rākşasas and human being.

data.v: पाण्डुरा रक्तपादाश्च विहगाः कालचोदिताः । राक्षसानां विनाशाय कपोता विचरन्ति च ॥
data.es: "The white and redfooted doves are moving about impelled by time spirit boding destruction of Rakshasas."
data.anv: पाण्डुराः white, रक्तपादाश्च redfooted, कपोताः doves, विहगाः birds, कालचोदिताः impelled by time, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, विनाशाय boding destruction, विचरन्ति move about.
data.md: are And red-footed white sky-coursing pigeons, urged on by Doom, are going about for the destruction of the Raksasas.

data.v: चीकी कूचीति वाशन्त्यः शारिका वेश्मसु स्थिताः । पतन्ति ग्रथिताश्चापि निर्जिताः कलहैषिणः ॥
data.es: "Minas living in households grappling with bellicose birds in delight are falling down dead."
data.anv: वेश्मसु in the households, स्थिताः living, शारिकाः minas, कलहैषिणः grapple, निर्जिताः dead, वीचीकूचीति delight, वाश्यन्तः inhabiting, ग्रथिताश्चापि bellicose birds, पतन्ति falling down.
data.md: And female-parrots in houses, wounded and worsted by other birds delighting in discord, are dropping down, emitting indistinct notes.

data.v: करालो विकटो मुण्डः पुरुषः कृष्णपिङ्गलः । कालो गृहाणि सर्वेषां काले कालेऽन्ववेक्षते । एतान्यन्यानि दुष्टानि निमित्तान्युत्पतन्ति च ॥
data.es: All birds and animals are making hostile noise. Time is always coming in a dreadful and monstrous blackish form with a shaved head, morning, and evening. Considering all these sinister portents are making an appearance at all households.
data.anv: पक्षिणः birds, सर्वे all, मृगाः animals, प्रत्यादित्यम् hostile, रुदन्ति crying, कराळः dreadful, विकटः monstrous, मुण्डः shaven head, परुषः male, कृष्णपिङ्गळः blackish, कालः time, कालेकाले at all times, सर्वेषाम् all, गृहाणि households, अन्ववेक्षते considering, एतानि all this, अन्यानि complete, दुष्टानि sinister निमित्तानि portents, उत्पतन्ति making appearance.

data.v: विष्णुं मन्यामहे रामं मानुषं देहमास्थितम् । न हि मानुषमात्रोऽसौ राघवो दृढविक्रमः ॥
येन बद्धः समुद्रस्य स सेतुः परमाद्भुतः । कुरुष्व नरराजेन संधिं रामेण रावण ॥
इदं वचस्तत्र निगद्य माल्यव;न्परीक्ष्य रक्षोऽधिपतेर्मनः पुनः । अनुत्तमेषूत्तमपौरुषो बली; बभूव तूष्णीं समवेक्ष्य रावणम् ॥
data.md: Having said this to that vile one, and known the intention of the lord of Rākşasa, that strong Mālyavān, of exceeding prowess, became silent, eying Ravana.

data.v: तत्तु माल्यवतो वाक्यं हितमुक्तं दशाननः । न मर्षयति दुष्टात्मा कालस्य वशमागतः ॥
data.es: "O Tenheaded king Fallen under the sway of death, you are foolish. You do not understand the well prepared good words spoken by me wishing your welfare."
data.anv: दशानन: tenheaded one, कालस्य: of death, वशम् under the sway, आगताः fallen, अकृतात्मानः foolish one, हितकामेन: wishing your welfare, उक्तम् spoken, सुनीतम् well prepared, हितम् good, वाक्यम् words, नगृह्णन्ति: not understand.
data.md: For your welfare I spoke those w ell-meaning words, O Ten-necked one, but you did not pay heed to them being brought under the control of Death.

data.v: स बद्ध्वा भ्रुकुटिं वक्त्रे क्रोधस्य वशमागतः । अमर्षात्परिवृत्ताक्षो माल्यवन्तमथाब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Then Ravana who had come under the influence of anger, knitting the brows of his face rolling his eyes said to Malyavan.
data.anv: सः he, क्रोधस्य by anger, वशम् submitted to, आगतः come under, वक्त्रे in the face, भ्रुकुटिम् eyebrows, बद् ध्वा knitting, अमर्षात् intolerant, परिवृत्ताक्षः rolling his eyes, अथ and then, माल्यवन्तम् to Malyavan, अब्रवीत् said.
data.md: Contracting his face into a frown, he, coming under the masterdom of passion, with his eyes rolling in wrath, addressed Mayavān, saying.

data.v: हितबुद्ध्या यदहितं वचः परुषमुच्यते । परपक्षं प्रविश्यैव नैतच्छ्रोत्रगतं मम ॥
data.es: "Harsh and not wellmeaning words have been uttered by you taking the enemy's side. I will not listen to what you said earlier."
data.anv: परपक्षम् enemies side, प्रविश्यैव taking, हितबुध्या salutary sense, यत् those, परुषम् harsh, अहितम् not meaning good, वचः words, उच्यते have uttered, एतत् all these, मम to me, श्रोत्रगतम् listen to what was told earlier, न not.
data.md: The words which, deeming the strength of the enemy as superior, you have harshly spoken, considering it as beneficial, had never before entered my ears.

data.v: मानुषं कृपणं राममेकं शाखामृगाश्रयम् । समर्थं मन्यसे केन त्यक्तं पित्रा वनालयम् ॥
data.es: "For what reason do you say that a wretched human being, alone, forsaken by a father who has taken asylum in the forest, who is taking the help of vanaras is capable?"
data.anv: मानुषम् human, कृपणम् wretched, एकम् alone, शाखामृगाश्रयम् who has the help of herbivorous animals to help, पित्रा by father, त्यक्तम् forsaken, वनालयम् forest as asylum, रामम् Rama, समर्थम् capable, केन by what, मन्यसे reason.
data.md: A (mere) man, and feeble, and alone, and having monkeys for his support, why do you deem Rāma, who has (further) been cast off by his sire, and has in consequence taken refuge in the woods, as competent (to cope with me)?

data.v: रक्षसामीश्वरं मां च देवतानां भयंकरम् । हीनं मां मन्यसे केन अहीनं सर्वविक्रमैः ॥
data.es: "The Lord of Rakshasas is a terror to all including the Devas and am endowed with all kinds of prowess and efficiency. Why do you think I am deficient?"
data.anv: रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, ईश्वरम् Lord, देवानांच including Devas, भयङ्करम् fearfulterror, माम् me, सर्वविक्रमैः all kinds of prowess, अहीनम् not deficient, माम् me, हीनम् deficient, केन why, मन्यसे think.
data.md: Why do you consider me, who am the lord of the Räksasa, and feared even by the immortals, as weak and reft of all power?

data.v: वीरद्वेषेण वा शङ्के पक्षपातेन वा रिपोः । त्वयाहं परुषाण्युक्तः परप्रोत्साहनेन वा ॥
data.es: "I suspect that out of hatred towards me, you are speaking such harsh words to a hero encouraged by the enemy."
data.anv: वीरद्वेषेण out of hatred to hero, रिपोः enemy, पक्षपातेन out of one sided view, पर others, प्रोत्साहनेनवा by the encouragement of, अहम् I am, त्वया by your, परुषाणि harsh words, उक्तः spoken, शङ्के suspect.
data.md: You, I suspect, speak (thus) roughly either from jealousy of my heroism, or for inciting me.

data.v: प्रभवन्तं पदस्थं हि परुषं कोऽभिधास्यति । पण्डितः शास्त्रतत्त्वज्ञो विना प्रोत्साहनाद्रिपोः ॥
data.es: "Which person who has learned the truth of sastras will address such harsh words to one in power without instigation?"
data.anv: शास्त्रतत्त्वज्ञः learned in the truth of sastras, पण्डितः learned, कः who, विनाप्रोत्साहनाद्रिपोः without instigation, प्रभवन्तम् in power, पदस्थम् address, परुषम् harsh, अभिभाषते will speak.
data.md: Who that is wise and learned, ever address him roughly that is at once puissant and of (high) station, if not to spur him on?

data.v: आनीय च वनात्सीतां पद्महीनामिव श्रियम् । किमर्थं प्रतिदास्यामि राघवस्य भयादहम् ॥
data.es: "Sita who is like Lakshmi without the lotus has been brought from the forest. Why would I return her for the fear of Rama?"
data.anv: पद्महीनाम् without the lotus, श्रियम् इव like Lakshmi, सीताम् Sita, वनात् from forest, आनीय brought her, अहम् I, राघवस्य Rama's, भयात् fear, किमर्थम् for what, प्रतिदास्यामि will not return.
data.md: Why, having brought Sītā like a Sri shorn of her lotus, shall I give her up, from fear of Rāghava?

data.v: वृतं वानरकोटीभिः ससुग्रीवं सलक्ष्मणम् । पश्य कैश्चिदहोभिस्त्वं राघवं निहतं मया ॥
data.es: "Indeed, in a short while crores of Vanaras, Sugriva and also Lakshmana and Raghava will be killed by me. Oh!"
data.anv: कैश्चित् in short time, अहोभिः praised, मया by me, निहतम् killed वानरकोटिभिः crores of Vanaras, वृतम् surrounding, ससुग्रीवम् Sugriva, सलक्ष्मणम् and that Lakshmana, राघवम् Raghava, पश्य see.
data.md: Behold Rāghava, environed by Koțis of monkeys, with Sugrīva and Lakşmaņa, slain on of these days!

data.v: द्वन्द्वे यस्य न तिष्ठन्ति दैवतान्यपि संयुगे । स कस्माद्रावणो युद्धे भयमाहारयिष्यति ॥
data.es: As even gods will not with stand Ravana in war, of whom Ravana will be afraid of in a duel.
data.anv: दैवतान्यपि even gods, युद्धे in war, यस्य, द्वन्द्वे duel, नतिष्ठन्ति not with stand, सः that he, रावणः Ravana, युद्धे in war, कस्मात् whom, भयम् fear, आहारयिष्यति striking.
data.md: He before whom even the gods cannot stay in the battle field, how can that Råvaņa ever come by fear?

data.v: द्विधा भज्येयमप्येवं न नमेयं तु कस्यचित् । एष मे सहजो दोषः स्वभावो दुरतिक्रमः ॥
data.es: "I would break my head into two also but not bend my head to anyone. It is my weakness. It is hard to overcome nature."
data.anv: द्विधा into two, भज्येयमपि resorts to breaks my head, एवम् also, कस्यचित् his mind, ननमेयम् bend myself to any one, एषः in that way, मे I, सहजः natural, दोषः weakness, स्वभावः nature, दुरतिक्रमः to overcome.
data.md: Better that I should be riven in twain, but bend I never will. This is my native fault; and nature is incapable of being overcome.

data.v: यदि तावत्समुद्रे तु सेतुर्बद्धो यदृच्छया । रामेण विस्मयः कोऽत्र येन ते भयमागतम् ॥
data.es: "Rama has constructed a bridge by chance and because of that you are fearing what wonder is there in it?"
data.anv: रामेण by Rama, यदृच्छया by chance, समुद्रे on the ocean, सेतुः bridge, बद्धःयदि constructed तावत् by that, अत्र there, येन because of that, मे to me, भयम् fear, आगतम् overtaken, विस्मयः wonder, कः what.
data.md: If Rāma bath at his pleasure constructed a bridge over the ocean, what is the wonder in this that you have conceived such a fear?

data.v: स तु तीर्त्वार्णवं रामः सह वानरसेनया । प्रतिजानामि ते सत्यं न जीवन्प्रतियास्यति ॥
data.es: "Rama having crossed the sea with his Vanara army will not go back with life. It is true."
data.anv: सःराघवः that Raghava, वानरसेवयासह along with Vanara army, आर्णवम् sea, तीर्त्वा crossed water, जीवन् with life, नप्रतियाप्यति not going back, ते, सत्यम् true, प्रतिजानामि will not return back.
data.md: And although Rāma has crossed the ocean along with the monkey-army, yet I swear to you truly, living, he shall not back hence.

data.v: एवं ब्रुवाणं संरब्धं रुष्टं विज्ञाय रावणम् । व्रीडितो माल्यवान्वाक्यं नोत्तरं प्रत्यपद्यत ॥
data.es: When Ravana was abashed and speaking in that way realizing that he is angry, Malyavan did not reply feeling shy.
data.anv: एवं in that way, संरब्धम् abashed, ब्रुवाणम् speaking, रावणम् to Ravana, रुष्टम् anger, विज्ञाय knowing, माल्यवान् Malyavan, व्रीळितः feeling shy, उत्तरम् reply, वाक्यम् words, नप्रत्यपद्यत not uttered.
data.md: When Ravana, wrought up with passion, had spoken thus, Malyavan, knowing him wroth, did not return a reply.

data.v: जयाशिषा च राजानं वर्धयित्वा यथोचितम् । माल्यवानभ्यनुज्ञातो जगाम स्वं निवेशनम् ॥
data.es: Malyavan offered blessings to the king for success in accordance with tradition left to his house.
data.anv: माल्यवान् Malyavan, राजानम् to the king, जयाशिषाच blessing to succeed यथोचितम् in accordance with tradition, स्वम् his, निवेशनम् house, जगाम went.
data.md: And, duly tendering blessings to the king, Mālyavān, taking his permission, went to his own abode.

data.v: रावणस्तु सहामात्यो मन्त्रयित्वा विमृश्य च । लङ्कायामतुलां गुप्तिं कारयामास राक्षसः ॥
data.es: Ravana then held discussions with his companions and ministers and made unequalled arrangements for (safety of) Lanka.
data.anv: राक्षसः Rakshasas, रावणस्तु with Ravana, सहामात्यः with companions, मन्त्रयित्वा with ministers, विमृश्य holding discussions, तदा then, लङ्कायां for Lanka, अतुलां unequalled, गुप्तिम् protection, कारयामास made arrangements.
data.md: The Räkşasa, Rāvaņa, along with his courtiers, having consulted together as to what was fit to be done, set about the defence of Lankā.

data.v: व्यादिदेश च पूर्वस्यां प्रहस्तं द्वारि राक्षसं । दक्षिणस्यां महावीर्यौ महापार्श्व महोदरौ ॥
data.es: Ravana posted Prahastha surrounded by many Rakshasas at the east gate, and the Rakshasas of great prowess, Mahaparsva and Mahodara at the southern gate, and like that Mahamaya and Indrajith, his own son at the western gate.
data.anv: सः he, पूर्वस्यांद्वारि at the eastern gate, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, व्यादिदेश posted, दक्षिणस्याम् at the southern gate, महावीर्यौदि of great prowess, महापर्श्वा Mahaparsva महोदरौ Mahodara, व्यादिदेश posted, अथ and, तदा like that, पश्चिमायांद्वारि at the western gate, महामायाम् Mahamaya, बहुभिः many, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, वृतम् surrounded by, पुत्रम् son, इन्द्रजितम् Indrajith, व्यादिदेश assigned duty.
data.md: He commanded the Raksasa Prahasta (to guard) the Eastern gate; and the exceedingly powerful Mahaparsva and Mahodara (to guard) the Southern gate; and he ordered his son Indrajit, possessing mighty powers of illusion, girt by innumerable Räkșasas, to guard the Western gate.

data.v: पश्चिमायामथो द्वारि पुत्रमिन्द्रजितं तथा । व्यादिदेश महामायं राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतम् ॥
data.es: Ravana posted Prahastha surrounded by many Rakshasas at the east gate, and the Rakshasas of great prowess, Mahaparsva and Mahodara at the southern gate, and like that Mahamaya and Indrajith, his own son at the western gate.
data.anv: सः he, पूर्वस्यांद्वारि at the eastern gate, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, व्यादिदेश posted, दक्षिणस्याम् at the southern gate, महावीर्यौदि of great prowess, महापर्श्वा Mahaparsva महोदरौ Mahodara, व्यादिदेश posted, अथ and, तदा like that, पश्चिमायांद्वारि at the western gate, महामायाम् Mahamaya, बहुभिः many, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, वृतम् surrounded by, पुत्रम् son, इन्द्रजितम् Indrajith, व्यादिदेश assigned duty.
data.md: He commanded the Raksasa Prahasta (to guard) the Eastern gate; and the exceedingly powerful Mahaparsva and Mahodara (to guard) the Southern gate; and he ordered his son Indrajit, possessing mighty powers of illusion, girt by innumerable Räkșasas, to guard the Western gate.

data.v: उत्तरस्यां पुरद्वारि व्यादिश्य शुकसारणौ । स्वयं चात्र भविष्यामि मन्त्रिणस्तानुवाच ह ॥
data.es: Ravana posted Suka and Sarana at the north gate of Lanka and himself reached there and told the ministers that he would be there.
data.anv: उत्तरस्याम् at the north, पुरद्वारि of the city gate, शुकसारणौ Suka and Sarana, व्यादिश्य posted, स्वयम् himself, चअत्र also there, गमिष्यामि reached, तान् his, मन्त्रिणः ministers, उवाच told.
data.md: He commanded Suka and Sārana to defend the Northern gate. But he said to the counsellors, I will myself go thither.* *i.e. to defend the Northerm gate.

data.v: राक्षसं तु विरूपाक्षं महावीर्यपराक्रमम् । मध्यमेऽस्थापयद्गुल्मे बहुभिः सह राक्षसैः ॥
data.es: In the middle of the city, he placed Virupaksha, a Rakshasa endowed with extraordinary strength and many more Rakshasas.
data.anv: महावीर्यपराक्रमम् endowed with extraordinary strength, विरूपाक्षम् Virupaksha,राक्षसाम् Rakshasa, बहुभिः and many more, राक्षसैःसह along with Rakshasas, मध्यमे middle, गुल्मे of city, आस्थापयत् placed.
data.md: And he posted in the middle in the garrison the Raksasa, Virupaksa, endowed with exceeding prowess and energy, backed by countless rākşasas.

data.v: एवंविधानं लङ्कायां कृत्वा राक्षसपुंगवः । मेने कृतार्थमात्मानं कृतान्तवशमागतः ॥
data.es: The best of Rakshasas under the sway of destiny, having been ordered in that way in Lanka, Ravana felt as though he had accomplished the task.
data.anv: राक्षसपुङ्गवः best of Rakshasas, लङ्कायाः in Lanka, एवम् in that way, विधानम् order, कृत्वा having done, कालचोदितः sway of destiny, आत्मानम् his own, कृतकृत्यमिव as if accomplished the task, मन्यते thought.
data.md: Having taken these measures in Lankā, the raksasa-chief, urged by Fate, deemed himself as having achieved success.

data.v: विसर्जयामास ततः स मन्त्रिणो; विधानमाज्ञाप्य पुरस्य पुष्कलम् । जयाशिषा मन्त्रगणेन पूजितो; विवेश सोऽन्तःपुरमृद्धिमन्महत् ॥
data.es: There after making arrangements adequately for the protection of Lanka, taking leave of ministers who offered blessings for his prosperity and uttered words of benediction for his success Ravana entered the inner chambers of the palace.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषटित्रंशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the thirty sixth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: सः he, पुरस्य for Lanka, पुष्कलम् adequately, विधानम् arrangements, आज्ञाप्य having ordered, ततः thereafter, मन्त्रिणः with ministers, विसर्जयामास taking leave, मन्त्रिगणेव body of ministers, जयाशिषा uttering benediction for success, पूजितः blessing सः him, बुद्धिमत् with prosperity, महत् great, अन्तःपुरम् inner chambers, विवेश entered.
data.md: Having thus completely provided for the defence of the city, he dismissed the ministers; and, honoured by the counsellors with blessings of victory, (then) entered his magnificent and splendid inner apartment.

data.v: नरवानरराजौ तौ स च वायुसुतः कपिः । जाम्बवानृक्षराजश्च राक्षसश्च विभीषणः ॥
अङ्गदो वालिपुत्रश्च सौमित्रिः शरभः कपिः । सुषेणः सहदायादो मैन्दो द्विविद एव च ॥
गजो गवाक्षो कुमुदो नलोऽथ पनसस्तथा । अमित्रविषयं प्राप्ताः समवेताः समर्थयन् ॥
इयं सा लक्ष्यते लङ्का पुरी रावणपालिता । सासुरोरगगन्धर्वैरमरैरपि दुर्जया ॥
data.es: "This Lanka city ruled by Ravana is seen. It appears that this city is unconquerable to Devas, demons and Gandharvas also by the immortals."
data.anv: रावणपालिता ruled by Ravana, सासुरोरगगन्धर्वैः Devas, demons and Gandharvas, अमरैरपि immortals, दुर्जया not conquerable, सा that, इयम् this, लङ्कापुरी Lanka city, लक्षयते appears.
data.md: Yonder is that Lankā ruled by Rāvana, invincible even to the celestials, serpents and Gandharvas.

data.v: कार्यसिद्धिं पुरस्कृत्य मन्त्रयध्वं विनिर्णये । नित्यं संनिहितो ह्यत्र रावणो राक्षसाधिपः ॥
data.es: "Rakshasa king Ravana is ever present here. Prepare yourself to achieve success in the mission and determine your duty."
data.anv: कार्यसिद्धिम् to achieve success, पुरस्कृत्य preparing, विनिर्णये determining duty, मन्त्रयध्वम् , अत्र there, राक्षसाधिपः Rakshasa king, रावणः Ravana, नित्यम् ever, सन्निहितःहि present here.
data.md: Let us, keeping before us success in the enterprise, consult together for the purpose of arriving at a decision.

data.v: तथा तेषु ब्रुवाणेषु रावणावरजोऽब्रवीत् । वाक्यमग्राम्यपदवत्पुष्कलार्थं विभीषणः ॥
data.es: While they were speaking like that to one another, Ravana's brother Vibheeshana spoke courteously, words full of meaning.
data.anv: तथा like that, तेषु they, ब्रुवाणेषु speaking to one another, रावणावरजः Ravana's brother, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, अग्राम्यपदवत् courteous words, पुष्कलार्थम् meaningful, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: We are here daily nearing Răvaņa, lord of Raksasas. As they were speaking thus, Ravana's younger brother, Vibhīşaņa, said in a pregnant speech free from provinicialism.

data.v: अनलः शरभश्चैव संपातिः प्रघसस्तथा । गत्वा लङ्कां ममामात्याः पुरीं पुनरिहागताः ॥
data.es: "My ministers Anala, Sarabha, Sampathi and also Praghasa went to Lanka and saw it and returned."
data.anv: मम my, अमात्याः ministers, अनलः Anala, शरभश्चैव and Sarabha, सम्पातिः Sampathi, तथा so also, प्रघसः Praghasa, लङ्कांपुरीम् to Lanka city, गत्वा went, पुनः again, इह there, आगताः came
data.md: Anala, Panasa, Sampāti and Pramāti— all courtiers of mine-having gone up to Lanka, have come back here.

data.v: भूत्वा शकुनयः सर्वे प्रविष्टाश्च रिपोर्बलम् । विधानं विहितं यच्च तद्दृष्ट्वा समुपस्थिताः ॥
data.es: All of them assumed the form of birds and went deep into Lanka, saw the enemy strength and arrangements made by the enemy and turned up.
data.anv: सर्वे all, शकुनयः birds, भूत्वा form, रिपोः enemy, बलम् strength, प्रविष्टाः went in deep, यत् , विधानम् arrangements, विहितम् knowing, तत् there, दृष्टवा seeing, समुपस्थिताः turned up.
data.md: Wearing the forms of birds, they entered into the hostile forces; and, having seen the measures that had been adopted (by them, have come (back).

data.v: संविधानं यथाहुस्ते रावणस्य दुरात्मनः । राम तद्ब्रुवतः सर्वं यथातथ्येन मे शृणु ॥
data.es: "Rama! Alas, they told me everything of the way evil minded Ravana's army is organized as it is. Listen to me."
data.anv: राम Rama, ते to you, दुरात्मनः evil minded, रावणस्य Ravana 's, संविधानम् army is organized, यथा that way, आहुः alas, सर्वम् everything, याथात्त्वेन as it is, ब्रुवतः told, मे to me, शृणु listen.
data.md: O Rāma, hearken to me as I tell you truly anent the provisions which they have related, made by the wicked-minded Ravana.

data.v: पूर्वं प्रहस्तः सबलो द्वारमासाद्य तिष्ठति । दक्षिणं च महावीर्यौ महापार्श्वमहोदरौ ॥
data.es: "Powerful Prahasta stands at east gate with army, Mahaparsva and Mahodara of great valour are at the south gate."
data.anv: प्रबलः powerful, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, पूर्वंद्वारम् at east gate, आसाद्य with army, तिष्ठति remains, महावीर्यौ of great valour, महापार्श्वमहोदरौ Mahaparsva and Mahodara, दक्षइणंच at south gate

data.v: इन्द्रजित्पश्चिमद्वारं राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः । पट्टसासिधनुष्मद्भिः शूलमुद्गरपाणिभिः ॥
data.es: "Ravana's own son, Indrajith stands at the west gate surrounded by numerous Rakshasas collected together wielding sharp swords, bows, spears, arrows and darts and many kinds of weapons."
data.anv: रावणात्मजः Ravana's own son, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, पट्टसासिधनुष्मद्भिः sharp iron words, bows and spears, शोलमुद्गरपाणिभिः arrows and darts, बहुभिः numerous, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, वृतः surrounded by, नानाप्रहरणैः many kinds of weapons, शूरैः heroes, आवृतः collected together, पश्चिमंद्वारम् west gate.

data.v: नानाप्रहरणैः शूरैरावृतो रावणात्मजः । राक्षसानां सहस्रैस्तु बहुभिः शस्त्रपाणिभिः ॥
युक्तः परमसंविग्नो राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः । उत्तरं नगरद्वारं रावणः स्वयमास्थितः ॥
data.es: "Ravana himself stands at the north gate of Lanka, highly agitated surrounded by many thousands of Rakshasas wielding weapons."
data.anv: रावणः Ravana, शस्त्रपाणिभिः wielding weapons, राक्षसानाम् with Rakshasas, बहुभिः many, वृतः surrounded by, सहस्रैः thousands, युक्तः skilled, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, परमसंविग्नः highly agitated, उत्तरम् north, नगरद्वारम् gate of the city, स्वयम् himself, आस्थितः stands.
data.md: And, backed by many thousands of Räkşasas wielding weapons, and accompanied by Rākşasas conversant with counsel, Rāvana himself, his heart agitated to the height, gaurd the Northern gate of the city.

data.v: विरूपाक्षस्तु महता शूलखड्गधनुष्मता । बलेन राक्षसैः सार्धं मध्यमं गुल्ममास्थितः ॥
data.es: "Virupaksha stands in the middle of Lanka wielding spears, swords, bows and arrows accompanied by mighty army."
data.anv: विरूपाक्षस्तु Virupaksha, शूलखडगधनुष्मता with spears, swords and bows, महता mighty, बलेन army, राक्षसैः of Rakshasas, सार्थम् accompanied by, मध्यमंगुल्मम् middle of city, आस्थितः remains.
data.md: Virüpākṣa with a powerful force accoutred in javelins, clubs and bows, protects the garrison in the centre.

data.v: एतानेवंविधान्गुल्माँल्लङ्कायां समुदीक्ष्य ते । मामकाः सचिवाः सर्वे शीघ्रं पुनरिहागताः ॥
data.es: All our ministers immediately returned back after keenly observing the city of Lanka in this way.
data.anv: मामकाः our, सर्वे all, तेमन्त्रिणः the ministers, एवंविधान् in this way, एतान् them, गुल्मान् in the city, लङ्कायाम् of Lanka, समुदीक्ष्य keenly observed, शीघ्रम् immediately, पुनः again, इह here, आगताः reached.
data.md: Having seen these hosts thus disposed in Lankä, my counsellors have speedily come back here.

data.v: गजानां च सहस्रं च रथानामयुतं पुरे । हयानामयुते द्वे च साग्रकोटी च रक्षसाम् ॥
data.es: "Elephant army of ten thousand, similarly ten thousand charioteers, horse riders in twenty thousand, more than a crore foot soldiers, mighty strong and valiant warriors, night ranger's beloved to Ravana, the king of Rakshasas were staying close and serving."
data.anv: गजानाम् elephant riders, दशसाहस्रम् ten thousands, तथा similarly, रथानाम् charioteers, अयुतम् ten thousands, हयानाम् horse riders, द्वे, आयुते twenty thousand, रक्षसाम् foot soldiers, साग्रा more than, कोटिश्च one crore, संयुगेषु in wars, विक्रान्ताः valiant warriors, बलवन्तश्च mighty strong, आततायिनः endeavouring to kill, एते all, निशाचराः night rangers, नित्यम् always, राक्षसराजस्य Rakshasa king's, इष्टाः dear.
data.md: There are ten thousand elephants, an Ayuta cars, two of horses, and abouta koti of Raksasas, powerful and strong, and equipped with arms in conflict.* *These are, remarks the commentator, the leader.

data.v: विक्रान्ता बलवन्तश्च संयुगेष्वाततायिनः । इष्टा राक्षसराजस्य नित्यमेते निशाचराः ॥
data.es: "Elephant army of ten thousand, similarly ten thousand charioteers, horse riders in twenty thousand, more than a crore foot soldiers, mighty strong and valiant warriors, night ranger's beloved to Ravana, the king of Rakshasas were staying close and serving."
data.anv: गजानाम् elephant riders, दशसाहस्रम् ten thousands, तथा similarly, रथानाम् charioteers, अयुतम् ten thousands, हयानाम् horse riders, द्वे, आयुते twenty thousand, रक्षसाम् foot soldiers, साग्रा more than, कोटिश्च one crore, संयुगेषु in wars, विक्रान्ताः valiant warriors, बलवन्तश्च mighty strong, आततायिनः endeavouring to kill, एते all, निशाचराः night rangers, नित्यम् always, राक्षसराजस्य Rakshasa king's, इष्टाः dear.
data.md: These night-rangers are ever the favourites of the Raksasa ruler. And, O kine, a koti of forces accompany each of these Rākşasas in battle.

data.v: एकैकस्यात्र युद्धार्थे राक्षसस्य विशां पते । परिवारः सहस्राणां सहस्रमुपतिष्ठते ॥
data.es: "O! Lord of men! For the sake of assisting one Rakshasa in war ten lakhs of Rakshasas are staying at his service."
data.anv: विशाम्पते Lord of men, अत्र there, एकस्य for one, राक्षसस्य Rakshasa, युद्धार्थे to assist in war, सहस्राणाम् thousands of, सहस्रम् thousands, परीवारः at the service, उपतिष्ठते are staying.
data.md: These night-rangers are ever the favourites of the Raksasa ruler. And, O kine, a koti of forces accompany each of these Rākşasas in battle.

data.v: एतां प्रवृत्तिं लङ्कायां मन्त्रिप्रोक्तं विभीषणः । रामं कमलपत्राक्षमिदमुत्तरमब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Mighty armed Vibheeshana revealed to Rama all the information that was told to him by ministers.
data.anv: महाबाहुः mighty armed, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, मन्त्रिप्रोक्तम् told by ministers, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, एताम् all this, प्रवृत्तिम् information, एनम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, तान् he, राक्षसान् by Rakshasas, अदर्शयत् revealed.

data.v: कुबेरं तु यदा राम रावणः प्रत्ययुध्यत । षष्टिः शतसहस्राणि तदा निर्यान्ति राक्षसाः ॥
data.es: "Rama! Earlier when Ravana launched an offensive battle against Kubera, sixty thousand Rakshasas who were equal to him in valour, brilliance, courage, and with respect sallied forth the proud, the evil minded Ravana."
data.anv: राम Rama, रावणः Ravana, यदा like that, कुबेरम् at Kubera, प्रत्ययुध्यत offensive, तदा then, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, षष्टिः sixty, शतसहस्राणि lakh, निर्यान्ति sallied forth, पराक्रमेण in courage, वीर्येण in valour, तेजसा brilliance, सत्त्वगौरवात् with respect, दर्पेण proud, यत्र there, दुरात्मनः evil minded, रावणस्य Ravana 's, सदृशाः befitting.
data.md: O Răma, when Rāvana battled with Kuvera, sixty lacs of Raksasas marched forth (to meet him). In prowess, energy, vigour, exceeding fortitude, and hauteur, they resembled the wicked-minded Ravana himself.

data.v: पराक्रमेण वीर्येण तेजसा सत्त्वगौरवात् । सदृशा योऽत्र दर्पेण रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ॥
data.es: "Rama! Earlier when Ravana launched an offensive battle against Kubera, sixty thousand Rakshasas who were equal to him in valour, brilliance, courage, and with respect sallied forth the proud, the evil minded Ravana."
data.anv: राम Rama, रावणः Ravana, यदा like that, कुबेरम् at Kubera, प्रत्ययुध्यत offensive, तदा then, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, षष्टिः sixty, शतसहस्राणि lakh, निर्यान्ति sallied forth, पराक्रमेण in courage, वीर्येण in valour, तेजसा brilliance, सत्त्वगौरवात् with respect, दर्पेण proud, यत्र there, दुरात्मनः evil minded, रावणस्य Ravana 's, सदृशाः befitting.
data.md: O Răma, when Rāvana battled with Kuvera, sixty lacs of Raksasas marched forth (to meet him). In prowess, energy, vigour, exceeding fortitude, and hauteur, they resembled the wicked-minded Ravana himself.

data.v: अत्र मन्युर्न कर्तव्यो रोषये त्वां न भीषये । समर्थो ह्यसि वीर्येण सुराणामपि निग्रहे ॥
data.es: "Here, in this case do not be angry. I am telling out of my duty and not out of indignation or to cause anger or fear in you. You are capable of resisting even Devatas."
data.anv: अत्र here in this case, मन्युः indignation, नकर्तव्यः as my duty, त्वाम् to you, रोषये not to cause anger, नभीषये not to cause fear, वीर्येण in valour, सुराणाम् Devatas, निग्रहेऽपिमोल can resist, समर्थः capable, असिहि am telling.
data.md: In this matter, you ought not to grow wroth, I only arouse your wrath, and do not endeavour to frighten you. You can subdue even the celestials by your prowess. *i.e. You ought not to be angry with me; for I do not frighten you, but rouse your wrath against Ravana.

data.v: तद्भवांश्चतुरङ्गेण बलेन महता वृतः । व्यूह्येदं वानरानीकं निर्मथिष्यसि रावणम् ॥
data.es: "You also have these Vanara armies surrounded by four kinds of army, elephants, chariots, cavalry and foot soldiers."
data.anv: तत् and also, भवान् you, इदम् these, वानरानीकम् army of Vanaras, व्यूह्य with, चतुरङ्गेणबलेन four kinds of army force, वृतः surrounded, रावणम् Ravana, निर्मथिष्यति crush.
data.md: Therefore you, environed by a mighty army, having arrayed the monkey-forces in order of battle, shall thrash Ravana (in battle)

data.v: रावणावरजे वाक्यमेवं ब्रुवति राघवः । शत्रूणां प्रतिघातार्थमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: When Ravana's younger brother spoke in that way Raghava instructed the army to attack the enemy.
data.anv: रावणावरजे Ravana's younger brother, इति this way, वाक्यम् words, ब्रुवति spoke इति this, राघवः Raghava, शत्रूणाम् enemies, प्रतिघातार्थम् issued orders to attack, इदम् thus, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् had spoken
data.md: When Rāvana's younger brother had spoken thus, Rāghava, said these words with reference to his beating the foe.

data.v: पूर्वद्वारे तु लङ्काया नीलो वानरपुंगवः । प्रहस्तं प्रतियोद्धा स्याद्वानरैर्बहुभिर्वृतः ॥
data.es: "Let the Vanara leader Neela along with Vanaras stay at the east gate of Lanka and give fight to Prahasta."
data.anv: लङ्कायाः at Lanka's, पूर्वद्वारे east gate, वानरपुङ्गवः Vanara leader, नीलः Neela, बहुभिः many more, वानरैः Vanaras, वृतः surrounded, प्रहस्तप्रतियोद्धा to Prahasta give fight, स्यात् with.
data.md: Let that foremost of monkey, Nila, surrounded to by an immense number of monkeys, cope with Prahasta at the Eastern gate of Lankā.

data.v: अङ्गदो वालिपुत्रस्तु बलेन महता वृतः । दक्षिणे बाधतां द्वारे महापार्श्वमहोदरौ ॥
data.es: "Let Vali's son the mighty and powerful Angada along with army crush Mahaparsva and Mahodara at the south gate."
data.anv: वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, अङ्गदः Angada, महता mighty, बलेन powerful, वृतः along with, दक्षिणेद्वारे south gate, महापार्श्वमहोदरौ Mahaparsva and Mahodara, बाधताम् crush.
data.md: And, engirt by a mighty force, let Angada, son of Válī, resist Mahăpărśva and Mahodara at the Southern gate (thereof).

data.v: हनूमान्पश्चिमद्वारं निपीड्य पवनात्मजः । प्रविशत्वप्रमेयात्मा बहुभिः कपिभिर्वृतः ॥
data.es: "Let Hanuman, the wind god's son of unimaginable prowess, enter the west gate along with numerous Vanaras and press against the enemy."
data.anv: पवनात्मजः wind god's son, अप्रमेयात्मा of unimaginable prowess, हनुमान् Hanuman, बहुभिः numerous, कपिभिः Vanaras, वृतः surrounded by, पश्चिमद्वारम् west gate, निपीड्य pressing, प्रविशतु enter.
data.md: And let that son of the Wind-god, Hanuman, backed by innumerable monkeys, (beating the host stationed) at the Western gate, find entrance (into the city).

data.v: दैत्यदानवसंघानामृषीणां च महात्मनाम् । विप्रकारप्रियः क्षुद्रो वरदानबलान्वितः ॥
परिक्रामति यः सर्वाँल्लोकान्संतापयन्प्रजाः । तस्याहं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य स्वयमेव वधे धृतः ॥
उत्तरं नगरद्वारमहं सौमित्रिणा सह । निपीड्याभिप्रवेक्ष्यामि सबलो यत्र रावणः ॥
वानरेन्द्रश्च बलवानृक्षराजश्च जाम्बवान् । राक्षसेन्द्रानुजश्चैव गुल्मे भवतु मध्यमे ॥
data.es: "Mighty strong Sugriva, valorous Jambavan, the ruler of Vanaras and Vibheeshana, brother of Ravana will remain at the middle of Lanka and fight."
data.anv: बलवान् mighty strong, वानरेन्द्रश्च Vanara king, वीर्यवान् valorous, ऋक्षराजश्च Rksharaja, Jambavan, राक्षसेन्द्रानुजश्चैव and Ravana's brother, मध्यम: middle, गुलो of city, भवतु will remain.
data.md: And let the powerful king of monkeys, and the puissant sovereign of bears, and the younger brother of the Raksasa-chief, manage the soldiery posted in the centre.

data.v: न चैव मानुषं रूपं कार्यं हरिभिराहवे । एषा भवतु नः संज्ञा युद्धेऽस्मिन्वानरे बले ॥
data.es: "In the battle like this at present Vanaras should not be in the semblance of humans. Let this be our sign."
data.anv: आहवे in battle, हरिभिः monkeys, मानुषं human, रूपम् form, नचैवम् not have, कार्यम् task, अस्मिन् our, युद्धे war, वानरे Vanaras, बले, एषा in that way, संज्ञा sign, भवतु let it be.
data.md: In this battle, the monkeys need not assume the forms of human being. And let this serve for a sign that the monkeys, in order to the recognition of our own forces, appear with their proper monkey-marks. We seven only shall battle with the foe in human shapes, viz.

data.v: वानरा एव निश्चिह्नं स्वजनेऽस्मिन्भविष्यति । वयं तु मानुषेणैव सप्त योत्स्यामहे परान् ॥
data.es: "To know our own people the Vanaras are the sign of recognition Chivalrous Lakshmana, my brother, similarly five of us and our friend Vibheeshana, these seven people alone will wage war in human form."
data.anv: अस्मिन् our, स्वजने own people, वानराःएव even Vanaras, नः not, चिह्नम् recognize, भविष्यति should be able to, महौजसौ very chivalrous, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेन Lakshmana, एषः similarly, अहम् I, आत्मना my own, पञ्चमः five of us, ममसखा our friends, अयम् our, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, वयम् also, सप्तमानुषेणैव seven human forms, परान् enemies, योत्स्यामहे wage war.
data.md: In this battle, the monkeys need not assume the forms of human being. And let this serve for a sign that the monkeys, in order to the recognition of our own forces, appear with their proper monkey-marks. We seven only shall battle with the foe in human shapes, viz.

data.v: अहमेव सह भ्रात्रा लक्ष्मणेन महौजसा । आत्मना पञ्चमश्चायं सखा मम विभीषणः ॥
data.es: "To know our own people the Vanaras are the sign of recognition Chivalrous Lakshmana, my brother, similarly five of us and our friend Vibheeshana, these seven people alone will wage war in human form."
data.anv: अस्मिन् our, स्वजने own people, वानराःएव even Vanaras, नः not, चिह्नम् recognize, भविष्यति should be able to, महौजसौ very chivalrous, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेन Lakshmana, एषः similarly, अहम् I, आत्मना my own, पञ्चमः five of us, ममसखा our friends, अयम् our, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, वयम् also, सप्तमानुषेणैव seven human forms, परान् enemies, योत्स्यामहे wage war.
data.md: I along with my brother, the exceedingly energetic Lakşmaņa, and my friend Vibhīşaņa counting for the fifth in company with his own following.

data.v: स रामः कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थमेवमुक्त्वा विभीषणम् । सुवेलारोहणे बुद्धिं चकार मतिमान्मतिम् ॥
data.es: Wise Rama having spoken like that to Vibheeshana for accomplishing the task, looking at the beauty of Suvela mountain slopes, climbed up and went.
data.anv: मतिमान् wise, मतिम् in mind, सःरामः that Rama, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, सुवेलस्यगिरिः Suvela mountain, रमणीयतरम् beauty, तटम् slopes, दृष्टवा seeing, कृत्यसिध्यर्थम् for accomplishing the task, सुवेलारोहणे climb up, बुद्धिम् thought, चकार and went.
data.md: Having said this to Vibhísaņa for attaining success in the enterprise, that lord, the intelligent Rāma, seeing the sides of Suvela more beautiful (than other places), intended to ascend it.

data.v: ततस्तु रामो महता बलेन; प्रच्छाद्य सर्वां पृथिवीं महात्मा । प्रहृष्टरूपोऽभिजगाम लङ्कां; कृत्वा मतिं सोऽरिवधे महात्मा ॥
data.md: Then, environed by a mighty host, the highsouled and magnanimous Rāma, his features mirroring forth high exultation, overshadowing the entire Earth (with his forces), set out for Lankā, determined upon destroying the enemy.

data.v: स तु कृत्वा सुवेलस्य मतिमारोहणं प्रति । लक्ष्मणानुगतो रामः सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Rama, the well wisher of Lakshmana climbing up the Suvela mountain thought in his mind and thus spoke to Sugriva and the righteous, affectionate Vibheeshana, a counsellor, knower of right action and facts of Lanka, and a respectable enemy.
data.anv: लक्ष्मणानुगतः Lakshmana's wellwisher, सःरामः Rama, सुवेलस्य Suvela's, आरोहणंप्रति climbing, मतिम् in his mind, कृत्वा made up, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, धर्मज्ञम् righteous, अनुरक्तम् very affectionate, निशाचरम् night ranger, मन्त्रज्ञम् thinkercounsellor, विधिज्ञम् knower of right action, विभीषणंच and Vibheeshana, श्लक्क्ष्णया knower of facts (of Lanka), परया enemy, गिरा respectable, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: Having been bent upon mounting Suvela, Rāma, followed by Lakşmaņa, addressed in sweet and excellent words, Sugriva, and that righteous night-ranger, Vibhisana, versed in। counsel and conversant with precepts, who was devoted to him, saying.

data.v: विभीषणं च धर्मज्ञमनुरक्तं निशाचरम् । मन्त्रज्ञं च विधिज्ञं च श्लक्ष्णया परया गिरा ॥
data.es: Rama, the well wisher of Lakshmana climbing up the Suvela mountain thought in his mind and thus spoke to Sugriva and the righteous, affectionate Vibheeshana, a counsellor, knower of right action and facts of Lanka, and a respectable enemy.
data.anv: लक्ष्मणानुगतः Lakshmana's wellwisher, सःरामः Rama, सुवेलस्य Suvela's, आरोहणंप्रति climbing, मतिम् in his mind, कृत्वा made up, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, धर्मज्ञम् righteous, अनुरक्तम् very affectionate, निशाचरम् night ranger, मन्त्रज्ञम् thinkercounsellor, विधिज्ञम् knower of right action, विभीषणंच and Vibheeshana, श्लक्क्ष्णया knower of facts (of Lanka), परया enemy, गिरा respectable, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: Having been bent upon mounting Suvela, Rāma, followed by Lakşmaņa, addressed in sweet and excellent words, Sugriva, and that righteous night-ranger, Vibhisana, versed in। counsel and conversant with precepts, who was devoted to him, saying.

data.v: सुवेलं साधु शैलेन्द्रमिमं धातुशतैश्चितम् । अध्यारोहामहे सर्वे वत्स्यामोऽत्र निशामिमाम् ॥
data.es: "We shall all climb up this Suvela mountain captivating with hundreds of minerals and remain there tonight."
data.anv: धातुशतैः hundreds of minerals, चितम् captivating, इमम् this, सुवेलंशैलेन्द्रम् Suvela mountain, साधु together, अध्यारोहामहे climb up, सर्वे all, इमाम् this, निशाम् night, अत्र there, वत्स्यामहे shall remain
data.md: We shall all ascend this mount Suvela, be dight with metals; and pass this night even here.

data.v: लङ्कां चालोकयिष्यामो निलयं तस्य रक्षसः । येन मे मरणान्ताय हृता भार्या दुरात्मना ॥
data.es: "We shall see Lanka the abode of Rakshasa by whom, who is evil minded as he is to face death, has stolen my consort not knowing, who turned away from righteous duty not knowing the race with lowly Rakshasa mentality, who is immoral."
data.anv: दुरात्मना evil minded, येन by whom, मरणान्ताय to end with death, मे I भार्या wife, हृता stolen, येन by whom, धर्मः righteous duty, नविज्ञातः not know, वृत्तम् turned round, न not, तथा similarly, कुलम् race, न not, येन by whom, नीचया lowly, राक्षस्याबुध्या Rakshasa mentality, गर्हितम् immoral, तत् him, कृतम् done, तस्यरक्षसः his Rakshasa, निलयम् abode, लङ्काम् Lanka, आलोकयिष्यामःच and also see.

data.v: येन धर्मो न विज्ञातो न वृत्तं न कुलं तथा । राक्षस्या नीचया बुद्ध्या येन तद्गर्हितं कृतम् ॥
data.es: "We shall see Lanka the abode of Rakshasa by whom, who is evil minded as he is to face death, has stolen my consort not knowing, who turned away from righteous duty not knowing the race with lowly Rakshasa mentality, who is immoral."
data.anv: दुरात्मना evil minded, येन by whom, मरणान्ताय to end with death, मे I भार्या wife, हृता stolen, येन by whom, धर्मः righteous duty, नविज्ञातः not know, वृत्तम् turned round, न not, तथा similarly, कुलम् race, न not, येन by whom, नीचया lowly, राक्षस्याबुध्या Rakshasa mentality, गर्हितम् immoral, तत् him, कृतम् done, तस्यरक्षसः his Rakshasa, निलयम् abode, लङ्काम् Lanka, आलोकयिष्यामःच and also see.

data.v: यस्मिन्मे वर्धते रोषः कीर्तिते राक्षसाधमे । यस्यापराधान्नीचस्य वधं द्रक्ष्यामि रक्षसाम् ॥
data.es: "My wrath is aroused by the mention of the name of lowly Rakshasa. Because of his mistakes all Rakshasas are to be exterminated now."
data.anv: नीचस्य mean, यस्य his, अपराधात् mistakes, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वधम् terminate, द्रक्ष्यामि perceive, तस्मिन् his, राक्षसाधमे lowly Rakshasa, कीर्तितेसति mention of name, मे my, रोषः wrath, वर्तते aroused.

data.v: एको हि कुरुते पापं कालपाशवशं गतः । नीचेनात्मापचारेण कुलं तेन विनश्यति ॥
data.es: "Only one has done that sin and fallen into the noose of death. Because of one Rakshasa's mistake the race will perish."
data.anv: एकः one alone, कालपाशवशम् fallen into the noose of death, गतः gone, पापम् sin, कुरुतेहि has done also, नीचेन meanly, तेन because of that, आत्मापचारेण because of his own mistake, कुलम् race, विनश्यति will perish.

data.v: एवं संमन्त्रयन्नेव सक्रोधो रावणं प्रति । रामः सुवेलं वासाय चित्रसानुमुपारुहत् ॥
data.es: Talking about Ravana in that manner, Rama climbed the captivating slopes of Suvela to rest there.
data.anv: रावणंप्रति about Ravana, सक्रोधः anger, रामः Rama, एवम् in that manner, सम्मन्त्रयन्नेन talking about, चित्रसानुम् captivating slopes, सुवेलम् of Suvela, आसाद्य climbed, उपारुहत् to rest there.
data.md: Having decided thus, Rāma, filled with wrath at Ravana, coming to Suvela, ascended its variegated plateau.
