data.v: पृष्ठतो लक्ष्मण चैनमन्वगच्छत्समाहितः । सशरं चापमुद्यम्य सुमहद्विक्रमे रतः ॥
data.es: Heroic and alert Lakshmana also holding his great bow, followed. His ministers and Vibheeshana and Sugriva also followed him up.
data.anv: विक्रमे heroic, रतः showing, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana too, समाहितः reached, सशरम् , सुमहत् great, चापम् bow, उद्यम्य holding, एवम् likewise, पृष्ठतः alert, अन्वगच्छत् followed, सामात्यः his ministers, सविभीषणः and Vibheeshana, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तम् and, अन्वारोहत् followed.
data.md: And Laksmana, collected, went in his wake. And, upraising bow and arrow, Sugriva, (ever) engaged in valorous acts, accompanied with Vibhişaņa as well as his counsellors, following him, also ascended (the mountain).

data.v: तमन्वरोहत्सुग्रीवः सामात्यः सविभीषणः । हनूमानङ्गदो नीलो मैन्दो द्विविद एव च ॥
गजो गवाक्षो गवयः शरभो गन्धमादनः । पनसः कुमुदश्चैव हरो रम्भश्च यूथपः ॥
data.es: Gaja, Gavaksha, Gava, Sarabha, Gandhamadana stood protecting the monkey troops wandering all over.
data.anv: गजो Gaja, गवाक्षो Gavaksha, गवयः Gava, शरभ Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandamadhana, मन्तात्परिधावन्तो all over wandering, ररक्षु protecting, हर्रिवाहिनीम् monkey troops.

data.v: एते चान्ये च बहवो वानराः शीघ्रगामिनः । ते वायुवेगप्रवणास्तं गिरिं गिरिचारिणः । अध्यारोहन्त शतशः सुवेलं यत्र राघवः ॥
ते त्वदीर्घेण कालेन गिरिमारुह्य सर्वतः । ददृशुः शिखरे तस्य विषक्तामिव खे पुरीम् ॥
data.es: All of them in no time ascended the mountain peak and saw the city of Lanka which was as if clinging closely to the sky and hanging.
data.anv: तेतु and they, अदीर्घेण short, कालेन time, सर्वतः all, गिरिम् mountain, आरुह्य ascended, तस्य its, शिखरे peak, खे sky, विषक्तामिव like a closely clinging, पुरीम् city, ददृशुः saw.

data.v: तां शुभां प्रवरद्वारां प्राकारवरशोभिताम् । लङ्कां राक्षससंपूर्णां ददृशुर्हरियूथपाः ॥
data.es: The vanara heroes witnessed beautiful gateways, captivating boundaries of auspicious Lanka filled all over with rakshasas.
data.anv: हरियूथपाः Vanara heroes, प्रवरद्वाराम् beautiful gateways, प्राकारपरिशोभिताम् captivating boundaries, राक्षससम्पूर्णाम् filled with Rakshasas, शुभाम् auspicious, तांलङ्काम् that Lanka, ददृशुः witnessed.
data.md: Ascending the mountain in a short time, they all beheld from its summit the city, appearing to be built on the air. And the monkey-leaders beheld Lankā, exceedingly splendid with noble gateways; gracefully enclosed with a wall; thronging with Rakşasas; and defended by sable Raksasas.

data.v: प्राकारचयसंस्थैश्च तथा नीलैर्निशाचरैः । ददृशुस्ते हरिश्रेष्ठाः प्राकारमपरं कृतम् ॥
data.es: The best of vanaras saw dark coloured rakshasas who stood like another boundary in a row.
data.anv: प्राकारवरसंस्थैः stood like boundary, तथा like that, नीलैश्च dark, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, कृतम् formed, अपरम् another, प्राकारम् boundary, ते they, हरिश्रेष्ठाः best of Vanaras, ददृशुः saw.
data.md: The foremost of monkeys saw these appearing like another wall (overtopping the one beneath).

data.v: ते दृष्ट्वा वानराः सर्वे राक्षसान्युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः । मुमुचुर्विपुलान्नादांस्तत्र रामस्य पश्यतः ॥
data.es: All the vanaras saw the rakshasas eager for war, and as Rama stood looking at them many kinds of clamours were heard.
data.anv: सर्वे all, तेवानराः the Vanaras, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः eager for war, राक्षसान् दृष्टवा seeing the Rakshasas, तस्य them, रामस्य Rama, पश्यतः saw, विविधान् many, नादान् clamours, मुमुचुः stood looking.
data.md: On seeing the Rākşasas, the monkeys burning for battle set up various roars in the presence of Rama.

data.v: ततोऽस्तमगमत्सूर्यः संध्यया प्रतिरञ्जितः । पूर्णचन्द्रप्रदीपा च क्षपा समभिवर्तते ॥
data.es: Thereafter the Sun had set in, and twilight reddened. Full moon started shining as night had set in.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, सूर्यः sun, सन्ध्यया twilight, प्रतिरञ्जितः reddened, अस्तम् sun set आगमत् had set in, पूर्णचन्द्रप्रदीप्ता full moon shining, क्षपाच dazzling, समभिवर्तते night set in duly.
data.md: Then the Sun, crimsoned with Eve, ascended the Setting-hill; and Night came, illumined by the Moon at his full.

data.v: ततः स रामो हरिवाहिनीपति;र्विभीषणेन प्रतिनन्द्य सत्कृतः । सलक्ष्मणो यूथपयूथसंवृतः; सुवेल पृष्ठे न्यवसद्यथासुखम् ॥
data.es: Thereafter, Rama, the leader of Vanara troops happily rested on Suvela peak after Vibheeshana and Lakshmana duly offered their prayers.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टात्रिंशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the thirty eighth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: ततः then, सलक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सः he, रामः Rama, यूथपयूथसम्वृतः surrounded by Vanara heroes, हरिवाहिनीपतिः leader of ocean of monkey troops, विभीषणेन to Vibheeshana, प्रतिनन्द्य offered prayers, सत्कृतः having, सुवेलपृष्ठे Suvela peak, यथासुखम् happily, न्यवसत् rested.
data.md: Then the master of the monkey-army, Rāma, saluted and honoured by Vibhisana, accompanied by Lakşmaņa as well as the leaders of the monkeys, sojourned happily on the beast of Suvela.

data.v: तां रात्रिमुषितास्तत्र सुवेले हरिपुंगवाः । लङ्कायां ददृशुर्वीरा वनान्युपवनानि च ॥
data.es: The heroic leader of the monkeys kept awake that night on the Suvela and saw forests and gardens there in Lanka.
data.anv: वीराः heroic, हरिपुङ्गवाः leader of monkeys, तत्र there, सुवेले on the Suvela, ताम् on that, रात्रिम् night, उषिताः kept awake, लङ्कायाम् Lanka, वनानि forests, उपवनानिच and gardens, ददृशः saw.
data.md: Having passed the night in Suvela, the heroic monkey-leaders surveyed woods and forests in Lankā.

data.v: समसौम्यानि रम्याणि विशालान्यायतानि च । दृष्टिरम्याणि ते दृष्ट्वा बभूवुर्जातविस्मयाः ॥
data.es: They were amazed to see the even terrain, beautiful and expansive, long, and continuous sanctuary lovely to look at being a feast to the eyes.
data.anv: ते they, समसौम्यानि even terrain with, रम्याणि beautiful, विशालानि expansive, आयतानिच long and continuous sanctuary, दृष्टिरम्याणि feast to the eyes, दृष्टवा on seeing, जातविस्मयाः lovely to look at, बभूवुः amazed.
data.md: Seeing those extensive (woods and forests), mild, and charming, and beautiful to behold, they were seized with wonderment.

data.v: चम्पकाशोकपुंनागसालतालसमाकुला । तमालवनसंछन्ना नागमालासमावृता ॥
हिन्तालैरर्जुनैर्नीपैः सप्तपर्णैश्च पुष्पितैः । तिलकैः कर्णिकारैश्च पटालैश्च समन्ततः ॥
शुशुभे पुष्पिताग्रैश्च लतापरिगतैर्द्रुमैः । लङ्का बहुविधैर्दिव्यैर्यथेन्द्रस्यामरावती ॥
विचित्रकुसुमोपेतै रक्तकोमलपल्लवैः । शाद्वलैश्च तथा नीलैश्चित्राभिर्वनराजिभिः ॥
data.md: And trees there, furnished with variegated flowers having tender rosy leaves, and blue lawns, and rows of woods; and bearing odorous and charming blossoms and fruits, looked like men adorned with ornaments.

data.v: गन्धाढ्यान्यभिरम्याणि पुष्पाणि च फलानि च । धारयन्त्यगमास्तत्र भूषणानीव मानवाः ॥
data.es: Having reached there where trees bore fragrance, very beautiful flowers and fruits seemed as though humans were wearing ornaments.
data.anv: तत्र there, अगमाः having reached, गन्धाढ्यानि bore fragrance, अभिरम्याणि very beautiful, पुष्पाणिच flowers, फलानिच and fruits, मानवाः humans, भूषणानीव ornaments, धारयतनि as though wearing.
data.md: And trees there, furnished with variegated flowers having tender rosy leaves, and blue lawns, and rows of woods; and bearing odorous and charming blossoms and fruits, looked like men adorned with ornaments.

data.v: तच्चैत्ररथसंकाशं मनोज्ञं नन्दनोपमम् । वनं सर्वर्तुकं रम्यं शुशुभे षट्पदायुतम् ॥
data.es: Appearing like the chaitra chariot of Kubera, Nandana garden of Indra, green in all seasons filled with bees, the garden was a wonderful delight.
data.anv: चैत्ररथसङ्काशम् with chaitra chariot, मनोज्ञम् delightful to the mind, नन्दनोपमम् like Nandana garden of Indra, सर्वर्तुकम् green in all seasons, षटपदायुतम् filled with bees, तत् that, वनम् garden, शुशुभे very wonderful.
data.md: There a delightful and pleasant wood resembling Caitraratha, and like to Nandana itself, having all the seasons present, appeared beauteous to the view, with black bees all around.

data.v: नत्यूहकोयष्टिभकैर्नृत्यमानैश्च बर्हिभिः । रुतं परभृतानां च शुश्रुवे वननिर्झरे ॥
data.es: The Vanaras heard the singing of cuckoos, dancing of peacocks, crying of gallinules, lapwings and herons from the gardens abounding in cascades.
data.anv: वन्निर्झरे abounding in cascades, नात्यूहकोयष्टिभकैः gallinules, lapwings, herons, नृत्यमानैः dancing, बर्हिणैः peacocks, परभृतानाम् cuckoos, रुतम् च and singing, शुश्रुवे heard.
data.md: And it had Dātyühas, and Koyașthivas, and peacocks dancing; and the strains of the coels were heard at the woodland rills.

data.v: नित्यमत्तविहंगानि भ्रमराचरितानि च । कोकिलाकुलषण्डानि विहगाभिरुतानि च ॥
data.es: "You may see the trees shaking violently by the pleasant breeze, inhabited by proud birds, drunken honeybees and crowded with cuckoos and other birds (Rama said to Lakshmana)."
data.anv: शिवः pleasant, अनिलः breeze, मत्तविहङ्गानि inhabited by proud birds प्रलीनभ्रमराणीच drunken honeybees, कोकिलाकुलषण्डानि crowded with cuckoos and other birds, दोधवीति shaking violently, पश्य you may see (said Rama to Lakshmana).
data.md: Behold the intoxicated birds, and the black bees blending (with the blossoms). And the blessed breeze sway the trees vocal with the coels.

data.v: भृङ्गराजाभिगीतानि भ्रमरैः सेवितानि च । कोणालकविघुष्टानि सारसाभिरुतानि च ॥
विविशुस्ते ततस्तानि वनान्युपवनानि च । हृष्टाः प्रमुदिता वीरा हरयः कामरूपिणः ॥
तेषां प्रविशतां तत्र वानराणां महौजसाम् । पुष्पसंसर्गसुरभिर्ववौ घ्राणसुखोऽनिलः ॥
data.es: Then the Vanaras of extraordinary energy, were enjoying the breeze redolent with the fragrance of flowers as they were entering, and the wind blew.
data.anv: महौजसाम् of extraordinary energy, तेषाम् all of them, वानराणाम् the Vanaras, तत्र then, प्रविशताम् as they were entering, पुष्पसंसर्गसुरभिः breeze redolent with the fragrance of flowers, घ्राणसुखः enjoying the fragrance, अनिलः wind, ववौ blew

data.v: अन्ये तु हरिवीराणां यूथान्निष्क्रम्य यूथपाः । सुग्रीवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता लङ्कां जग्मुः पताकिनीम् ॥
data.es: Some other monkey heroes permitted by Sugriva went to Lanka decorated with flags.
data.anv: अन्ये others, यूथपाःतु heroes too, हरिवीराणाम् monkey heroes, यूथात् troops, निष्क्रम्य left, सुग्रीवेण to Sugriva, अभ्यनुज्ञाताः permitted by, पताकिनीम् decorated with flags, लङ्काम् Lanka, जग्मुः went.

data.v: वित्रासयन्तो विहगांस्त्रासयन्तो मृगद्विपान् । कम्पयन्तश्च तां लङ्कां नादैः स्वैर्नदतां वराः ॥
data.es: Other monkeys capable of roaring went into Lanka, spreading out terrifying the birds, dispiriting the deer and elephants by noise.
data.anv: नदताम् capable of roaring, वराः best, विहगां birds, वित्रासयन्तः spreading, मृगद्विपान् dispiriting the deer and elephants, नादैः by the sound, ते they, लङ्काम् into Lanka, कम्पयन्तश्च terrifying.
data.md: And, terrifying the fowls and dispiriting beasts and birds and shaking Lankā with their roars, those foremost monkeys set up shouts.

data.v: कुर्वन्तस्ते महावेगा महीं चारणपीडिताम् । रजश्च सहसैवोर्ध्वं जगाम चरणोद्धतम् ॥
data.es: Those Vanaras endowed with speed went trampling down on the ground with force, the dust under their feet rose to the sky in a fraction of a second.
data.anv: महावेगाः capable of speed, ते they, महीम् great force, चरणपीडिताम् trampling down with feet, कुर्वन्तः doing, चरणोत्थितम् under feet, रजश्च dust, सहसैव in a second, ऊर्थ्वम् up to the sky, जगाम wentrose.
data.md: They, endowed with great impetuosity, went on, oppressing the earth with their battle-array; and clouds of dust suddenly arose from the march of the soldiery.

data.v: ऋक्षाः सिंहा वराहाश्च महिषा वारणा मृगाः । तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ता जग्मुर्भीता दिशो दश ॥
data.es: Alarmed by that sound the Bears, lions, pigs, elephants, buffaloes were frightened and went in all the ten directions.
data.anv: तेन by that, शब्देन sound, ऋक्षाः Bears, सिंहावराहश्च lions and pigs, महिषाः buffaloes, वारणामृगाः elephants, वित्रस्ताः alarmed, भीताः frightened, दश ten, दिशः directions, जग्मुः went.
data.md: And bears, and lions, and buffaloes, and elephants, and deer, and birds, overwhelmed with affright, made for the t en cardinal points.

data.v: शिखरं तु त्रिकूटस्य प्रांशु चैकं दिविस्पृशम् । समन्तात्पुष्पसंछन्नं महारजतसंनिभम् ॥
शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं विमलं चारुदर्शनम् । श्लक्ष्णं श्रीमन्महच्चैव दुष्प्रापं शकुनैरपि ॥
data.es: Trikuta peak was fully covered with flowers, sparkled with gold, spread over a hundred yojanas, beautiful to look at, splendid and smooth. It is difficult even for birds to reach, for sages even in thought and difficult to access by any physical action. It is praiseworthy as if touching the sky alone.
data.anv: समन्तात् all over, पुष्पसञ्छन्नम् covered with flowers, महारजतसन्निभम् sparkled with gold, शतयोजनविस्तीर्णम् spread over a hundred yojanas, विमलम् whitepure, चारुदर्शनम् beautiful to look, श्लक्ष्णम् smooth, श्रीमत् splendid, महच्छैव sages, शकुनैरपि even for birds, दुष्प्रापम् not possible to reach, जनैः people, मनसापि in thought, दुरारोहम् difficult to access, कर्मणा by physical action, किंपुनः why again, प्रांशु praise worthy, दिविस्पृशम् touching the sky, एकम् alone, त्रिकूटस्यशिखरम् peak of Trikuta.

data.v: मनसापि दुरारोहं किं पुनः कर्मणा जनैः । निविष्टा तत्र शिखरे लङ्का रावणपालिता ॥
सा पुरी गोपुरैरुच्चैः पाण्डुराम्बुदसंनिभैः । काञ्चनेन च सालेन राजतेन च शोभिता ॥
data.es: The city of Lanka looked charming with tall towers resembling white cluster of clouds fortified with gold and silver.
data.anv: सा that, पुरी city, उच्चैः tall, पाण्डुराम्बुदसन्निभैः like white cluster of clouds, गोपुरैः towers, काञ्चनेन with gold, राजतेनच and silver, शालेन fortified, शोभते charming.

data.v: प्रासादैश्च विमानैश्च लङ्का परमभूषिता । घनैरिवातपापाये मध्यमं वैष्णवं पदम् ॥
data.es: The tall buildings decorated beautifully resembled air planes and were shining like heavy rainy clouds exposed to the sun. The building in the centre resembled the abode of Vishnu.
data.anv: प्रासादैश्च even the buildings, विमानैश्च resembled air planes, परमभूषिता decorated beautifully, लङ्का Lanka, आतपापापये exposed to the sun, घनैः rainy clouds, मध्यमम् in the centre, वैष्णवंपदम् इव resembling the abode of Vishnu.

data.v: यस्यां स्तम्भसहस्रेण प्रासादः समलंकृतः । कैलासशिखराकारो दृश्यते खमिवोल्लिखन् ॥
data.es: In that city, which was always protected fully by a hundred Rakshasas, there was a palace with thousand pillars, which looked like peak of mount Kailas, and was as though it was scraping the sky and it as like an ornament of Lanka, the city of Rakshasa's Lord.
data.anv: यस्याम् in that city, यः that which is, नित्यम् always, रक्षसाम् protected, समग्रेण fully, शतेन hundred, रक्ष्यते graced, स्तम्बसहस्रेण thousand pillars, समलङ्कङ्कृतः ornament, कैलासशिखराकारः peak of mount Kailasa, प्रासादः palace, खम् sky, उललिखन्निव as if scraping, दृश्यते appeared, सः that, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa Lord's, पुरभूषणम् ornament of city, बभूव looked.
data.md: That palace, which was adorned with thousands of pillars, and which, as if piercing the heavens, looked like a peak of Kailasa—was the residence of the Sovereign of the Rākşasas—the ornament of the city, (ever guarded by full hundreds of Raksasas.

data.v: चैत्यः स राक्षसेन्द्रस्य बभूव पुरभूषणम् । शतेन रक्षसां नित्यं यः समग्रेण रक्ष्यते ॥
data.es: In that city, which was always protected fully by a hundred Rakshasas, there was a palace with thousand pillars, which looked like peak of mount Kailas, and was as though it was scraping the sky and it as like an ornament of Lanka, the city of Rakshasa's Lord.
data.anv: यस्याम् in that city, यः that which is, नित्यम् always, रक्षसाम् protected, समग्रेण fully, शतेन hundred, रक्ष्यते graced, स्तम्बसहस्रेण thousand pillars, समलङ्कङ्कृतः ornament, कैलासशिखराकारः peak of mount Kailasa, प्रासादः palace, खम् sky, उललिखन्निव as if scraping, दृश्यते appeared, सः that, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa Lord's, पुरभूषणम् ornament of city, बभूव looked.
data.md: That palace, which was adorned with thousands of pillars, and which, as if piercing the heavens, looked like a peak of Kailasa—was the residence of the Sovereign of the Rākşasas—the ornament of the city, (ever guarded by full hundreds of Raksasas.

data.v: तां समृद्धां समृद्धार्थो लक्ष्मीवाँल्लक्ष्मणाग्रजः । रावणस्य पुरीं रामो ददर्श सह वानरैः ॥
तां रत्नपूर्णां बहुसंविधानां; प्रासादमालाभिरलंकृतां च । पुरीं महायन्त्रकवाटमुख्यां; ददर्श रामो महता बलेन ॥
data.es: Accompanied by huge Vanara army, Rama saw in the city of Lanka rows of buildingspalaces, adorned with gems, gates fitted with huge machines for war and large army of Ravana.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकोनचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the thirty ninth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: महता huge, बलेन army, रामः Rama, रत्नपूर्णम् jewelsgems, बहुसंविधानाम् accompanied by Vanaras, प्रासादमालाभिः garland s of buildings, अलङ्कृतांच adorned with, महायन्त्रकवाटमुख्याम् gates fitted with huge machines for war, महता large, बलेन by army, ताम् that, पुरीम् city, ददर्श saw.
data.md: Rāma, surrounded by his mighty forces, saw that palace, filled with diverse kinds of gems, adorned with rows of edifices, and having huge engines and gateways.

data.v: अथ तस्मिन्निमित्तानि दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः । लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मिसंपन्नमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Perceiving the portents, Rama spoke these words embracing Saumithri who was aware of the portents.
data.anv: निमित्तज्ञः one who is aware of portents, लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः Lakshmana's elder brother, दृष्टवा perceiving, निमित्तानि portents, सौमित्रिम् to Saumithri, इदम् these, सम्परिष्वज्य embracing, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: Having seen omens, that one, Laksmina's elder brother, conversant with them, embracing the son of Sumitrā, said these words.

data.v: परिगृह्योदकं शीतं वनानि फलवन्ति च । बलौघं संविभज्येमं व्यूह्य तिष्ठेम लक्ष्मण ॥
data.es: "Lakshmana Arrange a place in this forest where there is cool water and fruits for the battalions of the army, we shall remain (alert)."
data.anv: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, शीतम् cool, उदकम् water, फलवन्ति fruit, वनानिच forests, परिगृह्य arranging, इदम् this, बलौघम् battalions of army, संविभज्य dividing, व्यूह्य the group, तिष्ठेम will remain.
data.md: O Laksmana, occupying (this tract) of cool waters and woods affluent with fruits, will we, dividing and arranging our forces, stay here.

data.v: लोकक्षयकरं भीमं भयं पश्याम्युपस्थितम् । निबर्हणं प्रवीराणामृक्षवानररक्षसाम् ॥
data.es: "Dreadful warriors, Bears, monkeys, and Rakshasas will be slain, and I foresee that which bodes destruction of people."
data.anv: लोकक्षयकरम् that which bodes destruction to the people, भीमम् dreadful, प्रवीराणाम् for the warriors, ऋक्षवानररक्षसाम् Bears, monkeys and Rakshasas, निबर्हणम् will be slain, भयम् fear, उपस्थितम् will happen, पश्यामि I foresee.
data.md: Mighty is the fear that I see at hand, boding destruction to people and the slaughter of the foremost heroes of bears, monkeys and Rākşasas.

data.v: वाताश्च परुषं वान्ति कम्पते च वसुंधरा । पर्वताग्राणि वेपन्ते पतन्ति धरणीधराः ॥
data.es: "The wind is blowing mixed with dust, even the earth is cracking, mountain tops are shaking, and huge trees are breaking and falling down."
data.anv: वाताः wind, कलुषाः mixed with dust is blowing, वान्ति cracking, वसुन्धराच even the earth, कम्पते shaking, पर्वताग्राणि mountain tops, वेपन्ते breaking, महीरुहाः huge trees, पतन्तिच and falling down.
data.md: The wind blow darkly, and the Earth shake. The tops of the mountains tremble, and trees topple down.

data.v: मेघाः क्रव्यादसंकाशाः परुषाः परुषस्वनाः । क्रूराः क्रूरं प्रवर्षन्ति मिश्रं शोणितबिन्दुभिः ॥
data.es: "Clouds resembling raw flesh in colour, are making harsh frightening sounds, and rain mixed with drops of blood."
data.anv: क्रव्यादसङ्काशाः clouds resembling raw flesh in colour, परुषाः harsh, परुषस्वनाः in harsh tone, क्रूराः cruel, मेघाः clouds, क्रूरम् frightening, शोणितबिन्दुभिः even drops of blood, मिश्रम् mixed, प्रवर्षन्ति raining.
data.md: The clouds are ashen and roistering, and roar roughly. And lowering, they shower portentous drops of blood.

data.v: रक्तचन्दनसंकाशा संध्यापरमदारुणा । ज्वलच्च निपतत्येतदादित्यादग्निमण्डलम् ॥
data.es: "The twilight in red sandal colour is very frightening. The Sun is blazing, raining masses of fire in variegated colours."
data.anv: रक्तचन्दनसङ्काशा like red sandal, सन्ध्या twilight, परमदारुणा very frightening, ज्वलतः blazing, आदित्यात् from the Sun, एतत of variegated colours, अग्निमण्डलम् , masses of fire प्रपतति raining.
data.md: The twilight is terrible and look like the red sandal. And a fiery circle dropped from the flaming sun.

data.v: आदित्यमभिवाश्यन्ते जनयन्तो महद्भयम् । दीना दीनस्वरा घोरा अप्रशस्ता मृगद्विजाः ॥
data.es: "The desperate inauspicious sounds of ominous beasts crying pitifully facing the sun are causing great fear."
data.anv: दीनाः desperate, दीनस्वराः crying pitifully, घोराः dreadful, नप्रशस्ताः inauspicious, मृगद्विजाः ominous beasts, महत् great, भयम् fear, जनयन्तः creating, आदित्यम् from Sun, अभिवाश्यन्ति facing the Sun.
data.md: And exciting great fear, inauspicious birds and beasts, wearing cruel looks, and in distressful guise, cry in piteous accents, facing the Sun.

data.v: रजन्यामप्रकाशश्च संतापयति चन्द्रमाः । कृष्णरक्तांशुपर्यन्तो यथा लोकस्य संक्षये ॥
data.es: "The moon devoid of glow even in the night is like the Sun with black rays around and red aura behind (the black)."
data.anv: लोकक्षये at the time of dissolution of the universe, उदितइव like the Sun, कृष्णरक्तांशपर्यन्तः with black rays around and red rays behind, चन्द्रमाः moon, रजन्याम् in the night, अप्रकाशः devoid of glow, सन्तापयति causing sorrow.
data.md: The Moon, although not appearing* in the night, burns, and with dark and red rays rises, as if it intended to exterminate people. *The moon, it seems appear, but does not look out clearly.

data.v: ह्रस्वो रूक्षोऽप्रशस्तश्च परिवेषः सुलोहितः । आदित्यमण्डले नीलं लक्ष्म लक्ष्मण दृश्यते ॥
data.es: "Lakshmana the white Sun is appearing in copper colour around with black colour in the centre which had not been seen before. It is small and dreary."
data.anv: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, विमले white, आदित्ये Sun, ह्रस्वः becoming small, रूक्षः dreary, अप्रशस्तः that which had not been seen before, लोहितः copper coloured, परिवेषः around, नीलम् black, लक्ष्म in the centre, दृश्यते appears.
data.md: The aspect (of the sun) is slight, rough, and good;* and, O Lakşmaņa, a blue mark is visible on the unclouded Sun. *Prasasta-I do not see the propriety of this epithet in this connection. This may be a mistake.

data.v: दृश्यन्ते न यथावच्च नक्षत्राण्यभिवर्तते । युगान्तमिव लोकस्य पश्य लक्ष्मण शंसति ॥
data.es: "Just as the spots on the moon, the stars are also dirty and not visible. It forebodes the end of the universe Lakshmana!"
data.anv: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, नक्षत्राणि even stars, यथावत् so also, नदृश्यन्ते not visible, लोकस्य in the universe, युगान्तम् end of the universe, शंसतीव spots on the moon, अभिवर्तते dirty, पश्य seen.
data.md: The stars do not course as formerly. Behold, O Laksmana, all these, prefiguring the Doom.

data.v: काकाः श्येनास्तथा गृध्रा नीचैः परिपतन्ति च । शिवाश्चाप्यशिवा वाचः प्रवदन्ति महास्वनाः ॥
data.es: "The crows, hawks and eagles are falling down like small animals. Also, the jackals are creating fear by making howls."
data.anv: काकाः crows, श्येनाः hawks, ततागृध्राः likewise eagles, नीचाः small, परिपतन्ति falling down, शिवाश्चापि also jackals, महाभयान् great fear, अशिवान् creating, नादान् howls, नदन्ति making.
data.md: Crows, and hawks, and the inferior vultures, wheel all round. And jackals are sending inauspicious yells, exciting great fear.

data.v: क्षिप्रमद्य दुराधर्षां पुरीं रावणपालिताम् । अभियाम जवेनैव सर्वतो हरिभिर्वृताः ॥
data.es: All the Vanaras turning their direction will go immediately and now itself, swiftly to the city ruled by Ravana (said Rama to Lakshmana).
data.anv: सर्वैः all, हरिभिः Vanaras, आवृताः turning direction, अद्यैव now itself, क्षिप्रम् immediately, जवेनैव swiftly, रावणपालिताम् ruled by Ravana, पुरीम् city, अभियाम will go.
data.md: Surrounded by all the monkeys, will we, using speed, this very day rapidly enter into the city ruled by Ravana, incapable of being subdued.

data.v: इत्येवं तु वदन्वीरो लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः । तस्मादवातरच्छीघ्रं पर्वताग्रान्महाबलः ॥
data.es: Mighty hero Rama, (the elder brother of Lakshmana) said to Lakshmana in this manner (as described earlier) and descended from the peak of the mountain without delay.
data.anv: वीरः hero, महाबलः mighty, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः Lakshmana's elder brother, इत्येवम् in this manner, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, वदन् said, तस्मात् from there, पर्वताग्रात् peak of the mountain, शीघ्रम् without delay, अवातरत् descended.
data.md: Having said this to Laksmana, Laksmana's elder brother possessed of exceeding strength, hastily descended from the top of the mountain.

data.v: अवतीर्य तु धर्मात्मा तस्माच्छैलात्स राघवः । परैः परमदुर्धर्षं ददर्श बलमात्मनः ॥
data.es: Climbing down the mountain, the righteous Rama reviewed in his mind the strength of his army and the enemy which is difficult to assail.
data.anv: धर्मात्माच righteous, सःराघवः that Raghava, तस्मात् शैलात् from the mountain, अवतीर्य climbing down, परैः foes, परमदुर्धर्षम् very difficult to assail, आत्मनः in the mind, बलम् army strength, ददर्श reviewed.
data.md: And descending from the mountain, the righteous Rāghava surveyed his troops, incapable of being beaten by enemies.

data.v: संनह्य तु ससुग्रीवः कपिराजबलं महत् । कालज्ञो राघवः काले संयुगायाभ्यचोदयत् ॥
data.es: Raghava, who is knowledgeable of when to do what, motivated the army of Vanaras and Sugriva and ordered.
data.anv: ससुग्रीवः Sugriva, कालज्ञः knower of when to do, राघवः Raghava, महत् great, कपिराजबलम् army of Vanaras, सन्नह्य ready, काले time, संयुगाय motivated, अभ्यचोदयत् ordered.
data.md: After making the mighty host of the monkeysking equip itself, Raghava versed in season, along with Sugrīva, at the proper hour, issued orders for battle.

data.v: ततः काले महाबाहुर्बलेन महता वृतः । प्रस्थितः पुरतो धन्वी लङ्कामभिमुखः पुरीम् ॥
data.es: Surrounded by a large army in front, the broad shouldered Rama proceeded towards Lanka.
data.anv: ततः then, महाबाहुः broad shouldered, महता great, बलेन army, वृतः surrounded by, पुरतः in front, धवनी early morning, काले time, लङ्कांपुरीं Lanka, अभिमुखः towards, प्रस्थितः proceeded.
data.md: Then in due time that one, accoutred with his bow, surrounded by a mighty army, set out, with the intention of entering the city of Lanka.

data.v: तं विभीषण सुग्रीवौ हनूमाञ्जाम्बवान्नलः । ऋक्षराजस्तथा नीलो लक्ष्मणश्चान्ययुस्तदा ॥
data.es: Then Vibheeshana, Sugriva, Hanuman, Jambavan, Nala, Neela in the same way Lakshmana followed.
data.anv: तदा then, विभीषणसुग्रीवौ Vibheeshana and Sugriva, हनुमान् Hanuman, ऋक्षराजः king of Bears, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, नलः Nala, तथा in the same way, नीलः Neela, लक्ष्मणश्च and Lakshmana, तम् them, अन्वयुः followed.
data.md: Those two-Vibhisana and Sugriva-~-and Hanumān, and jāmbavăn, and Nala, and the bear-king Nila, and Laksmana, followed (Rama).

data.v: ततः पश्चात्सुमहती पृतनर्क्षवनौकसाम् । प्रच्छाद्य महतीं भूमिमनुयाति स्म राघवम् ॥
data.es: Then the bears, monkeys, covering all over the land went behind Rama.
data.anv: ततः then, ऋक्षवनौकसाम् bears and monkeys, महती great, पृतना land महतीम् all over, भूमिम् land, प्रच्छाद्य covering, राघवम् Rama, अनुयातिस्म followed पशचात्सु behind.
data.md: Behind them, the mighty array of bears and monkeys followed Rāghava, severing a wide surface of land.

data.v: शैलशृङ्गाणि शतशः प्रवृद्धांश्च महीरुहाम् । जगृहुः कुञ्जरप्रख्या वानराः परवारणाः ॥
data.es: The monkeys who were of the size of elephants capable of warding off the enemy, bore huge grown up trees in their hands and went.
data.anv: परवारणाः capable of warding off the enemy, कुञ्जरप्रख्याः whose body were the size of elephants, वानराः monkeys, शैलशृङ्गाणि mountain peaks, प्रवृद्धान् fully grown, शतशः in hundreds, महीरुहान् huge trees, जगृहुः bore in their hands.
data.md: The monkeys, resembling elephants, capable of resisting foes, took mountain-peaks and tall trees by hundreds.

data.v: तौ त्वदीर्घेण कालेन भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । रावणस्य पुरीं लङ्कामासेदतुररिंदमौ ॥
data.es: In a short while the two brothers Rama and Lakshmana, tamers of foes reached the city of Lanka.
data.anv: अरिन्दमौ tamers of foes, भ्रातरौ the two brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, अदीर्घेण in a short, कालेन time, रावणस्य Ravana's, पुरीम् city, लङ्काम् of Lanka, आसेदतुः reached.
data.md: In a short time those repressors of foes— two brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa-arrived at the city of Răvaņa; with pennons streaming over her; charming; garnished with groves and woods, having variegated gateways; inaccessible; and having walls and gates.

data.v: पताकामालिनीं रम्यामुद्यानवनशोभिताम् । चित्रवप्रां सुदुष्प्रापामुच्चप्राकारतोरणाम् ॥
data.es: Commanded by Rama's words the Vanaras remaining in their positions as ordained, entered the wonderful Lanka, which was decorated with flags, embellished with gardens. The defensive walls and arches of the boundary of Lanka were difficult to access even for Devatas.
data.anv: रामवाक्यप्रचोदिताः commanded by Rama's words, वनौकसः gardens, पताकामालिनीम् decorated with flags, रम्याम् beautiful to look at, उद्यानवनशोभिताम् embellished with gardens, चित्रवस्राम् wonderful, सुदुष्प्रापाम् defensive walls, उच्चैः tall प्राकारतोरणाम् archways of boundary, सुरैरपि even for Devatas, दुर्धर्षाम् difficult to access, ताम् they, यथानिदेशम् as ordained, सम्पीड्य remaining, न्यविशन्त entered.
data.md: In a short time those repressors of foes— two brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa-arrived at the city of Răvaņa; with pennons streaming over her; charming; garnished with groves and woods, having variegated gateways; inaccessible; and having walls and gates.

data.v: तां सुरैरपि दुर्धर्षां रामवाक्यप्रचोदिताः । यथानिदेशं संपीड्य न्यविशन्त वनौकसः ॥
data.es: Commanded by Rama's words the Vanaras remaining in their positions as ordained, entered the wonderful Lanka, which was decorated with flags, embellished with gardens. The defensive walls and arches of the boundary of Lanka were difficult to access even for Devatas.
data.anv: रामवाक्यप्रचोदिताः commanded by Rama's words, वनौकसः gardens, पताकामालिनीम् decorated with flags, रम्याम् beautiful to look at, उद्यानवनशोभिताम् embellished with gardens, चित्रवस्राम् wonderful, सुदुष्प्रापाम् defensive walls, उच्चैः tall प्राकारतोरणाम् archways of boundary, सुरैरपि even for Devatas, दुर्धर्षाम् difficult to access, ताम् they, यथानिदेशम् as ordained, सम्पीड्य remaining, न्यविशन्त entered.
data.md: And urged on by Rāma's command, the wood-raingers,* as commanded, blocking up (Lankā) incapable of being subdued even by the gods, stationed themselves. *Monkeys.

data.v: लङ्कायास्तूत्तरद्वारं शैलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम् । रामः सहानुजो धन्वी जुगोप च रुरोध च ॥
data.es: Accompanied by his brother Lakshmana, Rama, armed with bow, blocked the northern gate of Lanka which was like a lofty mountain peak and protected.
data.anv: सहानुजः accompanied by his brother, रामः Rama, धन्वी armed with bow, लङ्कायाः into Lanka, शैलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम् like a lofty mountain peak, तम् that, उत्तरद्वारम् northern gate, जुगोप blocked, रुरोधच protected.

data.v: लङ्कामुपनिविष्टश्च रामो दशरथात्मजः । लक्ष्मणानुचरो वीरः पुरीं रावणपालिताम् ॥
उत्तरद्वारमासाद्य यत्र तिष्ठति रावणः । नान्यो रामाद्धि तद्द्वारं समर्थः परिरक्षितुम् ॥
रावणाधिष्ठितं भीमं वरुणेनेव सागरम् । सायुधौ राक्षसैर्भीमैरभिगुप्तं समन्ततः । लघूनां त्रासजननं पातालमिव दानवैः ॥
विन्यस्तानि च योधानां बहूनि विविधानि च । ददर्शायुधजालानि तथैव कवचानि च ॥
data.es: Rama Saw there, numerous weapons of every kind so also shields for the combatants of war.
data.anv: योधानाम् for the combatants of war, विन्यस्तानि of every kind, बहूनि numerous, विविधानिच and different kind, आयुधजालानि weapons, तथैव so also, कवचानिच and shields, ददर्श saw.

data.v: पूर्वं तु द्वारमासाद्य नीलो हरिचमूपतिः । अतिष्ठत्सह मैन्देन द्विविदेन च वीर्यवान् ॥
data.es: Neela the commanderinchief of the army of monkeys, a valiant one, also Dwivida, and Mainda reached the east gate and remained there.
data.anv: हरिचमूपतिः commander of the army of monkeys, वीर्यवान् valiant one, नीलः Neela, मैन्देन Mainda सह and also, द्विविदेनचसह Dwivida also, पूर्वंद्वारम् east gate, आसाद्य reached, अतिष्ठत् remained there.
data.md: And coming to the Eastern gate, that leader of the monkeys-army, the powerful Nila, along with Mainda and Dvivida, took up his post there.

data.v: अङ्गदो दक्षिणद्वारं जग्राह सुमहाबलः । ऋषभेण गवाक्षेण गजेन गवयेन च ॥
data.es: Angada endowed with great prowess along with Rshaba, Gavaksha, Gaja, and Gavaya reached the south gate.
data.anv: सुमहाबलः of great prowess, अङ्गदः Angada, ऋषभेण with Rshaba, गवाक्षेण and Gavaksha, गजेन Gaja, गवयेनच and Gavaya, दक्षिणद्वारम् south gate, जग्राह reached.
data.md: The exceedingly strong Angada, accompanied by Risabha, Gavaksa, Gaya, and Gavaya, occupied the Southern gate. And the mighty monkey Hanumān protected the Western entrance.

data.v: हनूमान्पश्चिमद्वारं ररक्ष बलवान्कपिः । प्रमाथि प्रघसाभ्यां च वीरैरन्यैश्च संगतः ॥
data.es: Mighty monkey Hanuman united with heroes Pramati and Praghasa and others protected the west gate.
data.anv: बलवान् mighty, कपिः monkey, हनुमान् Hanuman, प्रमाथिप्रषुभ्यांच Pramati and Praghasa, अन्यैः and others, वीरैश्च heroes, सङ्गतः united with, पश्चिमद्वारम् west gate, ररक्ष protected.

data.v: मध्यमे च स्वयं गुल्मे सुग्रीवः समतिष्ठत । सह सर्वैर्हरिश्रेष्ठैः सुपर्णश्वसनोपमैः ॥
data.es: Sugriva chief of all army and best of the monkey army who was equal to Garuda of beautiful wings, endowed with wind speed remained in the middle (of north and west) post.
data.anv: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, सर्वैः all, सुपर्णश्वसनोपमैः equal to Garuda of beautiful wings endowed with wind speed, हरिश्रेष्ठैः chief and best of monkey army, स्वयम् himself, मध्यमे middle, गुल्मे post, समतिष्ठत remained.

data.v: वानराणां तु षट्त्रिंशत्कोट्यः प्रख्यातयूथपाः । निपीड्योपनिविष्टाश्च सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः ॥
data.es: Renowned generals of the Vanara army and thirtysix crores of Vanaras stood there camping.
data.anv: प्रख्यातयूथपाः renowned generals, वानराणाम् of the Vanaras, षटित्रंशत्कोट्यः thirty six crores, वानरः Vanara, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, यत्र there, निपीड्य stood, उपनिविष्टाः camped.
data.md: And accompanied by all the foremost monkeys resembling Suparņa or the Wind, twenty kotis of renowned monkey-leaders, blocking up all sides, stationed themselves near the monkeys, Sugriva.

data.v: शासनेन तु रामस्य लक्ष्मणः सविभीषणः । द्वारे द्वारे हरीणां तु कोटिं कोटिं न्यवेशयत् ॥
data.es: By the command of Rama, Vibheeshana accompanied by Lakshmana posted crores and crores of Vanaras there.
data.anv: सविभीषणः Vibheeshana, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, रामस्य by Rama's, शासनेन command, द्वारेद्वारे crores and crores, हरीणाम् Vanaras, कोटिंकोटिम् crores and crores, न्यवेशयत् posted as per need.
data.md: At Rama's command, Laksmana along with Vibhisana, went from door to door, issuing instructions to kotis of monkeys.

data.v: पश्चिमेन तु रामस्य सुग्रीवः सह जाम्बवान् । अदूरान्मध्यमे गुल्मे तस्थौ बहुबलानुगः ॥
data.es: Sushena along with Jambavan and a large army of Vanaras were posted in the centre not far from Rama at the west by Rama's order.
data.anv: सुषेणः Sushena, सहजाम्बवान् along with Jambavan, बहुबलानुगः with large army, रामस्य by Rama, पश्चिमेन at the west, अदूरात् not far from, मध्यमेगुल्मे in the centre, तस्थौ at the back.
data.md: On the west of Rāma, Jāmbavän along with Susena, followed by innumerable troops, remained hard by at the garrison in the minddle.

data.v: ते तु वानरशार्दूलाः शार्दूला इव दंष्ट्रिणः । गृहीत्वा द्रुमशैलाग्रान्हृष्टा युद्धाय तस्थिरे ॥
data.es: Vanaras who resembled tigers, endowed with sharp teeth joyfully stood there holding trees and peaks of mountain waiting to combat.
data.anv: शार्दूलाःइव resembling tiger, दंष्ट्रिणः endowed with sharp teeth, ते they, वानरशार्दूलाः tigers among Vanaras, हृष्टाः joyfully, द्रुमशैलाग्रान् trees and peaks of mountains, गृहीत्वा holding, युद्धाय to combat, तस्थिरे waited.
data.md: And those tiger-like monkeys, furnished with teeth like to tigers, wielding trees and mountaintops, stood ready for fight.

data.v: सर्वे विकृतलाङ्गूलाः सर्वे दंष्ट्रानखायुधाः । सर्वे विकृतचित्राङ्गाः सर्वे च विकृताननाः ॥
data.es: All had their tails lifted unusually, had their nails and teeth sharp as weapons, some had unnatural face, and all of them had distorted eyes (as in fury).
data.anv: सर्वे all, विकृतालाङ्गूलाः unusually lifted up, सर्वे all, दंष्ट्रानखायुधा: had their teeth and nails as weapons, सर्वे all, विकृतचित्राङ्गाः unnatural faces, सर्वेच and all, विकृताननाः distorted eyes.
data.md: All had their tails curled up, and all were armed with teeth and nails, and all had chequered bodies, and all had frightful faces.

data.v: दशनागबलाः केचित्केचिद्दशगुणोत्तराः । केचिन्नागसहस्रस्य बभूवुस्तुल्यविक्रमाः ॥
data.es: A few of them were having the strength of ten elephants, some had ten times more than others, and a few were endowed with great strength equal to thousand elephants.
data.anv: केचित् a few, दशनागबलाः strength of ten elephants, केचित् some, दशगुणोत्तराः ten times more strong than others, केचित् a few, नागसहस्रस्य equal to thousand elephants in strength, तुल्यविक्रमाः endowed with great strength, बभूवुः were.
data.md: Some had the strength of ten elephants; and some had strength ten times as much; and some of the monkeys-leaders there had the strength of a thousand elephants.

data.v: सन्ति चौघा बलाः केचित्केचिच्छतगुणोत्तराः । अप्रमेयबलाश्चान्ये तत्रासन्हरियूथपाः ॥
data.es: Few monkeys had strength of an ogha, some had a hundred times more, and the monkey commanders possessed immeasurable strength.
data.anv: केचित् few, ओघबलाः strength of an ogha, केचित् some, शतगुणोत्तराः hundred times more, सन्ति still, तत्र there, अन्ये others, हरियूथपाः monkey commanders, अप्रमेयाबलाश्च immeasurable strength, आसन् possessed.
data.md: Some had the strength of numbers (of elephants); and some had strength hundred times as much. And others had immeasurable might.

data.v: अद्भुतश्च विचित्रश्च तेषामासीत्समागमः । तत्र वानरसैन्यानां शलभानामिवोद्गमः ॥
data.es: There it seemed as if a flight of locusts had gathered, with monkey army gathered there. It was amazing and astonishing.
data.anv: तत्र there, शलभानाम् in that place, उद्यमःइव like locusts, तेषाम् they, वानरसैन्यानाम् Vanara army, समागमः gathered, अद्भुतश्च amazing, विचित्रश्च astonishing, आसीत् seemed.
data.md: And wonderful and astonishing was their meeting. And the concourse at that place of the monkey-forces was like the concourse of locusts.

data.v: परिपूर्णमिवाकाशं संछन्नेव च मेदिनी । लङ्कामुपनिविष्टैश्च संपतद्भिश्च वानरैः ॥
data.es: Vanaras settled in such a way all around Lanka completely covering the land with those already at Lanka.
data.anv: लङ्काम् in Lanka, उपनिविष्टैः settled, वानरैः with Vanara, सम्पतद्भिश्च already staying, आकाशम् the sky, प्रतिपूर्णमिव fully around like, मेदिनीच on the land, सञ्छन्ने covering.
data.md: The air was filled up, and the earth was covered quite with the monkeys coursing towards Lankā and dropping down into it.

data.v: शतं शतसहस्राणां पृथगृक्षवनौकसाम् । लङ्का द्वाराण्युपाजग्मुरन्ये योद्धुं समन्ततः ॥
data.es: A hundred thousand bars and monkeys and several others already gathered at the gates of Lanka to fight proceeded.
data.anv: ऋक्षवनौकसाम् bears and monkeys, शतसहस्राणाम् a hundred thousand, शतम् a hundred, पृथक् several, अन्ये others, समन्ततः gathered, लङ्काद्वाराणि at the gates of Lanka, योद्धुम् to fight, उपाजग्मुः proceeded.
data.md: And hundreds and thousands making up the army of monkeys, arrived at the gate of Lanka; while others were pouring in from all sides for encounter.

data.v: आवृतः स गिरिः सर्वैस्तैः समन्तात्प्लवंगमैः । अयुतानां सहस्रं च पुरीं तामभ्यवर्तत ॥
data.es: All over the mountain the monkeys surrounded the boundary wall of Lanka city to collect information.
data.anv: सःगिरिः that mountain, समन्तात् all over, तैः those, प्लवङ्गमैः monkeys, आवृतः surrounded, अयुतानाम् boundary, सहस्रम् all over, ताम् them, पुरीम् city, अभ्यवर्तत to collect information.
data.md: That mount was covered with monkeys by all sides and a thousand ayutas were going round the city.

data.v: वानरैर्बलवद्भिश्च बभूव द्रुमपाणिभिः । सर्वतः संवृता लङ्का दुष्प्रवेशापि वायुना ॥
data.es: Mighty Vanaras holding uprooted trees occupied everywhere and it seemed difficult for even wind to enter Lanka.
data.anv: द्रुमपाणिभिः with uprooted trees, बलवद्भिः might, वानरैः Vanaras, सर्वतः everywhere, सम्वृता occupied, लङ्का Lanka, वायुनापि even for wind, दुष्प्रवेशा difficult to enter, बभूव appeared.
data.md: And Larkā, blocked up everywhere with powerful monkeys bearing trees in their hands, was incapable of being entered even by the Wind.

data.v: राक्षसा विस्मयं जग्मुः सहसाभिनिपीडिताः । वानरैर्मेघसंकाशैः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः ॥
data.es: Caught by Vanaras like clouds and equalled Indra in valour gave way to wonder for the Rakshasas.
data.anv: मेघसङ्काशैः clouds, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः Indra of great valour, वानरैः Vanaras, सहसा equalled, अभिनिपीडिताः caught, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, विस्मयम् wondered, जग्मुः gave way.
data.md: The Rākşasas, sore pressed by thousands of monkeys resembling masses of clouds, and like to Śakra himself in battle, were seized with amazement.

data.v: महाञ्शब्दोऽभवत्तत्र बलौघस्याभिवर्ततः । सागरस्येव भिन्नस्य यथा स्यात्सलिलस्वनः ॥
data.es: Thereafter with the divisions of the Vanara army moving like the ocean on the mountain peak, appeared like the roaring sound of water in the ocean moving out of boundary.
data.anv: तत्र thereafter, भिन्नस्य divisions, सागरस्येव like the ocean, बलौघस्य on the mountain peak, अभिवर्ततः appeared, सलिलस्वनः roaring sound of water, यथा like that, स्यात् , महान् great, शब्दः sound, अभवत् appeared.
data.md: Like to the roar of water on the ocean being riven, there arose a mighty tumult in consequence of the forces surging hither and thither.

data.v: तेन शब्देन महता सप्राकारा सतोरणा । लङ्का प्रचलिता सर्वा सशैलवनकानना ॥
data.es: By the great sound the boundary, the archways and the mountains and forests shook violently.
data.anv: महता great, तेनशब्देन by that sound, सप्राकारा that boundary, सतोरणा the archways, सशैलवनकानना mountains forests, सर्वा all, लङ्का Lanka, प्रचलिता shook violently.
data.md: With that sound the entire Lankā, with her wall and gateways, her mountains, woods, and forests, began to shake.

data.v: रामलक्ष्मणगुप्ता सा सुग्रीवेण च वाहिनी । बभूव दुर्धर्षतरा सर्वैरपि सुरासुरैः ॥
data.es: "Even if Rama and Lakshmana are protected, and even Sugriva also, the entire army seems formidable like suras and asuras."
data.anv: रामलक्ष्मणगुप्ता even if Rama and Lakshmana are protected, सुग्रीवेणच and Sugriva also, सावाहिनी that ocean of army, सर्वैः entire, सुरासुरैःअपि even suras and asuras, दुर्दर्षतर formidable, बभूव seems.
data.md: That host protected by Rāma, Lakşmaņa and Sugrīva, shall become exceedingly hard to combat even by the Asuras and gods.

data.v: राघवः संनिवेश्यैवं सैन्यं स्वं रक्षसां वधे । संमन्त्र्य मन्त्रिभिः सार्धं निश्चित्य च पुनः पुनः ॥
आनन्तर्यमभिप्रेप्सुः क्रमयोगार्थतत्त्ववित् । विभीषणस्यानुमते राजधर्ममनुस्मरन् । अङ्गदं वालितनयं समाहूयेदमब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Deliberating on the action to be taken to kill the Rakshasas, Raghava himself called the army and gathered them and the ministers all of them again and again discussed and took the decision. Later recalling the king's duty with Vibheeshana, summoned Vali's son Angada and spoke these words.
data.anv: क्रमयोगार्थतत्त्ववित् deliberating the action repeatedly, राघवः Raghava, स्वम् himself, सैन्यम् army, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वधे to kill, एवम् in the same way, संनिवेश्य gathering together, मन्त्रिभिः even ministers सार्थम् all of them, पुनःपुनः again and again, सम्मन्त्ऱ्य discussing, निश्चित्य decision taken, अनन्तर्यम् later, अभिप्रेप्सुः recalling राजधर्मम् king's duty, अनुस्मरन् calling, विभीषणस्य with Vibhishana, अनुमते per mission, वालितनयम् Vali's son, अङ्गदम् Angada, समाहूय summoning, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: Having arraigned his forces with the view of destroying the Räkşasa, Rāghava, versed in the resources of war, taking counsel of the counsellors, and deciding again and again his course of action, intending to adopt further measures, resolved to abide by the advice of Vibhīşaņa, remembering the morality regulating monarchs. And then, calling Vāli's son, Angada, (Rāma) said.

data.v: गत्वा सौम्य दशग्रीवं ब्रूहि मद्वचनात्कपे । लङ्घयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कां भयं त्यक्त्वा गतव्यथः ॥
data.es: "O noble Hanuman crossing over Lanka without fear, giving up the difficulties experienced earlier we reached. Admonish the tenheaded king who has lost senses, his past fortune and sovereignty."
data.anv: सौम्य noble, कपे monkey, लङ्कांपुरीम् Lanka's, लङ्घयित्वा crossing over, भयम् fear, त्यक्त्वा giving up, गतव्यधः past difficulty, भ्रष्टश्रीक lost sovereignty, गतैश्वर्य fallen out of past fortune, मुमूर्षोनष्टचेतनः lost his sense, दशग्रीवम् tenheaded king, गत्वा gone, मद्वचनात् proudly, ब्रूहि said.
data.md: O mild one, going to the Ten-necked one, tell him in my words, Bounding over the deep and casting off fear and dejection, I have laid siege to the city of Lankā; and have reft you of your prosperity and your wealth; and rendered you moribund and senseless.

data.v: भ्रष्टश्रीकगतैश्वर्यमुमूर्षो नष्टचेतनः । ऋषीणां देवतानां च गन्धर्वाप्सरसां तथा ॥
नागानामथ यक्षाणां राज्ञां च रजनीचर । यच्च पापं कृतं मोहादवलिप्तेन राक्षस ॥
नूनमद्य गतो दर्पः स्वयम्भू वरदानजः । यस्य दण्डधरस्तेऽहं दाराहरणकर्शितः । दण्डं धारयमाणस्तु लङ्काद्वरे व्यवस्थितः ॥
data.es: "You, who have abducted my wife, I will punish you with a rod of punishment. I am your chastiser, O king of Lanka I have taken position."
data.anv: दाराहरणकर्शितः one who has abducted my wife, अहम् I am, तस्य your, ते to you, दण्डधरः holding rod दण्डम् punish, धारयामाणः chastiser, लङ्काद्वारे o king of Lanka, व्यवस्थितः taken position.

data.v: पदवीं देवतानां च महर्षीणां च राक्षस । राजर्षीणां च सर्वेषां गमिष्यसि मया हतः ॥
data.es: "O Rakshasa! Even Devatas, sages and even royal sages have also lost their lives, killed by me."
data.anv: राक्षस Rakshasa, मया by me, हतः killed, देवतानांच even Devatas, महर्षीणांच even sages, सर्वेषाम् all of them, राजर्षीणांच royal sages, पदवीम् position, गमिष्यसि lost.
data.md: O Rākşasa, you shall, remaining steady in fight, attain the state of celestials and Maharsis and Rājarşis.

data.v: बलेन येन वै सीतां मायया राक्षसाधम । मामतिक्रामयित्वा त्वं हृतवांस्तद्विदर्शय ॥
data.es: "O lowly Rakshasa! By deceiving me you took away Sita. Display that strength now."
data.anv: राक्षसाधम lowly Rakshasa, त्वम् your, येन that, बलेन power, मायया to me, माम् me, अतिक्रामयित्वा by deceiving me, सीताम् Sita, हृतवान् took away, तत् that, द्विदर्शय display it now.
data.md: O worst of Rākşasas, do you display that prowess of your by which, aided by your power of illusion, you have forcible carried off Sītā, disregarding me.

data.v: अराक्षसमिमं लोकं कर्तास्मि निशितैः शरैः । न चेच्छरणमभ्येषि मामुपादाय मैथिलीम् ॥
data.es: "If you do not seek my protection I will devoid this world of Rakshasas with my sharp arrows."
data.anv: ताम् her, मैथिलीम् Mythili, आदाय seek, शरणम् my protection, नअभ्येषियदि if not take, निशितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, इमम् this, लोकम् world, अराक्षसम् devoid of Rakshasas, कर्तास्मि will make.
data.md: I shall with my sharpened shafts render this world free from Rākşasas, unless rendering back Mitbila's daughter, you throw yourself on my mercy.

data.v: धर्मात्मा रक्षसां श्रेष्ठः संप्राप्तोऽयं विभीषणः । लङ्कैश्वर्यं ध्रुवं श्रीमानयं प्राप्नोत्यकण्टकम् ॥
data.es: "This Vibheeshana, the best of Rakshasas will be glorious and fortunate undoubtedly having got the kingdom of Lanka."
data.anv: धर्मात्मा righteous, राक्षसश्रेष्ठः best of Rakshasas, अयंविभीषणः this Vibhishana, सम्प्राप्तः having got, श्रीमान् fortunate, अकण्डकम् glorious, धृवम् undoubtedly, लङ्कैश्वर्यम् kingdom of Lanka, प्राप्नोति will get.
data.md: And, for certain, that foremost of Rākşasas, the righteous and graceful Vibhīşaņa, who has joined us, shall obtain, without having a thorn in his side, all this wealth of Lankā.

data.v: न हि राज्यमधर्मेण भोक्तुं क्षणमपि त्वया । शक्यं मूर्खसहायेन पापेनाविजितात्मना ॥
data.es: "One who is not aware of himself, an unrighteous sinner ruling with foolish mates cannot enjoy the kingdom even for a moment."
data.anv: मूर्खसहायेन with the help of foolish mates, पापेन a sinner, अविदितात्मना not aware of himself, त्वया by you, क्षणमपि even a moment, राज्यम् kingdom, अथर्मेण unrighteousness, भोक्तुम् to enjoy, नशक्यंहि not possible.
data.md: For you, foolish, wicked, ignorant of selfknowledge, and having dolts for councillors, are not competent to unrighteously exercise kingship for a moment.

data.v: युध्यस्व वा धृतिं कृत्वा शौर्यमालम्ब्य राक्षस । मच्छरैस्त्वं रणे शान्तस्ततः पूतो भविष्यसि ॥
data.es: "O Rakshasa! You are resorting to fortitude and valour and embracing gallantry in war. By my arrows you will obtain peace (in death)."
data.anv: राक्षस Rakshasa, वा or, धृतिम् fortitude, कृत्वा resorting to, शौर्यम् valour, आलम्ब्य embracing, युध्यस्व gallantry, त्वम् you, रणे in war, मच्छरैः my arrows, शान्तः peace, ततः then, भविष्यसि will obtain.
data.md: Fight you, O Rāksasa, summoning fortitude and heroism. On being slain with my shafts, you shall attain peace.

data.v: यद्याविशसि लोकांस्त्रीन्पक्षिभूतो मनोजवः । मम चक्षुष्पथं प्राप्य न जीवन्प्रतियास्यसि ॥
data.es: "O Ravana! You have no control over your mind, and if you come in the range of my eyesight and enter the three worlds also you will not go alive again."
data.anv: मनोजवः one who has no control over mind, मम my, चक्षुःपथम् range of my eyesight, प्राप्य having come in, पक्षी bird, भूत्वा range, त्रीन् three, लोकान् worlds, अविशसि entering, जीवन् with life, नप्रतियास्यसि not go alive again.
data.md: O night-ranger, if you should range the three worlds in the shape of a bird, you, coming in my ken, shall not be able to preserve your life.

data.v: ब्रवीमि त्वां हितं वाक्यं क्रियतामौर्ध्वदेकिकम् । सुदृष्टा क्रियतां लङ्का जीवितं ते मयि स्थितम् ॥
data.es: Having addressed it in well meaning words, Rama said 'I will do you obsequies as no one will be left in Lanka to do your last rites'.
data.anv: त्वाम् these, हितम् well meaning, वाक्यम् words, ब्रवीमि having spoken, और्ध्वहिकम् obsequies, क्रियताम् to do, लङ्का in Lanka, सुदृष्टा to do the last rites, क्रियताम् do तेजीवितम् for your life, मयि I, स्थितम् will do.
data.md: It is all this for your good; do you perform acts for the good of your body surviving death; and do you see Lankā well; for your life is in my keeping.

data.v: इत्युक्तः स तु तारेयो रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । जगामाकाशमाविश्य मूर्तिमानिव हव्यवाट् ॥
data.es: Rama having spoken that way, Tara's son, Angada, who was like fire god, who was unwearied in action flew to the sky.
data.anv: अक्लिष्टकर्मणा unwearied in action, रामेण by Rama, इति this way, उक्तः spoken, तारेयः Tara's son, मूर्तिमान् resembled, हव्यवाट् इव like fire, आकाशम् sky, आविश्य flew, जगाम went.
data.md: Thus addressed by Rāma of untiring deeds, Tara's son went through the welkin like the embodied bearer of sacrificial offerings.

data.v: सोऽतिपत्य मुहूर्तेन श्रीमान्रावणमन्दिरम् । ददर्शासीनमव्यग्रं रावणं सचिवैः सह ॥
data.es: Angada landed on Ravana's palace in a moment and saw the tiger like prosperous Ravana seated with his ministers.
data.anv: श्रीमान् prosperous, सः that he, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, रावणमन्दिरम् Ravana's palace, अतिपत्य having landed, सचिवैःसह with his ministers, आसीनम् seated, रावणम् Ravana, अव्यग्रम् tiger, ददर्श saw.
data.md: Arriving near that subduer of enemies, Rāvana, in a moment, that graceful one saw Rāvana, sitting calmly in the midst of his ministers.

data.v: ततस्तस्याविदूरेण निपत्य हरिपुंगवः । दीप्ताग्निसदृशस्तस्थावङ्गदः कनकाङ्गदः ॥
data.es: Thereafter, the leader of the monkeys, Angada adorned with golden armlets stood like a blazing fire at a distance.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, सहरिपुङ्गवः that leader of monkeys, दीप्ताग्निसदृशः blazing like fire, कनकाङ्गदः adorned with golden armlets, अङ्गदः Angada, तस्य his, अविदूरेण at a short distance, निपत्य landed, तस्थौ stood.
data.md: And dropping down in his vicinity like a flaming fire, that best of monkeys, Augada, resembling a golden bracelet, stood there.

data.v: तद्रामवचनं सर्वमन्यूनाधिकमुत्तमम् । सामात्यं श्रावयामास निवेद्यात्मानमात्मना ॥
data.es: "I made known the words of Rama completely without adding or deleting. You may listen."
data.anv: आत्मानम् I am, आत्मना myself, निवेद्य known, तत् that, उत्तमम् best, सर्वम् all, रामवचनम् Rama's words, अन्यूनाधिकम् without adding or deleting, सामात्यम् completely, श्रावयामास you may listen.
data.md: Then introducing himself, Angada delivered to Rāvana along with his ministers all that Rama had excellently spoken to him, neither extenuating nor setting down aught of himself.

data.v: दूतोऽहं कोसलेन्द्रस्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । वालिपुत्रोऽङ्गदो नाम यदि ते श्रोत्रमागतः ॥
data.es: "I am the son of Vali,by name Angada,an envoy of Rama ,the king of Kosala of unwearied action. You may know that I have landed"
data.anv: वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, अङ्गदोनाम by name Angada, अहम् I am, कोशलेन्द्रस्य Kosala King's, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः unwearied in action, रामस्य Rama's, दूतः envoy, ते to you, श्रोत्रम् land, आगतःयदि have landed.
data.md: I am the envoy of the king of Kosala, Rāma of untiring deeds; and I am the son of Vāli I do not know whether you have heard of me.

data.v: आह त्वां राघवो रामः कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः । निष्पत्य प्रतियुध्यस्व नृशंसं पुरुषाधम ॥
data.es: "Raghava, the enhancer of the happiness of Kausalya speaks to you. Ruthless Rakshasa! Sallying forth, get ready for combat."
data.anv: राघवः Raghava, कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः enhancer of happiness of Kausalya (Rama), रामः Rama, त्वाम् to you, आह you, नृशंस ruthless, निष्पत्य sallying forth, युध्यस्व in combat, पुरुषः man, भव to me.
data.md: Raghu's son, Rāma-enhancer of Kausaiya's joy-has said to you, 'Do you, O fell one, coming out, give me battle and prove your prowess.

data.v: हन्तास्मि त्वां सहामात्यं सपुत्रज्ञातिबान्धवम् । निरुद्विग्नास्त्रयो लोका भविष्यन्ति हते त्वयि ॥
data.es: "You and your son's relatives and followers being killed (by me) the three worlds will be rid of fear of you."
data.anv: सहामात्यम् along with ministers, सपुत्रज्ञातिबान्धवम् sons, relatives and followers, त्वाम् you, हन्तास्मि been killed, त्वयि of you, हते killed, त्रयः three, लोकाः worlds, निरुद्विग्नाः rid of fear, भविष्यन्ति will become.
data.md: I shall slay you together with your ministers, and with your sons and relations and friends. And you being slain, the three worlds shall attain peace.

data.v: देवदानवयक्षाणां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् । शत्रुमद्योद्धरिष्यामि त्वामृषीणां च कण्टकम् ॥
data.es: "You are an enemy of the gods, Danavas and Yakshas, Gandharvas and Nagas and being a thorn in the neck of sages, I will uproot you from here."
data.anv: देवदानवयक्षाणाम् gods, Danavas and Yakshas, गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् Gandharvas, Nagas, शत्रुम् enemy, ऋषीणाम् for the sages, कण्टकंच thorn in the neck, त्वाम् you, अद्य being, उद्धरिष्यामि uproot you.
data.md: Today shall I destroy the enemy of the gods and Dänavas, and Yakşas, of the Gandharvas serpents and Rākṣasas, and the thorn (in the side of the Saints).

data.v: विभीषणस्य चैश्वर्यं भविष्यति हते त्वयि । न चेत्सत्कृत्य वैदेहीं प्रणिपत्य प्रदास्यसि ॥
data.es: "Unless you return back Vaidehi respectfully, bowing down to me you will be killed and Vibheeshana will get the fortune."
data.anv: प्रणिपत्य bowing down, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, सत्कृत्य respectfully, नप्रदास्यसिचेत् not return back, त्वयि by you, हते being killed, ऐश्वर्यम् fortune, विभीषणस्य to Vibhishana, भविष्यति will be getting.
data.md: On you being slain, all the wealth shall be Vibhisana's; unless, bowing down (to me) and paying me homage, you render back Maithilī.

data.v: इत्येवं परुषं वाक्यं ब्रुवाणे हरिपुंगवे । अमर्षवशमापन्नो निशाचरगणेश्वरः ॥
data.es: The leader of the monkeys having spoken in that manner, Ravana the ruler of night rangers was overtaken by fury.
data.anv: हरिपुङ्गवे leader of monkey army, इत्येवम् in this way, परुषम् harsh, वाक्यम् words, ब्रुवाणे having spoken, निशाचरगणेश्वरः ruler of night rangers, अमर्षवशम् by fury, आपन्नः overtaken.
data.md: When that monkey-chief had spoken thus, the lord of the night-rangers was wrought up with wrath.

data.v: ततः स रोषताम्राक्षः शशास सचिवांस्तदा । गृह्यतामेष दुर्मेधा वध्यतामिति चासकृत् ॥
data.es: Thereafter, Ravana who was shaken by fury repeatedly commanded his ministers and said 'Let this evil minded monkey be seized and killed'.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, रोषम् shaken by fury, आपन्नः overtaken, सः he, तदा then, एष in this way, सचिवान् ministers, असकृत् repeatedly, शशास commanded, दुर्मेधाः evil minded, गृह्यताम् seize him, वध्यताम् kill him.
data.md: And coming under the sway of passion, he commanded his counsellors, saying, "Take this one of perverse understanding, and slay him at once.”

data.md: Hearing Råvaņa's speech, four grim-visaged night rangers seized (Angada) flaming in energy like fire itself,

data.v: ग्राहयामास तारेयः स्वयमात्मानमात्मना । बलं दर्शयितुं वीरो यातुधानगणे तदा ॥
data.es: Then Angada, the son of Tara, on his own wanting to exhibit his strength in the presence of the Rakshasa army allowed himself to be caught.
data.anv: तदा then, आत्मवान् himself, वीरः heroic, तारेयः son of Tara, यातुधानगणे in the presence of Rakshasa army, बलम् strength, दर्शयितुम् to exhibit, स्वयम् on his own, आत्मानम् by his, ग्राहयामास allowed to be caught.
data.md: Tara's son suffered himself to be taken, in order that the hero might then display his prowess before the Yātudhānas.

data.v: स तान्बाहुद्वये सक्तानादाय पतगानिव । प्रासादं शैलसंकाशमुत्पापाताङ्गदस्तदा ॥
data.es: Then Angada holding the Rakshasas by his arms came down like birds on the roof of the palace which stood like a mountain.
data.anv: तदा then, सःअङ्गदः that Angada, बाहुद्वयसक्तान् holding the arms, तान् from that, पतगानिव like birds, आदाय came, शैलसङ्काशम् which stood like a mountain peak, प्रासादम् palace, उत्पपात came down.
data.md: Then Angada, taking them up, who were pressed against his arms, like insects, leapt up on a palace resembling a hill.

data.v: तेऽन्तरिक्षाद्विनिर्धूतास्तस्य वेगेन राक्षसाः । भुमौ निपतिताः सर्वे राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पश्यतः ॥
data.es: Crushed by that speed of Angada coming down as if from the sky all the Rakshasas fell down on the ground while the Rakshasa king looked on.
data.anv: तेन by that, अन्तरिक्षात् from the sky, तस्य its, निर्धूता crushed, वेगेन speed, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa king's, तस्य from (the mountain), तत्र there, सर्वे all, भूमौ on the ground, निपतिताः fell.
data.md: Thereat, in consequence of the impetuosity of his bound, the Raksasas, slipping off, fell on to the ground in the very sight of the Rākṣasa king.

data.v: ततः प्रासादशिखरं शैलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम् । तत्पफाल तदाक्रान्तं दशग्रीवस्य पश्यतः ॥
data.es: Then as the courageous Vali's son landed on the high peak of the palace which resembled a mountain peak, Ravana stood looking.
data.anv: ततः then, प्रतापवान् courageous, वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य at Ravana, शैलशृङ्गमिव like the peak of mountain, उन्नतम् high, प्रासादशिखरम् peak of the palace, ददर्श saw.
data.md: Then the powerful son of Vāli with his legs attacked the top of that palace, elevated like a hill, of the lord of Rākşasas.

data.v: भङ्क्त्वा प्रासादशिखरं नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः । विनद्य सुमहानादमुत्पपात विहायसा ॥
data.es: Hitting on the peak of the palace, Angada declaring his own name emitting loud sound rose up to the sky.
data.anv: प्रासादशिखरम् peak of the palace, भङ् क्त्वा hitting, आत्मनः his own, नाम name, विश्रान्य declaring, सुमहानादम् loud sound, विनद्य emitting, विहायसा into the sky, उत्पपात rose.
data.md: Having reft the top of the edifice, and proclaimed his name, Angada, setting up a mighty roar, sprang into the sky.

data.v: रावणस्तु परं चक्रे क्रोधं प्रासादधर्षणात् । विनाशं चात्मनः पश्यन्निःश्वासपरमोऽभवत् ॥
data.es: Ravana exhibiting extreme anger at the shattering of his palace and seeing his destruction started sighing heavily.
data.anv: रावणस्तु even Ravana, प्रासादधर्षणात् for shattering the palace, परम् very, क्रोधम् angry, चक्रे exhibiting, आत्मनः for him, विनाशम् destruction, पश्यन् seeing, निःश्वासपरमः sighing, अभवत् exhibited.
data.md: Rāvana was transported with wrath in consequence of the breaking down of the palace. And, finding his destruction (at hand), he began to heave sighs.

data.v: रामस्तु बहुभिर्हृष्टैर्निनदद्भिः प्लवंगमैः । वृतो रिपुवधाकाङ्क्षी युद्धायैवाभ्यवर्तत ॥
data.es: Delighted by the roaring sound of many monkeys Rama awaited surrounded by groups of monkeys desirous of starting war.
data.anv: रामस्तु On Rama's part, हृष्टैः delighted, विनदद्भिः roaring like a lion, बहुभिः many, प्लवङ्गमैः monkey groups, वृतः surrounded, रिपुवधाकाङ्क्षी desirous of destruction of enemy, युद्धायैव for war, अभ्यवर्तत waiting.
data.md: Rāma, surrounded by innumerable delighted monkeys setting up shouts, anxious for slaying his foe, prepared for battle.

data.v: सुषेणस्तु महावीर्यो गिरिकूटोपमो हरिः । बहुभिः संवृतस्तत्र वानरैः कामरूपिभिः ॥
data.es: Sushena of great prowess, who resembled a mountain in form stood there surrounded by many Vanaras who could change their form at their will.
data.anv: महावीर्यः of great prowess, गिरिकूटोपमः resembling mountain, हरिः Monkey, सुषेणस्तु Sushena also, तत्र there, कामरूपिभिः who change their form according to their will, बहुभिः many, वानरैः Vanaras, सम्वृतः surrounded.
data.md: At the command of Sugrīva, the exceedingly powerful monkey-Susena, resembling a mountain-summit, surrounded by a large number of monkeys capable of assuming shapes at pleasure, began to range from door to door; like the Moon ranging the stars.

data.v: चतुर्द्वाराणि सर्वाणि सुग्रीववचनात्कपिः । पर्याक्रमत दुर्धर्षो नक्षत्राणीव चन्द्रमाः ॥
data.es: Sushena, a monkey who is difficult to encounter, went around all the four gates just like the moon goes around stars by the order of Sugriva.
data.anv: दुर्धर्षः one who is difficult to encounter, कपिः monkey, सुग्रीववचनात् by the command of Sugriva, चतुर्द्वाराणि the four gates, सर्वाणि all, चन्द्रमाः moon, नक्षत्राणीव stars, पर्यक्रामत moves around.
data.md: At the command of Sugrīva, the exceedingly powerful monkey-Susena, resembling a mountain-summit, surrounded by a large number of monkeys capable of assuming shapes at pleasure, began to range from door to door; like the Moon ranging the stars.

data.v: तेषामक्षौहिणिशतं समवेक्ष्य वनौकसाम् । लङ्कामुपनिविष्टानां सागरं चातिवर्तताम् ॥
data.es: Seeing the large army of a hundred Akshauhinis of monkeys staying near Lanka spreading beyond the sea waiting for war the Rakshasas were wonder struck, some feared, some were alarmed to witness the jubilant Vanaras who exhibited joy alone.

data.md: Seeing the hundred Akşauhinis of the woodrangers, stationed in Lankā, extending down to the sea, some of the Rākşasas were struck with astonishment, while some came under the influence of fear; and some experienced delight from the (anticipated) delight of battle.

data.v: राक्षसा विस्मयं जग्मुस्त्रासं जग्मुस्तथापरे । अपरे समरोद्धर्षाद्धर्षमेवोपपेदिरे ॥
data.es: Seeing the large army of a hundred Akshauhinis of monkeys staying near Lanka spreading beyond the sea waiting for war the Rakshasas were wonder struck, some feared, some were alarmed to witness the jubilant Vanaras who exhibited joy alone.
data.anv: लङ्काम् उपनिविष्टानाम् staying near Lanka, सागरंच extending beyond the ocean, अनिवर्तताम् spreading beyond, तेषाम् them, वनौकसाम् Vanara army, अक्षौहिणिशतम् a hundred Akshauhinis, समवेक्ष्य collected together, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, विस्मयम् wonder struck, जग्मुः feared, अपरे alarmed, समरे war, हर्षात् joyful, हर्षमेव joy alone, प्रपेदिरे exhibited.

data.es: The Rakshasas were desperate to see the spread of monkeys over the entire area from the boundary to moat of Lanka. The way the space between was filled with Vanaras seemed as though the Vanaras converted into boundaries. Rakshasas were seen making a loud noise.

data.md: The space between the well and the moat all was flooded with monkeys. data.md: On that frightful uproar arising, the warriors of the Rākşasa monarch, Raksasa-seizing mighty arms, began to patrol about, like to winds blowing at the time to the universal dissolution. a

data.v: ततस्ते राक्षसास्तत्र गत्वा रावणमन्दिरम् । न्यवेदयन्पुरीं रुद्धां रामेण सह वानरैः ॥
data.es: Then the Rakshasas proceeding to Ravana's abode informed that Rama along with the vanaras have occupied the whole of Lanka.
data.anv: तत then, राक्षसा Rakshasas, स्तत्र there, रावणमन्दिरम् Ravana's abode, गत्वा proceeding to, रामेण Rama's, वानरैः Vanaras, सह along with, रुद्धां occupied, न्यवेदय informed, न्पुरीं total city.
data.md: Then those Rākşasas, going to that subduer of enemies, Rāvana, informed him that Rāma along with the monkeys had laid siege to the city.

data.v: रुद्धां तु नगरीं श्रुत्वा जातक्रोधो निशाचरः । विधानं द्विगुणं श्रुत्वा प्रासादं सोऽध्यरोहत ॥
data.es: On knowing that Lanka is occupied, the night ranger Ravana, became very furious and doubled the forces of Lanka for the protection and went to the top of Lanka palace.
data.anv: रुद्धां occupied, तु also, नगरीं city, श्रुत्वा hearing, जातक्रोधो very furious, निशाचरः night ranger, विधानं knowing, द्विगुणं twice, श्रुत्वा hearing, प्रासादं top of the mansion, अध्यरोहत planning for the protection of Lanka.
data.md: Hearing the city besieged, the night-ranger was enraged. And, hearing that double arrangements had been made (by Rāma) in guarding the gateways (Råvaņa) ascended the palace.

data.v: स ददर्शावृतां लङ्कां सशैलवनकाननाम् । असंख्येयैर्हरिगणैः सर्वतो युद्धकाङ्क्षिभिः ॥
data.es: He observed a countless number of Vanara troops spread all over Lanka, mountains, and forests.
data.anv: स: he, युद्धकाङ्क्षिभिः desirous of combat, असङ्ख्येयै countless numbers, हर्रिगणैः troops of Vanaras, सशैलवनकाननाम् mountains and forests, सर्वतो all over, अवृतां occupied, लङ्कां Lanka, ददर्शा observed.
data.md: He saw Lanka with her hills, woods, and forests, covered everywhere with innumerable monkeys eager for encounter.

data.v: स दृष्ट्वा वानरैः सर्वां वसुधां कवलीकृताम् । कथं क्षपयितव्याः स्युरिति चिन्तापरोऽभवत् ॥
data.es: Seeing the Vanaras occupying the entire earth, Ravana thought of destroying and started thinking.
data.anv: स: he, वानरैः Vanaras, सर्वां all, वसुधां earth, कवलीकृताम् occupied, दृष्ट्वा seeing, कथं how, स्युरिति thought, क्षपयितव्याः to destroy, चिन्तापरो thinking, अभवत् started.
data.md: He saw the entire Earth tawneyed with the monkeys; and he reflected within himself how he could destroy these.

data.v: स चिन्तयित्वा सुचिरं धैर्यमालम्ब्य रावणः । राघवं हरियूथांश्च ददर्शायतलोचनः ॥
data.es: Ravana, thinking over for long, picking up courage, saw Rama's Vanaras with thoughtful eyes.
data.anv: स: he, रावणः Ravana, सुचिरं for long, चिन्तयित्वा thinking over, धैर्यमालम्ब्य picking up courage, अयतलोचनः with thoughtful eyes, राघवं Raghava, हरियूथांश्च at the Vanaras, ददर्शा saw.
data.md: And reflecting for long, Rāvana having expansive eyes, Assuming patience, gazed at Rāghava and the leader of monkeys.

data.v: प्रेक्षतो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य तान्यनीकानि भागशः । राघवप्रियकामार्थं लङ्कामारुरुहुस्तदा ॥
data.es: To make Rama happy, all the Vanara army divided into groups and started ascending the boundary (of Lanka) walls the king of Rakshasas was witnessing.
data.anv: राक्षसेन्द्रस्य king of Rakshasas, प्रेक्षतो as he was looking, तान्यनीकानि all the Vanara army, राघवप्रियकामार्थं to make Rama happy, भागशः in divisions, लङ्काम Lanka, आरुरुहुस्तदा ascended the boundary.
data.md: And for doing what was dear to Rāma, that army, divided into separate parties, in the presence of the Raksasa chief commenced scaling Lanka.

data.v: ते ताम्रवक्त्रा हेमाभा रामार्थे त्यक्तजीविताः । लङ्कामेवाह्यवर्तन्त सालतालशिलायुधाः ॥
data.es: Vanaras of copper colour faces and golden coloured ones, dedicating their lives for the sake of Rama holding Sala trees and rocks went towards Lanka.
data.anv: ताम्रवक्त्रा having copper colour faces, हेमाभा golden coloured, रामार्थे for the sake of Rama, त्यक्तजीविताः giving up life, सालतालशिलायुधाः Sala, Tala trees and rocks as weapons, लङ्कामेवाभ्यवर्तन्त went to Lanka.
data.md: Those copper-faced once of golden sheen, who had consecrated their lives to the service of Rāma, equipped with trees and rocks, began to throng upon Lankā.

data.v: ते द्रुमैः पर्वताग्रैश्च मुष्टिभिश्च प्लवंगमाः । प्रासादाग्राणि चोच्चानि ममन्तुस्तोरणानि च ॥
data.es: With the means of mountain peaks, as well as their fists, the Vanaras scaled the boundary walls and gateways of the city.
data.anv: ते they (Vanaras ), द्रुमैः trees, पर्वताग्रैश्च peaks of mountains, मुष्टिभिश्च even with fists, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, प्राकाराग्रा top of boundary, अरण्यानि forests, ममन्थुस्तोरणानिच gateways of the city

data.v: पारिखाः पूरयन्ति स्म प्रसन्नसलिलायुताः । पांसुभिः पर्वताग्रैश्च तृणैः काष्ठैश्च वानराः ॥
data.es: The Vanaras started filling the moats with soil, pure water, logs of wood, grass, and mountain peaks.
data.anv: वानराः Vanaras, पारिखाः with soil, पर्वताग्रैश्च with mountain peaks, तृणैः with grass, काष्ठैश्च wooden pieces, पांसुभिः moats also, प्रसन्नसलिलायुताः with pure water, पूरयन्ति filled.

data.v: ततः सहस्रयूथाश्च कोटियूथाश्च यूथपाः । कोटीशतयुताश्चान्ये लङ्कामारुरुहुस्तदा ॥
data.es: Then the Vanaras in thousands and crores ascended Lanka.
data.anv: ततः then, वानराः Vanaras, सहस्रयूथाश्च thousand, कोटीयूथाश्च one crore, कोटीशतयुताश्चान्ये hundred crores, लङ्काम into Lanka, आरुरुहुस्तदा ascended then.
data.md: Then leader of thousands and koțis and hundreds of koțis began to scale Lanka.

data.v: काञ्चनानि प्रमृद्नन्तस्तोरणानि प्लवंगमाः । कैलासशिखराभानि गोपुराणि प्रमथ्य च ॥
data.es: The Vanaras started breaking the golden gateways and crushing them which were like peaks of Kailasa mountain.
data.anv: काञ्चनानि golden, प्रमृद्नन्तस्तोरणानि breaking the gateways, कैलासशिखराभानि like the peaks of Kailasa mountain, गोपुराणि towers, प्रमथ्यच crushing, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys went.

data.v: आप्लवन्तः प्लवन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवंगमाः । लङ्कां तामभ्यवर्तन्त महावारणसंनिभाः ॥
data.es: The monkeys went towards southern direction playing, leaping, running and roaring like lions.
data.anv: ते those, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, प्लवन्तः leaping, अप्लवन्तः running, गर्जन्तश्च roaring like lions, क्ष्वेळन्तः playing, निनदन्त:screaming, दक्षिणां दिशम् southerly direction, जग्मुः वै they went
data.md: The monkeys crushed golden gateways; and, breaking down gates resembling the tops of the summits of Kailasa, bounded roaring, some towards the wall and some all around. And resembling gigantic elephants, they rushed towards Lankā.

data.v: जयत्यतिबलो रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः । राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः ॥
data.es: "Victorious is Sri Rama, who is exceedingly strong and Lakshmana who is endowed with supreme strength. Victorious is Sugriva the king of Vanaras who is protected by Raghava on all sides."
data.anv: जयत्य victorious, अतिबलो exceedingly strong, रामो Rama, महाबलः endowed with supreme, strength, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana also, राजा king, जयति victorious, सुग्रीवो Sugriva, राघवेण by Raghava, अभिपालितः protected by on all sides.

data.v: इत्येवं घोषयन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवंगमाः । अभ्यधावन्त लङ्कायाः प्राकारं कामरूपिणः ॥
data.es: Shouting in that manner, the monkeys who could change their form at their will started roaring and rushed towards the defensive walls.
data.anv: कामरूपिणः who could change their form at will, इत्येवं in this manner, घोषयन्तश्च shouting, गर्जन्तश्च roaring, लङ्कायाः into Lanka, प्राकारं defensive walls, अभ्यधावन्त rushed over.
data.md: Victory to the mighty Rāma, and victory to the exceedingly powerful Lakşmaņa, and Victory to king Sugriva, who is protected by Rāghava.' Thus shouting, those monkeys, wearing forms at will, sending up roars, rushed amain towards the wall of Lankā.

data.v: वीरबाहुः सुबाहुश्च नलश्च वनगोचरः । निपीड्योपनिविष्टास्ते प्राकारं हरियूथपाः ॥
data.es: Veerabahu, Subahu, Nala and the foremost of the Vanara leaders storming the boundary walls in the meantime went inside and stationed at the northeast gate.
data.anv: वीरबाहुः Veerabahu, सुबाहुश्च and Subahu, नल Nala, वनगोचरः foremost of monkeys, निपीड्योप storming, निविष्टास्ते defensive, प्राकारं boundary walls, हरियूथपाः Vanara leaders, एतस्मिन्नन्तरे in the meantime inside, चक्रुः went, स्कन्धावारनिवेशनम् remained stationed at northeast.
data.md: And Virabăhu, Subāhu, Nala and Panasaleader of monkeys-breaking (a portion of) the wall, took up their post there. In the meantime, (they) arranged the forces in order of battle.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चक्रुः स्कन्धावारनिवेशनम् ॥
पूर्वद्वारं तु कुमुदः कोटिभिर्दशभिर्वृतः । आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ हरिभिर्जितकाशिभिः ॥
data.es: Kumuda, surrounded by ten crores of mighty monkeys, who appeared like conquerors, stationed at the east gate.
data.anv: कुमुदः Kumuda, तु also, कोटीभि one crore, र्दशभि ten, आर्वृतः surrounded by, पूर्वद्वारं east gate, आवृत्य surrounded, बलवां mighty, स्तस्थौ remained, हरिभि monkeys also, र्जितकाशिभिः appearing victorious.
data.md: The strong Kumuda, surrounded by ten kotis of victorious monkeys, stood obstruction the Estern gate.

data.v: दक्षिणद्वारमागम्य वीरः शतबलिः कपिः । आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ विंशत्या कोटिभिर्वृतः ॥
data.es: Valiant Satabali with twenty crores of monkeys stood besieging the south gate.
data.anv: वीरः valiant, शतबलिः Satabali, कपिः monkey, विंशत्या twenty, कोटिभि crores, आवृत्य surrounded by, बलवांस्तस्थौ stood besieging, दक्षिणं south, द्वारमागम्य reached the gate.
data.md: And obstruction the Southern entrance stood the strong and gallant monkey, Śatabali surrounded by twenty koțis.

data.v: सुषेणः पश्चिमद्वारं गतस्तारा पिता हरिः । आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ षष्टि कोटिभिरावृतः ॥
data.es: Valiant Satabali with twenty crores of monkeys stood besieging the south gate.
data.anv: वीरः valiant, शतबलिः Satabali, कपिः monkey, विंशत्या twenty, कोटिभि crores, आवृत्य surrounded by, बलवांस्तस्थौ stood besieging, दक्षिणं south, द्वारमागम्य reached the gate.
data.md: The strong sire of Tārā the powerful Sus ena, obstructed the Western gate, backed by kot is upon kotis (of monkeys).

data.v: उत्तरद्वारमासाद्य रामः सौमित्रिणा सह । आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ सुग्रीवश्च हरीश्वरः ॥
data.es: Reaching the north gate, Sri Rama along with Saumithri, blockading the gate stood Sugriva the Lord of monkeys.
data.anv: उत्तरंद्वारमासाद्य reaching north gate, रामः Rama, सौमित्रिणा Saumithri, सह along with, आवृत्य accompanied by, बलवांस्तस्थौ blockading the gate, हरीश्वरः Lord of monkeys, सुग्रीवश्च Sugriva.
data.md: Obstructing the Northern gate, remained the puissant Răma himself along with Sumitrā's son, as well as the king of monkeys-Sugriva.

data.v: गोलाङ्गूलो महाकायो गवाक्षो भीमदर्शनः । वृतः कोट्या महावीर्यस्तस्थौ रामस्य पार्वतः ॥
data.es: Gavaksha of gigantic body and fierce appearance, along with one crore of Golangula species of monkeys endowed with extraordinary virility stood by the side of Sri Rama.
data.anv: महाकायो of gigantic body, गवाक्षो Gavaksha, भीमदर्शनः of fierce appearance, गोलाङ्गूलो Golangula species of monkeys, कोट्या crore, वृतः surrounded by, महावीर्यस्तस्थौ of extraordinary virility, रामस्य Rama's, पार्श्वतः by the side of.
data.md: That huge-bodied and dreadful Golangula-the mighty and powerful Gavākşa-surrounded by a koti, remained by the side of Rama.

data.v: ऋष्काणां भीमवेगानां धूम्रः शत्रुनिबर्हणः । वृतः कोट्या महावीर्यस्तस्थौ रामस्य पार्श्वतः ॥
data.es: Gavaksha of gigantic body and fierce appearance, along with one crore of Golangula species of monkeys endowed with extraordinary virility stood by the side of Sri Rama.
data.anv: महाकायो of gigantic body, गवाक्षो Gavaksha, भीमदर्शनः of fierce appearance, गोलाङ्गूलो Golangula species of monkeys, कोट्या crore, वृतः surrounded by, महावीर्यस्तस्थौ of extraordinary virility, रामस्य Rama's, पार्श्वतः by the side of.
data.md: That huge-bodied and dreadful Golangula-the mighty and powerful Gavākşa-surrounded by a koti, remained by the side of Rama.

data.v: संनद्धस्तु महावीर्यो गदापाणिर्विभीषणः । वृतो यस्तैस्तु सचिवैस्तस्थौ तत्र महाबलः ॥
data.es: Vibheeshana with defensive clamour, of extraordinary virility accompanied by his mighty ministers, stood there with his mace in hand.
data.anv: वृतो accompanied by, सन्नद्धस्तु defensive clamour, महावीर्यो of extraordinary virility, गदापाणि wielding mace, विर्भीषणः Vibheeshana, यस्तैस्तु stood, सचिवैस्तस्थौ with ministers stood, तत्र there, महाबलः mighty.

data.v: गजो गवाक्षो गवयः शरभो गन्धमादनः । समन्तात्परिघावन्तो ररक्षुर्हरिवाहिनीम् ॥
data.es: Gaja, Gavaksha, Gava, Sarabha, Gandhamadana stood protecting the monkey troops wandering all over.
data.anv: गजो Gaja, गवाक्षो Gavaksha, गवयः Gava, शरभ Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandamadhana, मन्तात्परिधावन्तो all over wandering, ररक्षु protecting, हर्रिवाहिनीम् monkey troops.
data.md: And Gaya, and Gavāksa, and Gavaya, and Śarabha, and Gandhamādana, protected the monkey-army, coursing all around.

data.v: ततः कोपपरीतात्मा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । निर्याणं सर्वसैन्यानां द्रुतमाज्ञापयत्तदा ॥
data.es: Thereafter Ravana, the Lord of Rakshasas overcome by fury ordered all his forces to advance.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, रावण Ravana, सर्वसैन्यानां all his forces, निर्याणं to depart, कोपपरीतात्मा overcome by fury, द्रुत to advance, आज्ञापयत्तदा ordered.
data.md: Then, his soul wrought up with wrath, Rāvaņa-lord of Rākşasas-speedily ordered the whole host to sally out.

data.v: निष्पतन्ति ततः सैन्या हृष्टा रावणचोदिताः । समये पूर्यमाणस्य वेगा इव महोदधेः ॥
data.es: Urged by Ravana, the army then joyfully rushed forth swiftly like a great ocean at the time of universal destruction.
data.anv: रावणचोदिताः urged by Ravana, सैन्या army, ततः then, हृष्टा joyfully, निष्पतन्ति rushed forth, वेगा swiftly, महोदधेः great ocean, इव like, समये at the time of, पूर्यमाणस्य universal destruction.
data.md: And commanded by Råvana, the troops cheerfully issued forth like the onrushing of the mighty main filling all at the time of the universal dissolution.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे घोरः संग्रामः समपद्यत । रक्षसां वानराणां च यथा देवासुरे पुरा ॥
data.es: In the meantime, dreadful conflict arose all over between Rakshasas and Vanaras, which was like the conflict between Devas and asuras earlier.
data.anv: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे in the meantime, घोरः dreadful, सङ्ग्रामः conflict, समवर्तत all over, रक्षसां Rakshasas, वानराणांच between Vanaras, यथादेवासुरे like the conflict between Devas and asuras, पुरा earlier.
data.md: In the meantime there commenced a mighty a encounter between the Raksasas and the monkey, like that which took place of yore between the gods and the Asuras.

data.v: ते गदाभिः प्रदीप्ताभिः शक्तिशूलपरश्वधैः । निजघ्नुर्वानरान्घोराः कथयन्तः स्वविक्रमान् ॥
data.es: Vowing their own prowess, the Rakshasas began to strike the Vanaras with maces, flaming javelins, tridents, and pikes fiercely.
data.anv: ते the Rakshasas, स्वविक्रमान् vaunting their own prowess, गदाभिः with maces, प्रदीप्ताभिः flaming शक्तिशूलपरश्वधैः with javelins, tridents and pikes, निजघ्नु fiercely struck, नरान्घोराः at Vanaras, कथयन्तः attacked.
data.md: And displaying their prowess, They* began to slaughter monkeys with maces, and darts, and adzes. *Raksasas.

data.v: तथा वृक्षैर्महाकायाः पर्वताग्रैश्च वानराः । राक्षसास्तानि रक्षांसि नखैर्दन्तैश्च वेगिताः ॥
data.es: Vanaras in the same manner attacked the Rakshasas, with trees and mountains, swiftly and with their nails and teeth.
data.anv: तथा in the same manner, वृक्षैर्महाकायाः with trees, पर्वताग्रैश्च with mountain peaks, वानराः Vanaras, रक्षांसि at Rakshasas, नखैर्दन्तैश्च with nails and teeth, निजघ्नुस्तानि attacked, वेगिताः swiftly.
data.md: The vehement monkeys (on their side) slaughtered Rākşasa with trees and tops of crags as well as with their nails and teeth.

data.v: राक्षसास्त्वपरे भीमाः प्राकारस्था महीगतान् । भिण्डिपालैश्च खड्गैश्च शूलैश्चैव व्यदारयन् ॥
data.es: Standing on the walls, the redoubtable Rakshasas, pierced the Vanaras with swords, dreadful Bhindipalas.
