data.anv: राक्षसास्त्वपरे redoubtable Rakshasas, प्राकारस्था standing on the walls, भीमाः dreadful, भिन्दिपालैश्च Bhindipalas (javelin like weapons), खड्गैश्च and swords, शूलैश्चैव with tridents, व्यदारयन् pierced.
data.md: Then other dreadful Rākṣasa that were stationed upon the wall, dropping down, pierced the monkeys with darts and bhindipālas.

data.v: वानराश्चापि संक्रुद्धाः प्राकारस्थान्महीगताः । राक्षसान्पातयामासुः समाप्लुत्य प्लवंगमाः ॥
data.es: The vanaras jumping up dragged the Rakshasas stationed on the boundary wall down to the ground.
data.anv: प्राकारस्थान्महीगताः stationed on the boundary walls, वानराश्चापि Vanaras also, राक्षसान्पातयामासुः dragged down the Rakshasas, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, समाप्लुत्य jumping up.
data.md: And (thereat) the monkeys, flying into fury, descending to the earth and bounding, brought down the Rākşasas with their arms.

data.v: स संप्रहारस्तुमुलो मांसशोणितकर्दमः । रक्षसां वानराणां च संबभूवाद्भुतोपमाः ॥
data.es: The conflict that happened between the Rakshasas and Vanaras was amazing and intense and left a mire of flesh and blood.॥ इत्यार्षेश्रीमद्वाल्मीकिरामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेद्विचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the forty second sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: स that, सम्प्रहार conflict, रक्षसां of Rakshasas, वानराणांच and Vanaras, तमुलो intense, मांस flesh, शोणित blood, कर्दमः like mire, सम्बभूवा that happened, अद्भुतोपमाः was amazing.
data.md: That encounter of the Rākşasas and the monkeys was mighty and wonderful, and the ground became wet with flesh and gore.

data.v: युध्यतां तु ततस्तेषां वानराणां महात्मनाम् । रक्षसां संबभूवाथ बलकोपः सुदारुणः ॥
data.es: Thereafter the gigantic army of Vanaras were fighting with exceedingly terrific Rakshasas and the anguished Rakshasas could not tolerate the sight.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, महात्मानाम् gigantic, तेषांवानराणाम् those Vanaras, रक्षसांच and Rakshasas, युध्यताम् waging war, अथ while, सुदारुणः exceedingly terrific, बलरोषः anguished, सम्बभूव could not tolerate the sight.
data.md: As the high-soulcd monkeys and Raksasas taught on, their wrath vastly increase at sight of each other's forces.

data.v: ते हयैः काञ्चनापीडैर्ध्वजैश्चाग्निशिखोपमैः । रथैश्चादित्यसंकाशैः कवचैश्च मनोरमैः ॥
data.es: Wishing victory for Ravana, the tiger among ogres, the Rakshasas of terrific deeds sallied forth accompanied by horses with golden trappings and seizing posts, which were like flames of fire shining like the sun's rays on the chariots and delightful shields, roaring resounding in all the ten directions.
data.anv: रावणस्य for Ravana, जयैषिणः desiring victory, राक्षसव्याघ्राः tiger among Rakshasas, भीमकर्माणः of terrible deeds, तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, काञ्चनापीडैः provided with golden trappings, हयैः horses, अग्निशिखोपमैः like flames of fire, ऊर्ध्वैः posts, आदित्यसङ्काशैः shining like sun's rays, रथैः chariots, मनोरमैः delightful, कवचैश्च shields, दश ten, दिशः directions, नादयन्तः resounding, निर्ययुः sallied forth.
data.md: And furnished with steeds in golden trappings, and elephants resembling flames of fire; and cars appearing like (so many) suns; and shining armour, the valiant Räkşasas issued, making the ten cardinal points resound. The Rākşasas of terrific exploits were burning for victory on behalf of Rāvana.

data.v: निर्ययू राक्षसव्याघ्रा नादयन्तो दिशो दश । राक्षसा भीमकर्माणो रावणस्य जयैषिणः ॥
data.es: Wishing victory for Ravana, the tiger among ogres, the Rakshasas of terrific deeds sallied forth accompanied by horses with golden trappings and seizing posts, which were like flames of fire shining like the sun's rays on the chariots and delightful shields, roaring resounding in all the ten directions.
data.anv: रावणस्य for Ravana, जयैषिणः desiring victory, राक्षसव्याघ्राः tiger among Rakshasas, भीमकर्माणः of terrible deeds, तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, काञ्चनापीडैः provided with golden trappings, हयैः horses, अग्निशिखोपमैः like flames of fire, ऊर्ध्वैः posts, आदित्यसङ्काशैः shining like sun's rays, रथैः chariots, मनोरमैः delightful, कवचैश्च shields, दश ten, दिशः directions, नादयन्तः resounding, निर्ययुः sallied forth.
data.md: And furnished with steeds in golden trappings, and elephants resembling flames of fire; and cars appearing like (so many) suns; and shining armour, the valiant Räkşasas issued, making the ten cardinal points resound. The Rākşasas of terrific exploits were burning for victory on behalf of Rāvana.

data.v: वानराणामपि चमूर्महती जयमिच्चताम् । अभ्यधावत तां सेनां रक्षसां कामरूपिणाम् ॥
data.es: Wishing triumph even the powerful army of powerful Vanaras of terrific deeds went ahead to fight with Rakshasas.
data.anv: जयम् triumph, इच्छताम् wishing, वानराणाम् Vanaras, बृहती powerful, चमूःअपि army too, घोरकर्मणाम् of terrible deeds, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, तांसेनाम् those army, अभ्यधावत went ahead.
data.md: The mighty monkey-army also, eager for victory, darted against the host of the Rākşasa of dreadful deeds.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तेषामन्योन्यमभिधावताम् । रक्षसां वानराणां च द्वन्द्वयुद्धमवर्तत ॥
data.es: At that time the Vanaras and Rakshasas facing each other started a dual fight.
data.anv: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे at that time, अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिधावताम् facing one over the other, तेषाम् those, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वानराणांच and Vanaras, द्वन्द्वयुद्धम् duel fight, आवर्तत began.
data.md: In the meanwhile, as either party assailed the other, there took place single combats between the Raksasas and the monkeys.

data.v: अङ्गदेनेन्द्रजित्सार्धं वालिपुत्रेण राक्षसः । अयुध्यत महातेजास्त्र्यम्बकेण यथान्धकः ॥
data.es: Indrajith, an exceedingly brilliant Rakshasa, contended with Angada, son of Vali just like Lord Siva with and haka, the Lord of death.
data.anv: महातेजाः exceedingly brilliant, राक्षसः Rakshasa, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, वालिपुत्रेण with Vali's son, अङ्गदेव Angada, सार्धम् contended with, अन्तकः and haka, स्त्ऱ्यम्बकेणयथा like Lord Siva with Lord of death, अयुध्यत fought
data.md: And as Andhaka had combated with the Three-eyed (deity), That Raksasas, the exceedingly energetic Indrajit, faught with Angada, Son to Vāli.

data.v: प्रजङ्घेन च संपातिर्नित्यं दुर्मर्षणो रणे । जम्बूमालिनमारब्धो हनूमानपि वानरः ॥
data.es: Sampathi , who is invariably difficult to encounter in war fought with Prajangha, and Hanuman started with Jambumali.
data.anv: रणे in war, नित्यम् invariably, दुर्मर्षणः difficult to encounter, सम्पातिः Sampathi, प्रजङ्घेन Prajangha, वानरः Vanara, हनुमानपि Hanuman, जम्बुमालिनम् with Jambumali, आरब्दः started.
data.md: Sampāti, hard to to bear, engaged with Prajangha; and the monkey, Hanumān, entered into conflict with Jambumālī.

data.v: संगतः सुमहाक्रोधो राक्षसो रावणानुजः । समरे तीक्ष्णवेगेन मित्रघ्नेन विभीषणः ॥
data.es: Highly furious Rakshasa, Vibheeshana, brother of Ravana fought with Rakshasa, Mitraghna.
data.anv: महाक्रोधः highly furious, रावणानुजः Ravana's brother, राक्षसः Rakshasa, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, समरे in war, तीक्ष्णवेगेन endowed with high speed, मित्रघ्नेन Mitraghna, सङ्गतः contended.
data.md: And Ravana's younger brother, Vibhisana, fired with wrath, encountered Śatrughna, endowed with exceeding impetuosity.

data.v: तपनेन गजः सार्धं राक्षसेन महाबलः । निकुम्भेन महातेजा नीलोऽपि समयुध्यत ॥
data.es: Gaja of great strength fought with Rakshasa Tapa, and highly energetic Neela fought with Nikumbha.
data.anv: महाबलः of great strength, गजः Gaja, तपनेन with Tapa, राक्षसेनसार्धम् with Rakshasa, महातेजाः highly energetic, नीलोऽपि Neela too, निकुम्बेन with Nikumbha, समयुध्यत fought with each other.
data.md: The highly powerful Nīla engaged with undertook Praghasa, and the graceful Lakşmaņa was engaged with Virüpākşa.

data.v: वानरेन्द्रस्तु सुग्रीवः प्रघसेन समागतः । संगतः समरे श्रीमान्विरूपाक्षेण लक्ष्मणः ॥
data.es: Sugriva the Lord of Vanaras fought with Praghana and prosperous Lakshmana fought with Virupaksha.
data.anv: वानरेन्द्र Lord of Vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, प्रघनेन with Praghana, समागतः encountered, श्रीमान् prosperous, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, विरूपाक्षेण Virupaksha, समरे in war, सङ्गतः encountered.
data.md: The highly powerful Nīla engaged with undertook Praghasa, and the graceful Lakşmaņa was engaged with Virüpākşa.

data.v: अग्निकेतुश्च दुर्धर्षो रश्मिकेतुश्च राक्षसः । सुप्तघ्नो यज्ञकोपश्च रामेण सह संगताः ॥
data.es: Agnikethu, a Rakshasa who is difficult to win over, Rasmikethu, Suptaghna and Yajnakepu waged war with Rama.
data.anv: सुदुर्धर्षः difficult to win over, अग्निकेतुः Agnikethu, राक्षसः Rakshasa, रश्मिकेतुश्च and Rasmikethu, सुप्तघ्नुः Suptaghna, यज्ञकेपश्च Yajnakepu, रामेणसह along with Rama, सङ्गताः waged.
data.md: The exceedingly irrepressible Agniketu and the Raksasa Rasmiketu-and Mitraghna and Yajñakopa, were engaged with Rāma.

data.v: वज्रमुष्टिस्तु मैन्देन द्विविदेनाशनिप्रभः । राक्षसाभ्यां सुघोराभ्यां कपिमुख्यौ समागतौ ॥
data.es: Vajramushti with Mainda and Asaniprabhu with Dwivida, the chief of monkeys, fought with the two Rakshasas.
data.anv: वज्रमुष्टिः Vajramushti, तु also, मैन्देन with Mainda, अशनिप्रभः Asaniprabhu, द्विविदेन with Dwivida कपिमुख्यौ chief of monkeys, सुघोराभ्याम् fearful, राक्षसाभ्याम् with the two Rakshasas, समागतौ fought.

data.v: वीरः प्रतपनो घोरो राक्षसो रणदुर्धरः । समरे तीक्ष्णवेगेन नलेन समयुध्यत ॥
data.es: Heroic and dreadful Pratapana, who is indomitable in the battle, fought with Nala endowed with high speed.
data.anv: वीरः heroic, घोरः dreadful, रणदुर्धरः indomitable in war, प्रतपनः Pratapana, समरे in battle, तीक्ष्णवेगेन with high speed, नळेन Nala, समयुध्यत fought with.

data.v: धर्मस्य पुत्रो बलवान्सुषेण इति विश्रुतः । स विद्युन्मालिना सार्धमयुध्यत महाकपिः ॥
data.es: Mighty Sushena, the righteous son fought with well known Vidyunmali. And fierce monkeys and Rakshasas fought in dual war with each other.
data.anv: धर्मस्यपुत्रो righteous son, बलवान्सुषेण of mighty Sushena, इति so also, विश्रुतः well known, सविद्युन्मालिना with Vidyunmali, सार्धमयुध्यत fought with, महाकपिः great monkey, घोराः fierce, अपरे other, वानराश्च Vanaras also, बहुभिःसह along with many, युद्धायच fought in war, अपरैः, राक्षसैःसह Rakshasas also, द्वन्द्वंसमीयुः duel fight.

data.v: वानराश्चापरे भीमा राक्षसैरपरैः सह । द्वन्द्वं समीयुर्बहुधा युद्धाय बहुभिः सह ॥
data.es: Mighty Sushena, the righteous son fought with well known Vidyunmali. And fierce monkeys and Rakshasas fought in dual war with each other.
data.anv: धर्मस्यपुत्रो righteous son, बलवान्सुषेण of mighty Sushena, इति so also, विश्रुतः well known, सविद्युन्मालिना with Vidyunmali, सार्धमयुध्यत fought with, महाकपिः great monkey, घोराः fierce, अपरे other, वानराश्च Vanaras also, बहुभिःसह along with many, युद्धायच fought in war, अपरैः, राक्षसैःसह Rakshasas also, द्वन्द्वंसमीयुः duel fight.
data.md: And other fearful monkeys encountered other Rākşasas; and many were the encounters the took place.

data.v: तत्रासीत्सुमहद्युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम् । रक्षसां वानराणां च वीराणां जयमिच्छताम् ॥
data.es: Fierce war which made hair stand on end happened there, with the heroic Rakshasas and Vanaras longing for victory.
data.anv: तत्र there, जयम् victory, इच्छताम् longing, वीराणाम् heroes, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वानराणांच and Vanaras, रोमहर्षणम् fierce which made hair stand on end, तुमुलम् confused, सुमहत् great, युद्धम् war, आसीत् happened.
data.md: And great and fierce was the engagement that took place between the heroic Rakşasas and monkeys burning for victory, capable of making people's hair stand on end.

data.v: हरिराक्षसदेहेभ्यः प्रसृताः केशशाड्वलाः । शरीरसंघाटवहाः प्रसुस्रुः शोणितापगाः ॥
data.es: In that war, the streams of blood that flowed from the bodies of Vanaras and Rakshasas were strewn like weeds in the form of hair, bearing logs of wood in the form of dead bodies.
data.anv: हरिराक्षसदेहेभ्यः from the body of Rakshasas and Vanaras, प्रभूताः come out, केशशाद्वलाः in the form of hair, शरीरसङ्घाटवहाः the dead bodies like logs of wood, शोणितापगाः streams of blood, प्रसुस्रुः flown.
data.md: And from the persons of the Räkşasas and the monkeys there flowed a river of gore, having hair for grass (growing on its banks) and the bodies of the warriors for pieces of planks floating (a down the current).

data.v: आजघानेन्द्रजित्क्रुद्धो वज्रेणेव शतक्रतुः । अङ्गदं गदया वीरं शत्रुसैन्यविदारणम् ॥
data.es: Enraged, Indrajith struck Angada with his mace, the destroyer of hostile forces which was like Indra who had done a hundred sacrifices, would strike with his thunderbolt.
data.anv: क्रुद्धः enraged, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, शतक्रतुः who has done a hundred sacrifices, वज्रेणेव Indra thunderbolt, गदया mace, शत्रुसैन्यविदारणम् destroyer of hostile forces, वीरम् heroic, अङ्गदम् Angada, आजघान struck.
data.md: Indrajit, growing enraged, with his mace dealt a blow at that tearer of hostile ranks, angada, like him of an hundred sacrifices striking with his · thunderbolt.

data.v: तस्य काञ्चनचित्राङ्गं रथं साश्वं ससारथिम् । जघान समरे श्रीमानङ्गदो वेगवान्कपिः ॥
data.es: With the same mace (snatched from the Rakshasa) Angada swiftly struck Indrajit hand destroyed the horse, chariot, and charioteer.
data.anv: कपिः monkey, अङ्गदः Angada, वेगवान् swiftly, समरे in fight, तस्य his, काञ्चनचित्राङ्गम् bright with gold, साश्वम् horses, ससारथिम् with charioteer, रथम् chariot, जघान destroyed.
data.md: Thereat, that graceful monkey, Angada, gifted with vehemence, with his mace crushed his car decked in gold, together with the steeds and the charioteer.

data.v: संपातिस्तु त्रिभिर्बाणैः प्रजङ्घेन समाहतः । निजघानाश्वकर्णेन प्रजङ्घं रणमूर्धनि ॥
data.es: While Prajangha injured Sampathi with three arrows, in turn Sampathi killed him with Aswakarna tree in the midst of war.
data.anv: प्रजङ्घेन Prajangha, त्रिभिः three, बाणैः arrows, समाहतः injured, सम्पातिस्तु and Sampathi also, रणमूर्धनि in the midst of war, अश्वकर्णेन A swakarna, प्रजङ्घम् Prajangham, निजघान killed.
data.md: Sampāti was pierced with three arrows by Prajangha; and the former (in his turn) slew Prajangha on the edge of battle with an Ašvakarņa.

data.v: जम्बूमाली रथस्थस्तु रथशक्त्या महाबलः । बिभेद समरे क्रुद्धो हनूमन्तं स्तनान्तरे ॥
data.es: Jambumali of extraordinary might mounting on the chariot in the battle pierced Hanuman in his chest.
data.anv: महाबलः of extraordinary mighty, रथस्थः chariot's, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, क्रुद्धः angry, समरे in the battle, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, रथशक्त्या mounting on the chariot, स्तनान्तरे in the chest, बिभेद pierced
data.md: And Jambumali, mounted on a car, possessed of prodigious strength, fired with wrath, with all the access of force derived from his car wounded Hanumān between his paps.

data.v: तस्य तं रथमास्थाय हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः । प्रममाथ तलेनाशु सह तेनैव रक्षसा ॥
data.es: Hanuman the son of wind god, getting on to the chariot quickly destroyed that Rakshasa Jambumali with his palm.
data.anv: मारुतात्मजः son of wind god, हनुमान् Hanuman, तस्य his, तंरथम् that chariot, आस्थाय taking position, आशु quickly, तेनरक्षसा that Rakshasa, तलेन with the palm, प्रमामथ destroyed.
data.md: Thereat, getting at his car, Hanumān-son to the Wind-god with a slap speedily crushed his adversary's vehicle along with the Raksasa.

data.v: भिन्नगात्रः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः क्षिप्रहस्तेन रक्षसा । प्रजघानाद्रिशृङ्गेण तपनं मुष्टिना गजः ॥
ग्रसन्तमिव सैन्यानि प्रघसं वानराधिपः । सुग्रीवः सप्तपर्णेन निर्बिभेद जघान च ॥
data.es: Sugriva, the Vanara leader, taking hold of Sapataparni tree hit Pratapan who had his mouth open as if to swallow the army and killed him.
data.anv: क्षिप्रहस्तेन as if consuming monkey troops, रक्षसा Rakshasa, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरैः arrows, भिन्नगात्रः opening his throat, वानराधिपः Vanara leader, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, सैन्यानि army, ग्रसन्तमिव as if swallowing, प्रघसम् Praghasan, सप्तपर्णेन Sapataparni, जघानच hit speedily, निर्भिभेद and killed.
data.md: That lord of monkeys, Sugrīva, with a Saptaparma-swiftly slew Praghasa, who appeared to be devouring up the troops.

data.v: प्रपीड्य शरवर्षेण राक्षसं भीमदर्शनम् । निजघान विरूपाक्षं शरेणैकेन लक्ष्मणः ॥
data.md: Tormenting the Räkşasa Virupākṣa of dreadful form, Laksmana killed him with a single arrow.

data.v: अग्निकेतुश्च दुर्धर्षो रश्मिकेतुश्च राक्षसः । सुप्तिघ्नो यज्ञकोपश्च रामं निर्बिभिदुः शरैः ॥
data.es: Agnikethu, a Rakshasa who is difficult to win over, Rasmikethu, Suptaghna and Yajnakepu waged war with Rama.
data.anv: सुदुर्धर्षः difficult to win over, अग्निकेतुः Agnikethu, राक्षसः Rakshasa, रश्मिकेतुश्च and Rasmikethu, सुप्तघ्नुः Suptaghna, यज्ञकेपश्च Yajnakepu, रामेणसह along with Rama, सङ्गताः waged.
data.md: The exceedingly irrepressible Agniketu and the Raksasa Rasmiketu-and Mitraghna and Yajñakopa, were engaged with Rāma.

data.v: तेषां चतुर्णां रामस्तु शिरांसि समरे शरैः । क्रुद्धश्चतुर्भिश्चिच्छेद घोरैरग्निशिखोपमैः ॥
data.es: Raged Rama with his sharp arrows which were like flames of fire destroyed all the four Rakshasas by cutting their heads.
data.anv: निशितैः sharp, रामस्तु even Rama, क्रुद्धः anguished, घोरैः fierce, अग्निशिखोपमैः like flames of fire, चतुर्भिः all the four, शरैः by arrows, तेषाम् them, चतुर्णाम् four, शिरांसि heads, चिच्छेद shattered.
data.md: Thereat, Rāma, growing wroth, in battle severed the heads of those four by means of four shafts, dreadful, and resembling the tongues of a fame.

data.v: वज्रमुष्टिस्तु मैन्देन मुष्टिना निहतो रणे । पपात सरथः साश्वः पुराट्ट इव भूतले ॥
data.es: Even Vajramushti fell on the ground struck with the fist by Mainda and the chariot and charioteer fell like the fort.
data.anv: वज्रमुष्टिस्तु Vajramushti also, रणे in the battle, मैन्देन Mainda, मुष्टिना with fist, निहतः killed, सरथः charioteer, साश्वः horses, पुराट्टःइव like the fort, भूतले on the ground, पपात fell.
data.md: Vajramuști was slain in conflict by Mainda with a clenched fist; and down came he to the ground along with his car and horses, like a turret toppling (headlong.)

data.v: वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शो द्विविदोऽप्यशनिप्रभम् । जघान गिरिशृङ्गेण मिषतां सर्वरक्षसाम् ॥
data.es: Dwivida whose body was like a thunderbolt to feel, moved about on the mountain peak as Rakshasas were watching.
data.anv: वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शः like thunderbolt to touch, द्विविदोपि Dwivida's body, सर्वरक्षसाम् all Rakshasas, मिषताम् watching, गिरिशृङ्गेण mountain peak, अशनिप्रभम् Asaniprabhu, जघान moved about.
data.md: Dvivida, possessed of the touch of the Vajra and thunder bolt, in the presence of the entire Rākşasas host hurled a mountain-peak at him that was endowed with the splendour of the thunder bolt.

data.v: द्विविदं वानरेन्द्रं तु द्रुमयोधिनमाहवे । शरैरशनिसंकाशैः स विव्याधाशनिप्रभः ॥
data.es: Asaniprabha shot arrows resembling lightning at Dwivida the Vanara Lord who was fighting with trees.
data.anv: सःअशनिप्रभः that Asaniprabha, आहवे fighting with, नगयोधिनम् with trees, वानरेन्द्रम् Vanara Lord, तु you, द्विविधम् Dwivida, आशनिसङ्काशैः resembling lightening, शरैः arrows, विव्याध wounded
data.md: Asaniprabha in encounter pierced that foremost of monkeys bearer of trees in conflict, Dvivida, with shafts resembling thunder-bolts.

data.v: स शरैरतिविद्धाङ्गो द्विविदः क्रोधमूर्छितः । सालेन सरथं साश्वं निजघानाशनिप्रभम् ॥
data.es: Dwivida whose limbs have been injured being enraged took Sala tree and killed Asaniprabha and the charioteer as well as the horses.
data.anv: शरैः arrows, अभिविद्धाङ्गः whose limbs have been injured, सःद्विविदः that Dwivida, क्रोधमूर्छितः enraged, सालेन Sala tree, सरथम् charioteer, साश्वम् horses, अशनिप्रभम् Asaniprabha, निजघान killed.
data.md: Thereat, beside himself with wrath, with his entire body wounded with arrows, Dvivida with a sala destroyed Asaniprabha along with his car and horses.

data.v: निकुम्भस्तु रणे नीलं नीलाञ्जनचयप्रभम् । निर्बिभेद शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः करैर्मेघमिवांशुमान् ॥
data.es: Just as the Sun 's rays pierced through clouds Nikumbha was shattered and fell like a mass of collyrium in the battlefield.
data.anv: निकुम्भस्तु Nikumbha also, रणे in battlefield, नीलाञ्जनचयप्रभम् like a mass of dark collyrium, नीलम् Nila, अंशुमान् Sun, करैः dark, मेघमिव cloud like, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरैः arrows, निर्भिभेद shattered.
data.md: Nikumbha in fight wounded Nila resembling a mass of blue collyrium, with sharpened shafts, as the Sun pierce clouds with his rays.

data.v: पुनः शरशतेनाथ क्षिप्रहस्तो निशाचरः । बिभेद समरे नीलं निकुम्भः प्रजहास च ॥
data.es: Nikumbha, the night ranger who was endowed with speed in shooting arrows again shot with a thousand arrows and laughed heartily.
data.anv: क्षिप्रहस्तः endowed with speed in shooting arrows, निशाचरः night ranger, निकुम्भः Nikumbha, अथ there, शरशतेन a thousand arrows, समरे in the battle, नीलम् Nila, पुनः again, बिभेद shattered, प्रजहासच and laughed heartily.
data.md: Again with an hundred arrows, that lighthanded night-ranger pierced Nīla in the field; and Nikumbha laughed thereat.

data.v: तस्यैव रथचक्रेण नीलो विष्णुरिवाहवे । शिरश्चिच्छेद समरे निकुम्भस्य च सारथेः ॥
data.es: Like Lord Vishnu, Nila took the wheels of the chariot of Nikumbha and shattered the charioteer into pieces.
data.anv: नीलः Nila, आहवे, विष्णुरिव like Vishnu, तस्यैव his own, रथचक्रेण chariot wheels, समरे in battle, निकुम्भस्य at Nikumbha, सारथेः charioteer, शिरः head, चिच्छेदः broken to pieces.
data.md: At this, even as Visnu did in battle, Nila with a wheel of his car, cut off in conflict Nikumbha's head together with that of his charioteer.

data.v: विद्युन्माली रथस्थस्तु शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः । सुषेणं ताडयामास ननाद च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
data.es: Vidyunmali mounting the chariot started releasing arrows covered with gold at Sushena and roared.
data.anv: रथस्थः in the chariot, विद्युन्माली Vidyunmali, काञ्चनभूषणैः decorated with gold, शरैः arrows, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, सुषेणम् at Sushena, ताडयामास beating, ननादच roared.
data.md: And Vidyanmālī, mounted on a car, assailed Suşeņa with shafts decked with gold, and behan to shout momentarily.

data.v: तं रथस्थमथो दृष्ट्वा सुषेणो वानरोत्तमः । गिरिशृङ्गेण महता रथमाशु न्यपातयत् ॥
data.es: Nay, Sushena, the leader of Vanaras, saw himself down and Jambumali on top in the chariot. He crushed him with a big mountain peak.
data.anv: अथो Nay!, वानरोत्तमः leader of Vanaras, सुषेणः Sushena, रथस्थम् chariot, तम् him, दृष्टवा top, महता great, गिरिशृङ्गेण peak of the mountain, आशु there, रथम् chariot, न्यपातयत् crushed.
data.md: Seeing him mounted on his car, Suşena-best of monkeys-taking up a huge crag, swiftly brought his car down to the ground.

data.v: लाघवेन तु संयुक्तो विद्युन्माली निशाचरः । अपक्रम्य रथात्तूर्णं गदापाणिः क्षितौ स्थितः ॥
data.es: Vidyunmali seeing Sushena, the monkey leader got a huge rock, and hit him on his chest with the mace.
data.anv: लाघवेन huge, संयुक्तः, निशाचरः night ranger, विद्युन्माली Vidyunmali, रथात् from the chariot, तूर्णम् quickly, अपक्रम्य got down, गदापाणिः mace, क्षितौ placed on the chest, स्थितः remained.
data.md: Thereat, endowed with lightness, that nightranger, Vidyunmāli, at once extricating himself from his car, stood on the ground with a mace in his hand.

data.v: ततः क्रोधसमाविष्टः सुषेणो हरिपुंगवः । शिलां सुमहतीं गृह्य निशाचरमभिद्रवत् ॥
data.es: Thereafter overtaken by anger, the monkey leader Sushena seized the huge rock from the Rakshasa and dropped it.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, क्रोधसमाविष्टः overtaken by anger, हरिपुङ्गवः monkey leader, सुषेणः Sushena, महतीम् huge, शिलाम् rock, गृह्य seizing, निशाचरम् Rakshasa, अभिद्रवत् dropped.
data.md: Thereupon that foremost of monkeys, Sușeņa, growing furious, taking up a gigantic crag, rushed at the night-ranger.

data.v: तमापतन्तं गदया विद्युन्माली निशाचरः । वक्षस्यभिजग्नानाशु सुषेणं हरिसत्तमम् ॥
data.es: Then Vidyunmali, seeing the leader of monkeys getting the huge rock, hit him on the chest with the mace.
data.anv: निशाचरः night ranger, विद्युन्माली Vidyunmali, आपतन्तम् , तम् him, हरिपुङ्गवः leader of monkeys, सुषेणम् Sushena, आशु with, गदया the mace, वक्षसि on the chest, अभिजघानह hit him.
data.md: As he was descending, the night-ranger, Vidyunmālī, with his mace swiftly hit at the breast of Susena-greatest of monkeys.

data.v: गदाप्रहारं तं घोरमचिन्त्यप्लवगोत्तमः । तां शिलां पातयामास तस्योरसि महामृधे ॥
data.es: The great monkey leader Sushena, not caring for the mace, dropped the rock on Vidyunmali's chest.
data.anv: महामृधे great monkey, प्लवगोत्तमः leader of monkeys, घोरम् dreadful, तंगदाप्रहारम् that mace, अच्नित्य not caring, शिलाम् rock, ताम् him, तस्य his, उरसि chest, पातयामास dropped.
data.md: Thereat, without thinking at all of the terrific hit of the mace, that best of monkeys in mighty conflict brought down that upon his head.

data.v: शिलाप्रहाराभिहतो विद्युन्माली निशाचरः । निष्पिष्टहृदयो भूमौ गतासुर्निपपात ह ॥
data.es: Vidyunmali, the Rakshasa hit by the huge rock, was ceased of life.
data.anv: शिलाप्रहाराभिहतः hit by the huge rock, निशाचरः night ranger, विद्युन्माली Vidyunmali, निप्पिष्टहृदयः ceased of life, गतासुः gone, भूमौ on the ground, निपपातह dropped.
data.md: Assailed with the crag, the night-ranger Vidyanmali, having his chest crushed, fell down to the earth, deprived of life.

data.v: एवं तैर्वानरैः शूरैः शूरास्ते रजनीचराः । द्वन्द्वे विमृदितास्तत्र दैत्या इव दिवौकसैः ॥
data.es: In that manner the Rakshasa warriors and the Vanara warriors fought the duel wonderfully and like the way Devatas killed the Demons, the Rakshasas were killed.
data.anv: शूराः warriors, तेरजनीचराः those Rakshasas, शूरैः with warriors, तैःवानरैः those Vanaras, एवम् in that manner, तत्र there, द्वन्द्वे duel fight, दिवौकसैः wonderful, दैत्याइव like Devatas, विमृदिताः delighted.
data.md: Like the celestials warring against the Daityas, the heroic monkeys warred on and confounded the valiant rangers of the night.

data.v: भल्लैः खड्गैर्गदाभिश्च शक्तितोमर पट्टसैः । अपविद्धश्च भिन्नश्च रथैः सांग्रामिकैर्हयैः ॥
निहतैः कुञ्जरैर्मत्तैस्तथा वानरराक्षसैः । चक्राक्षयुगदण्डैश्च भग्नैर्धरणिसंश्रितैः । बभूवायोधनं घोरं गोमायुगणसेवितम् ॥
data.es: The battlefield was dreadful and, frequented by jackals with spears, javelins, maces, and swords, strewn all over, similarly with broken chariots, horses, elephants, and monkeys fit for war. Broken wheels and axles of chariots were found all over.
data.anv: गोमायुगणसेवितम् frequented by groups of jackals, अयोधनम् battlefield, भग्नैः broken, खडगैः swords, गदाभिश्च and maces, शक्तितोमरपट्टिशै: spears javelins maces. अपविद्धैः broken, रथैश्चापि chariots also, तथा similarly, साङ्ग्रामिकैः fit for war, हयैः horses, निहतैः dead, मत्स्सैः by elephants, कुञ्जरैः horses, तथा similarly, वानरराक्षसैः Vanaras and Rakshasas, भग्नैः broken, धरणिसंश्रितैः on the ground, चक्राक्षयुगदण्डैश्च wheels and axles of chariots, घोरम् dreadful, बभूव seemed.

data.v: कबन्धानि समुत्पेतुर्दिक्षु वानररक्षसाम् । विमर्दे तुमुले तस्मिन्देवासुररणोपमे ॥
data.es: It was like the war between Devatas and demons, with the trunks of the bodies of Vanaras and Rakshasas rubbing together lying scattered in all directions.
data.anv: देवासुररणोपमे like the war between Devatas and demons, तस्मिन् their, तुमुले confused, विमर्दे rubbing together, वानररक्षसाम् Vanaras and Rakshasas, कबन्धानि trunks of body, दिक्षु directions, समुत्पेतुः scattered.

data.v: विदार्यमाणा हरिपुंगवैस्तदा; निशाचराः शोणितदिग्धगात्राः । पुनः सुयुद्धं तरसा समाश्रिता; दिवाकरस्यास्तमयाभिकाङ्क्षिणः ॥
data.es: Then the Rakshasas killed by Vanara leaders, their bodies full of blood were looking for sunset and again picking up strength began to battle.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेत्रिचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the forty third sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: तदा then, हरिपुङ्गवैः monkey leader, विदार्यमाणाः killed by, शोणितदिग्धगात्राः full of blood, निशाचराः Rakshasas, दिवाकरस्य sun's, अस्तमयाभिकाङ्क्षिणः looking for Sun set, तरसा, पुनः again, सुयुद्धम् that war, समास्थिता adhering together.
data.md: Thus destroyed by the foremost of monkeys, the rangers of night, beyond themselves with the smell of blood, eagerly wishing for the setting of the Sun, again made active preparation for a renewal of the fight.

data.v: युध्यतामेव तेषां तु तदा वानररक्षसाम् । रविरस्तं गतो रात्रिः प्रवृत्ता प्राणहारिणी ॥
data.es: Thus, as the Vanaras and Rakshasas were battling, the Sun began to set, which is not favourable to the life of Vanaras.
data.anv: तेषाम् their, वानररक्षसाम् Vanara and Rakshasa, युध्यतामेव battling, तदा then, रविः sun, अस्तम् set, गतः went, प्राणहारिणी harmful to the life, रात्रिः night, प्रवृत्ता began.
data.md: As the monkeys and the Rākşasas thus faught on, the sun set, ant the fatal Night came.

data.v: अन्योन्यं बद्धवैराणां घोराणां जयमिच्छताम् । संप्रवृत्तं निशायुद्धं तदा वारणरक्षसाम् ॥
data.es: Then Vanaras and dreadful Rakshasas being strongly inimical to each other started the night battle wishing victory.
data.anv: तदा then, अन्योन्यम् to one another, बद्धवैराणाम् strong enmity, घोराणाम् dreadful, जयम् victory, इच्छताम् wishing, वानररक्षसाम् Vanara and Rakshasas, निशायुद्धम् night battle, सम्प्रवृत्तम् started.
data.md: Then commenced a night-engagement between the dreadful Rākşasas and the monkeys of fixed hostility, each party burning for victory.

data.v: राक्षसोऽसीति हरयो हरिश्चासीति राक्षसाः । अन्योन्यं समरे जघ्नुस्तस्मिंस्तमसि दारुणे ॥
data.es: In the fierce darkness that prevailed, monkeys hit monkeys thinking to be Rakshasas and Rakshasas hit Rakshasas thinking to be Vanaras (not knowing in darkness) hit each other.
data.anv: दारुणे fierce, तस्मिन् them, तमसि darkness, राक्षसःअसि thinking to be Rakshasa, इति thus, हरयः monkeys, हरिश्च and monkeys, असि thinking to be, इति thus, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, समरे fought, अन्योन्यम् one another, जघ्नुः hit .
data.md: In that profound darkness, the monkeys and the Rākşasas began to slay each other, exclaiming, You are a Raksasa,' and 'you are a monkey.'

data.v: जहि दारय चैतीति कथं विद्रवसीति च । एवं सुतुमुलः शब्दस्तस्मिंस्तमसि शुश्रुवे ॥
data.es: "Strike", "Tear", "Why are you running away?" were the kind of tumultuous echo heard in the darkness of the night. In that darkness the dark complexioned Vanaras and Rakshasas covered with golden armour in the night seemed like shining herbs of the forest in the mountain.
data.anv: जहिदारय strike, चैहीति tear, कथं how, विद्रवसीतिच why do you run away, एवं in this manner, सुतुमुलश्शब्द loud echo, स्तस्मिं such was, स्तमसि darkness, शुश्रुवे heard, तस्मिन् such was, तमसि dark complexioned, कालाः night, काञ्चनसन्नाहाः covered with golden armour, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, दीप्तौषधिवनाः shining like the herbs in the forests, शैलेन्द्राः mountain, सम्प्रदृश्यन्त appeared.
data.md: And in that army there was heard a mighty uproar of 'slain,' 'rive!" 'come!' 'why fliest?'

data.v: कालाः काञ्चनसंनाहास्तस्मिंस्तमसि राक्षसाः । संप्रादृश्यन्त शैलेन्द्रा दीप्तौषधिवना इव ॥
data.es: "Strike", "Tear", "Why are you running away?" were the kind of tumultuous echo heard in the darkness of the night. In that darkness the dark complexioned Vanaras and Rakshasas covered with golden armour in the night seemed like shining herbs of the forest in the mountain.
data.anv: जहिदारय strike, चैहीति tear, कथं how, विद्रवसीतिच why do you run away, एवं in this manner, सुतुमुलश्शब्द loud echo, स्तस्मिं such was, स्तमसि darkness, शुश्रुवे heard, तस्मिन् such was, तमसि dark complexioned, कालाः night, काञ्चनसन्नाहाः covered with golden armour, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, दीप्तौषधिवनाः shining like the herbs in the forests, शैलेन्द्राः mountain, सम्प्रदृश्यन्त appeared.
data.md: And, dark-hued, the Raksasas, equipped in golden mail, in that deep darkness appeared like elevated hills clad with woods of flaming incdicinal herbs.

data.v: तस्मिंस्तमसि दुष्पारे राक्षसाः क्रोधमूर्छिताः । परिपेतुर्महावेगा भक्षयन्तः प्लवंगमान् ॥
data.es: In that pitch darkness, which was difficult even to move, the Rakshasas overcome by anger and lost senses were wandering devouring the monkeys.
data.anv: दुष्पारे difficult to penetrate, तस्मिन् in that, तमसि darkness, क्रोधमूर्छिता lost senses overcome by anger, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, प्लवङ्गमान् monkeys, भक्षयन्तः devouring, महावेगाः swiftly, परिपेतुः wandered.
data.md: And in that limitless gloom, the Rākṣasas, transported with wrath, advanced with impetuous speed, devouring monkeys.

data.v: ते हयान्काञ्चनापीडन्ध्वजांश्चाग्निशिखोपमान् । आप्लुत्य दशनैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भीमकोपा व्यदारयन् ॥
data.es: The mighty strong Vanaras, terribly angry at the Rakshasas sprang up to the sky, and tore with their sharp teeth, the horses of Rakshasas decked with golden ornaments pervading like fire in the battle.
data.anv: भीमकोपाः terribly angry, बलिनः mighty strong, तेवानराः those Vanaras, आप्लुत्य springing up, तीक्ष्णैः their sharp, धवनैः teeth, काञ्चनापीडान् golden ornaments, हयान् horses, आशीविषोपमान् pervading like fire, ध्वजांश्च of the horses, व्यदारयन् splitting, युद्धे in battle, राक्षसीम् Rakshasa's, चमूम् , अक्षोभयन् tore to pieces.
data.md: And, fired with terrible wrath, they, bounding up, with their sharp tecih tore up steeds caparisoned in gold, and standards resembling venomous serpents. *i.e. the monkeys, as appears from the context.

data.v: कुञ्जरान्कुञ्जरारोहान्पताकाध्वजिनो रथान् । चकर्षुश्च ददंशुश्च दशनैः क्रोधमूर्छिताः ॥
data.es: Having lost senses in fury they dragged the elephants, those mounted upon them, and the chariots decorated with posts and flags and tore them with their teeth.
data.anv: व्यदारयन् lost sense with anger, कुञ्जरान् elephants, कुञ्जरारोहान् mounted on elephants, पताकाध्वजिनः posts tied with flags, रथान् chariots, चकर्षुः dragged them, दशनैः with teeth, ददंशुश्च destroyed.
data.md: The lusty monkeys in battle agitated the Rāks asa host, and, waxing furious, with their teeth pulled and bit elephants and the riders there of, and cars furnished with flags and standards.

data.v: लक्ष्मणश्चापि रामश्च शरैराशीविषोमपैः । दृश्यादृश्यानि रक्षांसि प्रवराणि निजघ्नतुः ॥
data.es: Then Rama as well as Lakshmana with their venomous snakelike arrows killed both visible and invisible principal Rakshasas.
data.anv: रामश्च Rama as well, लक्ष्मणश्चापि as Lakshmana also, आशीविषोपमैः shining like venomous snakes, शरैः arrows, दृश्यादृश्यानि visible and invisible, प्रवराणि principal, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, निजघ्नतुः killed
data.md: Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa with shafts resembling venomous serpents, slaughtered the foremost among the Rakşasas-both those that were seen and those that were not.

data.v: तुरंगखुरविध्वस्तं रथनेमिसमुद्धतम् । रुरोध कर्णनेत्राणिण्युध्यतां धरणीरजः ॥
data.es: Then the dust rose from the ground pulverised the horses' hooves and crushed by the chariot wheels, filling the ears and eyes of those in war.
data.anv: तुरङ्गखुरविध्वस्तम् pulverised by the horses hooves, रथनेमिसमुत्थितम् crushed by the wheels of chariots, धरणीरजः dust from the ground, युध्यताम् risen, कर्णनेत्राणि ears and eyes, रुरोध filled.
data.md: The dust of the earth arising from warring combatants, and from the hoofs of horses and the wheels of cars, choked up eye and ear.

data.v: वर्तमाने तथा घोरे संग्रामे लोमहर्षणे । रुधिरोदा महावेगा नद्यस्तत्र प्रसुस्रुवुः ॥
data.es: In that way as the war was going on, and rivers of blood flowing with the terrific noise it made hair stand on end.
data.anv: तथा like that, घोरे terrible, रोमहर्षणे horripilation, सङ्ग्रामे war, वर्तमाने moving, रुधिरोधा river of blood, महाघोराः terrific, नद्यः noise, तत्र there, प्रसुस्रुवुः flowed.
data.md: And as the mighty envounter, capable of making people's hair stand on end, went on, there flowed a fearful river of gore.

data.v: ततो भेरीमृदङ्गानां पणवानां च निस्वनः । शङ्खवेणुस्वनोन्मिश्रः संबभूवाद्भुतोपमः ॥
data.es: There arose wonderful sounds of musical instruments, the sounds of kettle drums, wooden drums, mixed with conchs and flutes.
data.anv: ततः there, भेरीमृदङ्गानाम् kettle drums and wooden drums, पणवानांच musical instrument panava, शङ्खवेणुस्वनोमनिश्रः sounds of conchs, flutes mixed, अद्भुतोपमः wonderful, निस्स्वनः rattling sounds, सम्बभूव arose.
data.md: The sounds of kettle-drums and Mşdangas and Panavas, mingled with those of conchs and carwheels, were wonderful (to hear).

data.v: हतानां स्तनमानानां राक्षसानां च निस्वनः । शस्त्राणां वानराणां च संबभूवातिदारुणः ॥
data.es: There from the battlefield arose the roaring sounds of wounded and appeased Rakshasas and Vanaras.
data.anv: अत्र there, स्तनमानानाम् in the battlefield, हतानाम् wounded, राक्षसानांच Rakshasas, शस्तानाम् appeased, वानराणांच and Vanaras, दारुणः dreadful, निःस्वनः roaring sounds, सम्बभूव arose.
data.md: The sounds of steeds neighing, and Rāks asas (roaring) and monkeys, rejoicing, were something tremendous.

data.v: शस्त्रपुष्पोपहारा च तत्रासीद्युद्धमेदिनी । दुर्ज्ञेया दुर्निवेशा च शोणितास्रवकर्दमा ॥
data.es: There with warriors of Vanaras wounded by javelins, tridents and axes, and the Rakshasas of mountain size who could change their form at will, the battlefield was muddy, and wet with blood flowing and difficult to reach.
data.anv: तत्र there, शस्त्रपुष्पोपहारा offering of flowers dropped from enemies (from the mountain), युद्धमेदिनी on the battlefield, हतैः killed, वानरवीरैश्च Vanara warriors also, शक्तिशूलपरश्वधैः by javelins, tridents and axes, निहतैः wounded, कामरूपिभिः who can change their form at will, पर्वताकारैः of mountain size, राक्षसैः Rakshasa, शोणितास्रावकर्दमा wetted by the flow of blood, दुर् ज्ञेया muddy, दुर्निवेशाच difficult to reach, आसीत् remained.
data.md: And, with able monkeys slain; and darts and javelins and axes; and slaughtered Raksasa wearing forms at pleasure, lying mountain likethe field of battle, seeming to have offerings of arms representing flowers, became difficult to recognise, and inaccessible; and the earth was drenched with streams of blood.

data.v: सा बभूव निशा घोरा हरिराक्षसहारिणी । कालरात्रीव भूतानां सर्वेषां दुरतिक्रमा ॥
data.es: Like the dreadful night for all beings, difficult to spend, as if it were a dissolution, destructive to Vanaras and Rakshasas.
data.anv: सर्वेषाम् for all beings, भूतानाम् beings, दुरतिक्रमा difficult to pass, कालरात्रीव like the night of dissolution, सानिशा that night, घोरा fierce, हरिराक्षसनाशिनी destructive to Vanaras and Rakshasas, बभूव remained.
data.md: That Night, destructive to monkeys and Rākş asas, was dreadful, and difficult of being outsped by all, like to the Fatal Night of beings.

data.v: ततस्ते राक्षसास्तत्र तस्मिंस्तमसि दारुणे । राममेवाभ्यधावन्त संहृष्टा शरवृष्टिभिः ॥
data.es: Thereafter in that exceedingly fearsome dark night in the battlefield highly delighted Rakshasas assailed Rama with a rain of arrows.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, तत्र there, परमदारुणे exceedingly fearsome, तस्मिन् तमसि in that dark night, तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, सम्हृष्टाः highly delighted, शरवृष्टिभिः rain of arrows, राममेव Rama himself, अभ्यवर्तन्त assailed.
data.md: And in that attacked Rama with a shower of shafts.

data.v: तेषामापततां शब्दः क्रुद्धानामभिगर्जताम् । उद्वर्त इव सप्तानां समुद्राणामभूत्स्वनः ॥
data.es: The thundering noise of the angry Rakshasas rushing towards Rama was like the seven seas rising to flow into the ocean.
data.anv: क्रुद्धानाम् angry Rakshasas, गर्जताम् thundering, आपतताम् rushing towards, तेषाम् them, शब्दः noise, सत्त्वानाम् seven seas, उद्वर्ते risen to flow, समुद्राणाम् into ocean, प्रशुश्रुवे heard.
data.md: The roars of those beings as they advanced, sending up shouts in anger, resembled the dashing of the Ocean at the time of the universal dissolution.

data.v: तेषां रामः शरैः षड्भिः षड्जघान निशाचरान् । निमेषान्तरमात्रेण शितैरग्निशिखोपमैः ॥
data.md: In the twinkling of an eye, Räma by means of six shafts resembling tongues of flames, struck six of the night-rangers, viz., Yajñaśatru, irrepressible (in fight), and Mahaparsva, and Mahodara, and the huge bodied Vajradanstra, and those two-Suka and Sarana.

data.v: यज्ञशत्रुश्च दुर्धर्षो महापार्श्वमहोदरौ । वज्रदंष्ट्रो महाकायस्तौ चोभौ शुकसारणौ ॥
data.md: In the twinkling of an eye, Räma by means of six shafts resembling tongues of flames, struck six of the night-rangers, viz., Yajñaśatru, irrepressible (in fight), and Mahaparsva, and Mahodara, and the huge bodied Vajradanstra, and those two-Suka and Sarana.

data.v: ते तु रामेण बाणौघः सर्वमर्मसु ताडिताः । युद्धादपसृतास्तत्र सावशेषायुषोऽभवन् ॥
data.md: And, pierced in their vitals with Rama's shafts, they, having only their lives left to them, disappeared from the field.

data.v: ततः काञ्चनचित्राङ्गैः शरैरग्निशिखोपमैः । दिशश्चकार विमलाः प्रदिशश्च महाबलः ॥
data.es: Mighty Rama with his shafts that were like flames of fire, decorated with gold, brightened in all directions.
data.anv: महारथः mighty, तत्रकाञ्चनचित्रङ्गैः decorated with gold, शरैः shafts, अग्निशिखोपमैः like the flames of fire, दिशश्च in all the directions, प्रदिशश्च brightened, विमलाः bright, चकार created.

data.v: ये त्वन्ये राक्षसा वीरा रामस्याभिमुखे स्थिताः । तेऽपि नष्टाः समासाद्य पतंगा इव पावकम् ॥
data.es: Those fierce Rakshasas who stood in front of Rama were destroyed like fireflies fallen in fire.
data.anv: रामस्य Rama's, अभिमुखे in front, स्थिताः stood, अन्ये other, ये who so ever, भीमा fierce, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, तेऽपि be it, पावकम् fire, आसाद्य fallen, पतङ्गाःइव like fireflies, नष्टाः destroyed.
data.md: Then in the twinkling of an eye, that Mahāratha rendered all sides clear (of all gloom) by means of arrows resembling tongues of fire; and those other heroic Raksasas that were in front of Rāma, were destroyed on approaching the place, like insects approaching a fire.

data.v: सुवर्णपुङ्खैर्विशिखैः संपतद्भिः सहस्रशः । बभूव रजनी चित्रा खद्योतैरिव शारदी ॥
data.es: By the rain of thousands of golden feathered arrows, the night appeared as if illumined by fireflies and like a wonderful autumnal night.
data.anv: सहस्रशः thousands, सम्पतद्भिः raining, सुवर्णपुङ्खैः golden feathered, विशिखैः arrows, रजनी night, खद्योतैः illumined by fireflies, शारदीव in autumnal, चित्रा wonderful, बभूव appeared.
data.md: And with shafts plated with gold lying in all directions the night resembled one in autumn decked with fire-flies.

data.v: राक्षसानां च निनदैर्हरीणां चापि गर्जितैः । सा बभूव निशा घोरा भूयो घोरतरा तदा ॥
data.es: The night which was fierce appeared more dreadful with the loud noise of Rakshasas and Vanaras.
data.anv: घोरा fierce, सानिशा that night, तदा then, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, हरीणाम् Vanaras, निस्स्वनैःच making noise, भूयः appeared, घोरतरा more dreadful, बभूव was.
data.md: And in consequence of the uproar occasioned by the Rakşasas, and the sounds of drums, that night, already dreadful (in itself), became all the more so,

data.v: तेन शब्देन महता प्रवृद्धेन समन्ततः । त्रिकूटः कन्दराकीर्णः प्रव्याहरदिवाचलः ॥
data.es: Resounding with the sound rising all over the caves of Trikuta mountain echoed and it looked as if the mountain was responding to someone's call.
data.anv: समन्ततः all over, प्रवृद्धेन risen, महता huge, तेन by that, शब्देन sound, कन्धराकीर्णः groups of caves, त्रिकूटःअचलः Trikuta mountain, प्रव्याहरदिव responded as if it was someone's call.
data.md: On that sound attaining dimensions on all sides, it seemed as if the mount Trikuta, containing numerous caverns, had been speaking.

data.v: गोलाङ्गूला महाकायास्तमसा तुल्यवर्चसः । संपरिष्वज्य बाहुभ्यां भक्षयन्रजनीचरान् ॥
data.es: The dark complexioned Rakshasas of gigantic body, who were highly energetic were held tightly by the monkeys with black faces and long tails and allowed them to be devoured.
data.anv: महाकायाः of gigantic body, तमसा dark complexioned, तुल्यवर्चसः highly energetic, गोलाङ्गूलाः endowed with long tails and black face, बाहुभ्याम् with their shoulders, सम्परिष्वज्य holding, रजनीचरान् Rakshasas, भक्षयन् allowed to be devoured.
data.md: And huge-bodied Golangulas of equal lustre with darkness itself binding fast the nightrangers with their arms, began to swallow them up.

data.v: अङ्गदस्तु रणे शत्रुं निहन्तुं समुपस्थितः । रावणेर्निजघानाशु सारथिं च हयानपि ॥
data.es: Angada who was determined to kill the enemies, in no time wounded Ravana's charioteer and also the horses.
data.anv: रणे in war, शत्रून् enemies, निहन्तुम् killing, समुपस्थितः who stood determined, अङ्गदस्तु Angada's, आशु in no time, रावणिम् Ravana's, सारथिंच charioteer, हयानपि horses also, निजघान wounded.

data.v: इन्द्रजित्तु रथं त्यक्त्वा हताश्वो हतसारथिः । अङ्गदेन महामायस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥
data.es: As the violent war was going on, the great cheat, Indrajith disappeared from there as Angada had already killed his horses and charioteer.
data.anv: तदा then, घोरे terrific, भृशदारुणे violent, सङ्ग्रामे from the battlefield, अङ्गदेन by Angada, हताश्वः horses being killed, हतसारथिः charioteer killed, महामायः great cheater, इन्द्रजित्तु Indrajith, तत्स्रैव himself, अन्तरधीयत disappeared.

data.v: सोऽन्तर्धान गतः पापो रावणी रणकर्कशः । ब्रह्मदत्तवरो वीरो रावणिः क्रोधमूर्छितः । अदृश्यो निशितान्बाणान्मुमोचाशनिवर्चसः ॥
data.es: That sinful son of Ravana, who is capable of encountering rising up remained invisible and shot sharp arrows.
data.anv: पापः sinful, रणकर्कशः capable of encounter, सःरावणि that Ravana, अदृश्यः rising up, अशनिवर्चसः remaining invisible, निशितान् sharp arrows, बाणान् by arrows, मुमोच remained.
data.md: And, being handled hard in battle, and having vanished from the field, the heroic and wicked son to Răvana, who had received a boon from Brahmä, transported with passion, remaining invisible, began to discharge sharpened shafts of the splendour of the thunder-bolt.

data.v: स रामं लक्ष्मणं चैव घोरैर्नागमयैः शरैः । बिभेद समरे क्रुद्धः सर्वगात्रेषु राक्षसः ॥
data.es: The angry Rakshasa (remaining invisible) pierced arrows full of serpents all over the body of Rama and Lakshmana.
data.anv: क्रुद्धः angry, समरे in war, घोरैः terrific, नागमयैः full of serpents, शरैः arrows, राक्षसः Rakshasa, रामंच at Rama, लक्ष्मणंचैव and Lakshmana, सर्वगात्रेषु all over the body, बिभेद pierced.
data.md: And worked up into rage, he in the conflict pierced Raghu's sons, Rāma and Lakşmaņa all over their bodies, with terrific arrows consisting of serpents.

data.v: स तस्य गतिमन्विच्छन्राजपुत्रः प्रतापवान् । दिदेशातिबलो रामो दशवानरयूथपान् ॥
data.es: Rama, the son of the king, a powerful and strong warrior, ordered ten Vanaras to know the whereabouts (of Indrajith).
data.anv: राजपुत्रः king's son, प्रतापवान् powerful, अतिबलः very strong, सःरामः Rama, तस्य his, गतिम् where about, अन्विच्छन् to know, दश ten, वानरयूथपान् Vanara troops, दिदेश assigned.
data.md: Then, anxious to ascertain his* course, the king's son possessed of prowess, and endowed with exceeding strength, Rāma, ordered ten of the monkey-leaders. * Indrajit's.

data.v: द्वौ सुषेणस्य दायादौ नीलं च प्लवगर्षभम् । अङ्गदं वालिपुत्रं च शरभं च तरस्विनम् ॥
data.es: Rama, the scorcher of enemies, ordered the two sons of Sushena, the best of Vanaras Neela, Jambavantha, Angada, as well as courageous Sarabha, Vinatha, and Hanumantha and Sanuprastha endowed with extraordinary might, also Rshaba and Rshaba Skanda.
data.anv: परन्तप scorcher of enemies, सुषेणस्य to Sushena, द्वौ both, दायादौ Dwivida, प्लवगर्षपम् best of Vanaras, नीलंच and Neela, जाम्बवन्तंच and Jambavantha, अङ्गदम् Angada, तरस्विनम् courageous, शरभंच Sarabha, विनतंच Vinatha, हनूमन्तम् Hanumantha, महाबलम् mighty strong, सानुप्रस्थम् Sanuprastha, ऋषभंच and Rshabam, ऋषभस्कन्धम् Rshaba Skanda, आदिदेश ordered.
data.md: The repressor of foes ordered Väli's sonAngada, the vigorous Śarabha, Dvivida, Hanumān, the mighty Sānuprastha, Rşabha and Rşabhaskandha.

data.v: विनतं जाम्बवन्तं च सानुप्रस्थं महाबलम् । ऋषभं चर्षभस्कन्धमादिदेश परंतपः ॥
data.es: Rama, the scorcher of enemies, ordered the two sons of Sushena, the best of Vanaras Neela, Jambavantha, Angada, as well as courageous Sarabha, Vinatha, and Hanumantha and Sanuprastha endowed with extraordinary might, also Rshaba and Rshaba Skanda.
data.anv: परन्तप scorcher of enemies, सुषेणस्य to Sushena, द्वौ both, दायादौ Dwivida, प्लवगर्षपम् best of Vanaras, नीलंच and Neela, जाम्बवन्तंच and Jambavantha, अङ्गदम् Angada, तरस्विनम् courageous, शरभंच Sarabha, विनतंच Vinatha, हनूमन्तम् Hanumantha, महाबलम् mighty strong, सानुप्रस्थम् Sanuprastha, ऋषभंच and Rshabam, ऋषभस्कन्धम् Rshaba Skanda, आदिदेश ordered.

data.v: ते संप्रहृष्टा हरयो भीमानुद्यम्य पादपान् । आकाशं विविशुः सर्वे मार्गामाणा दिशो दश ॥
data.es: All those monkeys, exceedingly rejoiced, held huge trees, and went in ten directions searching and sprang to the sky.
data.anv: सर्वे all, तेहरयः those monkeys, सम्प्रहृष्टाः exceedingly delighted, भीमान् huge, मार्गमाणा searching, दिशोदशः ten directions, पादपान् held huge trees, आकाशं sky, विविशुस्सर्वे sprang.
data.md: Thereat with alacrity those monkeys, wielding mighty trees, shot up into the sky, and began to scour the ten cardinal points.

data.v: तेषां वेगवतां वेगमिषुभिर्वेगवत्तरैः । अस्त्रवित्परमास्त्रेण वारयामास रावणिः ॥
data.es: Ravana's son being skilled in the use of weapons and an expert in mystic powers, he prohibited the speed of the Vanaras with his swift arrows.
data.anv: अस्त्रवित् skilled in the use of weapons, रावणिः Ravana's son, परमास्तै: expert in mystic weapons, वेगवत्तरैः endowed with speed, इषुभिः arrows, वेगवताम् charged with energy, तेषाम् them, वेगम् swiftly, वारयामास prohibited
data.md: And Ravana's son, skilled in arms, resisted the impetuous march of those vehement ones by means of a powerful weapon as well as arms more forceful (than the force of their rush).

data.v: तं भीमवेगा हरयो नाराचैः क्षतविक्षताः । अन्धकारे न ददृशुर्मेघैः सूर्यमिवावृतम् ॥
data.es: The Vanaras were mangled with iron arrows, however endowed with high speed they could not make out Indrajith in utter darkness just as the sun covered by clouds.
data.anv: नाराचैः iron arrows, क्षतविग्रहाः mangled, भीमवेगाः endowed with high speed, हरयः Vanaras, अन्धकारे in utter darkness, तम् him, Indrajith मेघैः cloud, आवृतम् covered, सूर्यमिव like Sun, नददृशुः not seen.
data.md: The exceedingly vehement monkeys, cut and mangled with Nărăcas, saw him in the dark like the sun enveloped in clouds.

data.v: रामलक्ष्मणयोरेव सर्वमर्मभिदः शरान् । भृशमावेशयामास रावणिः समितिंजयः ॥
data.es: Indrajith who is ever victorious, pierced repeatedly arrows all over the body of Rama and Lakshmana.
data.anv: समितिञ्जयः ever victorious, रावणिः Indrajith, सर्वदेहभिदः all over the body, शरान् arrows, भृशम् repeatedly, रामलक्ष्मणयोरेव on Rama and Lakshmana, आवेशयामास pierced.
data.md: That conqueror in battle, Ravana's son, with shafts sorely pierced the persons of Rāma and Laksmana.

data.v: निरन्तरशरीरौ तु भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । क्रुद्धेनेन्द्रजिता वीरौ पन्नगैः शरतां गतैः ॥
data.es: Both Rama and Lakshmana were pierced by furious Indrajith with serpents like arrows furious.
data.anv: वीरौ heroic, तौ they, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, उभौ both, क्रुद्धेन furious, इन्द्रजिता Indrajith, शरताम् with arrows, गतैः pierced, पन्नगैः serpents, निरन्तरशरीरौ all over the body
data.md: And both Rāma and Lakşmaņa had their bodies entirely covered by the angry Indrajit with shafts turned into serpents.

data.v: तयोः क्षतजमार्गेण सुस्राव रुधिरं बहु । तावुभौ च प्रकाशेते पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ ॥
data.es: Both Rama and Lakshmana bleeding excessively, wounded profusely, looked bright and red like Kimsuka trees with flowers.
data.anv: तयोः both of them, क्षतजमार्गेण wounded profusely, बहु excessively, रुधिरम् red with blood, सुस्राव flowing, तौ they, उभौ both, पुष्पितौ flowery, किंशुकौइव like Kimsuka trees, प्रकाशितौ looked bright.
data.md: And from their wounds blood began to gush out in streams; and they looked like flowercrowned Kinsukas.

data.v: ततः पर्यन्तरक्ताक्षो भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपमः । रावणिर्भ्रातरौ वाक्यमन्तर्धानगतोऽब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Then Ravana's son with the corner of his eyes turned red in anger looking like a huge collyrium, vanished from there and spoke these words to the two brothers, Rama, and Lakshmana.
data.anv: ततः then, पर्यन्तरक्ताक्षः corners of eyes turned red, भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपमः like a huge collyrium, रावणिः Ravana's son, अन्तर्धानगतः vanished, भ्रातरौ brothers, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: Then that one having red corners to his eyes and resembling a mass of crushed collyrium, Rāvana's son, said to the brothers, as he vanished.

data.v: युध्यमानमनालक्ष्यं शक्रोऽपि त्रिदशेश्वरः । द्रष्टुमासादितुं वापि न शक्तः किं पुनर्युवाम् ॥
data.es: Indrajith who had fire like eyes, said," even the ruler of gods cannot discern while I am fighting war, why speak about you? It is not possible."
data.anv: अनालक्षयम् who has fire like eyes, युध्यमानम् while fighting war, त्रिदशेश्वरः Lord of gods, शक्रोऽपि Indra also, द्रष्टुम् to see, आसादितुंनापि cannot discern, नशक्तः not possible, युवाम् for you, किंपुनः why again
data.md: When I fight remaining invisible, even Sakrathe lord of the celestials-cannot see or approach me, and who are you?

data.v: प्रावृताविषुजालेन राघवौ कङ्कपत्रिणा । एष रोषपरीतात्मा नयामि यमसादनम् ॥
data.es: "Raghava brothers! You are enmeshed with plumes of arrows all over the body. My anger will not go waste. I will send you to the abode of Yama, the Lord of death."
data.anv: राघवौ Raghava brothers, कङ्कपत्रिणा plumes of arrows, शरजालेन by the fire of arrows, प्रावृतौ enmeshed, रोषपरीतात्मा my anger, एषः in that way, यमसादनम् to the abode of Lord of death, नयामि am about to senddispatch you.
data.md: And I, with my soul surcharged with wrath, shall, assailing them with showers of weapons furnished with Karka feathers, send Raghu's sons to the abode of Yama."

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा तु धर्मज्ञौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । निर्बिभेद शितैर्बाणैः प्रजहर्ष ननाद च ॥
data.es: Indrajith having spoken to the righteous brothers Rama and Lakshmana in that way, began to pain them with arrows and stood rejoiced roaring aloud.
data.anv: धर्मज्ञौ righteous, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having been told, शितैः stood, बाणैः arrows, निर्बिभेद paining, प्रजहर्ष rejoiced, ननादच roaring aloud.
data.md: Having spoken thus to the brothers-Rāma and Laksmana, cognizant of righteousness-(Indrajit)pierced them with sharpened shafts, and shouted in joy.

data.v: भिन्नाञ्जनचयश्यामो विस्फार्य विपुलं धनुः । भूयो भूयः शरान्घोरान्विससर्ज महामृधे ॥
data.es: Indrajith who was like a mass of crushed black hill, mounting the huge bow released terrific arrows again and again in that great conflict.
data.anv: भिन्नाञ्जनचयश्यामः like a crushed black hill, विपुलम् huge, धनुः bow, विस्फार्यः mounting, महामृथे great conflict, भूयोभूय again and again, घोरान् terrific, शरान् arrows, विससर्ज released.
data.md: And stretching his large bow, that one sable like to a mass of crushed collyrium again discharged terrific shafts in battle.

data.v: ततो मर्मसु मर्मज्ञो मज्जयन्निशिताञ्शरान् । रामलक्ष्मणयोर्वीरो ननाद च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
data.es: There after that warrior went on digging sharp arrows into the vital parts of Rama and Lakshmana again and again and kept roaring.
data.anv: मर्मज्ञः vital, वीरः warrior, ततः thereafter, रामलक्ष्मणयोः Rama and Lakshmana, मर्मसु vital parts, निशितान् sharp, शरान् arrows, मज्जयन् digging, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, ननादच kept roaring.
data.md: That one versed in the inner sense of things, with whetted arrows pierced the vitals of Rāma and Lakşmaņa and shouted momentarily.

data.v: बद्धौ तु शरबन्धेन तावुभौ रणमूर्धनि । निमेषान्तरमात्रेण न शेकतुरुदीक्षितुम् ॥
data.es: In a fraction of a second, both Rama and Lakshmana facing the battle were bound by arrows and did not have energy to retaliate.
data.anv: रणमूर्धनि facing the battle, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in a fraction of twinkling of an eye, बद्धौ bound, तौउभौ both of them, उदीक्षितुम् to retaliate, नशेकतुः not have energy.
data.md: And fast bound by the shackles of shafts on the edge of battle, they* could not attain respite for a moment, *i.e. Rama and Laksmana.

data.v: ततो विभिन्नसर्वाङ्गौ शरशल्याचितावुभौ । ध्वजाविव महेन्द्रस्य रज्जुमुक्तौ प्रकम्पितौ ॥
data.es: Pierced all over their bodies with the heads of arrows, the gallant princes freed themselves from the cords by shaking violently like the banners of Indra. Pained by the hurting of the vital parts of both the princes, the Lords of the world fell.
data.anv: ततः and then, विभिन्नसर्वाङ्गौ pierced all over the body, शरशल्याचितौ with heads of arrows, कृतौ staggered, रज्जुमुक्तौ freed from their cords, प्रकम्पितौ violently, महेन्द्रस्य Indra's ध्वजाविव like banners, सम्प्रचलितौ shaking, वीरौ heroes, मर्मभेदेन in vital parts, कर्शितौ pained, महेष्वासौ gallant princes, जगतीपती Lords of the world, तौ both, जगत्याम् world, निपेततुः fell.
data.md: Then with their persons pierced with shafts and darts, and resembling the flags of the Great Indra let loose from the cords and trembling (in the air), and with their bodies bristling with arrows, those heroes and mighty bowmen-lords of the earth-tormented in consequence of their vitals having been pierced, dropped down to the earth.

data.v: तौ संप्रचलितौ वीरौ मर्मभेदेन कर्शितौ । निपेततुर्महेष्वासौ जगत्यां जगतीपती ॥
data.es: Pierced all over their bodies with the heads of arrows, the gallant princes freed themselves from the cords by shaking violently like the banners of Indra. Pained by the hurting of the vital parts of both the princes, the Lords of the world fell.
data.anv: ततः and then, विभिन्नसर्वाङ्गौ pierced all over the body, शरशल्याचितौ with heads of arrows, कृतौ staggered, रज्जुमुक्तौ freed from their cords, प्रकम्पितौ violently, महेन्द्रस्य Indra's ध्वजाविव like banners, सम्प्रचलितौ shaking, वीरौ heroes, मर्मभेदेन in vital parts, कर्शितौ pained, महेष्वासौ gallant princes, जगतीपती Lords of the world, तौ both, जगत्याम् world, निपेततुः fell.
data.md: Then with their persons pierced with shafts and darts, and resembling the flags of the Great Indra let loose from the cords and trembling (in the air), and with their bodies bristling with arrows, those heroes and mighty bowmen-lords of the earth-tormented in consequence of their vitals having been pierced, dropped down to the earth.

data.v: तौ वीरशयने वीरौ शयानौ रुधिरोक्षितौ । शरवेष्टितसर्वाङ्गावार्तौ परमपीडितौ ॥
data.es: The princes were lying on the warrior's bed in the battlefield, their limbs fully covered with arrows, in a highly distressed state.
data.anv: वीरशयने warrior's bed, शयानौ bed, रुधिरोक्षितौ drenched in blood, शरवेष्टितसर्वाङ्गै all their limbs covered with arrows, परमपीडितौ highly distressed, तौवीरौ those warriors, आर्तौ lying.
data.md: Those heroes, bathed in blood and their persons covered with arrows-pained and suffering terribly, lay down as became heroes.

data.v: न ह्यविद्धं तयोर्गात्रं बभूवाङ्गुलमन्तरम् । नानिर्भिन्नं न चास्तब्धमा कराग्रादजिह्मगैः ॥
data.es: Not an inch of space on their bodies remained without being pierced. Not even a part of the body was left unshaken, unhurt, or wounded.
data.anv: योः their, गात्रे in the body, अविद्धम् not wounded, अङ्गुळमात्रम् not even finger breadth space (an inch of space), अन्तरम् all over, नबभूव remained without being pierced, अजिह्मगैः unhurt, आकराग्रात् not even a part of the body was left, अनिर्भिन्नम् not wounded, अस्तब्दम् unshaken, न not.
data.md: There was not so much room unpierced in their persons as could be measured by a finger; and they were wounded with arrows up to the fore-parts of their hands.

data.v: तौ तु क्रूरेण निहतौ रक्षसा कामरूपिणा । असृक्सुस्रुवतुस्तीव्रं जलं प्रस्रवणाविव ॥
data.es: Wounded by the cruel Rakshasas capable of changing form at their will, blood flowed from their body copiously like water from spring bringing out their vital life breaths.
data.anv: क्रूरेण by the cruel, कामरूपिणा capable of acquiring desired form, रक्षसा Rakshasa, निहतौ wounded, तौ both, प्रस्रवणौ flowed, जलम् इव like water, तीव्रम् copiously, असृक् vital breaths, सुस्रुवतुः brought forth.
data.md: They being wounded by that fell one capable of assuming shapes at will, blood violently gushed out of their bodies like water from a spring.

data.v: पपात प्रथमं रामो विद्धो मर्मसु मार्गणैः । क्रोधादिन्द्रजिता येन पुरा शक्रो विनिर्जितः ॥
data.es: Rama fell first pierced by arrows in his vital parts released in anger by Indrajith, by whom Indra was utterly defeated.
data.anv: येन by whom, पुरा earlier, शक्रः Indra, विनिर्जितः utterly defeated, इन्द्रजिता Indrajith, क्रोधात् in anger, मार्गणैः arrows, मर्मसु vital parts, विद्धः, रामः Rama, प्रधमम् first, पपात fell.

data.v: नारचैरर्धनाराचैर्भल्लैरञ्जलिकैरपि । विव्याध वत्सदन्तैश्च सिंहदंष्ट्रैः क्षुरैस्तथा ॥
data.es: Indrajith pierced Rama with arrows coated with gold and gold tipped arrows, which had even and circular heads, with halfmoon arrows, with axe like heads, heads like joined palms, heads resembling teeth of calf and lion teeth arrows as well as razor sharp arrows which descended quickly unobstructed like dust.
data.anv: रुक्मपुङ्खैः coated with gold, प्रसन्नाग्रैः pure bright tips, अधोगतिभिः descending unobstructed like dust, आशुगैः quickly, नाराचैः with even and circular heads, अर्थनाराचैः halfmoon shaped heads, भल्लैः axe like heads, अञ्जलिकैरपि heads like joined palms, वत्सदन्तैश्च heads resembling teeth of calf, सिंहदंष्ट्रैः like lion's teeth, तथा in the same way, क्षुरैः heads as sharp as a razor, विव्याध hurt.

data.v: स वीरशयने शिश्ये विज्यमादाय कार्मुकम् । भिन्नमुष्टिपरीणाहं त्रिणतं रुक्मभूषितम् ॥
data.es: Rama lay relaxed on the hero's bed quitting his goldplated bow strung and bent at both ends, and the middle.
data.anv: सः he, Rama, विज्यम् quitting, भिन्नमुष्टिपरीणाहम् strung and bent at both ends, three places, रुक्मभूषितम् gold plated, कार्मुकम् bow, आदाय holding, वीरशयने hero's bed, शिश्ये relaxed.

data.v: बाणपातान्तरे रामं पतितं पुरुषर्षभम् । स तत्र लक्ष्मणो दृष्ट्वा निराशो जीवितेऽभवत् ॥
data.es: Lakshmana remained beholding the best of men fallen at an arrow's throw disappointed at his life.
data.anv: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तत्र there, बाणपातान्तरे at an arrow's throw, पतितम् fallen, पुरुषर्षभम् best of men, दृष्टवा beholding, जीविते life, निराशः disappointed, अभवत् remained.
data.md: Seeing Rāma, the foremost of men-down within arrow-range, Laksmana despaired of his life.

data.v: बद्धौ तु वीरौ पतितौ शयानौ; तौ वानराः संपरिवार्य तस्थुः । समागता वायुसुतप्रमुख्या; विषदमार्ताः परमं च जग्मुः ॥
data.es: Hanuman's army of Vanaras collected together stood surrounding fallen princes lying on the ground, despondent and extremely sorrowful.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेपञ्चचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the forty fifth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: वायुसुतप्रमुख्याः wind god's son's army, तेवानराः the Vanaras, समागताः collected together, बद्धौ bound, वीरौपतितौ fallen heroes, शयानौ lying, तौ both, सम्परिवार्य surrounding, तस्थुः stood, आर्ताः despondent, परमम् extremely, विषादम् sorrow, जग्मुःच remained.
data.md: When they had been bound and had laid themselves down as become heroes, the monkeys stood around them-and, conversing with one another, they, headed by the son of the Wing, were seized with extreme sorrow.

data.v: ततो द्यां पृथिवीं चैव वीक्षमाणा वनौकसः । ददृशुः संततौ बाणैर्भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥
data.es: Thereafter looking at the sky and the ground for Rama and Lakshmana, the Vanara leaders saw the two brothers, lying on the ground hurt by arrows.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, द्याम् at the sky, पृथिवींचैव on the ground, वीक्षमाणा seeing, वनौकसः Vanara leaders, बाणैः arrows, सन्ततौ, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, ददृशुः saw.
data.md: The rangers of woods, gazing at the earth and the sky, at length cast their eyes on the brothersRāma and Lakşmaņa covered all over with arrows. And after that Rākşasa had gone away having performed his work, like the God* going away, after having showered, there came to that place Vibhīşaņa with sugrīva. *Indra.

data.v: वृष्ट्वेवोपरते देवे कृतकर्मणि राक्षसे । आजगामाथ तं देशं ससुग्रीवो विभीषणः ॥
data.es: Indrajith retired after completing the task, like a cloud that retires after raining. Then came Vibheeshana and Sugriva to that location.
data.anv: देवे cloud, वृष्टवेव after raining, राक्षसे Rakshasa, कृतकर्मणि having completed the task, उपरते retired, अथ and then, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, ससुग्रीवः Sugriva, तंदेशम् that location, आजगाम reached.
data.md: And mourning Raghu's sons, there also came in all haste Nila and Dvivida and Mainda and Sușeņa and Kumuda and Angada in company with Hanuman.

data.v: नीलद्विविदमैन्दाश्च सुषेणसुमुखाङ्गदाः । तूर्णं हनुमता सार्धमन्वशोचन्त राघवौ ॥
data.es: Neela, Dwivida, Mainda, Sushena, Kumuda, Angada accompanied by Hanuman grieved intensely on looking at the Raghavas.
data.anv: नीलश्च Neela and, द्विविदः Dwivida, मैन्दः Mainda, सुषेणः Sushena, कुमुदः Kumuda, अङ्गदा: Angada, हनुमतासार्धम् accompanied by Hanuman, तूर्णम् intensely, राघवौ Ragahavas, अन्वशोचन्त grieved looking at.

data.v: निश्चेष्टौ मन्दनिःश्वासौ शोणितौघपरिप्लुतौ । शरजालाचितौ स्तब्धौ शयानौ शरतल्पयोः ॥
data.md: And moveless; breathing covered with bloodpierced all over with net-works of shafts; dumb; they* were lying on the field. *Rama and Laksmana.

data.v: निःश्वसन्तौ यथा सर्पौ निश्चेष्टौ मन्दविक्रमौ । रुधिरस्रावदिग्धाङ्गौ तापनीयाविव ध्वजौ ॥
data.md: They were sighing like serpents; and were inert; and deprived of prowess; and washed in blood; and looking like to golden standards.

data.v: तौ वीरशयने वीरौ शयानौ मन्दचेष्टितौ । यूथपैस्तैः परिवृतौ बाष्पव्याकुललोचनैः ॥
data.md: And as they lay moveless, as become heroes, the leaders of monkeys environed them with tear-charged eyes.

data.v: राघवौ पतितौ दृष्ट्वा शरजालसमावृतौ । बभूवुर्व्यथिताः सर्वे वानराः सविभीषणाः ॥
data.md: Seeing the sons of Raghu lying, covered with showers of shafts, the monkeys, with Vibhisana, were pained (exceedingly).

data.v: अन्तरिक्षं निरीक्षन्तो दिशः सर्वाश्च वानराः । न चैनं मायया छन्नं ददृशू रावणिं रणे ॥
data.es: Though the Vanaras searched all over the battlefield and in all directions of the sky, they could not see Indrajith of mystical powers.
data.anv: अन्तरिक्षम् sky, सर्वाः all over, दिशश्च directions, निरीक्षन्तः looking, वानराः Vanaras, रणे battle, मायया mystical power, चैनं not find, छन्नम् searched, एनम् all over, रावणिम् Indrajith, ददृशुः could not see.
data.md: The monkeys, Surveying the sky as well as all directions, could not see Rāvana's son in battle enveloped with illusion.

data.v: तं तु मायाप्रतिच्छिन्नं माययैव विभीषणः । वीक्षमाणो ददर्शाथ भ्रातुः पुत्रमवस्थितम् ॥
data.es: Vibheeshana started looking with occult powers for his brother's son endowed with occult power following occult means and found Indrajith.
data.anv: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, माययैव occult, वीक्षमाणः started looking, मायाप्रतिच्छन्नम् searched with occult powers, अथ and then, अवस्थितम् stood, तम् his, भ्रातुःपुत्रम् brother's son, ददर्श saw.

data.v: तमप्रतिम कर्माणमप्रतिद्वन्द्वमाहवे । ददर्शान्तर्हितं वीरं वरदानाद्विभीषणः ॥
data.es: Brilliant and glorious Vibheeshana, capable of difficult deeds, incomparable at work, and in fight, unrivalled in battle, saw the hidden hero Indrajith by virtue of a boon (from Brahma).
data.anv: तेजसा brilliant, यशसाचैव glory, विक्रमेणच capable of difficult deeds, सम्युतम् endowed with, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, अप्रतिमकर्माणम् incomparable in his task, आहवे in fight, अप्रतिद्वन्दम् unrivalled in battle, वरदानात् by virtue of a boon, अन्तर्हितम् hidden, तम् him, वीरम् hero, ददर्श seen.

data.v: इन्द्रजित्त्वात्मनः कर्म तौ शयानौ समीक्ष्य च । उवाच परमप्रीतो हर्षयन्सर्वनैरृतान् ॥
data.es: Reviewing the scions lying on bed by his action, Indrajith caused extreme joy to all Rakshasas and spoke.
data.anv: इन्द्रजित्तु Indrajith, आत्मनः himself, कर्म action, शयानौ on the bed, तौच both, समीक्ष्य reviewing, परमप्रीतः very happily, सर्वनैरृतान् to all Rakshasas, हर्षयन् making to rejoice, उवाच spoke.
data.md: And Indrajit, seeing his own feat and them lying at length, spoke in excess of joy, gladdening all the Rākşasas.

data.v: दूषणस्य च हन्तारौ खरस्य च महाबलौ । सादितौ मामकैर्बाणैर्भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥
data.es: "The two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, who slayed Dushana and Khara have been struck."
data.anv: दूषणस्यच Dushana, खरस्यच and Khara, हन्तारौ slayer, महाबलौ very strong, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, मामकैः by my, बाणैः arrows, सादितौ struck.
data.md: The brothers-Rāma and Lakşmaņa, possessed of great strength, who had slain Khara and Dūşaņa, are themselves slain with my shafts.

data.v: नेमौ मोक्षयितुं शक्यावेतस्मादिषुबन्धनात् । सर्वैरपि समागम्य सर्षिसङ्घैः सुरासुरैः ॥
data.es: "Even if all the sages, Devatas and Rakshasas collected together come, they cannot get liberated from this bondage of arrows."
data.anv: सर्वैः all, सर्षिसङ्घैः sages, सुरासुरैः Devatas and Rakshasas, समागम्य collected together, इमौ this, एतस्मात् by them, इषुबन्धनात् to rid of this network, मोक्षयितुम् liberate, नशक्यौ not possible.
data.md: All the celestials and Asuras assembled together with the saints, are incompetent to emancipate these from the fetters of my shafts.

data.v: यत्कृते चिन्तयानस्य शोकार्तस्य पितुर्मम । अस्पृष्ट्वा शयनं गात्रैस्त्रियामा याति शर्वती ॥
data.es: "On whose account my father was in grief and spent all night and passed the three parts of the night (without sleep) and why he was unable to sleep was not understood clearly. By his (Rama's) action this Lanka is agitated like a river during the rainy season. He, who is the root cause of this calamity, has been got rid of by me," thought Indrajith.
data.anv: यत्कृकते on whose account, चिन्तयानस्य with this thought, शोकार्तस्य is in grief, ममपितुः my father, गात्रैः body, शयनम् bed, अस्पृष्टवा not understood clearly, त्रियामा three periods, शर्वरी night, याति passed away, यत्कृते by what action, कृत्स्ना dark, इयंलङ्का this Lanka, वर्षासु raining, नदीइव like river, आकुला agitated, सः he, अयम् all, सर्वेषाम् all of us, मूलहरः root cause, अनर्थः got rid of, मया by me, निहतः killed.
data.md: He for whom my father was exercise with anxiety and tormented by grief, for whom my sire used to spend nights without pressing his bed, for whom this entire Lankā had resembled a river turbulent in the rainy reason, that same evil sticking by the root of all, has been dispensed his quietus by me.

data.v: कृत्स्नेयं यत्कृते लङ्का नदी वर्षास्विवाकुला । सोऽयं मूलहरोऽनर्थः सर्वेषां निहतो मया ॥
data.es: "On whose account my father was in grief and spent all night and passed the three parts of the night (without sleep) and why he was unable to sleep was not understood clearly. By his (Rama's) action this Lanka is agitated like a river during the rainy season. He, who is the root cause of this calamity, has been got rid of by me," thought Indrajith.
data.anv: यत्कृकते on whose account, चिन्तयानस्य with this thought, शोकार्तस्य is in grief, ममपितुः my father, गात्रैः body, शयनम् bed, अस्पृष्टवा not understood clearly, त्रियामा three periods, शर्वरी night, याति passed away, यत्कृते by what action, कृत्स्ना dark, इयंलङ्का this Lanka, वर्षासु raining, नदीइव like river, आकुला agitated, सः he, अयम् all, सर्वेषाम् all of us, मूलहरः root cause, अनर्थः got rid of, मया by me, निहतः killed.
data.md: He for whom my father was exercise with anxiety and tormented by grief, for whom my sire used to spend nights without pressing his bed, for whom this entire Lankā had resembled a river turbulent in the rainy reason, that same evil sticking by the root of all, has been dispensed his quietus by me.

data.v: रामस्य लक्ष्मणस्यैव सर्वेषां च वनौकसाम् । विक्रमा निष्फलाः सर्वे यथा शरदि तोयदाः ॥
data.es: "Rama, and Lakshmana and even all valiant Vanaras have been got rid of just like clouds of autumn are wasted."
data.anv: रामस्य Rama's, लक्ष्मणस्यैव and even Lakshmana's, सर्वेषाम् everything, वनौकसाम् Vanaras, सर्वे all, विक्रमाः valiant, शरदि autumn, तोयदाःइव like clouds, निष्फलाः wasted.
data.md: And like clouds of autumn, the prowess of Råma and Laksmana as well as that of all the rangers of the woods, has been rendered useless.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा तु तान्सर्वान्राक्षसान्परिपार्श्वगान् । यूथपानपि तान्सर्वांस्ताडयामास रावणिः ॥
data.es: Indrajith, having spoken in that way to all Rakshasas, began to strike all the Vanara leaders looking at him.
data.anv: सःरावणिः that Indrajith, तान् his, सर्वान् all, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, परिपार्श्वतः those looking at him, सर्वान् all, यूथपानपि army generals, ताडयामास began to strike.

data.v: तानर्दयित्वा बाणौघैस्त्रासयित्वा च वानरान् । प्रजहास महाबाहुर्वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Indrajith hurt the Vanaras with hails of arrows terrifying them. Then the mighty armed son of Ravana laughed and spoke these words.
data.anv: तान् Indrajith, बाणौघैः hails of arrows, अर्धयित्वा struck, वानरान् Vanaras, त्रासयित्वाच terrifying, महाबाहुः of strong arms, प्रजहास laughing, इदम् these, वचनंच words, अब्रवीत् spoken.
data.md: And tormenting the monkeys with volleys of shafts and striking terror into them, that mightyarmed one. bursting out into a laugh, said.

data.v: शरबन्धेन घोरेण मया बद्धौ चमूमुखे । सहितौ भ्रातरावेतौ निशामयत राक्षसाः ॥
data.es: "O Rakshasas! Look at these two brothers together bound by my fierce arrows in front of you."
data.anv: राक्षसाः Rakshasas, घोरेण terrible, शरबन्धेन bound by arrows, चमूमुखे in the forefront, मया by me, बद्धौ bound, सहितौ together, एतौभ्रातरौ these two brothers, निशामयत fallen.
data.md: “Let the Raksasas behold these brothers lying fast bound with dreadful arrows in front of the forces."

data.v: एवमुक्तास्तु ते सर्वे राक्षसाः कूटयोधिनः । परं विस्मयमाजग्मुः कर्मणा तेन तोषिताः ॥
data.es: Indrajith having spoken in that way to the Rakshasas, all of them were highly amazed by the action of Indrajith and went laughing.
data.anv: एवम् in that way, उक्ताः having said, कूटयोधिनः cheerful, ते they, सर्वेराक्षसाः all Rakshasas, तेनकर्मणा by that action, परम् extremely, विस्मयम् amazed, आजग्मुः went, हर्षिताः laughing.
data.md: Thus addressed, those Rākşasas-wily warriors all-resembling masses of clouds, witnessing that deed (of Indrajit), struck with wonder and rejoicing (greatly), set up tremendous roars. And thinking that Rāma was slain, they honoured Ravana's son.

data.v: विनेदुश्च महानादान्सर्वे ते जलदोपमाः । हतो राम इति ज्ञात्वा रावणिं समपूजयन् ॥
data.es: The Rakshasas thundering like rain clouds, roaring aloud thinking 'Rama is killed' by Ravana's son offered prayers.
data.anv: जलदोपमाः like clouds, तेसर्वे all of them, महानादान् roaring aloud, विनेदुः joyfully, रामः Rama, हतःइति is killed, ज्ञात्वा thinking, रावणिम् Son of Ravana, समपूजयन् offered prayers.
data.md: Thus addressed, those Rākşasas-wily warriors all-resembling masses of clouds, witnessing that deed (of Indrajit), struck with wonder and rejoicing (greatly), set up tremendous roars. And thinking that Rāma was slain, they honoured Ravana's son.

data.v: निष्पन्दौ तु तदा दृष्ट्वा तावुभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । वसुधायां निरुच्छ्वासौ हतावित्यन्वमन्यत ॥
data.es: Thereafter having seen the two brothers Rama and Lakshmana not responding or breathing, lying on the ground, he thought they were dead.
data.anv: तदा thereafter, निष्पन्दौ not responding, निरुच्छवासौ without breathing, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, वसुधायाम् on the ground, दृष्टवा having seen, हताविति dead, अन्वमन्यत thought.
data.md: Seeing the brothers-Rāma and Laksmanamotionless, and lying inert on the ground, they took them for slain.

data.v: हर्षेण तु समाविष्ट इन्द्रजित्समितिंजयः । प्रविवेश पुरीं लङ्कां हर्षयन्सर्वनैरृतान् ॥
data.es: Indrajith, who is victorious in battles, feeling happy and creating happiness to all Rakshasas collected there entered the city of Lanka.
data.anv: समितिञ्जयः one who is victorious in battles, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, हर्षेण felt happy, समाविष्टः collected there, सर्वनैर्वतान् for all Rakshasas, हर्षयन् creating happiness, लङ्कांपुरीम् Lanka city, प्रविवेश entered
data.md: And, experiencing excess of joy, Indrajitconquerer in conflict-entered the city of Lankā, rejoicing all the Nairtas.

data.v: रामलक्ष्मणयोर्दृष्ट्वा शरीरे सायकैश्चिते । सर्वाणि चाङ्गोपाङ्गानि सुग्रीवं भयमाविशत् ॥
data.es: Sugriva was overtaken by fear on seeing Rama and Lakshmana riddled with arrows from head to foot all over the body
data.anv: रामलक्ष्मणयोः Rama and Lakshmana, सायकैः by arrows, चिते riddled with, शरीरे body, सर्वाणि all over, अङ्गोपाङ्गानि from head to foot, दृष्टवा seeing, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, भयम् feared, आविशत् possessed.
data.md: Seeing the bodies as well as the limbs of Rāma and Lakşmana, covered entirely with arrows, fear took possession of Sugriva.

data.v: तमुवाच परित्रस्तं वानरेन्द्रं विभीषणः । सबाष्पवदनं दीनं शोकव्याकुललोचनम् ॥
data.md: Thereat Vibhīşaņa said to that lord of monkeys, staying in woe-begone guise, with a tearful countenance, and his eyes wild with wrath, "Do not give way to fear, O Sugriva. Restrain your rising tears!

data.v: अलं त्रासेन सुग्रीव बाष्पवेगो निगृह्यताम् । एवं प्रायाणि युद्धानि विजयो नास्ति नैष्ठिकः ॥
सशेषभाग्यतास्माकं यदि वीर भविष्यति । मोहमेतौ प्रहास्येते भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥
पर्यवस्थापयात्मानमनाथं मां च वानर । सत्यधर्मानुरक्तानां नास्ति मृत्युकृतं भयम् ॥
data.es: "O Vanara! We are helpless, be confident, for those following righteousness and truthfulness there is no fear of death."
data.anv: वानर Vanara, आत्मानम् our self, अनाथम् helpless, मांच and mine, पर्यमास्थापय restoring, सत्यधर्मानिरक्तानाम् for those following righteousness and truthfulness, मृत्युकृतम् from death, भयम् fear, नास्ति not.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा ततस्तस्य जलक्लिन्नेन पाणिना । सुग्रीवस्य शुभे नेत्रे प्रममार्ज विभीषणः ॥
data.es: Vibheeshana, having spoken in that manner, there after dipped his hand in water and wiped the beautiful eyes of Sugriva to brighten.
data.anv: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा spoken, ततः then, जलक्लिन्नेन dipping in water, पाणिना hand, तस्यसुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, शुभे beautiful, नेत्रे eyes, प्रममार्ज brightened.
data.md: Saying this, with hand Vibhīşaņa washed Sugriva's graceful eyes with water.

data.v: प्रमृज्य वदनं तस्य कपिराजस्य धीमतः । अब्रवीत्कालसंप्रातमसंभ्रान्तमिदं वचः ॥
data.es: Wise Vibheeshana having wiped Sugriva's face clean in accordance with time addressed with opportune words.
data.anv: धीमतः wise, तस्यकपिराजस्य that monkey king, वदनम् countenance, विमृज्य wiped clean, कालसम्प्राप्तम् as per that time, असम्भ्रान्तम् opportune, इदंवचः these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: And washing the face of the intelligent monkey-monarch, Vibhisana spoke these words, seasonable and sedate.

data.v: न कालः कपिराजेन्द्र वैक्लव्यमनुवर्तितुम् । अतिस्नेहोऽप्यकालेऽस्मिन्मरणायोपपद्यते ॥
data.es: "O king of monkeys! This is not the time for faint heartedness. Extreme attachment at this time will lead us to death."
data.anv: कपिराजेन्द्र monkey king, वैक्लब्यम् faint heartedness, अवलम्बितुम् to follow, कालः time, न not this, अस्मिन् our, काले time, अतिस्नेहोऽप्य with extreme attachment, मरणाय death, उपकल्पते lead.
data.md: O foremost of monkey-kings, this is no time for being overcome with stupor. At this hour, even immoderate affection may lead destruction.

data.v: तस्मादुत्सृज्य वैक्लव्यं सर्वकार्यविनाशनम् । हितं रामपुरोगाणां सैन्यानामनुचिन्त्यताम् ॥
data.es: "Therefore, give up faintheartedness as all actions will be destroyed by that. Following Rama's leadership, think of the army's welfare."
data.anv: तस्मात् therefore, सर्वकार्यविनाशनम् all actions will be destroyed, वैक्लब्यम् faintheartedness, उत्सृज्य give up, रामपुरोगणाम् following Rama, सैन्यानाम् army, हितम् welfare, अनुचिन्त्यताम् think of.
data.md: Therefore, casting off stupor, which tends to mar all work, do you bethink you how you may serve this army headed by Rāma.

data.v: अथ वा रक्ष्यतां रामो यावत्संज्ञा विपर्ययः । लब्धसंज्ञौ तु काकुत्स्थौ भयं नो व्यपनेष्यतः ॥
data.es: "Or else till they become conscious, protect the Kakuthsa princes. When they become conscious, they can get rid of our fear."
data.anv: अथवा or else, यावत्संज्ञाविपर्ययः till they become conscious, रामः Rama, रक्ष्यताम् protect, लब्धसंज्ञौ when they get back consciousness, काकुत्स्थौ both Kakuthsa princes, नौ, भयम् fear, व्यपनेष्यतःहि will be able to get rid off.
data.md: Or do you protect Rāma so long as he does not regain consciousness; and when the Kākutsthas shall have regained consciousness, all our apprehension shall vanish.

data.v: नैतत्किंचन रामस्य न च रामो मुमूर्षति । न ह्येनं हास्यते लक्ष्मीर्दुर्लभा या गतायुषाम् ॥
data.es: "Therefore, Rama has no fear of death, even a little. Whatever splendour is lost, prosperity will not leave him."
