data.anv: एतत् therefore, रामस्य Rama's, किञ्चन even a little, न not, रामः Rama, नमुमूर्षति not going to die, या whatever, गतायुषाम् life is lost, दुर्लभा difficult, लक्ष्मीः prosperous, एनम् , नहास्यतेहि not leave him.
data.md: This is nothing to Rāma is not dying. And Lakşmi* who is incapable of being attained by those that are doomed, shall not forsake this one. *The goddess of prosperity. to

data.v: तस्मादाश्वासयात्मानं बलं चाश्वासय स्वकम् । यावत्सर्वाणि सैन्यानि पुनः संस्थापयाम्यहम् ॥
data.es: "Therefore, restoring breath let us reassure the army again till all actions are carried out by restoring their confidence."
data.anv: तस्मात् therefore, आत्मानम् ourselves, आश्वासय restoring breath, स्वकम् myself, बलम् army, आश्वासय reassure, अहम् I, सर्वाणि all, कार्यानि actions, पुनः again, यावत् संस्थापयामि all the army restore confidence.
data.md: Therefore do you comfort yourself, do you also cheer up your own forces, while I am engaged in composing all the troops.

data.v: एते ह्युत्फुल्लनयनास्त्रासादागतसाध्वसाः । कर्णे कर्णे प्रकथिता हरयो हरिपुंगव ॥
data.es: "O Monkey leader! these monkeys whose eyes have become big (are dilated) with fear are talking ear to ear (about Rama)."
data.anv: हरिसत्तम monkey leader, एते these, हरयः monkeys, फुल्लनयनाः dilated eyes, त्रासात् by fear, आगतसाध्वसाः seized with fear, कर्णेकर्णे ear to ear, प्रकथिताः talking to each other.
data.md: O best of monkeys, these with distended eyes, come under the governance of terror, are, stricken with panic, whispering into each other's ears.

data.v: मां तु दृष्ट्वा प्रधावन्तमनीकं संप्रहर्षितुम् । त्यजन्तु हरयस्त्रासं भुक्तपूर्वामिव स्रजम् ॥
data.es: "Let the army forces of monkeys be happy seeing me moving, getting rid of the inherent fear in them just as they discard a garland of flowers enjoyed by them earlier."
data.anv: अनीकम् army forces, सम्प्रहर्षितुम् made them happy, प्रधावन्तम् inherent, माम् me, दृष्टवा seeing, हरयः monkeys, त्रासम् moving in fear, भुक्तपूर्वम् enjoyed earlier, स्रजम् garland of flowers, इव like that, त्यजन्तु discard.
data.md: But seeing me, let the forces rushing about, cheered up, as well as the monkeys, cast off all fear, like a wreath that has been used before.

data.v: समाश्वास्य तु सुग्रीवं राक्षसेन्द्रो विभीषणः । विद्रुतं वानरानीकं तत्समाश्वासयत्पुनः ॥
data.es: The king of Rakshasas, Vibheeshana having assured Sugriva, knowing the Vanara army he reassured them.
data.anv: राक्षसेन्द्रः king of Rakshasas, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, समाश्वास्य assured, विद्रुतम् knowing, तत् वानरानीकम् that Vanara army, पुनः again, समाश्वासयत् reassured.
data.md: Thus comforting Sugriva, Vibhisana-lord of Rākṣasas-again instilled spirits into the flying forces of monkeys.

data.v: इन्द्रजित्तु महामायः सर्वसैन्यसमावृतः । विवेश नगरीं लङ्कां पितरं चाभ्युपागमत् ॥
data.es: Great Indrajith surrounded by all army entered the city of Lanka and approached his father.
data.anv: महामायः great, इन्द्रजित्तुः Indrajith, सर्वसैन्यसमावृतः all the army surrounding him, लङ्कां Lanka नगरीम् City, विवेश entered, पितरम् father, अभ्युपागमत् च approached.
data.md: And Indrajit, worker of mighty illusionsaccompanied by his troops, entered the city of Larkā and presented himself before his father.

data.v: तत्र रावणमासीनमभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः । आचचक्षे प्रियं पित्रे निहतौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥
data.es: Having reached Ravana, Indrajith greeted him with folded palms and broke the pleasant news, "Rama and Lakshmana are killed."
data.anv: तत्र there, रावणम् Ravana, आसाद्य having reached, अभिवाद्य greeted, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, निहतौ are killed, पित्रे O father, प्रियम् dear, आचचक्षे broke the news.
data.md: And approaching Rāvana and saluting him with joined hands, he informed his sire of the welcome tidings that Răma and Lakṣmaṇa had been slain.

data.v: उत्पपात ततो हृष्टः पुत्रं च परिषस्वजे । रावणो रक्षसां मध्ये श्रुत्वा शत्रू निपातितौ ॥
data.es: In the midst of Rakshasas, Ravana hearing the news of his enemies being killed, rejoiced, and got up from his couch and embraced his son.
data.anv: रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, मध्ये midst, रावणः Ravana, शत्रू enemy, निपातितौ killed, श्रुत्वा hearing, ततः then, हृष्टः rejoiced, उत्पपात got up, पुत्रम् son, पर्षिस्वजेच embraced
data.md: And hearing that his foe had fallen, Rāvana springing up in the midst of the Rākşasas, With great joy embraced his son.

data.v: उपाघ्राय स मूर्ध्न्येनं पप्रच्छ प्रीतमानसः । पृच्छते च यथावृत्तं पित्रे सर्वं न्यवेदयत् ॥
data.es: Delighted Ravana kissed his son on the forehead and enquired of him of the details. Indrajith presented details saying that both Rama and Lakshmana were stunned in the network of arrows, and lost splendour.
data.anv: पृच्छते enquired, पित्रे father, तौ both of them, शरबन्धेन from the network of arrows, निश्चेष्टौ stunned, निष्प्रभौ splendour gone, यथा like that, कृतौ did, तस्मै their, यथावृत्तम् all in detail, न्यवेदयत् presented.
data.md: And scenting the crown of his head, (Rāvana) with a delighted heart, asked (Indrajit as to all that had taken place). And on being asked, he (Indrajit) truly related to his sire how (Rāma and Lakşmaņa) had been rendered senseless and lack-Lustre by being fastened with shafts.

data.v: स हर्षवेगानुगतान्तरात्मा; श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य महारथस्य । जहौ ज्वरं दाशरथेः समुत्थितं; प्रहृष्य वाचाभिननन्द पुत्रम् ॥
data.es: Hearing the words of the great chariot warrior, Ravana was filled with excessive joy at heart. His fear and agony of Dasaratha's son having gone on hearing the words of his son, Ravana greeted him.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषटचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the forty sixth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: महारथस्य of the great chariot warrior, तस्य his, वचः words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, हर्षवेगानुगतान्तरात्मा filled with joy at heart, सः he, दाशरथेः Dasaratha's son, समुत्थितम् fear, ज्वरम् agony, जहौ gone, प्रहृष्यवाचा joyful words, पुत्रम् son, अभिननन्द greeted.
data.md: Thereat, with rapture surcharging his inmost soul, Rāvana, hearing the speech of the mighty car warrior, banished his fear of Dasaratha's son, and rising up, honoured his son with glad words.

data.v: प्रतिप्रविष्टे लङ्कां तु कृतार्थे रावणात्मजे । राघवं परिवार्यार्ता ररक्षुर्वानरर्षभाः ॥
data.es: After accomplishing the task Ravana's son entered Lanka while the bull among monkeys guarded Raghava staying around.
data.anv: पति king, रावणात्मजे Ravana's son, कृतार्थे accomplished the task, लङ्कायाम् into Lanka, प्रविष्टे entered, अथ and then, वानरर्षभाः bull among monkeys, राघवम् at Raghava, परिवार्यार्तुः around, ररक्षुः guarded.
data.md: When Rāvana's son entered Lankā, after having accomplished his purpose, the foremost monkeys protected Raghava, surrounding him on all sides.

data.v: हनूमानङ्गदो नीलः सुषेणः कुमुदो नलः । गजो गवाक्षो गवयः शरभो गन्धमादनः ॥
जाम्बवानृषभः सुन्दो रम्भः शतबलिः पृथुः । व्यूढानीकाश्च यत्ताश्च द्रुमानादाय सर्वतः ॥
वीक्षमाणा दिशः सर्वास्तिर्यगूर्ध्वं च वानराः । तृणेष्वपि च चेष्टत्सु राक्षसा इति मेनिरे ॥
रावणश्चापि संहृष्टो विसृज्येन्द्रजितं सुतम् । आजुहाव ततः सीता रक्षणी राक्षसीस्तदा ॥
data.es: Ravana was also content to send away his son Indrajith and calls for the Rakshasa woman, caretaker of Sita.
data.anv: रावणश्चापि Ravana also, सम्हृष्टः contended, सुतम् son, इन्द्रजितम् Indrajith, विसृज्य sending away, ततः then, सीताक्षिणीः caretaker of Sita, राक्षसीः rakshasi, तदा then, आजुहाव called for.
data.md: Rāvana, on his part experiencing the height of exaltation, summoned the Rākṣasais engaged in guarding Sita.

data.v: राक्षस्यस्त्रिजटा चापि शासनात्तमुपस्थिताः । ता उवाच ततो हृष्टो राक्षसी राक्षसेश्वरः ॥
data.es: The rakshasi and also Trijata came and waited there by the order. Lowly Rakshasa, Ravana, full of joy addressed rakshasi.
data.anv: राक्षस्यः rakshasi, त्रिजटाचैव Trijata also, शासनात् by the order, तम् his, उपस्थिताः waited, ततः there, हृष्टः joyful, राक्षसाधमः lowly Rakshasa, ताःराक्षसीः that rakshasi, उवाच addressed.
data.md: Thereat the Raksasi-Trijata and otherspresented themselves at his command. And then the lord of Rākşasas, delighted addressed then the Raksasis, saying.

data.v: हताविन्द्रजिताख्यात वैदेह्या रामलक्ष्मणौ । पुष्पकं च समारोप्य दर्शयध्वं हतौ रणे ॥
data.es: "Rama and Lakshmana are killed by Indrajith in war. Take Vaidehi in the aerial car and show her."
data.anv: रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, इन्द्रता by Indrajith, हतौ killed, वैदेह्याः to Vaidehi, तत् that, पुष्पकम् aerial car, समारोप्य ascended, रणे war, हतौ killed, दर्शयध्वम् you may show.
data.md: Tell Vaidehí that Rāma and Lakşmaņa have been slain in battle by Indrajit. And taking her on Pushaka, show her (Rāma and Lakşmaņa) lying slain on the field of battle.

data.v: यदाश्रयादवष्टब्धो नेयं मामुपतिष्ठति । सोऽस्या भर्ता सह भ्रात्रा निरस्तो रणमूर्धनि ॥
data.es: "That husband with whose support she was proud and not yielding to me is unconscious along with his brother who have been killed," said Ravana.
data.anv: इयम् that husband, यताश्रयात् with whose support, अवष्टब्धा being proud, माम् to me, नउपतिष्ठते not yielding, सः he, अस्याः, भर्ता husband, रणमूर्धनि unconscious in the war, भ्रात्रासह along with brother, निहतः has been killed.
data.md: That one depending on whom she had proudly set her face against me, that husband of hers, along with his brother, has been slain in conflict.

data.v: निर्विशङ्का निरुद्विग्ना निरपेक्षा च मैथिली । मामुपस्थास्यते सीता सर्वाभरणभूषिता ॥
data.es: "Mythili, rid of sorrow and free from perturbation, giving up hope (of Rama) can wait upon me adorned with all kinds of jewels."
data.anv: मैथिली Mythili, सीता Sita, निर्विशङ्का rid of sorrow, निरुद्विग्ना free from perturbation, निरपेक्षा giving up hope, सर्वाभरणभूषिता adorned with all kinds of jewels, माम् me, उपस्थास्यते wait on me.
data.md: Then methyl's daughter, her fear gone off with her anxiety, and herself losing all support, Sītādaughter to methyl-decked out in all ornaments, shall seek me.

data.v: अद्य कालवशं प्राप्तं रणे रामं सलक्ष्मणम् । अवेक्ष्य विनिवृत्ताशा नान्यां गतिमपश्यती ॥
data.es: Ravana thought that the broad eyed Sita coming to conclusion in course of time that Rama has gone along with Lakshmana, rid of hope, with no other haven, will seek him on her own accord.
data.anv: विशालाक्षी broad eyed, सा that, अद्य coming to conclusion, रणे war, सलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, रामम् Rama, कालवशम् in course of time, गतम् gone, अवेक्ष्य seek, विनिवृत्ता, अन्याम् no other, गतिम् haven, अपश्यती will seek, निरपेक्षा getting rid of hope, स्वयम् Ravana, माम् me, उपस्थास्यते will on her own accord.
data.md: And today beholding Rāma with Lakşmaņa, come under the away of Time, she, finding no other way, shall desist from her present course. And seeing no other resource, that one of expansive eyes shall of herself seek me.

data.v: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रावणस्य दुरात्मनः । राक्षस्यस्तास्तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रजग्मुर्यत्र पुष्पकम् ॥
data.es: The evil minded Rakshasas listening to Ravana's words went to the aerial car.
data.anv: ताःराक्षस्यः those Rakshasas, दुरात्मनः evil minded, तस्यरावणस्य that Ravana's, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा hearing, तथाइति thus, उक्त्वा said, पुष्पकम् aerial car, यत्र there, जग्मुःवै went.
data.md: Hearing those words of the wicked-minded Rāvana, the Rākşasais, saying, “So be it,” went to where Puspaka was.

data.v: ततः पुष्पकमादय राक्षस्यो रावणाज्ञया । अशोकवनिकास्थां तां मैथिलीं समुपानयन् ॥
data.es: Thereafter, by Ravana's order the Rakshasas went with the aerial car to Mythili in the Ashoka Garden.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, राक्षस्यः Rakshasas, रावणाज्ञया by Ravana's order, पुष्पकम् aerial car, आदाय went, अशोकवनिकासंस्थाम् in the Ashoka garden, ताम् they, मैथिलीम् Mythili, समुपानयन् went near.
data.md: Then taking Pușpaka, the Rākşasis at Rāvana's command went to Maithilī staying in theasoka wood.

data.v: तामादाय तु राक्षस्यो भर्तृशोकपरायणाम् । सीतामारोपयामासुर्विमानं पुष्पकं तदा ॥
data.es: Then the Rakshasas took the aerial car near Sita who was overcome by her husband's grief.
data.anv: तदा then, राक्षस्यः Rakshasas, भर्तृशोकपराजिताम् overcome by husband 's grief, तांसीताम् that Sita, आदाय went near, पुष्पकंविमानम् Pushpaka aerial car, आरोपयामासुः to ascend.
data.md: Then, taking Sītā, who was overcome with grief for her lord, the Raksasais, placed her on the car, Puspaka.

data.v: ततः पुष्पकमारोप्य सीतां त्रिजटया सह । रावणोऽकारयल्लङ्कां पताकाध्वजमालिनीम् ॥
प्राघोषयत हृष्टश्च लङ्कायां राक्षसेश्वरः । राघवो लक्ष्मणश्चैव हताविन्द्रजिता रणे ॥
data.es: The Lord of Rakshasas rejoiced and went to Lanka decorated with flags and posts proclaiming that Rama and Lakshmana were killed by Indrajith in war.
data.anv: राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, हृष्टः rejoiced, लङ्काम् Lanka, पताकाध्वजमालिनीम् with rows of flags and posts, कारयामास made decorations, राघवः Raghava, लक्ष्मणश्चैव and Lakshmana, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajith, रणे in war, हतौ killed, प्राघोषयत proclaimed.

data.v: विमानेनापि सीता तु गत्वा त्रिजटया सह । ददर्श वानराणां तु सर्वं सिन्यं निपातितम् ॥
data.es: Sita and Trijata flying on the Pushpaka saw all the fallen Vanara army.
data.anv: सीता Sita, त्रिजटयासह with Trijata, विमानेन on the Pushpaka, गत्वा going, निपातितम् fallen, सर्वम् all, वानराणांसैन्यम् Vanara army, ददर्श saw.

data.v: प्रहृष्टमनसश्चापि ददर्श पिशिताशनान् । वानरांश्चापि दुःखार्तान्रामलक्ष्मणपार्श्वतः ॥
data.es: Sita beheld extremely happy Rakshasas, and grief stricken Vanaras, in great agony near Rama and Lakshmana.
data.anv: प्रहृष्टमनसः extremely happy, पिशिताशनान् grief stricken, रामलक्ष्मणपार्श्वतः near Rama and Lakshmana, अतिदुःखार्तान् very much agonised, वानरांश्च Vanaras also, ददर्श beheld.
data.md: She found the flesh-eaters elated in spirits, and the monkeys afflicted with extreme grief at the side of Rāma and Lakşmaņa.

data.v: ततः सीता ददर्शोभौ शयानौ शततल्पयोः । लक्ष्मणं चैव रामं च विसंज्ञौ शरपीडितौ ॥
data.md: Then Sītā beheld both Lakşmaņa and Rāma lying in the field, senseless and bound with arrows.

data.v: विध्वस्तकवचौ वीरौ विप्रविद्धशरासनौ । सायकैश्छिन्नसर्वाङ्गौ शरस्तम्भमयौ क्षितौ ॥
data.es: Thereafter Sita beheld both Rama and Lakshmana lying on the bed of arrows, unconscious, struck by arrows, with shields of darts, arrows with feathers, all limbs wounded with shattered armour, bows and reeds.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, सीता Sita, शयानौ lying, शरतल्पगौ on the bed of arrows, विसंज्ञौ unconscious, शरपीडितौ struck by arrows, विध्वस्तकवचौ with shield of darts, वीरौ heroes, विप्रविद्धशरासनौ lying on bed of arrows, सायकैः arrows with feathers, भिन्नसर्वाङ्गौ all limbs wounded with shattered armour and bows, क्षितौ broken, शरस्तम्बमयौ reeds of arrows, उभौ both, लक्ष्मणंचापि Lakshmana with, रामंच Rama, ददर्श beheld.
data.md: Those heroes were lying on the earth, their mail torn, their bows cast off their bodies mangled all over and thickly pierce with shafts.

data.v: तौ दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरौ तत्र वीरौ सा पुरुषर्षभौ । दुःखार्ता सुभृशं सीता करुणं विललाप ह ॥
सा बाष्पशोकाभिहता समीक्ष्य; तौ भ्रातरौ देवसमप्रभावौ । वितर्कयन्ती निधनं तयोः सा; दुःखान्विता वाक्यमिदं जगाद ॥
data.md: With her eyes shedding plentiful tears, she seeing those brothers, endowed with god-like prowess, concluded them to be dead; and overwhelmed with grief, spoke as follows. as as

data.v: भर्तारं निहतं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम् । विललाप भृशं सीता करुणं शोककर्शिता ॥
data.es: On seeing her husband killed and also mighty Lakshmana, Sita became emotional in intense sorrow and cried piteously.
data.anv: सीता Sita, निहतम् killed, भर्तारम् husband, महाबलम् mighty, लक्ष्मणंच Lakshmana also, दृष्टवा seeing, भृशम् intense, शोककर्शिता emotional in sorrow, करुणम् piteously, विललाप cried.
data.md: Seeing her husband, well the exceedingly powerful Laksmana, slain, Srta, afflicted with grief, burst into bitter lamentation.

data.v: ऊचुर्लक्षणिका ये मां पुत्रिण्यविधवेति च । तेऽस्य सर्वे हते रामेऽज्ञानिनोऽनृतवादिनः ॥
data.es: "Whoever was capable of predicting the future have said that I will be the mother of sons and not become a widow. Now if Rama is dead, they become liars."
data.anv: ये whoever, लक्षणिकाः capable of predicting, माम् my, पुत्रिणी mother of sons, अविधवेतिच not become a widow, ऊचुः told, ते they, ज्ञानिनः knowledgeable, capable of reading future, अद्य their, रामे Rama, हते killed, अनृतवादिनः liars.
data.md: The soothsayers had said that I should have sons, and should never be a widow. But on Råma being slain, it sees now that those ones, possessed of knowledge, had spoken untruthfully.

data.v: इमानि खलु पद्मानि पादयोर्यैः किल स्त्रियः । अधिराज्येऽभिषिच्यन्ते नरेन्द्रैः पतिभिः सह ॥
data.es: "Those virtuous lotus marks that a woman has on their feet to become crowned queen of a kingdom are seen in my feet."
data.anv: पादयोः on the sole of my feet, इमानि such, पद्मानिखलु lotus marks, यैः whose, कुलस्त्रियः virtuous women, नरेन्द्रैः king, पतिभिःसह husband also, अधिराज्ये kingdom, अभिषिच्यन्ते will be crowned.
data.md: These lotus-marks on the feet, betokening to gentlewomen possessing them, that they are to be installed in the kingdom in company with their husbands-who are kings-are on me.

data.v: वैधव्यं यान्ति यैर्नार्योऽलक्षणैर्भाग्यदुर्लभाः । नात्मनस्तानि पश्यामि पश्यन्ती हतलक्षणा ॥
data.es: "Those inauspicious signs found in unlucky and widowed women are difficult to find in me. I do not see any such signs in me."
data.anv: हतलक्षणा auspicious signs gone, पश्यन्ती to see, भागदुर्लभाः very difficult, नार्यः noble, यैः whoever, अलक्षणैःवैधव्यम् inauspicious widowed, यान्ति indeed, तानि not in me, आत्मनः myself, नपश्यामि do not see.
data.md: Those marks find I none on me by which women of rare fortune come by widowhood, but I find that in me these good tokens are nullified.

data.v: सत्यानीमानि पद्मानि स्त्रीणामुक्त्वानि लक्षणे । तान्यद्य निहते रामे वितथानि भवन्ति मे ॥
data.es: "Characteristic marks of lotuses, unfailing in their effect (truthful) predicted are all false if Rama is killed."
data.anv: लक्षणैः characteristic marks, पद्मानि lotuses, स्त्रीणाम् in sastras, सत्यनानामानि truthful lines, उक्तानि told, मे my, तानि such, अद्य, रामे Rama, निहते killed, वितथानि false, भवन्ति will be.
data.md: Those marks that are pronounced infallible by those versed in such knowledge, on Rama being slain, are nullified in me.

data.v: केशाः सूक्ष्माः समा नीला भ्रुवौ चासंगते मम । वृत्ते चालोमशे जङ्घे दन्ताश्चाविरला मम ॥
data.es: "My hair is fine and dark, my eyebrows are uniform and not joined, my shanks are round devoid of hair, and my teeth are closely set."
data.anv: मम my, केशाः hair, सूक्ष्माः fine, नीलाः dark, समाः uniform, भ्रुवौच my eyebrows, असंहते not joined, मम my, जङ्घे shanks, वृत्ते round, अरोमके devoid of hair, दन्ताश्च teeth, अविरलाः closely set.
data.md: My hairs are fine, equal, and blue; my eyebrows touch each other; my hips are devoid of down and round; and my teeth are close.

data.v: शङ्खे नेत्रे करौ पादौ गुल्फावूरू च मे चितौ । अनुवृत्ता नखाः स्निग्धाः समाश्चाङ्गुलयो मम ॥
data.es: "My temporal bones, eyes, hands, feet, ankles, thighs are even, and my fingers are fleshy and round with nails proportioned and bright."
data.anv: मम my, शङ्खे temporal bones, नेत्रे eyes, करौ hand s, पादौ feet, गुल्फौ ankles, ऊरू thighs, समौ even, चितौ fleshy, अङ्गुलयः fingers, अनुवृत्तनखाः nails are round, स्निग्धाः well proportioned, समाश्च and bright.
data.md: My temples, and eyes hands, feet, ankles, and thighs are equal. And my fingers are furnished with round nails, and are plump and even in the middle.

data.v: स्तनौ चाविरलौ पीनौ ममेमौ मग्नचूचुकौ । मग्ना चोत्सङ्गिनी नाभिः पार्श्वोरस्कं च मे चितम् ॥
data.es: "My breasts are well formed and developed, the nipples are depressed and joined, the navel is deep, and the surrounding part is fleshy."
data.anv: मामकौ my, स्तनौ breast, अविरळौ well formed, पीनौ developed, मग्नचूचुकौ depressed nipples, उत्सङ्गिनी joined, नाभिः navel, मग्ना deep, मे my, पार्श्वोरस्कंच and the surrounding area, चितम् fleshy.
data.md: And my breasts are close and firm and developed, and have their nipples sunk. And my navel is depressed, with high sides. And my chest is swelling.

data.v: मम वर्णो मणिनिभो मृदून्यङ्गरुहाणि च । प्रतिष्ठितां द्वदशभिर्मामूचुः शुभलक्षणाम् ॥
data.es: "My complexion is like the shine of a gem. My hair on the skin is soft. When I touch the ground with my ten fingers and toes, it is said to leave auspicious marks."
data.anv: मम my, वर्णः colour, मणिनिभः shine of gem, अङ्गरुहाणि hair on my skin, मृदूनि soft, द्वादशभिः ten fingers and toes, प्रतिष्ठिताम् when placed on the ground, माम् me, शुभलक्षणाम् auspicious marks, ऊचुः said to be.
data.md: My complexion is like the hue of gems, and my down soft. And they said that I was furnished with twelve auspicious signs.

data.v: समग्रयवमच्छिद्रं पाणिपादं च वर्णवत् । मन्दस्मितेत्येव च मां कन्यालक्षणिका विदुः ॥
data.es: "My palms and feet placed together have no space which are auspicious marks and brahmins have said that my gentle smile is also a mark of auspiciousness."
data.anv: पाणिपादंच palms and feet, समग्रयवम् with no space in between, अच्छ्रिद्रम् collected, वर्णवत् described, मन्दस्मिता gentle smile, इति thus, माम् myself, कन्यालाक्षणिनः marks of auspiciousness, द्विजाः brahmins.
data.md: And my hands in the middle parts of my fingers contain wheat-marks, and in the spaces between the fingers, have no uneven corners. And my feet also partake of the general complexion. And my laugh is a gentle smile. And those versed in marks of women knew that I was possessed of such marks.

data.v: अधिराज्येऽभिषेको मे ब्राह्मणैः पतिना सह । कृतान्तकुशलैरुक्तं तत्सर्वं वितथीकृतम् ॥
data.es: "The prediction of astrologers that I will be consecrated with my husband and all that is falsified."
data.anv: पतिनासह with husband, मे I, आधिराज्याभिषेकः consecrated, कृतान्तकुशलैः astrologers prediction, ब्राह्मणैः by brahmins, उक्तम् said, तत् सर्वम् all that, वितथीकृतम् falsified.
data.md: Those Brähmaņas skilled in telling fortune said that I should be installed in the kingdom along with my husband; but all that has been falsified.

data.v: शोधयित्वा जनस्थानं प्रवृत्तिमुपलभ्य च । तीर्त्वा सागरमक्षोभ्यं भ्रातरौ गोष्पदे हतौ ॥
data.es: "Having gained Janasthana and crossing the ocean which is impossible knowing about my whereabouts and getting me is impossible since the brothers have been killed by the maya of Indrajith whose footprints are like a cow's hoof."
data.anv: जनस्थानम् Janasthana, शोधयित्वा in search of me, प्रवृततिम् knowing my where about, उपलभ्यच to get me, अक्षोभ्यम् impossible, सागरम् ocean, तीर्त्वा crossing, भ्रातरौ brothers, गोष्पदे maya of Indrajith which is like foot print of cow's hoof, हतौ killed.
data.md: Having purified Janasthana (of Raksasas), obtained tidings of me, and crossed the Ocean* incapable of being agitated, those brothers have been slain in the footprint of a cow! *The commentator assigns a metaphorical sense to ocean-but this is hardly necessary.

data.v: ननु वारुणमाग्नेयमैन्द्रं वायव्यमेव च । अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरश्चैव राघवौ प्रत्यपद्यताम् ॥
data.es: "Raghavas knew to use Varuna's weapons, fire god's weapons, Indra's also, even wind god's and Brahma's weapons. Why have they not used?"
data.anv: राघवौ Raghavas, वारुणम् Varuna weapons, आग्नेयम् fire weapons, ऐन्द्रम् Indra's, वायव्यमेवच and even wind god's, ब्रह्मशिरःअस्त्रंच even Brahma's, प्रत्यपद्यतांननु why have they not used
data.md: The descendants of Raghu had obtained Väruņa and Āgneya and Aindra and Vāyavya and Brahmasira weapons.* * And did they not remember this now? completes the sense.

data.v: अदृश्यमानेन रणे मायया वासवोपमौ । मम नाथावनाथाया निहतौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥
data.es: "Indrajith remaining invisible in war by conjuring could kill my husband who is equal to Indra in valour. Rama and Lakshmana! I am orphaned now."
data.anv: अनाथायाः orphaned, मम I am, नाथौ dear husband, वासनोपमौ equal to Indra in valour, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, रणे in war, मायया by conjuring trick, अदृश्यमानेन by being invisible, निहतौ killed
data.md: Through illusion have those lords of me, who am forlorn. Rāma and Lakşmaņa, resembling Vasava himself in battle, been slain.

data.v: न हि दृष्टिपथं प्राप्य राघवस्य रणे रिपुः । जीवन्प्रतिनिवर्तेत यद्यपि स्यान्मनोजवः ॥
data.es: "Even if the enemy is endowed with speed of thought, if he comes in the range of Rama's sight, he will not go alive."
data.anv: रिपुः enemy, मनोजवः who is endowed with speed in thought, स्याद्यद्यपि if seen, रणे in war, राघवस्य by Rama, दृष्टिपथम् range of sight, प्राप्य happens, जीवन् life, नप्रन्तिवर्ततेहि not go alive.
data.md: Coming in battle within ken of Raghava, a foe, even if he be endowed with the fleetness of thought, does not go back living.

data.v: न कालस्यातिभारोऽस्ति कृतान्तश्च सुदुर्जयः । यत्र रामः सह भ्रात्रा शेते युधि निपाथितः ॥
data.es: "Rama along with Lakshmana has fallen in the battlefield. Time spirit is too heavy and capable of doing anything, so difficult to conquer."
data.anv: यत्र since, रामः Rama, भ्रात्रासह with his brother, युधि in the battle, निपातितः fallen, शेते lies, कालस्य time spirit, अतिभारः too heavy, नास्ति not, कृतान्तश्च capable of doing anything, सुदुर्जयः difficult to conquer.
data.md: There is nothing which is too hard for Time; and the Destroyer is incapable of being overcome; inasmuch as Rāma along with his brother Lakşmaņa has fallen in fight.

data.v: नाहं शोचामि भर्तारं निहतं न च लक्ष्मणम् । नात्मानं जननी चापि यथा श्वश्रूं तपस्विनीम् ॥
data.es: "When I think of Rama or even great warrior Lakshmana, or my mother or myself I am not so sad as when I think of my motherinlaw who is an observer of austerity."
data.anv: तपस्विनीम् one who observes austerities, श्वश्रूम् motherinlaw, यथा like that, तथा so also, रामम् Rama, नशोचामि not grieve, महारथम् great warrior, लक्ष्मणंच even Lakshmana, आत्मानम् my own self, नजननींचापि even my mother, न not.

data.v: सा हि चिन्तयते नित्यं समाप्तव्रतमागतम् । कदा द्रक्ष्यामि सीतां च रामं च सहलक्ष्मणम् ॥
data.es: "She will also be worried and wait for Rama who has completed his vow (for fourteen years) and Lakshmana and Sita to come."
data.anv: सातु she also, समाप्तव्रतम् vow completed, आगतम् will come, सराघवम् Raghava, लक्ष्मणंच and Lakshmana, सीताम् च Sita also, कदा then, द्रक्ष्यामि will see, नित्यम् always, चिन्तयते worried

data.v: परिदेवयमानां तां राक्षसी त्रिजटाब्रवीत् । मा विषादं कृथा देवि भर्तायं तव जीवति ॥
data.es: Looking at Sita, worried, Trijata said 'Devi, do not despair. Your husband is alive'.
data.anv: परिदेवयमानाम् god like woman, ताम् her, राक्षसी rakshasi, त्रिजटा Trijata, अब्रवीत् said, देवी Devi, विषादम् sorrow, माकृथाः not despair, तव your, भर्ता husband, अयम् this, जीवति is alive.
data.md: As she was thus lamenting, the Rākṣasai, said, O exalted lady, do not weep thus, your lord live.

data.v: कारणानि च वक्ष्यामि महान्ति सदृशानि च । यथेमौ जीवतो देवि भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥
data.es: "O Devi! Rama and Lakshmana are alive. I see great reasons for this."
data.anv: देवी Devi, भ्रातरौ brothers, इमौ like this, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, यथा in this way, जीवतः alive, महान्ति great, सदृशानि living, कारणानिच and the reasons, वक्ष्यामि I see.
data.md: O dignified one, I shall unfold to you potent and probable reasons why the brothers Rāma and Laksmana live.

data.v: न हि कोपपरीतानि हर्षपर्युत्सुकानि च । भवन्ति युधि योधानां मुखानि निहते पतौ ॥
data.es: "If a husband ceases life in war, their face will not have an angry look or happy appearance."
data.anv: पतौ husband, युधि in war, निहते ceased of life, योधानाम् in the war, मुखानि face, कोपपरीतानि angry look, हर्षपर्युत्सुकानिच happy looks, नभवन्तिहि not be there.
data.md: When their leader fall, the countenances of the warriors in battle are not overspread with passion, or display cheerfulness and vivacity.

data.v: इदं विमानं वैदेहि पुष्पकं नाम नामतः । दिव्यं त्वां धारयेन्नेदं यद्येतौ गजजीवितौ ॥
data.es: "Vaidehi! Indeed, this aerial car called Pushpaka which is an auspicious one would not have brought you if they are ceased of life."
data.anv: वैदेही Vaidehi, नामतः indeed, पुष्पकंनाम Pushpaka by name, दिव्यम् auspicious, इदंविमानम् this aerial car, एतौ if they, गतजीवितौयदि are ceased of life, त्वाम् your, नधारयेत् would not have borne.
data.md: O Vaidehi, if those had lost their lives, this celestial chariot, named Puspaka, would not have held you.

data.v: हतवीरप्रधाना हि हतोत्साहा निरुद्यमा । सेना भ्रमति संख्येषु हतकर्णेव नौर्जले ॥
data.es: "The army chief killed, the interest of the troop lost, Pushpaka will move about without making an effort like the ship which lost the helmsman."
data.anv: सङ् ख्येषु the troop, हतवीरप्रधाना chief leader dead, सेना army, गतोत्साहा lost interest, निरुद्यमा without making effort, जले in water, हतकर्णा lost helmsman, नौःइव like ship, भ्रमति moves about.

data.v: इयं पुनरसंभ्रान्ता निरुद्विग्ना तरस्विनी । सेना रक्षति काकुत्स्थौ मायया निर्जितौ रणे ॥
data.es: "O Lady, given to austerities! These monkeys are guarding Kakuthsa as proclaimed by me lovingly. Do not be confused. They are safe."
data.anv: तरस्विनी O lady given to austerities, इयम् this, सेवापुनः guarding, असम्भ्रान्ता confused, निरुद्विग्ना proclaimed, मया by me, प्रीत्या lovingly, निवेदितौ telling, काकुत्स्थौ Kakuthsa, रक्षति are safe.

data.v: सा त्वं भव सुविस्रब्धा अनुमानैः सुखोदयैः । अहतौ पश्य काकुत्स्थौ स्नेहादेतद्ब्रवीमि ते ॥
data.es: "This army is not doubting, not perturbed also, that they are killed. They are guarding the Kakutsthas lovingly. I am telling you."
data.anv: सा he, त्वम् you, सुखोदयैः the army, अनुमानैः not doubtful, सविस्रब्धाः not perturbed, भव you, अहतौ not killed, काकुत्स्थौ Kakutsthas, पश्य seeing, स्नेहात् lovingly, एतद् all this, ते to you, ब्रवीमि telling.
data.md: Do you, at this conclusion bringing in joy, take comfort; and behold the Kākutsthas unslain. This I tell you from affection.

data.v: अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं मे न च वक्ष्ये कदाचन । चारित्रसुखशीलत्वात्प्रविष्टासि मनो मम ॥
data.es: "I have not uttered untruth earlier nor shall I do now. Indeed, you have found entry into my mind being a woman of good disposition."
data.anv: नउक्तपूर्वम् not uttered earlier, नचवक्ष्ये nor tell a lie, कदाचन indeed, चारित्रसुखशीलत्वात् woman of good disposition, मम I am, मनः heartily, प्रविष्टाअसि found entry into my mind.
data.md: I never told you untruths heretofore; nor, O Mithila's daughter, will I tell them to you now. You by virtue of your character conducive to delight, have found an access into my heart.

data.v: नेमौ शक्यौ रणे जेतुं सेन्द्रैरपि सुरासुरैः । एतयोराननं दृष्ट्वा मया चावेदितं तव ॥
data.es: "These two are not capable of being won in war even by gods or demons. On observation of the indications by me I am making you realize."
data.anv: इमौ these, सेन्द्रैः Indra, सुरासुरैरपि even Suras or Asuras also, रणे in war, जेतुम् to win, नशक्यौ not capable, तादृशम् indications of life, दर्शनम् observation, दृष्टवा seeing, मया by me, तव your, आवेदितुम् making you to know.
data.md: These even the celestials and Asuras with Indra (at their head) are incompetent to quell. Seeing such sight, I speak to you as to their being alive.

data.v: इदं च सुमहच्चिह्नं शनैः पश्यस्व मैथिलि । निःसंज्ञावप्युभावेतौ नैव लक्ष्मीर्वियुज्यते ॥
data.es: "O Mythili! Even though both of them have fallen and unconscious under arrows their body splendour has not diminished. You may see."
data.anv: मैथिलि Mythili, शरैः arrows, निस्संज्ञावपि unconscious also, उभौ both, अपि indeed, एतौ these, लक्ष्मीः prosperous, नैवमुञ्चति body splendour not diminished, इदम् this, सुमहत् great, चित्रम् wonder, पश्यस्व you may see
data.md: And behold O Maithili, this mighty wonder! These are lying insensible with arrows; but of these Grace has not taken leave.

data.v: प्रायेण गतसत्त्वानां पुरुषाणां गतायुषाम् । दृश्यमानेषु वक्त्रेषु परं भवति वैकृतम् ॥
data.es: "Normally when we see men who have ceased life and stopped breathing their features are unappealing."
data.anv: प्रायेण normally, गतायुषाम् ceased of life, गतसत्त्वानाम् whose breathing has stopped, पुरुषाणाम् among men, दृश्यमानेषु when we see, वक्त्रेषु in features, परम् very, वैकृतम् unappealing, भवति will be
data.md: It generally happens that the faces of persons dead and gone, are unsightly to a degree. Therefore, O Janka's daughter, leave off grief and sorrow and stupor. For the sake of Rāma and Lakşmaņa you can not today put a period to your existence.

data.v: त्यज शोकं च दुःखं च मोहं च जनकात्मजे । रामलक्ष्मणयोरर्थे नाद्य शक्यमजीवितुम् ॥
data.es: "O Janaka's daughter! You give up grief and delusion about Rama and Lakshmana. They are alive, no doubt."
data.anv: जनकात्मजे Janaki, रामलक्ष्मणयोः Rama and Lakshmana अर्थे both, शोकम् sorrow, दुःखंच and grief, मोहंच and delusion, त्यज giving up, अद्य get up, अजीवितुम् are alive, नशक्यम् not possible.
data.md: It generally happens that the faces of persons dead and gone, are unsightly to a degree. Therefore, O Janka's daughter, leave off grief and sorrow and stupor. For the sake of Rāma and Lakşmaņa you can not today put a period to your existence.

data.v: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्याः सीता सुरसुतोपमा । कृताञ्जलिरुवाचेदमेवमस्त्विति मैथिली ॥
data.es: Sita who was like deity, on hearing the words of consolation, spoken by Trijata, greeted Trijata with palms together.
data.anv: सुरसुतोपमा equal to deities, मैथिली Mythili, सीता Sita, तस्याः her, वचनम् words of consolation, श्रुत्वा hearing, कृताज्ञलिः greeted with both palms together, एवम् in that way, अस्, इति thus, उवाच spoke.
data.md: Hearing her words, Mithila's daughter-Sītāresembling the daughter of a celestial, with hands joined, said, "May this be so!

data.v: विमानं पुष्पकं तत्तु समिवर्त्य मनोजवम् । दीना त्रिजटया सीता लङ्कामेव प्रवेशिता ॥
data.es: Then Trijata took Sita in the Pushpaka chariot endowed with the speed of mind and entered Lanka.
data.anv: दीना desperate, सीता Sita, त्रिजटया Trijata, मनोजवम् speed of mind, तत् there, पुष्पकंविमानम् Pushpaka chariot, सन्निवर्त्य turning, लङ्कामेव into Lanka, प्रवेशिता entered.
data.md: Then turning away the car Puşpaka fleet as the mind, the distressed Sītā entered Lankā along with Trijata.

data.v: ततस्त्रिजटया सार्धं पुष्पकादवरुह्य सा । अशोकवनिकामेव रक्षसीभिः प्रवेशिता ॥
data.es: Thereafter Sita along with Trijata went to Pushpaka. Making Sita to get down, rakshasi also entered Ashoka grove.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, सा she, त्रिजटयासार्थम् along with Trijata, पुष्पकात् in Pushpaka, अनरुह्य making to get down, राक्षसीभिः rakshasi also, अशोकवनिकामेव to Ashoka grove, प्रवेशिता entered.
data.md: Then in company with Trijatā alighting from Puşpaka, she along with the Rākşasis entered the asoka wood.

data.v: प्रविश्य सीता बहुवृक्षषण्डां; तां राक्षसेन्द्रस्य विहारभूमिम् । संप्रेक्ष्य संचिन्त्य च राजपुत्रौ; परं विषादं समुपाजगाम ॥
data.es: Having entered the Rakshasa's pleasure garden which had many trees, Sita gave way to intense sorrow having keenly observed the king's sons.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the forty eighth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: सीता Sita, बहुवृक्षषण्डाम् with many trees, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa Lord's, विहारभूमिम् pleasure garden, ताम् they, प्रविश्य on entering, राजपुत्रौ king's sons, सम्प्रेक्ष्य having keenly observed, सञ्चिन्त्यच with intense agony, परम् very, विषादम् sad, उपाजगाम gave way.
data.md: Entering that sporting-ground of the Raksasa lord abounding in woody tracts, Sītā, having beheld those princes and reflected on them, became subject to a mighty grief.

data.v: घोरेण शरबन्धेन बद्धौ दशरथात्मजौ । निश्वसन्तौ यथा नागौ शयानौ रुधिरोक्षितौ ॥
data.es: Sugriva, the very powerful one and all the best of Vanaras stood immersed in sorrow surrounding the great sons of Dasaratha, who were lying on the ground bound by a network of arrows like serpents, sighing, bodies covered with blood.
data.anv: ससुग्रीवाः that Sugriva, महाबलाः very powerful, सर्वे all, तेवानरश्रेष्ठाः best of Vanaras, घोरेण horrible, शरबन्धेन caught in network of arrows, बद्धौ bound, नागौयथा like serpents, निःश्वसन्तौ sighing, रुधिरोक्षितौ covered with blood, शयानौ lying, महात्मानौ great souls, दशरथात्मजौ Dasaratha's sons, परिवार्य surrounding, शोकपरिप्लुताः immersed in sorrow, तस्थुः were.
data.md: Bound up terribly with shafts, Dasaratha's sons, lying down bathed in blood, sighed hard like to serpents.

data.v: सर्वे ते वानरश्रेष्ठाः ससुग्रीवा महाबलाः । परिवार्य महात्मानौ तस्थुः शोकपरिप्लुताः ॥
data.es: Sugriva, the very powerful one and all the best of Vanaras stood immersed in sorrow surrounding the great sons of Dasaratha, who were lying on the ground bound by a network of arrows like serpents, sighing, bodies covered with blood.
data.anv: ससुग्रीवाः that Sugriva, महाबलाः very powerful, सर्वे all, तेवानरश्रेष्ठाः best of Vanaras, घोरेण horrible, शरबन्धेन caught in network of arrows, बद्धौ bound, नागौयथा like serpents, निःश्वसन्तौ sighing, रुधिरोक्षितौ covered with blood, शयानौ lying, महात्मानौ great souls, दशरथात्मजौ Dasaratha's sons, परिवार्य surrounding, शोकपरिप्लुताः immersed in sorrow, तस्थुः were.
data.md: All those foremost monkeys, along with Sugrīva, possessed of exceeding strength, overwhelmed with sorrow, remained surrounding those high-souled ones.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नन्तेरे रामः प्रत्यबुध्यत वीर्यवान् । स्थिरत्वात्सत्त्वयोगाच्च शरैः संदानितोऽपि सन् ॥
data.es: In the meantime, Rama, although bound, being a man of fortitude established in spiritual discipline, returned to consciousness.
data.anv: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे in the meantime, वीर्यवान् heroic, रामः Rama, शरैः arrows, सन्दानितोऽपि although bound, स्थिरत्वात् man of fortitude, सत्त्वयोगात् च and established in spiritual discipline, प्रत्यबुध्यत returned to consciousness.
data.md: In the meanwhile, the powerful Rāma, albeit fast bound by the shafts, awoke by virtue of the exceeding toughness of his person, as well as his might.

data.v: ततो दृष्ट्वा सरुधिरं विषण्णं गाढमर्पितम् । भ्रातरं दीनवदनं पर्यदेवयदातुरः ॥
data.es: There after seeing the piteous countenance of his brother, bound, and injured, Rama lamented.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, सरुधिरम् the blood, विषण्णम् in agony, गाढम् severe, अर्पितम्  bound, दीनवदनम् piteous countenance, भ्रातरम् brother, दृष्टवा seeing, आतुरः injured, पर्यदेवयत् lamented.
data.md: Then, seeing his brother having a distressful countenance, covered with blood, feeble, and fast bound by the shafts, Rāma, greatly aggrieved, began to mourn.

data.v: किं नु मे सीतया कार्यं किं कार्यं जीवितेन वा । शयानं योऽद्य पश्यामि भ्रातरं युधि निर्जितम् ॥
data.es: "Of what purpose is my life when I behold my brother lying lifeless in war? What do I have with Sita? Or even with my life?"
data.anv: यः of what, अद्य my use, युधि in war, निर्जितम् lifeless, शयानम् lying, भ्रातरम् brother, पश्यामि behold, मे my, सीतया Sita, किंनुकार्यम् What accomplishment, जीवितेनवा even of life, किंकार्यम् of what use.
data.md: Of what use to me is the recovery of Sītă, or life either, when today I see my brother vanquished in fight and lying down in the field?

data.v: शक्या सीता समा नारी प्राप्तुं लोके विचिन्वता । न लक्ष्मणसमो भ्राता सचिवः साम्परायिकः ॥
data.es: "In a mortal world I can look for a woman like Sita but not possible to find a helpful and capable brother."
data.anv: मर्त्यलोके mortal world, विचिन्वता look for, सीतासमा equal to Sita, नारी woman, शक्या possible, सचिवः friend, साम्परायिकः capable, लक्ष्मणसमः Lakshmana like, भ्राता brother, न not.
data.md: Seeking in the world (of men), I may light upon a woman like Sītā; but never on a brother, or a helper, or a warrior like to Laksmana.

data.v: परित्यक्ष्याम्यहं प्राणान्वानराणां तु पश्यताम् । यदि पञ्चत्वमापन्नः सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः ॥
data.es: "If Sumithra's dear son gets merged with the five elements, I will give up my life as the Vanaras are beholding."
data.anv: सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः Sumithra's dear son, पञ्चत्वम् killedmerging with five elements, आपन्नः happens यदि if it, अहम् I, वानराणाम् Vanaras also, पश्यताम् as they behold, प्राणान् life, परित्यक्ष्यामि will give up life.
data.md: If that enhancer of Sumitra's joy have met with his end, my life I must renounce in the sight of the monkeys.

data.v: किं नु वक्ष्यामि कौसल्यां मातरं किं नु कैकयीम् । कथमम्बां सुमित्रांच पुत्रदर्शनलालसाम् ॥
data.es: "What can I say to mother Kausalya, Kaikeyi and mother Sumithra waiting to see her son?"
data.anv: मातरम् mother, कौसल्याम् to Kausalya, किंनुवक्ष्यामि What can I say, कैकयीम् to Kaikeyi, किंनु What to say, पुत्रदर्शनलालसाम् waiting to see the son, अम्बाम् mother, सुमित्राम् to Sumithra, कथम् What.
data.md: What shall I say to Kausalyā; and what shall I say to Kaikeyi ? And what shall I say to mother Sumitrā eager for a sight of her son? And if I go (back) without him, how shall I soothe her, like to a cow reft of her calf; and trembling; and resembling a mourning Kurari?

data.v: विवत्सां वेपमानां च क्रोशन्तीं कुररीमिव । कथमाश्वासयिष्यामि यदि यास्यामि तं विना ॥
data.es: "If I go to Ayodhya without him, how can I console Sumithra crying aloud like a female osprey?"
data.anv: तंविना without him, यास्यामियदि if I go, विवत्साम् without son, वेपमानांच and trembling, कुररीमिव a female osprey, क्रोशन्तीम् crying aloud, कथम् how, आश्वासयिष्यामि can console.

data.v: कथं वक्ष्यामि शत्रुघ्नं भरतं च यशस्विनम् । मया सह वनं यातो विना तेनागतः पुनः ॥
data.es: "How can I return bereft of Lakshmana who went with me to the forest? What can I tell Satrughna, also the Bharata of great fame?"
data.anv: मयासह along with me, वनम् forest, यातः return, तेनविना bereft of him, अहम् I, आगतः go, शत्रघ्नम् Satrughna, यशस्विनम् of great fame, भरतम् Bharata, कथम् how, वक्ष्यामि can I say, पुनः again.
data.md: How shall I say to Satrughna and the illustrious Bharata, 'He went with me to the forest; but I come (back) here without him "?

data.v: उपालम्भं न शक्ष्यामि सोढुं बत सुमित्रया । इहैव देहं त्यक्ष्यामि न हि जीवितुमुत्सहे ॥
data.es: "If Sumithra asks me, I can't endure. I cannot bear it. I shall give up my body, my life here itself."
data.anv: बत tell, सुमित्रया to Sumithra, उपालम्भम् endure, सोढुम् blame, नशक्ष्यामि not tolerate, इहैव here itself, देहम् body, त्यक्ष्यामि will give up, जीवितुम् life, नउत्सहे not bear.
data.md: I shall not be able to bear the rebuke of mother Sumitră. Therefore even here shall I renounce my person; for certainly I dare not live.

data.v: धिङ्मां दुष्कृतकर्माणमनार्यं यत्कृते ह्यसौ । लक्ष्मणः पतितः शेते शरतल्पे गतासुवत् ॥
data.es: "What a pity! Me of sinful deeds and not a noble one, because of whose action Lakshmana's life having departed and lying on the bed of arrows."
data.anv: दुष्कृतकर्माणाम् of sinful deeds, अनार्यम् not noble, माम् me, धिक् What a pity, मत्कृते by my action, असौ Oh, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, पतितः sinful, गतासुवत् whose life has departed, शरतल्पे on bed of arrows, शेतेहि let him be burnt.
data.md: Fie on me, who am wicked and base; for me this Lakşmaņa, brought down, leith in the field of battle, like one that is without life.

data.v: त्वं नित्यं सुविषण्णं मामाश्वासयसि लक्ष्मण । गतासुर्नाद्य शक्नोषि मामार्तमभिभाषितुम् ॥
data.es: "You were always comforting me when I was sad. Now however much I am grieved, ceased of life you cannot comfort me."
data.anv: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, त्वम् you were, नित्यम् always, सुविषण्णम् sad, माम् me, आश्वासयसि comforted, अद्य now, गतासुः ceased of life, आर्तम् grieved, माम् me, अभिभाषितुम् to comfort, शक्तः capable, नासि not.
data.md: O Lakşmaņa, you ever comforts me when I am dispirited. But today, having lost your life, you can not speak to me, who am afflicted.

data.v: येनाद्य बहवो युद्धे राक्षसा निहताः क्षितौ । तस्यामेव क्षितौ वीरः स शेते निहतः परैः ॥
data.es: "You, who have struck down many Rakshasas in war, are lying unconscious on the same ground struck by arrows."
data.anv: येन who, अद्य now, युद्धे in war, बहवः many, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, विनिपातिताः injured and thrown down, निहताः struck down, शूरः by arrows, त्वम् such you, अद्य now, परैः fallen, निहतः killed, तस्यामेव there itself, शेषे unconscious.
data.md: You, O hero, who had in battle slain innumerable Rākṣasa lying around, have (at length) yourself been slain in the field with shafts.

data.v: शयानः शरतल्पेऽस्मिन्स्वशोणितपरिप्लुतः । शरजालैश्चितो भाति भास्करोऽस्तमिव व्रजन् ॥
data.es: "Lying on the bed of arrows in the network of arrows, blood flowing out from the body he remains shining like the setting sun."
data.anv: शरजालैः by the network of arrows, चितः lying, शोणितपरिप्लुतः blood flowing, अस्मिन् his, शरतल्पे bed of arrows, शयानः lying, सः he, अस्तम् his own, व्रजन् sinking, भास्करःइव like the sun, भासि remains shining.
data.md: And lying down in the battle-field, bleeding and covered with arrows, you appear like the Sun when he has gone up the Setting-hill.

data.v: बाणाभिहतमर्मत्वान्न शक्नोत्यभिवीक्षितुम् । रुजा चाब्रुवतो ह्यस्य दृष्टिरागेण सूच्यते ॥
data.es: "Struck in the vital parts by the arrows, it is not possible for you to speak, but your anguish is indicated in your looks."
data.anv: बाणाभिहतमर्मत्वात् struck in the vital parts by the arrows, अभिभाषितुम् to speak, नशक्नोति, अब्रुवतोऽपि not possible, अस्य his, रुजा anguish, दृष्टिरागेण his looks, सूच्यते indicating.
data.md: In consequence of shafts piercing your vitals, you cannot speak; but your visible expression, albeit you are dumb, betokens pain.

data.v: यथैव मां वनं यान्तमनुयातो महाद्युतिः । अहमप्यनुयास्यामि तथैवैनं यमक्षयम् ॥
data.es: "This Lakshmana glowing in brightness, travelled with me following me in the forest. In the same way I shall follow him to the abode of death."
data.anv: महाद्युतिः glowing in brightness, वनम् forest, यान्तम् travelling, माम् me, यथैव with me, अनुयातः followed, तथैव in the same way, अहमपि I will also, एनम् in that way, यमक्ष्यम् abode of death, अनुयास्यामि will follow you.
data.md: O you endowed with exceeding splendour, even as you did follow me into the forest, will I follow you to the mansion of Yama.

data.v: इष्टबन्धुजनो नित्यं मां च नित्यमनुव्रतः । इमामद्य गतोऽवस्थां ममानार्यस्य दुर्नयैः ॥
data.es: "He who was liked by relatives, was following ignoble me ever devoutly has reached this state."
data.anv: नित्यम् always, इष्टबन्धुजनः liked by relatives, नित्यम् ever, माम् me, अनुव्रतः following, अनार्यस्य ignoble, मम me, दुर्नयैः devoted, अद्य now, इमाम् such, अवस्थाम् state, गतः reached.
data.md: You having dear friends, and ever following me, has come by this plight in consequence of my reprehensible conduct.

data.v: सुरुष्टेनापि वीरेण लक्ष्मणेना न संस्मरे । परुषं विप्रियं वापि श्रावितं न कदाचन ॥
data.es: "Indeed, heroic Lakshmana never uttered an unpalatable word. I do not remember him speaking harsh words even when he was deeply provoked."
data.anv: सुरुष्टेनापि even unpalatable, वीरेण heroic, लक्ष्मणेनवापि by Lakshmana, कदाचन indeed, परुषम् harsh, विप्रियम् deeply, श्रावितम् invoked, नसंस्मरे I do not remember.
data.md: I do not remember having heard any harsh speech from the heroic Lakşmaņa, even when he had happened to be exceedingly wroth.

data.v: विससर्जैकवेगेन पञ्चबाणशतानि यः । इष्वस्त्रेष्वधिकस्तस्मात्कार्तवीर्याच्च लक्ष्मणः ॥
data.es: "He who, in one go released five hundred arrows (with two hand s) is therefore superior to Kartaveerya (with thousand hands) releasing the same arrows."
data.anv: यः he who, एकवेगेन in one go, पञ्च five, बाणशतानि fund red arrows, विससर्ज released, तस्मात् therefore, कार्तवीर्यात् च by Kartaveerya, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, इष्वस्त्रषु in discharging, अधिकः superior.
data.md: He that could discharge at one shot five hundred shafts, that Lakşmaņa is superior to karttaviryya himself in that weapon-the bow.

data.v: अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि यो हन्याच्छक्रस्यापि महात्मनः । सोऽयमुर्व्यांहतः शेते महार्हशयनोचितः ॥
data.es: "He, who could destroy Indra's arrows also deserves to be on Indra's bed, is lying on the ground, killed."
data.anv: यः he who, महात्मनः great soul, शक्रस्य Indra's, अस्त्राण्यपि arrows also, अस्त्रः arrows, हन्यात् destroy, महार्हशयनोचितः deserve to be esteemed, सःअयम् such a person, हतः killed, उर्व्याम् on the ground, शेते lying.
data.md: He that with his arms could resist the arms of Sakra himself, that one worthy of a costly couchLeith down on the ground, slain.

data.v: तच्च मिथ्या प्रलप्तं मां प्रधक्ष्यति न संशयः । यन्मया न कृतो राजा राक्षसानां विभीषणः ॥
data.es: "I have not made Vibheeshana as the king of Rakshasas. Because of that untruth utterance they want to consume me, no doubt."
data.anv: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, मया by my, यत् those, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, नकृतः not done, तत् therefore, मिथ्याप्रलप्तम् untruth utterance, माम् me, प्रधक्ष्यति consume, संशयः doubt, न no.
data.md: That false babble shall now, without doubt, consume me; for by me has not Bibhishna been made monarch of the Rákşasas.

data.v: अस्मिन्मुहूर्ते सुग्रीव प्रतियातुमितोऽर्हसि । मत्वा हीनं मया राजन्रावणोऽभिद्रवेद्बली ॥
data.es: "Sugriva! You return back from here now. Strong Ravana will chase you because of my not being here."
data.anv: सुग्रीव Sugriva, अस्मिन् his, मुहूर्ते time, इतः from here, प्रतियातुम् return back, अर्हसि I think, राजन् king, रावणः Ravana, मया by me, हीनम् weak, मत्वा chase, बली strong, अब्रवेत् said.
data.md: Do you, O Sugrīva, this very moment retrace your steps. Bereft of your strength through me you will be worsted by Rāvaņa.

data.v: अङ्गदं तु पुरस्कृत्य ससैन्यः ससुहृज्जनः । सागरं तर सुग्रीव पुनस्तेनैव सेतुना ॥
data.es: "Sugriva! Return back from here along with the army keeping Angada in front, even Neela and Nala. Cross the ocean."
data.anv: सुग्रीव Sugriva, ससैन्यम् with army, सपरिच्छदम् along with all, अङ्गदम् Angada, पुरस्कृत्य keeping in front, नीलेनच even Neela, नलेनच and Nala, समुद्रम् ocean, तर you may cross.
data.md: O Sugriva, placing Angada to the fore, do you, taking your host as well as the equipage, in company with Nila and Nala, cross over the Ocean.

data.v: कृतं हनुमता कार्यं यदन्यैर्दुष्करं रणे । ऋक्षराजेन तुष्यामि गोलाङ्गूलाधिपेन च ॥
data.es: "O King of Bears! King of Golangulas! Difficult action has been done by you and others in war. I am pleased with Hanumantha's action."
data.anv: ऋक्षराजेन king of Bears, गोलाङ्गूलाधिपेन king of Golangulas, Gavaksha, रणे in war, यत् by you, अन्यैः others, दुष्करम् difficult, हनुमता Hanumantha, कार्यं in action, कृतंहि has done, तुष्यामि pleased.

data.v: अङ्गदेन कृतं कर्म मैन्देन द्विविदेन च । युद्धं केसरिणा संख्ये घोरं संपातिना कृतम् ॥
data.es: "Formidable war was done by Angada, Mainda, Dwivida, and by all the Vanaras, Kesari and Sampathi."
data.anv: अङ्गदेन by Angada, मैन्देन Mainda, द्विविदेनच by Dwivida, कर्म action, कृतम् done, सङ् ख्ये Vanaras केसरिणा Kesari, सम्पातिना Sampathi, घोरम् formidable, युद्धम् war, कृतम् was done.
data.md: By you has been achieved a mighty feat incapable of being done by another in battle. And pleased am I with the king of bears, and the lord of Golãngulas; and Angada has quit himself nobly, as also Mainda and Dvivida. And Kesarin and Sampāti have both faught terribly.

data.v: गवयेन गवाक्षेण शरभेण गजेन च । अन्यैश्च हरिभिर्युद्धं मदार्थे त्यक्तजीवितैः ॥
data.es: "Gava, Gavaksha, Sarabha and others even Vanaras have done war sacrificing their lives for me."
data.anv: गवयेन Gava, गवाक्षेण by Gavaksha, शरभेण By Sarabha, गजेन Gaja, मदर्थे and others, त्यक्तजीवितैः sacrificing their lives, अन्यैः others, हरिभिश्च even Vanaras, युद्धम् in war.
data.md: Gavaya, and Gavākşa, and Sarabha, and Gaja, and other monkeys have faught as others are incapable of fighting, determined to lay down their lives (for me).

data.v: न चातिक्रमितुं शक्यं दैवं सुग्रीव मानुषैः । यत्तु शक्यं वयस्येन सुहृदा वा परंतप । कृतं सुग्रीव तत्सर्वं भवताधर्मभीरुणा ॥
data.es: "Sugriva! It is not possible for human beings to overcome God (destiny). O scorcher of enemies! Sugriva, my best friend, you have all done righteously that which is not possible."
data.anv: सुग्रीव Sugriva, मानुषैः in human beings, दैवम् god, अतिक्रमितुम् to overcome, नचशक्यम् not possible, परन्तप scorcher of enemies, सुग्रीव Sugriva, सुहृदा best friend, वयस्येन by you, यत्तु that which, शक्यम् not possible, तत् that, सर्वम् all, धर्मभीरुणा righteously, त्वया by you, कृतम् was done.
data.md: But, O Sugriva, man cannot overrule Destiny. You, my friend, fearing righteousness, has done what lay in your power. And, You foremost of monkeys, you also have acted as become friends. Now, with my permission, go you whitersoever you are minded.

data.v: मित्रकार्यं कृतमिदं भवद्भिर्वानरर्षभाः । अनुज्ञाता मया सर्वे यथेष्टं गन्तुमर्हथ ॥
data.es: "O Bulls among Vanaras! All of you should go permitted by me. You have done friend's work. You may go where you wish to go. I permit said Rama."
data.anv: वानरर्षभाः bull among Vanaras, भवद्भिः you also, इदम् this, मित्रकार्यम् friend's work, कृतम् having done, सर्वे all, मया my, अनुज्ञाताः per mission, यथेष्टम् as you will, प्रतिगच्छत can go

data.v: शुश्रुवुस्तस्य ते सर्वे वानराः परिदेवितम् । वर्तयां चक्रुरश्रूणि नेत्रैः कृष्णेतरेक्षणाः ॥
data.es: All the Vanaras started shedding tears from their tawny eyes on listening to the lamentation of Rama.
data.anv: सर्वे all, ये you, वानराः, Vanaras तस्य their, परिदेवतम् lamentation, शुश्रुवुः tears, कृष्णेतरेक्षणाः tawny eyes, नेत्रैः eyes, अश्रूणि tears, वर्तयाञ्चक्रु: started shedding.
data.md: Hearing Rāma's lament, the monkeys-those dark-eyed and others-began to shed tears from their eyes.

data.v: ततः सर्वाण्यनीकानि स्थापयित्वा विभीषणः । आजगाम गदापाणिस्त्वरितो यत्र राघवः ॥
data.es: Thereafter, Vibheeshana, settling all the army, hastened to reach Raghava with a mace.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सर्वाणि all, अनीकानि many, स्थापयित्वा settled, गदापाणिः mace, राघवः Raghava, यत्र there, त्वरितम् hastily, आजगाम reached.
data.md: Then Vibhisana, quieting the army, taking a mace in his hand, swiftly went to where Rāghava was.

data.v: तं दृष्ट्वा त्वरितं यान्तं नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् । वानरा दुद्रुवुः सर्वे मन्यमानास्तु रावणिम् ॥
data.es: Seeing Vibheeshana resembling a dark mountain, thinking him to be Indrajith, all the Vanaras ran from there.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकोनपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the forty ninth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: त्वरितम् quickly, यान्तम् all, नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् like a dark mountain, तम् him, दृष्टवा seeing, सर्व all, वानराः Vanaras, रावणिम् Ravana's son, मन्यमानाः thinking, दुद्रुवुः ran away.
data.md: Seeing him fast making his way, resembling a mass of dark collyrium, the monkeys taking him to be Ravana's son, began to run away.

data.v: अथोवाच महातेजा हरिराजो महाबलः । किमियं व्यथिता सेना मूढवातेव नौर्जले ॥
data.es: Extremely brilliant and mighty Sugriva looking at the army of Vanaras said, "Why are you worried like a boat tossed by wind in water?"
data.anv: अथ and now, महातेजाः extremely brilliant, महाबलः mighty, हरिराजः king of monkeys, वाच words, इयंसेना the army, जले by water, मूढवातेव tossed by wind, नौःइव like the boat, किम् why, व्यथिता worrying.
data.md: Then out spoke the highly energetic and exceedingly mighty king of monkeys, “Why is this host agitated like a bark driven hither and thither by the wind?"

data.v: सुग्रीवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा वालिपुत्रोऽङ्गदोऽब्रवीत् । न त्वं पश्यसि रामं च लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम् ॥
data.es: On hearing Sugriva's question, Angada the son of Vali said, "Did you not see Dasaratha's sons Rama and chariot warrior Lakshmana, the great souls lying on a bed of arrows bathed in blood?"
data.anv: सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, अङ्गदः Angada, अब्रवीत् spoke, शरजालचितौ network of arrows, रुधिरोक्षितौ bathed in blood, शरतल्पे on a bed of arrows, शयानौ lying, महात्मानौ great souls, दशरथात्मजौ Dasaratha's sons, रामम् Rama, महारथम् chariot warrior, लक्ष्मणंच Lakshmana also, त्वम् you, नपश्यसि do you not see.
data.md: Hearing Sugriva's speech, Vali's son said, Did you not see both those heroes-sons of Dasaratha, Rama and that mighty car-warriorLakşmaņa-covered with arrows?

data.v: शरजालाचितौ वीरावुभौ दशरथात्मजौ । शरतल्पे महात्मानौ शयानौ रुधिरोक्षितौ ॥
data.es: On hearing Sugriva's question, Angada the son of Vali said, "Did you not see Dasaratha's sons Rama and chariot warrior Lakshmana, the great souls lying on a bed of arrows bathed in blood?"
data.anv: सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, अङ्गदः Angada, अब्रवीत् spoke, शरजालचितौ network of arrows, रुधिरोक्षितौ bathed in blood, शरतल्पे on a bed of arrows, शयानौ lying, महात्मानौ great souls, दशरथात्मजौ Dasaratha's sons, रामम् Rama, महारथम् chariot warrior, लक्ष्मणंच Lakshmana also, त्वम् you, नपश्यसि do you not see.
data.md: And (did you not see) those high-should ones lying in the field of battle, covered with blood ?

data.v: अथाब्रवीद्वानरेन्द्रः सुग्रीवः पुत्रमङ्गदम् । नानिमित्तमिदं मन्ये भवितव्यं भयेन तु ॥
data.es: Then Vanara king Sugriva looking at Angada said, "I do not think that the Vanaras running like this is not without any cause. Maybe out of fear of some reason ahead."
data.anv: अथ now, वानरेन्द्र Vanara king, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, पुत्रम् son, अङ्गदम् Angada, अब्रवीत् said, इदम् this, अनिमित्तम् without any reason, नमन्ये not think, भयेन out of fear, भवितव्यम् some reason ahead.
data.md: Thereat, the lord of monkeys, Sugrīva, spoke to his son, Angada "I do not deem it without cause. This may have come to pass through sheer fear.

data.v: विषण्णवदना ह्येते त्यक्तप्रहरणा दिशः । प्रपलायन्ति हरयस्त्रासादुत्फुल्ललोचनाः ॥
data.es: "Here, the distressed Vanaras with sad faces, their eyes downcast, are fleeing in all directions abandoning their arms."
data.anv: अत्र in this place, एते their, हरयः Vanaras, त्रासात् distressed, उत्फुल्ललोचनाः downcast their eyes, त्यक्तप्रहरणाः abandoning arms, विषण्णवदनाः sad face, दिशः directions, प्रपलायन्ति fleeing.
data.md: These monkeys with sad faces, leaving their arms behind them are flying in all directions, their eyes distended in affright.

data.v: अन्योन्यस्य न लज्जन्ते न निरीक्षन्ति पृष्ठतः । विप्रकर्षन्ति चान्योन्यं पतितं लङ्घयन्ति च ॥
data.es: "Without waiting to look back at others, not shy to see one another, the Vanaras are distancing themselves from those fallen and are seen fleeing."
data.anv: अन्योन्यस्य one to the other, नलज्जन्ते not shy to see others, पृष्ठतः the other side, ननिरीक्षन्ति not waiting to look back at others, अन्योन्यम् one another, विप्रकर्षन्ति distancing, पतितम् fallen, लङ्घयन्तिच and fleeing.
data.md: They are not ashamed of each other, and they do not cast their looks back. And they hug each other, and go leaping over the fallen.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरो गदापाणिर्विभीषणः । सुग्रीवं वर्धयामास राघवं च निरैक्षत ॥
data.es: In the meantime, heroic Vibheeshana holding mace came to Sugriva and Rama and cheered with victory.
data.anv: एतस्मिन् in the mean, अन्तरे while, गदापाणिः holding mace, वीरः hero, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, विभीषणंच to Vibheeshana, राघवंच Raghava, निरैक्षत seeing, वर्धयामास cheered with victory.
data.md: In the meanwhile that hero, Vibhisana, bearing a mace in his hand, (approaching) greeted Sugrīva as well as Rāghava with blessings of victory.

data.v: विभीषणं तं सुग्रीवो दृष्ट्वा वानरभीषणम् । ऋक्षराजं समीपस्थं जाम्बवन्तमुवाच ह ॥
data.es: Beholding Vibheeshana, the Vanaras fled, said Sugriva to the great Jambavan who stood near him.
data.anv: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, वानरभीषणम् Vanaras beholding Vibheeshana, दृष्टवा beholding, समीपस्थम् stood near, महात्मानम् great, ऋक्षराजम् king of Bears, Jambavan, उवाचह spoke.
data.md: And Sugriva, seeing Vibhisana, capable of inspiring fear in the monkeys, spoke to the highsouled sovereign of bears, who stood by.

data.v: विभीषणोऽयं संप्राप्तो यं दृष्ट्वा वानरर्षभाः । विद्रवन्ति परित्रस्ता रावणात्मजशङ्कया ॥
data.es: "Vibheeshana has come here. Beholding him the foremost of the Vanaras fleeing suspecting him to be the son of Ravana."
data.anv: अयम् this, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सम्प्राप्तः having come here, यम् , दृष्टवा beholding, वानरर्षभाः foremost Vanaras, रावणात्मशङ्काया thinking him to be Ravana's son, विद्रवन्ति suspecting, परित्रस्त fleeing.
data.md: This is Vibhișana that has come hither, seeing whom the foremost among the monkeys, from fear of Rāvana's son who, they apprehend, he is, are fleeing away, seized with a panic.

data.v: शीघ्रमेतान्सुवित्रस्तान्बहुधा विप्रधावितान् । पर्यवस्थापयाख्याहि विभीषणमुपस्थितम् ॥
data.es: "Call them back who are running in different directions quickly. Tell them Vibheeshana has come here."
data.anv: सुसन्त्रस्तान् fearing, बहुधा many directions, विप्रधावितान् fleeing, एतान् all of them, शीघ्रम् quickly, पर्यवस्था running, उपस्थितम् has come here, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, आख्याहि call them.
data.md: Do you at once stay these agitated with fear and scampering all around; and proclaim, 'This is Vibhisana, who has come here.'

data.v: सुग्रीवेणैवमुक्तस्तु जाम्बवानृक्षपार्थिवः । वानरान्सान्त्वयामास संनिवर्त्य प्रहावतः ॥
data.es: Sugriva having spoken in that way, the king of Bears, Jambavan restored the confidence of Vanaras.
data.anv: सुग्रीवेण Sugriva, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having said, ऋक्षपार्थिवः king of Bears, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, प्रधानतः chief, वानरान् of Vanaras, निरुध्य restored, सान्त्वयामास confidence.
data.md: Thus directed, Jõmbavān-king of bearsrestraining those that were flying, composed the monkeys.

data.v: ते निवृत्ताः पुनः सर्वे वानरास्त्यक्तसंभ्रमाः । ऋक्षराजवचः श्रुत्वा तं च दृष्ट्वा विभीषणम् ॥
data.es: Having heard Jambavan, all the Vanaras finally shed their fear and returned to see Vibheeshana.
data.anv: सर्वे all, तेवानराः the Vanaras, ऋक्षराजवचः Jambavan's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, तम् their, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, दृष्टवा beholding, त्यक्तसम्भ्रमाः finally shed their fear, पुनः again, विवृत्ताः returned.
data.md: Hearing the bear-king's words, and seeing Vibhisana, the monkeys, renouncing fear, desisted (from their flight).

data.v: विभीषणस्तु रामस्य दृष्ट्वा गात्रं शरैश्चितम् । लक्ष्मणस्य च धर्मात्मा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रियः ॥
data.es: On seeing the body of Rama and Lakshmana fully covered by arrows, Vibheeshana also became piteous and sad.
data.anv: धर्मात्मा righteous, विभीषणस्तु Vibheeshana also, शरैः arrows, चितम् mind, रामस्य Rama's, गात्रम् limbs, लक्ष्मणस्यच and Lakshmana's, दृष्टवा observing, तदा then, व्यथितः grievous, बभूव remained.
data.md: Then the righteous Vibhīșaņa, viewing Rama's as well as Laksmana's body pierced with arrows, was exceedingly aggrieved.

data.v: जलक्लिन्नेन हस्तेन तयोर्नेत्रे प्रमृज्य च । शोकसंपीडितमना रुरोद विललाप च ॥
data.es: Vibheeshana, wetting his hands with water cleaned the eyes of Rama and Lakshmana. Tormented with pain he cried aloud.
data.anv: जलक्लिन्नेन with water, हस्तेन in hand, तयोः their, नेत्रे eyes, प्रमृज्यच cleaned, शोकसम्पीडितमनाः tormented with pain, रुरोद aloud, विललापच cried.
data.md: Washing their eyes with water, he, with his mind overpowered with grief, began to weep and broke out into lamentation.

data.v: इमौ तौ सत्त्वसंपन्नौ विक्रान्तौ प्रियसंयुगौ । इमामवस्थां गमितौ राकसैः कूटयोधिभिः ॥
data.es: "Both the princess, who are endowed with good nature, and power are fond of combat. The Rakshasas have reduced them to this state by their deceitful ways."
data.anv: सत्त्वसम्पन्नौ endowed with good nature, विक्रान्तौ powerful, प्रियसम्युगौ fond of combat, तौ both, इमौ thus, कूटयोधिभिः deceitful, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, इमाम् like this, अवस्थाम् predicament, गमितौ reduced to.
data.md: The Rāksasas, fighting in wily ways, have brought to this pass these ones endowed with prowess and possessed of every perfection and gifted with might (of arm).

data.v: भ्रातुः पुत्रेण मे तेन दुष्पुत्रेण दुरात्मना । राक्षस्या जिह्मया बुद्ध्या छलितावृजुविक्रमौ ॥
data.es: "The princess who were guileless in their prowess were cheated by my evil minded and stupid son of my brother by his crooked thinking and cheating."
data.anv: ऋजुविक्रमौ guileless in prowess, दुष्पुत्रेण stupid son, दुरात्मना evil minded, एतेन by him, भ्रातृपुत्रेण brother's son, राक्षस्या Rakshasa's, जिह्मया crooked, बुध्या mind, चालिता cheated.
data.md: And with his guileful mind, that brother's son of mine, wicked-souled and an evil son (to me), has deceived these ones of straight prowess.

data.v: शरैरिमावलं विद्धौ रुधिरेण समुक्षितौ । वसुधायामिम सुप्तौ दृश्येते शल्यकाविव ॥
data.es: "Pierced with arrows, fully covered with blood, the bodies of the two princes appear like porcupines sleeping on the ground."
data.anv: शरैः arrows, अलम् body, विद्धौ fully, रुधिरेण with blood, समुक्षितौ pierced with, वसुधायाम् on the ground, सुप्तौ sleeping, इमौ these two (Rama and Lakshmana), शल्यकाविव like a porcupine, दृश्येते appears.
data.md: Pierced with innumerable shafts, and covered with blood, these are lying on the ground like Salyakas.

data.v: ययोर्वीर्यमुपाश्रित्य प्रतिष्ठा काङ्क्षिता मया । तावुभौ देहनाशाय प्रसुप्तौ पुरुषर्षभौ ॥
data.es: "These two bulls among men of great valour and fame whose refuge was sought by me are lying asleep wounded all over and limbs broken."
data.anv: मया by me, ययोः whose, वीर्यम् valour, आश्रित्य sought refuge, प्रतिष्ठा of great fame, काङ्क्षिता limbs broken, ता these, उभौ both, पुरुषर्षभौ bull among men, देहनाशाय wounded all over the body, प्रसुप्तौ lying asleep.
data.md: Those depending on whose prowess, I had sought eminence, those foremost of men, sleep here soundly for renouncing their bodies.

data.v: जीवन्नद्य विपन्नोऽस्मि नष्टराज्यमनोरथः । प्राप्तप्रतिज्ञश्च रिपुः सकामो रावणः कृतः ॥
data.es: "Having lost my life ambition for the kingdom, frustrated I am. My enemy Ravana, having succeeded in his vow, did this deed."
data.anv: नष्टराज्यमनोरथः having lost kingdom, जीवन्नद्यअद्य life ambition, विपन्नः frustrated, अस्मि I am, रिपुः enemy, रावणः Ravana, प्राप्तप्रतिज्ञः having succeeded in his vow, सकामश्च this deed, कृतः did.
data.md: Living, today I am in distress: and my desire of dominion is annihilated; and my foe, Rāvana, has his promise fulfilled and his aim crowned with success.

data.v: एवं विलपमानं तं परिष्वज्य विभीषणम् । सुग्रीवः सत्त्वसंपन्नो हरिराजोऽब्रवीदिदम् ॥
data.es: To Vibheeshana who was lamenting in that way, Sugriva, who was endowed with good qualities embraced him and spoke.
data.anv: एवम् in that way, विलपमानम् lamenting in despair, तंविभीषणम् that Vibheeshana, परिष्वज्य embracing, सत्त्वसम्पन्नः endowed with good qualities, हरिराजः king of monkeys, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: As Vibhīşana was thus lamenting, the lord of monkeys-Sugriva-endowed with strength, embracing him spoke to him.

data.v: राज्यं प्राप्स्यसि धर्मज्ञ लङ्कायां नात्र संशयः । रावणः सह पुत्रेण स राज्यं नेह लप्स्यते ॥
data.es: "O righteous one! there is no doubt that you will attain the kingdom of Lanka. Ravana and his sons will not attain what they desire."
data.anv: धर्मज्ञ righteous, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, राज्यम् kingdom, प्राप्स्यसि having got, अत्र and now, संशयः doubt, न no, रावणः Ravana, सहपुत्रेण with his sons, स्वकामम् of their desire, इह now, नलप्स्यते not attain.
data.md: O you cognisant of righteousness, you will here in Lankā obtain empire: no doubt of this; and Răvaņa along with his sons will be disappointed in their expectations.

data.v: शरसंपीडितावेतावुभौ राघवलक्ष्मणौ । त्यक्त्वा मोहं वधिष्येते सगणं रावणं रणे ॥
data.es: "Both these heroes Raghava and Lakshmana wounded and pained having shaken off from their unconscious state will kill Ravana and his army in war."
data.anv: एतौ these, उभौ both, राघवलक्ष्मणौ Raghava and Lakshmana, रुजा wounded, पीडितौ pained, न not, मोहम् unconscious state त्यक्त्वा shaken off, रणे in war, सगणम् his own army, रावणम् Ravana, वधिष्येते killed.
data.md: Both these-Rāma and Lakşmaņa-are under the aegis of Garuda; and, casting off their stupor: they will in battle slay Rävaņa along with his adherents.

data.v: तमेवं सान्त्वयित्वा तु समाश्वास्य च राक्षसं । सुषेणं श्वशुरं पार्श्वे सुग्रीवस्तमुवाच ह ॥
data.es: Thus, consoling and pacifying, the Rakshasa, Vibheeshana in that manner, Sugriva turned to his uncle Sushena and spoke.
data.anv: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तंराक्षसम् that Rakshasa, एवम् in that manner, सान्त्वयित्वा consoling, समाश्वास्य pacifying, पार्श्वे at, श्वशुरम् uncle, तंसुषेणम् Sushena, उवाच spoke.
data.md: Having thus soothed and comforted the Raksasa, Sugriva addressed his father-in-law, who was at his side, saying.

data.v: सह शूरैर्हरिगणैर्लब्धसंज्ञावरिंदमौ । गच्छ त्वं भ्रातरौ गृह्य किष्किन्धां रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥
data.es: "On regaining consciousness, take the brothers Rama and Lakshmana, the tamers of enemies to Kishkinda accompanied by the heroic monkey army."
data.anv: शूरैः heroes हरिगणैः monkey army, त्वम् them, लब्दसंज्ञौ on regaining consciousness, अरिन्दमौ tamers of their enemies, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, गृह्य taking, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkinda, गच्छ proceed.
data.md: Do you along with numbers of heroic monkeys, taking those repressors of foes, the brothers-Rama and Laksmana-when they shall have regained their consciousness, repair to Kiskindha.

data.v: अहं तु रावणं हत्वा सपुत्रं सहबान्धवम् । मैथिलीमानयिष्यामि शक्रो नष्टामिव श्रियम् ॥
data.es: "On killing Ravana and his sons along with his kin, I will on my part also bring Mythili just as Indra recovered his prosperity."
data.anv: अहंतु I also, सपुत्रम् his sons, सहबान्दवम् with the kin, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा having killed, शक्रः Indra, नष्टाम् loss, श्रियमिव prosperity, मैथिलीम् Mythili also, आनयिष्यामि will bring.
data.md: And I, slaying Råvaņa along with his sons and friends, shall bring back Mithila's daughter, even as Sakra recovered the lost Sri.

data.v: श्रुत्वैतद्वानरेन्द्रस्य सुषेणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् । देवासुरं महायुद्धमनुभूतं सुदारुणम् ॥
data.es: Hearing the words of Vanara Lord, Sushena spoke about the fierce and great war that he had experienced between Devas and asuras.
data.anv: वानरेन्द्रस्य Vanara Lord, एतत् वाक्यम् these words, श्रुत्वा hearing, सुषेणः Sushena, अब्रवीत् spoke, दैवासुरम् Devatas and Asuras, सुदारुणम् fierce, महत् great, युद्धम् in war, अनुभूतम् experienced.
data.md: Hearing the words of the monkey-king, Suşeņa said, I had witnessed the war of yore between the gods and the Asuras.

data.v: तदा स्म दानवा देवाञ्शरसंस्पर्शकोविदाः । निजघ्नुः शस्त्रविदुषश्छादयन्तो मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
data.es: "Then the Rakshasas adept in using arms went about agitating concealing themselves, attacking Devatas who were learned in using arms."
data.anv: तदा then, शरसम्स्पर्शकोविदाः adept in using arms, दानवाः Rakshasa, शस्त्रविदुषः learned in using arms, देवान् Devatas, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, छादयन्तः concealing by tricks, निजघ्नुः went about agitated.
data.md: Then the Dänavas, enveloping themselves, momentarily destroyed the deities, albeit versed in arms and accomplished in weapons.

data.v: तानार्तान्नष्टसंज्ञांश्च परासूंश्च बृहस्पतिः । विध्याभिर्मन्त्रयुक्ताभिरोषधीभिश्चिकित्सति ॥
data.es: "Brhaspati, the priest restored the wounded and lifeless, unconscious by means of reciting mantras, prayers and treatment by herbs."
data.anv: बृहस्पतिः Brhaspati the sage, आर्तान् restored the affected, नष्टसंज्ञान् wounded and life less, गतासूंश्च lost consciousness, तान् them, मन्त्रयुक्ताभिः by means of mantras, विद्याभिः recitation of prayers, रोषधीभिः herbs, चिकित्सति treatment.
data.md: They, their senses lost, and their lives departed, Bịhaspati treated by means of his knowledge of mantras, as well with medicines.

data.v: तान्यौषधान्यानयितुं क्षीरोदं यान्तु सागरम् । जवेन वानराः शीघ्रं संपाति पनसादयः ॥
data.es: "Let Sampati and Panasa go quickly to the milky ocean in a swift phase to get those medicines."
data.anv: औषधानि herbal medicines, आनयितुम् secured, सम्पातिपनसादयः Sampati and Panasa, वानराः Vanara, जवेन swift phase, शीघ्रम् quickly, क्षीरोदम् milky ocean, सागरम् ocean, यान्तु to get.
data.md: Let Sampati, Panasa, and other monkeys speedily hie to the Milky Ocean for the purpose of bringing those medicines.

data.v: हरयस्तु विजानन्ति पार्वती ते महौषधी । संजीवकरणीं दिव्यां विशल्यां देवनिर्मिताम् ॥
data.es: "Those monkeys only know the supreme medicine available in the mountains. They have to get Sanjeevakarani and Visalyakarani known to Brahma."
data.anv: हरयः monkeys, पार्वतीः mountains, ताःमहौषधीः that supreme medicine, दिव्याम् wonderful, सञ्जीवकरणीम् Sanjeevakarani, देवनिर्मिताम् for the cause of Devatas विशल्याम् Visalyakarani, विजा s नन्ति known to Brahma.
data.md: The monkeys well know that mighty mountainous medicine-divine and capable of reviving the dead, and made by the deities themselves-visalya.

data.v: चन्द्रश्च नाम द्रोणश्च पर्वतौ सागरोत्तमे । अमृतं यत्र मथितं तत्र ते परमौषधी ॥
data.es: "There, where the milky ocean, the foremost of oceans, was churned, two mountains have risen by the name Chandra and Drona. The supreme herbs of medicine are present there."
data.anv: यत्र there, अमृतम् nectar of immortality, मथितम् was churned, सागरोत्तमे foremost of oceans, क्षीरोदे milky ocean, चन्द्रश्च Chandra's, द्रोणश्च Drona's, ते they, परमौषधी supreme medicine, तत्र present.

data.v: ते तत्र निहिते देवैः पर्वते परमौषधी । अयं वायुसुतो राजन्हनूमांस्तत्र गच्छतु ॥
data.es: "Both the mountains are well known. Deities have kept the herbal medicine there. Let the son of wind god, Hanuman proceed."
data.anv: तौ both, तौपर्वतौ mountains, तत्र there, महोदधौ well known, देवैः Deities, विहितौ kept, राजन् o King, वायुसुतः son of wind God, अयम् let go, हनुमान् Hanuman, तत्र there, गच्छतु proceed.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वायुर्मेघांश्चापि सविद्युतः । पर्यस्यन्सागरे तोयं कम्पयन्निव पर्वतान् ॥
data.es: In the mean while winds blew, clouds also rose up, water in the ocean was scattered about by the wind and lightning appeared in the sky.
data.anv: एतस्मिन् in the meanwhile, अन्तरे middle, सविद्युतः wind also, मेघांश्चापि clouds also, सागरे ocean, तोयम् water, पर्यस्यन् scattered about, वायुः by the wind, मेदिनीम् in the sky, कम्पयननिव started shaking.
data.md: In the meanwhile, the wing arose, and masses of clouds appeared along with lightning, and the wind blew, agitating the waters of the deep, and shaking the mountains.

data.v: महता पक्षवातेन सर्वे द्वीपमहाद्रुमाः । निपेतुर्भग्नविटपाः समूला लवणाम्भसि ॥
data.es: All the huge trees of the island were broken by the flutter of the wings (of Garuda) and fell into the salt water of the ocean.
data.anv: सर्ववदीपमहाद्रुमाः all the trees of the island, महता huge, पक्षवातेन by the flutter of the wings wind, भग्नविटपाः broken, लवणाम्भसि salt water of the ocean, सलिले water, निपेतुः entered.
data.md: And mighty trees of the ocean-islands, broken down by-the terrible wing-raised wind, began to topple headlong into the salt waters.

data.v: अभवन्पन्नगास्त्रस्ता भोगिनस्तत्रवासिनः । शीघ्रं सर्वाणि यादांसि जग्मुश्च लवणार्णवम् ॥
data.es: All the serpents and sea monsters inhabiting there terrified at Garuda went quickly into the salty waters of the ocean.
data.anv: पन्नगाः serpents, त्रस्ताः frightened, अभवन् in fear, तत्र there, वासिनः inhabiting, भोगिनः sea monsters, सर्वाणि all of them, यादांसि crawled, शीघ्रम् quickly, लवणार्णवम् into the salty ocean, जग्मुः went.
data.md: The serpents dwelling there were seized with affright; and speedily all the aquatic animals dived into the Salt sea,

data.v: ततो मुहूर्तद्गरुडं वैनतेयं महाबलम् । वानरा ददृशुः सर्वे ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम् ॥
data.es: Then all the Vanaras perceived Garuda endowed with mighty prowess, the son of Vinatha blazing like fire.
data.anv: ततः then, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanaras, मुहूर्तात् instantly, ज्वलन्तम् blazing like, पावकम् इव like fire, वैनतेयम् son of Vinatha, महाबलम् of mighty prowess, गरुडम् Garuda, ददृशुः perceived.
data.md: Then in a moment the monkeys saw Vinatā's son possessed of terrific strength, like to a flaming fire.

data.v: तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य नागास्ते विप्रदुद्रुवुः । यैस्तौ सत्पुरुषौ बद्धौ शरभूतैर्महाबलौ ॥
data.es: Seeing the noble Rama and Lakshmana bound by the serpents in the form of arrows (released by Indrajith), the serpents fled.
data.anv: शरभूतैः in the form of arrows, महाबलौ mighty, यैः those, तौ both, सत्परुषौ noble, बद्धौ bound, ते those, नागाः serpents, आगतम् seeing, तम् they, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, सम्प्रदुद्रुवुः fled.
data.md: Seeing him come, the serpents began to dart away, those exceedingly powerful ones that, turning into shafts, had bound those persons.* *Rama and Laksmana.

data.v: ततः सुपर्णः काकुत्स्थौ दृष्ट्वा प्रत्यभिनन्द्य च । विममर्श च पाणिभ्यां मुखे चन्द्रसमप्रभे ॥
data.es: Thereafter Garuda paying his respects to the noble Rama and Lakshmana, touching their feet, wiped their face which shone like the moon.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, सुपर्णः Garuda, काकुत्स्थौ at Kakuthsas, Rama and Lakshmana, स्पृष्टवा touching, प्रत्यभिनन्द्यच paying respect, पाणिभ्याम् both feet, चन्द्रसमप्रख्ये like moon, मुखे face, विममर्शच wiped.
data.md: Then, touching the Kākutsthas and saluting them, Suparna rubbed with his hands their countenances furnished with the splendour of the Moon.

data.v: वैनतेयेन संस्पृष्टास्तयोः संरुरुहुर्व्रणाः । सुवर्णे च तनू स्निग्धे तयोराशु बभूवतुः ॥
data.es: Caressed by Garuda, both their bodies were cleared of wounds instantly shone like gold and turned bright.
data.anv: वैनतेयेन by Garuda, सम्सृष्टाः caressed, तयोः both of their, व्रणाः wounds, सम्रुरुहुः cleared, आशु instantly, तयोः both, तनू bodies, सुवर्णेच like gold, स्निग्धे bright, बभूवतुः turned.
data.md: Their wounds, on being touched by Vinata's son, were (immediately) healed: and the bodies of both speedily became cool and shone with an excellent complexion.

data.v: तेजो वीर्यं बलं चौज उत्साहश्च महागुणाः । प्रदर्शनं च बुद्धिश्च स्मृतिश्च द्विगुणं तयोः ॥
data.es: Their brilliance, prowess, daring courage, intelligence, memory, and great qualities got manifested many folds.
data.anv: तयोः their, तेजः brilliance, वीर्यम् prowess, उत्साहश्च daring courage, महागुणाः great qualities, प्रदर्शनम् manifested, बुद्धिश्च intelligence, स्मृतिश्च memory, द्विगुणम् redoubled.
data.md: They attained immense energy and prowess; and a double share of strength, and of rational and perceptive powers, and of memory.

data.v: तावुत्थाप्य महावीर्यौ गरुडो वासवोपमौ । उभौ तौ सस्वजे हृष्टौ रामश्चैनमुवाच ह ॥
data.es: Raising up both the princes who were extraordinarily brilliant and equalled Indra, Garuda embraced Rama joyfully and thus spoke.
data.anv: महातेजाः extraordinary brilliance, गरुडः Garuda, वासनोपमौ equal to Indra, तौ them, उत्थाप्य raising up, उभौ both, सस्वजे embraced, रामश्च Rama, हृष्टः joyful, एवम् in that way, उवाचह spoke.
data.md: Then raising them up, the exceedingly energetic Garuda, resembling Vāşava himself, embraced both joyfully. And then Rāma addressed (Garuda), saying.

data.v: भवत्प्रसादाद्व्यसनं रावणिप्रभवं महत् । आवामिह व्यतिक्रान्तौ शीघ्रं च बलिनौ कृतौ ॥
data.es: "By your kindness, we have overcome this calamity caused by Ravana's son and regained our strength as before."
data.anv: भवत्प्रसादाद् by your kindness, आवाम् we, रावणिप्रभवम् Ravana's son's influence, महत् great, व्यसनम् calamity, इह here, व्यतिक्रान्तौ overcome, पूर्ववत् regained like before, बलिनौ strength, कृतौ did.
data.md: By your grace we have through means survived the mighty calamity that had sprung from Răvana's son; and we have also speedily been rendered strong.

data.v: यथा तातं दशरथं यथाजं च पितामहम् । तथा भवन्तमासाद्य हृषयं मे प्रसीदति ॥
data.es: "For me to meet you is like meeting my father Dasaratha and grandfather, Aja. My heart rejoices."
data.anv: भवन्तम् for me, आसाद्य to meet you, तातम् father, दशरथम् Dasaratha, यथा same way, पितामहम् grandfather, अजंच Aja also, यथा in the same way, तथा like that, मे my, हृदयम् in my heart, प्रसीदति rejoices.
data.md: My heart is delighted on having these, like to my father, Dasaratha, or my grand sire, Aja.

data.v: को भवान्रूपसंपन्नो दिव्यस्रगनुलेपनः । वसानो विरजे वस्त्रे दिव्याभरणभूषितः ॥
data.es: "Who are you, richly endowed with charming appearance, smeared with unguents adored in dust free garments, wearing beautiful ornaments?"
data.anv: रूपसम्पन्नः of charming appearance, दिव्यस्रगनुलेपः smeared with wonderful unguents, विरजे free from dust, वस्त्र adored in,, वसानः garments, दिव्याभरणभूषितः wearing beautiful ornaments, भवान् yourself, कः who are you.
data.md: Who are your, furnished with beauty, and bearing wreaths and unguents (on your person); clad in stainless attire: and adorned in noble ornaments ?
