data.v: तमुवाच महातेजा वैनतेयो महाबलः । पतत्रिराजः प्रीतात्मा हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षणः ॥
data.es: To Rama whose eyes were filled with joyful tears, Vinatha, the king of birds, full of brightness and strength said.
data.anv: महातेजाः endowed with brightness, महाबलः strong, पतत्त्रिराजः king of birds, वैनतेयः Vinatha, प्रीतात्मा delighted self, हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षणः eyes with tears of joy, तम् to him, उवाच said.
data.md: To him spoke the exceedingly energetic son of Vinată endowed with great strength, the lord of birds, with a pleased heart, and his eyes wild with glee.

data.v: अहं सखा ते काकुत्स्थ प्रियः प्राणो बहिश्चरः । गरुत्मानिह संप्राप्तो युवयोः साह्यकारणात् ॥
data.es: "O Kakuthsa! I am Garuthman, your dear friend and your outer breath. I reached here to help you."
data.anv: काकुत्स्थ Kakuthsa, अहम् I am, ते to you, प्रियः dear, सखा friend, बहिश्चरः outer, प्राणः breath, गरुत्मान् Garuthman, युवयोः you both, साह्यकारणात् in order to help, इह here, सम्प्राप्त reached.
data.md: O Kakutstha, I am your friend-your life ranging externally-Garutmän. I am come hither for aiding you.

data.v: असुरा वा महावीर्या दानवा वा महाबलाः । सुराश्चापि सगन्धर्वाः पुरस्कृत्य शतक्रतुम् ॥
data.es: "For the demons endowed with great strength and of mighty valour or for Gandharvas, or Vanaras or for even Devatas, or Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices, it is not possible to get relieved from bondage of the arrows of Indrajith of cruel deeds carried out by tricks."
data.anv: क्रूरकर्मणा of cruel deeds, इन्द्रजिता of Indrajith, मायाबलात् by his tricks, निर्मितम् for that reason, सुदारुणम् very fierce, इमम् such, शरबन्धम् bondage with arrows, मोक्षयितुम् to get freed from, महावीर्याः of mighty valour, असुराःवा demon, महाबलाः great strength, वानराःवा Vanara also, शतक्रतुम् hundred sacrifices, पुरस्कृत्य had done, सगन्धर्वाः even Gandharvas, सुरश्चापि even Devatas, नशक्ताः not possible.

data.v: नेमं मोक्षयितुं शक्ताः शरबन्धं सुदारुणम् । माया बलादिन्द्रजिता निर्मितं क्रूरकर्मणा ॥
data.es: "For the demons endowed with great strength and of mighty valour or for Gandharvas, or Vanaras or for even Devatas, or Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices, it is not possible to get relieved from bondage of the arrows of Indrajith of cruel deeds carried out by tricks."
data.anv: क्रूरकर्मणा of cruel deeds, इन्द्रजिता of Indrajith, मायाबलात् by his tricks, निर्मितम् for that reason, सुदारुणम् very fierce, इमम् such, शरबन्धम् bondage with arrows, मोक्षयितुम् to get freed from, महावीर्याः of mighty valour, असुराःवा demon, महाबलाः great strength, वानराःवा Vanara also, शतक्रतुम् hundred sacrifices, पुरस्कृत्य had done, सगन्धर्वाः even Gandharvas, सुरश्चापि even Devatas, नशक्ताः not possible.

data.v: एते नागाः काद्रवेयास्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्राविषोल्बणाः । रक्षोमाया प्रभावेन शरा भूत्वा त्वदाश्रिताः ॥
data.es: "These arrows are serpents born of Kadra Devata. They have sharp fangs and are highly poisonous. By the tricks of Rakshasa, it has turned into arrows and reached you."
data.anv: तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्राः with sharp fangs विषोल्बणाः highly poisonous, काद्रवेयाः born to Kadra Devata, एतेनागाः these serpents, रक्षोमायाप्रभावेण by the tricks applied by Rakshasas, शराः arrows, भूत्वा turned into, त्वदाश्रिताः reached you.

data.v: सभाग्यश्चासि धर्मज्ञ राम सत्यपराक्रम । लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा समरे रिपुघातिना ॥
data.es: "You are lucky and also Lakshmana your brother, destroyer of foes in war. Rama your strength is truth, and you are righteous."
data.anv: धर्मज्ञ righteous, सत्यपराक्रम whose strength is truth, राम Rama, समरे in war, शत्रुघातिना destroyer of foes, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेनसह accompanied by Lakshmana, सभाग्यः lucky, असि you are.
data.md: O Ráma having truth for prowess, you are fortunate-along with that destroyer of foe in fight, Laksmana.

data.v: इमं श्रुत्वा तु वृत्तान्तं त्वरमाणोऽहमागतः । सहसा युवयोः स्नेहात्सखित्वमनुपालयन् ॥
data.es: "Having heard the information about both of you bound by serpents, out of my friendship and affection and in obedience to you I hastened and reached here."
data.anv: अहम् I am, इमम् this, वृत्तान्तम् information, श्रुत्वा having heard, युवयोः both of you, स्नेहात् out of friendship, सखित्वम् affection, अनुपालयन् in obedience to you, सहसा at once, त्वरमाणः hastened, आगतः to reach.
data.md: Hearing this, I, summoning energy: have come hither swiftly, and I, doing by you as a friend, have from affection at once set you free from these dreadful arrowy bonds.

data.v: मोक्षितौ च महाघोरादस्मात्सायकबन्धनात् । अप्रमादश्च कर्तव्यो युवाभ्यां नित्यमेव हि ॥
data.es: "Considering it as my duty to relieve you both from the frightful bondage of snakes I reached. Do not be inattentive and guileless."
data.anv: महाघोरात् frightful, अस्मात् to you, सायकबन्धनात् from the bondage of snakes, मोक्षितौच and to relieve, युवाभ्याम् both of you, नित्यमेवच guilelessness, अप्रमादः inattentive, कर्तव्यः your duty.

data.v: प्रकृत्या राक्षसाः सर्वे संग्रामे कूटयोधिनः । शूराणां शुद्धभावानां भवतामार्जवं बलम् ॥
data.es: "Rakshasas by nature use tricks in war. For noble people with good nature guilelessness is strength."
data.anv: प्रकृत्या by nature, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, सङ्ग्रामे in war, कूटयोधिनः use tricks in war, शूराणाम् noble people, शुद्धभावानाम् of good nature, भवताम् for you, आर्जवम् guilelessness, बलम् strength.
data.md: you should always be on your guard. By nature the Rākşasas have cunning shifts in fight and you, who are heroic and of a pure spirit, can but rely on your simplicity alone for strength.

data.v: तन्न विश्वसितव्यं वो राक्षसानां रणाजिरे । एतेनैवोपमानेन नित्यजिह्मा हि राक्षसाः ॥
data.es: "Being so you should not trust Rakshasas. By this experience you know that Rakshasas are crooked."
data.anv: तत् being so, रणाजिरे in war, वः them, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, नविश्वसनीयम् not to be trusted, एतेन because, उपमानेनैव by this experience, राक्षसाः of Rakshasa, नित्यम् ever, जिह्माःहि crooked.
data.md: Therefore you must not trust the Raksasas in the field of battle. By this one instance you must know that Rakşasas are ever deceitful in fight.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा ततो रामं सुपर्णः सुमहाबलः । परिष्वज्य सुहृत्स्निग्धमाप्रष्टुमुपचक्रमे ॥
data.es: Having said so, Suparna endowed with mighty strength embraced Rama most affectionately and took leave of him.
data.anv: महाबलः mighty strong, सःसुपर्णः that Suparna, तदा then, रामम् to Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, सुहृत्स्निग्धम् most affectionately, परिष्वज्यच embracing, अप्रष्टुम् took leave, उपचक्रमे and proceeded.
data.md: Having said this the wondrous mighty Suparna, embracing Rama tenderly again) said.

data.v: सखे राघव धर्मज्ञ रिपूणामपि वत्सल । अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छामि गमिष्यामि यथागतम् ॥
data.es: "My dear friend! I wish to take leave of you. Truly you are knower of what is right, and you are dear even to an enemy."
data.anv: धर्मज्ञ right, रिपूणामपि even to an enemy, वत्सल dear, सखे friend, राम Rama, अभ्यनुज्ञातुम् take leave of you, इच्छामि wish, यथामतम् truly, गमिष्यामि let me go.
data.md: My friend Raghava, O you who even cherish affection for your foes, permit me, I shall go at pleasure. And O Raghva, entertain no curiosity as to our friendship. when, O hero, you shall have achieved success in battle, you shall know all about this friendship of ours.

data.v: बालवृद्धावशेषां तु लङ्कां कृत्वा शरोर्मिभिः । रावणं च रिपुं हत्वा सीतां समुपलप्स्यसे ॥
data.es: "Lanka will be left with youngsters and the aged with your arrows. The enemy Ravana killed, you will recover Sita."
data.anv: लङ्काम् at Lanka, शरोर्मिभिः with arrows, बालवृद्धानशेषाम् left with youngsters and aged, कृत्वा having done so, रिपुम् enemy, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा killed, त्वम् you, सीताम् Sita, समुलप्स्यते recover again.
data.md: And with the surges of your shafts, making Larkā contain only children and aged, and slaying your foe, Ravana, you shall recover Sita.

data.v: इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं सुपर्णः शीघ्रविक्रमः । रामं च विरुजं कृत्वा मध्ये तेषां वनौकसाम् ॥
data.es: Having spoken to Rama in that manner, Suparna endowed with wind speed in flight embraced Rama and went around him as a mark of reverence and soared into the sky.
data.anv: सुपर्णः Suparna, शीघ्रविक्रमः swift in flying, वीर्यवान् valiant, सुपर्णः Suparna, तेषाम् from there, वनौकसाम् to the forest, मध्ये middle, इत्येवम् in that way, वचनम् words, उक्त्वा having spoken, रामम् to Rama, विरुजम् embracing him, कृत्वा done, ततः thereafter, प्रदक्षिणंकृत्वा going round in reverence, परिष्वज्यच soared, पवनोयथा like wind, आकाशम् into the sky, आविश्य flew, जगाम and went.
data.md: Having spoken thus, Suparna, endowed with vigour, having rendered Rāma hale in the midst of the monkeys, having gone round them and embrace them also, that one possessed of prowess, set out, covering up the sky, like to the wind.

data.v: प्रदक्षिणं ततः कृत्वा परिष्वज्य च वीर्यवान् । जगामाकाशमाविश्य सुपर्णः पवनो यथा ॥
data.es: Having spoken to Rama in that manner, Suparna endowed with wind speed in flight embraced Rama and went around him as a mark of reverence and soared into the sky.
data.anv: सुपर्णः Suparna, शीघ्रविक्रमः swift in flying, वीर्यवान् valiant, सुपर्णः Suparna, तेषाम् from there, वनौकसाम् to the forest, मध्ये middle, इत्येवम् in that way, वचनम् words, उक्त्वा having spoken, रामम् to Rama, विरुजम् embracing him, कृत्वा done, ततः thereafter, प्रदक्षिणंकृत्वा going round in reverence, परिष्वज्यच soared, पवनोयथा like wind, आकाशम् into the sky, आविश्य flew, जगाम and went.
data.md: Having spoken thus, Suparna, endowed with vigour, having rendered Rāma hale in the midst of the monkeys, having gone round them and embrace them also, that one possessed of prowess, set out, covering up the sky, like to the wind.

data.v: विरुजौ राघवौ दृष्ट्वा ततो वानरयूथपाः । सिंहनादांस्तदा नेदुर्लाङ्गूलं दुधुवुश्च ते ॥
data.es: Thereafter the Vanara troops, seeing the Raghavas freed from anguish, roared like a lion, and lashed their tails.
data.anv: ततः then, वानरयूथपाः Vanara troops, राघवौ Raghavas, विरुजौ freed from anguish, दृष्टवा seeing, तदा then, सिंहनादान् roared like lions, नेदुः sound, तदा then, लाङ्गूलान् tails, दुधुवुश्च lashed.
data.md: Seeing Raghu's sons rendered hale, the monkey-leaders set up leonine roars, and began to flourish their tails.

data.v: ततो भेरीः समाजघ्नुर्मृदङ्गांश्च व्यनादयन् । दध्मुः शङ्खान्संप्रहृष्टाः क्ष्वेलन्त्यपि यथापुरम् ॥
data.es: Then the Vanaras played drums and even mridangams, blew conches and started jumping and leaping as before.
data.anv: ततः and then, भेरीः drums, समाजघ्नुः played, मृदङ्गांश्चापि even mridangams, अवादयन् played, शङ्खान् conches, दध्मुः blew, यथापुरम् as before, क्षेवलन्त्यपि leap and jump.
data.md: Then beat the kettle-drums and the drums struck up. And conchs were cheerfully blown; and shouts were sent.

data.v: आस्फोट्यास्फोट्य विक्रान्ता वानरा नगयोधिनः । द्रुमानुत्पाट्य विविधांस्तस्थुः शतसहस्रशः ॥
data.es: The Vanaras who can fight with trees, uprooted several trees expressing their capacity distinctly and breaking them, and cracking their fingers. Making loud noise in hundreds and thousands stood there.
data.anv: नगयोधिनः who fight uprooting trees, विक्रान्ताः proud of their ability, आस्फोट्याः breaking forth, वानराः Vanaras, स्पोट्य cracking fingers and making loud noise, शतसहस्रशः hundreds and thousands, विविधान् several, द्रुमान् trees, उत्पाट्य uprooted, तस्थुः stood.

data.v: विसृजन्तो महानादांस्त्रासयन्तो निशाचरान् । लङ्काद्वाराण्युपाजग्मुर्योद्धुकामाः प्लवंगमाः ॥
data.es: Making a lot of noise, the Vanaras reached the gates of Lanka frightening night rangers and desiring to wage war.
data.anv: प्लवङ्गमाः Vanaras, महानादान् great noise, विसृजन्तः emitting, निशाचरान् night rangers, त्रासयन्तः frightening, युद्धकामाः desiring to wage war, लङ्काद्वाराणि gates of Lanka, उपाजग्मुः reached.
data.md: And others struck at their arms with their hands. The monkeys, accustomed to battle with trees, uprooting them, stood by hundreds and thousands. And emitting tremendous roars and thereby frightening the night-rangers, the monkeys eager for encounter, approached the gate of Lanka.

data.v: ततस्तु भीमस्तुमुलो निनादो; बभूव शाखामृगयूथपानाम् । क्षये निदाघस्य यथा घनानां; नादः सुभीमो नदतां निशीथे ॥
data.es: Thundering sounds resembling heavy clouds making terrific sounds arose, as if universal destruction was taking place at midnight.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the fiftieth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: निदाघस्य thundering, क्षये universal destruction, निशीधे midnight, नदताम् sound, घनानाम् heavy clouds, सुभीमः terrific, नादःयथा like sound, तेषाम् from there, शाखामृगयूथपानाम् troops of Vanaras who fight with trees, सुभीमः frightening, तुमुलः loud, नादः sound, बभूव arose.
data.md: That mighty and dreadful din raised by the monkeys, resembled the terrible rumbling of the clouds at midnight about the end of Summer.

data.v: तेषां सुतुमुलं शब्दं वानराणां तरस्विनाम् । नर्दतां राक्षसैः सार्धं तदा शुश्राव रावणः ॥
data.es: Then Ravana and all the Rakshasas heard the increasing and highly tumultuous sound made by the courageous Vanaras.
data.anv: तदा then, तरस्विनाम् courageous, नर्दताम् increasing, तेषांवानराणाम् by those Vanaras, सुतुमुलम् tumultuous noise, शब्दम् sound, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसैःसार्धम् all Rakshasas, शुश्राव heard.
data.md: Then Rāvana heard the tumult raised by the highly energetic monkeys roaring in company with the Rākşasas.

data.v: स्निग्धगम्भीरनिर्घोषं श्रुत्वा स निनदं भृशम् । सचिवानां ततस्तेषां मध्ये वचनमब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Thereafter, hearing the loud and deep sounds of roaring and seeing his (Ravana's) ministers in the midst, he spoke as follows.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, सः he, स्निग्धगम्भीरनिर्घोषम् deep and loud sound, निनदम् roaring, भृशम् swiftly, श्रुत्वा having heard, तेषाम् to them, सचिवानाम् ministers, मध्ये midst, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: Hearing that low and solemn noise-that prodigious uproar-Rävaņa said in the midst of his counsellors.

data.v: यथासौ संप्रहृष्टानां वानराणां समुत्थितः । बहूनां सुमहान्नादो मेघानामिव गर्जताम् ॥
data.es: "Many Vanaras have collected together and roared making loud noises just as thunder rumbling clouds. By that there is no doubt that they are very happy. For that reason, even the wide ocean is agitated."
data.anv: सम्प्रहृष्टानाम् very happy, बहूनाम् many of them, वानराणाम् Vanaras, समुत्थित collected:, सुमहान् very great, असौ such, नादः sound, गर्जताम् roaring, मेघानामिव like thunder of rumbling clouds, यथा just as, श्रूयते, सुव्यक्तम् , एतेषाम् by that, प्रीतिः happiness, सुमहती huge, अत्र there, संशयः doubt, न no, तथाहि for that reason, विपुलैः wide, नादैः noise, वरुणालयः ocean, चुक्षुभे agitated.
data.md: From mighty roars that are heard of in innumerous delighted monkeys, resembling the roar of couds, it is evident, beyond a doubt, that there is great rejoicing there. And the salt Ocean is vexed with these thundering noises.

data.v: व्यक्तं सुमहती प्रीतिरेतेषां नात्र संशयः । तथा हि विपुलैर्नादैश्चुक्षुभे वरुणालयः ॥
data.es: "Many Vanaras have collected together and roared making loud noises just as thunder rumbling clouds. By that there is no doubt that they are very happy. For that reason, even the wide ocean is agitated."
data.anv: सम्प्रहृष्टानाम् very happy, बहूनाम् many of them, वानराणाम् Vanaras, समुत्थित collected:, सुमहान् very great, असौ such, नादः sound, गर्जताम् roaring, मेघानामिव like thunder of rumbling clouds, यथा just as, श्रूयते, सुव्यक्तम् , एतेषाम् by that, प्रीतिः happiness, सुमहती huge, अत्र there, संशयः doubt, न no, तथाहि for that reason, विपुलैः wide, नादैः noise, वरुणालयः ocean, चुक्षुभे agitated.

data.v: तौ तु बद्धौ शरैस्तीष्क्णैर्भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । अयं च सुमहान्नादः शङ्कां जनयतीव मे ॥
data.es: "The two brothers Rama and Lakshmana are bound by sharp arrows. By the loud noise that I hear I doubt in my mind!"
data.anv: भ्रातरौ brothers, तौरामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरैः arrows, बद्धौ are bound, सुमहान् great, अयंनादः such sound I hear, मे to me, शङ्काम् doubt, जनयतीव in my mind.
data.md: The brother-Rama and Laksmana-have been fast bound with sharp shafts, and here this uproar is exciting my alarm.

data.v: एतत्तु वचनं चोक्त्वा मन्त्रिणो राक्षसेश्वरः । उवाच नैरृतांस्तत्र समीपपरिवर्तिनः ॥
data.es: Having spoken like that to the ministers, the Lord of Rakshasas said to the Rakshasas who stood waiting close by.
data.anv: राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, मन्त्रिणः to ministers, एतत्तु such, वचनम् words, तु you, उक्त्वा having spoken, तत्र there, समीपपरिवर्तिनः waiting near, नैरृतान् to Rakshasas, उवाच said.
data.md: Having spoken thus to his ministers, the lord of the Rākşasas addressed the Naiſtas present there, saying.

data.v: ज्ञायतां तूर्णमेतषां सर्वेषां वनचारिणाम् । शोककाले समुत्पन्ने हर्षकारणमुत्थितम् ॥
data.es: "For what reason are the Vanaras (rangers of woods) rejoicing that way in the time of grief? It may be found out speedily."
data.anv: एतेषाम् for what reason, सर्वेषाम् all of them, वनचारिणाम् rangers of woods, शोककाले in the time for grief, समुत्पन्न arisen, तूर्णम् speedily, हर्षकारणमुत्थितम् reason for rejoicing, ज्ञायताम् be found out.
data.md: Do you speedily acquaint yourselves with the cause of rejoicing that has arisen of these monkeys on this mournful occasion.

data.v: तथोक्तास्तेन संभ्रान्ताः प्राकारमधिरुह्य ते । ददृशुः पालितां सेनां सुग्रीवेण महात्मना ॥
data.es: Ravana having said so, the bewildered Rakshasas scaling the boundary wall beheld the army protected by great Sugriva and the prosperous Raghavas relieved from arrows and happy, he became worried.
data.anv: तथा as, उक्ताः having said, ते his, नसम्भ्रान्ताः bewildered, प्राकारम् the boundary wall, अधिरुह्य scaling, महात्मना great, सुग्रीवेण to Sugriva, पालिताम् protected by, सेनाम् army, सुघोरेण at a distance, शरबन्धेन bound by arrows, मुक्तौ relieved, समुत्थितौ happy, महाभागौ prosperous, तौराघवौ them, the Raghavas, ददृशुः beheld, प्रेक्षराक्षसाः Rakshasas saw, विषेदुः worried.
data.md: Thus accosted, they hurriedly mounting up on the wall, surveyed the forces maintained by the high-souled Sugrīva as well as those exalted ones-Raghu's sons-emancipated from their terrific arrowy fetters and arisen (now).

data.v: तौ च मुक्तौ सुघोरेण शरबन्धेन राघवौ । समुत्थितौ महाभागौ विषेदुः प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसाः ॥
data.es: Ravana having said so, the bewildered Rakshasas scaling the boundary wall beheld the army protected by great Sugriva and the prosperous Raghavas relieved from arrows and happy, he became worried.
data.anv: तथा as, उक्ताः having said, ते his, नसम्भ्रान्ताः bewildered, प्राकारम् the boundary wall, अधिरुह्य scaling, महात्मना great, सुग्रीवेण to Sugriva, पालिताम् protected by, सेनाम् army, सुघोरेण at a distance, शरबन्धेन bound by arrows, मुक्तौ relieved, समुत्थितौ happy, महाभागौ prosperous, तौराघवौ them, the Raghavas, ददृशुः beheld, प्रेक्षराक्षसाः Rakshasas saw, विषेदुः worried.

data.v: संत्रस्तहृदया सर्वे प्राकारादवरुह्य ते । विषण्णवदनाः सर्वे राक्षसेन्द्रमुपस्थिताः ॥
data.es: All the dreadful Rakshasas getting down the boundary wall with pale faces, sad countenance reached the Lord of Rakshasas.
data.anv: घोराः dreadful, सर्वे all, तेवदनाः their countenance, सन्त्रस्तहृदयाः frightened at heart, विषण्णाः pale faces, प्राकारात् boundary, अवरुह्य getting down, राक्षसेन्द्रम् to the Lord of Rakshasas, उपस्थिताः reached.
data.md: Thereat, with their hearts wrought up, grimvisaged Rākşasas descending from the wall appeared before the Rākşasa-lord with pale faces.

data.v: तदप्रियं दीनमुखा रावणस्य निशाचराः । कृत्स्नं निवेदयामासुर्यथावद्वाक्यकोविदाः ॥
data.es: Rakshasas who were well versed in talking, desperately conveyed the unpleasantness as it is to Ravana.
data.anv: वाक्यकोविदाः capable of talking, निशाचराः Rakshasas, दीनमुखाः desperate, अप्रियम् unpleasant, तत् those, कृत्स्नम् dark, यथावत् as it is, रावणस्य to Ravana, न्यवेदयन् presented.
data.md: Then with woe-begone faces, those Raksasas, skilled in speech, faithfully informed Rāvana in full of that unfortunate circumstance.

data.v: यौ ताविन्द्रजिता युद्धे भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । निबद्धौ शरबन्धेन निष्प्रकम्पभुजौ कृतौ ॥
data.es: "The two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, who are like powerful elephants have been set free from the bondage of arrows of Indrajith in the battlefield. Their shoulders are relieved and are like elephants snapped off the rope binding them."
data.anv: युद्धे in the battlefield, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajith, भ्रातरौ brothers, यौ those, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, शरबन्धेन from the bondage of arrows, निबद्धौ have been set free, निष्प्रकम्पभुजौ shoulders relieved, कृतौ done, गजेन्द्रसमविक्रमौ powerful elephants, तौ they, पाशान् rope, छित्वा snapped, गजौइव like elephants, रणाजिरे like elephant heroes, दृश्येते are seen.
data.md: Those brothers-Rāma and Lakşmaņa-who had in battle been bound up in arrowy fetters by Indrajit, and whose arms lay moveless, having been emancipated from the arrowy bonds, are seen in the field of battle; and those ones like to the foremost of elephants in strength, seem like elephants that have snapped their fetters.

data.v: विमुक्तौ शरबन्धेन तौ दृश्येते रणाजिरे । पाशानिव गजौ छित्त्वा गजेन्द्रसमविक्रमौ ॥
data.es: "The two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, who are like powerful elephants have been set free from the bondage of arrows of Indrajith in the battlefield. Their shoulders are relieved and are like elephants snapped off the rope binding them."
data.anv: युद्धे in the battlefield, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajith, भ्रातरौ brothers, यौ those, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, शरबन्धेन from the bondage of arrows, निबद्धौ have been set free, निष्प्रकम्पभुजौ shoulders relieved, कृतौ done, गजेन्द्रसमविक्रमौ powerful elephants, तौ they, पाशान् rope, छित्वा snapped, गजौइव like elephants, रणाजिरे like elephant heroes, दृश्येते are seen.
data.md: Those brothers-Rāma and Lakşmaņa-who had in battle been bound up in arrowy fetters by Indrajit, and whose arms lay moveless, having been emancipated from the arrowy bonds, are seen in the field of battle; and those ones like to the foremost of elephants in strength, seem like elephants that have snapped their fetters.

data.v: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां राक्षसेन्द्रो महाबलः । चिन्ताशोकसमाक्रान्तो विषण्णवदनोऽब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: The Rakshasa king endowed with mighty prowess became pale in face, worried and enraged on hearing the words of Rakshasas.
data.anv: महाबलः of mighty prowess, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, तेषाम् by that, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा hearing, चिन्तारोषसमाक्रान्तः very worried and enraged, विषण्णवदनः pale face, अभवत् remained.
data.md: Hearing those words of theirs, the exceedingly powerful lord of the Raksasas was wrought up with anxiety and anger, and his countenance lost its complexion.

data.v: घोरैर्दत्तवरैर्बद्धौ शरैराशीविषोमपैः । अमोघैः सूर्यसंकाशैः प्रमथ्येन्द्रजिता युधि ॥
data.es: "My enemies who are bound by the formidable and unfailing, sharp, poisonous and bright arrows like the sun of Indrajith blessed with boons, are liberated from the bondage! I doubt if my army is in danger!"
data.anv: घोरैः dreadful, दत्तवरैः blessed with boons, आशीविषोपमैः like sharp poisonous snakes, अमोघैः amazing, सूर्यसङ्काशैः bright like the sun, शरैः arrows, युधि in battle, प्रमध्य violently, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajith, बद्धौ bound by, ममरिपू our enemies, तत् that, अस्त्रबन्धम् bondage by the arrows, आसाद्य formidable, मुक्तौयदि to liberate, इदम् this, सर्वम् everything, बलम् army, संशयस्थम् doubt, अहम् I am, अनुपश्यामि perceive.
data.md: Indrajit, having routed them in conflict, had bound them by means of irresistible and terrible arrows, resembling venomous serpents, and like to the Sun himself, which had been conferred on (Indrajit) as boons. But if my enemy having actually been bound by the weapons, can have been liberated, all this strength of mine I see placed in peril.

data.v: तमस्त्रबन्धमासाद्य यदि मुक्तौ रिपू मम । संशयस्थमिदं सर्वमनुपश्याम्यहं बलम् ॥
data.es: "My enemies who are bound by the formidable and unfailing, sharp, poisonous and bright arrows like the sun of Indrajith blessed with boons, are liberated from the bondage! I doubt if my army is in danger!"
data.anv: घोरैः dreadful, दत्तवरैः blessed with boons, आशीविषोपमैः like sharp poisonous snakes, अमोघैः amazing, सूर्यसङ्काशैः bright like the sun, शरैः arrows, युधि in battle, प्रमध्य violently, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajith, बद्धौ bound by, ममरिपू our enemies, तत् that, अस्त्रबन्धम् bondage by the arrows, आसाद्य formidable, मुक्तौयदि to liberate, इदम् this, सर्वम् everything, बलम् army, संशयस्थम् doubt, अहम् I am, अनुपश्यामि perceive.
data.md: Indrajit, having routed them in conflict, had bound them by means of irresistible and terrible arrows, resembling venomous serpents, and like to the Sun himself, which had been conferred on (Indrajit) as boons. But if my enemy having actually been bound by the weapons, can have been liberated, all this strength of mine I see placed in peril.

data.v: निष्फलाः खलु संवृत्ताः शरा वासुकितेजसः । आदत्तं यैस्तु संग्रामे रिपूणां मम जीवितम् ॥
data.es: "My arrows which are equal in brilliance to Vasuki by which my enemies' life was taken away has become in fructuous now."
data.anv: तैः they, सङ्ग्रामे in battlefield, मम me, रिपूणाम् enemies, जीवितम् life, अदत्तम् taken away, वासुकितेजसः of equal brilliance as Vasuki, शराः arrows, निष्फलाः wasted, सम्वृत्ताःखलु become in fructuous now.
data.md: And those shafts resembling Fire in fierceness, which had in battle deprived my foes of their lives, have forsooth been rendered fruitless.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा तु संक्रुद्धो निश्वसन्नुरगो यथा । अब्रवीद्रक्षसां मध्ये धूम्राक्षं नाम राकसं ॥
data.es: Having said so, hissing Ravana called Dhumraksha to the midst.
data.anv: एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, सङ्क्रुद्धः enraged, यथा just like, निश्श्वसन् hissing, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, मध्ये midst, धूम्राक्षंनाम called Dhumraksha, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, अब्रवीत् said.
data.md: Having said this in high rage Rāvana, sighing like a serpent, addressed a Raksasa, named Dhūmrākṣa, seated in the midst of the Rākşasa.

data.v: बलेन महता युक्तो रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम् । त्वं वधायाभिनिर्याहि रामस्य सह वानरैः ॥
data.es: "Dhumraksha of fierce prowess, you along with a huge Rakshasa army go just now to destroy Rama along with able Vanaras."
data.anv: भीमविक्रमः of fierce prowess, त्वम् you, महता huge, बलेन army, राक्षसैः of Rakshasas, युक्तः able, वानरैःसह along with Vanaras, रामस्य and Rama also, वधाय destroying, अभि now, निर्याहि commanded.
data.md: O you of dreadful prowess, surrounded by a mighty force, do you march forth to compass the destruction of Rāma along with the monkeys.

data.v: एवमुक्तस्तु धूम्राक्षो राक्षसेन्द्रेण धीमता । कृत्वा प्रणामं संहृष्टो निर्जगाम नृपालयात् ॥
data.es: Commanded by the Intelligent king of Rakshasas in that manner, Dhumraksha offered prayers and went from there joyfully.
data.anv: धीमता Intelligent, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the Lord of Rakshasas, एवम् in that manner, उक्तः ordered by, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, प्रणाम् prayers, कृत्वा having offered, नृपालयत् from the king, सम्हृष्ट: joyful, निर्जगाम went from there.
data.md: Thus accosted by the intelligent lord of the Raksasas, Dhumraksa, turning about, issued out of the abode of the king.

data.v: अभिनिष्क्रम्य तद्द्वारं बलाध्यक्षमुवाच ह । त्वरयस्व बलं तूर्णं किं चिरेण युयुत्सतः ॥
data.es: There after Dhumraksha went from the gateway and said to the CommanderinChief of the army" Get ready immediately and start quickly. Why delay?"
data.anv: तद् thereafter, द्वारम् from the gateway, अभिनिष्क्रम्य went from there, बलाध्यक्षम् commander inchief of the army, उवाचह said so, तूर्णम् Instantly, बलम् army, युयुत्सतः get ready, त्वरयस्व speedily, चिरेण delay, किम् why.
data.md: And speedily sallying forth from the gate of (Ravana's residence, he said to the general of the forces, “Do you speedily move off your forces. why should a warrior linger?”

data.v: धूम्राक्षस्य वचः श्रुत्वा बलाध्यक्षो बलानुगः । बलमुद्योजयामास रावणस्याज्ञया द्रुतम् ॥
data.es: On hearing the words of Dhumraksha, the CommanderinChief of the large army, he got ready quickly by the order of Ravana.
data.anv: बलानुगः large army contingent, बलाध्यक्षः CommanderinChief of army, धूम्राक्षवचनम् Dhumraksha's words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, रावणस्य Ravana's, आज्ञया by the order, द्रुतम् quickly, बलम् army, उद्योजयामास got ready.
data.md: Hearing Dhumraksa's words, the general of the forces, following them, at the command of Rāvaņa forthwith made the army ready.

data.v: ते बद्धघण्टा बलिनो घोररूपा निशाचराः । विनर्दमानाः संहृष्टा धूम्राक्षं पर्यवारयन् ॥
data.es: Mighty army bound with girdles of bells to their waist, of fierce form roaring surrounded Dhumraksha joyfully.
data.anv: बद्धघण्टाः bound with girdles of bells, बलिनः mighty, घोररूपाः of fierce, तेनिशाचराः the Rakshasa, विगर्जमाना roaring, सम्हृष्टाः joyfully, धूम्राक्षम् with Dhumraksha, पर्यवारयन् surrounded.
data.md: And those powerful and dreadful nightrangers, bursting with high spirits, with bells tied to their arms, set up shouts, and surrounded Dhumraksa.

data.v: विविधायुधहस्ताश्च शूलमुद्गरपाणयः । गदाभिः पट्टसैर्दण्डैरायसैर्मुसलैर्भृशम् ॥
data.es: The dreadful Rakshasas set out roaring like rain clouds armed with different kinds of weapons, like tridents, darts, maces, spears, iron bars, rods, even clubs, spears and slings, arrows in thousands.
data.anv: जलदायथा like rain clouds, नर्दन्तः roaring, घोराः dreadful, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, विविधायुधहस्ताश्च holding different kinds of weapons, शूलमुद्गरपाणयः tridents, spikes, गदाभिः maces too, पट्टसै: iron spears, दण्डैः rods, आयसैः armour, मुसलैरपि even clubs, परिघैः iron bars, भिण्डिवापालैश्च slings use for hurling stones, भल्लैः arrows, प्रासै: darts, परश्वधैः in thousands, निर्ययुः set out.
data.md: And bearing various weapons in their hands, and wielding darts and clubs, and equipped with maces and bearded darts and rods and iron bludgeons and parighas and bhindipālas and lances and nooses and axes, those terrific Rāks asas sallied out roaring like to clouds.

data.v: परिघैर्भिण्डिपालैश्च भल्लैः प्रासैः परश्वधैः । निर्ययू राक्षसा घोरा नर्दन्तो जलदा यथा ॥
data.es: The dreadful Rakshasas set out roaring like rain clouds armed with different kinds of weapons, like tridents, darts, maces, spears, iron bars, rods, even clubs, spears and slings, arrows in thousands.
data.anv: जलदायथा like rain clouds, नर्दन्तः roaring, घोराः dreadful, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, विविधायुधहस्ताश्च holding different kinds of weapons, शूलमुद्गरपाणयः tridents, spikes, गदाभिः maces too, पट्टसै: iron spears, दण्डैः rods, आयसैः armour, मुसलैरपि even clubs, परिघैः iron bars, भिण्डिवापालैश्च slings use for hurling stones, भल्लैः arrows, प्रासै: darts, परश्वधैः in thousands, निर्ययुः set out.
data.md: And bearing various weapons in their hands, and wielding darts and clubs, and equipped with maces and bearded darts and rods and iron bludgeons and parighas and bhindipālas and lances and nooses and axes, those terrific Rāks asas sallied out roaring like to clouds.

data.v: रथैः कवचिनस्त्वन्ये ध्वजैश्च समलंकृतैः । सुवर्णजालविहितैः खरैश्च विविधाननैः ॥
data.es: And others collected together holding shields, fearless like tigers, frightful in appearance, mounted on fast horses, chariots yoked to donkeys of different kinds covered with gold mesh, on maddened elephants Set out.
data.anv: अन्ये and others, कवचिनः holding shields, ध्वजैः flags, समलङ्कृतैः collected together, सुवर्णजालविहितैः with golden mesh, विविधाननैः many kinds, खरैश्च donkeys, रथैः chariots, परमशीघ्रैः very fast, हयैश्च horses also, मदोत्कटैः maddened, गजैश्चैव and elephants, व्याघ्राःइव like tigers, and horses दुरासदाः frightful, निर्ययुर्नैरृतव्याघ्रा fearless like tigers, निर्ययुः set out.
data.md: And others, accoutred in armour, with cars; adorned with banners; furnished with golden networks, and mules having various faces, and extremely swift steeds, and lusty elephants in rut, tiger-like Naiſtas incapable of being subdued even as tigers-sallied out (thereafter).

data.v: हयैः परमशीघ्रैश्च गजेन्द्रैश्च मदोत्कटैः । निर्ययू राक्षसव्याघ्रा व्याघ्रा इव दुरासदाः ॥
data.es: And others collected together holding shields, fearless like tigers, frightful in appearance, mounted on fast horses, chariots yoked to donkeys of different kinds covered with gold mesh, on maddened elephants Set out.
data.anv: अन्ये and others, कवचिनः holding shields, ध्वजैः flags, समलङ्कृतैः collected together, सुवर्णजालविहितैः with golden mesh, विविधाननैः many kinds, खरैश्च donkeys, रथैः chariots, परमशीघ्रैः very fast, हयैश्च horses also, मदोत्कटैः maddened, गजैश्चैव and elephants, व्याघ्राःइव like tigers, and horses दुरासदाः frightful, निर्ययुर्नैरृतव्याघ्रा fearless like tigers, निर्ययुः set out.

data.v: वृकसिंहमुखैर्युक्तं खरैः कनकभूषणैः । आरुरोह रथं दिव्यं धूम्राक्षः खरनिस्वनः ॥
data.es: Dhumraksha of frightful tone mounted on a chariot adorned with gold yoked to donkeys with lion and bear like faces.
data.anv: खरनिःस्वनः of frightful tone, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, वृकसिंहमुखैः having faces like lion and bear, कनकभूषणै: adorned with gold, खरैः donkeys, युक्तम् yoked, दिव्यम् awesome, रथम् chariots, आरुरोह mounted.
data.md: Then Dhūmrākṣa himself ascended a superb car, bearing faces of deer and lions decked with gold, and sending forth a loud clatter.

data.v: स निर्यातो महावीर्यो धूम्राक्षो राक्षसैर्वृतः । प्रहसन्पश्चिमद्वारं हनूमान्यत्र यूथपः ॥
data.es: Heroic Rakshasa, Dhumraksha surrounded by rakshasas set forth laughing to the west gate where Hanuman stood.
data.anv: महावीर्यः heroic, सःधूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, वृतः surrounded by, प्रहसन् laughing, यत्र there, हनूमान् Hanuman, यूधपः taken position, पश्चिमद्वारं west gate, निर्यातः set forth.
data.md: The highly powerful Dhūmrākşa, surrounded by Rākşasas, cheerfully issued out of the Western Entrance, where Hanumān was posted.

data.v: प्रयान्तं तु महाघोरं राक्षसं भीमदर्शनम् । अन्तरिक्षगताः क्रूराः शकुनाः प्रत्यवारयन् ॥
data.es: While the Rakshasa was mounted on the chariot and going braying like a donkey, a fearful bird going in the sky stood before his chariot.
data.anv: खरयुक्तम् yoked to donkeys, खरस्वनम् braying like donkeys, रथप्रवरम् chariot, आस्थाय mounting, प्रयान्तम् while going, महाघोरम् terrible, भीमदर्शनम् fearful appearance, राक्षसम् at the Rakshasa, अन्तरिक्षागताः going to the sky, घोराः fierce, शकुनाः birds, प्रत्यषेधयन् stood before.
data.md: Thereat, fell fowls of the air forbade that exceedingly dreadful Räksasa of a fearful form, as he went out ascending an excellent car joked with mules, and sending sharp sounds.

data.v: रथशीर्षे महाभीमो गृध्रश्च निपपात ह । ध्वजाग्रे ग्रथिताश्चैव निपेतुः कुणपाशनाः ॥
data.es: A foul smelling frightening vulture (that feeds on the dead body) descended on top of the chariot and fell down.
data.anv: महान्भीमः very frightening, गृध्रश्च vultures, रथशीर्षे on the chariot, निपपातह descended on, कुणपाशनाः a foul smelling, ग्रथिताः vultures, ध्वजाग्रे from the chariot top, निपेतुः fell down.
data.md: And an exceedingly terrific vulture alighted at the crest of the car and forming themselves into lines, vultures began to drop down about the top of the banner. And emitting a frightful cry, (a headless trunk) dropped down before Dhumraksa.

data.v: रुधिरार्द्रो महाञ्श्वेतः कबन्धः पतितो भुवि । विस्वरं चोत्सृजन्नादं धूम्राक्षस्य समीपतः ॥
data.es: A trunk of a white bird drenched in blood sounding discordant fell near by Dhumraksha. It appeared like a rain god shedding blood on the ground.
data.anv: रुधिरार्द्रः drenched in blood, श्वेतः white, महान् great, कबन्धः bird, विस्वरम् discordant cry, नादम् sound, उत्सृजन् heard, धूम्राक्षस्य at Dhumraksha, समीपतः nearby, भुवि on ground, पतितः fell, देवः Deva, रुधिरम् , blood, ववर्ष rained, मेदिनी on earth.

data.v: ववर्ष रुधिरं देवः संचचाल च मेदिनी । प्रतिलोमं ववौ वायुर्निर्घातसमनिस्वनः । तिमिरौघावृतास्तत्र दिशश्च न चकाशिरे ॥
data.es: Thunder like roar was heard. Wind blew adversely. Darkness pervaded, and directions could not be seen.
data.anv: निर्घातसमनिस्वनः thunder like roar, वायुः wind, प्रतिलोमम् adversely, ववौ blew, तत्र there, दिशः directions, तिमिरौघवृताः darkness pervaded, नचकाशिरे directions could not be discerned.
data.md: That god* showered down blood; and the earth shook. And the wind blew awry with a sound resembling thunder. And every side, covered with darkness, appeared dim. *Indra-cloud compeller.

data.v: स तूत्पातांस्ततो दृष्ट्वा राक्षसानां भयावहान् । प्रादुर्भूतान्सुघोरांश्च धूम्राक्षो व्यथितोऽभवत् ॥
data.es: Then Rakshasa feared seeing the dreadful manifestation and got worried. All the Rakshasas walking in front of Dhumraksha lost consciousness.
data.anv: राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, भयावहान् feared, तदा then, प्रादुद्भूतान् manifesting deities, घोरान् dreadful, उत्पातान् generated, दृष्टवा seeing, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, व्यथितः worried, अभवत् became, धूम्राक्षस्य Dhumraksha's, पुरःसराः in front, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, मुमुहुः lost consciousness.
data.md: And witnessing those dreadful inauspicious omens at the outset, fraught with fear to the Räkşasas, Dhūmrākṣa was greatly aggrieved; and the Räksaşas marching before him, were stupefied.

data.v: ततः सुभीमो बहुभिर्निशाचरै;र्वृतोऽभिनिष्क्रम्य रणोत्सुको बली । ददर्श तां राघवबाहुपालितां; समुद्रकल्पां बहुवानरीं चमूम् ॥
data.es: Thereafter many strong and powerful Rakshasas surrounding Dhumraksha, who was enthusiastic about war, beheld many Vanaras protected by Raghava like at universal dissolution.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the fifty first sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, सुभीमः very powerful, बली strong, बहुभिः many, निशाचरैः Rakshasas, वृतः surrounding, रणोत्सुकः enthusiastic of war, अभिनिष्क्रम्य, राघवबाहुपालिताम् protected by Raghava, महौघकल्पाम् universal dissolution, बहुवानरीम् many Vanaras, तांचमूम् the army, ददर्श beheld.
data.md: Then as that strong and fearful one, eager for encounter, surrounded by in numerable nigh rangers, issued out (of the city), he beheld that monkey-host, protected by the arm of Rāghava, resembling the deep at the time of universal dissolution.

data.v: धूम्राक्षं प्रेक्ष्य निर्यान्तं राक्षसं भीमनिस्वनम् । विनेदुर्वानराः सर्वे प्रहृष्टा युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः ॥
data.es: Seeing Dhumraksha of terrible prowess returning, the vanaras made loud noises out of joy and desire to wage war.
data.anv: निर्यान्तम् returning, भीमविक्रमम् of terrible prowess, राक्षसम् Rakshasas, धूम्राक्षम् Dhumraksha, वीक्ष्य seeing, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanaras, युद्धकाङ् क्षिणः desirous to wage war, प्रहृष्टाः rejoicing, विनेदुः made loud noise.
data.md: Seeing the Rākṣasa-Dhūmrākṣa of dreadful prowess-issue out, the monkeys, rejoicing greatly, eager for encounter, set up roars.

data.v: तेषां तु तुमुलं युद्धं संजज्ञे हरिरक्षसाम् । अन्योन्यं पादपैर्घोरैर्निघ्नतं शूलमुद्गरैः ॥
data.es: Tumultuous war took place between Vanaras and Rakshasas, striking one another, monkeys with terrible trees and Rakshasas with tridents and clubs.
data.anv: घोरैः terrible, पादपैः trees, शूलमुद्गरैः tridents and clubs, अन्योन्यम् one another, निघ्नताम् , तेषाम् in that way, कपिरक्षसाम् between the Vanaras and Rakshasas, सुतुमुलम् tumultuous, युद्धम् war, संजज्ञे happened.
data.md: Then there took place a terrific conflict between the monkeys and the Rākşasas, charging each other with fearful trees, and darts, and maces.

data.v: राक्षसैर्वानरा घोरा विनिकृत्ताः समन्ततः । वानरै राक्षसाश्चापि द्रुमैर्भूमौ समीकृताः ॥
data.es: Fierce Rakshasas mowed down the Vanaras all over and even the Vanaras pulled down Rakshasas to the ground with trees.
data.anv: समन्ततः all over, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, घोराः fierce, वानराः Vanara, विनिकृत्ताः mowed down, राक्षसश्चापि even Rakshasas, वानरैः Vanara, द्रुमैः with trees, भूमिसमीकृताः pulled down to the ground.
data.md: The Rākşasas began to scatter the dreadful monkeys on all sides; and the monkeys (on their parts) felled the Raksasas with trees.

data.v: राक्षसाश्चापि संक्रुद्धा वानरान्निशितैः शरैः । विव्यधुर्घोरसंकाशैः कङ्कपत्रैरजिह्मगैः ॥
data.es: Highly enraged Rakshasas on their part fixed the Vanaras with sharp dreadful arrows with itching feathers.
data.anv: राक्षसास्तु Rakshasas on their part, अभिसङ्क्रुद्धाः highly enraged, निशितैः sharp, घोरसङ्काशैः dreadful, कङ्कपत्रैः itching feathers, अजिह्मगैः fixed, शरैः arrows, वानरान् at Vanaras, विव्यथु attacked.
data.md: The Raksasas, growing enraged, began to pierce that monkeys with straight speeding sharp shafts winged with Kanka plumes.

data.v: ते गदाभिश्च भीमाभिः पट्टसैः कूटमुद्गरैः । घोरैश्च परिघैश्चित्रैस्त्रिशूलैश्चापि संशितैः ॥
data.es: The Vanaras although strong were wielding maces, spikes, tridents, terrific iron bars and multitude of weapons of many kinds to crush the Rakshasas. They were endowed with prowess, knowledgeable of weapons and doing their duty without fear and with great enthusiasm.
data.anv: भीमाभिः being strong, गदाभिः wielding maces, पट्टसै: spikes, कूटमुद्गरैः multitude of weapons to crush, घोरैः terrific, परिघैश्च iron bars also, चित्स्रैः many kinds, संश्रितैः wielders, त्रिशूलैश्च tridents also, रक्षोभिः guarding, विदीर्यमाणाः knowers, महाबलाः endowed with prowess, तेवानराः those Vanaras, अमर्ष bearing, जनितोद्धर्षाः with great enthusiasm, अभीतवत् without fear, कर्माणि their duty, चक्रुः doing.
data.md: And riven by the Rākşasa with drcadful clubs and bearded darts, daggers and maces and terrible and curious bludgeons and grasped javelins, the exceedingly powerful (monkeys), their anger aroused, began with alacrity to perform deeds of intrepid valour.

data.v: विदार्यमाणा रक्षोभिर्वानरास्ते महाबलाः । अमर्षाज्जनितोद्धर्षाश्चक्रुः कर्माण्यभीतवत् ॥
data.es: The Vanaras although strong were wielding maces, spikes, tridents, terrific iron bars and multitude of weapons of many kinds to crush the Rakshasas. They were endowed with prowess, knowledgeable of weapons and doing their duty without fear and with great enthusiasm.
data.anv: भीमाभिः being strong, गदाभिः wielding maces, पट्टसै: spikes, कूटमुद्गरैः multitude of weapons to crush, घोरैः terrific, परिघैश्च iron bars also, चित्स्रैः many kinds, संश्रितैः wielders, त्रिशूलैश्च tridents also, रक्षोभिः guarding, विदीर्यमाणाः knowers, महाबलाः endowed with prowess, तेवानराः those Vanaras, अमर्ष bearing, जनितोद्धर्षाः with great enthusiasm, अभीतवत् without fear, कर्माणि their duty, चक्रुः doing.
data.md: And riven by the Rākşasa with drcadful clubs and bearded darts, daggers and maces and terrible and curious bludgeons and grasped javelins, the exceedingly powerful (monkeys), their anger aroused, began with alacrity to perform deeds of intrepid valour.

data.v: शरनिर्भिन्नगात्रास्ते शूलनिर्भिन्नदेहिनः । जगृहुस्ते द्रुमांस्तत्र शिलाश्च हरियूथपाः ॥
data.es: Vanaras 's bodies split in their necks by the terrible tridents, took up trees and rocks to fight.
data.anv: शरनिर्भिन्नगात्राः split necks and bodies, शूलनिर्भिन्नदेहिनः by the terrible tridents, ते they, वानरयूथपाः Vanara troops, तत्र there, द्रुमान् trees, शिलाश्च rocks, जगृहुः took up to fight.
data.md: Those monkey-leaders, their bodies pierced with shafts and their persons riven with darts, took up trees and crags.

data.v: ते भीमवेगा हरयो नर्दमानास्ततस्ततः । ममन्थू राक्षसान्भीमान्नामानि च बभाषिरे ॥
data.es: The monkeys endowed with terrific speed, proceeding from there roaring, proclaiming their names crushed the Rakshasa heroes.
data.anv: भीमवेगाः of terrific speed, तेहरयः the monkeys, नर्दमानाः roaring, ततस्ततः proceeding from there, वीरान् heroes, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, ममन्थुः proclaiming नामानिच their names, बभाषिरे crushed.
data.md: Those monkeys, endowed with terrific vehemence, sending up shouts, and proclaiming their respective names, set about tossing the brave Rākşasa rank,

data.v: तद्बभूवाद्भुतं घोरं युद्धं वानररक्षसाम् । शिलाभिर्विविधाभिश्च बहुशाखैश्च पादपैः ॥
data.es: Wonderful fight took place between Vanaras and Rakshasas who held trees and rocks of several kinds.
data.anv: विविधाभिः of several kinds, शिलाभिः rocks, बहुभिः many, पादपैः trees, तत् there, वानररक्षसाम् between Vanaras and Rakshasas, घोरम् fierce, युद्धम् war, अद्भुतम् च wonderful, बभूव took place.
data.md: The monkeys, waged with diverse rocks and innumerable trees, waxed exceedingly furious.

data.v: राक्षसा मथिताः केचिद्वानरैर्जितकाशिभिः । ववर्षू रुधिरं केचिन्मुखै रुधिरभोजनाः ॥
data.es: Vanaras who had conquered fear crushed Rakshasas into lumps of flesh indeed the Rakshasas threw out blood from their mouths.
data.anv: जितकाशिभिः who conquered fear, वानरैः Vanaras, केचित् indeed, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, मथिताः crushed into lumps, केचित् indeed, रुधिरभोजनाः blood thrown out, मुखैः from mouth, रुधिरम् blood, ववमूः vomited.
data.md: Sparkling in the glory of victory, the monkeys crushed the Rākşasas and some among them feeding on gore began to vomit blood.

data.v: पार्श्वेषु दारिताः केचित्केचिद्राशीकृता द्रुमैः । शिलाभिश्चूर्णिताः केचित्केचिद्दन्तैर्विदारिताः ॥
data.es: Some tore by the sides of the body, some crushed by the trees, some powdered by the rocks, and some were torn into pieces with teeth.
data.anv: केचित् some, पार्श्वेषु by the sides, दारिताः tore, केचित् some, द्रुमैः by trees, राशीकृताः crushed, केचित् some, शिलाभिः with rocks, चूर्णिताः powdered, केचित् some, दन्तै with teeth, विदारिताः tore into pieces.
data.md: And some were severed along their flanks; and, some, slain with trees, were heaped up; and some were crushed with crags; and some were torn with teeth.

data.v: ध्वजैर्विमथितैर्भग्नैः खरैश्च विनिपातितैः । रथैर्विध्वंसितैश्चापि पतितै रजनीचरैः ॥
data.es: Indeed, the night rangers were killed, their flags were broken. They were crushed, their swords were destroyed with chariots fallen.
data.anv: केचित् indeed, रजनीचरैः night rangers, विमथितैः killed, भग्नैः broken, ध्वजैः flags, विनिपातितैः crushed, खङ्गैश्च swords, विध्वंसितैः totally destroyed, रथैः chariots, पतितैः fallen down.
data.md: Some being broken down by means of broken standards, and some by means of fallen swords, and some crushed down by cars, the rangers of the night suffered sorely.

data.v: वानरैर्भीमविक्रान्तैराप्लुत्याप्लुत्य वेगितैः । राक्षसाः करजैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मुखेषु विनिकर्तिताः ॥
data.es: The Vanaras with their terrific valour jumping up wounded the Rakshasas in their face with their sharp nails.
data.anv: भीमविक्रान्स्सैः of terrific valour, वेगितैः of high speed, वानरैः Vanaras, आप्लुत्य jumping up, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, करजैः nails, मुखेषु on the face, विनिर्तिताः wounded.
data.md: Bounding again and again, the vehement monkeys endowed with terrific prowess, with their finger-nails tore up the Rākṣasas by the mouths.

data.v: विवर्णवदना भूयो विप्रकीर्णशिरोरुहाः । मूढाः शोणितगन्धेन निपेतुर्धरणीतले ॥
data.es: Some others with pale faces and dishevelled hair lost senses due to rolling in blood dropped on the ground.
data.anv: भूयः some others, विषण्णवदनाः pale faces, विप्रकीर्णशिरोरुहाः dishevelled hair, शोणितगन्धेन due to the smell of blood, मूढाः lost senses, धरणीतले on the ground, निपेतुः dropped.
data.md: With woebegone faces, and with hair dishevelled, (the Raksasas), stupified with the smell of blood, saught the earth.

data.v: नये तु परमक्रुद्धा राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः । तलैरेवाभिधावन्ति वज्रस्पर्शसमैर्हरीन् ॥
data.es: Other Rakshasas of terrific valour, extremely enraged, hit the monkeys with their palms which were hard as diamond to touch.
data.anv: भीमविक्रमाः of terrific valour, अन्ये others, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, परमसङ्कृक्रुद्धाः extremely enraged, वज्रस्पर्शसमैः of hard touch like diamond, तलैरेव with palms, हरीन् monkeys, अभिधावन्ति assailed.
data.md: Other Rākşasas endowed with dreadful vigour, waxing wondrous wroth, dealt the monkeys slaps with hands having the touch of the thunder-bolt.

data.v: वनरैरापतन्तस्ते वेगिता वेगवत्तरैः । मुष्टिभिश्चरणैर्दन्तैः पादपैश्चापपोथिताः ॥
data.es: Endowed with speed, the Vanaras also fell on the Rakshasas at greater speed, knocking them down with fists, feet, teeth and even trees.
data.anv: वेगिताः endowed with speed, आपतन्तः falling upon, ते them, वेगवत्तरैः of greater speed, वानरैः Vanaras, मुष्टिभिः with fists, चरणैः feet, दन्स्सैः with teeth, पादपैश्च trees also, अवपोथिताः knocking.
data.md: Gift with greater impetuosity, the monkeys felled the impetuous (Raksasas) with blows, and feet and teeth; and some were slain with trees.

data.v: सन्यं तु विद्रुतं दृष्ट्वा धूम्राक्षो राक्षसर्षभः । क्रोधेन कदनं चक्रे वानराणां युयुत्सताम् ॥
data.es: Dhumraksha, the bull among the Rakshasas seeing the army distressed and running away, being eager to fight began to cause havoc to the Vanaras.
data.anv: राक्षसर्षभ bull among Rakshasas, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, विद्रुतम् distressed, सैन्यम् army, दृष्टवा seeing, रोषेण angrily, युयुत्सताम् eager to fight, वानराणाम् Vanaras, कदनम् havoc, चक्रे running away.
data.md: Seeing the forces fleeing away, that foremost of Raksasas-Dhumraksa-flying into fury, began a terrific conflict with the monkeys desirous of encounter.

data.v: प्रासैः प्रमथिताः केचिद्वानराः शोणितस्रवाः । मुद्गरैराहताः केचित्पतिता धरणीतले ॥
data.es: Few Vanaras mutilated by barbed darts, some struck with mallets, blood oozing dropped down.
data.anv: केचित् a few, वानराः Vanaras, प्रासैः by barbed darts, प्रमथिताः mutilated, शोणितस्रवाः, केचित् , मुद्गरैः, आहताः, धरणीतले on the ground, पातिताः dropped.
data.md: Some of the monkeys, sore assailed with prāśas, began to bleed; and some, wounded with maces, dropped down to the ground.

data.v: परिघैर्मथितः केचिद्भिण्डिपालैर्विदारिताः । पट्टसैराहताः केचिद्विह्वलन्तो गतासवः ॥
data.es: Some were pound by iron bars, some were torn up, some split and some pierced and cut ceased in life.
data.anv: केचित् some, परिघैः iron bars, मथिताः pounded, भिण्डिवालैः torn up, विदारिताः split, केचित् some, पट्टसैः pierced, मथिताः pounded, विह्वलन्तः cut, गतासनः ceased of life.
data.md: Some were beaten hard with bludgeons; and some were cleft with bhindipālas. And some, on being assailed with bearded darts, became insensible and lost their lives.

data.v: केचिद्विनिहता भूमौ रुधिरार्द्रा वनौकसः । केचिद्विद्राविता नष्टाः संक्रुद्धै राक्षसैर्युधि ॥
data.es: In the battlefield some Vanaras, attacked by Rakshasas, were floating on the ground in blood, dead.
data.anv: युधि in the battlefield, केचित् some, वनौकसः Vanaras, सङ्क्रुद्धैः attacked by, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, विनिहताः killed, रुधिरार्द्राः floating in blood, भूमौ on the ground, एचित् some, विद्राविताः split, नष्टाः destroyed.
data.md: Some among the monkeys lay slain on the ground, drenched in blood. and some, fleeing away from the field, were slaughtered by the infuriated Rākşasas.

data.v: विभिन्नहृदयाः केचिदेकपार्श्वेन शायिताः । विदारितास्त्रशूलै च केचिदान्त्रैर्विनिस्रुताः ॥
data.es: Some with their hearts open and broken, beaten on side laid detached of their inner parts.
data.anv: केचित् a few, विभिन्नहृदयाः hearts open and broken, एकपार्श्वेन beaten on one side, शायिताः laid, केचित् few, त्रिशूलैः by tridents, विदारिताः split, आन्स्रैः inner parts, विनिःसृताः detached.
data.md: Some, having their breasts pierced, lay on their sides. and some were riven with tridents; and the entrails of some had come out.

data.v: तत्सुभीमं महद्युद्धं हरिराकस संकुलम् । प्रबभौ शस्त्रबहुलं शिलापादपसंकुलम् ॥
data.es: The monkeys and Rakshasa groups took part in a fierce fight with rocks and trees abounding loud noise.
data.anv: सुभीमम् very frightful, हरिराक्षससङ्कुलम् monkeys and Rakshasa groups, शिलापादमसङ्कुलम् with rocks and trees, शब्दबहुलम् loud noise, महत् great, तत् युद्धम् that battle, प्रबभौ abounded.
data.md: That mighty and dreadful encounter of the Räksasas and the monkeys, was waged with countless weapons and rocks and trees.

data.v: धनुर्ज्यातन्त्रिमधुरं हिक्कातालसमन्वितम् । मन्द्रस्तनितसंगीतं युद्धगान्धर्वमाबभौ ॥
data.es: It seemed like music in the form of twang of bow strings, neighing of horses like the sound of wooden cymbals, vocal music in the form of trumpeting of elephants, that battle seemed like symphony.
data.anv: धनुर्ज्यातन्त्रिमधुरम् in the form of twang of bow strings, हिक्कातालसमन्वितम् neighing of horses in the form of wooden cymbals, मन्धस्न्तितसङ्गीतम् music in the form of trumpeting of elephants, तत् that, युद्धगान्धर्वम् , आबभौ seemed.
data.md: That battle he come a musical entertainment' mellifluous with bow-string for Vina, having the neighing of chargers for its measure, and with the cries of Maindas' for its strains. 1. The reader has already perceived that the carrying out of a simile to a number of details is a characteristic as much of Vālmīki as of his rival in the epic sphere-Vyāsa, but the comparisons are never on all fours, as in the case before us. 2. A classical Hindu musical instrument, having metallic strings, with a pair of gourds at one end for the sounding-board. Vide Yantra-Kosa by Sir Saurindra Mohan Tagore, Mus-Doc. 3. A species of elephants.

data.v: धूम्राक्षस्तु धनुष्पाणिर्वानरान्रणमूर्धनि । हसन्विद्रावयामास दिशस्ताञ्शरवृष्टिभिः ॥
data.es: Dhumraksha with his bow in hand, showering arrows, laughing in battlefront dispersed the Vanaras in directions.
data.anv: धूम्राक्षस्तु Dhumraksha with bow in hand, रणमूर्धनि in the battle front, धनुष्पाणिः wielding arrows and bow, हसन् laughing, शरवृष्टिभिः showers of arrows, तान् वानरान् on the Vanaras, दिशः directions, तु at, विद्रावयामास started dispersing.
data.md: Then in the field, Dhūmrākṣa bow in hand, laughing, pursued the monkeys in all directions with showers of shafts.

data.v: धूम्राक्षेणार्दितं सैन्यं व्यथितं दृश्य मारुतिः । अभ्यवर्तत संक्रुद्धः प्रगृह्य विपुलां शिलाम् ॥
data.es: Beholding the perturbed army, Hanuman seized a huge rock and turned towards Dhumraksha.
data.anv: मारुतिः Hanuman, धूम्राक्षेण at Dhumraksha, अर्धितम् perturbed, व्यथितम् harassed, सैन्यम् army, प्रेक्ष्य beholding, सङ्क्रुद्धः very angry, विपुलाम् huge, शिलाम् rock, प्रगृह्य grabbing, अभ्यवर्तत turned towards.
data.md: Seeing the forces hard beset by Dhūmrākşa and distressed thereat, the Windgod's offspring, waxing enraged, seizing a huge crag, approached (the Rākşasa).

data.v: क्रोधाद्द्विगुणताम्राक्षः पितृतुल्यपराक्रमः । शिलां तां पातयामास धूम्राक्षस्य रथं प्रति ॥
data.es: Endowed with mighty valour equal to his father, an angry Hanuman hurled the rock at the chariot of Dhumraksha.
data.anv: पितृ father:, तुल्यपराक्रमः endowed with mighty valour, क्रोधात् angrily, द्विगुणताम्राक्षः copper colour red eyed, धूम्राक्षस्य at Dhumraksha, रथंप्रति at the chariot, तांशिलाम् that rock, पातयामास hurled.
data.md: And with his eyes double reddened in wrath, the one, like to his sire himself in prowess, brought down the crag upon Dhūmrākṣa's car.

data.v: आपतन्तीं शिलां दृष्ट्वा गदामुद्यम्य संभ्रमात् । रथादाप्लुत्य वेगेन वसुधायां व्यतिष्ठत ॥
data.es: Beholding the rock descending upon him, Dhumraksha rushed instantly on the ground from the chariot and stood.
data.anv: आपतन्तीम् descending upon, शिलाम् rock, दृष्टवा beholding, सम्भ्रमात् bewildered, गदाम् mace, उद्यम्य seizing, वेगेन rushing, रथात् chariot's, आप्लुत्य mounting, वसुधायाम् on the ground, व्यतिष्ठत stood
data.md: Seeing the crag, (Dhumraksa) upraising his mace hurriedly, leapt down in vehemence, and stood on the ground. And having shattered his car, that crag fell down to the earth.

data.v: सा प्रमथ्य रथं तस्य निपपात शिलाभुवि । सचक्रकूबरं साश्वं सध्वजं सशरासनम् ॥
data.es: That rock fell on the chariot and got crushed along with its wheel and axle and with arrows.
data.anv: साशिला that rock, तस्य its, सचक्रकूबरसाश्वम् with wheel and axle, सध्वजम् with posts, सशरासनम् with arrows, रथम् chariot, प्रमध्य crushed, भुवि ground, निपपात Fell.

data.v: स भङ्क्त्वा तु रथं तस्य हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः । रक्षसां कदनं चक्रे सस्कन्धविटपैर्द्रुमैः ॥
data.es: Hanuman the son of WindGod in that way started destroying the chariot and the Rakshasa with tree trunks and stems.
data.anv: मारुतात्मजः son of WindGod, सःहनुमान् that Hanuman, तस्य his, रथम् chariot, भङ् क्त्वा trunks, सस्कन्धविटपैः stems of trees, द्रुमैः Dhumraksha, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, कदनम् destruction, चक्रे started.
data.md: Thereat letting go the car furnished with wheels, Kuvaras and a face, as well as a banner; in which Dhūmrākṣa had left his bow, Hanuman-son to the Wind-god-laid about him right lustily for destroying the Rākşasas, with trees having branches long and short.

data.v: विभिन्नशिरसो भूत्वा राक्षसाः शोणितोक्षिताः । द्रुमैः प्रमथिताश्चान्ये निपेतुर्धरणीतले ॥
data.es: Some Rakshasas hit by trees with their heads broken, shedding blood fell on the ground.
data.anv: राक्षसाः Rakshasa, विभिन्नशिरसः heads broken, भूत्वा hit, शोणितोक्षिताः drenched in blood, अन्ये other, द्रुमैः trees, प्रमथिताः hit by, धरणीतले on the ground, निपेतुः fell.
data.md: Thereat some Rākşasas with their heads shattered, lay drenched in blood; and others, struck with trees, dropped down to the earth.

data.v: विद्राव्य राक्षसं सैन्यं हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः । गिरेः शिखरमादाय धूम्राक्षमभिदुद्रुवे ॥
data.es: Hanuman the son of WindGod, after chasing the army of Rakshasas reaching the top of the mountain, jumped on Dhumraksha.
data.anv: मारुतात्मजः the son of Wind God, हनुमान् Hanuman, राक्षसम् at Rakshasas, सैन्यम् army, विद्राव्य chasing, गिरेः mountain, शिखरम् top, आदाय reaching, धूम्राक्षम् Dhumraksha, अभिदुद्रुवे jumped on to.
data.md: Then Hanumān-son to the Wind-god-charged in full career against the Räkşasa army; and, taking a mountain-peak, he rushed against Dhumraksa.

data.v: तमापतन्तं धूम्राक्षो गदामुद्यम्य वीर्यवान् । विनर्दमानः सहसा हनूमन्तमभिद्रवत् ॥
data.es: Lifting his mace on seeing Hanuman, heroic and brave Dhumraksha darted on Hanuman, roaring like a lion.
data.anv: वीर्यवान् heroic, धूम्राक्षः Dhumrakshasa, गदाम् mace, उद्यम्य lifting up, विनर्दमानः roaring like a lion, सहसा brave, आपतन्तम् jumped, तंहनूमन्तम् that Hanuman, अभिद्रवत् darted.
data.md: As Hanumān was descending, the powerful Dhūmrākşa, upraising a mace and giving out a shout, made towards him speedily.

data.v: ततः क्रुद्धस्तु वेगेन गदां तां बहुकण्टकाम् । पातयामास धूम्राक्षो मस्तके तु हनूमतः ॥
data.es: And then lifting his mace fixed with many nails, Dhumraksha enraged lighted on Hanuman.
data.anv: अथ and then, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, बहुकण्टकाम् fixed with many nails, तांगदाम् that mace, क्रुद्धस्य enraged, तस्यहनूमतः that Hanuman's, मस्तके head, रोषेण in anger, पातयामास alighted.
data.md: Then Dhūmrākṣa enraged, brought down that mace studded with innumerable pricks, on the head of Hanumān fired with wrath.

data.v: ताडितः स तया तत्र गदया भीमरूपया । स कपिर्मारुतबलस्तं प्रहारमचिन्तयन् । धूम्राक्षस्य शिरो मध्ये गिरिशृङ्गमपातयत् ॥
data.es: That fierce mace fell on Hanuman's head. Hanuman who was equal to wind god without caring for the hit dropped the peak of the mountain on the centre of Dhumraksha's head.
data.anv: तत्र there, भीमवेरूपया of fierce form, तया like that, गदया mace, ताडितः fell, सः he, मारुतबलः equal to WindGod in strength, सःकपिः that monkey, तम् that, प्रहारम् hurt, अचिन्तयन् without caring, धूम्राक्षस्य Dhumraksha's, शिरोमध्ये middle of the head, गिरिशृङ्गम् peak of the mountain, अपातयत् dropped.
data.md: Thus assailed with the mace of fearful impetuosity, the monkey endowed with he mace of fearful impetuosity, the monkey endowed with the strength of the wind without at all heeding that blow, let fall a mountain-top right against Dhumraksa's head.

data.v: स विह्वलितसर्वाङ्गो गिरिशृङ्गेण ताडितः । पपात सहसा भूमौ विकीर्ण इव पर्वतः ॥
data.es: By the falling of the peak of the mountain on Dhumraksha, all his limbs broken to pieces and crushed fell on the ground like a mountain.
data.anv: गिरिशृङ्गेण by the peak of the mountain, ताडितः falling, सः he, विस्फारितसर्वाङ्गः all limbs broken to pieces, सहसा along with, विकीर्णः crushed, पर्वतःइव like a mountain, भूमौ on the ground, पपात fell.
data.md: On being assailed with the mountain-peak, Dhūmrākşa, having his entire body mangled, suddenly fell to the earth, like to a toppling hill.

data.v: धूम्राक्षं निहतं दृष्ट्वा हतशेषा निशाचराः । त्रस्ताः प्रविविशुर्लङ्कां वध्यमानाः प्लवंगमैः ॥
data.es: Those Rakshasas who survived the onslaught, seeing Dhumraksha killed, reentered Lanka out of fear of being killed by Vanaras.
data.anv: हतशेषाः those who survived, निशाचराः night rangers, धूम्राक्षम् Dhumraksha, निहतम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, त्रस्ताः out of fear, प्लवङ्गमैः of Vanaras, वध्यमानाः killed, लङ्काम् into Lanka, प्रविविशुः reentered.
data.md: Seeing Dhūmrākṣa slain, those night-rangers that survived the carnage, in extreme agitation began to pour into Lankā, attacked by the monkeys.

data.v: स तु पवनसुतो निहत्य शत्रुं; क्षतजवहाः सरितश्च संविकीर्य । रिपुवधजनितश्रमो महात्मा; मुदमगमत्कपिभिश्च पूज्यमानः ॥
data.es: The son of wind god, the great soul, having killed the enemy in the battlefield and making the river of blood to flow, was exhausted by killing enemies. The monkeys started worshipping him in joy.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेद्विपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the fifty second sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: महात्मा great soul, सः he, पवनसुतः son of wind god, शत्रुम् enemy, निहत्य killing, क्षतजवहाः in the battlefield, परितश्च made to flow, संनिकीर्य river of blood, रिपुवधजनितश्रमः exhausted by killing the enemies, कपिभिः even the monkeys, सुपूज्यमानः started worshipping, मुदम् in joy, आगमत् felt.
data.md: That high-souled offspring of the Wind-god, having slain his foes, and come under the influence of fatigue incident to his slaughtering his enemies, having caused rivers of gore to flow (in the field), experienced the excess of joy on being honoured of the monkeys.

data.v: धूम्राक्षं निहतं श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । बलाध्यक्षमुवाचेदं कृताञ्जलिमुपस्थितम् ॥
data.es: On hearing about Vajradamshtra being killed by Vali's son, Ravana spoke to the chief of the army who stood with folded hands.
data.anv: रावणः Ravana, वज्रदंष्ट्रम् Vajradamshtra, वालिपुत्रेण by Vali's son, हतम् killed, श्रुत्वा hearing, उपस्थितम् stood, कृताञ्जलिम् with folded hand s, बलाध्यक्षम् chief of army, इदम् this, उवाच spoke.
data.md: Hearing Dhūmrākṣa slain, Rāvana-lord of the Raksasas-overwhelmed with a mighty rage, began to sigh like a serpent.

data.v: शीघ्रं निर्यान्तु दुर्धर्षा राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः । अकम्पनं पुरस्कृत्य सर्वशस्त्रप्रकोविदम् ॥
data.es: "Send for Akampana quickly, who is of terrific valour, difficult to encounter and skilled in all sastras."
data.anv: भीमविक्रमाः of terrific valour, दुर्धर्षाः difficult to encounter, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, सर्वशस्त्रप्रकोविदम् skilled in all sastras, अकम्पनम् Akampana, पुरस्कृत्य send for, शीघ्रम् quickly, निर्यान्तु assign.
data.md: Let invincible Rākşasas of dreadful prowess, march forth, placing before them Akampana, skilled in all weapons and arms.

data.v: ततो नानाप्रहरणा भीमाक्षा भीमदर्शनाः । निष्पेतू राक्षसा मुख्या बलाध्यक्षप्रचोदिताः ॥
data.es: Thereafter taking different weapons, Rakshasas of fearful eyes and terrific appearance rushed forward ordered by CommanderinChief of the army.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, नानाप्रहरणाः different weapons, भीमाक्षाः of fearful eyes, भीमदर्शनाः terrific appearance, मुख्याः commander, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, बलाध्यक्षप्रचोदिताः CommanderinChief of army, निष्पेतुः rushed forward.
data.md: Then equipped with various arms, the foremost of Rākşasas, having dreadful eyes (in their heads, and of dreadful forms, marched forth, urged on by their general.

data.v: रथमास्थाय विपुलं तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः । राकसैः संवृतो घोरैस्तदा निर्यात्यकम्पनः ॥
data.es: Mounted on a huge chariot, Akampana, decked in pure gold jewels, like cloud in form and complexion, whose loud voice resembled thunder, surrounded by Rakshasas went forward.
data.anv: तदा then, मेघाभः like cloud, मेघवर्णश्च of cloud complexion, मेघस्वनमहास्वनः whose loud voice resembled thunder, अकम्पनः Akampana, तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणम् decked in polished gold jewels, विपुलम् huge, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय seated, घोरैः terrific, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, सम्वृतः surrounded, निर्याति went.
data.md: Ascending a large car, adorned with burnished gold, Akampana, possessed of the splendour of clouds,* and cloud-hued, and furnished with a voice resembling the roar of clouds, went out, environed by Rākașasas of terrific forms. *There is a pun here on the word Akampana-lit.one incapable of being shaken.

data.v: न हि कम्पयितुं शक्यः सुरैरपि महामृधे । अकम्पनस्ततस्तेषामादित्य इव तेजसा ॥
data.es: Akampana who, possibly could not be shaken in war by suras shone like the sun in that manner.
data.anv: अकम्पनः Akampana, महामृधे in great war, सुरैरपि even for Suras, कम्पयितुम् could not be shaken, नशक्यःहि not possible, ततः then, तेषाम् in that manner, तेजसा brilliant, आदित्यःइव like Sun.
data.md: Akampana, resembling the sun in power, was incapable of being shaken in fight by the very gods, and of being beheld by them. 1. Possessed of a person measuring, according to the commentator, a mass of clouds. I give the apparent sense, which answers. 2. Monkeys.

data.v: तस्य निधावमानस्य संरब्धस्य युयुत्सया । अकस्माद्दैन्यमागच्छद्धयानां रथवाहिनाम् ॥
data.es: As Akampana was going forth excited to wage war, an expression of desperation developed suddenly in the horses drawing the chariots and an experience of depression in him.
data.anv: तस्य his, युयुत्सया excited, सम्रब्दस्य to wage war, निर्धानमानस्य experienced depression, अकस्मात् suddenly, रथवाहिनाम् dr awing the chariots, हयानाम् horses, दैन्यम् feeling of desperation, अगच्छत् developed
data.md: And as, burning for battle, he rushed out in wrath, the steeds drawing his car suddenly lost their energy.

data.v: व्यस्फुरन्नयनं चास्य सव्यं युद्धाभिनन्दिनः । विवर्णो मुखवर्णश्च गद्गदश्चाभवत्स्वरः ॥
data.es: Himself being a lover of war, became pale with his countenance changed, voice choked, and his eyes lost its lustre.
data.anv: युद्धाभिनन्दनः lover of war, अस्य his, सव्यम् his own, नयनम् eyes, व्यस्फुरत् lustre, मुखवर्णश्च facial colour, विवर्णः pale, स्वनः voice, गद्गदः choked, अभवत् became.
data.md: The left eye of that one delighting in encounter, began to throb. And his continence grew pale, and his voice faltered.

data.v: अभवत्सुदिने चापि दुर्दिने रूक्षमारुतम् । ऊचुः खगा मृगाः सर्वे वाचः क्रूरा भयावहाः ॥
data.es: At a time on a good day of fine weather, it became cloudy, birds and beasts were making frightening cries all over.
data.anv: सुदिने good day, काले at a time, रूक्षमारुतम् fine wea the r, दुर्दिनम् cloudy, अभवत् became, सर्वे all over, खगमृगाः birds and beasts, क्रूराः cruel, भयावहाः frightening, वाचः words, ऊचुः cries.
data.md: In a fair day, it looked foul with the wind breathing roughly. And fierce and frightful beasts and birds began to emit cries.

data.v: स सिंहोपचितस्कन्धः शार्दूलसमविक्रमः । तानुत्पातानचिन्त्यैव निर्जगाम रणाजिरम् ॥
data.es: He whose shoulders were developed like that of a lion, who equalled tiger in valour, went forth not minding the evil portents.
data.anv: सिंहापचितस्कन्धः whose shoulders were like that of a lion, शार्दूलसमविक्रमः equalled tiger in valour, सः he, तान् them, उत्पातान् developed, अविचिन्स्सैव not minding evil portents, रणाजिरम् to battle, निर्जगाम went.
data.md: That lion-shouldered one like a tiger in prowess, without heeding these ominous occurrences, marched forth into the field.

data.v: तदा निर्गच्छतस्तस्य रक्षसः सह राक्षसैः । बभूव सुमहान्नादः क्षोभयन्निव सागरम् ॥
data.es: While that Akampana was going like that along with Rakshasas huge noise that arose was as if the ocean was agitated.
data.anv: तस्यरक्षसः that Rakshasa, राक्षसैःसह along with Rakshasas, तथा like that, निर्गच्छदः going, सागरम् ocean, क्षोभयन्निव agitated,, सुमहान् नादः huge noise, बभूव rose.
data.md: As that Rākşasa was setting out along with the Rākṣasas, he set up mighty roars as if agitating the deep.

data.v: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ता वानराणां महाचमूः । द्रुमशैलप्रहरणा योद्धुं समवतिष्ठत ॥
data.es: Huge troops of Vanaras holding trees and hillocks stood prepared for waging and by that the noise that arose expanded.
data.anv: द्रुमशैलप्रहाराणाम् trees and hillocks in hand, वानराणाम् Vanaras, महाचमूः huge troops, योद्धुम् for the combat, समुपतिष्ठतं stood prepared, तेनशब्देन by that noise, वित्रस्ता expanded.

data.v: तेषां युद्धं महारौद्रं संजज्ञे कपिरक्षसाम् । रामरावणयोरर्थे समभित्यक्तजीविनाम् ॥
data.es: Vanaras and Rakshasas dedicated their lives for Rama and Ravana, respectively in that way were enraged and battle took place.
data.anv: रामरावणयोः Rama and Ravana, समभित्यक्तजीविनाम् dedicated their lives तेषाम् that way, कपिराक्षसाम् Vanaras and Rakshasas, महारौद्रम् enraged, युद्धम् battle, सञ्जज्ञे took place.

data.v: सर्वे ह्यतिबलाः शूराः सर्वे पर्वतसंनिभाः । हरयो राक्षसाश्चैव परस्परजिघंसवः ॥
data.es: Intending to kill one another both Vanaras and Rakshasas who resembled hills, also of extraordinary might and heroic fighting.
data.anv: परस्परजिघासवः intending to kill one another, सर्वे all, हरयः Vanaras, राक्षसाश्चैव even Rakshasas, अतिबलाः of extraordinary might, शूराः warriors, सर्वे all, पर्वतसन्निभाः resembled hills.

data.v: तेषां विनर्दातां शब्दः संयुगेऽतितरस्विनाम् । शुश्रुवे सुमहान्क्रोधादन्योन्यमभिगर्जताम् ॥
data.es: A tremendous sound thundered in that war when they fought with exceeding impetuosity with one another and yelled at each other.
data.anv: विवर्धताम् exceeding, तरस्विनाम् impetuosity, कोपात् furiously, अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिगर्जताम् bawled, तेषाम् in that way, सुमहान् tremendous, शब्दः sound, संयुगे in that war, शुश्रुवे thundered.
data.md: And each side desirous of slaying the other, the monkeys and the Raksasas were exceedingly strong and heroic and like to mountains. And each party storming at the other, in that conflict were heard loud cries emitted by those swiftspeeding ones in anger.

data.v: रजश्चारुणवर्णाभं सुभीममभवद्भृशम् । उद्धूतं हरिरक्षोभिः संरुरोध दिशो दश ॥
data.es: Terrific dust of red colour arose instantly in all the ten directions by the Vanaras, and Rakshasas and it enveloped all over.
data.anv: भृशम् instantly, अरुणवर्णाभम् red coloured, सुभीमम् terrific, रजश्च dust, अभवत् arose, हरिरक्षोभिः Vanaras and Rakshasas, उद्धतम् raised, दश ten, दिशः directions, संरुरोध enveloped.
data.md: And fearful was the dust red-hued that was raised incessantly by the monkeys and the Rākṣasa; and it enveloped the ten cardinal points.

data.v: अन्योन्यं रजसा तेन कौशेयोद्धूतपाण्डुना । संवृतानि च भूतानि ददृशुर्न रणाजिरे ॥
data.es: The combatants could not see one another in the battlefield, and it seemed as though white silk piece was shaken by the wind by the appearance of the surrounding dust.
data.anv: कौशेयोद्धूतपाण्डुना whitish like silk shaken by wind, तेनरजसा by that dust, सम्वृतानि surrounding, भूतानि living beings, रणाजिरे in the battlefield, अन्योन्यम् one another, सददृशुः could not see.
data.md: In the field of battle, each enveloped with that dust raised, pale as silk, could not be discovered by the other.

data.v: न ध्वजो न पताकावा वर्म वा तुरगोऽपि वा । आयुधं स्यन्दनं वापि ददृशे तेन रेणुना ॥
data.es: By the dust raised, the posts, flags, shields and not even horses, weapons and chariots were visible.
data.anv: तेन by that, रेणुना form, ध्वजः posts, नददृशे not visible, पताकावा fags also, न, चर्मवा not shield, तुरगोऽपिवा not horses, आयुधम् not weapons, स्यन्दनोवापि even chariots could not be seen.
data.md: In consequence of that dust arising, neither standard, nor ensign, nor shield, nor steed, nor weapon, nor car could be seen.

data.v: शब्दश्च सुमहांस्तेषां नर्दतामभिधावताम् । श्रूयते तुमुले युद्धे न रूपाणि चकाशिरे ॥
data.es: As they were rushing over one another, terrific noise was heard, and no form was discernible.
data.anv: नर्धताम् rushing, अभिधावताम् one over the other, तेम् their, सुमहां great, तुमुलः terrific, शब्दश्च sound, युद्धे in war, श्रूयते was heard, रूपाणि forms, नचकाशिरे not discernible.
data.md: The fierce cries alone of those roaring and rushing were heard in that dreadful battle; but their forms were not visible to the sight.

data.v: हरीनेव सुसंक्रुद्धा हरयो जघ्नुराहवे । राक्षसाश्चापि रक्षांसि निजघ्नुस्तिमिरे तदा ॥
data.es: Then in that darkness and in anger Vanaras went attacking Vanaras and Rakshasas also attacked Rakshasas (not knowing).
data.anv: तदा then, तिमिरे darkness, आहवे attacked, सुसंरुष्टाः in anger, हरयः Vanaras, हरीनेव Vanaras, जघ्नुः went, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, राक्षसांश्चापि Rakshasas even, निजघ्नुः attacked.
data.md: In that conflict in the dark then monkeys extremely enraged slew monkeys, and Räkşasas also killed the Rākşasas.

data.v: परांश्चैव विनिघ्नन्तः स्वांश्च वानरराक्षसाः । रुधिरार्द्रं तदा चक्रुर्महीं पङ्कानुलेपनाम् ॥
data.es: Not knowing enemies and own people the Vanaras and Rakshasas terminating drenched the mud with their blood and covered the earth.
data.anv: परांश्च enemies, स्वांश्च own people, निघ्नन्तः terminating, ते they, वानरराक्षसाः Vanaras and Rakshasas, तदा then, महीम् great, रुधिरार्द्राम् blood flow, पङ्कानुलेपनाम् covered it with mud, चक्रुः did.
data.md: And monkeys and Rākşasas slaying (indiscriminately) friends and foes, made the earth wet with blood, and miry.

data.v: ततस्तु रुधिरौघेण सिक्तं व्यपगतं रजः । शरीरशवसंकीर्णा बभूव च वसुंधरा ॥
data.es: Then moistened with blood, the dust settled on the ground was seen covered with bodies and limbs.
data.anv: ततः then, रुधिरौघेण moistened with blood, सिक्तम् settled, रजः dust, अपगतम् disappeared, वसुन्धरा earth, शरीरवशसङ्कीर्णा covered with bodies and limbs, बभूव appeared.
data.md: Then with showers of blood the dust was layed; and the earth was covered with corpses.

data.v: द्रुमशक्तिशिलाप्रासैर्गदापरिघतोमरैः । हरयो राक्षसास्तूर्णं जघ्नुरन्योन्यमोजसा ॥
data.es: Then Rakshasas and Vanaras fought one another vigorously with trees, javelins, maces, darts, rocks, and peaks.
data.anv: राक्षसाः Rakshasa, हरयः Vanaras, तूर्णम् rapidly, अन्योन्यम् one another, द्रुमशक्तिगदाप्रासैः trees javelins, maces and darts, शिलापरिघतोमरैः rocks and peaks, ओजसा vigorously, जघ्नुः fought.

data.v: बाहुभिः परिघाकारैर्युध्यन्तः पर्वतोपमाः । हरयो भीमकर्माणो राक्षसाञ्जघ्नुराहवे ॥
data.es: The Vanaras of terrific deeds, like hills in form, resembling iron bars attacked many Rakshasas in the battle.
data.anv: भीमकर्माणः terrific deeds, पर्वतोपमाः hills like, हरयः Vanaras, परिघाकारैः resembling iron bars, बाहुभिः many, युध्यन्तः in battle, आहवे attacked, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, जघ्नुः went on.
data.md: Rākşasas and monkeys fast slew each other vigorously with trees and darts, maces and prasas, rocks, bludgeons and Tomaras, and by means of their arms resembling bludgeons, coped with their adversaries appearing like hills.

data.v: राक्षसाश्चापि संक्रुद्धाः प्रासतोमरपाणयः । कपीन्निजघ्निरे तत्र शस्त्रैः परमदारुणैः ॥
data.es: There, the highly furious Rakshasas also exterminated the Vanaras with their weapons and darts.
data.anv: तत्र there, अभिसङ्क्रुद्धाः highly furious, राक्षसास्तु Rakshasas also, प्रासतोमरपाणयः with clubs and darts, परमदारुणैः very dreadful, शस् त्रैः weapons, कपीन् Vanaras, निजघ्निरे exterminated.
data.md: And in the encounter monkeys slew Rākşasas of dreadful deeds. And in their turn Rākşasas, wrought up with passion, bearing in their hands prāśas and tomaras destroyed monkeys wielding dire arms.

data.v: हरयस्त्वपि रक्षांसि महाद्रुममहाश्मभिः । विदारयन्त्यभिक्रम्य शस्त्राण्याच्छिद्य वीर्यतः ॥
data.es: Even the Vanaras mangled Rakshasas countering with weapons, huge rocks and trees and destroyed them.
data.anv: हरयस्तुअपि even Vanaras, वीर्यतः valiant, शस्त्राणि weapons, आच्छिद्य mangled, अभिक्रम्य countering, महाद्रुममहाश्मभिः huge trees and rocks, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, विदारयन्ति destroyed.
data.md: And the monkeys forcibly snatching away the weapons (of the Rākşasas), began to rive the Rákşasas with mighty trees and giant crags.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरा हरयः कुमुदो नलः । मैन्दश्च परमक्रुद्धश्चक्रुर्वेगमनुत्तमम् ॥
data.es: In the meantime, in the midst Kumuda, Nala, Mainda, heroic vanaras became furious and went
data.anv: एतस्मिन् in the meantime अन्तरे in the midst, कुमुदः Kumuda, नलः Nala, मैन्धश्च Mainda, वीराः heroic, हरयः Vanaras, परमक्रुद्धाः very furious, अनुत्तमम् supreme, वेगम् speed, चक्रुः went.
data.md: In the meanwhile those heroes among the monkeys-Kumuda, Nīla and the exceedingly exasperated Mainda, summoned the utmost impetuosity they were masters of.

data.v: ते तु वृक्षैर्महावेगा राक्षसानां चमूमुखे । कदनं सुमह चक्रुर्लीलया हरियूथपाः ॥
data.es: Great heroes of the Vanara leaders, chiefs of army sportively waged a great battle and crushed Rakshasas repeatedly.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेपञ्चपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the fifty fifth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: महावीराः great heroes, ते they, हरिपुङ्गवाः Vanara leaders, चमूमुखेः chiefs of army, लीलया sportively, वृक्षैः trees, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, सुमहत् very great, कदनम् battle, चक्रुः happened, सर्वे all, वानरागणशः Vanara leaders, भृशम् repeatedly, राक्षसान् Rakshasa, ममन्थुः crushed.
data.md: And those foremost of monkeys and redoubtable able warriors without much ado began to spread quite a carnage in the van of the Rākşasa army, and by means of various arms terribly beat the Rākşasas.

data.v: तद्दृष्ट्वा सुमहत्कर्म कृतं वानरसत्तमैः । क्रोधमाहारयामास युधि तीव्रमकम्पनः ॥
data.es: Observing the great action and accomplishment of the foremost Vanaras in the battle, Akampana exhibited violent anger.
data.anv: अकम्पनः Akampana, युधि in battle, वानरसत्तमैः foremost of Vanaras, कृतम् accomplishment, तत् that, सुमहत् great, कर्म action, दृष्टवा observing, तीव्रम् violent, क्रोधम् angry, आहारयामास exhibiting.
data.md: And witnessing that mighty exploit of the foremost of the monkeys, Akampana waxed furious with wrath.

data.v: क्रोधमूर्छितरूपस्तु ध्नुवन्परमकार्मुकम् । दृष्ट्वा तु कर्म शत्रूणां सारथिं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Looking at the deeds of enemies, deluded with violent anger, Akampana spoke these words holding the bow and looking at the charioteer.
data.anv: शत्रूणाम् by enemies, कर्म deeds, दृष्टवा looking, क्रोधमूर्चितरूपः exhibited violent anger, परमकार्मुकम् highly furious, धून्वन् bow, सारथिम् charioteer, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: And transported with passion, he, twanging his mighty bow seeing that feat of his foe, addressed his charioteer saying.

data.v: तत्रैव तावत्त्वरितं रथं प्रापय सारथे । एतेऽत्र बहवो घ्नन्ति सुबहून्राक्षसान्रणे ॥
data.es: "O Charioteer, quickly drive the chariot to that place where many Rakshasas are destroyed in the battle."
data.anv: सारथे O Charioteer, यत्र there, बहव: many, एते those, रणे in battle, सुबहून् many, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, घ्नन्ति destroyed, त्वरितः quickly, तत्त्रैव to that place, रथम् chariot, प्रापय drive.
data.md: O charioteer, swiftly conduct you the car to that same place. These powerful ones are slaying innumerable Rākşasas in fight.

data.v: एतेऽत्र बलवन्तो हि भीमकायाश्च वानराः । द्रुमशैलप्रहरणास्तिष्ठन्ति प्रमुखे मम ॥
data.es: "Those Vanaras are mighty and terribly angry. They are using trees and hillocks as weapons. Take me where chiefs are standing."
data.anv: बलवन्तः mighty, भीमकोपाश्च terribly angry, एते those, वानराः Vanara, द्रुमशैलप्रहरणाः using trees and hillocks as weapons, अत्र there, मम my, प्रमुखे chiefs, तिष्ठन्तिहि stand.
data.md: And all those vigorous monkeys of dreadful deeds stay before me, armed with trees and rocks.

data.v: एतान्निहन्तुमिच्छामि समरश्लाघिनो ह्यहम् । एतैः प्रमथितं सर्वं दृश्यते राक्षसं बलम् ॥
data.es: "I wish to see the end of Vanaras who boast of their warfare. The entire Rakshasa army is destroyed by them."
data.anv: अहम् I, समरश्लाघिनः boast of their warfare, एतान् them, निहन्तुम् will finish, इच्छामि desire to, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, सर्वम् all, बलम् army, एतैः in the same way, प्रमथिम् end, दृश्यते wish to see.
data.md: Those, pluming themselves overmuch on their martial worth, I intended to slay in battle. And all this Rākşasa force appeared to be harassed by these.

data.v: ततः प्रजविताश्वेन रथेन रथिनां वरः । हरीनभ्यहनत्क्रोधाच्छरजालैरकम्पनः ॥
data.es: Then Akampana seated in the chariot drawn by fast moving horses, assailed the Vanaras with a network of arrows.
