data.es: "He whose eyes are coppery red in anger, who rides on elephant resembles the beating of bells, roars in harsh tone are a great courageous one by the name Mahodara."
data.anv: नवार्कोदितताम्रचक्षुः whose eyes are coppery red in anger, यःअसौ he Oh!, घण्टनिनदप्रणादम् whose trumpeting resembles beating of bells, गजम् elephant, आरुह्य mounted, खरम् harsh, गर्जति roars, महात्मा great, सःएषःवीरः he in that way a courageous one, महोदरोनाम by name Mahodara.
data.md: That high souled hero is named Mahodara that, furnished with right coppery eyes resembling the sun new risen, and ascending a car resonant with the sound of bells, shout shrill.

data.v: योऽसौ हयं काञ्चनचित्रभाण्ड;मारुह्य संध्याभ्रगिरिप्रकाशम् । प्रासं समुद्यम्य मरीचिनद्धं; पिशाच एषाशनितुल्यवेगः ॥
data.es: "He who is mounted on horses decorated with gold shining, like a mountain crowned with cloud, radiant as the Sun holding the shining yokes coming at high speed is by name Pisacha."
data.anv: सन्ध्याभ्रगिरिप्रकाशम् shining like a mountain crowned with cloud, यः he, असौ Oh!, काञ्चनचित्रभाण्डम् decorated with gold jewels, हयम् horses, आरुह्य mounted, मरीचिनद्धम् radiant like the Sun, प्रासम् holding the yoke, समुद्यम्य ascended, एषः in that way, अशनितुल्यवेगः of high speed, पिशाचः Pisacha.
data.md: That one having the vehemence of the thunder-bolt is Pisacha, that, mounted on a steed in variegated golden trappings, and having the aspect of a mass of evening clouds, or a mountain, (appear) with a prāsa furnished with effulgence.

data.v: यश्चैष शूलं निशितं प्रगृह्य; विद्युत्प्रभं किंकरवज्रवेगम् । वृषेन्द्रमास्थाय गिरिप्रकाश;मायाति सोऽसौ त्रिशिरा यशस्वी ॥
data.es: "He who comes firmly shining like lightning, surpassing thunderbolt in speed, seizing a trident, riding a Lordly bull shining like a mountain is the famous Trisira."
data.anv: यःएषः he in that way, निशितम् firmly, विद्युत्प्रभम् shining like lightning, किङ्करवज्रवेगम् surpassing the thunderbolt in speed, शूलम् trident, प्रगृह्य seizing, गिरिप्रकाशम् shining like mountain, वृषेन्द्रम् Lordly bull, आरुह्य riding, आयाति coming, सःअसौ he is, यशस्वी famous, यः he, त्रिशिराः Trisira.
data.md: That one is the famed Trisiras, that grasping a whetted dart endowed with the splendour of lightning and having the speed of the thunder for its minister, approach, riding a bull-the best of his species-and having the appearance of the Moon himself.

data.v: असौ च जीमूतनिकाश रूपः; कुम्भः पृथुव्यूढसुजातवक्षाः । समाहितः पन्नगराजकेतु;र्विस्फारयन्भाति धनुर्विधून्वन् ॥
data.es: "There comes Kumbha whose form is like a cloud in form, whose chest is fleshy and broad. He is fully prepared, coming with a sign of the king of serpents (Vasuki) stretching his bow."
data.anv: जीमूतनिकाशरूपः in the form of cloud, पृथुव्यूढसुजातवक्षाः of fleshy well shaped broad chest, समाहितः fully prepared, पन्नगराजकेतुः with the sign of the king of serpents, असौ he is, कुम्भं Kumbha, धनुः bow, विधून्वन् , विष्पारयन् stretching, याति there comes.
data.md: That one looking like a mass of clouds, that, having a broad and beautiful breast and a banner surmounted with the king of serpents, goes in collected carriage, stretching his bow is Kumbha.

data.v: यश्चैष जाम्बूनदवज्रजुष्टं; दीप्तं सधूमं परिघं प्रगृह्य । आयाति रक्षोबलकेतुभूतः; सोऽसौ निकुम्भोऽद्भुतघोरकर्मा ॥
data.es: "There comes Nikumbha, studded with gold and diamonds, shining and smoky, who is the chief of Rakshasa army seizing an iron club, is capable of wonderful and terrific deeds."
data.anv: यःएषः he in that way, जाम्बूनदवज्रजुष्टम् studded with gold and diamonds, दीप्तम् shining, सधूमम् smoky, परिघम् iron club, प्रगृह्य seizing, आयाति comes, सःअसौ he is, रक्षोबलकेतुभूतः chief of all Rakshasa army, अद्भुतघोरकर्मा capable of wonderful and terrible deeds, निकुम्भः Nikumbha.
data.md: That one is Nikumbha of wondrous valorous deeds (in battle) that, grasping a flaming and smoky bludgeon embellished with gold and diamonds, come-a very banner of the entire Rāksasa host.

data.v: यश्चैष चापासिशरौघजुष्टं; पताकिनं पावकदीप्तरूपम् । रथं समास्थाय विभात्युदग्रो; नरान्तकोऽसौ नगशृङ्गयोधी ॥
data.es: Again, comes Naranthaka, with multitude of swords and arrows, mounted on top of a chariot with flags, blazing like fire, who fights with mountain peaks.
data.anv: चापासिशरौघजुष्टम् with multitude of swords and arrows, पताकिनम् with flags, पावकदीप्तरूपम् blazing like fire, रथम् chariot, समास्थाय mounted on, यःएषः he that way, विभाति glorious, उदग्रः on top, असौ he is, नगशृङ्गयोधी fights with mountain peaks, नरान्तकः Naranthaka.
data.md: That one is Narāntaka, fighting with mountain-peaks, that appear before us, mounted on a car flaming like fire, furnished with pennons and equipped with bows and swords and shafts.

data.v: यश्चैष नानाविधघोररूपै;र्व्याघ्रोष्ट्रनागेन्द्रमृगेन्द्रवक्त्रैः । भूतैर्वृतो भाति विवृत्तनेत्रैः; सोऽसौ सुराणामपि दर्पहन्ता ॥
यत्रैतदिन्दुप्रतिमं विभाति;च्छत्त्रं सितं सूक्ष्मशलाकमग्र्यम् । अत्रैष रक्षोऽधिपतिर्महात्मा; भूतैर्वृतो रुद्र इवावभाति ॥
असौ किरीटी चलकुण्डलास्यो; नागेन्द्रविन्ध्योपमभीमकायः । महेन्द्रवैवस्वतदर्पहन्ता; रक्षोऽधिपः सूर्य इवावभाति ॥
data.es: "There is the king of Rakshasas shining like Sun, whose countenance shines with hanging earrings, of terrible form like the Himalayas and Vindhya, who has humbled the pride of Mahendra and Yama."
data.anv: किरीटी decked with crown, चलकुण्डलास्यः countenance with hanging earrings, नगेन्द्रविन्ध्योपमभीमकायः of terrible form like Himalayas and Vindhya, महेन्द्रवैवस्वतदर्पहन्ता who has humbled the pride of Mahendra and Yama, रक्षोधिपः king of Rakshasas, सूर्यःइव like Sun, अवभाति shining.

data.v: प्रत्युवाच ततो रामो विभीषणमरिंदमम् । अहो दीप्तो महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ॥
data.es: Then Rama the scourge of enemies replied Vibheeshana, "Oh! Ravana! King of Rakshasas is endowed with luminous glory."
data.anv: ततः then, अरिन्दमः scourge of enemies, रामः Rama, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, प्रत्युवाच replied, अहो Oh, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa king, रावणः Ravana, दीप्तमहातेजाः endowed with great luminous glory.

data.v: आदित्य इव दुष्प्रेक्ष्यो रश्मिभिर्भाति रावणः । सुव्यक्तं लक्षये ह्यस्य रूपं तेजःसमावृतम् ॥
data.es: "Ravana blazing like the sun is difficult to gaze even. His shine is spread all over and not perceptible to discern."
data.anv: रावणः Ravana, रश्मिभिः blazing, आदित्यःइव like the Sun, दुष्प्रेक्ष्य difficult to gaze, भाति shining, अस्य his, तेजःसमावृतम् brilliance spread all over, रूपम् form, सुव्यक्तम् to discern, लक्ष्यतेहि not perceptible.
data.md: Then Rāma-repressor of foes-answered Vibhisana, saying, “Alas! Ravana-lord of the Rākşasas-is of exceeding glowing splendour; and Rāvana shine in glory, and is incapable of being gazed at like the Sun himself. And his grace, being enshrouded in his own splendour, I cannot view plainly.

data.v: देवदानववीराणां वपुर्नैवंविधं भवेत् । यादृशं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वपुरेतत्प्रकाशते ॥
data.es: Among the Devas and Danavas such brilliance is not there. He shines so brightly.
data.anv: देवदावनवीराणाम् among the Devas and Danavas, वपुः brilliance, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Ravana's, एतत् such, वपुः brilliance, यादृशम् , प्रकाशते shines, एवंविधम् like this, नभवेत् not brightly.
data.md: The persons of celestials appear splendid as does the person of the Raksasa-chief.

data.v: सर्वे पर्वतसंकाशाः सर्वे पर्वतयोधिनः । सर्वे दीप्तायुधधरा योधश्चास्य महौजसः ॥
data.es: "The great warriors of Ravana fighting in war are like mountains and all fought with mountains and glowing weapons."
data.anv: महोजस: great warriors, अस्य of him, योधाः in war, सर्वे all, पर्वतसङ्काशाः like mountain, सर्वे all, पर्वतयोधिनः fight with mountains, सर्वे all, दीप्तायुधधराः glowing weapons.
data.md: All the warriors of the high-souled one are like mountain and fight with crags; and all are equipped with flaming weapons.

data.v: भाति राक्षसराजोऽसौ प्रदीप्तैर्भीमविक्रमैः । भूतैः परिवृतस्तीक्ष्णैर्देहवद्भिरिवान्तकः ॥
data.es: "The Rakshasa king is surrounded by sharp, furious beings of terrible valour shining like the god of death."
data.anv: प्रदीप्त्तै: shining brilliance, भीमविक्रमैः of terrible valour, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, देहवद्भिः furious forms, परिवृत surrounded by, भूतैः beings, असौ oh, रक्षोराजः Rakshasa king, अन्तकःइव like god of death, भाति shining.
data.md: And environed by glowing ghosts of dreadful forms and fierce-looking and furnished with material tenements the king of Räkşasas appear imposing like the Destroyer himself.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा ततो रामो धनुरादाय वीर्यवान् । लक्ष्मणानुचरस्तस्थौ समुद्धृत्य शरोत्तमम् ॥
data.es: Indomitable Rama having spoken in that manner, followed by Lakshmana got ready and took out an excellent bow and stood.
data.anv: वीर्यवान् indomitable, रामः Rama, एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा having spoken, ततः then, धनुः bow, आदाय taking out, शरोत्तमम् excellent, समुद्धृत्य got ready, लक्ष्मणानुचरः Lakshmana as follower, तस्थौ stood.
data.md: Having said this, Rāma endowed with prowess, eve followed by Laksmana, stood, taking up his bow and pulling out a powerful shaft.

data.v: ततः स रक्षोऽधिपतिर्महात्मा; रक्षांसि तान्याह महाबलानि । द्वारेषु चर्यागृहगोपुरेषु; सुनिर्वृतास्तिष्ठत निर्विशङ्काः ॥
data.es: There upon the great soul, the king of Rakshasas thus spoke to the strong army of Rakshasas, "Fully complacent, free from any apprehension be stationed at the gates and the buildings of the four main streets."
data.anv: ततः thereupon, महात्मा great soul, सः he, रक्षोधिपतिः Rakshasa king, महाबलानि strong army, तानि them, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, आह you, द्वारेषु at gates, चर्यागृहगोपुरेणु buildings on the four main streets, सुनिर्वृताः fully complacent, निर्विशङ्काः free from apprehension, तिष्ठत stationed.
data.md: Then that high-souled lord of Rākşasas addressed that mighty host, saying, "Do you casting off fear stay at ease, at the gateways, high ways, and the edifices (in Lankā).

data.v: विसर्जयित्वा सहसा ततस्ता;न्गतेषु रक्षःसु यथानियोगम् । व्यदारयद्वानरसागरौघं; महाझषः पूर्ममिवार्णवौघम् ॥
data.es: After the counsellors departed from there Ravana pierced through the ocean of Vanaras just as gigantic fish would pierce in the sea.
data.anv: तान् them, सचिवान् counsellors, विसर्जयित्वा sent away, ततः there upon, रक्षःसु Rakshasa, यथानियोगम् as instructed, गतेषु having departed, वानरसागरौघम् ocean of Vanaras, महाझषः gigantic fish, पूर्णम् totally, अर्णवौघम् इव like the war in the ocean, व्यदारयत् pierced through.
data.md: Then leaving those counsellors, (Ravana) on the Raksasa having departed agreeably to his injunction, dived into that ocean of monkeys, like a mighty fish diving into the waves of over brimming deep.

data.v: तमापतन्तं सहसा समीक्ष्य; दीप्तेषुचापं युधि राक्षसेन्द्रम् । महत्समुत्पाट्य महीधराग्रं; दुद्राव रक्षोऽधिपतिं हरीशः ॥
data.es: Watching Ravana advancing suddenly on the battlefield with great speed, Sugriva took a huge mountain top and went towards Rakshasa king.
data.anv: युधि on the battlefield, सहसा speedily, आपतन्तम् advancing suddenly, दीप्तेषुचापम् with radiant bow, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa king, समीक्ष्य watching, हरीशः monkey, महत् great, महीधराग्रम् huge mountain top, समुत्पाट्य lifting up, रक्षोधिपतिम् towards Rakshasa king, दुद्राव went.
data.md: Seeing the lord of Rākşasas, furnished with flaming deep. And seeing the lord of Rākşasas, furnished with flaming a bow and arrows, suddenly rushing, the king of monkeys uprooting a mighty mountain-top, darted against the sovereign of the Rākşasa.

data.v: तच्छैलशृङ्गं बहुवृक्षसानुं; प्रगृह्य चिक्षेप निशाचराय । तमापतन्तं सहसा समीक्ष्य; बिभेद बाणैस्तपनीयपुङ्खैः ॥
data.es: Seizing mountain tops whose slopes were filled with trees Sugriva hurled at the night rangers. Watching this Ravana quickly broke them with his arrows fixed with golden shafts.
data.anv: बहुवृक्षसानुम् whose slopes were crowded with many trees, तत् that, शैलशृङ्गम् mountain top, प्रगृह्य seizing, निशाचराय at night rangers, चिक्षेप hurled, आपतन्तम् towards, तम् him, समीक्ष्य watching, सहसा quickly, तपनीयपुङ्खैः arrows with gold shafts, बाणैः arrows, चिच्छेद broke.
data.md: Taking up that mountain-peak having its sides covered with innumerable trees, he hurled it at the night ranger. And seeing it descend swiftly, (Rāvana) in battle severed the same by means of gold-knobbed shafts.

data.v: तस्मिन्प्रवृद्धोत्तमसानुवृक्षे; शृङ्गे विकीर्णे पतिते पृथिव्याम् । महाहिकल्पं शरमन्तकाभं; समाददे राक्षसलोकनाथः ॥
data.es: After that slope covered with excellent trees had fallen on the ground and broken, Ravana got readied with an arrow as if for arranging destruction like the spirit of death.
data.anv: तस्मिन् in that, प्रवृद्धोत्तमसानुवृक्षे slope covered with excellent trees, शृङ्गे peak, विदीर्णे broken, पृथिव्याम् on the ground, पतिते fallen, राक्षसलोकनाथः king of Rakshasa world, महाहिकल्पम् arranging for destruction, अन्तकाभम् like the spirit of death, शरम् arrow, समादधे got ready.
data.md: On that gigantic peak furnished with fair sides filled with trees, falling to the earth, severed in pieces, the lord of Råkşasas took up an arrow, resembling a mighty serpent and having the splendour of the Destroyer himself.

data.v: स तं गृहीत्वानिलतुल्यवेगं; सविस्फुलिङ्गज्वलनप्रकाशम् । बाणं महेन्द्राशनितुल्यवेगं; चिक्षेप सुग्रीववधाय रुष्टः ॥
data.es: Seizing an arrow which shone like sparks of fire and had the speed of wind, nay vied with thunderbolt of Indra in speed, he (Ravana) released an arrow in anger.
data.anv: रुष्टः angry, सः he, अनिलतुल्यवेगम् like the wind in speed, सविस्फुलिङ्गज्वलनप्रकाशम् shone like sparks of fire, महेन्द्राशनितुल्यवेगम् vied with thunderbolt of Indra in speed, तंबाणम् that arrow, गृहीत्वा seizing, सुग्रीववधाय for the destruction of Sugriva, चिक्षेप released.
data.md: Taking that shaft endowed with the vehemence of the wind, flaming like a fire aglow, and having the impetuosity of the great Indra's thunder-bolt, (Ravana) hurled it in rage to compass the destruction of Sugrīva.

data.v: स सायको रावणबाहुमुक्तः; शक्राशनिप्रख्यवपुः शिताग्रः । सुग्रीवमासाद्य बिभेद वेगा;द्गुहेरिता क्रौचमिवोग्रशक्तिः ॥
data.es: That arrow released from Ravana's arm, which was hard and sharp as the thunderbolt of Indra, pierced Sugriva just as the sharp thorn edged spear of Guha penetrated Krauncha mountain.
data.anv: रावणबाहुमुक्तः released from Ravana's arms, सःसायकः that arrow, शक्रशनिप्रख्यवपुः hard and sharp like Indra's thunderbolt, शिताग्रः sharp thorn edged spear, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, आसाद्य reaching, गुहेरिता like Guha's, उग्रशक्तिः fierce, क्रौञ्चमिव Krauncha like, वेगात् violently, बिभेद pierced.
data.md: Even as the fierce dart discharged by Guha' had pierced Krauñca, that shaft shot by Rāvana, rushing in violence at Sugrīva possessed of a person having the touch of Sakra's thunder-bolt, pierced it.

data.v: स सायकार्तो विपरीतचेताः; कूजन्पृथिव्यां निपपात वीरः । तं प्रेक्ष्य भूमौ पतितं विसंज्मं; नेदुः प्रहृष्टा युधि यातुधानाः ॥
data.es: That hero (Sugriva) hurt by the arrow lost senses and fell on the ground groaning in the battlefield. Seeing that the Rakshasas shouted joyfully overtaken by evil spirits.
data.anv: सःवीरः that hero, सायकार्तः hurt by arrow, विपरीतचेताः lost sense, कूजन् groaning, पृथिव्याम् on the ground, निपपात fell, युधि in battle, विसंज्ञम् sent forth, भूमौ on the ground, पतितम् fallen, तम् they, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, यातुधानाः an evil spirit, प्रहृष्टाः joyfully, नेदुः shouted.
data.md: Thereat, agonised by the shaft, that hero, with his senses bewildered, dropped down to the ground with shrieks. And seeing him down on the earth bereft of his senses, the Yātudhānas were filled with rejoicing.

data.v: ततो गवाक्षो गवयः सुदंष्ट्र;स्तथर्षभो ज्योतिमुखो नलश्च । शैलान्समुद्यम्य विवृद्धकायाः; प्रदुद्रुवुस्तं प्रति राक्षसेन्द्रम् ॥
data.es: Thereafter Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sudamshtra, Rshaba, Jyothimukha and Nala increasing their body size rushed towards the king of Rakshasas.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, सुदंष्ट्र Sudamshtra, अथ and, ऋषभः Rshaba, ज्योतिमुखः Jyothimukha, नलश्च Nala, शैलान् rock, समुत्पाट्य taking mountains, विवृद्धकायाः raising their body size, तम् they, राक्षसेन्द्रंप्रति over the king of Rakshasas, प्रदुद्रुवुः rushed.
data.md: Then Gavaksa and Gavaya, Susena, Rsabha, Jyotimukha and Nala, uprooting crags and magnifying their bodies, rushed against the lord of Raksasas.

data.v: तेषां प्रहारान्स चकार मेघा;न्रक्षोऽधिपो बाणगणैः शिताग्रैः । तान्वानरेन्द्रानपि बाणजालै;र्बिभेद जाम्बूनदचित्रपुङ्खैः ॥
data.es: The Rakshasa Lord made the mountain peaks useless by the hundreds of arrows released by him. The streams of arrows with golden shafts could resist the Rakshasas and strike the Vanara king.
data.anv: सःरक्षोधिपः the Rakshasa Lord, शिताग्रैः mountain peaks, बाणशतैः hundreds of arrows, तेषाम् by that, प्रहारान् released, मोघान् useless, चकार resist, जाम्बूनदचित्रपुङ्खैः arrows with golden shafts, बाणजालैः streams of arrows, तान् them, वानरेन्द्रानपि even Vanara king, बिभेद struck.

data.v: ते वानरेन्द्रास्त्रिदशारिबाणै;र्भिन्ना निपेतुर्भुवि भीमरूपाः । ततस्तु तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रं; प्रच्छादयामास स बाणजालैः ॥
data.es: The Vanara leaders of fierce form torn by the streams of sharp arrows discharged in the three directions fell covering the ground.
data.anv: भीमकायाः fierce form, तेवानरेन्द्राः of that Vanara leaders, त्रिदशारिबाणैः in the three directions, भिन्नाः torn, भुवि ground, निपेतुः fell, ततः that, सः he, बाणजालैः streams of arrows, उग्रम् sharp, तत् वानरसैन्यम् the army of Vanaras, प्रच्छादयामास covered.

data.v: ते वध्यमानाः पतिताग्र्यवीरा; नानद्यमाना भयशल्यविद्धाः । शाखामृगा रावणसायकार्ता; जग्मुः शरण्यं शरणं स्म रामम् ॥
data.es: Those monkeys struck and fallen by the piercing of arrows shrieking went to seek refuge from Rama.
data.anv: वध्यमानाः those struck, पतिताः fallen, नावद्यमानाः shrieking, भयशल्यविद्धाः fear of pain by piercing, प्रवीराः heroes, तेशाखामृगाः the monkeys, रावणसायकार्ताः pressed by Ravana's arrows, शरण्यम् refuge रामम् Rama, शरणंजुग्मुः went to seek refuge.
data.md: On being sore assailed and falling in consequence, those heroes, the monkeys, pierced with terrific arrows, and distressed with the shafts of Rāvana, emitting cries, sought the shelter of Rāma worthy of being sought. Then the high-souled and excellent bowman-Rāma, taking his bow, at once sallied forth. And thereat, Laksmana, approaching Rama, with joined hands addressed him words couching prime import.

data.v: ततो महात्मा स धनुर्धनुष्मा;नादाय रामः सहरा जगाम । तं लक्ष्मणः प्राञ्जलिरभ्युपेत्य; उवाच वाक्यं परमार्थयुक्तम् ॥
data.es: The great soul Rama who was holding a bow went seizing it. Lakshmana approached him immediately with folded hands and addressed Rama with words consonant with truth.
data.anv: ततः that, महात्मा great soul, धनुष्मान् holding bow, सःरामः that Rama, धनुः bow, आदाय taking, सहसा immediately, जगाम went, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तम् him, अभ्युपेत्य addressed, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hand s, परमार्थयुक्तम् consonant with truth, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoken.

data.v: काममार्यः सुपर्याप्तो वधायास्य दुरात्मनः । विधमिष्याम्यहं नीचमनुजानीहि मां विभो ॥
data.es: "I will exterminate the evil minded Ravana. Oh! noble brother, may I be permitted to complete the task"
data.anv: दुरात्मनः evil minded, अस्य his, वधाय destruction, आर्यः noble, सुपर्याप्तःकामम् complete the task, विभो glory, अहम् I, एतम् thus, विधमिष्यामि will exterminate, माम् me, अनुजानीहि I may be permitted.
data.md: O noble one, I alone am fit to compass the destruction of this wicked-minded one. I will slay him. Do you, O master, permit me.

data.v: तमब्रवीन्महातेजा रामः सत्यपराक्रमः । गच्छ यत्नपरश्चापि भव लक्ष्मण संयुगे ॥
data.es: Sri Rama, who was highly energetic and truthful in enthusiasm to succeed, told Lakshmana, "You go and be careful in the battle."
data.anv: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, सत्यपराक्रमः truthful in enthusiasm to succeed, महातेजाः highly energetic, रामः Rama, तम् to him, अब्रवीत् said, गच्छ going, संयुगे in the battle, यत्नपरश्चापि be careful, भव you.
data.md: To him replied Rāma of exceeding energy, having truth for his prowess, “Go then O Lakşmaņa, and put forth your utmost exertions in the encounter.

data.v: रावणो हि महावीर्यो रणेऽद्भुतपराक्रमः । त्रैलोक्येनापि संक्रुद्धो दुष्प्रसह्यो न संशयः ॥
data.es: "Ravana is a great hero in the battlefield. His valour in war is wonderful. He is angry but none can withstand him in the three worlds."
data.anv: रावणः Ravana, महावीर्यंरणे is a great hero in the battle, अद्भुतपराक्रमः wonderful valour, संक्रुद्धः angry, त्रैलोक्येनापि in the three worlds, दुष्प्रसह्यः difficult to resist, संशयः doubt, न not.
data.md: Rāvana is forsooth endowed with mighty energy, and his prowess in battle is wonderful. Without doubt, when enraged, he is incapable of being borne by this triple world.

data.v: तस्य च्छिद्राणि मार्गस्व स्वच्छिद्राणि च गोपय । चक्षुषा धनुषा यत्नाद्रक्षात्मानं समाहितः ॥
data.es: "Remaining alert, apply your arrows in the direction of his arrows. Looking at his arrows carefully, making an effort to protect yourself, set your bow."
data.anv: तस्य his, छिद्राणि arrows, मार्गस्व in the direction of, स्वच्छिद्राणि your arrows, लक्ष्य aim, समाहितः being alert, चक्षुषा your sight, धनुषा bow, यत्ना making effort, आत्मानम् yourself.
data.md: Do you keep an eye on his shortcomings as you should watch your own failings. Being always on the alert, you must with your eyes as much as your bow protect yourself.

data.v: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा संपरिष्वज्य पूज्य च । अभिवाद्य ततो रामं ययौ सौमित्रिराहवम् ॥
data.es: On hearing Raghava's words, son of Sumitra embraced him and offered prayers, paying respects sallied forth for the encounter.
data.anv: सौमित्रिः son of Sumitra, राघवस्य Raghava's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, सपरिष्वज्य embracing, अभिपूज्य offering prayers, तं that, रामम् Rama, अभिवाद्यच paying respects, अहवम् for encounter, ययौ sallied forth.
data.md: Hearing Rāghava's speech, Sumitrā's son, embracing Rāma, and saluting him and paying him his respect, went forth to battle.

data.v: स रावणं वारणहस्तबाहु;र्ददर्श दीप्तोद्यतभीमचापम् । प्रच्छादयन्तं शरवृष्टिजालै;स्तान्वानरान्भिन्नविकीर्णदेहान् ॥
data.es: He saw Ravana, endowed with round shoulders like elephant trunks, with fierce bow glowing and the broken bodies of Vanaras spread all over. Ravana was showering nets of arrows and instigating vanaras.
data.anv: सः he, वारणहस्तबाहुम् endowed with elephant trunk like round shoulders, भीमोद्यतदीप्तचापम् fierce bow glowing, भिन्नविकीर्णदेहान् broken bodies of Vanaras spread over, तान् them, वानरान् Vanaras, शरवृष्टिजालैः showering net of arrows, प्रच्छादयन्तम् instigating, रावणम् Ravana, ददर्श saw.
data.md: And (going to the field), he found Ravana, endowed with arms resembling the trunks of elephants, wielding his dreadful and flaming bow, and covering with showers of arrows those monkeys, whose bodies had been swarming with shafts.

data.v: तमालोक्य महातेजा हनूमान्मारुतात्मजा । निवार्य शरजालानि प्रदुद्राव स रावणम् ॥
data.es: The son of the wind god, Hanuman, a brilliant one seeing Ravana, obstructed the stream of arrows and darted towards him.
data.anv: महातेजाः very brilliant, मारुतात्मजः son of wind god, सः he, हनूमान् Hanuman, तम् him, आलोक्य seeing, शरजालानि stream of arrows, निवार्य obstructing, रावणम् Ravana, प्रदुद्राव darted towards.
data.md: Seeing Răvaņa, the exceedingly powerful Hanuman-son to the Wind-god, resisting that downpour of arrows, charged him vehemently.

data.v: रथं तस्य समासाद्य भुजमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम् । त्रासयन्रावणं धीमान्हनूमान्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Courageous Hanuman seeing the chariot of Ravana lifting his right arm menacing him spoke these words.
data.anv: धीमान् courageous, हनुमान् Hanuman, तस्य his, रथम् chariot, समासाद्य approaching near, दक्षिणम् right, बाहुम् arm, उद्यम्य lifting, त्रासयन् menacing, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: Coming at his car, the intelligent Hanumān, uplifting his right arm and terrifying Rāvana, said.

data.v: देवदानवगन्धर्वा यक्षाश्च सह राक्षसैः । अवध्यत्वात्त्वया भग्ना वानरेभ्यस्तु ते भयम् ॥
data.es: "Your life is surely secure from gods, demons, Gandharvas and Yakshas and Rakshasas but you fear Vanaras."
data.anv: देवदावनगन्धर्वैः gods, demons and Gandharvas, सहराक्षसैः along with Rakshasas, यक्षैश्च Yakshas also, अवश्यंतु surely, त्वया by you, भग्ना death, ते to you, वानरेभ्यस्तु from Vanaras also, भयम् fear.
data.md: Incapable of being slain by gods, Dānavas or Gandharvas, Yaksas or Raksasas, Fear has (at last), found you, coming even from monkeys.

data.v: एष मे दक्षिणो बाहुः पञ्चशाखः समुद्यतः । विधमिष्यति ते देहाद्भूतात्मानं चिरोषितम् ॥
data.es: "I raised this right arm that way with five branches (five fingers) at you that will expel your subtle self (made up of the five subtle elements) from your body."
data.anv: मे I, पञ्चशाखः five branches, एषः that way, समुद्यतः together, दक्षिणःबाहुः right arm, ते to you, देहात् body, चिरोषितम् for long, भूतात्मानम् subtle body, विधमिष्यति will expel.
data.md: This my upraised right arm furnished with five fingers shall rod you of your soul long resident (in your body).

data.v: श्रुत्वा हनूमतो वाक्यं रावणो भीमविक्रमः । संरक्तनयनः क्रोधादिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Having heard Hanuman's words, full of love, Rama replied.
data.anv: रामः Rama, यथावत्:  in that manner, अभिभाषितम् : spoken , हनुमतः by Hanuman, वाक्यम्: words,श्रुत्वा: having heard, प्रीतिसमायुक्तः filled with love, उत्तरम: replied, वाक्यम्: words, अब्रवीत्: said
data.md: Hearing Hanuman's words, Ravana possessed of dreadful prowess, with his eyes reddened in wrath, said these words.

data.v: क्षिप्रं प्रहर निःशङ्कं स्थिरां कीर्तिमवाप्नुहि । ततस्त्वां ज्ञातिविक्रान्तं नाशयिष्यामि वानर ॥
data.es: "O Vanara! Go about without any hesitation. Attain the fame of a Vanara hitting Ravana permanently. Thereafter knowing your prowess, I shall put an end to you."
data.anv: वानर Vanara, निःशङ्कम् without any hesitation, क्षिप्रम् at once, प्रहर go about, स्थिराम् permanent, कीर्तिम् fame, अवाप्नुहि will attain, ततः thereafter, ज्ञातविक्रान्तम् knowing your prowess, त्वाम् you, नाशयिष्यामि shall destroy.
data.md: Strike you swift maugre fear; and acquire lasting renown. And, O monkey, having (at first) taken the measure of your might, will I finish you.

data.v: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा वायुसूनुर्वचोऽब्रवीत् । प्रहृतं हि मया पूर्वमक्षं स्मर सुतं तव ॥
data.es: Having heard Ravana's words, Hanuman said, "Think of your son Akshaya killed by me earlier."
data.anv: रावणस्य Ravana's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, वायुसूनुः son of wind god, वचः words, अब्रवीत् spoke, मया by me, पूर्वम् earlier, प्रहृतम् killed, तवसुतम् your son, अक्षम् Akshaya, तव your.
data.md: Hearing Rāvana's words, the offspring of the Wind-god said, "(First) remember you your sonAkşa-slaughtered by me !"

data.v: एवमुक्तो महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । आजघानानिलसुतं तलेनोरसि वीर्यवान् ॥
data.es: Having spoken that way by Hanuman, the Lord of Rakshasas slapped his hand on Hanuman's chest.
data.anv: एवम् that manner, उक्तः having spoken, महातेजाः highly energetic, वीर्यवान् valiant, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa Lord, रावणः Ravana, अनिलसुतम् son of wind god, तलेन with hand, उरसि on the chest, आजघान slapped.
data.md: Thus addressed, the exceedingly energetic lord of the Rākṣasas possessed of prowess dealt a slap to the offspring of the Wind-god. Struck with his slap, he shook momentarily.

data.v: स तलाभिहतस्तेन चचाल च मुहुर्मुहुः । आजघानाभिसंक्रुद्धस्तलेनैवामरद्विषम् ॥
data.es: Smacked by him (Ravana), Hanuman, a brilliant and intelligent one stood firm for a while and picking up courage, highly enraged struck the enemy of gods with his palm.
data.anv: तेन by him, तलाभिहतः smacked by, सः he (Hanuman), मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, चचालच with hand, तेजस्वी brilliant, महामतिः intellectual, मुहूर्तम् for a minute, स्थित्वा stood firm, स्थैर्यम् picking up courage, अभि very, कृत्वा did, सङ्कृद्धः enraged, तलेनैव with his palm, अमरद्विषम् enemy of gods, आजघान struck.

data.v: ततस्तलेनाभिहतो वानरेण महात्मना । दशग्रीवः समाधूतो यथा भूमिचलेऽचलः ॥
data.es: Thereupon, struck by the great soul, Vanara, the ten headed Ravana was shaken like the earthquake on the mountain together.
data.anv: ततः thereupon, महात्मना great soul, तेनवानरेण by the Vanara, अभिहतः struck, दशग्रीवः ten headed, भूमिचले shaken like an earthquake, अचलःयथा like mountain, समाधूतः shaken together, तते afterwards.
data.md: Hit by the high souled monkey, the Tennecked one trembled, as tremble a mountain during an earthquake.

data.v: संग्रामे तं तथा दृष्ट्व रावणं तलताडितम् । ऋषयो वानराः सिद्धा नेदुर्देवाः सहासुराः ॥
data.es: Ravana hit by hand in that way in a hard manner, the siddhas, demons as well and even Devatas raised their voice.
data.anv: सङ्ग्रामे in that war, तथा that way, तलताडितम् hit by hand, तंरावणम् that Ravana, दृष्टवा hard, ऋषयः sages, वानराः Vanara, सिद्धाः siddhas, असुरैःसह demons as well, देवा Devas, नेदुः shouted.
data.md: Witnessing Răvaņa struck with a slap (by Hanumān saints and Siddhas and celestials and the Asuras shouted in glee.

data.v: अथाश्वस्य महातेजा रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् । साधु वानरवीर्येण श्लाघनीयोऽसि मे रिपुः ॥
data.es: And thereafter, thus spoke extremely energetic Ravana recovering from breath, "Well done vanara. You are courageous and praiseworthy, my enemy!"

data.v: पितृमाहात्म्य संयोगादात्मनश्चापि तेजसा । जानुभ्यामपतद्भूमौ न च प्राणैर्व्ययुज्यत ॥
data.es: By virtue of his father's greatness and his own power, his life did not cease but he fell on the ground.
data.anv: पितृमहात्म्यसंयोगात् by virtue of father's greatness, आत्मनः himself, तेजसाचापि own power, जानुभ्याम् knees, भूमौ to the ground, न्यपतत् fell, तु but, प्राणैः life, नव्ययुज्यत not ceased.
data.md: And by virtue of the greatness of his sire and also of his own energy, he went to the earth on his knees, but was not utterly deprived of life.

data.v: विसंज्ञं वानरं दृष्ट्वा दशग्रीवो रणोत्सुकः । रथेनाम्बुदनादेन सौमित्रिमभिदुद्रुवे ॥
data.es: Finding the vanara unconscious the ten headed Ravana who was eager to fight went towards Saumithri in the chariot making sounds that resembled the sound of rattling of clouds.
data.anv: दशग्रीवः ten headed, वानरम् at the Vanaras, विसंज्ञम् unconscious, दृष्टवा watching, रणोत्सुकः eager to fight, अम्बुदनादेन resembling the rattling sound of cloud, रथेन chariot, सौमित्रिम् to Saumithri, अभिदुद्रुवे went towards.
data.md: Seeing the monkey deprived of his senses, the Ten-necked one, eager for encounter, riding a car emitting a rattle resembling the rumbling of clouds, darted against Sumitra's son.

data.v: तमाह सौमित्रिरदीनसत्त्वो; विस्फारयन्तं धनुरप्रमेयम् । अन्वेहि मामेव निशाचरेन्द्र; न वानरांस्त्वं प्रति योद्धुमर्हसि ॥
data.es: Saumithri who was not depressed in spirit (by Ravana's attack) addressing Ravana who was stretching his bow said "Oh! Lord of night rangers, Be aware. You ought not to fight with vanaras."
data.anv: अदीनसत्त्वः not depressed in spirit, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, अप्रमेयम् immeasurable, धनुः bow, विष्फारयन्तम् stretching, तम् him, आह Oh, निशाचरेन्द्र Lord of night rangers, माम् me, अभ्येहि aware, त्वम् you, वानरान् Vanaras, प्रतियोद्धुम् fighting war, अर्हः you ought not.
data.md: As that one of immeasurable prowess kept stretching his bow. And as that one of immeasurable prowess kept stretching his bow, Sumitrā's son of unflagging mettle, addressed him saying, “O lord of night-rangers, do you today try me in encounter. You ought not to strive with the monkeys."

data.v: स तस्य वाक्यं परिपूर्णघोषं; ज्याशब्दमुग्रं च निशम्य राजा । आसाद्य सौमित्रिमवस्थितं तं; कोपान्वितं वाक्यमुवाच रक्षः ॥
data.es: Hearing the challenging statement of the king of Rakshasas and hearing the vibrating sound, Saumithri standing close by spoke these wrathful words.
data.anv: राजा king, सःरक्षः that Rakshasa, तस्य his, वाक्यम् words, प्रतिपूर्णघोषम् challenging statement, उग्रम् violent, ज्याशब्दम् vibrating sound, निशम्य hearing, उपस्थितम् standing near, तंसौमित्रिम् to Saumithri, आसाद्य reaching near, कोपान्वितम् wrathful, वाचम् words, उवाच spoke.
data.md: Hearing Saumitri's speech uttered in a full voice, as well as the terrific twangs of his bowstring, that Raksasa-the king-approaching Sumitrā son staying in the field, spoke to him wrathfully.

data.v: दिष्ट्यासि मे राघव दृष्टिमार्गं; प्राप्तोऽन्तगामी विपरीतबुद्धिः । अस्मिन्क्षणे यास्यसि मृत्युदेशं; संसाद्यमानो मम बाणजालैः ॥
data.es: "Oh Raghava! You have come under the path of my sight. You are going to meet your end. You who are perverted in mind, struck by a stream of my arrows will reach the abode of death this very moment."
data.anv: राघव Raghava, विपरीतबुद्धिः perverted mind, अन्तगामी reaching the end, दिष्ट्या sight, मे my, दृष्टिमार्गम् my sight, प्राप्तः attained, मम me, बाणजालैः stream of arrows, संसाद्यमानः struck by my arrows, अस्मिन् you, क्षणे this very moment, मृत्युदेशम् abode of death, यास्यसि will go.
data.md: O Raghu's son, by my luck have you of perverse sense, finding your fate come within the range of my ken. This very instant, tormented with the springs of my shafts, you will repair to the regions of Death.

data.v: तमाह सौमित्रिरविस्मयानो; गर्जन्तमुद्वृत्तसिताग्रदंष्ट्रम् । राजन्न गर्जन्ति महाप्रभावा; विकत्थसे पापकृतां वरिष्ठ ॥
data.es: Saumithri, not surprised at the screaming of Ravana with his projected teeth, said, "You are great in sinful action. People of great valour do not display such bluster. Do not shout like that."
data.anv: सौमित्रिः Saumithri, अविस्मयानः not surprised, उद्वृत्तसिताग्रदंष्ट्रम् projected teeth, गर्जन्तम् screaming, तम् you, आह great, पापकृताम् sinful action, वरिष्ठ displaying, राजन् king, विकत्थसे bluster, महाप्रभावाः of great valour, नगर्जन्ति not shout like that.
data.md: Thereat Sumitra's son, without being overwhelmed with wonder (on witnessing Rāvana's prowess), addressed that one furnished with large and sharp teeth, setting up roars, “O king, those who are (really) endowed with prowess, do no storm. O prince of sinners, in vain you vauntest.

data.v: जानामि वीर्यं तव राक्षसेन्द्र; बलं प्रतापं च पराक्रमं च । अवस्थितोऽहं शरचापपाणि;रागच्छ किं मोघविकत्थनेन ॥
data.es: "Your valour, heroism, strength and prowess are known to me. I stand firmly with bow and arrow come on. What is the use of bragging"
data.anv: राक्षसेन्द्र Rakshasa king तव your, वीर्यम् valour, बलम् strength, प्रतापंच and heroism, पराक्रमंच and prowess, जानामि not known to me, अहम् I am, शरचापपाणिः arrow and bow in hand, अवस्थितः stand firmly, आगच्छ come on, मोघविकत्थेन by bragging, किम What.
data.md: O lord of Raksasas, I know your prowess and strength and energy and vigour. Here am I stationed, bow and shafts in hand. Come you. What is the use of vain-glorious self-laudation?

data.v: स एवमुक्तः कुपितः ससर्ज; रक्षोऽधिपः सप्तशरान्सुपुङ्खान् । ताँल्लक्ष्मणः काञ्चनचित्रपुङ्खै;श्चिच्छेद बाणैर्निशिताग्रधारैः ॥
data.es: Lakshmana, having spoken in that manner, the Lord of Rakshasas released seven arrows with beautiful plumes. Lakshmana tore them into pieces with sharp pointed and sharpheaded arrows with gold shafts.
data.anv: एवम् in that manner, उक्तः having said, सःरक्षोधिपः that Lord of Rakshasas, कुपितः angrily, सुपुङ्खान् beautiful plumes, सप्त seven, शरान् arrows, ससर्ज released, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, काञ्चनमित्रपुङ्खैः gold shafted, निशिताग्रधारैः sharp pointed and sharp headed, बाणैः arrows, तान् them, चिच्छेद tore to pieces.
data.md: Thus accosted, the Raksasa monarch, growing wroth, discharged seven shafts furnished with knobs. Thereupon Lakşmaņa split them up with sharp-pointed arrows having variegated golden knobs.

data.v: तान्प्रेक्षमाणः सहसा निकृत्ता;न्निकृत्तभोगानिव पन्नगेन्द्रान् । लङ्केश्वरः क्रोधवशं जगाम; ससर्ज चान्यान्निशितान्पृषत्कान् ॥
data.es: Seeing the arrows cut down with force broken pieces like coils of serpents, the Lord of Lanka overtaken by anger let go another sharp arrow.
data.anv: सहसा with force, निकृत्तान् broken down, निकृत्तभोगान् whose coils have been broken, पन्नगेन्द्रानिव like serpent Lords, तान् them, प्रेक्षमाणः seeing, लङ्केश्वरः Lord of Lanka, क्रोधवशम् overtaken by wrath, जगाम fallen down, अन्यान् other, निशितान् sharp, पृषत्कान् let go.
data.md: They suddenly severed like powerful serpents cut.off, Lanka's lord came under the away of passion, and discharged other whetted arrows.

data.v: स बाणवर्षं तु ववर्ष तीव्रं; रामानुजः कार्मुकसंप्रयुक्तम् । क्षुरार्धचन्द्रोत्तमकर्णिभल्लैः; शरांश्च चिच्छेद न चुक्षुभे च ॥
data.es: The brother of Rama stretched his bow into a circle and showered rain of piercing arrows. He tore the arrows of his enemy with his arrows Kshura, Ardhachandra, karni and Balan without nay, perturbance.
data.anv: सःरामानुजः that Rama's brother, कार्मुसम्प्रयुक्तम् stretching the bow into a round shape, तीव्रम् piercing, बाणवर्षम् rain of arrows, ववर्ष showered, क्षुरार्थचन्द्रोत्तमकर्णिभल्लैः Kshura, Ardhachandra, karni and Balan, शरान् च arrows, चिच्छेद tore, चचुक्षुभेच not perturbed.
data.md: Rāma's younger brother poured showers of arrows from his bow; and, planting himself at his post, cut off those arrows (of his adversary) by means of .razors, and crescents, and excellent karnas and darts.

data.v: स लक्ष्मणश्चाशु शराञ्शिताग्रा;न्महेन्द्रवज्राशनितुल्यवेगान् । संधाय चापे ज्वलनप्रकाशा;न्ससर्ज रक्षोऽधिपतेर्वधाय ॥
data.es: Lakshmana also, who is comparable to Mahendra, fitting his bow and arrows that shone like fire released sharp and pointed arrows to put an end to Rakshasa king.
data.anv: महेन्द्रतुल्यः comparable to Mahendra, सः he, लक्ष्मणश्चापि Lakshmana also, शिताग्रान् sharp pointed, अशनितुल्यवेगान् flying at high speed, ज्वलनप्रकाशान् shining like fire, शरान् arrows, चापे bow, सन्धाय fitting, रक्षोधिपतेः Lord of Rakshasas, वधाय to put an end, ससर्ज loosed.
data.md: Laksmana also, resembling Indra the Great, setting on his bow sharpened, sharp-pointed, flaming, and luminous shafts, endowed with the dreadful vehement impetus of the thunder-bolt, discharged (them) to compass the destruction of the lord of Räkşasa.

data.v: स तान्प्रचिच्छेद हि राक्षसेन्द्र;श्छित्त्वा च ताँल्लक्ष्मणमाजघान । शरेण कालाग्निसमप्रभेण; स्वयम्भुदत्तेन ललाटदेशे ॥
data.es: The Rakshasa king broke into pieces those arrows of Lakshmana and struck him on the forehead with the arrow gifted to him by Brahma, that was bright like the fire at the time of universal destruction.
data.anv: सः he, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, छित्वा broken, तान् those, चतान् arrows, प्रचिच्छेदहि covered, कालाग्निसमप्रभेण bright as the fire at universal destruction, स्वयम्भुदत्तेन given by Brahma, शरेण by arrow, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana's, ललाटदेशे forehead, आजघान struck.
data.md: Thereat the Rākşasa sovereign cut off those whetted arrows; and smote Lakşmaņa in the foreheads with an arrow resembling the Fire of Dooms-day in energy, which had been conferred on him by the Self-create.

data.v: स लक्ष्मणो रावणसायकार्त;श्चचाल चापं शिथिलं प्रगृह्य । पुनश्च संज्ञां प्रतिलभ्य कृच्छ्रा;च्चिच्छेद चापं त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रोः ॥
data.es: Lakshmana hurt by Ravana's dart, shaken up, seizing the bow feebly with great difficulty regaining consciousness tore the bow of the enemy of Indra into pieces in return.
data.anv: सःलक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, रावणसायकार्तः hurt by Ravana's dart, चापम् bow, शिथिलम् feebly, प्रगृह्य seizing, चचाल shaken, पुनःच and again, कृच्छ्रात् with great difficulty, संज्ञाम् regaining consciousness, प्रतिलभ्य back in return, त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रोः enemy of Indra, चापम् dart, चिच्छेद tore to pieces
data.md: Laksmana, tortured with Ravan's arrow, shook, loosely holding his bow; and then recovering his consciousness after undergoing extreme agony he severed the bow of the foe of the foremost of celestials.

data.v: निकृत्तचापं त्रिभिराजघान; बाणैस्तदा दाशरथिः शिताग्रैः । स सायकार्तो विचचाल राजा; कृच्छ्राच्च संज्ञां पुनराससाद ॥
data.es: Then Lakshmana son of Dasaratha, struck the bow of the king into pieces with three sharp and pointed arrows. The king swooned and recovered with great difficulty.
data.anv: दाशरथिः son of Dasaratha, तदा then, निकृत्तचापम् bow cut into pieces, शिताग्रैः sharp and pointed tops, त्रिभिः three, बाणैः arrows, आजघान taking, सःराजा that king, सायकार्तः bow, पुनः again, कृच्छ्रात् with great difficulty, संज्ञाम् swooned, आससादंच and recovered.
data.md: Having cut off Ravana's bow, Dasaratha's son hit (him) with three sharp-pointed arrows. And the king smarting under the shafts, with much ado regained his consciousness.

data.v: स कृत्तचापः शरताडितश्च; स्वेदार्द्रगात्रो रुधिरावसिक्तः । जग्राह शक्तिं समुदग्रशक्तिः; स्वयम्भुदत्तां युधि देवशत्रुः ॥
data.es: Hurt by the arrows, bow cut, bathed in blood, limbs splattered with fat, Ravana the enemy of gods, himself being endowed with formidable energy gifted by the Self born creator seized javelin on the battlefield.
data.anv: कृत्तचापः bow being cut, शरताडितश्च hurt by the arrows, मेदार्द्रगात्रः limbs splattered with fat, रुधिरावसिक्तः bathed in blood, स्वयम् his own, उग्रशक्तिः formidable energy, सः he, देवशत्रुः enemy of god, युधि in the battlefield, स्वयम्भुदत्ताम् gifted by the self born, शक्तिम् javelin जग्राह seized.
data.md: The enemy of the immortals of terrific power with his bow severed, and himself hit with shafts, and his body covered with fat, and himself washed in blood, took up a dart conferred on him by the Self-create.

data.v: स तां विधूमानलसंनिकाशां; वित्रासनीं वानरवाहिनीनाम् । चिक्षेप शक्तिं तरसा ज्वलन्तीं; सौमित्रये राक्षसराष्ट्रनाथः ॥
data.es: The Lord of the world of Rakshasas instantly flung javelin, emitting fire without smoke, on Saumithri, which created fear among Vanaras.
data.anv: राक्षसराष्ट्रनाथः Lord of the world of Rakshasas, सः he, सधूमानलसन्निकाशाम् like fire without smoke, संयति similar, वानराणाम् Vanaras, वित्रासनीम् create fear, ज्वलन्तीम् emitting fire, तांशक्तिम् that javelin, तरसा instantly, सौमित्रये on Saumithri, चिक्षेप flung.
data.md: The sovereign of the Rākşasas and their lord in that encounter hurled at Sumitrā's son the dart resembling smoking fire, sending up living flames, and striking terror into the monkeys.

data.v: तामापतन्तीं भरतानुजोऽस्त्रै;र्जघान बाणैश्च हुताग्निकल्पैः । तथापि सा तस्य विवेश शक्ति;र्भुजान्तरं दाशरथेर्विशालम् ॥
data.es: Lakshmana, the brother of Bharata struck the fierce weapon coming towards him like flames of fire fuelled by ghee, even then it struck him on his broad chest.
data.anv: भरतानुजः Bharata's brother, Lakshmana, अपतन्तीम् coming towards, ताम् that, अस्त्रै: weapon, हुताग्निकल्पैः with shafts like flames of fire fuelled by ghee, बाणैश्च dart, जघान coming, तथापि even so, साशक्तिः that javelin, दाशरथेः Lakshmana, विशालम् broad, भुजान्तरम् chest, विवेश entered.
data.md: As it coursed on, Bharata's younger brother resisted it with arrows resembling a sacrificial flame. Yet the dart pierced into the broad arm of Dasaratha's son.

data.v: शक्त्या ब्राम्या तु सौमित्रिस्ताडितस्तु स्तनान्तरे । विष्णोरचिन्त्यं स्वं भागमात्मानं प्रत्यनुस्मरत् ॥
data.es: Even though Saumithri was wounded in the chest and the power of Brahma entered (into his chest) he recalled himself as an inconceivable form of Vishnu.
data.anv: सौमित्रिः Saumithri, ब्राह्म्या shoulders, शक्त्या by the javelin, स्तनान्तरे in the chest, ताडितास्तु wounded, विष्णोः Vishnu, अचिन्त्यम् inconceivable, स्वम् him, आत्मानम् own self, अनुस्मरत् recalled.
data.md: And hit at his chest by the dart of Brahmā, Sumitrā's son remembered that he was verily a portion of Vişņu himself.

data.v: ततो दानवदर्पघ्नं सौमित्रिं देवकण्टकः । तं पीडयित्वा बाहुभ्यामप्रभुर्लङ्घनेऽभवत् ॥
data.es: Thereafter, Ravana the enemy of Devatas was not capable of lifting Lakshmana's shoulders. Lakshmana could crush the pride of Rakshasas.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, देवकण्टकः enemy of Devatas, तम् him, दानवदर्पघ्नम् pride of Rakshasas, सौमित्रिम् Saumithri, बाहुभ्याम् shoulders, पीडयित्वा capable of crushing, लङ्घने to lift, प्रभुः king, नाभवत् not do.
data.md: Then pressing hard Sumitrā's son-that humbler of the hauteur of the Daityas, that thorn in the sides of the celestials-could not move him (from his place).

data.v: हिमवान्मन्दरो मेरुस्त्रैलोक्यं वा सहामरैः । शक्यं भुजाभ्यामुद्धर्तुं न संख्ये भरतानुजः ॥
data.es: It may be possible to lift Himalayas, Mandara, Meru mountains or even the Devatas of the three worlds but not possible to lift Lakshmana by shoulders.
data.anv: हिमवान् Himalayas, मन्दरः Mandara, मेरुः Meru, सहामरैः Devatas, त्रैलोक्यंवा even the three worlds, भुजाभ्याम् shoulders, उद्धर्तुम् to lift, शक्यम् possible, भरतानुजः Lakshmana, नसङ् ख्यः not possible.
data.md: But he that could with his arms wield Himavan or Mandara or Meru or the triple world itself along with the immortals, could not (for all his strength) lift up Bharata's younger brother.

data.v: अथैनं वैष्णवं भागं मानुषं देहमास्थितम् । विसंज्ञं लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा रावणो विस्मितोऽभवत् ॥
अथ वायुसुतः क्रुद्धो रावणं समभिद्रवत् । आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना ॥
data.es: Then the son of the wind god, enraged, came towards Ravana. Full of anger, he struck him with his thunderbolt like fist on the chest of Ravana.
data.anv: अथ and then, क्रुद्धः angry, वायुसुतः son of wind god, रावणम् Ravana, समभिद्रवत् came towards, क्रुद्धः angry, वज्रकल्पेन by thunderbolt, मुष्टिना fist, उरसि on the chest, आजघान struck.
data.md: Then the Wind-god's offspring waxing wroth rushed at Rāvana, and overwhelmed with rage smote at his chest with his clenched fist resembling the thunderbolt.

data.v: तेन मुष्टिप्रहारेण रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । जानुभ्यामपतद्भूमौ चचाल च पपात च ॥
data.es: By the blow of Hanuman's fist, Ravana the Lord of Rakshasas was shaken and fell on the ground on his knees.
data.anv: तेन by that, मुष्टिप्रहारेण blow of the fist, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa Lord, रावणः Ravana, चचाल shaken, जानुभ्याम् on his knees, भूमौ on the ground, अपतत् च fell.
data.md: And boxed (by Hanumāna), Ravana-lord of the Rākşasas-went down to the ground on his knees, and shook and dropped to the earth.

data.v: विसंज्ञं रावणं दृष्ट्वा समरे भीमविक्रमम् । ऋषयो वानराश्चैव नेदुर्देवाः सवासवाः ॥
data.es: Ravana of fierce valour having lost senses and waking up from unconscious state, perturbed, did not know where he was. Seeing this the sages, even Vanaras, the demons as well as Devatas shouted in joy.
data.anv: विसंज्ञः lost senses, मूर्छितश्च unconscious, आसीन्न perturbed, स्थानम् location, नचसमालभत् not knowing, समरे in the combat, भीमविक्रमम् fierce valour, रावणम् Ravana, दृष्टवा seeing, ऋषयः sages, वानराश्चैव Vanaras also, सवासवाःसह demons also, देवाश्चैव even Devatas, नेदुः shouted in joy.
data.md: Witnessing Răvaņa struck with a slap (by Hanumān saints and Siddhas and celestials and the Asuras shouted in glee.

data.v: हनूमानपि तेजस्वी लक्ष्मणं रावणार्दितम् । अनयद्राघवाभ्याशं बाहुभ्यां परिगृह्य तम् ॥
data.es: Brilliant Hanuman holding Lakshmana wounded by Ravana in both shoulders brought him to Rama.
data.anv: अथ and, तेजस्वी brilliant, हनूमानपि Hanuman, रावणार्धितम् wounded by Ravana, तंलक्ष्मणम् that Lakshmana, बाहुभ्याम् both shoulders, परिगृह्य holding, राघूभ्याशम् near Rama, आनयत् brought.
data.md: Then energetic Hanumān taking Lakşmaņa racked by Rävaņa, with his arms brought him before Rāghava. And albeit incapable of being moved by the foes, (Laksmana), on account of the friendship of the Wind-god's offspring as well as the high reverence in which he was held by Hanumān, became extremely light to the monkey.

data.v: वायुसूनोः सुहृत्त्वेन भक्त्या परमया च सः । शत्रूणामप्रकम्प्योऽपि लघुत्वमगमत्कपेः ॥
data.es: Lakshmana though unshakeable for enemies, became light for the son of wind god by his friendship and high devotion.
data.anv: सः he, शत्रूणाम् for the enemies, अप्रकम्पःअपि unshakeable by enemies, वायुसूनोः son of wind god, सुहृत्त्वेन friend, परमया highly, भक्त्याच being devoted, कपेः monkey, लघुत्वम् became light, आगमत् became.
data.md: Then energetic Hanumān taking Lakşmaņa racked by Rävaņa, with his arms brought him before Rāghava. And albeit incapable of being moved by the foes, (Laksmana), on account of the friendship of the Wind-god's offspring as well as the high reverence in which he was held by Hanumān, became extremely light to the monkey.

data.v: तं समुत्सृज्य सा शक्तिः सौमित्रिं युधि दुर्जयम् । रावणस्य रथे तस्मिन्स्थानं पुनरुपागमत् ॥
data.es: That power returned back to Ravana's chariot to its position, leaving Lakshmana, who was difficult to vanquish.
data.anv: साशक्तिः that power, युधि in war, दुर्जयम् vanquish, सौमित्रिम् Saumithri, रावणस्य Ravana's, तस्मिन् रथे in his chariot, पुनः again, स्थानम् position, उपागता returning back.
data.md: Then that dart, renouncing Sumitra's son vanquished in fight, again sought its place in Ravana's car.

data.v: रावणोऽपि महातेजाः प्राप्य संज्ञां महाहवे । आददे निशितान्बाणाञ्जग्राह च महद्धनुः ॥
data.es: Ravana of mighty prowess waking up from consciousness took over his sharp arrows and the great bow also.
data.anv: महातेजाः of mighty prowess, रावणोऽपि Ravana too, महाहवे huge combat संज्ञाम् waking up, प्राप्य endured, निशितान् sharp, बाणान् arrows, आददे, महत् great, धनुःच bow also, आददे took over.
data.md: The exceedingly powerful Răvaņa recovering his consciousness in the dread encounter, took up whetted shafts and seized a mighty bow.

data.v: आश्वस्तश्च विशल्यश्च लक्ष्मणः शत्रुसूदनः । विष्णोर्भागममीमांस्यमात्मानं प्रत्यनुस्मरन् ॥
data.es: Lakshmana who could destroy foes, recovering from unconsciousness, relieved of wounds again remembered himself to be part of Vishnu of immeasurable power.
data.anv: शत्रुसूदनः could destroy foes, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अमीमांस्यम् immeasurable, विष्णोःभागम् part of Vishnu, आत्मानम् himself, प्रत्यनुस्मरन् again remembering, आश्वस्तःच from consciousness, विशल्यःच relieved of wounds.
data.md: That finisher of foes-Lakşmaņa-recovered the exercise of his senses, and had his entire person perfectly healed, on his recalling that he verily was a part and parcel of Vişņu himself.

data.v: निपातितमहावीरां वानराणां महाचमूम् । राघवस्तु रणे दृष्ट्वा रावणं समभिद्रवत् ॥
data.es: Raghava also assailed Ravana seeing the fallen Vanara heroes struck in the combat.
data.anv: राघवस्तु Raghava also, रणे in the combat, निपातितमहावीराम् fallen heroes, द्रवन्तीम् struck down, वानरीम् Vanaras, चमूम् leaders, दृष्टवा seeing, रावणम् Ravana, समभिद्रवत् assailed.
data.md: Witnessing the mighty army of the monkeys and the redoubted heroes brought down in the conflict, Rāghava rushed at Ravana.

data.v: अथैनमुपसंगम्य हनूमान्वाक्यमब्रवीत् । मम पृष्ठं समारुह्य रक्षसं शास्तुमर्हसि ॥
data.es: And then Hanuman submitted to Rama, "Just as Lord Vishnu mounted on mighty Garuda, you should also be mounted on my back and subdue Ravana."
data.anv: अथ and then, हनूमान् Hanuman, एनम् , उपसङ्गम्य submitted, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, विष्णुः Vishnu, गरुत्मन्तम् Garuda, बलवंन्तं mighty, समाहितः mounted, यथा so also, मम my, पृष्ठम् back, समारुह्य mounting, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, शास्तुम् subdue, अर्हसि ought to.
data.md: Thereat drawing near to him, Hanuman said to him, "It behove you to chastise the foe ascending my back, even as Vişņu chastise the enemies of the immortals, riding Garutmān."

data.v: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवो वाक्यं वायुपुत्रेण भाषितम् । आरोहत्सहसा शूरो हनूमन्तं महाकपिम् । रथस्थं रावणं संख्ये ददर्श मनुजाधिपः ॥
data.es: On hearing the sub mission of Hanuman, Sri Rama, the Lord of humans climbed on the great monkey and saw Ravana on the chariot.
data.anv: राघवः Raghava, वायुपुत्रेण to the son of wind god, भाषितम् spoken, तत् those, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, आरुरोहमहाशूरं climbed on the hero, महाकपिम् great monkey, बलवन्तम् strong, आरुरोह on climbing, मनुजाधिपः Lord of humans, सङ् ख्ये in war, रथस्थम् on the chariot, रावणम् Ravana, ददर्श saw.
data.md: Hearing the words spoken by Hanumān, Rāghava at once got up on that gigantic monkey; and that master of men beheld Rāvana in battle.

data.v: तमालोक्य महातेजाः प्रदुद्राव स राघवः । वैरोचनमिव क्रुद्धो विष्णुरभ्युद्यतायुधः ॥
data.es: Beholding Ravana, highly energetic Rama wielding his bow went furiously towards him just as Lord Vishnu went with his discuss against Virochana.
data.anv: महातेजाः highly energetic, सः he, तम् him, आलोक्य beheld, क्रुद्धः furious, अभ्युद्यतायुधः rushed towards, विष्णुः Vishnu, वैरोचनिव like Virochana, राघवः Raghava, प्रदुद्राव wielding bow.
data.md: Seeing him, that highly powerful one darted against Rāvaņa, even as the enraged Vişnu had rushed against Virocana's son, upraising his weapons.

data.v: ज्याशब्दमकरोत्तीव्रं वज्रनिष्पेषनिस्वनम् । गिरा गम्भीरया रामो राक्षसेन्द्रमुवाच ह ॥
data.es: Rama created a sound like a clap of thunder ringing intensely, a majestic one and spoke in a deep voice to the king.
data.anv: रामः Rama, वज्रनिष्पेषनिस्वनम् like the clap of thunder sound, तीव्रम् intense, ज्याशब्दम् echoing the sound, अकरोत् caused, गम्भीरया majestic, गिरा in deep voice, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa king, उवाचह spoke.
data.md: He sharply twanged his bow-string sounding like the terrific crash of thunder, and then in solemn tones, Rāma addressed the lord of Răks asas, Saying.

data.v: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ मम त्वं हि कृत्वा विप्रियमीदृशम् । क्व नु राक्षसशार्दूल गतो मोक्षमवाप्स्यसि ॥
data.es: "Oh! Tiger among Rakshasas, forbear, forbear. Having done such an offence to me, where are you going for deliverance"
data.anv: राक्षसशार्दूल tiger among Rakshasas, तिष्ठतिष्ठ forbear, त्वम् you, मम to me, ईदृशम् such, विप्रियम् delivered, कृत्वा having done, क्वनु where, गत्वा going, मोक्षम् deliverance, अवाप्स्यसि after the offence.
data.md: Stay, stay, having done me such wrong. Repairing whither, shall you, O powerful Raksasa, attain respite?

data.v: यदीन्द्रवैवस्वत भास्करान्वा; स्वयम्भुवैश्वानरशंकरान्वा । गमिष्यसि त्वं दश वा दिशो वा; तथापि मे नाद्य गतो विमोक्ष्यसे ॥
data.es: "If you go to Indra or Yama or Sun God or the selfborn Brahma or fire God or Shankara or the ten directions like that, and if you run in front of me you cannot escape."
data.anv: इन्द्रवैवस्वतभास्करान्वा either to Indra, or Yama or sun god, स्वयम्भुवैश्वानरशंकरान्वा to selfborn Brahma or to fire god or Shankara, दशवा ten, दिशोवा directions, त्वम् you, गमिष्यसियदि even if you run, तथापि like that, अद्य front, मे of me, गतः gone, नविमोक्ष्यसे not escape.
data.md: Even if you should seek Yama or Indra or the Sun-son to Vivaśvăn-or the Self-sprung or the Fire-god or Sankara himself, or go to the ten cardinal points in ten portions, yet shall you not, so resorting attain deliverance.

data.v: यश्चैष शक्त्याभिहतस्त्वयाद्य; इच्छन्विषादं सहसाभ्युपेतः । स एष रक्षोगणराज मृत्युः; सपुत्रदारस्य तवाद्य युद्धे ॥
data.es: "Oh! king of Rakshasa troop! He, who was struck without support now, even if he were to come now in front, you with your sons and grandsons will be struck to death by him."
data.anv: रक्षोगणराज king of Rakshasa troop, अद्य in front, यःएषः he who like that, त्वया by you, शक्त्या support, अभिहतः struck now, विषादम् sorrow, इच्छन् , सःएव he himself, सहसा now, अभ्युपेत्य come, अद्य in front, युद्धे to combat, सपुत्रपौत्रस्य sons and grandsons, तव your, मृत्युः death.
data.md: And (Laksmana), going forth to the fight, has been wounded with the dart and has suddenly been stupefied. But, o king of the Rākşasa today in conflict Death shall claim for his own you and your sons and grandsons.

data.v: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो महाकपिम् । आजघान शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः कालानलशिखोपमैः ॥
data.es: On hearing Raghava's words, the mighty strong king of Rakshasas seized with violent anger, recalling earlier enmity, struck with blazing arrows like tongues of fire at the time of universal destruction while Hanuman bore Rama.
data.anv: महाबलः mighty strong, राक्षसेन्द्रः Lord of Rakshasas, राघवस्य Raghava's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, महता violent, रोषेण anger, आविष्टः seized with, पूर्ववैरम् earlier enmity, अनुस्मरन् recalling, रणे in combat, राघवम् Raghava, वहन्तम् struck, महावेगम् at high speed, वायुपुत्रम् son of wind god, कालानलशिखोपमैः like tongues of fire at universal destruction, दीप्स्सैः blazing, शरैः darts, आजघान discharged.
data.md: Hearing Rāghava's words, the exceedingly strong lord of the Rākşasas, overwhelmed with a mighty wrath, recalling enmity a gone, with burning shafts resembling the fire of Doom hit in encounter the exceedingly impetuous offspring of the Wind-god, who was bearing Rāghava.

data.v: राक्षसेनाहवे तस्य ताडितस्यापि सायकैः । स्वभावतेजोयुक्तस्य भूयस्तेजो व्यवर्धत ॥
data.es: Even though Hanuman was hurt by the arrows discharged by the Rakshasa king, being endowed with energy by nature, his energy went on increasing.
data.anv: राक्षसेन by the Rakshasa, आहवे discharged, सायकैः arrows, ताडितस्यापि when hurt him also, स्वभावतेजोयुक्तस्य by nature endowed with energy, तस्य his, तेजः energy, भूयः exceedingly, अभ्यवर्धत went on increasing.
data.md: Although struck and resisted by the Rākşasa with arrows, the energy of that one, endowed by nature with prowess-increased greatly.

data.v: ततो रामो महातेजा रावणेन कृतव्रणम् । दृष्ट्वा प्लवगशार्दूलं क्रोधस्य वशमेयिवान् ॥
data.es: Seeing the wounds caused by Ravana to Hanuman, the tiger among monkeys, possibly Rama was seized with anger.
data.anv: ततः then, महातेजाः of extraordinary energy, रामः Rama, रावणेन Ravana, कृतव्रणम् wounds caused, प्लवगशार्दूलम् tiger among monkeys, दृष्टवा seeing, क्रोधस्य in anger, वशम् seized, एयिवान् possibly.
data.md: The exceedingly energetic Rāma, on seeing that foremost of the monkeys wounded by Ravana, was mastered by wrath.

data.v: तस्याभिसंक्रम्य रथं सचक्रं; साश्वध्वजच्छत्रमहापताकम् । ससारथिं साशनिशूलखड्गं; रामः प्रचिच्छेद शरैः सुपुङ्खैः ॥
data.es: Advancing towards him, (Ravana), Rama tore into pieces his chariot, wheels, horses, standard and canopy including the charioteer and the darts and swords.
data.anv: रामः Rama, अभिसङ्क्रम्य advancing forward, तस्य his, सचक्रम् the wheel of chariot, साश्वध्वजच्छत्रमहापताकम् horses, standard, canopy, ससारथिम् the charioteer, साशनिशूलखडगम् tridents and weapons, रथम् chariot, शरैः darts, पुङ्खैः swords, प्रचिच्छेद tore into pieces.
data.md: Rāma, closing with his enemy, by means of whetted arrow-points severed in pieces his car together with the wheels and the steeds, the banner, the umbrella, and the majestic streamer, as well as with the charioteers and the thunderbolts and darts and swords.

data.v: अथेन्द्रशत्रुं तरसा जघान; बाणेन वज्राशनिसंनिभेन । भुजान्तरे व्यूढसुजातरूपे; वज्रेण मेरुं भगवानिवेन्द्रः ॥
data.es: Then with a shining thunderbolt like arrows Rama struck with the weapon of Indra into the fine chest in between the shoulders just as Indra would strike the Meru Mountain with his thunderbolt.
data.anv: अथ and, वज्राशनिसन्निभेन resembling thunderbolt in shining, बाणेन arrows, इन्द्रशत्रुम् weapon of Indra, तरसा sharp, व्यूढसुजातरूपे broad fine looking chest,भुजान्तरे in between the shoulders, भगवान् divine, इन्द्रः Indra, वज्रेण with thunderbolt, मेरुम् इव like the Meru mountain, जघान struck.
data.md: Then as the reverend Indra cleave Meru with his thunder-bolt, (Raghava) swiftly smote on Rāvaņa's spacious and shapely chest with a shaft resembling Vajra and the thunderbolt.

data.v: यो वज्रपाताशनिसंनिपाता;न्न चुक्षुभे नापि चचाल राजा । स रामबाणाभिहतो भृशार्त;श्चचाल चापं च मुमोच वीरः ॥
data.es: He, that heroic king, who was not disturbed hurt by thunderbolt of lightning, was agonized when struck by Rama's arrow and let his bow fall.
data.anv: यः he, राजा king, वज्रपाताशनिसन्निपातात् one who is not disturbed hit by thunderbolt or by lightning, नचुक्षुभे not disturbed, नापिचचाल arrow, सः he, वीरः hero, रामबाणाभिहतः struck by Rama's arrow, भृशार्तः reeled, चचाल agonized, चापंच bow also, मुमोच let go.
data.md: That the king hero-who had not smarted nor shaken under the impetus of Vajra and the thunder-bolt, assailed with the arrows of Răma and agonised in consequence, shock and lost hold of his bow.

data.v: तं विह्वलन्तं प्रसमीक्ष्य रामः; समाददे दीप्तमथार्धचन्द्रम् । तेनार्कवर्णं सहसा किरीटं; चिच्छेद रक्षोऽधिपतेर्महात्माः ॥
data.es: Seeing Ravana swooning, great soul Rama took up a crescent shaped arrow and hastily broke his crown into pieces which were shining bright red like the Sun.
data.anv: रामः Rama, विह्वलन्तम् swooning, तम् him, प्रसमीक्ष्य seeing, अथ then, दीप्तम् flaming, अर्थचन्द्रम् crescent shaped, समाददे took up, तेन by that, महात्मा great soul, सहसा hastily, अर्कवर्णम् red like sun, किरीटम् crown, चिच्छेद broke into pieces.
data.md: Seeing him overwhelmed, Ráma took up a flaming half-moon and with the same at once severed the sun-bright tiara of the high-souled sovereign of the Rākşasas.

data.v: तं निर्विषाशीविषसंनिकाशं; शान्तार्चिषं सूर्यमिवाप्रकाशम् । गतश्रियं कृत्तकिरीटकूट;मुवाच रामो युधि राक्षसेन्द्रम् ॥
data.es: Rama said to the king of Rakshasas, who was like a serpent rid of poison without (head) crown, without splendour like the Sun without brightness, his glory lost with the crown broken in the combat.
data.anv: रामः Rama, युधि in combat, निर्विषाशीविषसन्निकाशम् resembling a serpent rid of poison without his crown, शान्तार्चिषम् without splendour, सूर्यमिव like sun, अप्रकाशम् without brightness, गतश्रियम् glory lost, कृत्तकिरीटकूटम् crown being torn, तंराक्षसेन्द्रम् that king of Rakshasas, उवाच said.
data.md: Rāma in the encounter addressed the lord of Rākşasas, resembling a serpent bereft of venom, shorn of his splendour, like to the sun shrouded (in mist), without his wonted grace, and having his entire tiara riven-saying.

data.v: कृतं त्वया कर्म महत्सुभीमं; हतप्रवीरश्च कृतस्त्वयाहम् । तस्मात्परिश्रान्त इति व्यवस्य; न त्वं शरैर्मृत्युवशं नयामि ॥
data.es: A great task of killing mighty heroes has been accomplished by you. Therefore, you are exhausted. I declare that I will not send you to death.
data.anv: त्वया by you, सुभीमम् exceedingly difficult, महत् great, कर्म task, कृतम् done, त्वया by you, अहम् I, हतप्रवीरः mighty heroes killed, कृतःच done, तस्मात् therefore, परिशान्तःइति exhausted, व्यवस्य declare, त्वाम् you, मृत्युवशम् to death, ननयामि not sent.
data.md: You have in battle) performed high and dreadful deeds, and have also (in-the conflict) slain my foremost heroes. And therefore I know you are fatigued. And for this reason it is that I will not with my shafts bring you to the door of Death.

data.v: स एवमुक्तो हतदर्पहर्षो; निकृत्तचापः स हताश्वसूतः । शरार्दितः कृत्तमहाकिरीटो; विवेश लङ्कां सहसा स्म राजा ॥
data.es: Rama having spoken in that way (consoling), the king with his vanity and pride crushed, bow broken into pieces, horses and charioteer killed, wounded by arrows, crown broken entered Lanka hastily.
data.anv: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, सः by him, हतदर्पहर्षः vanity and joy crushed, निकृत्तचापः bow broken into pieces, हताश्वसूतः horses and charioteer killed, शरार्धितः wounded by arrows, कृत्तमहाकिरीटः crown broken, सःराजा that king, सहसा hastily, लङ्काम् Lanka, विवेश entered.
data.md: Thus addressed, the king, with his pride and joy defeated, with his bow severed, and his steeds and charioteer killed himself smarting under. shafts, and having his crown splintered, speedily entered Lankā.

data.v: तस्मिन्प्रविष्टे रजनीचरेन्द्रे; महाबले दानवदेवशत्रौ । हरीन्विशल्यान्सहलक्ष्मणेन; चकार रामः परमाहवाग्रे ॥
data.es: After the king of prowlers, the enemy of Danavas and Devas entered Lanka, Rama and Lakshmana also drew out the arrows from monkeys in the forefront of the battlefield and went.
data.anv: महाबले endowed with great prowess, दानवदेवशत्रौ enemy of Danavas and Devas, तस्मिन् his, रजनीचरेन्द्रे king night prowlers, प्रविष्टे entering, रामः Rama, परमाहवाग्रे in the forefront, लक्ष्मणेनसह with Lakshmana, हरीन् monkeys ', विशल्यान् removed, चकार went.
data.md: On that foe of the deities and the Dănavas-the puissant lord of the night-rangers-entering (into Lankā), Rāma rendered the monkeys along with Lakşmaņa hale in that fierce conflict.

data.v: तस्मिन्प्रभग्ने त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रौ; सुरासुरा भूतगणा दिशश्च । ससागराः सर्षिमहोरगाश्च; तथैव भूम्यम्बुचराश्च हृष्टाः ॥
data.es: The enemy of Indra having been routed, the suras and asuras, the guardians of the four quarters, including the sea, the large serpents, and sages so also the creatures of land and water were joyful.॥इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the fifty ninth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रौ enemy of Indra, तस्मिन् his, प्रभन्ने having been routed, सुरासुराः suras and Asuras, भूतगणाः guardians, दिशश्च of four quarters, हसागराः including sea, सर्षिमहोरगाःच including the sages and serpents, तथैव so also, भूम्यम्बुचराः creatures of land and water, प्रहृष्टाः joyful.
data.md: At the break-down of that foe of the immortals, the celestials and the Asuras, the ghosts and the Cardinal points, and all the mighty serpents together with the oceans and the creatures inhabiting earth and water, felt exceedingly delighted.

data.v: स प्रविश्य पुरीं लङ्कां रामबाणभयार्दितः । भग्नदर्पस्तदा राजा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रियः ॥
data.es: Then the king of Lanka after entering the city of Lanka, felt humiliated by Rama's arrow, vanity crushed and had lost control over his senses.
data.anv: तदा then, सः he, राजा king, लङ्कांपुरीम् Lanka, प्रविश्य entered, रामबाणभयार्धितः fearing the arrow of Rama, भग्नदर्पः vanity crushed, व्यथितेन्द्रियः lost control over senses, बभूव felt.
data.md: Entering the city of Larkā, the king afflicted with the fear of Rāma's arrows, with his pride humbled, was undergoing great torments:

data.v: मातंग इव सिंहेन गरुडेनेव पन्नगः । अभिभूतोऽभवद्राजा राघवेण महात्मना ॥
data.es: Overcome by humiliation from the high souled Rama, Ravana remained like an elephant rejected by a lion and a serpent rejected by Garuda.
data.anv: राजा king, सिंहेन lion, मातङ्गःइव like an elephant, गरुडेन by Garuda, पन्नगइव like a serpent, महात्मना high souled, राघवेण at Rama, अभिभूतः humiliated, अभवत् remained.
data.md: Overpowered by the high souled Rāghava, the king resembled an elephant defeated by a lion or a serpent defeated by Garuda.

data.v: ब्रह्मदण्डप्रकाशानां विद्युत्सदृशवर्चसाम् । स्मरन्राघवबाणानां विव्यथे राक्षसेश्वरः ॥
data.es: The Lord of Rakshasas remained disquieted recalling the arrows of Rama which emitted light like lightning, resembling Brahmadanda.
data.anv: राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, ब्रह्मदण्डप्रतीकानाम् resembling Brahmadanda (A comet seen at the time of dissolution), विद्युत्सदृशवर्चसाम् emitted an unsteady light like lightning, राघवमाणानम् Rama on his part, स्मरन् recalling, विव्यथे disquieted.
data.md: Remembering Råghava's arrows resembling a comet risen at the universal wreck, and of the splendour of live lightning, the Raksasa chief was aggrieved.

data.v: स काञ्चनमयं दिव्यमाश्रित्य परमासनम् । विक्प्रेक्षमाणो रक्षांसि रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Ravana seated on the wonderful golden magnificent throne gazing at Rakshasas spoke these words.
data.anv: सःरावणः Ravana, काञ्चनमयम् golden, दिव्यम् wonderful, परमासनम् magnificent, आश्रित्य seated, रक्षांसि at Rakshasas, विप्रेक्षमाणः gazing at, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: Rāma, seated on a superb golden seat and eyeing the Raksasas, spoke this word.

data.v: सर्वं तत्खलु मे मोघं यत्तप्तं परमं तपः । यत्समानो महेन्द्रेण मानुषेणास्मि निर्जितः ॥
data.es: " All the penance which I have done, and the asceticism practised by me equal to Mahendra has become purposeless and defeated."
data.anv: रमम् Rama, यत् that which, तपः penance, तप्तम् asceticism, मे my, तत् सर्वम् all that, मोघंखलु purposeless, यत् that which, महेन्द्रेण by Mahendra, समानः equal to, मानुषेण human, िर्जितः defeated.
data.md: Forsooth all the austere asceticism I have performed go go for nothing, for although resembling the redoubtable Indra, I have been overcome by a mortal.

data.v: इदं तद्ब्रह्मणो घोरं वाक्यं मामभ्युपस्थितम् । मानुषेभ्यो विजानीहि भयं त्वमिति तत्तथा ॥
data.es: The dreadful words of Brahma spoken to me" know that danger from humans is coming to be true.
data.anv: त्वम् you, मानुषेभ्यः from humans, भयम् fear, विजानीहि coming to be true, इति thus, ब्रह्मणः Brahma, इदम् these, घोरम् dreadful, वाक्यम् words, माम् to me, उपस्थितम् warning given, तत् that, तथा like that.
data.md: This dire speech of Brahmā also reverts to my remembrance, Know you that the fear come from a human being.

data.v: देवदानवगन्धर्वैर्यक्षराक्षसपन्नगैः । अवध्यत्वं मया प्राप्तं मानुषेभ्यो न याचितम् ॥
data.es: "Your life is surely secure from gods, demons, Gandharvas and Yakshas and Rakshasas but you fear Vanaras."
data.anv: देवदावनगन्धर्वैः gods, demons and Gandharvas, सहराक्षसैः along with Rakshasas, यक्षैश्च Yakshas also, अवश्यंतु surely, त्वया by you, भग्ना death, ते to you, वानरेभ्यस्तु from Vanaras also, भयम् fear.
data.md: Incapable of being slain by gods, Dānavas or Gandharvas, Yaksas or Raksasas, Fear has (at last), found you, coming even from monkeys.

data.v: एतदेवाभ्युपागम्य यत्नं कर्तुमिहार्हथ । राक्षसाश्चापि तिष्ठन्तु चर्यागोपुरमूर्धसु ॥
data.es: "Knowing all this, make effort doing what ought to be done and let the Rakshasas strive to succeed positioned on top of the gates."
data.anv: एतत् एव all this, अभ्युपागम्य knowing, इह here, यत्नम् make effort, कर्तुम् will do, अर्हथ ought to, राक्षसाश्चापि even Rakshasas, चर्यागोपुरमूर्धसु strive to succeed positioned at the top of gates, तिष्ठन्तु positioned.
data.md: Taking note of this, you should strive (to the uttermost.) And let the Räkşasas be posted at the gateways, highways, and the walls.

data.v: स चाप्रतिमगम्भीरो देवदानवदर्पहा । ब्रह्मशापाभिभूतस्तु कुम्भकर्णो विबोध्यताम् ॥
data.es: "Let Kumbhakarna of unparalleled profundity, capable of crushing Devas and Danavas, who is in slumber owing to the curse of Brahma be awakened."
data.anv: अप्रतिमगाम्भीर्यः unparalleled in profundity, देवदानवदर्पहाः capable of crushing the vanity of Devas and Danavas, ब्रह्मशापाभिभूतः cursed by Brahma, सः he, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, विबोध्यताम् be aroused.
data.md: Do you wake up that destroyer of the pride of the deities and then Danavas-Kumbhakarma, endowed with unparalleled gravity, overwhelmed with the curse of Brahmā.

data.v: स पराजितमात्मानं प्रहस्तं च निषूदितम् । ज्ञात्वा रक्षोबलं भीममादिदेश महाबलः ॥
data.es: "Let him be instructed that Prahastha endowed with mighty prowess has been defeated and killed."
data.anv: महाबलः endowed with mighty prowess, सः he, पराजितम् defeated, आत्मानम् himself, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, निषूदितम् killed, भीमम् terrific, बलम् strength, आदिदेश be instructed.

data.v: द्वारेषु यत्नः क्रियतां प्राकाराश्चाधिरुह्यताम् । निद्रावशसमाविष्टः कुम्भकर्णो विबोध्यताम् ॥
data.es: "Let the Rakshasas climb up the defensive walls and attempt to guard. Also let Kumbhakarna be aroused from sleep."
data.anv: द्वारेषु gates, यत्नः attempt, क्रियताम् carryout, प्राकारश्च defensive walls, अधिरुह्यताम् climbing up, निद्राववसमाविष्टः fully awakened from sleep, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, विबोध्यताम् aroused.
data.md: Seeing himself worsted and Prahasta also slain, that Rākşasa endowed with dreadful power issued his orders to the fearful force. “Do you vigilantly guard the gates and mount the wall. And do you wake up Kumbhakarņa come under the sway of slumber.

data.v: नव षट्सप्त चाष्टौ च मासान्स्वपिति राक्षसः । तं तु बोधयत क्षिप्रं कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ॥
data.es: "Deliberating like this with me, Kumbhakarna is sleeping for the ninth day from now. He may be quickly informed (aroused)."
data.anv: मन्त्रयित्वा deliberating like this, अयम् I am, इतः here, नवमे nine, अहनि day and night, प्रसुप्तः sleeping, महाबलम् great strength, तंकुम्बकुर्णम् that Kumbhakarna, क्षिप्रम् quickly, बोधयत may be informed

data.v: स हि संख्ये महाबाहुः ककुदं सर्वरक्षसाम् । वानरान्राजपुत्रौ च क्षिप्रमेव वधिष्यति ॥
data.es: "Endowed with broad shoulders, he is the foremost of Rakshasas. He will crush many Vanaras immediately and the two princes (Rama and Lakshmana)."
data.anv: सर्वरक्षसाम् among the Rakshasas, ककुदम् foremost, महाबाहुःतु endowed with broad shoulders, सः he, सङ् ख्ये many, वानरान् Vanaras, राजपुत्रौच princes, क्षिप्रमेव instantly, हनिष्यति will crush them.
data.md: Therefore, speedily rouse very powerful Kumbhakarņa. Foremost of all the Rākşasas in fight, that long armed one shall speedily slay the monkeys as well as the princes.

data.v: कुम्भकर्णः सदा शेते मूढो ग्राम्यसुखे रतः । रामेणाभिनिरस्तस्य संग्रामोऽस्मिन्सुदारुणे ॥
भविष्यति न मे शोकः कुम्भकर्णे विबोधिते । किं करिष्याम्यहं तेन शक्रतुल्यबलेन हि ॥
ईदृशे व्यसने प्राप्ते यो न साह्याय कल्पते । ते तु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य राक्षसाः ॥
जग्मुः परमसंभ्रान्ताः कुम्भकर्णनिवेशनम् । ते रावणसमादिष्टा मांसशोणितभोजनाः ॥
गन्धमाल्यांस्तथा भक्ष्यानादाय सहसा ययुः । तां प्रविश्य महाद्वारां सर्वतो योजनायताम् ॥
कुम्भकर्णगुहां रम्यां सर्वगन्धप्रवाहिनीम् । प्रतिष्ठमानाः कृच्छ्रेण यत्नात्प्रविविशुर्गुहाम् ॥
data.es: The Rakshasas entered the beautiful residence of Kumbhakarna which was one yojana on all sides with huge gates, taking fragrant garlands and foods (to wake up Kumbhakarna) from where they were pushed out by the breath of Kumbhakarna. The Rakshasas endowed with mighty strength pushed their way into the residence of Kumbhakarna and entered.
data.anv: महाद्वाराम् huge gates, सर्वतः all over, योजनायुताम् one yojana on all sides, सर्वगन्धप्रवाहिनीम् with all fragrant flowers food etc, रम्याम् beautiful, कुम्भकर्णगुहाम् residence of Kumbhakarna, प्रविश्य entered, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, निःश्वासात् by the breath, अवधूताः attendants, महाबलाः of mighty strength, कृच्छ्रेण pushed out, प्रतिष्ठमानाः pushed their way, यत्नात् attempt, गुहाम् residence, प्रविविशुः entered.
data.md: And entering Kumbhakarņa's charming cave having a wide gateway, measuring a yojana breathing around perfumes of flowers, those highly powerful ones, pushed off by Kumbhakarna's breath, with the utmost energy they could summon up stood their ground and entered the cave.

data.v: तां प्रविश्य गुहां रम्यां शुभां काञ्चनकुट्टिमाम् । ददृशुर्नैरृतव्याघ्रं शयानं भीमदर्शनम् ॥
data.es: The tigers among Rakshasas entered the residence paved with gold and precious stones, a delightful one and saw sleeping Kumbhakarna of great prowess.
data.anv: नैरृतव्याघ्रं tigers among Rakshasas, शुभाम् काञ्चनकुट्टिमाम् paved with gold and precious stones, रम्याम् delightful, तांगुहाम् home, प्रविव्य entered, शयानम् sleeping, भीमविदर्शनम् of terrible prowess, ददृशुः saw.
data.md: Then entering that charming cave having floors paved with gold and gems. those Naiſtas endowed with great strength, saw that one of dreadful prowess, lying down.

data.v: ते तु तं विकृतं सुप्तं विकीर्णमिव पर्वतम् । कुम्भकर्णं महानिद्रं सहिताः प्रत्यबोधयन् ॥
data.es: Those Rakshasas collected together started to awaken Kumbhakarna, who was like a scattered mountain in dead sleep.
data.anv: ते those, सहिताः collected together, विकृतम् of unnatural form, सुप्तम् sleeping on bed, विकीर्णम् scattered, पर्वतम् इव mountain like, महानिद्रम् in dead sleep, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, प्रत्यबोधयन् to awaken.

data.v: ऊर्ध्वरोमाञ्चिततनुं श्वसन्तमिव पन्नगम् । त्रासयन्तं महाश्वासैः शयानं भीमदर्शनम् ॥
भीमनासापुटं तं तु पातालविपुलाननम् । ददृशुर्नैरृतव्याघ्रं कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ॥
ततश्चक्रुर्महात्मानः कुम्भकर्णाग्रतस्तदा । मांसानां मेरुसंकाशं राशिं परमतर्पणम् ॥
data.es: Thereafter the Rakshasas placed a heap of me at the size of Meru Mountain to please him immensely.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, महात्मानः great soul, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, अग्रतः before, मांसानाम् meat, मेरुसङ्काशम् of the size of Meru mountain, परमतर्पणम् for pleasing immensely, राशिम् heap, चक्रुः placed.

data.v: मृगाणां महिषाणां च वराहाणां च संचयान् । चक्रुर्नैरृतशार्दूला राशिमन्नस्य चाद्भुतम् ॥
data.es: The tigers of the south west Rakshasas piled up a mass of marvellous food like the me at of buffaloes, swine, and antelopes.
data.anv: नैरृतशार्दूलाः tiger of southwest, मृगाणाम् antelopes, महिषाणांच buffaloes also, वराहाणांच swine also, सञ्चयान् in heaps, अन्नस्य food, अद्भुतम् marvellous, राशिंच a mass, चक्रुः placed.
data.md: Then they huge bodied Rākșasas piled up before Kumbhakarma, Meru-like animals for conferring rare gratification and heaps of deer and buffaloes and boars. And the Rākşasas made an astounding heap of rice.

data.v: ततः शोणितकुम्भांश्च मद्यानि विविधानि च । पुरस्तात्कुम्भकर्णस्य चक्रुस्त्रिदशशत्रवः ॥
data.es: Then the Rakshasas placed thirty three kinds of meat, pails of blood, and a variety of wines in front of Kumbhakarna.
data.anv: ततः then, त्रिदशत्रवः thirty three kinds, शोणितकुम्भांश्च pails of blood, विविधानि variety, मद्यानि wines, कुम्भकर्णस्य at Kumbhakarna, पुरस्तात् in front of, चक्रुः placed.

data.v: लिलिपुश्च परार्ध्येन चन्दनेन परंतपम् । दिव्यैराच्छादयामासुर्माल्यैर्गन्धैः सुगन्धिभिः ॥
data.es: Again, they daubed Kumbhakarna with highly fragrant sandal paste to take in fragrance, with wonderful garlands and perfumes.
data.anv: परार्ध्येन highly fragrant, चन्दनेन sandal paste, परन्तपम् super, लिलिपुः to take in, दिव्यैः wonderful, सुगन्धिभिः fragrant, माल्यैः garland s, गन्दैःच and perfumes, आश्वासयामासुः daubed him.

data.v: धूपं सुगन्धं ससृजुस्तुष्टुवुश्च परंतपम् । जलदा इव चोनेदुर्यातुधानाः सहस्रशः ॥
data.es: They also burnt incense, sandal to send forth fragrance to gratify Kumbhakarna and thundered like clouds here and there.
data.anv: यातुधानाः incense, धूपम् burnt, गन्धाम् च sandal, ससृजुः to send forth, परन्तपम् supreme, तुष्टवुश्च to gratify, ततस्ततः here and there, जलदाःइव like clouds, आनेदुःच thundered.

data.v: शङ्खानापूरयामासुः शशाङ्कसदृशप्रभान् । तुमुलं युगपच्चापि विनेदुश्चाप्यमर्षिताः ॥
data.es: They blew moon size conches shining brightly. Intolerant Rakshasas raised loud noise simultaneously.
data.anv: शशाङ्कसदृशप्रभान् like moon and shining brightly, शङ्खान् conchs, आपूरयामासुः blew, अमर्षिताः intolerant, युगपत् simultaneously, तुमुलम् loudly, विनेदुःचापि raised noise.
data.md: They winded conchs beaming moon-like. And they incapable of being beaten shouted in full chorus.

data.v: नेदुरास्फोटयामासुश्चिक्षिपुस्ते निशाचराः । कुम्भकर्णविबोधार्थं चक्रुस्ते विपुलं स्वनम् ॥
data.es: Those night rangers drawing the limbs of Kumbhakarna pushed his arms, clapping loudly to awaken him making a sound.
data.anv: तेनिशाचराः those night rangers, नेदुः drawing near, अस्फोटयामासुः pushed the limbs, चिक्षिपुः clapped, कुम्भकर्णविबोधार्थम् to make Kumbhakarna wake up, विपुलम् loud, स्वनम् sound, चक्रुः did.
data.md: The night-rangers shouted and struck at their arms with their hands and began to pull him. And for rousing Kumbhakarņa, mighty was the din that they raised.

data.v: सशङ्खभेरीपटहप्रणाद;मास्फोटितक्ष्वेडितसिंहनादम् । दिशो द्रवन्तस्त्रिदिवं किरन्तः; श्रुत्वा विहंगाः सहसा निपेतुः ॥
data.es: On hearing the conchs, and of the clapping of arms, and thundering like a lion, the birds playing in the sky got scattered and fell.
data.anv: विहंगाः birds, सशङ्खभेरीपणवप्रणादम् by the sound of the conchs, आस्फोटितक्षेवळितसिंहनादम् clapping of arms, thundering and lion roar, श्रुत्वा hearing, दिशः direction, द्रवन्तः playing, त्रिदिवम् in the sky, कीरन्तः scattered, सहसा forcibly, निपेतुः fell down.
data.md: Hearing those loud sounds of conchs and drums and Papavas; and those proceeding from persons striking at their arms with their hands; and leonine roars, rushing on all sides and riving the very heavens, birds suddenly dropped down.

data.v: यदा भृशं तैर्निनदैर्महात्मा; न कुम्भकर्णो बुबुधे प्रसुप्तः । ततो मुसुण्डीमुसलानि सर्वे; रक्षोगणास्ते जगृहुर्गदाश्च ॥
data.es: Kumbhakarna sleeping like that, could not be awakened. Angry Rakshasas roared and hit him with mallets and maces.
data.anv: प्रसुप्तः sleeping, महात्मा great soul, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, भृशम् angry, तैः they, निनदैः roared, यदा that way, नबुबुधे not awakened, ततः then सर्वे all, रक्षोगणाः Rakshasas, तम् him, मुसुण्ठीः mallets, मुसलानि bars, गदाश्च and maces, जगृहुः hit.
data.md: When the high-souled Kumbhakarņa sleeping soundly did not awake at that terrific tumult, the Raksasas took up Bhusundis and maces.

data.v: तं शैलशृङ्गैर्मुसलैर्गदाभि;र्वृक्षैस्तलैर्मुद्गरमुष्टिभिश्च । सुखप्रसुप्तं भुवि कुम्भकर्णं; रक्षांस्युदग्राणि तदा निजघ्नुः ॥
data.es: Then the excited Rakshasas could not wake up Kumbhakarna happily sleeping on the ground in spite of hitting with rocks and trees and their fists.
data.anv: तदा then, उदग्राणि exited, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, भुवि on the ground, सुखप्रसुप्तम् happily sleeping, तंकुम्भकर्णम् that Kumbhakarna, शैलशृङ्गैः with rocks and trees, मुसलैः bars, गदाभिः maces, मुद्गरमुष्टिभिःच with fists, निजघ्नुः not got up.
