data.anv: एकेन by one, भग्नाः destroyed, बहवः though many, उददिष्टाः distinguished, वयम् we, पलायनने by running away, प्राणान् life, रक्षामहे protect, यशः glory, नाशम् gone, गमिष्यति come to an end.
data.md: If we save our lives by flight, and if the many are brought down by one, we shall lose our fame utterly.

data.v: एवं ब्रुवाणं तं शूरमङ्गदं कनकाङ्गदम् । द्रवमाणास्ततो वाक्यमूचुः शूरविगर्हितम् ॥
data.es: While the heroic Angada, adorned with gold armlets, was speaking in that manner to the fleeing vanara heroes, condemned by the hero the vanaras replied as follows.
data.anv: द्रवमाणाः fleeing away, एवम् in that manner, ब्रुवाणम् speaking, कनकाङ्गदम् adorned with gold armlets, शूरम् to the heroes, तम् that, अङ्गदम् Angada, ततः thereafter, शूरुविगर्हितम् condemned by hero, वाक्यम् words, ऊचुः said.
data.md: As Angada decked in golden angadas was saying this, the monkeys, flying away spoke to that hero words not worthy of being spoken to an hero.

data.v: कृतं नः कदनं घोरं कुम्भकर्णेन रक्षसा । न स्थानकालो गच्छामो दयितं जीवितं हि नः ॥
data.es: "Kumbhakarna, the Rakshasa has done havoc to us. This is not the moment to stay. Our life is dear to us."
data.anv: नः us, रक्षसा Rakshasa, कुम्भकर्णेनKumbhakarna, घोरम् dreadful, कदनम् havoc, कृतम् done, स्थानकालः moment to stay, न not, नः we, जीवितम् our life, दयितंहि dear to us.
data.md: Great is the havoc that the Rākşasa-Kumbhakarma-has spread among us. “This not the time to stay: life is dear to us."

data.v: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं सर्वे ते भेजिरे दिशः । भीमं भीमाक्षमायान्तं दृष्ट्वा वानरयूथपाः ॥
data.es: All the Vanara troops having replied that way, seeing Kumbhakarna of frightful eyes coming towards them, scattered in all directions.
data.anv: सर्वे all,एता to you. वानरयूथपाः Vanara troops, भीमाक्षम् frightful eyes, भीमम् fear, आयान्तम् coming towards, दृष्टवा seeing, एतावत् in that way, वचनम्words, उक्त्वा having spoken, दिशः directions, भेजिरे scattered.
data.md: Having said this the monkey bands darted to the ten cardinal points, as they saw that dreadful and grim-eyed one approach.

data.v: द्रवमाणास्तु ते वीरा अङ्गदेन वलीमुखाः । सान्त्वैश्च बहुमानैश्च ततः सर्वे निवर्तिताः ॥
data.es: Though the heroic monkeys were running away, Angada by his good words and examples turned them to return from wherever they were.
data.anv: द्रवमाणाः running away, वीराः heroes, ते you are, वलीमुखाः to return back, सरेततः wherever they were, अङ्गदेन by Angada, सान्त्वैश्चै with good words, अनुमानैश्च by examples, निवर्तिताः turned.
data.md: As those flower of the forces were on the flight, those heroes were made to desist by Angada with words of comfort and hope pointing to the future.

data.v: ऋषभशरभमैन्दधूम्रनीलाः; कुमुदसुषेणगवाक्षरम्भताराः । द्विविदपनसवायुपुत्रमुख्या;स्त्वरिततराभिमुखं रणं प्रयाताः ॥
data.es: Rshaba, Sarabha, Mainda and Nila, Kumuda, Susena, Rambha, and Tara headed by Dwiviida, Panasa and Hanuman marched ahead swiftly to the battlefield.॥ इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषष्टितमस्सर्गः ॥This is the end of the sixty sixth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic, the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
data.anv: ऋषभशरभमैन्धधूम्रनीलाः Rshaba, Sarabha, Mainda, Dhruma and Nila, कुमुदसुषेणगवाक्षम्भताराः Kumuda, Susena, Gavaksha, Rambha, and Tara, द्विविदपनसवायुपुत्रमुख्याः Dwivida, Panasa, and Hanuman, त्वरिततराभिमुखम् marched ahead swiftly, रणम् to the battlefield, प्रयाताः quickly.
data.md: Rşabha, Sarabha, Mainda, Dhūmra, Nila, Kumuda, Susena, Gavaksa, Rambha, Dvivida, Panasa, and son of wind Hanuman and other powerf:! leaders speedily proceeded to the battle field.

data.v: ते निवृत्ता महाकायाः श्रुत्वाङ्गदवचस्तदा । नैष्ठिकीं बुद्धिमास्थाय सर्वे संग्रामकाङ्क्षिणः ॥
data.es: Having heard Angada's words, the Vanaras of gigantic body firmly decided to wage war and returned back.
data.anv: तदा then, अङ्गदवचः Angada's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, निवृत्ताः death, महाकायाः of huge body, सर्वे all, ते they, नैष्ठिकीम् decided, बुद्धिम् realising, आस्थाय returned, सङ्ग्रामकाङ्क्षिणः who desired to wage war.
data.md: Having desisted on hearing the words of Angada those huge-bodied ones, regaining calmness, became (again) intent on fight.

data.v: समुदीरितवीर्यास्ते समारोपितविक्रमाः । पर्यवस्थापिता वाक्यैरङ्गदेन वलीमुखाः ॥
data.es: The Vanara leaders, having been reminded of their valour in battle by Angada gladly returned with a resolve to stake their life and carried on the battle.
data.anv: समुदीरितवीर्याः leaders reminded of their valour, समारोपितविक्रमाः valiant in war, वलीमुखाः returned, अङ्गदेन by Angada, वाक्यैः words, पर्यवस्थापिताः reminded of their valour, तेवानराः The Vanaras, हर्षम् gladly, गताः came, मरणे at death, कृतश्चयाः resolved, प्रयाताः restrained, त्यक्तजीविताः staked their life, सुतुमलम् fierce, युद्धम् battle, चक्रुः carried on.
data.md: Attaining energy at the exhortation (of Angada), and summoning up their prowess, they stayed in the field agreeable to the words of the powerful Angada.

data.v: प्रयाताश्च गता हर्षं मरणे कृतनिश्चयाः । चक्रुः सुतुमुलं युद्धं वानरास्त्यक्तजीविताः ॥
data.es: The Vanara leaders, having been reminded of their valour in battle by Angada gladly returned with a resolve to stake their life and carried on the battle.
data.anv: समुदीरितवीर्याः leaders reminded of their valour, समारोपितविक्रमाः valiant in war, वलीमुखाः returned, अङ्गदेन by Angada, वाक्यैः words, पर्यवस्थापिताः reminded of their valour, तेवानराः The Vanaras, हर्षम् gladly, गताः came, मरणे at death, कृतश्चयाः resolved, प्रयाताः restrained, त्यक्तजीविताः staked their life, सुतुमलम् fierce, युद्धम् battle, चक्रुः carried on.
data.md: Inspired with spirits, the monkeys, determined to face their fate, rushed into the conflict, and, casting away all care for their lives, entered into a furious fight (with the foe)

data.v: अथ वृक्षान्महाकायाः सानूनि सुमहान्ति च । वानरास्तूर्णमुद्यम्य कुम्भकर्णमभिद्रवन् ॥
data.es: Thereafter the Vanaras of huge body wielding huge trees and mountain peaks quickly rushed towards Kumbhakarna.
data.anv: अथ and then, महाकायाः endowed with huge body, वानराः Vanaras, वृक्षान् trees, सुमहान्ति huge size, सानूनि mountain peaks, उद्यम्य taking hold, तूर्णम् quickly, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, अभिद्रुताः rushed towards.
data.md: And speedily upraising trees and gigantic crags, the huge-bodied monkeys charged Kumbhakarņa.

data.v: स कुम्भकर्णः संक्रुद्धो गदामुद्यम्य वीर्यवान् । अर्दयन्सुमहाकायः समन्ताद्व्याक्षिपद्रिपून् ॥
data.es: Valiant Kumbhakarna, a gigantic one, highly enraged lifted mace and crescent shaped arrow struck the enemies on all sides.
data.anv: महाकायः possessing huge body, वीर्यवान् valiant one, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, सुसङ्कृद्धः highly enraged, गदाम् mace, उद्यम्य lifted , अर्धयन् crescent shaped arrow, रिपून् enemies, समन्तात् all sides, व्यक्षिपत् struck.
data.md: Thereat the mighty Kumbhakarņa possessed of a prodigious person waxing wroth taking up his mace let the same alight on the enemies.

data.v: शतानि सप्त चाष्टौ च सहस्राणि च वानराः । प्रकीर्णाः शेरते भूमौ कुम्भकर्णेन पोथिताः ॥
data.es: Kumbhakarna held seven or eight or even hundred, thousand vanaras and threw them on the ground like serpents thrown by Garuda.
data.anv: सप्त seven, अष्टौ च eight, शतानि even hundred, सहस्राणि च thousand, वानराः Vanara, कुम्भकर्णेन by Kumbhakarna, पोधिताः folding in arms, प्रकीर्णाः threw, भूमौ on the ground, शेरते serpents.
data.md: Attacked by Kumbhakarma, seven, eight hundreds and thousands of monkeys measure their lengths on the earth.

data.v: षोडशाष्टौ च दश च विंशत्त्रिंशत्तथैव च । परिक्षिप्य च बाहुभ्यां खादन्विपरिधावति । भक्षयन्भृशसंक्रुद्धो गरुडः पन्नगानिव ॥
data.es: Kumbhakarna became extremely angry, and caught hold of sixteen, eight, ten vanaras in the same way ninetynine and thirty and many more Vanaras and devoured them and went about like Garuda after having eaten the serpents.
data.anv: भृशःसङ्क्रुद्धः extremely angry, षोडश sixteen, अष्टौ च eight, दश च ten also, तथैव in the same way, विंशत् ninety nine, त्रिंशत् thirty, बाहुभ्याम् many more, परिक्षिप्य holding around, खादन् devouring, पन्नगान् serpents, भक्ष्यन् eating, गरुडःइव like Garuda, परिधावति went about.
data.md: Casting about his arms, he rush on, devouring sixteen, eight, ten, twenty or thirty. And he devoured (the monkeys) like Garuda swallowing up serpents.

data.v: हनूमाञ्शैलशृङ्गाणि वृक्षांश्च विविधान्बहून् । ववर्ष कुम्भकर्णस्य शिरस्यम्बरमास्थितः ॥
data.es: Stationed in the sky Hanuman rained mountain peaks, rocks, and huge trees of several kinds on the head of Kumbhakarna.
data.anv: हनूमान् Hanuman, अम्बरम् sky, आस्थितः stationed, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, शिरसि on the head, शैलशृङ्गाणि mountain peaks, शिलाश्च rocks, विविधान् several, द्रुमान् kinds of trees, ववर्षrained.
data.md: And remaining in the sky, Hanumān discharged at Kumbhakarņa's head mountainpeaks and rocks and various trees.

data.v: तानि पर्वतशृङ्गाणि शूलेन तु बिभेद ह । बभञ्ज वृक्षवर्षं च कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः ॥
data.es: Mighty Kumbhakarna split off the rocks, mountain peaks and the trees breaking them.
data.anv: महाबलः mighty, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, शूलेन those rocks, तानि them, पर्वतशृङ्गाणि mountain peaks, बिभेद ह breaking, वृक्षवर्षं च rain of trees, बभञ्ज split off.
data.md: And all those mountain-tops he cut off with his dart; and the mighty Kumbhakarņa also baffled the shower of trees.

data.v: ततो हरीणां तदनीकमुग्रं; दुद्राव शूलं निशितं प्रगृह्य । तस्थौ ततोऽस्यापततः पुरस्ता;न्महीधराग्रं हनुमान्प्रगृह्य ॥
data.es: Thereafter Kumbhakarna holding a sharp pike rushed towards Hanuman who uprooted a mountain peak and obstructed him placing it before him.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, उग्रम् sharp, शूलम् pike, प्रगृह्य holding, हरीणाम् Vanaras, उग्रम् sharp, तत् that, अभीकम् rushed, दुद्राव uprooted, हनुमान् Hanuman, महीधराग्रम् mountain peak, प्रगृह्य seizing, आपततः obstructed, तस्य its, पुरस्तात् before, तस्थौ him.
data.md: Then grasping his sharpened spear, Kumbhakarņa darted against that terrific array of monkeys. And as he charged them, Hanuman armed with a mountain-peak, stood before him.

data.v: स कुम्भकर्णं कुपितो जघान; वेगेन शैलोत्तमभीमकायम् । स चुक्षुभे तेन तदाभिबूतो; मेदार्द्रगात्रो रुधिरावसिक्तः ॥
data.es: Enraged Hanuman struck Kumbhakarna endowed with a rock like frightening body. Overpowered by that blow Kumbhakarna was upset and bespattered with fat and got bathed in blood.
data.anv: कुपितः enraged, सः he, शैलोत्तमभीमकायम् rock like frightening body, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, वेगेन swiftly, जघान struck, तदा then, तेन by that, अभिभूतः overpo were d, सः he, मेदार्द्रगात्रः bespattered with fat, रुदिरावसिक्तः bathed in blood, सचक्षुभे upset.
data.md: Waxing enraged (Hanuman) vehemently smote Kumbhakarņa with a gigantic crag. And overpowered by that, Kumbhakarna experienced great torments, and his body was covered with fat and blood.

data.v: स शूलमाविध्य तडित्प्रकाशं; गिरिं यथा प्रज्वलिताग्रशृङ्गम् । बाह्वन्तरे मारुतिमाजघान; गुहोऽचलं क्रौञ्चमिवोग्रशक्त्या ॥
data.es: Kumbhakarna ,who was like a mountain blazing like fire, pierced at Maruti's chest with his pike shining like lightning just as Guha struck at Krauncha mountain.
data.anv: सः that, गिरिः mountain, प्रज्वलिताग्रशृङ्गंयथा like a blazing peak, तडित्प्रकाशम् shining like lightning, शूलम् pike, आविध्य pierced, गुहः as Guha (son of Lord Siva), उग्रशक्त्या formidable, क्रौञ्चम् अचलमिव like the Krauncha mountain, मारुतिम् at Maruti, बाह्वन्तरे in between shoulders, the breast, आजघान struck.
data.md: Then as Guha had pierced Krauñca with his fierce dart, Kumbhakarna the mountain-like smote the Wind-god's son in the chest with his dart resembling lightning or like a glowing mountain-summit.

data.v: स शूलनिर्भिन्न महाभुजान्तरः; प्रविह्वलः शोणितमुद्वमन्मुखात् । ननाद भीमं हनुमान्महाहवे; युगान्तमेघस्तनितस्वनोपमम् ॥
data.es: The great son of windgod, pierced with pike in the chest, ejected blood from his mouth, and roared in a frightening manner which was like thunder rumbling at the time of dissolution of the universe.
data.anv: महाहवे great son of windgod, शूलनिर्भिन्नमहाभुजान्तरः being pierced with pike in the chest, सःहनूमान् that Hanuman, प्रविह्वलः ejecting, मुखात् from his mouth, शोणितम् blood, उद्वमन् came out, युगान्तमेघस्न्तितस्वनोपमम् thunder rumblings at dissolution of the universe, भीमम् frightening, ननाद roar.
data.md: And having his mighty chest pierced in the mighty encounter, Hanumān, overwhelmed, and vomiting blood-transported with wrath, set up roars resembling the roaring of the clouds at the universal disruption.

data.v: ततो विनेदुः सहसा प्रहृष्टा; रक्षोगणास्तं व्यथितं समीक्ष्य । प्लवंगमास्तु व्यथिता भयार्ताः; प्रदुद्रुवुः संयति कुम्भकर्णात् ॥
data.es: Rakshasa's army collected together rejoiced to see Hanuman agonized. Vanaras were frightened and fled in fear of Kumbhakarna.
data.anv: ततः then, रक्षोगणाः Rakshasa army, व्यथितम् agonized तम् his, समीक्ष्य perceiving, प्रहृष्टाः happy, सहसा collected, विनेदुः rejoiced, प्लवङ्गमास्तु for Vanaras, व्यथिताः. frightened, भयार्ताः in fear, संयति , कुम्भकर्णात् Kumbhakarna's, प्रदुद्रुवुः fled.
data.md: Then, beholding him in torments, Raksasas suddenly rejoiced, emitted shouts; and the monkeys aggrieved and overcome with fright, began to fly Kumbhakarna in battle.

data.v: नीलश्चिक्षेप शैलाग्रं कुम्भकर्णाय धीमते । तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य मुष्टिनाभिजघान ह ॥
मुष्टिप्रहाराभिहतं तच्छैलाग्रं व्यशीर्यत । सविस्फुलिङ्गं सज्वालं निपपात महीतले ॥
data.es: (Kumbhakarna) observing the mountain peak coming towards him pierced it with his fist. Struck by the fist, the peak broke and sparks of fire came out shining brightly and fell on the ground.
data.anv: तदा after that, आपतन्तम् coming towards, सम्प्रेक्ष्य observing, मुष्टिना with fist, अभिजघान ह pierced, मुष्टिप्रहाराभिहतम् struck by fist, तत् that, शैलाग्रम् mountain peak, व्यशीर्यत broken, सविस्फुलिंगम् like sparks of fire, सज्वालम् shining brightly, महीतले on the ground, निपपात fell.
data.md: Seeing it descend, he dealt it a blow; and struck by the blow, the mountain-top was shattered in pieces; and dropped to the earth glowing and shooting living flames.

data.v: ऋषभः शरभो नीलो गवाक्षो गन्धमादनः । पञ्चवानरशार्दूलाः कुम्भकर्णमुपाद्रवन् ॥
data.es: Rshaba, Sarabha, Neela, Gavaksha and Gandhamadana, these five tigers among Vanaras attacked Kumbhakarna.
data.anv: ऋषभः Rshaba, शरभः Sarabha, नीलः Neela, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, पञ्च five, वानरशार्धूलाः tigers among Vanaras, कुम्बकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, उपाद्रवन् attacked.
data.md: Then Rşabha and Sarabha and Nīla and Gavākṣa and Gandhamādana, these five terrific monkeys, rushed against Kumbhakarņa.

data.v: शैलैर्वृक्षैस्तलैः पादैर्मुष्टिभिश्च महाबलाः । कुम्भकर्णं महाकायं सर्वतोऽभिनिजघ्निरे ॥
data.es: Those Vanaras of exceptional strength attacked gigantic Kumbhakarna on all sides by rocks, trees and by their fists, hands and feet also.
data.anv: महाबलाः Vanaras of exceptional strength, शैलैः rock, वृक्षैः trees, तलैः palms, पादैः feet, मुष्टिभिः च and fist also, महाकायम् of huge body, कुम्बकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, सर्वतः all over, अभिप्रदुद्रुवुः attacked severely.
data.md: And in the encounter those mighty monkeys began to sorely assail the huge-bodied Kumbhakarma with crags and trees and slaps and kicks and blows.

data.v: स्पर्शानिव प्रहारांस्तान्वेदयानो न विव्यथे । ऋषभं तु महावेगं बाहुभ्यां परिषस्वजे ॥
data.es: Their attacks were like soft touches to Kumbhakarna, and no pain was experienced by him, and he encircled Rshaba by the shoulders with great impetuosity.
data.anv: तान् his, प्रहारान् attacks, स्पर्शानिव like touches, वेदयानः pain, न विव्यधे not felt, महावेगम् of great impetuosity, ऋषभम् Rshaba, बाहुभ्याम् shoulders, परिषस्वजे encircled.
data.md: But those blows seemed to him like touches* and did not at all pain him. Then he fastened the vehement Rşabha with his arms. *Like the feel, remarks Rāmánuja, of wreaths, unguents, etc. blows

data.v: कुम्भकर्णभुजाभ्यां तु पीडितो वानरर्षभः । निपपातर्षभो भीमः प्रमुखागतशोणितः ॥
data.es: Rshaba, the bull among Vanaras, of frightful appearance pressed by Kumbhakarna's shoulders, started bleeding from his teeth and fell down.
data.anv: कुम्भकर्णभुजाभ्यां Kumbhakarna's shoulders, पीडितः pressing, वानरर्षभः bull among Vanaras, भीमः frightful, ऋषभः Rshaba, प्रमुखाद्वान्तशोणितः blood flowing from his teeth, निपपात fell down.
data.md: Agonised on being fastened with Kumbhakarma's arms, that foremost of monkeys, the dreadful Rşabha, fell down to the earth, vomiting blood by his mouth.

data.v: मुष्टिना शरभं हत्वा जानुना नीलमाहवे । आजघान गवाक्षं च तलेनेन्द्ररिपुस्तदा ॥
data.es: Angry Kumbhakarna (enemy of Indra) hit Sarabha with his fist, Neela with his knees hurt Gavaksha and slapped him with his palms. Gandhamadana was kicked with force.
data.anv: तदा then, क्रुद्धः angry, इन्द्ररिपुः enemy of Indra, आहवे hit, शरभम् Sarabha, मुष्टिना with fist, नीलम् Neela, जानुना knees, हत्वा hurting, गवाक्षम् Gavaksha, तलेन with palm, आजघान slapped, गन्धमादनम् Gandhamadana, तरसा kicked, पादेन with feet, अभ्यह नत् with force.
data.md: Then the enemy of Indra smite, Sarabha with blow, and Nila, in the conflict with his thigh, struck a slap at Gavākṣa.

data.v: दत्तप्रहरव्यथिता मुमुहुः शोणितोक्षिताः । निपेतुस्ते तु मेदिन्यां निकृत्ता इव किंशुकाः ॥
data.es: Hurt by the blows of Kumbhakarna, their eyes bathed in blood, the Vanaras fainted and fell on the ground like cut down Kimsuka trees.
data.anv: ते they, दत्तप्रहारव्यथिताः hurt by the blows, शोणितोक्षिताः eyes bathed in blood, मुमुहुः fainted, निकृत्ताः cut down, किंशुकाःइव like Kimsuka trees, मेदिन्याम् on the ground, निपेतुः lay.
data.md: Then he speedily hit by his feet with wrath Gandhamadana. Suffering great . pain in consequence of the (dealt by Kumbhakarņa those monkeys), deprived of their senses and bathed in blood, dropped down to the earth like Kinśukas that have been cut down.

data.v: तेषु वानरमुख्येषु पतितेषु महात्मसु । वानराणां सहस्राणि कुम्भकर्णं प्रदुद्रुवुः ॥
data.es: Being great leaders and the important among them fallen, the Vanaras went in thousands towards Kumbhakarna.
data.anv: महात्मसु great leaders, तेषु they being, वानरमुख्येषु important among Vanaras, पातितेषु fallen, वानराणाम् Vanaras, सहस्राणि thousands, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, प्रदुद्रुवुः went towards.
data.md: On those high-souled and mighty monkeys falling down, thousands of monkeys rushed at Kumbhakarna.

data.v: तं शैलमिव शैलाभाः सर्वे तु प्लवगर्षभाः । समारुह्य समुत्पत्य ददंशुश्च महाबलाः ॥
data.es: The bulls among Vanaras themselves looking like mountains endowed with great strength climbed up Kumbhakarna and bit him.
data.anv: शैलाभाः looking like mountains themselves, महाबलाः endowed with strength, सर्वे all, ते of them, प्लवगर्षभाः bulls among Vanaras, शैलमिव like mountain, तम् him, समारुह्य climbing up, समुत्पत्य jumping, ददंशुः bit him.
data.md: Ascending a mountain-summit, those foremost of monkeys, possessed of the splendour of a mountain-peak, sprang upon him and tore him with their teeth.

data.v: तं नखैर्दशनैश्चापि मुष्टिभिर्जानुभिस्तथा । कुम्भकर्णं महाकायं ते जघ्नुः प्लवगर्षभाः ॥
data.es: The bulls among Vanaras hurt Kumbhakarna, endowed with strong shoulders, by scratching with nails, biting with teeth and hitting him with arms and fists.
data.anv: प्लवगर्षभाः bull among monkeys, महाबाहुम् endowed with strong shoulders, तंकुम्बकर्णम् that Kumbhakarna, नखैः nails, दशनैश्चापि teeth also, मुष्टिभिः with fists also, तथा like that, बाहुभिः arms, तेजघ्नुः hurt him.
data.md: And those foremost of monkeys attacked the long-armed Kumbhakarma with their claws and teeth and blows and arms.

data.v: स वानरसहस्रैस्तैराचितः पर्वतोपमः । रराज राक्षसव्याघ्रो गिरिरात्मरुहैरिव ॥
data.es: The tiger among Rakshasas covered with thousands of Rakshasas was resembling a mountain with trees grown on itself.
data.anv: वानरसहस्त्रैरजित covered by thousands of monkeys, पर्वतोपमः resembling mountain, सः he, राक्षसव्याघ्रः tiger among Rakshasas, आत्मरुहैः grown on itself, गिरिःइव like mountain, रराज appeared.
data.md: Then with thousands of monkeys on him that extraordinary onethat fearful Raksasa-resembling a hill, looked like a mountain with trees on it.

data.v: बाहुभ्यां वानरान्सर्वान्प्रगृह्य स महाबलः । भक्षयामास संक्रुद्धो गरुडः पन्नगानिव ॥
data.es: Holding the Vanaras, the mighty Kumbhakarna started devouring all Vanaras just as Garuda does with serpents.
data.anv: महाबलः mighty strong, सः he, सर्वान् all, वानरान् Vanaras, बाहुभ्याम् shoulders, प्रगृह्य holding, सङ्क्रुद्धः highly enraged, गरुडः Garuda, पन्नगानिव serpents like, भक्ष्यामास started devouring.
data.md: Like Garuda eating up serpents, that wondours strong one, wrought up with rage, devoured those monkeys, seizing them with his arms.

data.v: प्रक्षिप्ताः कुम्भकर्णेन वक्त्रे पातालसंनिभे । नासा पुटाभ्यां निर्जग्मुः कर्णाभ्यां चैव वानराः ॥
data.es: As Kumbhakarna thrust Vanaras into his mouth, the Vanaras came out through his nostrils and also through his ears.
data.anv: कुम्बकर्णेन Kumbhakarna, पातालसन्निभे the nethermost world, वक्त्रे mouth, प्रक्षिप्ताः thrust into, वानराः Vanaras, नासापुटाभ्याम् through nostrils, कर्णाभ्यांचैव and also through ears, निर्जग्मुः came out.
data.md: And cast by Kumbhakarņa into his mouth resembling the nether regions the monkeys emerged from his nose and ears.

data.v: भक्षयन्भृशसंक्रुद्धो हरीन्पर्वतसंनिभः । बभञ्ज वानरान्सर्वान्संक्रुद्धो राक्षसोत्तमः ॥
data.es: The foremost of the Rakshasas, who resembled a mountain became enraged and mutilated the Vanaras.
data.anv: भृशसङ्क्रुद्धः very angry, पर्वतसन्निभः like the mountain, राक्षसोत्तमः foremost of Rakshasas, सङ्कृद्धः very angry, हरीन् Vanaras, भक्ष्यन् eating, वानरान् Vanaras, बभञ्ज mutilated.
data.md: And eating up the monkeys, that foremost of Raksasas resembling a hill, growing worth, and fired with rage, began to break the monkeys down.

data.v: मांसशोणितसंक्लेदां भूमिं कुर्वन्स राक्षसः । चचार हरिसैन्येषु कालाग्निरिव मूर्छितः ॥
data.es: That terrible Rakshasa swooning and wetting the ground with flesh and blood ranged through the army of Vanaras like fire at the time of dissolution of the universe.
data.anv: सःराक्षसः That Rakshasa, भूमिम् terrible, मांसशोणितसंक्लेदाम् wetting the ground with flesh and blood, कुर्वन् done, मूर्छितः swooning, कालानगिरिव like the fire at dissolution, हरिसैन्येषु into the army of Vanaras, चचार ranged through.
data.md: And transported with passion, that Raksasa, making the earth miry with flesh and blood, spread among the monkey-ranks like to the fire at the time of the Universal dissolution.

data.v: वज्रहस्तो यथा शक्रः पाशहस्त इवान्तकः । शूलहस्तो बभौ तस्मिन्कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः ॥
data.es: Holding pike in hand, mighty Kumbhakarna was shining in the battlefield like Indra holding thunderbolt, and like Lord of Death holding the noose.
data.anv: शूलहस्तः holding pike in hand, महाबलः mighty, कुम्बकर्णः Kumbhakarna, युद्धे in battlefield, वज्रहस्तः thunderbolt in hand, शक्रःयथा like Indra, पाशहस्तः like noose in hand, अन्तकःइव like Lord of death, बभौ shone.
data.md: In that encounter, Kumbhakarņa armed with his dart in his hand, resembled the thunderhanded ſakra, or the noose-handed Destroyer himself.

data.v: यथा शुष्काण्यरण्यानि ग्रीष्मे दहति पावकः । तथा वानरसैन्यानि कुम्भकर्णो विनिर्दहत् ॥
data.es: Just as fire god consumes dried forest in summer, Kumbhakarna was consuming the Vanara army.
data.anv: ग्रष्मे summer, शुष्काणि dried, अरण्यानि forest, पावकः fire god, यथा like that, दहति consumes, तथा that, सःकुम्बकर्णः Kumbhakarna, वानरसैन्यानि Vanara army, विनिर्दहत् consuming.
data.md: As a conflagration burn up a withered forest in the summer, Kumbhakarna burnt that host of the monkeys.

data.v: ततस्ते वध्यमानास्तु हतयूथा विनायकाः । वानरा भयसंविग्ना विनेदुर्विस्वरं भृशम् ॥
data.es: Then with the army killed, the Vanaras moved without any leader making unnatural sounds out of fear and anger.
data.anv: ततः then, हतयूथाः killed army, विनायकाः moved without any leader, तेवानराः those Vanaras, वध्यमानाः killed, भयसंविग्नाः with fear, विकृतैः unnatural sound, भृशैः in anger, विस्वरम् roared.
data.md: Thus beaten (by Kumbhakarna), those monkeys, with their ranks destroyed, the monkeys, racked with anxiety, began to cry in unnatural tones.

data.v: अनेकशो वध्यमानाः कुम्भकर्णेन वानराः । राघवं शरणं जग्मुर्व्यथिताः खिन्नचेतसः ॥
data.es: Destroyed by Kumbhakarna in many ways, the Vanaras were heartbroken and sought the refuge of Raghava.
data.anv: कुम्भकर्णेन Kumbhakarna, अनेकशः in many ways, वध्यमानाः destroying, वानराः Vanaras, व्यथिताः worried, भिन्नचेतसः heartbroken, राघवम् Raghava, शरणंजग्मुः sought refuge.
data.md: Having innumerable monkeys slain by Kumbhakarņa, the monkeys, aggrieved and their hearts riven with sorrow, sought the shelter of Raghava.

data.v: तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् । उत्पपात तदा वीरः सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः ॥
data.es: Valiant Sugriva, seeing the mighty Kumbhakarna coming towards him jumped (in excitement).
data.anv: तदा then, वीरः valiant, वानराधिपः Vanara leader, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, आपतन्तम् coming, महाबलम् mighty, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, उत्पपात jumped.
data.md: Seeing the exceeding stout Kumbhakarņa approach, the heroic king of monkeys-Sugriva-sprang up; and taking a mountain-top that one possessed of great strength darted against the mighty Kumbhakarņa.

data.v: स पर्वताग्रमुत्क्षिप्य समाविध्य महाकपिः । अभिदुद्राव वेगेन कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ॥
data.es: Sugriva, of great prowess lifting a mountain peak, whirled it round and round and darted towards Kumbhakarna swiftly.
data.anv: महाबलः of great prowess, सः he (Sugriva), पर्वताग्रम् mountain peak, उत्क्षिप्य lifting, समाविध्य whirling round, महाबलम् great strength, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, वेगेन swiftly, अभिदुद्राव darted towards.
data.md: Seeing the exceeding stout Kumbhakarņa approach, the heroic king of monkeys-Sugriva-sprang up; and taking a mountain-top that one possessed of great strength darted against the mighty Kumbhakarņa.

data.v: तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य कुम्भकर्णः प्लवंगमम् । तस्थौ विवृतसर्वाङ्गो वानरेन्द्रस्य संमुखः ॥
data.es: Kumbhakarna, looking at the monkey Lord advancing towards him, stood in front of all limbs braced.
data.anv: कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, आपतन्तम् approaching, तम् him, प्लवङ्गमम् monkey, सम्प्रेक्ष्य looking, विवृतसर्वाङ्गः all limbs braced, वानरेन्द्रस्य Vanara Lord's, सम्मुखः forefront.
data.md: Seeing that monkey, Kumbhakarņa, stretching his limbs, stood before the lord of monkeys.

data.v: कपिशोणितदिग्धाङ्गं भक्षयन्तं महाकपीन् । कुम्भकर्णं स्थितं दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Sugriva spoke these words seeing Kumbhakarna who stood smeared with the blood of Vanaras and eating monkeys.
data.anv: कपिशोणितदिग्धाङ्गम् smeared with the blood of Vanaras, प्लवङ्गमान् monkeys, भक्ष्यन्तम् eating, स्थितम् stood, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, दृष्टवा seeing, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: Seeing Kumbhakarņa, with his body laved in the blood of monkeys; and eating up mighty monkeys, Sugriva addressed him, saying.

data.v: पातिताश्च त्वया वीराः कृतं कर्म सुदुष्करम् । भक्षितानि च सैन्यानि प्राप्तं ते परमं यशः ॥
data.md: You have felled heroes done deeds difficult of being performed, and have devoured the warriors; and you have thus attained renown. But let go now the monkey-army. What shall you do with the ignoble? Do you, O Raksasa bear the descent of this mountain.

data.v: त्यज तद्वानरानीकं प्राकृतैः किं करिष्यसि । सहस्वैकं निपातं मे पर्वतस्यास्य राक्षस ॥
data.es: "Give up with Vanaras, who are monkeys by nature. Bear this one mountain's blow of mine."
data.anv: तत् that, वानरानीकम् Vanara troops, त्यज give up, प्राकृतैः by nature, किंकरिष्यसि What work, राक्षस Rakshasa, मे with me, अस्यपर्वतस्य your mountain's, एकम् निपातम् one mountain, सहस्व bear.
data.md: You have felled heroes done deeds difficult of being performed, and have devoured the warriors; and you have thus attained renown. But let go now the monkey-army. What shall you do with the ignoble? Do you, O Raksasa bear the descent of this mountain.

data.v: तद्वाक्यं हरिराजस्य सत्त्वधैर्यसमन्वितम् । श्रुत्वा राक्षसशार्दूलः कुम्भकर्णोऽब्रवीद्वचः ॥
data.es: Hearing the king of Vanara's words of courage and strength, the tiger among Rakshasas, Kumbhakarna spoke these words.
data.anv: हरिराजस्य king of Vanaras, सत्त्वधैर्यसमन्वितम् words of courage and strength, तत् वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, राक्षसशार्दूलः Rakshasa tiger, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, वचः words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: Hearing those words of the monkey-king instinct with strength and fortitude, that terrible Raksasa-Kumbhakarna-said.

data.v: प्रजापतेस्तु पौत्रस्त्वं तथैवर्क्षरजःसुतः । श्रुतपौरुषसंपन्नस्तस्माद्गर्जसि वानर ॥
data.es: "O Vanara! You are the grandson of creator Brahma and son of Rksharaja, endowed with fortitude and so roaring like this."
data.anv: वानर O Vanara, त्वम् you, प्रजापतेः creator, पौत्रः grandson, तथैव therefore, ऋक्षरजस्सुतः Rksharaja's son, श्रुतपौरुषसम्पन्नः endowed richly with fortitude, कस्मात् therefore, गर्जसि roaring.
data.md: O monkey, you storm, because you are the grandson of Prajāpati and the son of the king of bears; and because as such you are endowed with fortitude and prowess.

data.v: स कुम्भकर्णस्य वचो निशम्य; व्याविध्य शैलं सहसा मुमोच । तेनाजघानोरसि कुम्भकर्णं; शैलेन वज्राशनिसंनिभेन ॥
data.es: On hearing Kumbhakarna's words, Sugriva forcibly discharged a mountain resembling a thunderbolt on the chest of Kumbhakarna.
data.anv: सः he, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, वचः words, निशम्य hearing, शैलम् mountain, व्याविध्य separating, सहसा forcibly, मुमोच discharged, वज्राशनिसन्निभेन resembling thunderbolt, तेन by that, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, उरसि chest, आजघान dropped.
data.md: Hearing Kumbhakarna's speech, Sugrīva whirling that mountain-peak, suddeniy let it go; and with that rock resembling Vajra or the thunder-bolt, smote Kumbhakarņa in the chest.

data.v: तच्छैलशृङ्गं सहसा विकीर्णं; भुजान्तरे तस्य तदा विशाले । ततो विषेदुः सहसा प्लवंगमा; रक्षोगणाश्चापि मुदा विनेदुः ॥
data.es: Then the mountain peak dropped on the chest broke into pieces. Thereafter the monkeys were despaired, and Rakshasas roared in joy.
data.anv: तदा then, तस्य his, विशाले broad, भुजान्तरे between shoulders, तत् that, शैलशृङ्गम् mountain peak, सहसा forcefully, विभिन्नम् broke into pieces, ततः thereafter, प्लवङ्गाः monkey, सहसा forcibly, विषण्णाः desperate, रक्षोगणाश्चापि the troops of Rakshasas, मुदा joy, विनेदुः roared.
data.md: On coming in contact with his wide breast, that mountain-peak was at once shattered in shivers, And thereat the monkeys grew dispirited and the Raksas's ranks shouted in joy.

data.v: स शैलशृङ्गाभिहतश्चुकोप; ननाद कोपाच्च विवृत्य वक्त्रम् । व्याविध्य शूलं च तडित्प्रकाशं; चिक्षेप हर्यृक्षपतेर्वधाय ॥
data.es: Struck with mountain peaks, the Rakshasa became furious, and his pride was hurt. He opened his mouth widely making loud noises, his pike glowing like lightning, turned the pike into circles and hurled at Sugriva to put an end to him.
data.anv: सः , शैलशृङ्गाभिहताः struck with mountain peak, चुकोप became furious, रोषात् pride hurt, वक्त्रम् mouth, विवृत्य opening widely, ननाद made loud noise, तटित्प्रकाशम् glowing like lightning, शूलम् pike, व्याविध्य turning round in circles, हर्यृक्षिपतेः to destroy Sugriva, वधाय put an end, चिक्षेप hurled.
data.md: And struck with the mountain-summit, Kumbhakarna was fired with wrath; and roared, expending his face. And then, whirling his dart resembling lightning displayed, he hurled it for compassing the destruction of the master of monkeys.

data.v: तत्कुम्भकर्णस्य भुजप्रविद्धं; शूलं शितं काञ्चनदामजुष्टम् । क्षिप्रं समुत्पत्य निगृह्य दोर्भ्यां; बभञ्ज वेगेन सुतोऽनिलस्य ॥
data.es: Hanuman the son of windgod instantly seized Kumbhakarna with his arms, whose shaft was covered by chains and broke with both hands quickly.
data.anv: अनिलस्यसुतः son of windgod, क्षिप्रम् instantly, समुत्पत्य seizing, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, भुजप्रविद्धम् with his arms, शितम् shaft, काञ्चनदामजुष्टम् covered with chains of gold, तत् that, शूलम् pike, दोर्भ्याम् both hands, निगृह्य holding, वेगेन quickly, बभञ्ज broke.
data.md: Then swiftly bounding up, the Wind-god's son, resisting that whetted dart fastened with golden chains, with his hands violently snapped it in twain.

data.v: कृतं भारसहस्रस्य शूलं कालायसं महत् । बभञ्ज जनौमारोप्य प्रहृष्टः प्लवगर्षभः ॥
data.es: Then a rejoiced monkey, resting the thousand bharas iron pike on his knee broke it.
data.anv: तदा then, हृष्टः rejoiced, प्लवङ्गमः monkey, भारसहस्रस्य thousand bharas, कृतम् done, महत् great, कालायसम् iron, शूलम् pike, जानुम् knee, आरोप्य resting, बभञ्ज broke it.
data.md: And placing the same on his thighs, (Hanuman) snapped that ponderous and terrible dart composed of black iron, and thereat the monkeys waxed delighted.

data.v: स तत्तदा भग्नमवेक्ष्य शूलं; चुकोप रक्षोऽधिपतिर्महात्मा । उत्पाट्य लङ्कामलयात्स शृङ्गं; जघान सुग्रीवमुपेत्य तेन ॥
data.es: That great soul, the Lord of Rakshasas seeing the pike broken in that way, was highly enraged. Taking Malaya Mountain from Lanka, he struck Sugriva who was approaching him.
data.anv: महात्मा great soul, सः he, रक्षोधिपतिः Lord of Rakshasas, तत् there, शूलम् pike, तथा that way, भग्नम् broken, अवेक्ष्य seeing, चुकोप highly enraged, लङ्कामलयात् Malaya from Lanka, शृङ्गम् mountain, उत्पाट्य taking hold, सुग्रीवम् at Sugriva, उपेत्यतेन approaching, जघान struck.
data.md: Then the mighty-minded lord of Rákşasas seeing the dart thus severed, uprooted a peak from the Malaya and with it smote Sugrīva.

data.v: स शैलशृङ्गाभिहतो विसंज्ञः; पपात भूमौ युधि वानरेन्द्रः । तं प्रेक्ष्य भूमौ पतितं विसंज्ञं; नेदुः प्रहृष्टा युधि यातुधानाः ॥
data.es: That hero (Sugriva) hurt by the arrow lost senses and fell on the ground groaning in the battlefield. Seeing that the Rakshasas shouted joyfully overtaken by evil spirits.
data.anv: सःवीरः that hero, सायकार्तः hurt by arrow, विपरीतचेताः lost sense, कूजन् groaning, पृथिव्याम् on the ground, निपपात fell, युधि in battle, विसंज्ञम् sent forth, भूमौ on the ground, पतितम् fallen, तम् they, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, यातुधानाः an evil spirit, प्रहृष्टाः joyfully, नेदुः shouted.
data.md: Thereat, agonised by the shaft, that hero, with his senses bewildered, dropped down to the ground with shrieks. And seeing him down on the earth bereft of his senses, the Yātudhānas were filled with rejoicing.

data.v: तमभ्युपेत्याद्भुतघोरवीर्यं; स कुम्भकर्णो युधि वानरेन्द्रम् । जहार सुग्रीवमभिप्रगृह्य; यथानिलो मेघमतिप्रचण्डः ॥
data.es: Kumbhakarna approaching the Vanara Lord Sugriva endowed with wonderful and dreadful prowess, went like wind carrying clouds taking him.
data.anv: सः he, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, युधि battle, अद्भुतघोरवीर्यम् wonderful and dreadful valour, वानरेन्द्रम् Vanara Lord, तंसुग्रीवम् that Sugriva, अभिप्रगृह्य taking up again, अतिप्रचण्डः highly tempestuous, अनिलः wind, मेघंयथा like cloud, जहार took him.
data.md: Then Kumbhakarna coming to the wonderfully mighty master of monkeys, took him up and stole away from the field, as a violent gust of wind steal away a patch of cloud.

data.v: स तं महामेघनिकाशरूप;मुत्पाट्य गच्छन्युधि कुम्भकर्णः । रराज मेरुप्रतिमानरूपो; मेरुर्यथात्युच्छ्रितघोरशृङ्गः ॥
data.es: In the battlefield, the form of Kumbhakarna which resembled a huge cloud was distinguished in appearance like the lofty peak of mountain Meru.
data.anv: युधि in the battlefield, महामेघनिकाशरूपम् form which resembled huge cloud, तम् him, उत्पाट्य lifting, गच्छन् went, मेरुप्रतिमानरूपः form of Meru mountain, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, अभ्युछ्रचितघोरशृङ्गः distinguished by lofty peak, मेरुर्यथा like Meru, रराज seemed.
data.md: Kumbhakarņa, who resembled a mountain in loftiness of stature, while taking him away like a mass of cloud appeared like Sumeru overtopped with lofty peaks.

data.v: ततः समुत्पाट्य जगाम वीरः; संस्तूयमानो युधि राक्षसेन्द्रैः । शृण्वन्निनादं त्रिदशालयानां; प्लवंगराजग्रहविस्मितानाम् ॥
data.es: Thereafter the heroic Rakshasa king having held Sugriva in the battle went, duly praised (by Rakshasas), hearing the roaring sounds of gods in heaven wondering at Sugriva's capture.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, वीरः hero, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, तम् his, आदाय taking hold, युधि in battle, संस्तूयमानः praising, प्लवङ्गराजग्रहविस्मितानाम् wondered at Sugriva's capture, त्रिदिवालयानाम् , निनादम् roaring sounds, शृण्वन् hearing, जगाम went.
data.md: Thus the lord of Rākşasas went on hearing thanks (from the Rākşasas) and shouts from the lords of the heavens, wondered at the capture of the foremost of monkeys.

data.v: ततस्तमादाय तदा स मेने; हरीन्द्रमिन्द्रोपममिन्द्रवीर्यः । अस्मिन्हृते सर्वमिदं हृतं स्या;त्सराघवं सैन्यमितीन्द्रशत्रुः ॥
data.es: Then Kumbhakarna, an enemy of Indra, who was equal to Indra in heroism seizing Sugriva, the Indra of monkeys, who is equal to Indra, thought, 'If Sugriva is killed it is like killing all the army including Rama.'
data.anv: इन्द्रवीर्यः equal to Indra in heroism, इन्द्रशत्रुः Indra's enemy, सः he, ततः then, इन्द्रोपमम् like Indra, तम् him, हरीन्द्रम् Indra of monkeys, आदाय seizing, तदा then, अस्मिन् his, हते killed, सराघवम् having been killed, सर्वम् all, इदम् like this, सैन्यम् army, हतम् killed, स्यात् including, इति thus, मेने thought.
data.md: Thus taking him captive, that mighty one resembling Indra in puissance, thought his death would destroy the entire host of the opponents together with Rāghava.

data.v: विद्रुतां वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा वानराणां ततस्ततः । कुम्भकर्णेन सुग्रीवं गृहीतं चापि वानरम् ॥
data.es: Seeing the army running away here and there and Sugriva being captured by Kumbhakarna, wise Hanuman, the son of Maruti started thinking.
data.anv: मतिमान् wise one, मारुतात्मजः son of Maruti, हनुमान् Hanuman, इतस्ततः here and there, विद्रुताम् running away, वानराणाम् Vanaras, वाहिनीम् army, दृष्टवा seeing, वानरम् Vanaras, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, कुम्भकर्णेन Kumbhakarna, गृहीतंचापि being captured, चिन्तयामास started thinking.
data.md: Then Hanumān, the shrewd son of Maruta, finding the whole host of monkeys scattered in all directions, as well as Sugrīva captured by Kumbhakarņa bethought himself—“What ought to be done by me now that our king has been captured?

data.v: हनूमांश्चिन्तयामास मतिमान्मारुतात्मजः । एवं गृहीते सुग्रीवे किं कर्तव्यं मया भवेत् ॥
data.md: Then Hanumān, the shrewd son of Maruta, finding the whole host of monkeys scattered in all directions, as well as Sugrīva captured by Kumbhakarņa bethought himself—“What ought to be done by me now that our king has been captured?

data.v: यद्वै न्याय्यं मया कर्तुं तत्करिष्यामि सर्वथा । भूत्वा पर्वतसंकाशो नाशयिष्यामि राक्षसं ॥
data.es: 'Sugriva has been caught. What is my duty now? I will do what is just. I will destroy that Rakshasa who is in the form of a mountain', thought Maruti.
data.anv: सुग्रीवे Sugriva, एवम् in this way, गृहीते captured, मया my, किम् what, कर्तव्यम् duty, भवेत् will be, मया my, यत् that which, कर्तुम् will do, न्याय्यम् justice, तत् that, सर्वधा thought, करिष्यामि will do, पर्वतसङ्काशः one who is like a mountain, भूत्वा to be done, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, नाशयिष्यामि will destroy.
data.md: I will doubtless do as befits me now let me assume the shape of a mountain and kill the Raksasas.

data.v: मया हते संयति कुम्भकर्णे; महाबले मुष्टिविशीर्णदेहे । विमोचिते वानरपार्थिवे च; भवन्तु हृष्टाः प्रवगाः समग्राः ॥
data.es: 'Mighty Kumbhakarna shattered by my fist in a duel, and the king of Vanaras delivered, all the monkeys will be rejoiced.'
data.anv: महाबले mighty, कुम्भकर्णे Kumbhakarna, मुष्टिविशीर्णदेहे shattered hit by fist, संयति in duel, मया by me, हते killed, वानरपार्थिवे Vanara king विमोचिते delivered, समस्ताः all, प्लवगाः monkeys, हृष्टाः rejoice, भवन्तु will be.
data.md: Let me kill the mighty Kumbhakarņa, splitting his body with my strong fist and thus relive the master of monkeys—thus let the whole host of monkeys become delighted.

data.v: अथ वा स्वयमप्येष मोक्षं प्राप्स्यति पार्थिवः । गृहीतोऽयं यदि भवेत्त्रिदशैः सासुरोरगैः ॥
data.es: 'Or else this Sugriva alone can get liberated by fighting by himself with gods, demons and Nagas also, even if he is captured'.
data.anv: अथवा or else, अयम् एषः he alone, पार्थिव remain, सासुरोरगैः Nagas, gods and demons त्रिदशैः all the three, गृहीतः captured, भवेद्यदि by himself, स्वयम् himself, मोक्षम् liberate, प्राप्स्यति will attain.
data.md: Or, even when captured by the whole host of gods or Asuras or serpents he is mighty enough to extricate himself.

data.v: मन्ये न तावदात्मानं बुध्यते वानराधिपः । शैलप्रहाराभिहतः कुम्भकर्णेन संयुगे ॥
data.es: "I think that Sugriva, hit by Kumbhakarna with a mountain, has lost senses and is not able to know."
data.anv: संयुगे in battle, कुम्भकर्णेन Kumbhakarna, शैलप्रहाराभिहतः hit by mountain and lost senses, वानराधिपः Vanara leader, आत्मानम् himself, न बुध्यतेतावत् not able to know, मन्ये I think.
data.md: Meseems, the lord of monkeys struck with dart in battle by Kumbhakarna has not yet recovered his senses.

data.v: अयं मुहूर्तात्सुग्रीवो लब्धसंज्ञो महाहवे । आत्मनो वानराणां च यत्पथ्यं तत्करिष्यति ॥
data.es: Sugriva will soon regain consciousness and do what is good for Vanaras.
data.anv: अयम् I, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, महाहवे gaining consciousness, मुहूर्तात् soon, लब्दसंज्ञः regaining senses, आत्मनः himself, वानराणां च Vanaras also, यत् that which, पथ्यम् good, तत् that, करिष्यति will do.
data.md: Else in a moment he would do the needful for himself as well as the monkeys.

data.v: मया तु मोक्षितस्यास्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः । अप्रीतश्च भवेत्कष्टा कीर्तिनाशश्च शाश्वतः ॥
data.es: "If Sugriva is released by me, he will not be happy forever. His fame will be lost."
data.anv: मया I, मेक्षितस्य if released, महात्मनः great soul, अस्य his, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, कष्टा caused, अप्रीतिश्च not happy, शाश्वतः ever, कीर्तिनाशश्च fame lost, भवेत् will be.
data.md: Should the relief of the mighty-minded Sugrīva come from me, I should be incurring his displeasure and it would certainly lead to the loss of his reputation for ever; then I must wait a moment and see his own mighty displayed by himself when relieved. Meanwhile let me cheer up the monkey-host.

data.v: तस्मान्मुहूर्तं काङ्क्षिष्ये विक्रमं पार्थिवस्य नः । भिन्नं च वानरानीकं तावदाश्वासयाम्यहम् ॥
data.es: "Therefore, I will see the exhibition of his prowess for a while. Thereafter I shall reinforce the scattered army of Vanaras."
data.anv: तस्मात् therefore, मुहूर्तम् for a while, पार्थिवस्य exhibition, विक्रमम् of prowess, काङ्क्षिष्ये see, तावत् thereafter, भिन्नम् scattered, वानरानीकम् Vanara army, अहम् I, आश्वासयामि will reinforce.

data.v: इत्येवं चिन्तयित्वा तु हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः । भूयः संस्तम्भयामास वानराणां महाचमूम् ॥
data.es: Hanuman, the son of Maruti thinking in this way said to the Vanara army and brought determination.
data.anv: मारुतात्मज son of Maruti, हनुमान् Hanuman, इत्येवम् in this way, चिन्तयित्वा thinking, अथ then, भूयः said, वानराणाम् to Vanaras, महाचमूम् huge army, संस्तम्भयामास brought determination.
data.md: Thinking thus within himself, Hanumăn, that son of Maruta, began to stay the mighty host of Monkeys.

data.v: स कुम्भकर्णोऽथ विवेश लङ्कां; स्फुरन्तमादाय महाहरिं तम् । विमानचर्यागृहगोपुरस्थैः; पुष्पाग्र्यवर्षैरवकीर्यमाणः ॥
data.es: Then Kumbhakarna taking the great Vanara who started to shake by then, entered Lanka through the roads of lofty mansions from where Rakshasas hailed showering flowers.
data.anv: अत then, सःकुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, स्फुरन्तम् shaking, तम् his, महाकपिम् great Vanara, आदाय taking, विमानचर्यागृहगोपुरस्थैः through the roads of lofty mansions, पुष्पाग्य्रवर्षैः showered with flowers, अवकीर्यमाणः hailed by Rakshasas, लङ्काम् Lanka, विवेश entered.
data.md: In the meantime Kumbhakarņa entered Lankā with Sugrīva trembling, being honoured with the showering of beautiful flowers from the sky, the buildings on the main roads and the town-gate.

data.v: ततः स संज्ञामुपलभ्य कृच्छ्रा;द्बलीयसस्तस्य भुजान्तरस्थः । अवेक्षमाणः पुरराजमार्गं; विचिन्तयामास मुहुर्महात्मा ॥
data.es: (Sugriva) being strong and painfully gained senses, from the arms of the great Rakshasa, started looking at the royal path of the city. He was bewildered and started pondering this way.
data.anv: बलीयसः being strong, तस्य his, भुजान्तरस्थः from the arms, महात्मा great, सः he, कृच्छ्रात् painfully, संज्ञाम् senses, उपलभ्य having gained, पुरराजमार्गम् royal path of the city, अवेक्षमाणः started looking, मुहुः bewildered, विचिन्तयामास started pondering.
data.md: Then that mighty-minded (Sugriva), caught in the arms of the powerful Räksasa, having with difficulty come to his senses and surveying around him the streets of the town bethought himself.

data.v: एवं गृहीतेन कथं नु नाम; शक्यं मया संप्रति कर्तुमद्य । तथा करिष्यामि यथा हरीणां; भविष्यतीष्टं च हितं च कार्यम् ॥
data.es: 'Caught in this way, how can I do (take action)? I will do what is possible, pleasing, and good to Vanaras now.'
data.anv: एवम् in that way, गृहीतेन caught, मया my, सम्प्रति taken, कथम् how, कर्तुम् What to do, शक्यम् possible, हरीणाम् to Vanaras, इष्टम् pleasing, हितं च good, कार्यम् task, यथा by which, भविष्यति will do, तथा that way, अद्य now, करिष्यामि will do.
data.md: When thus within the grasp of the enemy how can I take revenge? Or let me do what will be acceptable and advantageous to our army.

data.v: ततः कराग्रैः सहसा समेत्य; राजा हरीणाममरेन्द्रशत्रोः । नखैश्च कर्णौ दशनैश्च नासां; ददंश पार्श्वेषु च कुम्भकर्णम् ॥
data.es: There after the king of Vanaras decided to act and tore off the ears of the enemy ruler of gods (Kumbhakarna) with his sharp nails, bit off the nose with his teeth, and sides of Kumbhakarna.
data.anv: हरीणाम् Vanaras, राजा king, समेत्य deciding, ततः thereafter, खरैः ears, कराग्रैः with sharp nails, अमरेन्द्रशत्रोः enemy of the ruler of gods, कर्णौ ears, दशनैः with teeth, नासाम् nose, पार्श्वेषु sides, कुम्भकर्ण Kumbhakarna, ददंश bit off.
data.md: Then advancing all on a sudden, he with his nails and sharp teeth cut off the ears and nose of that lord of the enemies of the gods and split both his sides with the blow of his feet.

data.v: स कुम्भकर्णौ हृतकर्णनासो; विदारितस्तेन विमर्दितश्च । रोषाभिभूतः क्षतजार्द्रगात्रः; सुग्रीवमाविध्य पिपेष भूमौ ॥
data.es: Deprived of ears and nose by Sugriva, splitting with nails and teeth, Kumbhakarna was highly furious and pinning down Sugriva pounded him against the ground, limbs bespattered.
data.anv: तेन by him (Sugriva), रदैः teeth, नखैश्च with nails, विदारितः splitting, हृतकर्णनासः deprived of ears and nose, सःकुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, रोषाभिघातः highly furious, क्षतजार्द्रगात्रः limbs bespattered, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, भूमौ ground, आविध्य against, पिपेष pounded.
data.md: Kumbhakarņa losing his ears and nose and having his sides split with nails and teeth grew angry, and becoming all covered over with blood, threw Sugrīva to the ground and pressed him.

data.v: स भूतले भीमबलाभिपिष्टः; सुरारिभिस्तैरभिहन्यमानः । जगाम खं वेगवदभ्युपेत्य; पुनश्च रामेण समाजगाम ॥
data.es: Dropped on the ground by Kumbhakarna of dreadful strength, pressed against the ground surface, Sugriva bounced to the sky to get reunited with Rama.
data.anv: भूतले on the ground, भीमबलाभिपिष्टः of dreadful strength, तैः they, सुरारिभिः by enemies of god, अभिहन्यमानः pressed against the ground, सः he, वेगवत् with speed, अभ्युपेत्य bounced, खम् sky, जगाम reached, पुनश्च again, रामेण to Rama, समाजगाम reunited.
data.md: Thus pressed upon the ground with main force and severely struck by the enemies of gods, he flew to the skies like a ball-rolling, and once morejoined Rāma.

data.v: कर्णनासा विहीनस्य कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः । रराज शोणितोत्सिक्तो गिरिः प्रस्रवणैरिव ॥
data.es: Great hero Kumbhakarna, devoid of ears and nose drenched in blood shone like a mountain in springs.
data.anv: कर्णनासाविहीनः devoid of nose and ears, महाबलः great hero, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, शोणितैः with blood, सिक्तः drenched, प्रस्रवणैः like springs, गिरिःइव like mountain, रराज shone.
data.md: The mighty Kumbhakarna having lost his nose and ears and drenched in blood, appeared like a mountain covered all over with streamlets.

data.v: ततः स पुर्याः सहसा महात्मा; निष्क्रम्य तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रम् । बभक्ष रक्षो युधि कुम्भकर्णः; प्रजा युगान्ताग्निरिव प्रदीप्तः ॥
data.es: Thereafter, Ravana possessed with great splendour stopped at the city and saw the army of Vanaras collected together looking like an ocean of clouds wielding trees and rocks.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, महौजाः possessed with great splendour, सहसा forcibly, नगर्याः at the city, निष्क्रम्य stopped, उग्रम् in front, महार्णवाभ्रस्तनितम् resembling great ocean and cloud, समुद्यतम् collected together, पादपशैलहस्तम् taking trees and rocks, तत् वानरसैन्यम् the Vanara army, ददर्श saw.
data.md: Then that mighty-minded one, the Raksasa Kumbhakarņa, issuing out of the city began to devour the terrific host of monkeys, as do the mighty fire eat up people at the end of a Yuga.

data.v: बुभुक्षितः शोणितमांसगृध्नुः; प्रविश्य तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रम् । चखाद रक्षांसि हरीन्पिशाचा;नृक्षांश्च मोहाद्युधि कुम्भकर्णः ॥
data.es: Kumbhakarna started seizing principal monkeys in the same way as death at the end of universe. Being famished for flesh and blood he entered the Vanara army in delusion and consumed not only Vanaras but Rakshasas, demons and bears also.
data.anv: बुभुक्षितः consumed, शोणितमांसगृध्नुः blood and flesh, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, उग्रम् ferocious, तत् that, वानरसैन्यम् Vanara army, प्रविश्य entering, युधि battle, मोहात् delusion, रक्षांसि Rakshasas also, हरीन् Vanaras, पिशाचान् demons, ऋक्षान् च Bears, चखाद entering, युगान्ते at the end of universe, मृत्युः death, यथैव like the same way, हरते seizing, मुख्यान् principal, हरीन् Vanaras, भक्ष्यामास started consuming.
data.md: On entering the mighty host of monkeys, the hungry Kumbhakarna, hankering after flesh and blood, ate up the monkeys and with them, devoured many a Rākşasa and Piśāca by, mistake. Thus, as Death devour creatures at the end of a Yuga, he destroyed the mighty monkeys.

data.v: एकं द्वौ त्रीन्बहून्क्रुद्धो वानरान्सह राक्षसैः । समादायैकहस्तेन प्रचिक्षेप त्वरन्मुखे ॥
data.es: Taking one, two, three, and many Vanaras along with Rakshasas hastily with one hand he was gulping them.
data.anv: क्रुद्धः enraged, त्वरन् hastily, एकहस्तेन with one hand, समादाय taking, राक्षसैःसह Rakshasas, वानरान् Vanaras, एकम् alone, द्वौ two, त्रीन् three, बहून् many, मुखे mouth, प्रचिक्षेप gulping them.
data.md: He in wrath, taking up with one hand the monkeys along with the Rākṣasa, hurriedly threw them into his mouth, one, two three, or many at a time.

data.v: संप्रस्रवंस्तदा मेदः शोणितं च महाबलः । वध्यमानो नगेन्द्राग्रैर्भक्षयामास वानरान् । ते भक्ष्यमाणा हरयो रामं जग्मुस्तदा गतिम् ॥
data.es: Then the mighty Kumbhakarna while being struck by peaks of mountains, he was feasting on Vanaras fat and blood oozing out from his mouth.
data.anv: तदा then, महाबलः mighty, नगेन्द्राग्रैः peaks of mountains, वध्यमानः while being struck, मेदःशोणिते brain and blood, सम्प्रस्रवन् oozing out, वानरान् Vanaras, भक्ष्यामास feasting.
data.md: And blood and fat flowed copiously down his body; and though struck by the monkeys with peaks of mountains, the mighty one devoured all those monkeys.

data.v: तस्मिन्काले सुमित्रायाः पुत्रः परबलार्दनः । चकार लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धो युद्धं परपुरंजयः ॥
data.es: At that time, Sumitra's son, Lakshmana, winner of enemy forces, conqueror of forts, enraged went to fight.
data.anv: तस्मिन् at that, काले time, सुमित्रायाः Sumitra's, पुत्रः son, परबलार्दनः winner of enemy forces, परपुरञ्जयः conqueror of forts, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, क्रुद्धः enraged, युद्धम् fight, चकार went.
data.md: At this moment, that subduer of hostile hosts and captor of the capitals of foes-Sumitra's son-Laksmana, growing enraged, entered on an encounter with the enemy.

data.v: स कुम्भकर्णस्य शराञ्शरीरे सप्त वीर्यवान् । निचखानाददे चान्यान्विससर्ज च लक्ष्मणः ॥
data.es: Valiant Lakshmana pierced seven arrows on Kumbhakarna's body and discharged many arrows on him.
data.anv: वीर्यवान् valiant one, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, शरीरे body, सप्त seven, शरान् arrows, निचखान pierced, अन्यान् other, आददे seizing, विससर्ज च discharged.
data.md: Lakşamna endued with prowess shot seven shafts at Kumbhakarma's body; and next, taking up other arrows also discharged them (at his antagonist).

data.v: अतिक्रम्य च सौमित्रिं कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः । राममेवाभिदुद्राव दारयन्निव मेदिनीम् ॥
data.es: Kumbhakarna of mighty strength, the night ranger hearing Lakshmana, rather disregarding his words, overlooking him went alone towards Rama as if shaking the earth.
data.anv: निशाचरः night ranger, महाबलः of mighty strength, सःकुम्भकर्णः he, Kumbhakarna, इति thus, श्रुत्वा hearing, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, अनादृत्य disregarding, सौमित्रिम् Lakshmana, अतिक्रम्य च overlooking, मेदिनम् earth, कम्पयन्निव to shake, राममेव Rama alone, अभिदुद्राव rushed towards.
data.md: Hearing this, that night-ranger Kumbhakarna, possessed of immense might, disregarding Laks maņa and passing beyond Sumitrā's son, rushed against Rāma, making the earth tremble.

data.v: अथ दाशरथी रामो रौद्रमस्त्रं प्रयोजयन् । कुम्भकर्णस्य हृदये ससर्ज निशिताञ्शरान् ॥
data.es: Sri Rama, son of Dasaratha, now released a sharp arrow presided over by Rudra and fixed into the chest of Kumbhakarna.
data.anv: अथ now, दाशरथिः Dasaratha's son, रामः Rama, रौद्रम् presided by Rudra, अस्त्रम् weapon, प्रयोजयन् released, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, हृदये into the chest, निशितान् sharp, शरान् arrow, ससर्ज fixed.
data.md: Thereat Dasaratha's son, Rāma, employing a terrific weapon, discharged sharpened shafts at Kumbhakarņa's breast.

data.v: तस्य रामेण विद्धस्य सहसाभिप्रधावतः । अङ्गारमिश्राः क्रुद्धस्य मुखान्निश्चेरुरर्चिषः ॥
data.es: As Rama hit in anger, at once fire mixed with flames shot forth from Kumbhakarna's mouth.
data.anv: रामेण by Rama, विद्धस्य hit, सहसा at once, अभिप्रधावतः towards, क्रुद्धस्य in anger, तस्य his, मुखात् mouth, अङ्गारमिश्राः fire mixed with flame, अर्चिषः flames, निश्चेरुः shot forth.
data.md: Thereat flames mixed with live embers shot out from the mouth of that enraged one suddenly rushing (against Răma), as Rama pierced him (with his arrows).

data.v: तस्योरसि निमग्नाश्च शरा बर्हिणवाससः । हस्ताच्चास्य परिभ्रष्टा पपातोर्व्यां महागदा ॥
data.es: Adorned by peacock's plumes, those arrows slipped into his breast, he lost senses, his mace naturally dropped down from his hand.
data.anv: बर्हिणवाससः adorned by peacock's plumes, तेशराः those arrows, तस्य his, उरसि breast, निमग्नाः lost senses, अस्य his, हस्तात् from hand, परिभ्रष्टा slipped, गदा mace, उर्व्याम् naturally, पपात ह fallen.

data.v: स निरायुधमात्मानं यदा मेने महाबलः । मुष्टिभ्यां चारणाभ्यां च चकार कदनं महत् ॥
data.es: All his weapons scattered on the ground, the mighty Kumbhakarna deprived of weapons thought for himself and created havoc with his feet and fists.
data.anv: सर्वाणि all, आयुधानि weapons, भूतले on ground, विप्राकीर्यन्त scattered, महाबलः mighty, सः he, यदा in that, आत्मानम् himself, निरायुधम् deprived of weapons, मेने thought, मुष्टिभ्यां च with fists, चरणाभ्यां च and feet, महत् great, कदनम् senses, चकार created havoc.

data.v: स बाणैरतिविद्धाङ्गः क्षतजेन समुक्षितः । रुधिरं परिसुस्राव गिरिः प्रस्रवणानिव ॥
data.es: Pierced by arrows excessively all over his limbs, bathing in blood flowing from the injury was like a mountain with a spring.
data.anv: बाणैः arrows, अतिविद्धाङ्गः pierced all over excessively his limbs, क्षतजेन blood produced by injury, समुक्षितः produced from, सः he, गिरिः mountain, प्रस्रवणयथा like pouring, रुधिरम् blood, परिसुस्राव flowed.
data.md: With his body entirely covered with arrows and bathed in blood, he began to bleed like a hill overflowing with fountains.

data.v: स तीव्रेण च कोपेन रुधिरेण च मूर्छितः । वानरान्राक्षसानृक्षान्खादन्विपरिधावति ॥
data.es: Kumbhakarna in violent anger, blood flowing from the injury, went about devouring Vanaras, Rakshasas and bears.
data.anv: सः he, तीव्रेण violent, कोपेन in anger, रुधिरेणच by blood, मूर्छितः intensified, सः he, वानरान् Vanaras, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, ऋक्षान् Bears, खादन् eating, विपरिधावति went about.
data.md: And fired with wrath and maddened with blood, he rushed on, devouring monkeys and Rākşasas and bears.

data.v: तस्मिन्काले स धर्मात्मा लक्ष्मणो राममब्रवीत् । कुम्भकर्णवधे युक्तो योगान्परिमृशन्बहून् ॥
data.es: At that time, righteous Lakshmana who was attentively deliberating on many plans to kill Kumbhakarna, said to Rama.
data.anv: तस्मिन् at that, काले time, धर्मात्मा righteous, कुम्भकर्णवधे for killing Kumbhakarna, युक्तः plans, बहून् many, योगान् attentive, परिमृशन् deliberating, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, रामम् to Rama, अब्रवीत् said.
data.md: Intent on finishing Kumbhakarņa, the virtuous Laksmana, revolving many a means, (at last) spoke to Rāma.

data.v: नैवायं वानरान्राजन्न विजानाति राक्षसान् । मत्तः शोणितगन्धेन स्वान्परांश्चैव खादति ॥
data.es: "This king intoxicated with the smell of blood is not knowing his own people and foes and devouring both Vanaras and Rakshasas."
data.anv: राजन् king, अयम् this, वानरान् Vanaras, नैवविजानाति not knowing, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, न nor, शोणितगन्धेन smell of blood, मत्तः intoxicated, स्वान् his people, परांश्चव foes, खादते devouring.
data.md: O king, this one know not monkeys and Rākşasas, maddened with the smell of blood, he eat up his own as well as his enemies.

data.v: साध्वेनमधिरोहन्तु सर्वतो वानरर्षभाः । यूथपाश्च यथामुख्यास्तिष्ठन्त्वस्य समन्ततः ॥
data.es: Let the bulls among Vanaras climb upon him and the foremost of Vanaras and the troops stand all over.
data.anv: वानरर्षभाः bull among Vanaras, एनम् on him, साधु proper सर्वतः all over, अधिरोहस्तु climb up, यथामुख्याः foremost like that, यूथपाश्च troops also, अस्य his, समन्ततः all over, तिष्ठन्तु stand.
data.md: Now let the foremost monkeys, putting forth their best mount on him; and let the leaders of bands according to their rank, stand surrounding him.

data.v: अप्ययं दुर्मतिः काले गुरुभारप्रपीडितः । प्रपतन्राक्षसो भूमौ नान्यान्हन्यात्प्लवंगमान् ॥
data.es: Distressed by heavy weight unable to get up evil minded Rakshasa fallen on the ground will not destroy monkeys.
data.anv: अप्ययं minded, राक्षसः Rakshasa, भूमौ on the ground, प्रपत fallen, अन्यान् others, प्लवङ्गमान् monkeys, न हन्यात् not destroy.
data.md: Then today this wicked-minded Rākşasa, oppressed with a mighty weight, will no longer be able to eat up any more monkeys.

data.v: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राजपुत्रस्य धीमतः । ते समारुरुहुर्हृष्टाः कुम्भकर्णं प्लवंगमाः ॥
data.es: Having heard the words of the wise Prince, the monkeys collected climbed on Kumbhakarna happily.
data.anv: धीमतः wise, तस्यराजपुत्रस्य that, तत् those, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, ते those, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, हृष्टाः happily, कुम्भकर्णम् on Kumbhakarna, समारुरुहुः collected.
data.md: Hearing the words of the intelligent prince, those exceedingly powerful monkeys with alacrity ascended Kumbhakarņa.

data.v: कुम्भकर्णस्तु संक्रुद्धः समारूढः प्लवंगमैः । व्यधूनयत्तान्वेगेन दुष्टहस्तीव हस्तिपान् ॥
data.es: Enraged Kumbhakarna shook off the monkeys climbed on his body like a harsh elephant shakes off its rider.
data.anv: प्लवङ्गमैः on monkeys, समारूढः climbed up कुम्भकर्णस्तु on Kumbhakarna, सङ्ककृद्धः very angry, दुष्टहस्ती harsh elephant, हस्तिपान् इव rider, आन् blowing, वेगेन speedily, व्यधूनयत् shook off.
data.md: Kumbhakarna mounted by those monkeys, waxing exceedingly enraged, shook them vehemently, even as mad elephants shake the drivers thereof,

data.v: तान्दृष्ट्वा निर्धूतान्रामो रुष्टोऽयमिति राक्षसः । समुत्पपात वेगेन धनुरुत्तममाददे ॥
data.es: Seeing the Vanaras shaken, Rama went towards the Rakshasa instantly and took out his best bow.
data.anv: रामः Rama, निर्धुतान् shaken off, तान् them, दृष्टवा seeing, अयम् that, दुष्टःइति thus seeing, राक्षसम् towards Rakshasa, वेगेन at speed, समुत्पपात took out, उत्तमम् the best, धनुः bow, आददे went towards.
data.md: Rāghava seeing them shaken, and concluding the Rāksasa to be wroth, furiously sprang forward, taking his bow.

data.v: स चापमादाय भुजंगकल्पं; दृढज्यमुग्रं तपनीयचित्रम् । हरीन्समाश्वास्य समुत्पपात; रामो निबद्धोत्तमतूणबाणः ॥
data.es: Rama, taking a formidable bow which resembled a great serpent, with a quiver full of excellent arrows shining in gold that looked beautiful, went forward restoring the confidence of the monkeys.
data.anv: सःरामः that Rama, भुजङ्गकल्पम् resembled a great serpent, धृढज्यम् formidable, उग्रम् frightening, तपनीय shining with polished gold चित्रम् beautiful, चापम् bow, आदाय taking, हरीन् , monkey, समाश्वास्य restoring confidence, निबद्धोत्तमतूणबाणः with quiver full of excellent arrows fastened, समुत्पपात went forward.
data.md: And equipped with an excellent quiver and arrows, Rāma checring up the monkeys sprang forward, taking a bow, resembling a serpent; terrific; having a stout string; and embellished in gold.

data.v: स वानरगणैस्तैस्तु वृतः परमदुर्जयः । लक्ष्मणानुचरो रामः संप्रतस्थे महाबलः ॥
data.es: Mighty Rama, who is extremely difficult to win over, went with full conviction followed by Lakshmana and surrounded by vanara troops.
data.anv: परमदुर्जयः extremely difficult to win over, लक्ष्मणानुचरः followed by Lakshmana, रामः Rama, महाबलः mighty, तु also, तैः both, वानरगणैः Vanara troops, वृतः surrounded by, सम्प्रतस्थे went with full conviction.
data.md: Then surrounded by exceedingly invincible monkey-bands, that highly powerful hero, followed by Laksmana, marched forth.

data.v: स ददर्श महात्मानं किरीटिनमरिंदमम् । शोणिताप्लुतसर्वाङ्गं कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ॥
data.es: Great Rama, endowed with extraordinary might, saw Kumbhakarna, the tamer of enemies covered with blood and having red eyes.
data.anv: महाबलम् extraordinary might, सः he, महात्मानम् great Rama, किरीटिनम् adorned with crown, अरिन्दमम् tamer of foes, शोणितावृतरक्ताक्षम् covered with blood, and having red eyes, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, ददर्श saw.

data.v: सर्वान्समभिधावन्तं यथारुष्टं दिशा गजम् । मार्गमाणं हरीन्क्रुद्धं राक्षसैः परिवारितम् ॥
data.es: Surrounded by Rakshasas, he was searching for Vanaras, like an elephant, guarding a quarter, searches.
data.anv: दुष्टम् saw, दिशागजंयथा like elephant guarding the quarter, सर्वान् all, समभिधावन्तम् pursuing, हरीन् for Vanaras, मार्गमाणम् searching, क्रुद्धम् angry, राक्षसैः Rakshasa, परिवारितम् surrounded.

data.v: विन्ध्यमन्दरसंकाशं काञ्चनाङ्गदभूषणम् । स्रवन्तं रुधिरं वक्त्राद्वर्षमेघमिवोत्थितम् ॥
data.es: (Kumbhakarna) Adorned with gold armlets, blood flowing from his mouth was like a rain cloud showering from Vindhya or Mandara mountain.
data.anv: व्निध्यमन्दरसङ्काशम् like Vindhya or Mandara, काञ्चनाङ्गदभूषणम् adorned with gold armlets, वक्त्रात् from the mouth, रुधिरम् blood, स्रवन्तम् flowing, उथतितम् ejecting, वर्षामेघामिव like a rain cloud.

data.v: जिह्वया परिलिह्यन्तं शोणितं शोणितोक्षितम् । मृद्नन्तं वानरानीकं कालान्तकयमोपमम् ॥
data.es: With blood red eyes, licking the corner of his mouth with his tongue, crushing Vanara army, he looked like God of Death at dissolution.
data.anv: शोणितेक्षणम् blood red eyes, सृक्किणी corner of the mouth, जिह्वया with tongue, परिलिह्यन्तम् licking, वानरानीकम् Vanara army, मृद्नन्तम् crushing, कालान्तकयमोपमम् resembling god of death at dissolution.

data.v: तं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसश्रेष्ठं प्रदीप्तानलवर्चसं । विस्फारयामास तदा कार्मुकं पुरुषर्षभः ॥
data.es: Seeing the foremost of Rakshasas, shining like fire, Rama, the bull among men stretched his bow.
data.anv: पुरुषर्षभः bull among men, प्रदीप्तानलतेजसम् shining like fire, तम् him, राक्षसश्रेष्ठम् foremost of Rakshasas, दृष्टवा seeing, तदा then, कार्मुकम् bow. विस्फारयामास stretched.
data.md: That best of persons, seeing that foremost of Rākṣasas having the splendour of a living fire, stretched his bow to its full bent.

data.v: स तस्य चापनिर्घोषात्कुपितो नैरृतर्षभः । अमृष्यमाणस्तं घोषमभिदुद्राव राघवम् ॥
data.es: Enraged by the loud sound of the twang of the bow, the bull among Rakshasas unable to bear rushed towards Raghava.
data.anv: तस्य his, चापनिर्घोषात् twang of bow, कुपितः enraged, सः he, राक्षसर्षभः bull among Rakshasas, तंघोषम् that loud sound, अमृष्यमाणदु unable to bear, राघवम् Raghava, अभिदुद्राव rushed.
data.md: And fired with wrath at the twang of his bow, that foremost of Raksasas, inflamed with wrath, not brooking that report, rushed against Rāghava.

data.v: ततस्तु वातोद्धतमेघकल्पं; भुजंगराजोत्तमभोगबाहुम् । तमापतन्तं धरणीधराभ;मुवाच रामो युधि कुम्भकर्णम् ॥
data.es: Thereafter Rama spoke to Kumbhakarna, whose hands were like Vasuki's body, coming towards him to attack on the battlefield like a cloud chased by wind.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, रामः Rama, वातोद्धतमेघकल्पम् like a cloud chased by wind, भजङ्गराजोत्तमभोगबाहुम् one whose hands were like Vasuki's body, धरणीधराभम् mountain like, युधि battlefield, आपतन्तम् coming to attack, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, उवाच spoke.
data.md: Thereat, the gentle Rāma, endowed with arms resembling the body of the sovereign of serpents, in that encounter addressed Kumbhakarņa, like to an elevated cloud and possessed of the splendour of a mountain, as he darted forward, saying.

data.v: आगच्छ रक्षोऽधिपमा विषाद;मवस्थितोऽहं प्रगृहीतचापः । अवेहि मां शक्रसपत्न राम;मयं मुहूर्ताद्भविता विचेताः ॥
data.es: "O king of Rakshasas! Come. Do not be despondent. I stand with my bow. In a moment I will destroy you. Look, the Rakshasa clan will be put to an end."
data.anv: रक्षोधिप Rakshasa king, आगच्छ come, विषादम् despondency, मा to me, अहम् I, प्रगृहीताचापः with bow, अवस्थितः stand, यःत्वम् so that, मुहूर्तात् in a moment, विचेताः destroy, भविता you, माम् by me, राक्षसवंशनाशनम् Rakshasa clan will be destroyed, अवेहि look.
data.md: Come, O king of Rākşasa! Let no grief be your! Here I stay, taking my bow in my hand. Know me for the destroyer of the race of the Rākṣasas—you who in a moment shall be deprived of your senses.

data.v: रामोऽयमिति विज्ञाय जहास विकृतस्वनम् । पातयन्निव सर्वेषां हृदयानि वनौकसाम् ॥
data.es: Knowing that this is Rama, Kumbhakarna laughed in an unnatural manner making a sound and ran after scattering the monkeys in great rage.
data.anv: अयम् this, रामःइति this is Rama, विज्ञाय victory, विकृतस्वनम् unnatural sound, जहास laughed, सङ्ककृद्धः great rage, रणे battle, हरीन् monkeys, वित्रासयन् scattered, अभ्यधावत ran after.

data.v: प्रहस्य विकृतं भीमं स मेघस्वनितोपमम् । कुम्भकर्णो महातेजा राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Highly energetic Kumbhakarna laughing in hideous ways making sounds like rumblings of clouds breaking the hearts of forest rangers spoke these words.
data.anv: महातेजाः highly energetic, सःकुम्भकर्णः that Kumbhakarna, सर्वेषाम् all over, वनौकसाम् forest rangers, हृदयानि hearts, दारयन्निव breaking, विकृतम् hideous manner, भीमम् terrific, मेघस्न्तितोपमम् like the rumbling sound of clouds, प्रहस्य laughing, राघवम् Raghava, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

data.v: नाहं विराधो विज्ञेयो न कबन्धः खरो न च । न वाली न च मारीचः कुम्भकर्णोऽहमागतः ॥
data.es: "I am not Viradha, not Vijeya, not Kabhanda, not also Vali or Maricha. I am Kumbhakarna and have come."
data.anv: अहम् I am, विराधः Viradha, न विज्ञेयः not Vijeya, कबन्दः Kabhanda, न not, खरः Khara, नच not also, वाली Vali, न not, मारीचः च Maricha also, न not, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, समागतः have come.

data.v: पश्य मे मुद्गरं घोरं सर्वकालायसं महत् । अनेन निर्जिता देवा दानवाश्च मया पुरा ॥
data.es: "See my terrible club made of wrought iron. By this I have won earlier Devatas and Danavas."
data.anv: मे I, सर्वकालायसम् made of wrought iron, भीमम् terrible, महत् great, मुद्गरम् club, पश्य see, अनेन by this, पुरा earlier, देवाः Devas, दानवाश्च Danavas, निर्जिताः won.
data.md: Behold my dreadful and mighty mace entirely made of iron. By help of this I had formerly brought down deities and Dänavas.

data.v: विकर्णनास इति मां नावज्ञातुं त्वमर्हसि । स्वल्पापि हि न मे पीडा कर्णनासाविनाशनात् ॥
data.es: "Do not think I have been deprived of ears and nose and look with contempt. I do not have little pain."
data.anv: विकर्णनासःइति that I lost nose and ears, माम् me, त्वम् you, अवज्ञातुम् in contempt, न अर्हसि not look, कर्णनासाविनाशनात् deprived of ears and nose, मे myself, स्वल्पापि not a little, पीडा pained, न हि not have.
data.md: It does not behove you to scorn me in that my nose has been severed. I do not feel any the smallest torment in consequence of my ears and nose having been cut off.

data.v: दर्शयेक्ष्वाकुशार्दूल वीर्यं गात्रेषु मे लघु । ततस्त्वां भक्षयिष्यामि दृष्टपौरुषविक्रमम् ॥
data.es: "O Tiger of the Ikshvaku clan! Exhibit your manliness, prowess, and valour on me. I will eat you up later."
data.anv: इक्ष्वाकुशार्दूल tiger of Ikshvaku clan, मे myself, लघुगात्रेषु with, वीर्यम् valour, दर्शय exhibit, ततः that, दृष्टपौरुषविक्रमम् manliness and prowess, त्वाम् of yours, भक्षयिष्यामि will devour you.
data.md: O tiger of the Ikşvāku line, O sinless one, do you witness the prowess that is in my frame. And thereafter, when you shall have displayed your prowess and power, shall I devour you up.

data.v: स कुम्भकर्णस्य वचो निशम्य; रामः सुपुङ्खान्विससर्ज बाणान् । तैराहतो वज्रसमप्रवेगै;र्न चुक्षुभे न व्यथते सुरारिः ॥
data.es: On hearing Kumbhakarna's words Rama was bewildered. He discharged plumed arrows at a speed of thunderbolt. Struck by the arrows the enemy of Devatas was not shaken or agonized.
data.anv: सःरामः that Rama, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, वचः words, निशम्य bewildered, सपुङ्खान् plumed arrows, बाणान् arrows, विससर्ज discharged, वज्रसमवेगैः at the speed of thunderbolt, तैः those, आहतः having been struck, सुरारिः enemy of Devatas, न चुक्षुभे न व्यथते not shaken or agonized.
data.md: Hearing Kumbhakarna's words, Rama discharged (at him) shafts furnished with knobs. And smite with these having the impetus of the thunder-bolt, the foe of the celestials did not feel any pain or sinart.

data.v: यैः सायकैः सालवरा निकृत्ता; वाली हतो वानरपुंगवश्च । ते कुम्भकर्णस्य तदा शरीरं; वज्रोपमा न व्यथयां प्रचक्रुः ॥
data.es: Those arrows which had cut down the Sala trees and the Vanara leader, Vali, which were like thunderbolts, did not affect Kumbhakarna's body.
data.anv: यैः by that, सायकैः arrows, सालवराः Sala trees, निकृत्ताः cut down, वानरपुङ्गवः Vanara leaders, वाली च Vali also, हतः struck, ते that, तदा then, वज्रोपमम् like thunderbolt, कुम्भकर्णस्यशरीरम् Kumbhakarna's body, न व्यधयांप्रचक्रुः not able to affect him.
data.md: Those shafts which had severed the seven stately salas, and, to boot, had slain Vāli—best of monkeys, they resembling the thunder itselfcould not impart any pain to Kumbhakarņa's body.

data.v: स वारिधारा इव सायकांस्ता;न्पिबञ्शरीरेण महेन्द्रशत्रुः । जघान रामस्य शरप्रवेगं; व्याविध्य तं मुद्गरमुग्रवेगम् ॥
data.es: The enemy of Lord Indra drank the arrows through his body and hurled his club at great speed whirling it round and round arrested the arrows of Rama.
data.anv: तान् those, सायकान् arrows, वारिधाराःइव like torrents of water, शरीरेण into the body, पिबन् drank, सः he, महेन्द्रशत्रुः enemy of Lord Indra, उग्रवेगम् at great speed, तम् that, मुद्गरम् club, व्याविध्य whirling round, रामस्य Rama's, शरप्रवेगम् speed of arrows, जगाम arrested.
data.md: Drinking up in his body those arrows resembling a shower, the enemy of the great Indra whirling his mace possessed of fierce ventinence, put out the arrowy discharge of Rāma.

data.v: ततस्तु रक्षः क्षतजानुलिप्तं; वित्रासनं देवमहाचमूनाम् । व्याविध्य तं मुद्गरमुग्रवेगं; विद्रावयामास चमूं हरीणाम् ॥
data.es: Then Kumbhakarna with his club covered with blood and frightening even the celestials scattered the monkeys.
data.anv: ततः then, रक्षः Rakshasa, क्षतजावलिप्तम् covered with cuts and wounds, देवमहाचमूनाम् frightening even to the mighty celestials, वित्रासनम् covered with blood, उग्रवेगम् at high speed, तंमुद्गरम् that club, व्याविध्य scattered, हरीणाम् monkeys, चमूम् , विद्रावयामास with the club.
data.md: Then that Rākşasa whirling his mace washed in blood, capable of striking terror into the mighty hosts of gods and Dānavas, and possessed of fierce impetus, made the monkeyarmy take to its heels.

data.v: वायव्यमादाय ततो वरास्त्रं; रामः प्रचिक्षेप निशाचराय । समुद्गरं तेन जहार बाहुं; स कृत्तबाहुस्तुमुलं ननाद ॥
data.es: Thereupon taking up the weapon of Wind God, Rama discharged on the night ranger and severed his right arm with the mace. His arm torn off, Kumbhakarna made uproarious noise.
data.anv: ततः there upon, रामः Rama, वायव्यम् wind god, महास्त्रम् weapon, आदाय taking निशाचराय night ranger, प्रचिक्षेप severed, तेन his, समुद्गरम् with the mace, बाहुम् from arm, जघान torn, कृत्तबाहुः arm cut off, सः he, तुमुलम् uproarious, ननाद noise.
data.md: Then Rāma, taking a trighty Vāyavya weapon, used the same against the night-ranger; and cut off his arm with the mace. And having his arm cut off, he set up tremendousrears.

data.v: स तस्य बाहुर्गिरिशृङ्गकल्पः; समुद्गरो राघवबाणकृत्तः । पपात तस्मिन्हरिराजसैन्ये; जघान तां वानरवाहिनीं च ॥
data.es: Kumbhakarna's arm severed by Rama's arrow was like a mountain peak. It fell on Vanara army too and killed the monkey king's army.
data.anv: गिरिशृङ्गकल्पः mountain peak, समुद्गरः that mace, राघवबाणकृत्तः by Raghava's arrow, सः he, तस्यबाहुः his arm, तस्मिन् by this, हरिराजसैन्ये monkey king's army, पपात fell, ताम् them, हरिवाहिनीं च Vanara army too, जघान killed.
data.md: And his arm with the mace, resembling a mountain-peak, cut off by Rāghava's arrows, fell in the midst of the army of the monkey-king, and destroyed that army,* * This, or course, is not to be taken literally.

data.v: ते वानरा भग्नहतावशेषाः; पर्यन्तमाश्रित्य तदा विषण्णाः । प्रवेपिताङ्गा ददृशुः सुघोरं; नरेन्द्ररक्षोऽधिपसंनिपातम् ॥
data.es: Then the remaining Vanaras who escaped killing and mutilation went close feeling desperate and witnessed the comb at between Rama and Kumbhakarna.
data.anv: तदा then, भग्नहतावशेषाः Vanaras who escaped from getting killed and mutilated, तेवानराः those Vanaras, प्रपीडिताङ्गाः feeling desperate, विषण्णाः terrible, पर्यन्तम् close, आश्रित्य going, सुघोरम् dreadful, नरेन्द्ररक्षोधिपसन्निपातम् between Kumbhakarna and Rama, ददृशुः witnessed.
data.md: Thereat the monkeys remaining after those broken and slain, dispirited, and having their limbs wounded, moving aside, looked on the dreadfiil encounter between the Rākşasa and the lord of men.

data.v: स कुम्भकर्णोऽस्त्रनिकृत्तबाहु;र्महान्निकृत्ताग्र इवाचलेन्द्रः । उत्पाटयामास करेण वृक्षं; ततोऽभिदुद्राव रणे नरेन्द्रम् ॥
data.es: One arm cut off, Kumbhakarna deprived of limb looked like a mountain with peak cut off. Thereafter he seized a palmyra tree and went towards Rama.
data.anv: अस्त्रनिकृत्तबाहुः arm cut off by arrow, महासिना like peak cut off, कृत्ताग्रः deprived of limb, अचलेन्द्रःइव like a mountain, सः he कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, करेण Palmyra, वृक्षम् tree, उत्पाटयमास seized, ततः thereafter, रणे battle, नरेन्द्रम् king, अभिदुद्राव went towards.
data.md: Then Kumbhakarma, having his arm severed, resembling the foremost of mountains with its crest hewn away by a mighty sabre, tore up a tree with his (remaining) arm and in the conflict rushed against the monarch of men.

data.v: तं तस्य बाहुं सह सालवृक्षं; समुद्यतं पन्नगभोगकल्पम् । ऐन्द्रास्त्रयुक्तेन जहार रामो; बाणेन जाम्बूनदचित्रितेन ॥
data.es: Then Rama yoking his bow with an arrow charged with Indra's mantra and decked with gold severed Kumbhakarna's arm which was like coils of serpent and held the palmyra tree.
data.anv: सःरामः that Rama, इन्द्रास्त्रयुक्तेन yoking bow charged with Indra's mantra, जाम्भूनदचित्रितेन decked with gold, बाणेन arrow, तस्य of his, पन्नगभोगकल्पम् like coils of serpent, समुद्यतम् held, सतालवृक्षम् the Palmyra tree, बाहुम् arms, जघान severed.
data.md: Thereupon with a shaft plated in gold, set upon a weapon of Indra, Rāma cut off his uplifted arm with a palm tree, looking like the body of a pannaga.

data.v: स कुम्भकर्णस्य भुजो निकृत्तः; पपात भूमौ गिरिसंनिकाशः । विवेष्टमानो निजघान वृक्षा;ञ्शैलाञ्शिलावानरराक्षसांश्च ॥
data.es: Kumbhakarna who resembled a mountain, his arm severed turning round and round fell on trees, mountains, Vanaras and Rakshasas crushing them.
data.anv: कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, गिरिसन्निकाशः resembled a mountain, सःभुजः that arm, निकृत्तः severed, भूमौ on ground, पपात fell, विवेष्टमानाः turning round and round, वृक्षान् trees, शैलान् mountains, शिलावानरराक्षसांश्च mountains, Vanaras and Rakshasas, निजघान crushed.
data.md: That arm of Kumbhakarma, being severed, dropped inert on the earth, like a hill, and crushed trees and rocks and crags and monkeys and Raksasas.

data.v: तं छिन्नबाहुं समवेक्ष्य रामः; समापतन्तं सहसा नदन्तम् । द्वावर्धचन्द्रौ निशितौ प्रगृह्य; चिच्छेद पादौ युधि राक्षसस्य ॥
data.es: Perceiving Kumbhakarna with broken arms rushing towards him, Rama at once took a sharp moon shaped arrow and split his feet.
data.anv: रामः Rama, छिन्नबाहुम् with broken arms, सहसा rushing, समापतन्तम् towards, तम् him, समवेक्ष्य perceiving, युधि combat, द्वौ at once, निशितौ sharp, अर्धचन्द्रौ moon shaped, प्रगृह्य taking, राक्षसस्य Rakshasa's, पादौ feet, चिच्छेद split.
data.md: Rāma, seeing that one shorn of his arms suddenly spring up, roaring, took up two whetted crescents, and in the contest cut off the legs of the Rākşasa.

data.v: निकृत्तबाहुर्विनिकृत्तपादो; विदार्य वक्त्रं वडवामुखाभम् । दुद्राव रामं सहसाभिगर्ज;न्राहुर्यथा चन्द्रमिवान्तरिक्षे ॥
data.es: Arms broken, feet cut off, dilating his mouth like fire, shouting aloud like Rahu entering moon in the sky he rushed to Rama speedily.
data.anv: निकृत्तबाहुः arms broken, विनिकृत्तपादः feet cut off, वदनामुखाभम् like fire, वक्त्रम् mouth, विदार्य enlarging, अभिगर्जन् shouting, अन्तरिक्षे sky, राहुर्यथा like Rahu, चन्द्रमिव capturing moon, सहसा rushed, रामम् to Rama, दुद्राव speedily.
data.md: Having his arms cut off and his legs also severed, (Kumbhakarma), opening wide his mouth resembling in sheen the mouth of a mare, roaring swiftly darted against Rāghava, even as Rāhu pursue the Moon in the firmament.

data.v: अपूरयत्तस्य मुखं शिताग्रै; रामः शरैर्हेमपिनद्धपुङ्खैः । स पूर्णवक्त्रो न शशाक वक्तुं; चुकूज कृच्छ्रेण मुमोह चापि ॥
data.es: Rama filled the mouth of Kumbhakarna with his sharp and pointed gold encrusted arrows. Unable to speak the Rakshasa moaned and fainted.
data.anv: रामः Rama, शिताग्रैः sharp pointed, हेमपिनद्धपुङ्खैः gold encrusted, शरैः shafts, तस्य his, मुखम् mouth, अपूरयत् filled, सः he, पूर्णवक्त्रः mouth fully, वक्तुम् mouth, न शशाक not able to speak, कृच्छ्रेण moaned, चुकूज shouted, मुमूर्छचापि fainted.
data.md: Then Rama stuffed his mouth full of sharpened shafts having their feathered parts furnished with gold. And having his mouth filled, he could not articulate; but with extreme effort uttered indistinct accents and swooned away.

data.v: अथाददे सूर्यमरीचिकल्पं; स ब्रह्मदण्डान्तककालकल्पम् । अरिष्टमैन्द्रं निशितं सुपुङ्खं; रामः शरं मारुततुल्यवेगम् ॥
data.es: Then Rama took up the effulgent sun beam like arrow with feathers and the destructive rod of Brahma and the Time spirit that was fatal to enemies that was fast as wind speed and charged with Indra's mantra.
data.anv: अथ and then, सःरामः that Rama, सूर्यमरीचिकल्पम् effulgent as sunbeam with feathers, ब्रह्मदण्डान्तककालकल्पम् rod of Brahma and the Time spirit, अरिष्टम् destructive, निशितम् sharp, सुपुङ्खम् fatal to the enemies, मारुततुल्यवेगम् fast as the wind, ऐन्द्रंशरम् Indra's arrow charged with mantra, आददे took.

data.v: तं वज्रजाम्बूनदचारुपुङ्खं; प्रदीप्तसूर्यज्वलनप्रकाशम् । महेन्द्रवज्राशनितुल्यवेगं; रामः प्रचिक्षेप निशाचराय ॥
data.es: Rama crushed the night ranger to pieces with his arrow encrusted with diamonds and gold, glowing like the Sun 's rays and fire which resembled Indra's thunderbolt, in speed.
data.anv: वज्रजाम्भूनदचारुपुङ्खम् arrow encrusted with diamonds and gold, प्रदीप्तसूर्यज्वलनप्रकाशम् glowing like sun's rays and fire, महेन्द्रवज्राशनितुल्यवेगम् resembled Indra's thunderbolt in speed, तम् that, रामः Rama, निशाचराय night ranger, प्रचिक्षेप crushed to pieces.
data.md: Then Rāma took an arrow of Indra, whetted and knobbed, impetuous as the wind, resembling the effulgence of the Sun, and like to the very banner of Brahmā, or the destroyer himself; and fatal to foes. And then Rāma hurled it at the ranger of the night.

data.v: स सायको राघवबाहुचोदितो; दिशः स्वभासा दश संप्रकाशयन् । विधूमवैश्वानरदीप्तदर्शनो; जगाम शक्राशनितुल्यविक्रमः ॥
data.es: Discharged from Rama's arm, the terrific weapon went just as the Lord of god's weapon, which was like Indra's thunderbolt burning like fire, shining by its brilliance and went in all directions and cut the head of Vritasura.
