data.anv: राघवबाहुचोदितः discharged from Rama's arm, विधूमवैश्वानरभीमदर्शनः terrific just as Vritasura's head was cut off by Indra, the Lord of gods, शक्राशनिवीर्यविक्रमः which was like Indra's thunderbolt, सःसायकः like burning fire, स्वभासा by its brilliance, दश ten, दिशः directions, प्रकाशयन् shining, जगाम went.
data.md: Thereat that weapon hurled by Rāma's arm, resembling a smokeless flame, lighting up the ten cardinal points with its own glory, saught him that was possessed of the dreadful energy of Sakra's thunder-bolt.

data.v: स तन्महापर्वतकूटसंनिभं; विवृत्तदंष्ट्रं चलचारुकुण्डलम् । चकर्त रक्षोऽधिपतेः शिरस्तदा; यथैव वृत्रस्य पुरा पुरंदरः ॥
data.es: The arrow (of Rama) severed the head of Rakshasa king whose body was like a lofty mountain peak, whose teeth were large and protruded, hanging earrings shaking, just as Indra severed the head of Vritasura earlier.
data.anv: सः that, महापर्वतकूटसन्निभम् lofty peak of a mountain, विवृत्तदंष्ट्रम् distinguished by large pointed teeth, चलचारुकुण्डलम् shaking ear rings, रक्षोधिपतेः Rakshasa king, शिरः head, तदा then, पुरा earlier, पुरन्दरः Indra, वृत्रस्य Vritasya, यतैव like that, चकर्त severed.
data.md: Therewith he (Rāma) cut off the head of the lord of Räkşasa resembling a mountain-summit, furnished with prominent teeth, from which the ear-rings had fallen off, even as formerly Purandara had cut off the head of Vſtra.

data.v: तद्रामबाणाभिहतं पपात; रक्षःशिरः पर्वतसंनिकाशम् । बभञ्ज चर्यागृहगोपुराणि; प्राकारमुच्चं तमपातयच्च ॥
data.es: Killed by Rama's arrow, that head of the Rakshasa, which was like a mountain had demolished the walls and houses and peaks of buildings.
data.anv: रामबाणाभिहतम् killed by Rama's arrow, तत् that, पर्वतसन्निकाशम् like a mountain, रक्षः Rakshasa शिरः head, पापत fallen, चर्यागृहगोपुराणि homes and peaks of buildings, बभञ्ज demolished, उच्चम् tall, तम् they, प्राकारम् defensive walls, अपातयच्च fell down broken.
data.md: And struck with Rāma's arrow, the head of the Rākşasa resembling a hill fell down to the earth; and (in its fall) crushed edifices on the highways and gateways; and elevated walls also it bore down to the ground.

data.v: तच्चातिकायं हिमवत्प्रकाशं; रक्षस्तदा तोयनिधौ पपात । ग्राहान्महामीनचयान्भुजंगमा;न्ममर्द भूमिं च तथा विवेश ॥
data.es: The shining huge body of Rakshasa fell into the ocean crushing the other beings in the ocean like alligators, fishes and serpents that entered into the earth.
data.anv: तदा then, अतिकायम् huge body, महत्प्रकाशम् highly shining, तत् that रक्षः Rakshasa, तोयनिधौ ocean, पपात fell, परान् other, ग्राहान् alligators, मीनवरान् fish, भुजङ्गमान् serpents, ममर्द crushed, तथा in the same way, भूमिम् into the earth, विवेश entered.
data.md: Then that Rākşasa of gigantic proportions and vast to the view plunged into the deep; and crushing huge and mighty fishes and serpents, saught the depths.

data.v: तस्मिर्हते ब्राह्मणदेवशत्रौ; महाबले संयति कुम्भकर्णे । चचाल भूर्भूमिधराश्च सर्वे; हर्षाच्च देवास्तुमुलं प्रणेदुः ॥
data.es: Kumbhakarna, the enemy of Brahmans and Devatas, having been killed, the Earth, all mountains, Devatas highly rejoiced.
data.anv: ब्राह्मणदेवशत्रौ the enemy of Brahmans and Devatas, महाबले mighty, तस्मिन् his, कुम्भकर्णे Kumbhakarna, संयति having died, हते killed, भूः earth, चचाल mountains, सर्वे all, भूमिधराश्च god of earth, देवाः च Devatas, हर्षात् rejoiced, तुमुलम् highly, विनेदुः uproar.
data.md: On that enemy of the Brāhmanas and gods, endowed with immense strength, having been slain in battle, the earth shook and the mountains also; and from excess of joy the celestials shouted aloud.

data.v: ततस्तु देवर्षिमहर्षिपन्नगाः; सुराश्च भूतानि सुपर्णगुह्यकाः । सयक्षगन्धर्वगणा नभोगताः; प्रहर्षिता राम पराक्रमेण ॥
data.es: Thereafter the celestial sages and other sages, serpents, Devatas and all beings including eagles and Guhyakas (airborne animals), Yakshas and Gandharvas rejoiced very much at Rama's valour.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, देवर्षिमहर्षिपन्नगाः celestial sages and sages, as well as serpents, सुराश्च Devatas, भूतानि all beings, सुपर्णगुह्यकाः eagles and Guhyakas, सयक्षगन्धर्वगणाः Yaksha, Gandharvas, नभोगताः highly rejoiced, रामपराक्रमेण by Rama's valour, सन्तोषिताः rejoiced very much.
data.md: Those deities and saints and Maharsis and Pannagas, and celestials and (other), beings and birds and Guhyakas, together with Yakşas and Gandharvas, all these who had stationed themselves in the welkin, were rejoiced at the prowess of Rama.

data.v: प्रहर्षमीयुर्बहवस्तु वानराः; प्रबुद्धपद्मप्रतिमैरिवाननैः । अपूजयन्राघवमिष्टभागिनं; हते रिपौ भीमबले दुरासदे ॥
data.es: Many Vanaras, with their faces resembling full blown lotuses joyfully laughed and worshipped Rama for getting rid of an enemy of terrific strength.
data.anv: बहवः many, वानराः Vanaras, प्रबुद्धपद्मप्रतिमैःइव resembling full blown lotuses, आननैः faces, प्रहर्षम् laughing, ईयुः experienced, भीमबले terrific strength, रिपौ enemy, हते killed, इष्टनाषिनम् got rid of, दुरासदम् enemy, राघवम् Raghava, अपूजयन् worshipped.
data.md: And countless monkeys experienced the very height of delight; and on (their) foe of terrific strength having been slain, they with countenances resembling awaked lotuses paid homage to the king's son-Rāghava—the sharer of good fortune.

data.v: स कुम्भकर्णं सुरसैन्यमर्दनं; महत्सु युद्धेष्वपराजितश्रमम् । ननन्द हत्वा भरताग्रजो रणे; महासुरं वृत्रमिवामराधिपः ॥
data.md: As the monarch of the immortals had rejoiced on slaying the mighty Asura Vrtra-Bharata's elder brother rejoiced on having in battle slain that smiter of celestial hosts, Kumbhakarna in mighty conflict, never (before) vanquished in renowned encounters.

data.v: कुम्भकर्णं हतं दृष्ट्वा राघवेण महात्मना । राक्षसा राक्षसेन्द्राय रावणाय न्यवेदयन् ॥
data.es: Seeing Kumbhakarna slain by the glorious Raghava, the Rakshasas informed Ravana, the king of Rakshasas.
data.anv: महात्मना glorious, राघवेण by Raghava, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, हतम् slain, दृष्टवा seeing, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, राक्षसेन्द्राय Rakshasa king, रावणाय to Ravana, न्यवेदयन् informed.
data.md: Seeing Kumbhakarņa slain by the high-souled Rāghava, the Räkşasas conveyed the tidings to the lord of the Raksasas-Ravana; (and addressed him, saying)

data.v: श्रुत्वा विनिहतं संख्ये कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् । रावणः शोकसंतप्तो मुमोह च पपात च ॥
data.es: Hearing that Kumbhakarna of great strength was slain, Ravana immersed in grief became deluded and fell.
data.anv: रावणः Ravana, सङ्ख्ये hearing, महाबलम् of great strength, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, विनिहतम् slain, तम् श्रुत्वा hearing that, शोकसन्तप्तः immersed in grief, मुमोह च पपात च became deluded and fell down.
data.md: Hearing the mighty Kumbhakarņa slain in battle, Ravana burning in grief, swooned away and dropped to the earth.

data.v: पितृव्यं निहतं श्रुत्वा देवान्तकनरान्तकौ । त्रिशिराश्चातिकायश्च रुरुदुः शोकपीडिताः ॥
data.es: Hearing about uncle's destruction, the sons of Ravana, Devanthaka, Naranthaka, Trisira and Atikaya, roared aloud afflicted by grief.
data.anv: पितृव्यम् uncle, निहतम् killed, श्रुत्वा hearing, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devantaka and Naranthaka, sons of Ravana, त्रिशिराः Trisira, अतिकायश्च Atikaya, शोकपीडिताः afflicted by grief, रुरुदुः roared aloud.
data.md: Hearing their uncle slain, Trisiras* and Atikāya-destroyers of gods and men, began to weep, oppressed with sorrow. *Three-headed.

data.v: भ्रातरं निहतं श्रुत्वा रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । महोदरमहापार्श्वौ शोकाक्रान्तौ बभूवतुः ॥
data.es: Ravana's brothers, Mahodara and Mahaparsva were overtaken by sorrow on hearing about the unwearied action of Rama and slaying of Kumbhakarna.
data.anv: अक्लिष्टकर्मणा of unwearied action, रामेण of Rama, भ्रातरम् brothers, निहतम् slain, श्रुत्वा hearing, महोदरमहापार्श्वौ Mahodara, Mahaparsva, शोकाक्रान्तौ overtaken by sorrow, बभूवतुः remained.
data.md: Mahodara' and Mahāpārśvahearing of their uncle slain by Rāma of untiring deeds, were overcome with grief. 1. Huge-bellied. 2. Mighty flanked.

data.v: ततः कृच्छ्रात्समासाद्य संज्ञां राक्षसपुंगवः । कुम्भकर्णवधाद्दीनो विललाप स रावणः ॥
data.es: Thereafter the foremost of the Rakshasas regained consciousness with great difficulty and awakened to the situation of Kumbhakarna's destruction, wailed disturbed in mind.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, राक्षसपुङ्गवः foremost of Rakshasas, कृच्छ्रात् with great difficulty, संज्ञाम् regaining, समासाद्य awakening, कुम्भकर्णवधात् Kumbhakarna's killing, दीनः desperate, आकुलेन्द्रियः disturbed in mind, विललाप wailed.
data.md: Then regaining his senses with extreme exertion, that foremost of Rākṣasas, distressed in consequence of the destruction of Kumbhakarna, mourned with his senses overwhelmed, saying.

data.v: हा वीर रिपुदर्पघ्न कुम्भकर्ण महाबल । शत्रुसैन्यं प्रताप्यैकः क्व मां संत्यज्य गच्छसि ॥
data.es: "Ha! Hero! Kumbhakarna! You, who crushed the pride of the enemy, endowed with great prowess have deserted me and gone to the abode of death, actually by divine will."
data.anv: हा Ha, वीर hero, रिपुदर्पघ्न who crushed the pride of enemy, महाबल of great prowess, कुम्भकर्ण Kumbhakarna, त्वम् you, माम् to me, विहाय deserted, दैवात् divine will, यमसादनम् abode of god of death, यातःअसि you actually.
data.md: O exceedingly powerful one, leaving me (alone) whither did you wend, without extracting my dart as well as that of your friends?

data.v: इदानीं खल्वहं नास्मि यस्य मे पतितो भुजः । दक्षिणो यं समाश्रित्य न बिभेमि सुरासुरान् ॥
data.es: "I who depended on you like my right arm did not fear Devatas or Danavas and I am destroyed now."
data.anv: यस्य मे by that I, दक्षिणःभुजः right arm, पतितः fallen, यम् God of death, समाश्रित्य depending on which, सुरासुरात् Devatas or Danavas, न बिभेमि not feared, अहम् I, इदानीम् from now, नास्मिखलु I am destroyed.
data.md: Now really I am not, inasmuch as my right arm has dropped. Backed by this one, I would not fear celestials and Asuras.

data.v: कथमेवंविधो वीरो देवदानवदर्पहा । कालाग्निप्रतिमो ह्यद्य राघवेण रणे हतः ॥
data.es: "You, who crushed the pride of Devas and Danavas are equal to timespirit and death at dissolution and being a hero, how did you die in the hands of Raghava?"
data.anv: देवदानवदर्पहा one who crushed the pride of Devas and Danavas, कालाग्निरुद्राप्रतिमः equal to time spirit and death at the time of destruction, एवंविधः being so, वीरः hero, रणे in battle, राघवेण by Raghava, कथम् how, हतःवै did you die?
data.md: How today forsooth has such a hero-crusher of the hauteur of gods and Dänavas—resembling the fire arisen at the hour of universal wreck, been slain in fight by Raghava?

data.v: यस्य ते वज्रनिष्पेषो न कुर्याद्व्यसनं सदा । स कथं रामबाणार्तः प्रसुप्तोऽसि महीतले ॥
data.es: "You are never affected by the strike of thunderbolt. How are you sleeping on the ground hit by Rama's arrows?"
data.anv: यस्य his, ते to you, वज्रनिष्पेषः the strike of thunderbolt, सदा ever, व्यसनम् not affect, न कुर्यात् not do any, सः that, रामबाणार्तः Rama's arrows, महीतले on ground, कथम् how, प्रसुप्तःअसि sleeping.
data.md: He who could not be harmed by the concussion of the thunder-bolt itself-how can he, smitten with Rāma's arrows, sleep soundly on the earth?

data.v: एते देवगणाः सार्धमृषिभिर्गगने स्थिताः । निहतं त्वां रणे दृष्ट्वा निनदन्ति प्रहर्षिताः ॥
data.es: "These Devatas and all sages are standing in the sky, seeing the battle and laughing aloud seeing your destruction."
data.anv: एते these, देवगणाः Devatas, ऋषिभिःसार्थम् all sages, गगने in the sky, स्थिताः stood, रणे battle, निहतम् your destruction, त्वाम् you, दृष्टवा seeing, प्रहर्षिताः laughing, निनदन्ति aloud.
data.md: These gods stationed in the sky along with the saints, beholding you slain the battle, are shouting in glee.

data.v: ध्रुवमद्यैव संहृष्टा लब्धलक्ष्याः प्लवंगमाः । आरोक्ष्यन्तीह दुर्गाणि लङ्काद्वाराणि सर्वशः ॥
data.es: "Having found an opportunity, all the Vanaras, highly rejoiced, on this very day, will surely climb over the gates of forts of Lanka determined."
data.anv: लब्धलक्षाः having found opportunity, प्लवङ्गमाः Vanaras, संहृष्टाः highly rejoiced, अद्यैव surely, सर्वशः all over, अद्यैव the very day, इह here, दुर्गाणि fort, लङ्काद्वाराणि gates of Lanka, आरोक्ष्यन्ति will climb, ध्रुवम् determined.
data.md: Surely today the monkeys overjoyed, finding occasion, well scale all the gateways and fortifications of Lankā.

data.v: राज्येन नास्ति मे कार्यं किं करिष्यामि सीतया । कुम्भकर्णविहीनस्य जीविते नास्ति मे रतिः ॥
data.es: "I have no purpose with the kingdom. What will I do with Sita? I have lost my life and mind with Kumbhakarna's death."
data.anv: मे my, राज्येन kingdom, कार्यम् purpose, नास्ति not, सीतया Sita, किंकरिष्यामि What will I do, कुम्भकर्णविहीनस्य Kumbhakarna's death, मे I, जीविते life, मतिः mind, नास्ति lost.
data.md: I have nothing to do with empire. And what shall I do with Sītā? And deprived of Kumbhakarma, I do not even wish to live.

data.v: यद्यहं भ्रातृहन्तारं न हन्मि युधि राघवम् । ननु मे मरणं श्रेयो न चेदं व्यर्थजीवितम् ॥
data.es: "If I do not kill Raghava who killed my brother in battle it is a waste of my life." Thus, thought Ravana.
data.anv: अहम् I am, भ्रातृहन्तारम् who killed my brother, राघवम् Raghavan, युधि in battle, न हन्मियदि if I do not kill, मे my, मरणम् death, श्रेयःननु better for me, इदम् thus, व्यर्थजीवितम् waste of life, न not worth.
data.md: If I do not slay in encounter that slayer of my brother-Rāghava, certainly death is even that which is good for me, otherwise, this life is useless.

data.v: अद्यैव तं गमिष्यामि देशं यत्रानुजो मम । न हि भ्रातॄन्समुत्सृज्य क्षणं जीवितुमुत्सहे ॥
data.es: "This very day, this very minute I shall reach the region where my brother died, I have no interest in life."
data.anv: मम me, अनुजः brother, यत्र there, तंदेशम् his region, अद्यैव today, गमिष्यामि will reach, भ्रातृ़न् brother's, समुत्सृज्य where he died, क्षणम् this very minute, जीवितुम् life, न उत्सहे no interest.
data.md: This very day will I repair to that place where my younger brother is. Forsaking my brother, I forsooth dare not live for a moment.

data.v: देवा हि मां हसिष्यन्ति दृष्ट्वा पूर्वापकारिणम् । कथमिन्द्रं जयिष्यामि कुम्भकर्णहते त्वयि ॥
data.es: "Devatas who were harmed by me earlier will laugh at me now that Kumbhakarna is slain. How will I win Indra?"
data.anv: पूर्वापकारिणम् earlier harmed, माम् by me, दृष्टवा seeing, देवाः Devatas, हसिष्यन्तिहि will laugh at me, कुम्भकर्ण Kumbhakarna, त्वयि your, हते destruction, इन्द्रम् Indra, कथम् how, जयिष्यामि will I win?.
data.md: For the gods shall laugh on seeing me, who had formerly wronged them. But, how, O Kumbhakarņa, you having been slain, shall I conquer Indra?

data.v: तदिदं मामनुप्राप्तं विभीषणवचः शुभम् । यदज्ञानान्मया तस्य न गृहीतं महात्मनः ॥
data.es: "This calamity that has come upon me was because I have not taken such auspicious advice rendered by the great soul Vibheeshana."
data.anv: अज्ञानात् this calamity, महात्मनः great soul, तस्य his, यत् that which, मया by me, न गृहीतम् not taken, तत् that, इदम् such, शुभम् auspicious, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words of advice, माम् me, अनुप्राप्तम् not accepted.
data.md: Now the beneficial words of Vibhīşaņa have been verified. And as through blindness I did not accept the advice of that high-souled one, Kumbhakarņa and of Prahasta, this disaster arisen, shame me sore.

data.v: विभीषणवचो यावत्कुम्भकर्णप्रहस्तयोः । विनाशोऽयं समुत्पन्नो मां व्रीडयति दारुणः ॥
data.es: "Thus, loss of both Kumbhakarna and Prahastha is dreadful. It is because of not following the words of advice of Vibheeshana totally. It hurts me."
data.anv: कुम्भकर्णप्रहस्तयोः both Kumbhakarna and Prahastha, दारुणः dreadful, अयम् this, विनाशः loss, यावत् totally, समुत्पन्नः that which has come up, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, माम् me, व्रीडयति hurts me.
data.md: Now the beneficial words of Vibhīşaņa have been verified. And as through blindness I did not accept the advice of that high-souled one, Kumbhakarņa and of Prahasta, this disaster arisen, shame me sore.

data.v: तस्यायं कर्मणः प्रातो विपाको मम शोकदः । यन्मया धार्मिकः श्रीमान्स निरस्तो विभीषणः ॥
data.es: "Righteous and prosperous Vibheeshana has been expelled by me earlier. By that action, I have obtained this grief."
data.anv: धार्मिकः righteous, श्रीमान् prosperous, सः he, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, यत् his, मया by me, निरस्तः expelled, तस्यकर्मणः by that action, शोकदः grief, अयम् this, विपाकः in the form of grief, मम to me, प्राप्तः obtained.
data.md: As I had disgraced the virtuous and graceful Vibhīşaņa, this peril producing grief, has been the consequence of my conduct.

data.v: इति बहुविधमाकुलान्तरात्मा; कृपणमतीव विलप्य कुम्भकर्णम् । न्यपतदथ दशाननो भृशार्त;स्तमनुजमिन्द्ररिपुं हतं विदित्वा ॥
data.md: Having thus piteously and long lamented Kumbhakarna, the Ten-necked one, with his inmost soul overwhelmed with sorrow, and sore distressed in consequence of grief, fell down, knowing his brother—the enemy of Indra-slain in battle.

data.v: एवं विलपमानस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः । श्रुत्वा शोकाभितप्तस्य त्रिशिरा वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
data.es: Hearing the lamentations of the evilminded Ravana, Trisira spoke to him.
data.anv: एवम् in that way, विलपमानस्य lamenting, दुरात्मनः evil minded, शोकाभितप्तस्य immersed in sorrow, रावणस्य Ravana's, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, त्रिशिराः Trisira, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: Hearing the lamentations of the wickedminded Ravana, overwhelmed with grief, Trisiras addressed him, saying.

data.v: एवमेव महावीर्यो हतो नस्तात मध्यमः । न तु सत्पुरुषा राजन्विलपन्ति यथा भवान् ॥
data.es: "There is no doubt that Kumbhakarna, who is your middle father and uncle, was also endowed with great prowess. He has been killed. O King! Good men like you do not wail."
data.anv: नः no doubt, तातमध्यमः middle father and uncle, महावीर्यः of great prowess, हतः killed, एवमेव he alone, तु to you, राजन् King, भवान् यथा like you, सत्पुरुषाः good men, न विलपन्ति not wail.
data.md: O Sire, this second uncle to us possessed of mighty prowess has* forsooth been slain in fight. But, О king, heroes never indulge in grief as youdoes. as *Evameva-forsooth, I render it. The commentator, however, says it means such as you have described him.

data.v: नूनं त्रिभुवणस्यापि पर्याप्तस्त्वमसि प्रभो । स कस्मात्प्राकृत इव शोकस्यात्मानमीदृशम् ॥
data.es: "O King! You are a conqueror of the three worlds. Why do you wail like a common man?"
data.anv: प्रभो King, त्वम् you, त्रिभुवनस्यासि three worlds, पर्याप्तः conqueror, असि are, सः such you, ईदृशम् this way आत्मानम् yourself, प्राकृतःइव like a common man, कस्मात् allow, शोचसि to wail.
data.md: O lord, you certainly alone are competent to conquer the triple world. Wherefore then did you went such sorrow like an ignoble one?

data.v: ब्रह्मदत्तास्ति ते शक्तिः कवचः सायको धनुः । सहस्रखरसंयुक्तो रथो मेघसमस्वनः ॥
data.es: "You are bestowed by Brahma with a javelin, a shield and an arrow and a chariot yoked by a thousand donkeys making rumbling sounds like a cloud."
data.anv: ते you, ब्रह्मदत्ता bestowed by Brahma, शक्तिः javelin, अस्ति have, कवचम् shield, सायकः arrow, धनुः bow, सहस्रखरसंयुक्तः a thousand donkeys yoked, मेघस्वनोमहान् emitting sound like rumbling of cloud, रथः chariot.
data.md: You have your dart conferred on you by Brahmā; and your mail and your weapon—the bow-and your car yoked with a thousand asses, sending forth clatter resembling the rumbling of clouds.

data.v: त्वयासकृद्विशस्त्रेण विशस्ता देवदानवाः । स सर्वायुधसंपन्नो राघवं शास्तुमर्हसि ॥
data.es: "Devas and Danavas have been won over by you, deprived of weapons also. Now endowed with all weapons you will be able to win Raghava."
data.anv: त्वया by you, असकृत् deprived of, शस्त्रेण with weapons, देवदानवाः Devas and Danavas, विशस्ताःहि won over, सः he, सर्वायुधसम्पन्नः endowed with all kinds of weapons, राघवम् Raghava, शास्तुम् winning, अर्हसि will be able to.
data.md: The deities and the Dănavas have by means of your arms been terrified over and over again. And furnished with all arms, you ought to chastise Rāghava.

data.v: कामं तिष्ठ महाराजनिर्गमिष्याम्यहं रणम् । उद्धरिष्यामि ते शत्रून्गरुडः पन्नगानिह ॥
data.es: "O King! Stay on. I will move forth to the battlefield and uproot your enemy like Garuda uprooted serpents."
data.anv: महाराज O King!, तिष्ठकामम् stay on, अहम् I, निर्गमिष्यामि will go forth, गरुडः Garuda, पन्नगानिव like serpent, रणम् battlefield, तेशत्रून् your enemy, उद्धरिष्यामि will uproot.
data.md: But stay at your pleasure, O mighty sovereign, I will go out to battle; and even as Garuda capture serpents, will I capture your enemies.

data.v: शम्बरो देवराजेन नरको विष्णुना यथा । तथाद्य शयिता रामो मया युधि निपातितः ॥
data.es: "Just as Lord of Devas by Sambara, and Vishnu by Naraka, in the same way Rama will also be destroyed struck by me."
data.anv: शम्बरः Sambara, देवराजेन Lord of Devas, नरकः Naraka, विष्णुना like Vishnu, यथा that way, तथा in the same manner, मया by me, अद्य struck, युधि in combat, निपातितः destroyed, रामः Rama, शयिता throw down.
data.md: As Sambara was vanquished by the lord of the immortals, or Naraka by Visnu, will I bringing down Rāma in battle make him sleep (in the field).

data.v: श्रुत्वा त्रिशिरसो वाक्यं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः । पुनर्जातमिवात्मानं मन्यते कालचोदितः ॥
data.es: Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, hearing Trisira's words thought that impelled by destiny that he was reborn.
data.anv: राक्षसाधिपः King of Rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, त्रिशिरसः Trisira's, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, कालचोदितः impelled by destiny, आत्मानम् himself, पुनः again, जातम् इव as if born again, मन्यते thought.
data.md: Hearing Triſiras words Rāvana-lord of Rākşasas-urged on by fate, considered himself as having regained his life.

data.v: श्रुत्वा त्रिशिरसो वाक्यं देवान्तकनरान्तकौ । अतिकायश्च तेजस्वी बभूवुर्युद्धहर्षिताः ॥
data.es: Hearing Trisira's words both Devanthaka and Naranthaka and glorious Atikaya became enthusiastic for combat.
data.anv: त्रिशिरसः Trisira, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devanthaka and Naranthaka both, तेजस्वी glorious, अतिकायश्च Atikaya, युद्धहर्षिताः enthusiastic to fight war, बभूवुः became.
data.md: Hearing the speech of Triģiras, Devāntaka, and Narāntaka, and the energetic Atikāya also, were wrought up with martial enthusiam.

data.v: ततोऽहमहमित्येवं गर्जन्तो नैरृतर्षभाः । रावणस्य सुता वीराः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमाः ॥
data.es: Then Ravana's sons, the heroes, and bulls among ogres, equal to Indra in valour, roared saying, "I will start", "I will lead."
data.anv: ततः then, रावणस्य Ravana's, सुताः sons, वीराः heroes, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमाः equal to Indra in valour, नैरृतर्षभाः bulls among ogres, अहम् इत्येव" I will lead", I will start", गर्जन्तः roared.
data.md: Then those foremost of Naiſtas-the heroic sons of Rāvaņa-endowed with the prowess of Sakra himself-roared out, I will go,' 'I will go.' or

data.v: अन्तरिक्षचराः सर्वे सर्वे माया विशारदाः । सर्वे त्रिदशदर्पघ्नाः सर्वे च रणदुर्मदाः ॥
data.es: All (sons of Ravana) are capable of coursing through the sky, experts in conjuring tricks, capable of crushing the pride of Devatas and all, are fierce in fighting.
data.anv: सर्वे all, अन्तरिक्षगताः coursing through the sky, सर्वे all, मायाविशारदाः experts in conjuring tricks, सर्वे all, त्रिदशदर्पघ्नाः who can crush the pride of all Devatas, सर्वे all, रणदुर्जयाः fierce in fighting.
data.md: All could range the sky, and all were skilled in illusion, and all were crushers of the pride of the immortals; and all were irresistible in encounter.

data.v: सर्वेऽस्त्रबलसंपन्नाः सर्वे विस्तीर्ण कीर्तयः । सर्वे समरमासाद्य न श्रूयन्ते स्म निर्जिताः ॥
data.es: All sons of Ravana possessed stupendous strength, all were very famous, and never got defeated in war be it Gandharvas, Kinnaras or even gods will get vanquished by them.
data.anv: सर्वे all, सुबलसम्पन्नाः possessed stupendous strength, सर्वे all, विस्तीर्णकीर्तयः very well known for their fame, सर्वे all, समरम् in war, आसाद्य accompanied by, सगन्धर्वैः Gandharvas, संकिन्नरमहोरगैः even if they are Kinnaras, देवैरपि gods also, निर्जिताः will be vanquished, न श्रूयन्ते स्म never get defeated.

data.v: सर्वेऽस्त्रविदुषो वीराः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः । सर्वे प्रवरजिज्ञानाः सर्वे लब्धवरास्तथा ॥
data.es: All were experts in the use of weapons, all were heroes and skilled in warfare, knowledgeable in scriptures, so also all were blessed with boons.
data.anv: सर्वall, अस्त्रविदुषः experts in the use of weapons, वीराः heroes, सर्वेall, युद्धविशारदाः skilled in warfare, सर्वall, प्रवरविज्ञानाः knowledgeable in scriptures, तथा so also, सर्वे all, लब्धवराः received boons.

data.v: स तैस्तथा भास्करतुल्यवर्चसैः; सुतैर्वृतः शत्रुबलप्रमर्दनैः । रराज राजा मघवान्यथामरै;र्वृतो महादानवदर्पनाशनैः ॥
data.es: Surrounded by his sons, who matched Sun in brilliance and capable of crushing the pride of foes, great in destroying immortals, Ravana shone like Lord gods.
data.anv: भासतुल्यवर्चसैः equal to Sun in brilliance, शत्रुबलप्रमार्धनैः capable of crushing the foes, तैः those, सुतैः sons, तथा like that, वृतः surrounded, सःराजा the king, महादानवदर्पनाशनैः great in destroying the pride of Danavas, अमरैः immortals, वृतः surrounded, मघवायथा like Madhava, रराज shone.
data.md: Then the king surrounded by those sons of his, appearing like celestials, capable of injuring the force and fortune of the foes, looked splendid like Maghavan environed by the immortals, humblers of the hauteur of mighty Danavas.

data.v: स पुत्रान्संपरिष्वज्य भूषयित्वा च भूषणैः । आशीर्भिश्च प्रशस्ताभिः प्रेषयामास संयुगे ॥
data.es: Ravana embraced his sons, decked them with ornaments and jewels and enriched them and offered benediction and sent to encounter.
data.anv: सः he, पुत्रान् sons, सम्परिष्वज्य embraced, भूषणैः with ornaments, भूषयित्वा च decked with jewels, प्रशस्ताभिः enriched, आशीर्भिः benediction, सम्युगे for encounter, प्रेषयामास sent.
data.md: Embracing his sons and adorning them in ornaments, he sent them to the field with his best benedictions.

data.v: महोदरमहापार्श्वौ भ्रातरौ चापि रावणः । रक्षणार्थं कुमाराणां प्रेषयामास संयुगे ॥
data.es: Ravana sent his two brothers Yuddhonmatta and Matta for the protection of his sons for defence in combat.
data.anv: रावणः Ravana, कुमाराणाम् for his sons, रक्षणार्थम् for protection of, भ्रातरौ brothers, युद्धोन्मत्तं च Yuddhonmatta, मत्तं च अपि and Matta, संयुगे for combat, प्रेषयामास for defence.
data.md: Rävaņa sent the brothers, Yudhyonmatta and Matta, for protecting the princes in the field.

data.v: तेऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं रावणं रिपुरावणम् । कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं चैव महाकायाः प्रतस्थिरे ॥
data.es: Those heroes greeting gigantic Ravana, went around him clockwise (as per tradition) and departed.
data.anv: महाकायाः of huge body, ते those, महात्मानम् great, लोकरावणम् heroes, रावणम् to Ravana, प्रदक्षिणम् going round clockwise, कृत्वाचैव having done, प्रतस्थिरे departed.
data.md: Then, saluting the high-souled Ravanadestroyer of creatures, and going round him, those huge-bodied ones marched forth.

data.v: सर्वौषधीभिर्गन्धैश्च समालभ्य महाबलाः । निर्जग्मुर्नैरृतश्रेष्ठाः षडेते युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः ॥
data.es: The six leaders endowed with great strength, anointing themselves with fragrance, which can ward off injury went to fight.
data.anv: एते those, महाबलाः endowed with great strength, षट् six, नैरृतश्रेष्ठाः Rakshasa leaders, सर्वौषधीभिः which ward off injury, गन्धैः fragrance, समालभ्य anointing, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः longing to fight, निर्जग्मुः went.
data.md: And furnished with every description of medicinal herbs and perfumes, these six Nairtas-foremost of their kind endowed with great strength, burning for battle, marched forth, Triširas and Atikāya, and Devântaka and Narāntaka, and Mahodara and Mahāpāśva went out, urged on by Fate.

data.v: ततः सुदर्शनं नाम नीलजीमूतसंनिभम् । ऐरावतकुले जातमारुरोह महोदरः ॥
data.es: Thereafter Mahodara mounted on an elephant born of Airavata (Indra 's elephant) family, by name Sudarsana went.
data.anv: ततः thereafter, महोदरः Mahodara, नीलजीमूतसन्निभम् resembling a dark cloud, ऐरावतकुलेजातम् born in the family of Airavatam elephant, सुदर्शनम् Sudarsanam, नागम् by name, आरुरोह mounted.
data.md: Then Mahodara mounted the elephant Sudarsana-sprung in the race of Airāvata, and resembling dark-blue clouds.

data.v: सर्वायुधसमायुक्तं तूणीभिश्च स्वलंकृतम् । रराज गजमास्थाय सवितेवास्तमूर्धनि ॥
data.es: Ready with all kinds of weapons, quivers as well mounted on elephants shone like the setting Sun in the west.
data.anv: सर्वायुधसमायुक्तः ready with all kinds of weapons, तूणीभिश्चा quivers also, स्वलङ्कृतः decked, गजम् elephant, आस्थाय mounted, अस्तमूर्धनि on the western region, सवितेव like Sun, रराज shone.
data.md: Accoutred in every weapon, and decked with quivers, he looked splendid on his elephant like the Sun ascending the crest of the Setting-hill.

data.v: हयोत्तमसमायुक्तं सर्वायुधसमाकुलम् । आरुरोह रथश्रेष्ठं त्रिशिरा रावणात्मजः ॥
data.es: Ravana's brother, Trisira went mounted on a chariot yoked to the best of horses with all kinds of weapons.
data.anv: रावणात्मजः Ravana's brother, त्रिशिराः Trisira, हयोत्तमसमायुक्तम् best of horses, सर्वायुधसमाकुलम् with all kinds of weapons, रथश्रेष्ठम् best of chariots, आरुरोह mounted.
data.md: Ravana's son-Trisiras, ascended a car yoked with excellent steeds, and furnished with every variety of arms.

data.v: त्रिशिरा रथमास्थाय विरराज धनुर्धरः । सविद्युदुल्कः सज्वालः सेन्द्रचाप इवाम्बुदः ॥
data.es: Wielding a bow and sitting like a leader in the chariot Trisira shone as if attended by lightning, meteors, light, and rainbows.
data.anv: धनुर्धरः wielding Bow, त्रिशिराः Trisira, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय taking seat, सविद्युदुल्कः attended by lightning, meteors light and rainbows, सैलाग्रे top of the mountain, सेन्द्रचापः sitting like leader, अम्बुदःइव like rain clouds, विरराज shone.
data.md: Having ascended the car, Trisiras bow in hand appeared beautiful like a mass of burning clouds having lightning and meteors, and crowned with Indra's bow.. *The rain-bow is called sometimes Indra's bow and at others Rama's bow.

data.v: त्रिभिः किरीटैस्त्रिशिराः शुशुभे स रथोत्तमे । हिमवानिव शैलेन्द्रस्त्रिभिः काञ्चनपर्वतैः ॥
data.es: Trisira seated in the best of chariots, with his three heads adorned with crowns shone like the golden mountain, Himalayas with its three peaks.
data.anv: सः he, त्रिशिराः Trisira, रथोत्तमे best of chariot, त्रिभिः three, किरीटैः adorned with crowns, त्रिभिः three, काञ्चनपर्वतैः golden mountain, शैलेंद्रः Lord of mountains, हिमवानिव Himalaya like, शुशुभे shone.
data.md: Dight with three diadems, Trisiras looked splendid in that superb car, like the monarch of mountains Himavān—with the three golden hills.

data.v: अतिकायोऽपि तेजस्वी राक्षसेन्द्रसुतस्तदा । आरुरोह रथश्रेष्ठं श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम् ॥
data.es: Then Atikaya the very bright son of Rakshasa king, foremost of all archers mounted on the best of chariots.
data.anv: तदा then, अतितेजस्वी very bright, राक्षसेन्द्रसुतः Lord of Rakshasas's son, सर्वधनुष्मताम् all archers, श्रेष्ठः best of, अतिकायः Atikaya, रथश्रेष्ठम् best of chariots, आरुरोह mounted.
data.md: Then that foremost of all bowmen-the powerful Atikāya-son to the lord of Raksasas-ascended the best of cars, having excellent wheels and akşas, and yoked with excellent steeds, and furnished with bottoms and holes; flaming with quivers and bows; and bristling with prāścas and swords and blugdeons.

data.v: सुचक्राक्षं सुसंयुक्तं सानुकर्षं सकूबरम् । तूणीबाणासनैर्दीप्तं प्रासासि परिघाकुलम् ॥
data.es: The chariot (of Atikaya) had excellent wheels, well fitted with strong axles, stout poles, equipped with quivers and bows, with best of spears, bars, and swords.
data.anv: सुचक्राक्षम् of excellent wheels, सुसंयुक्तम् well fixed, स्वनुकर्षम् strong axles, सुकूबरम् with stout poles, तूणीबाणासनैः with quivers and bows, दीप्तम् radiant, प्रासासिपरिघाकुलम् with best of bars, spears and swords.
data.md: Then that foremost of all bowmen-the powerful Atikāya-son to the lord of Raksasas-ascended the best of cars, having excellent wheels and akşas, and yoked with excellent steeds, and furnished with bottoms and holes; flaming with quivers and bows; and bristling with prāścas and swords and blugdeons.

data.v: स काञ्चनविचित्रेण किरीटेन विराजता । भूषणैश्च बभौ मेरुः प्रभाभिरिव भास्वरः ॥
data.es: His wonderful coronet encrusted with gold was shining, sparkling, and looked splendid like the Meru Mountain.
data.anv: सः he, काञ्चनविचित्रेण wonderful gold, विराजता shining, मकुटेन coronet, भूषणैश्च encrusted, प्रभाभिः sparkling, भासयन् splendid, मेरुःइव like Meru, बभौ seemed.
data.md: Adorned with a crown plated with wrought gold' and (other) ornaments he looked like the Meru swimming in its own splendour.

data.v: स रराज रथे तस्मिन्राजसूनुर्महाबलः । वृतो नैरृतशार्दूलैर्वज्रपाणिरिवामरैः ॥
data.es: The tiger among ogres (Atikaya) surrounded by the great army of ogres, the prince was shining in the chariot like Indra, the king of gods and wielder of thunderbolt.
data.anv: नैरृतशार्दूलैः tiger among ogres, वृतः surrounded by, महाबलः great army, राजसूनुः the prince, तस्मिन् रथे in his chariot, अमरैः like king of gods, वज्रपाणिःइव like Indra the wielder of thunderbolt, रराज appeared.
data.md: That powerful son of the kind surrounded by the Naiſtas looked lovely on that car like the thunder-handed (Deity) engirt by the immortals.

data.v: हयमुच्चैःश्रवः प्रख्यं श्वेतं कनकभूषणम् । मनोजवं महाकायमारुरोह नरान्तकः ॥
data.es: Naranthaka, mounted on Uchaisrava, the white horse, decked in gold, was swift as thought in speed.
data.anv: नरान्तकः Naranthaka, उच्छैःश्रवःप्रख्यम् Uchaisrava (horse evolved in churning of the milky ocean), श्वेतम् white, कनकभूषणम् decked in gold, मनोजवम् swift as thought in speed, महाकायम् huge, हयम् horse, आरुरोह mounted.
data.md: Narāntaka mounted a white steed resembling Uccaiḥśravă, caparisoned in gold, having a large frame and endowed with the velocity of the wind.

data.v: गृहीत्वा प्रासमुक्लाभं विरराज नरान्तकः । शक्तिमादाय तेजस्वी गुहः शत्रुष्विवाहवे ॥
data.es: Naranthaka seizing a barbed missile like a burning spear, looked like son of Lord Siva wielding javelin in hand.
data.anv: नरान्तकः Naranthaka, उल्काभम् burning spear like, प्रासम् barbed missile, गृहीत्वा seizing, तेजस्वी brilliant, शिखिगतः like the one with peacock feather in head (son of Siva), गुहः Guha, शक्तिम् taking javelin, आदायथा taking that way, विरजा shone.
data.md: Taking a prāśa, Narāntaka appeared like the energetic Guha mounted on the peacock, grasping his dart.

data.v: देवान्तकः समादाय परिघं वज्रभूषणम् । परिगृह्य गिरिं दोर्भ्यां वपुर्विष्णोर्विडम्बयन् ॥
data.es: Devanthaka, holding a bar encrusted with diamonds in both hands, seemed like Vishnu in disguise with a mountain (to churn the milky ocean).
data.anv: देवान्तकः Devanthaka, वज्रभूषणम् encrusted with diamonds, परिघम् bar, समादाय taking, दोर्भ्याम् in both hands, गिरिम् mountain, परिगृह्य taking, विष्णोः Vishnu, वपुः enemy, विडम्बयन् in disguise.
data.md: Taking a bludgeon decked in golden Ornaments, Devántaka resembled Vişņu at the time of the churning of the ocean, holding the Dorbhya* and staying burthening (the earth). *The mountain Mandara which served as the churning-stick..

data.v: महापार्श्वो महातेजा गदामादाय वीर्यवान् । विरराज गदापाणिः कुबेर इव संयुगे ॥
data.es: Mahaparsva holding an ace in hand in the war shone like Kubera.
data.anv: वीर्यवान् heroic, गदापाणिः holding mace, महापार्श्वः Mahaparsva, गदाम् आदाय holding mace, संयुगे for war, कुबेरःइव like Kubera, विरजा shone.
data.md: The powerful Mahāpārsva endowed with terrific energy, taking his mace, appeared like Kuvera holding in his hand a mace in the encounter.

data.v: ते प्रतस्थुर्महात्मानो बलैरप्रतिमैर्वृताः । सुरा इवामरावत्यां बलैरप्रतिमैर्वृताः ॥
तान्गजैश्च तुरंगैश्च रथैश्चाम्बुदनिस्वनैः । अनुजग्मुर्महात्मानो राक्षसाः प्रवरायुधाः ॥
data.es: Many great warriors seated on the best of chariots, with best of weapons amidst noise of conchs and drums, elephants, horses also and thunder like chariot warriors, started to proceed.
data.anv: महात्मानं many great warriors, रथिनः seated on chariot, रथिनाम् chariot, वरम् best of, तम् that, शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैः with the noise of conches and drums, वरायुधैः best of weapons, सैन्यैः च army too, गजैश्च elephants also, तुरङ्गैश्च horses, अम्बुदस्वनैः thunder like, स्यन्दनैश्च war chariots also, अनुजग्मुः started to proceed.
data.md: And high-souled mighty warriors followed that foremost of heroes with elephant and steeds and chariots sending out rattle resembling the rumbling of thunder.

data.v: ते विरेजुर्महात्मानो कुमाराः सूर्यवर्चसः । किरीटिनः श्रिया जुष्टा ग्रहा दीप्ता इवाम्बरे ॥
data.es: The great princes were wearing crowns resplendent like the Sun and glowing like planets in the sky.
data.anv: सूर्यवर्चसः resplendent as Sun, किरीटिनः wearing crowns, श्रिया prosperous, जुष्टाः , महात्मानः great ones, ते they, कुमाराः princes, अम्बरे sky, दीप्ताः glowing, ग्रहाःइव like planets, विरेजुः shone.
data.md: Those sun-bright high-souled princes decked with diadems appeared splendid like burning planets in the firmament.

data.v: प्रगृहीता बभौ तेषां छत्राणामावलिः सिता । शारदाभ्रप्रतीकाशां हंसावलिरिवाम्बरे ॥
data.es: The princes, grasping the white weapons shone like flocks of white cranes in the dark autumnal clouds in the sky.
data.anv: तेषाम् those princes, शस्त्राणाम् weapons, प्रगृहीता grasping, शिवा pure white, शरदभ्रप्रतीकाशा like autumnal clouds, आवलिः dark coloured, अम्बरे in the sky, हंसावलिःइव like white cranes, बभौ shone.
data.md: The various gorgeous attires which they had worn resembled rows of cranes in the sky, looking like autumnal clouds.

data.v: मरणं वापि निश्चित्य शत्रूणां वा पराजयम् । इति कृत्वा मतिं वीरा निर्जग्मुः संयुगार्थिनः ॥
data.es: Those heroes determined to defeat the enemy even if it meant death and went thinking for the combat.
data.anv: मरणंवापि even if it meant death, शत्रूणाम् enemy, पराजयंवापि even defeated, निश्चित्य determined, वीराः heroes, इति thus, मतिम् thinking, कृत्वा to do, संयुगार्थिनः for the combat, निर्जग्मुः started.
data.md: Resolved on dying or conquering the foe in fight, those heroes sallied out seeking encounter.

data.v: जगर्जुश्च प्रणेदुश्च चिक्षिपुश्चापि सायकान् । जहृषुश्च महात्मानो निर्यान्तो युद्धदुर्मदाः ॥
data.es: The great Rakshasas who were fierce in combat went roaring shouting loudly and discharging arrows.
data.anv: निर्याताः determined, महात्मानः great Rakshasas, युद्धदुर्मदाः fierce in combat, जगर्जुश्च roaring, प्रणेदुश्च shouted loudly, सायकान् arrows, चिक्षिपुश्च discharged, जगृहुः च went.
data.md: Those high-souled ones, incapable of being repressed in fight, roared and shouted and discharged shafts and held them,

data.v: क्ष्वेडितास्फोटनिनदैः संचचालेव मेदिनी । रक्षसां सिंहनादैश्च पुस्फोटेव तदाम्बरम् ॥
data.es: By the sound of their clapping of arms and their lion roar it was as though the sky was breaking and the earth was shaking.
data.anv: क्ष्वेळिडितास्फोटितः by the sound of clapping of arms, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, सिंहनादैः lion roar, संस्फोटितइव as though breaking like अम्बरम् sky, निनदैः by the roar, वसुन्दरा earth, चचाल shook.
data.md: The earth shook as they sent up leonine roars and struck at their arms with their hands; and the sky seemed riven with the leonine roars of the Rākşasa.

data.v: तेऽभिनिष्क्रम्य मुदिता राक्षसेन्द्रा महाबलाः । ददृशुर्वानरानीकं समुद्यतशिलानगम् ॥
data.es: Departing from there the Rakshasa army saw Vanara army ready with many rocks.
data.anv: महाबलाः possessed of extraordinary might, ते they, राक्षसेन्ध्राः Rakshasa army, अभिनिष्क्रम्य departing from there, समुद्यतशिलानगम् ready with many rocks, वानरानीकम् Vanara army, ददृशुः witnessed.
data.md: Issuing out cheerfully, those foremost of Rāks asas endowed with great strength beheld that monkey-army staying with upraised rocks and stones.

data.v: हरयोऽपि महात्मानो ददृशुर्नैरृतं बलम् । हस्त्यश्वरथसंबाधं किङ्किणीशतनादितम् ॥
data.es: The huge monkeys also saw groups of elephants, horses and chariots and heard hundreds of bells of the chariots and Rakshasas all over like groups of dark clouds with huge weapons glowing like fire and Sun surrounded by Rakshasa army.
data.anv: महात्मानः huge gigantic, हरयोऽपि Vanaras also, हस्त्यश्वरथसम्भाधम् groups of elephants, horses and chariots, किङ्किणीशतनादितम् sounds of hundreds of bells of the chariots, नीलजीमूतसङ्काशम् like group of dark clouds, समुद्यतमहायुधम् with huge weapons, सर्वतः all, दीप्तानलरविप्रख्यैः glowing like fire and Sun, नैरृतैः Rakshasas, वृतम् surrounded, राक्षसम् Rakshasas, बलम् army, ददृशुः saw.

data.v: नीलजीमूतसंकाशं समुद्यतमहायुधम् । दीप्तानलरविप्रख्यैर्नैरृतैः सर्वतो वृतम् ॥
data.es: The huge monkeys also saw groups of elephants, horses and chariots and heard hundreds of bells of the chariots and Rakshasas all over like groups of dark clouds with huge weapons glowing like fire and Sun surrounded by Rakshasa army.
data.anv: महात्मानः huge gigantic, हरयोऽपि Vanaras also, हस्त्यश्वरथसम्भाधम् groups of elephants, horses and chariots, किङ्किणीशतनादितम् sounds of hundreds of bells of the chariots, नीलजीमूतसङ्काशम् like group of dark clouds, समुद्यतमहायुधम् with huge weapons, सर्वतः all, दीप्तानलरविप्रख्यैः glowing like fire and Sun, नैरृतैः Rakshasas, वृतम् surrounded, राक्षसम् Rakshasas, बलम् army, ददृशुः saw.
data.md: The high souled monkeys also saw that mighty host of Räkşasas thronging with elephants, horses and cars, and ringing with hundreds of bell-lets; resembling dark-blue clouds; upraising mighty arms; and environed on all sides by Naiſtas resembling flaming fire.

data.v: तद्दृष्ट्वा बलमायान्तं लब्धलक्ष्याः प्लवंगमाः । समुद्यतमहाशैलाः संप्रणेदुर्मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
data.es: Seeing the Rakshasa army approaching, the monkeys found an opportunity to attack them and collected huge mountains, deadly strong trees in great joy unable to tolerate roared in return.
data.anv: आयातम् approaching, तत् that, बलम् army, दृष्टवा seeing, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, लब्धलक्षाः found their target to attack, समुद्यतमहाशैलाः collected huge mountains, दुर्महाबला deadly strong, सम्प्रणेदुः in great joy, वानराः Vanara, रक्षांसि at Rakshasas, अमृष्यमाणाः unable to tolerate, प्रतिनर्दन्त roared in return.

data.v: ततः समुद्घुष्टरवं निशम्य; रक्षोगणा वानरयूथपानाम् । अमृष्यमाणाः परहर्षमुग्रं; महाबला भीमतरं विनेदुः ॥
data.es: There upon the Vanara leaders, endowed with extraordinary prowess, beholding the joy of Rakshasa troops, unable to bear roared dreadfully.
data.anv: ततः there upon, उग्रमहाबलाः endowed with extraordinary prowess, रक्षोगणाः Rakshasa troop, वानरयूथपानाम् Vanara leaders, समुद्घुष्टरवम् joy of the troops, निशम्य beholding, परहर्षम् their joy, अमृष्यमाणाः unable to bear, भीमतरम् dreadfully, विनेदुः roared.

data.v: ते राक्षसबलं घोरं प्रविश्य हरियूथपाः । विचेरुरुद्यतैः शैलैर्नगाः शिखरिणो यथा ॥
data.es: Those monkey leaders entering dreadful Rakshasa army uplifted rocks and mountains with trees and shone.
data.anv: ते those, हरियूथपाः monkey leaders, घोरम् dreadful, राक्षसबलम् Rakshasa army, प्रविश्य entering, उद्यतैः uplifted, शैलैः rocks, शिखरिणः peaks of mountains, नगाःयथा forest trees, विचेरुः shone.
data.md: Then diving into that dreadful Räkşasa army, the monkey-leaders began to range it with uplifted rocks, like to mountains.

data.v: केचिदाकाशमाविश्य केचिदुर्व्यां प्लवंगमाः । रक्षःसैन्येषु संक्रुद्धाश्चेरुर्द्रुमशिलायुधाः ॥
data.es: Some monkeys springing into the sky, while some staying on earth, with trees, rocks as weapons, enraged, ranged the Rakshasa army.
data.anv: केचित् some, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, आकाशम् sky, आविश्य springing, केचित् some, उर्व्याम् staying on earth, सङ्कृद्धाः highly enraged, द्रुमशिलायुधाः trees and rocks as weapons, रक्षस्सैन्येषु Rakshasa army, चेरुः ranged.
data.md: Equipped with trees and stones, the monkeys enraged, ranged the Raksasa army, now rising into the sky, and now coming down to the earth. And some among the powerful monkeys went about taking broad-shouldered trees.

data.v: ते पादपशिलाशैलैश्चक्रुर्वृष्टिमनुत्तमाम् । बाणौघैर्वार्यमाणाश्च हरयो भीमविक्रमाः ॥
data.es: The Vanaras of dreadful valour and unparalleled might waged with trees, rock and mountain when obstructed by the Rakshasas॥
data.anv: बाणौघैः arrows, वार्यमाणाः heroic, भीमविक्रमाः of dreadful valour, ते those, हरयः monkeys, पादपशिलाश्शैलैः trees, rocks and mountains, अनूपमाम् unparalleled, वृष्टिम् rain, चक्रुः showered.

data.v: सिंहनादान्विनेदुश्च रणे राक्षसवानराः । शिलाभिश्चूर्णयामासुर्यातुधानान्प्लवंगमाः ॥
data.es: The Rakshasas and Vanaras enthusiastic in the battlefield roared like lion. The Vanaras pounded the Rakshasas with rocks.
data.anv: रणे in the battlefield, राक्षसवानराः Rakshasas and Vanaras, सिंहनादान् roaring like lions, विनेदुः enthusiastic, प्लवंवङ्गमाः Vanaras, यातुधानान् pounded, शिलाभिः rocks, चूर्णयामासुः crushed.

data.v: निजघ्नुः संयुगे क्रुद्धाः कवचाभरणावृतान् । केचिद्रथगतान्वीरान्गजवाजिगतानपि ॥
data.es: In the combat, the enraged Vanaras killed Rakshasas decked with shields and ornaments. Some killed the ones mounted on chariots, elephants, and horses.
data.anv: क्रुद्धाः angered, संयुगे in combat, कवचाभरणावृतान् decked with shields and ornaments, निर्जजघ्नुः killed, केचित् some, रथगतान् seated on chariots, वीरान् heroes, गजवाजिगतानपि mounted on elephants and horses.

data.v: निजघ्नुः सहसाप्लुत्य यातुधानान्प्लवंगमाः । शैलशृङ्गनिपातैश्च मुष्टिभिर्वान्तलोचनाः । चेलुः पेतुश्च नेदुश्च तत्र राक्षसपुंगवाः ॥
data.es: The Rakshasa leaders, hit by the blows of Vanaras, fell down on the mountain peaks, trembling with their eyes protruded by the blows of fists.
data.anv: प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, वीरान् leaders, यातुधानान् troop leaders, सहसा also, निर्जघ्नुः blows, तत्र there, ते they, राक्षसपुङ्गवाः Rakshasa leaders, शृङ्गाचितांङ्गाश्च bodies covered by mountain peak, मुष्टिभिः with fists, वान्तलोचनाः eyeballs protruded, चेलुः trembled, पेतुश्च shrieked, नेदुश्च fell down.
data.md: Smite with mountain-peaks on their persons, and with their eyes falling off, the foremost of Rakşasas moved, dropped down, or roared in the scene of conflict.

data.v: ततः शैलैश्च खड्गैश्च विसृष्टैर्हरिराक्षसैः । मुहूर्तेनावृता भूमिरभवच्छोणिताप्लुता ॥
data.es: "The earth will turn into a mass of flesh and blood and will be covered by the mountains and tridents hurled by Vanaras and Rakshasas."
data.anv: कपिराक्षसैः Vanaras and Rakshasas, विसृष्टैः hurled, शैलैः mountains, शूलैश्च tridents, खढगैश्च with swords, मांसशोणितकर्दमा covered with flesh and blood, भूमिः earth, आवृता turning to, भविष्यति will become.
data.md: In a moment the earth was covered with crags and swords discharged by monkeys and Raksasas, and was drenched in gore.

data.v: विकीर्णपर्वताकारै रक्षोभिररिमर्दनैः । आक्षिप्ताः क्षिप्यमाणाश्च भग्नशूलाश्च वानरैः ॥
data.es: There, the battlefield was filled with mountain like forms of Rakshasas drunk with the pride of warfare, lying scattered all over.
data.anv: तदा then, वसुमती earth, विकीर्णैः filled, पर्वताकारैः of mountain like, अभिमर्दितैः crushed, युद्धमदान्वितैः drunk pride of warfare, रक्षोभिः Rakshasas also, पूर्णा fully, आसीत् lying scattered.

data.v: वानरान्वानरैरेव जग्नुस्ते रजनीचराः । राक्षसान्राक्षसैरेव जघ्नुस्ते वानरा अपि ॥
data.es: The bull among Rakshasas struck at Vanaras with other Vanaras and the monkeys struck Rakshasas with other Rakshasas.
data.anv: ते they, नैरृतर्षभाः bull of Rakshasas, वानरान् at Vanaras, वानरैरेव with monkeys, जघ्नुः struck, वानराः Vanaras अपि and also, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, राक्षसैरेव with Rakshasas, जघ्नुः struck.

data.v: आक्षिप्य च शिलास्तेषां निजघ्नू राक्षसा हरीन् । तेषां चाच्छिद्य शस्त्राणि जघ्नू रक्षांसि वानराः ॥
data.es: The monkeys struck at the Rakshasas taking the weapons left over and tearing the weapons of the Rakshasas and the Vanaras also struck the Rakshasas.
data.anv: हरीन् monkeys, तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, शिलाः rocks, सेषाम् left over, आक्षिप्य taking, जघ्नुः struck, वानराः च Vanaras also, तेषाम् while they, शस्त्राणि weapons, आछचिद्य tearing, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, निजघ्नुः struck.

data.v: निजघ्नुः शैलशूलास्त्रैर्विभिदुश्च परस्परम् । सिंहनादान्विनेदुश्च रणे वानरराक्षसाः ॥
data.es: In the battlefield both Vanaras and Rakshasas struck at one another with their head, rocks and swords and emitted lion roar.
data.anv: रणे in the battlefield, वानरराक्षसा Vanaras and Rakshasas, शैलशूलान् with rocks and swords, परस्परम् one another, बिभुदुः struck, सिंहनादैः lion roar, विनेदुश्च emitted, निजघ्नु one another (with their head).

data.v: छिन्नवर्मतनुत्राणा राक्षसा वानरैर्हताः । रुधिरं प्रस्रुतास्तत्र रससारमिव द्रुमाः ॥
data.es: The Rakshasas killed by Vanaras, their shields and weapons broken, blood flowed from their limbs just as sap exudes from broken trees.
data.anv: वानरैः Vanaras, हताः killed, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, छिन्नवर्णतनुत्राणाः shields and weapons broken, द्रुमाः trees, रससारम् sap exudes from stem, तत्र there, रुधिरम् blood, प्रसृताः flowed.
data.md: The Rākşasas, slain by the monkeys, having their mail and defence for the body rent, bled like to trees exuding sap.

data.v: रथेन च रथं चापि वारणेन च वारणम् । हयेन च हयं केचिन्निजघ्नुर्वानरा रणे ॥
data.es: In the battlefield a chariot with another chariot, an elephant with another elephant, a horse with another horse struck one another.
data.anv: रणे in the battlefield, केचित् , some वानराः Vanaras, रथेन on chariot, रथम् another chariot, वारणेनापि elephant, वारणम् with another elephant, हयेन horse, हयम् with another horse, निजघ्नुः struck.
data.md: And in that encounter, some among the monkeys destroyed cars with cars, elephants with elephants, and steeds with steeds.

data.v: क्षुरप्रैरर्धचन्द्रैश्च भल्लैश्च निशितैः शरैः । राक्षसा वानरेन्द्राणां चिच्छिदुः पादपाञ्शिलाः ॥
data.es: Rakshasas shattered the Vanara leaders with horseshoe shaped, halfmoon shaped, spear shaped sharp arrows, as well as trees and rocks.
data.anv: राक्षसाः Rakshasa, क्षुरप्रैः horse shoe shaped, अर्धचन्द्रेःच halfmoon shaped, भल्लैश्च spear shaped heads, निशितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, वानरेन्द्राणाम् Vanara leaders, पादपान् trees, शिलाः rocks, बिभिदुः shattered.
data.md: The Raksasas rived the trees and rocks of the foremost monkeys by means of Kșurapras and crescents and sharpened Bhallas and arrows.

data.v: विकीर्णैः पर्वताग्रैश्च द्रुमैश्छिन्नैश्च संयुगे । हतैश्च कपिरक्षोभिर्दुर्गमा वसुधाभवत् ॥
data.es: The battlefield, covered with broken trees and mountains, fallen vanaras and rakshasas, seemed difficult to tread on ground.
data.anv: संयुगे in combat, तैः they, पर्वत mountains चिनैः broken, द्रुमैः trees, हतैः killed, कपिरक्षोभिः च Vanaras and Rakshasas, विकीर्णै covered, वसुधा earth, दुर्गमा difficult to tread, अभवत् seemed.
data.md: In that encounter the earth became impassable, having been scattered with crags baffled and severed trees and (warriors) slain by monkeys and Rākṣasa.

data.v: तस्मिन्प्रवृत्ते तुमुले विमर्दे; प्रहृष्यमाणेषु वली मुखेषु । निपात्यमानेषु च राक्षसेषु; महर्षयो देवगणाश्च नेदुः ॥
data.es: As the conflict progressed and tumultuous fighting was on, Vanaras were feeling exultant and seeing Rakshasas struck down the ascetics and Devatas made loud noises in joy.
data.anv: प्रवृत्ते as the fight progressed, तस्मिन् their, तुमुले tumultuous, विमर्धे crushed, वलीमुखेषु feeling exultant, प्रहृष्यमाणेषु rejoiced, राक्षसेषु Rakshasas too, निपात्यमानेषु were being struck down, महर्षयः ascetics, देवगणाः Devatas, श्चनेदुः made loud noise.
data.md: In that fearful conflict, which was being waged, on the monkeys having been exhilarated and the Rākşasas having been brought down, the Maharsis and the deities sent up shouts.

data.v: ततो हयं मारुततुल्यवेग;मारुह्य शक्तिं निशितां प्रगृह्य । नरान्तको वानरराजसैन्यं; महार्णवं मीन इवाविवेश ॥
data.es: Then Naranthaka, mounted on horseback went at wind speed taking hold of javelin and entered Vanara army just as fish entered the ocean.
data.anv: ततः then, नरान्तकः Naranthaka, मारुततुल्यवेगम् at wind speed, हयम् horse, आरुह्य mounting on top, निशिताम् sharp, शक्तिम् javelin, प्रगृह्य taking hold, मीनः fish, महार्णवम् इव like the ocean, वानरराजसैन्यम् Vanara kingdom army, आविवेश entered.
data.md: Then mounted on a charger endued with the celerity of the wind, and grasping a whetted dart, Narāntaka entered into that fierce army of monkeys, like a fish diving into the deep.

data.v: स वानरान्सप्तशतानि वीरः; प्रासेन दीप्तेन विनिर्बिभेद । एकः क्षणेनेन्द्ररिपुर्महात्मा; जघान सैन्यं हरिपुंगवानाम् ॥
data.es: Great hero (Naranthaka) single handed persistently destroyed seven hundred Vanaras with his glowing spear. In that way the enemy of Indra shattered Vanara army and monkey leaders.
data.anv: वीरः hero, महात्मा great, सः he, एकः alone, दीप्तेन glowing, प्रासेन spear, क्षणेन in a moment, सप्तशतानि seven hundred, वानरान् Vanaras, वनिर्बिभेद destroyed persistently, इन्द्ररिपुः Indra's enemy, हरिपुङ्गवानाम् monkey leaders, सैन्यम् army, जघान shattered.
data.md: That hero by means of an effulgent bearded dart pierced seven hundred monkeys, and at one time the high-souled enemy of Indra slew the army of the foremost of monkeys.

data.v: ददृशुश्च महात्मानं हयपृष्ठे प्रतिष्ठितम् । चरन्तं हरिसैन्येषु विद्याधरमहर्षयः ॥
data.es: Vidhyadhara, the great sage, witnessed Naranthaka moving seated on the horseback firmly.
data.anv: विद्याधरमहर्षयः sage Vidhyadhara, हयपृष्ठेप्रतिष्ठितम् seated on horseback firmly, हरिसैन्येषु monkey army too, चरन्तम् moving, महात्मानम् great, ददृशुः witnessed.
data.md: The Vidyadharas and Maharsis saw that highsouled one mounted on horseback, ranging the monkey-ranks.

data.v: स तस्य ददृशे मार्गो मांसशोणितकर्दमः । पतितैः पर्वताकारैर्वानरैरभिसंवृतः ॥
data.es: On the way he saw flesh and blood fallen like a heap of a mountain covered fully with Vanaras.
data.anv: मांसशोणितकर्दमः flesh and blood like mire, पतितैः fallen, पर्वताकारैः like a mountain in shape, वानरैः Vanaras, अभिसंवृतः covered fully, तस्य their, सःमार्गः on the way, ददृशे saw.
data.md: His course was discovered, miry with flesh and blood and blocked up with mountain-like monkeys fallen.

data.v: यावद्विक्रमितुं बुद्धिं चक्रुः प्लवगपुंगवाः । तावदेतानतिक्रम्य निर्बिभेद नरान्तकः ॥
data.es: Naranthaka went past the Vanara leaders all over even before they attempted, he destroyed them.
data.anv: प्लवगपुङ्गवाः leaders of monkeys, विक्रमितुम् going past, यावत् all over, बुधदिम् before knowing, चक्रुः went, तावदेव before their attempt, एतान् them, अतिक्रम्य overcoming, नरान्तकः Naranthaka, निर्बिभेद destroyed.
data.md: When the monkeys set their hearts on displaying their prowess, Narāntaka, baffling them, pierced them with shafts.

data.v: ज्वलन्तं प्रासमुद्यम्य संग्रामान्ते नरान्तकः । ददाह हरिसैन्यानि वनानीव विभावसुः ॥
यावदुत्पाटयामासुर्वृक्षाञ्शैलान्वनौकसः । तावत्प्रासहताः पेतुर्वज्रकृत्ता इवाचलाः ॥
data.es: Uplifting his lance in the battle, Naranthaka consumed the Vanara troops as fire would burn up forests even before the Vanaras uprooted trees and rocks. many Vanaras fell like mountains hit by a thunderbolt.
data.anv: विभावसुः like burning, वनानीव forests, हरिसैन्यानि Vanara army, ददाह burnt, वनौकसः Vanaras, वृक्षान् trees, शैलान् rocks, यावत everything, उत्पाटयामासुः uplifting, तावत् many, प्रासहताः lance, वज्रकृत्ताः like thunderbolt, अचलाःइव mountain like, पेतुः fell.
data.md: He consumed the monkey-army, like fire burning a forest. And when the wood-rangers uprooted trees and crags, they slain by bearded darts dropped down like mountains riven by the thunder.

data.v: दिक्षु सर्वासु बलवान्विचचार नरान्तकः । प्रमृद्नन्सर्वतो युद्धे प्रावृट्काले यथानिलः ॥
data.es: Mighty Naranthaka, the destroyer of humans, ranged over all sides in all directions in the battlefield, like the wind in the rainy season, taking a burning spear and crushing everything.
data.anv: नरान्तकः Naranthaka, बलवान् mighty, नरान्तकः capable of killing humans, सङ्ग्रामान्ते in the battle, ज्वलन्तम् burning, प्रासम् spear, उद्यम्य taking up, युद्धे in battle, अनिलः wind, प्रावृटकालेइव like in the rainy season, सर्वतः everything, प्रमृद्नन् crushing, सर्वासु all sides, दिक्षु directions, विचचार ranged about.
data.md: Raising a glowing prasa, the powerful Narāntaka began to range about in the rear of the forces; dashing everywhere (against the foe) in fight, like the wind in the rainy season. *Sangramānte, I presume, means rear of the forces; although literally it means, at the conclusion of the conflict, because this interpretation would not be proper, the battle being now at its hottest.

data.v: न शेकुर्धावितुं वीरा न स्थातुं स्पन्दितुं कुतः । उत्पतन्तं स्थितं यान्तं सर्वान्विव्याध वीर्यवान् ॥
data.es: The gallant monkeys got terrified and could not flee, nor stand, nor move. The audacious Naranthaka marching ahead pierced the Vanaras either marching or jumping or stationary.
data.anv: वीराः gallant, र्भाषितुम् terrified, न शेकुः not flee, स्थातुम् stand, न not, स्पन्दितुम् move, भयात् out of fear, वीर्यवान् audacious, उत्पतन्तम् jumping up, स्थितम् stationary, यान्तम् marching, सर्वान् all, विव्याध pierced.
data.md: The heroes could not appear prominently, or keep their posts. And how could they then move freely? And that one endued with prowess pierced everyone, whether springing, or staying, or moving.

data.v: एकेनान्तककल्पेन प्रासेनादित्यतेजसा । भिन्नानि हरिसैन्यानि निपेतुर्धरणीतले ॥
data.es: With lance that looked like death and the spear glowing like the Sun, Naranthaka routed the Vanaras, who fell down.
data.anv: अनन्तकल्पेन lance which was like death, एकेन alone, आदित्यतेजसा glowing like the Sun, प्रासेन spear, हरिसैन्यानि at Vanara army, भग्नानि routed, धरणीतले on the ground, निपेतुः fell.
data.md: Broken through by a single praśa, resembling the Reaper, and furnished with solar effulgence, the monkey-ranks began to roll on the earth.

data.v: वज्रनिष्पेषसदृशं प्रासस्याभिनिपातनम् । न शेकुर्वानराः सोढुं ते विनेदुर्महास्वनम् ॥
data.es: Unable to bear the very severe impact of the strike of the spear which was like the strike of thunderbolt the Vanaras cried making loud noise.
data.anv: ते those, वानराः Vanaras, वज्रनिष्पेषसदृशम् like the strike of thunderbolt, प्रासस्य spear's, अभिनिपातनम् very severe, सोढुम् impact, न शेकुः not bear, महास्वनम् very loud voice, विनेदुः cried.
data.md: The monkeys were ill fitted to bear the impetus of that präśa having the touch of thunder itself; and they raised a loud cry.

data.v: पततां हरिवीराणां रूपाणि प्रचकाशिरे । वज्रभिन्नाग्रकूटानां शैलानां पततामिव ॥
data.es: The forms of the monkey heroes fallen down unconscious shone like mountain peaks struck by the thunderbolt and fallen.
data.anv: पतताम् fallen, हरिवीराणाम् monkey heroes, रूपाणि forms, वज्रभिन्नाग्रकूटानाम् like mountain peaks struck by thunderbolt, पतताम् fallen, शैलानाम् इव like mountains, प्रचकाशिरे shone.
data.md: The appearances of those monkey-heroes falling were like mountains toppling, having their summits riven with the thunder-bolt.

data.v: ये तु पूर्वं महात्मानः कुम्भकर्णेन पातिताः । तेऽस्वस्था वानरश्रेष्ठाः सुग्रीवमुपतस्थिरे ॥
data.es: The Vanaras who were struck by Kumbhakarna and fallen unconscious, came and stood before Sugriva.
data.anv: पूर्वम् earlier, ये by, महात्मानः great soul, कुम्भकर्णेन Kumbhakarna, पातिताः struck, ते those, वानरश्रेष्ठाः foremost of Vanaras, स्वस्थाः for their part, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, उपतस्थिरे stood before.
data.md: Those high-souled and powerful monkeys that formerly had been brought down by Kumbhakarma, having recovered, were present with Sugrīva in this encounter.

data.v: विप्रेक्षमाणः सुग्रीवो ददर्श हरिवाहिनीम् । नरान्तकभयत्रस्तां विद्रवन्तीमितस्ततः ॥
data.es: Sugriva looked around all over the monkey troops running here and there out of fear of Naranthaka.
data.anv: विप्रेक्षमाणः looking all around, सःसुग्रीवः that Sugriva, नरान्तकभयत्रस्ताम् fear of Naranthaka, इतस्ततः here and there, विद्रवन्तीम् running, हरिवाहिनीम् monkey troops, ददर्श saw.
data.md: Sugrīva, looking around, saw that monkeyarmy flying in all directions, agitated with the fear of Narantaka.

data.v: विद्रुतां वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा स ददर्श नरान्तकम् । गृहीतप्रासमायान्तं हयपृष्ठे प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
data.es: (Sugriva) saw the Vanaras troops running and Naranthaka seated on horseback advancing with a spear.
data.anv: सः he, Sugriva, विद्रुताम् running, वाहिनीम् troops, दृष्टवा seeing, गृहीतप्रासम् taking hold of spear, हयपृष्ठेप्रतिष्ठितम् seated on horseback, आयान्तम् advancing, नरान्तकम् Naranthaka, ददर्श saw.
data.md: After seeing the army in flight, he saw Narāntaka himself, advancing, wielding a prasa, and mounted on a steed.

data.v: अथोवाच महातेजाः सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः । कुमारमङ्गदं वीरं शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमम् ॥
data.es: Sugriva, the Lord of Vanaras seeing (Naranthaka advancing) spoke to his son Angada who resembled Indra in valour.
data.anv: महातेजाः highly energetic, वानराधिपः Lord of Vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, अथ now, वीरम् gallant, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमम् who resembled Indra in valour, कुमारम् son, अङ्गदम् Angada, उवाच spoke.
data.md: As soon as he saw (that hero), the exceedingly energetic lord of monkeys, Sugriva addressed the heroic prince Angada endowed with strength equal to that of Indra, saying.

data.v: गच्छैनं राक्षसं वीर योऽसौ तुरगमास्थितः । क्षोभयन्तं हरिबलं क्षिप्रं प्राणैर्वियोजय ॥
data.es: "Oh! March ahead and immediately release the life of the Rakshasa seated on horseback terrifying the Vanara army."
data.anv: गच्छै march, असौ Oh, तुरगम् horse, आस्थितः seated there, हरिबलम् Vanara army, त्वम् you, क्षोभयन्तम् terrifying, एनम् these, वीरः heroes, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, क्षिप्रम् immediately, प्राणैः life, वियोजय relieve.
data.md: Go against this heroic Raksasas that is mounted on a steed; and speedily deprive of life that one who is devouring up the ranks of his foes.

data.v: स भर्तुर्वचनं श्रुत्वा निष्पपाताङ्गदस्तदा । अनीकान्मेघसंकाशान्मेघानीकादिवांशुमान् ॥
data.es: On hearing the king's words, Angada went just as the sun rays comes out of a cluster of clouds.
data.anv: तदा then, वीर्यवान् heroic, सःअङ्गदः that angada, भर्तुः king's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, मेघसङ्काशात् resembling cluster of clouds, अनीकात् Sun, अंशुमानिव rays, निष्पपात comes out.
data.md: Hearing his master's speech, Angada descended from that host resembling clouds, like the powerful Sun himself.

data.v: शैलसंघातसंकाशो हरीणामुत्तमोऽङ्गदः । रराजाङ्गदसंनद्धः सधातुरिव पर्वतः ॥
data.es: Angada, the best of the Vanaras, adorned with arm lets resembled masses of rocks and shone like a mountain with metal streaks.
data.anv: शैलसङ्घातसङ्काशः who resembled mass of rocks, हरीणाम् Vanaras, उत्तमः best, अङ्गदसन्नद्धः Angada adorned with armlets, अङ्गदः Angada, सधातुः metal streaks, पर्वतःइव like mountain, रराज shone.
data.md: And resembling a mass of crags, Angada-foremost of monkeys, Adorned with Angadas, appeared beautiful like a mountain with metals on it.

data.v: निरायुधो महातेजाः केवलं नखदंष्ट्रवान् । नरान्तकमभिक्रम्य वालिपुत्रोऽब्रवीद्वचः ॥
data.es: Brilliant Angada, unarmed only with nails and teeth (to fight) advanced towards Naranthaka and spoke these words.
data.anv: निरायुधः deprived of any weapon, महातेजाः brilliant, केवलम् with only, नखदंष्ट्रवान् nails and teeth, वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, नरान्तकम् Naranthakam, अभिक्रम्य advancing towards, वचः words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
data.md: And weaponless himself, and furnished only with nails and teeth, Vali's son attacking Narāntaka, said.

data.v: तिष्ठ किं प्राकृतैरेभिर्हरिभिस्त्वं करिष्यसि । अस्मिन्वज्रसमस्पर्शे प्रासं क्षिप ममोरसि ॥
data.es: "Stop! What can you do with these common monkeys? Throw your spear at me, which equals thunderbolt."
data.anv: तिष्ठ stop, एभिः with these, प्राकृतैः common, हरिभिः monkeys, त्वम् you, किम् what, करिष्यसि can you do, मम me, अस्मिन् with you, वज्रसमस्पर्शम् spear equalling thunderbolt, प्रासम् spear, क्षिप throw.
data.md: Stay! What shall you do with these inferior monkeys? This prasa, having the feel of the thunder-bolt, do you hurl at my heart itself.

data.v: अङ्गदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रचुक्रोध नरान्तकः । संदश्य दशनैरोष्ठं निश्वस्य च भुजंगवत् ॥
data.md: Hearing Angada's words, Narāntaka was fired with wrath. And knawing his upper lip with his teeth and sighing like a serpent, Narāntaka, wrought with wrath, approached Vali's son.

data.v: स प्रासमाविध्य तदाङ्गदाय; समुज्ज्वलन्तं सहसोत्ससर्ज । स वालिपुत्रोरसि वज्रकल्पे; बभूव भग्नो न्यपतच्च भूमौ ॥
data.md: Then whirling his praśa, he suddenly discharged that flaming (weapon) against Argada. And then it was snapped on the breast of Vali's son, resembling the thunder-bolt, and dropped to the earth.

data.v: तं प्रासमालोक्य तदा विभग्नं; सुपर्णकृत्तोरगभोगकल्पम् । तलं समुद्यम्य स वालिपुत्र;स्तुरंगमस्याभिजघान मूर्ध्नि ॥
data.es: Then Vali's son beholding the broken and shattered spear fallen like the coils of serpent, raised his palm and struck at the head of Naranthaka's horse.
data.anv: सःवालिपुत्रः that Vali's son, तदा then, विभग्नम् broken and fallen, सुवर्णकृत्तोरगभोगकल्पम् like the coils of the serpent, प्रासम् spear, आलोक्य beholding, तलम् palm, उद्यम्य raising, तुरङ्गमस्य at the horse, मूर्ध्नि at the head, तस्यजघान struck at.
data.md: Seeing the praśa broken in pieces, like a powerful snake severed by Suparna, Vāli's son, raising his hand, dealt a slap at the head of his (Narāntaka's) steed.

data.v: निमग्नपादः स्फुटिताक्षि तारो; निष्क्रान्तजिह्वोऽचलसंनिकाशः । स तस्य वाजी निपपात भूमौ; तलप्रहारेण विकीर्णमूर्धा ॥
data.es: His horse, which closely resembled a mountain, fell on the ground, its head broken, cheeks drawn in, eyeballs broken, tongue got ejected by the stroke of the palm of Angada.
data.anv: तस्य his, अचलसन्नकाशः closely resembling mountain, सःवाजी that Angada, तलप्रहारेण by the stroke of the palm, विशीर्णमूर्धा head broken, निमग्नतालुः cheeks drawn in, स्फुटिताक्षितारः eyeballs broken, निष्क्रान्तजिह्वः tongue ejected, भूमौ on ground, निपपात fell.
data.md: Thereat, with his legs sinking down and his eye-balls coming off and his tongue hanging down, and wearing the look of a mountain, on being smite with that slap, Narāntaka's steed fell down to the ground, with its head lying at random.

data.v: नरान्तकः क्रोधवशं जगाम; हतं तुरगं पतितं निरीक्ष्य । स मुष्टिमुद्यम्य महाप्रभावो; जघान शीर्षे युधि वालिपुत्रम् ॥
data.es: Observing the horse fallen, Naranthaka, endowed with great power, overcome by anger raised his fist and struck at the head of Vali's son.
data.anv: हतम् killed, पतितम् fallen, तुरङ्गम् horse, निरीक्ष्य observing, नरान्तकः Naranthaka, क्रोधवशम् overcome by anger, जगाम went, महाप्रभावः great power, सः he, मुष्टिम् fist, उद्यम्य raising, युधि battle, वालिपुत्रम् Vali's son, शीर्षे head, जघान struck.
data.md: Narāntaka seeing his charger slain and fallen, was seized with a furious wrath, and raising his clenched fist, that one endowed with exceeding great energy in that conflict hit Vāll's son on the head.

data.v: अथाङ्गदो मुष्टिविभिन्नमूर्धा; सुस्राव तीव्रं रुधिरं भृशोष्णम् । मुहुर्विजज्वाल मुमोह चापि; संज्ञां समासाद्य विसिष्मिये च ॥
data.es: Angada's head smashed by the blow of the fist of Naranthaka, hot blood flowed rapidly for a while. Recovering from delusion, gaining consciousness he wondered at the strength of Naranthaka.
data.anv: अथ now, मुष्टिविशीर्णमूर्धा head smashed by the blow of the fist, अङ्गदः Angada, भृशोष्णम् burning sensation, रुधिरम् blood, तीव्रम् intensely, सुस्राव flowed rapidly, मुहुः for a while, विजज्वाल recovering, मुमोहचापि from delusion, संज्ञाम् recovering, समासाद्य consciousness, विसिष्मिये च wondered.
data.md: Thereat Angada having his head wounded by that blow, warm blood gushed out plentifully. And momentarily burning and momentarily swooning he, regaining his senses, was amazed.

data.v: अथाङ्गदो वज्रसमानवेगं; संवर्त्य मुष्टिं गिरिशृङ्गकल्पम् । निपातयामास तदा महात्मा; नरान्तकस्योरसि वालिपुत्रः ॥
data.es: Angada clenching his fist, whose vehemence was equal to vehemence of death coming down from the top of the mountain peak, brought down Naranthaka.
data.anv: अथ now, महात्मा great, वालिपुत्रः son of Vali, अङ्गदः Angada, तदा then, मृत्युसमानवेगम् equalling vehemence of death, गिरिशृङ्गकल्पम् mountain peak, मुष्टिम् fist, संवर्त्य clenching, नरान्तकस्य Naranthaka's, उपिरि top, निपातयामास brought.
data.md: Then Vāli's son, the high-souled Angada clenching his fist into a blow resembling Death itself in energy, and like to a mountain-peak, let it descend on the chest of Narāntaka.

data.v: स मुष्टिनिष्पिष्टविभिन्नवक्षा; ज्वालां वमञ्शोणितदिग्धगात्रः । नरान्तको भूमितले पपात; यथाचलो वज्रनिपातभग्नः ॥
data.es: Naranthaka's chest having been split by a blow on his chest, vomiting flaming blood from his throat was as if shattered by the stroke of lightning fell down like a mountain.
data.anv: सःनरान्तकः that Naranthaka, मुष्टिनिष्पिष्टविभिन्नवक्षाः chest having been split by the blow of the fist, ज्वालाः flaming, वमन् vomit, शोणितदिग्धगात्रः blood from throat, वज्रनिपातभग्नः shattered by stroke of lightning, अचलःयथा like mountain, पपात fell.
data.md: Thereat, with his breast riven and broken down, vomiting flames and having his body bathed in blood, Narāntaka dropped down to the earth, like a hill shattered by the impetus of the thunder-bolt.

data.v: अथान्तरिक्षे त्रिदशोत्तमानां; वनौकसां चैव महाप्रणादः । बभूव तस्मिन्निहतेऽग्र्यवीरे; नरान्तके वालिसुतेन संख्ये ॥
data.es: Naranthaka, the foremost of the heroes, having been killed in combat, the Devatas and gods of the three worlds experienced great joy.
data.anv: अग्रवीर्ये of foremost among heroes, तस्मिन् his, नरान्तके Naranthaka, संख्ये in combat, वालिसुतेन by Vali's son, निहते killed, अथा and then, अन्तरिक्षे sky, त्रिदशोत्तमानाम् Devatas and gods of three worlds, वनौकसांचैव including Vanaras, महान् great, प्रणादः happiness, बभूव radiated.
data.md: On Narāntaka of exceeding prowess having been slain by Vali's son in battle, there arose a tremendous uproar in the firmament from the wood-rangers and the foremost of celestials.

data.v: अथाङ्गदो राममनः प्रहर्षणं; सुदुष्करं तं कृतवान्हि विक्रमम् । विसिष्मिये सोऽप्यतिवीर्य विक्रमः; पुनश्च युद्धे स बभूव हर्षितः ॥
data.md: Angada having performed that difficult deed of prowess, capable of delighting the mind of Rāma, was seized with amazement;* and that one of terrific feats in fight was again inspired with delight in the encounter. * Probably, at his own prowess.

data.v: नरान्तकं हतं दृष्ट्वा चुक्रुशुर्नैरृतर्षभाः । देवान्तकस्त्रिमूर्धा च पौलस्त्यश्च महोदरः ॥
data.es: Seeing the bulls among Rakshasas Naranthaka, Devanthaka, Trisira and Mahodara a scion of Paulastya and Mahodara, killed the Rakshasas cried aloud.
data.anv: नरान्तकम् Naranthaka, हतम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, नैरृतर्षभाः bull among Rakshasas, देवान्तकः Devanthaka, त्रिमूर्धा च Trisira, पौलस्त्यः of Paulastya, महोदरः च and Mahodara, चुक्रुशुः cried aloud.
data.md: Seeing Narāntaka slain, the foremost of Naiſtas-including the three-headed Devāntaka and Pulastya's descendant, Mahodara, began to cry (in chorus).

data.v: आरूढो मेघसंकाशं वारणेन्द्रं महोदरः । वालिपुत्रं महावीर्यमभिदुद्राव वीर्यवान् ॥
data.es: Mahodara who closely resembled a cloud, mounted on the best of elephants chased brave and courageous son of Vali.
data.anv: महोदरः Mahodara, मेघसङ्काशम् resembling cloud, वारणेन्द्रम् best of elephants, आरूढः mounted, वीर्यवान् courageous, महावीर्यम् brave, वालिपुत्रम् Vali's son, अभिदुद्राव chased.
data.md: Then the vehement Mahodara, mounted (on horseback), rushed against Vali's son endued with energy.

data.v: भ्रातृव्यसनसंतप्तस्तदा देवान्तको बली । आदाय परिघं दीप्तमङ्गदं समभिद्रवत् ॥
data.es: Then, powerful Devanthaka who was immersed in grief of his brother, taking hold of a glowing iron bar rushed forward towards Angada.
data.anv: तदा then, भ्रातृव्यसनसन्तप्तः immersed in the grief of brother, बली powerful, देवान्तकः Devanthaka, दीप्तम् glowing, परिघम् iron bar, आदाय taking hold of, अङ्गदम् at Angada, समभिद्रवत् rushed forward.
data.md: Aggrieved in consequence of the calamity that had befallen his brother, the strong Devāntaka grasping a dreadful bludgeon, darted against Angada.

data.v: रथमादित्यसंकाशं युक्तं परमवाजिभिः । आस्थाय त्रिशिरा वीरो वालिपुत्रमथाभ्ययात् ॥
data.es: Then Trisira, seated on the chariot, effulgent as the Sun, yoked to the best horse marched towards Angada.
data.anv: अथ and then, वीरः hero, त्रिशिराः Trisira, वाजिभिः best horse, युक्तम् yoked, आदित्यसङ्काशम् effulgent as the Sun, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय taking seat, वालिपुत्रम् Vali's son, अभ्ययात् marched.
data.md: Ascending a car resembling the Sun yoked with superb steeds, the heroic Triģiras rushed against Vali's son.

data.v: स त्रिभिर्देवदर्पघ्नैर्नैरृतेन्द्रैरभिद्रुतः । वृक्षमुत्पाटयामास महाविटपमङ्गदः ॥
data.es: Angada observed that all the three chiefs of Rakshasas, who were capable of crushing the pride of gods marching towards him and uprooted a huge tree.

data.v: अथ शक्तिं समादाय कालरात्रिमिवान्तकः । चिक्षेपानिलपुत्राय त्रिशिरा रावणात्मजः ॥
data.es: In the same manner, Trisira, the son of Ravana sprung up and seized a javelin, just as God of death in dark night and hurled at the son of wind god and shattered.
data.anv: तथ in the same way, रावणात्मजः Ravana's son, त्रिशिराः Trisira, अन्तकः Death, काळरात्रिम् इव like Kalaratri (Kaala, the deity presiding over the night of dissolution) शक्तिम् javelin, समादाय seizing, अनिलपुत्राय at the son of wind god, चिक्षेप shattered.
data.md: Then taking a dart even as the destroyer employ the fatal night, Ravana's son, TriSiras discharged it at the offspring of the wind-god.

data.v: दिवि क्षिप्तामिवोल्कां तां शक्तिं क्षिप्तामसंगताम् । गृहीत्वा हरिशार्दूलो बभञ्ज च ननाद च ॥
data.es: Hanuman, the best of monkeys, snapped the javelin flung by Trisira on him, which came down unobstructed like a meteor from heaven and the monkeys roared.
data.anv: हरिश्रेष्ठः best of the monkeys, दिवः heaven, क्षिप्ताम् flung, उल्कामिव like a meteor, तांशक्तिम् that javelin, असङ्गताम् obstructed, गृहीत्वा taking, बभञ्ज च snapped, ननाद च and roared.
data.md: Thereat catching the dart of resistless course as it descended from the sky, the powerful monkey snapped it and then shouted.

data.v: तां दृष्ट्वा घोरसंकाशां शक्तिं भग्नां हनूमता । प्रहृष्टा वानरगणा विनेदुर्जलदा इव ॥
data.es: Seeing the dreadful form of shattered javelin, all Vanaras rejoiced and thundered like rain clouds.
data.anv: घोरसङ्काशाम् dreadful form, तांशक्तिम् of that javelin, हनूमता by Hanuman, भग्नाम् shattered, दृष्टवा seeing, प्रहृष्टाःवानरगणाः all Vanaras rejoiced, जलदाःइव like the rain clouds, विनेदुः thundered.
data.md: Seeing that dreadful dart broken by Hanumān, the monkeys, transported with delignt, sent up shouts, even as clouds rumble.

data.v: ततः खड्गं समुद्यम्य त्रिशिरा राक्षसोत्तमः । निचखान तदा रोषाद्वानरेन्द्रस्य वक्षसि ॥
data.es: Trisira, the foremost of Rakshasas then lifted his sword, placed it on the chest of Hanuman and dug into it.
data.anv: राक्षसोत्तमः foremost of Rakshasas, त्रिशिराः Trisira, ततः that, व्यूढं placed, समुद्यम्य lifting up, तदा then, खडगम् sword, वायुपुत्रस्य into son of wind god, वक्षसि chest of, निजघा dug into.
data.md: Then upraising his sword, that foremost of Raksasas-Trisiras-brought it down on the breast of the monkey-chief.

data.v: खड्गप्रहाराभिहतो हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः । आजघान त्रिमूर्धानं तलेनोरसि वीर्यवान् ॥
data.es: Heroic Hanuman hit by Trisira, attacked him with his palm on the chest.
data.anv: खडगप्रहाराभिहतः hit by sword, वीर्यवान् hero, मारुतात्मजः wind god's son, हनुमान् Hanuman, तलेन palm, तिशिरसम् Trisira, उरसि chest, आजघान attacked.
data.md: Overpowered with the sword-blow, Hanumān son to the wind-god, endowed with energy, dealt the three-headed one a slap on the head.

data.v: स तलभिहतस्तेन स्रस्तहस्ताम्बरो भुवि । निपपात महातेजास्त्रिशिरास्त्यक्तचेतनः ॥
data.es: Trisira, a highly energetic one, hit by Hanuman with his palm, dropped the weapon from his hand, lost his senses and fell on the ground.
data.anv: महातेजाः highly energetic, सःत्रिशिराः that Trisira, तेन by that, तलाभिहतः hit by palm, स्रस्तहस्तायुधः weapon dropped from hand, त्यक्तचेतनः senses lost, भुवि ground, निपपात fell.
data.md: And smitten with that slap, the highly powerful Triśiras, with his hands and attire dropping off, fell down to the earth, deprived of consciousness.

data.v: स तस्य पततः खड्गं समाच्छिद्य महाकपिः । ननाद गिरिसंकाशस्त्रासयन्सर्वनैरृतान् ॥
data.es: Taking the sword from Trisira, as he was falling, the great Vanara who resembled a mountain roared, creating terror in all, surrounded there.
data.anv: रिसङ्काशः who resembled mountain, सः he, महाकपिः great Vanara, पततः falling down, तस्य his, तंखङ्गम् that sword, अच्छिद्य taking, सर्वनारृता all those surrounded, त्रासयन् creating terror, ननाद roared.
data.md: Then that mighty monkey-resembling a hill broke his sword as he fell, and roared, terrifying all the Raksasas.

data.v: अमृष्यमाणस्तं घोषमुत्पपात निशाचरः । उत्पत्य च हनूमन्तं ताडयामास मुष्टिना ॥
data.es: Unable to bear that roar, that Rakshasa got up jumping and struck Hanuman with his fist.
data.anv: निशाचरः Rakshasa, तंघोषम् that roar, अमृष्यमाणः unable to bear, उत्पपात got up, उत्पत्य jumping, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, मुष्टिना fist, ताडयामास struck.
data.md: But not brooking that uproar, that night-ranger sprang up; and springing up, he dealt a blow at Hanuman.

data.v: तेन मुष्टिप्रहारेण संचुकोप महाकपिः । कुपितश्च निजग्राह किरीटे राक्षसर्षभम् ॥
data.es: The great monkey hit by the fist (of Trisira) became furious and in anger he got hold of Trisira's head with crown.
data.anv: महाकपिः great monkey, तेन by that, मुष्टिप्रहारेण by the hit with fist, सञ्चुकोप became furious, कुपितः च and angry, राक्षसर्षभम् bull among Rakshasas, किरीटे crown, निजग्राह got hold of.
data.md: At that blow, the redoubtable monkey was wrought up with wrath; and inflamed with rage, he smote that foremost of Räkşasas about his diadem.

data.v: स तस्य शीर्षाण्यसिना शितेन; किरीटजुष्टानि सकुण्डलानि । क्रुद्धः प्रचिच्छेद सुतोऽनिलस्य; त्वष्टुः सुतस्येव शिरांसि शक्रः ॥
data.es: Enraged wind god's son, cut off the three heads of Trisira adorned with earrings just as Indra cut off the heads of Vishwarupa, son of Twashta.
data.anv: क्रुद्धः enraged, सः he, अनिलस्यसुतः wind god's son, तस्य his, कीरीटजुष्टानि along with crown, सकुण्डलानि and earrings, शीर्षाणि three heads (of Vishwarupa), शक्रः Indra, त्वष्टुः Twashsta's, सुतस्य son's, शिरांसिइव three heads like that, शितेन sharp, असिना cut off, प्रचिच्छेद severed.
data.md: Then with a sharp sword the wind-god's son cut off his heads decked with diadems and furnished with ear-rings; even as Sakra had severed the heads of Tastri' son.* *Visvarupa.

data.v: तान्यायताक्षाण्यगसंनिभानि; प्रदीप्तवैश्वानरलोचनानि । पेतुः शिरांसीन्द्ररिपोर्धरण्यां; ज्योतींषि मुक्तानि यथार्कमार्गात् ॥
data.es: The heads of Trisira, an enemy of Indra, resembling mountains with incongruous eyes glowing like Vyshvanara's eyes, fell into wilderness like stars fallen from the path of Sun.
data.anv: आयताक्षाणि incongruous eyes, अगसन्निभानि resembling mountains, प्रदीप्तवैश्वानरलोचनानि glowing like Vyshvanara's eyes, इन्द्ररिपोः Indra's enemy, तानिशिरांसि those heads, अर्कमार्गात् from the path of the Sun, मुक्तानि like pearls, ज्योतींषियथा like stars, अरण्याम् wilderness, पेतुः fallen.
data.md: Thereat even as burning stars, loosened, drop down from the course of Indra, the large organs of sense, and eyes flaming like glowing fire, and heads of that foe of Indra, dropped down to the ground.

data.v: तस्मिन्हते देवरिपौ त्रिशीर्षे; हनूमत शक्रपराक्रमेण । नेदुः प्लवंगाः प्रचचाल भूमी; रक्षांस्यथो दुद्रुविरे समन्तात् ॥
data.es: Trisira, the enemy of gods, endowed with the prowess of Indra got killed by Hanuman. The earth shook, the monkeys roared and the Rakshasas from all sides took to their heels.
data.anv: देवरिपौ enemy of gods, तस्मिन् his, त्रिशीर्षे Trisira's, शक्रपराक्रमेण endowed with the prowess of Indra, हनूमता Hanuman, हते killed, प्लवंगाः monkeys, नेदुः roared, भूमिः earth, प्रचचाल shook, अथो and, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, समन्तात् in all sides, दुद्रुविरे took to their heels.
data.md: On Trisiras, enemy of the immortals-having been slain by Hanuman endowed with the prowess itself of Sakra, the monkeys shouted, the earth shook, and the Rākṣas began to fly on all sides.

data.v: हतं त्रिशिरसं दृष्ट्वा तथैव च महोदरम् । हतौ प्रेक्ष्य दुराधर्षौ देवान्तकनरान्तकौ ॥
data.es: Witnessing Trisira killed, earlier Mahodara also, Devanthaka and Naranthaka who are difficult to encounter killed, monkeys roared in joy seeing that Matta became very angry.
